entries.en: The city of commerce built its wealth on four major factors. One is the freetrade agreement with the thaian kingdom to which they in theory belong. This ensures trade with all cities, cultures and lands, known or yet to be discovered. Often seen as a separate law but actually part of the free trade agreement is the gambling licence, that is unique in the Thaian Kingdom, because 'commercial' gambling is outlawed since the times of king Yorik I.
entries.translated: La ciudad del comercio construyó su riqueza sobre la base de cuatro factores principales. Uno es el acuerdo de libre comercio con el reino tailandés al que en teoría pertenecen. Esto asegura el comercio con todas las ciudades, culturas y tierras, conocidas o aún por descubrir. A menudo vista como una ley separada, pero en realidad parte del acuerdo de libre comercio es la licencia de juego, que es única en el Reino de Tailandia, porque el juego 'commercial' está prohibido desde los tiempos del rey Yorik I.

entries.en: This does not have to happen to you again!
entries.translated: ¡Esto no tiene por qué volver a pasarte!

entries.en: The first rider of this mount became the leader of his country! legends say that.
entries.translated: Первый наездник на этом скакуне стал лидером своей страны! легенды говорят об этом.

entries.en: Are you hunted? Tired of that? Get a new name, a new life!
entries.translated: На тебя охотятся? Устали от этого? Получите новое имя, новую жизнь!

entries.en: A new name to suit your needs!
This outfit looks nice. Only high-class people are able to wear it!
entries.translated: Этот наряд выглядит красиво. Его могут носить только люди высокого класса!

entries.en: An outfit that was created to suit you. We are sure you'll like it.
entries.translated: Одежда, созданная специально для вас. Мы уверены, вам понравится.

entries.en: Legend says only smart people should wear it, otherwise you will burn!
entries.translated: Легенда гласит, что его должны носить только умные люди, иначе сгоришь!

entries.en: You activated a prey but do not like the randomly selected bonus? Roll for a new one! Here you can purchase five Prey Bonus Rerolls! \nA Bonus Reroll allows you to get a bonus with a higher value (max. 50%). The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The 2 hours hunting time will start anew once you have rolled for a new bonus. Your prey monster will stay the same.
entries.translated: Вы активировали добычу, но вам не нравится случайно выбранный бонус? Катайтесь за новым! Здесь вы можете приобрести пять бонусных рероллов Prey! \nA Bonus Reroll позволяет получить бонус более высокого значения (максимум 50%). Бонус для вашей добычи будет выбран случайным образом из одного из следующих: увеличение урона, уменьшение урона, бонусный опыт, улучшенная добыча. 2-часовое время охоты начнется заново, как только вы получите новый бонус. Ваш монстр-жертва останется прежним.

entries.en: It's hunting season! Activate a prey to gain a bonus when hunting a certain monster. Every character can purchase one Permanent Prey Slot, which enables the activation of an additional prey. \nIf you activate a prey, you can select one monster out of nine. The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The bonus value may range from 5% to 50%. Your prey will be active for 2 hours hunting time: the duration of an active prey will only be reduced while you are hunting.
entries.translated: Настал сезон охоты! Активируйте добычу, чтобы получить бонус при охоте на определенного монстра. Каждый персонаж может приобрести один слот постоянной добычи, который позволяет активировать дополнительную добычу. \nЕсли вы активируете добычу, вы сможете выбрать одного монстра из девяти. Бонус для вашей добычи будет выбран случайным образом из одного из следующих: увеличение урона, уменьшение урона, бонусный опыт, улучшенная добыча. Размер бонуса может варьироваться от 5% до 50%. Ваша добыча будет активна в течение 2 часов охоты: продолжительность активной добычи будет уменьшаться только во время охоты.

entries.en: Bored of your character's sex? Get a new sex for him now!!
entries.translated: Вам надоел пол вашего персонажа? Получите для него новый секс прямо сейчас!!

entries.en: Need a quick way home? Buy this transportation service to get instantly teleported to your home temple. \n\nNote, you cannot use this service while having a battle sign or a protection zone block. Further, the service will not work in no-logout zones or close to your home temple.
entries.translated: Нужен быстрый путь домой? Купите эту транспортную услугу, чтобы мгновенно телепортироваться в ваш домашний храм. \n\nОбратите внимание: вы не можете использовать эту услугу, если у вас есть боевой знак или блок защитной зоны. Кроме того, услуга не будет работать в зонах без выхода из системы или рядом с вашим домашним храмом.

entries.en: You already have an active XP boost.
entries.translated: У вас уже есть активный бонус опыта.
У вас уже есть все Благословения.
У вас уже есть этот аддон.
У вас уже есть расширение очарования.
Это крепление у вас уже есть.
У вас уже есть этот наряд.

entries.en: This hireling outfit is already unlocked.
You reached the maximum amount for this blessing.
entries.translated: Вы достигли максимальной суммы для этого благословения.

entries.en: You have entered an ancient demon prison cell!
entries.translated: Ai intrat într-o celulă antică de închisoare a demonilor!

entries.en: You may construct this only inside a house.
entries.translated: Poți construi acest lucru doar în interiorul unei case.

entries.en: Are you tired of leveling slow? try it!
entries.translated: Te-ai săturat să nivelezi încet? incearca!

entries.en: This is a fantastic mount that helps to become faster, try it!
entries.translated: Aceasta este o montură fantastică care vă ajută să deveniți mai rapid, încercați-o!

entries.en: The first rider of this mount became the leader of his country! legends say that.
entries.translated: Primul călăreț al acestei monturi a devenit liderul țării sale! legendele spun că.

entries.en: Are you hunted? Tired of that? Get a new name, a new life!
entries.translated: Ești vânat? Obosit de asta? Obțineți un nume nou, o viață nouă!

entries.en: A new name to suit your needs!
entries.translated: Un nou nume pentru nevoile tale!

entries.en: This outfit looks nice. Only high-class people are able to wear it!
entries.translated: Arata frumos aceasta tinuta. Numai oamenii de înaltă clasă îl pot purta!

entries.en: An outfit that was created to suit you. We are sure you'll like it.
entries.translated: O ținută care a fost creată pentru a vă potrivi. Suntem siguri că vă va plăcea.

entries.en: Legend says only smart people should wear it, otherwise you will burn!
entries.translated: Legenda spune că numai oamenii deștepți ar trebui să-l poarte, altfel vei arde!

entries.en: You activated a prey but do not like the randomly selected bonus? Roll for a new one! Here you can purchase five Prey Bonus Rerolls! \nA Bonus Reroll allows you to get a bonus with a higher value (max. 50%). The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The 2 hours hunting time will start anew once you have rolled for a new bonus. Your prey monster will stay the same.
entries.translated: Ai activat o pradă, dar nu-ți place bonusul selectat aleatoriu? Rulează pentru unul nou! Aici puteți cumpăra cinci Prey Bonus Rerolls! \nO rerollare bonus vă permite să obțineți un bonus cu o valoare mai mare (max. 50%). Bonusul pentru prada ta va fi selectat aleatoriu din una dintre următoarele: sporirea daunelor, reducerea daunelor, XP bonus, prada îmbunătățită. Timpul de vânătoare de 2 ore va începe din nou odată ce ați primit un nou bonus. Monstrul tău pradă va rămâne același.

entries.en: It's hunting season! Activate a prey to gain a bonus when hunting a certain monster. Every character can purchase one Permanent Prey Slot, which enables the activation of an additional prey. \nIf you activate a prey, you can select one monster out of nine. The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The bonus value may range from 5% to 50%. Your prey will be active for 2 hours hunting time: the duration of an active prey will only be reduced while you are hunting.
entries.translated: Este sezonul de vânătoare! Activați o pradă pentru a obține un bonus atunci când vânați un anumit monstru. Fiecare personaj poate achiziționa un Slot de pradă permanentă, care permite activarea unei prade suplimentare. \nDacă activezi o pradă, poți selecta un monstru din nouă. Bonusul pentru prada ta va fi selectat aleatoriu din una dintre următoarele: sporirea daunelor, reducerea daunelor, XP bonus, prada îmbunătățită. Valoarea bonusului poate varia de la 5% la 50%. Prada ta va fi activă timp de 2 ore de vânătoare: durata unei prade active va fi redusă doar în timp ce vânezi.

entries.en: Bored of your character's sex? Get a new sex for him now!!
entries.translated: Te-ai plictisit de sexul personajului tău? Ia un sex nou pentru el acum!!

entries.en: Need a quick way home? Buy this transportation service to get instantly teleported to your home temple. \n\nNote, you cannot use this service while having a battle sign or a protection zone block. Further, the service will not work in no-logout zones or close to your home temple.
entries.translated: Ai nevoie de un drum rapid spre casă? Cumpărați acest serviciu de transport pentru a fi teleportat instantaneu la templul de acasă. \n\nNotă, nu puteți folosi acest serviciu în timp ce aveți un semn de luptă sau un bloc de zonă de protecție. În plus, serviciul nu va funcționa în zonele fără deconectare sau în apropierea templului de acasă.

entries.en: You already have an active XP boost.
entries.translated: Ai deja un boos XP activ.

entries.en: As soon as you're pouring out the vial over the dreambird tree the plant is infused with starlight. The barrier strengthens.
entries.translated: Чим сипате бочицу преко дрвета птица снова, биљка је прожета звезданом светлошћу. Баријера јача.

entries.en: As soon as you're pouring out the vial over the dreambird tree the plant is infused with starlight. This was the last tree.
entries.translated: Чим сипате бочицу преко дрвета птица снова, биљка је прожета звезданом светлошћу. Ово је било последње дрво.

entries.en: You are rubbing the gem in the sun catcher's centre but nothing happens.
entries.translated: Трљате драгуљ у центар хватача сунца, али ништа се не дешава.

entries.en: The sun has to be shining in order to strengthen the barrier. Wait for the day.
entries.translated: Сунце мора да сија да би се баријера ојачала. Сачекај дан.

entries.en: The sun catcher is shining with sunlight now.
entries.translated: Хватач сунца сада сија сунчевом светлошћу.

entries.en: As soon as you're placing the sun catcher on the stone the pattern the mosaic is infused with sunlight. The barrier strengthens.
entries.translated: Чим поставите хватач сунца на камен, мозаик је прожет сунчевом светлошћу. Баријера јача.

entries.en: As soon as you're placing the sun catcher on the stone the pattern the mosaic is infused with sunlight. This was the last mosaic.
entries.translated: Чим поставите хватач сунца на камен, мозаик је прожет сунчевом светлошћу. Ово је био последњи мозаик.

entries.en: The pile of bones is empty.
This can only be used between 1st of April and 1st of May.
entries.translated: Ово се може користити само између 1. априла и 1. маја.

entries.en: You hold the skull up high. You can resist the urge to have it look through a telescope though.
entries.translated: Држиш лобању високо. Ипак, можете се одупрети жељи да га погледате кроз телескоп.

entries.en: That's definitely one of the highest spots in whole Tibia. If that's not simply perfect you don't know what it is.
entries.translated: То је дефинитивно једно од највиших места у целини Tibia. Ако то није једноставно савршено, онда не знате шта је.

entries.en: What a beautiful view. Worthy of a Queen indeed! Time to head back to Lazaran and show him what you got.
entries.translated: Какав леп поглед. Заиста достојан краљице! Време је да се вратиш у Лазаран и покажеш му шта имаш.

entries.en: You hold up the skull and let it take a peek over the beautiful elven town through the dense leaves.
entries.translated: Подижете лобању и пустите је да завири у прелепи вилењачки град кроз густо лишће.

entries.en: Thanita gives you a really strange look as you hold up the skull, but oh well.
entries.translated: Танита вам даје заиста чудан поглед док држите лобању, али добро.

entries.en: That was a real easy one. And you are used to getting strange looks now, so whatever!
entries.translated: То је било стварно лако. А сада сте навикли да добијате чудне погледе, па шта год!

entries.en: Wow, it's hot up here. Luckily the skull can't get a sunburn any more, but you can, so you better descend again!
entries.translated: Вау, овде је вруће. Срећом, лобања више не може да добије опекотине од сунца, али можете, па је боље да се поново спустите!

entries.en: Considering that higher places around here aren't that easy to reach, you think the view from here is tolerably good.
entries.translated: С обзиром да овде није лако доћи до виших места, мислите да је поглед одавде подношљиво добар.

entries.en: Yep, that's a pretty high spot. If Lazaran ever sees what the skull sees, he'd be pretty satisfied with that nice view.
entries.translated: Да, то је прилично висока тачка. Ако Лазаран икада види оно што види лобања, био би прилично задовољан тим лепим погледом.

entries.en: Well, there are higher spots around here, but none of them is as easily reachable as this one. It just has to suffice.
entries.translated: Па, овде има виших места, али ниједно од њих није тако лако доступно као ово. Само мора бити довољно.

entries.en: Nice! White in white as far as the eye can see. Time to leave before your fingers turn into icicles.
entries.translated: Лепо! Бело у бело докле поглед сеже. Време је да одете пре него што вам се прсти претворе у леденице.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: No, no. I need more bat wings! I said, 10!
entries.translated: No, no. ¡Necesito más alas de murciélago! ¡Dije 10!

entries.en: You are not one of us. I don't want to talk to you.
entries.translated: No eres uno de nosotros. No quiero hablar contigo.

entries.en: Easy, boys! Don't mention that name again. Makes the boys nuts, ye know?
entries.translated: ¡Tranquilo, muchachos! No vuelvas a mencionar ese nombre. Vuelve locos a los chicos, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Are you tired of leveling slow? try it!
entries.translated: Sei stanco di livellare lentamente? provalo!

entries.en: This is a fantastic mount that helps to become faster, try it!
entries.translated: Questa è una montatura fantastica che aiuta a diventare più veloci, provala!

entries.en: The first rider of this mount became the leader of his country! legends say that.
entries.translated: Il primo cavaliere su questa cavalcatura divenne il leader del suo paese! lo dicono le leggende.

entries.en: Are you hunted? Tired of that? Get a new name, a new life!
entries.translated: Sei cacciato? Stanco di questo? Ottieni un nuovo nome, una nuova vita!

entries.en: A new name to suit your needs!
entries.translated: Un nuovo nome per soddisfare le tue esigenze!

entries.en: This outfit looks nice. Only high-class people are able to wear it!
entries.translated: Questo vestito sembra carino. Solo le persone di alta classe possono indossarlo!

entries.en: An outfit that was created to suit you. We are sure you'll like it.
entries.translated: Un outfit creato su misura per te. Siamo sicuri che ti piacerà.

entries.en: Legend says only smart people should wear it, otherwise you will burn!
entries.translated: La leggenda dice che solo le persone intelligenti dovrebbero indossarlo, altrimenti brucerai!

entries.en: You activated a prey but do not like the randomly selected bonus? Roll for a new one! Here you can purchase five Prey Bonus Rerolls! \nA Bonus Reroll allows you to get a bonus with a higher value (max. 50%). The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The 2 hours hunting time will start anew once you have rolled for a new bonus. Your prey monster will stay the same.
entries.translated: Hai attivato una preda ma non ti piace il bonus selezionato casualmente? Lanciati per uno nuovo! Qui puoi acquistare cinque Reroll Prey Bonus! \nUn Bonus Reroll ti consente di ottenere un bonus di valore più alto (max. 50%). Il bonus per la tua preda verrà selezionato casualmente da uno dei seguenti: aumento del danno, riduzione del danno, XP bonus, bottino migliorato. Il tempo di caccia di 2 ore ricomincerà una volta che avrai tirato per un nuovo bonus. Il tuo mostro preda rimarrà lo stesso.

entries.en: It's hunting season! Activate a prey to gain a bonus when hunting a certain monster. Every character can purchase one Permanent Prey Slot, which enables the activation of an additional prey. \nIf you activate a prey, you can select one monster out of nine. The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The bonus value may range from 5% to 50%. Your prey will be active for 2 hours hunting time: the duration of an active prey will only be reduced while you are hunting.
entries.translated: È la stagione della caccia! Attiva una preda per ottenere un bonus quando cacci un determinato mostro. Ogni personaggio può acquistare uno slot preda permanente, che consente l'attivazione di una preda aggiuntiva. \nSe attivi una preda, puoi selezionare un mostro tra nove. Il bonus per la tua preda verrà selezionato casualmente da uno dei seguenti: aumento del danno, riduzione del danno, XP bonus, bottino migliorato. Il valore del bonus può variare dal 5% al ​​50%. La tua preda sarà attiva per 2 ore di tempo di caccia: la durata di una preda attiva sarà ridotta solo durante la caccia.

entries.en: Bored of your character's sex? Get a new sex for him now!!
entries.translated: Annoiato dal sesso del tuo personaggio? Ottieni un nuovo sesso per lui adesso!!

entries.en: Need a quick way home? Buy this transportation service to get instantly teleported to your home temple. \n\nNote, you cannot use this service while having a battle sign or a protection zone block. Further, the service will not work in no-logout zones or close to your home temple.
entries.translated: Hai bisogno di un ritorno veloce a casa? Acquista questo servizio di trasporto per essere immediatamente teletrasportato al tuo tempio di origine. \n\nNota, non puoi utilizzare questo servizio mentre hai un segno di battaglia o un blocco della zona di protezione. Inoltre, il servizio non funzionerà nelle zone senza disconnessione o vicino al tuo tempio di casa.

entries.en: You already have an active XP boost.
entries.translated: Hai già un potenziamento XP attivo.

entries.en: You do not have enough level.
The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Чини се да су врата запечаћена од нежељених уљеза.

entries.en: You have a feeling of dread.
Once more you mix the chalk with a drop of your blood and a bit of water and renew the symbol on the floor...
entries.translated: Још једном помешаш креду са капљицом крви и мало воде и обновиш симбол на поду...

entries.en: You can only use this entrance during the night.
entries.translated: Овај улаз можете користити само током ноћи.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Када дође време, '%s' ће бити прихваћено у овој светињи.

entries.en: Something clicked at same time a booming sound almost deafens you.
entries.translated: Нешто је шкљоцнуло у исто време, грмљави звук вас скоро заглушује.

entries.en: Something clicked at same time a booming sound almost deafens you.
entries.translated: Нешто је шкљоцнуло у исто време, грмљави звук вас скоро заглушује.

entries.en: Something clicked at same time a booming sound almost deafens you.
entries.translated: Нешто је шкљоцнуло у исто време, грмљави звук вас скоро заглушује.

entries.en: Hm... the device reads: 0,0,zero,0,zero which may roughly translate to: NOTHING OF INTEREST HERE
entries.translated: Хм... уређај гласи: 0,0,нула,0,нула што би отприлике могло да се преведе на: ОВДЕ НИШТА ОД ИНТЕРЕСА

entries.en: You have successfully gathered the data.
An outfit that was created to suit you. We are sure you'll like it.
entries.translated: En outfit som skapades för att passa dig. Vi är säkra på att du kommer att gilla det.

entries.en: Legend says only smart people should wear it, otherwise you will burn!
entries.translated: Legenden säger att bara smarta människor ska bära den, annars kommer du att bränna dig!

entries.en: You activated a prey but do not like the randomly selected bonus? Roll for a new one! Here you can purchase five Prey Bonus Rerolls! \nA Bonus Reroll allows you to get a bonus with a higher value (max. 50%). The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The 2 hours hunting time will start anew once you have rolled for a new bonus. Your prey monster will stay the same.
entries.translated: Du aktiverade ett byte men gillar inte den slumpmässigt valda bonusen? Rulla för en ny! Här kan du köpa fem Prey Bonus Rerolls! \nA Bonus Reroll låter dig få en bonus med ett högre värde (max. 50%). Bonusen för ditt byte kommer att väljas slumpmässigt från något av följande: skadeförstärkning, skademinskning, bonus XP, förbättrat byte. Den 2 timmar långa jakttiden kommer att börja om när du har rullat för en ny bonus. Ditt bytesmonster kommer att förbli detsamma.

entries.en: It's hunting season! Activate a prey to gain a bonus when hunting a certain monster. Every character can purchase one Permanent Prey Slot, which enables the activation of an additional prey. \nIf you activate a prey, you can select one monster out of nine. The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The bonus value may range from 5% to 50%. Your prey will be active for 2 hours hunting time: the duration of an active prey will only be reduced while you are hunting.
entries.translated: Det är jaktsäsong! Aktivera ett byte för att få en bonus när du jagar ett visst monster. Varje karaktär kan köpa en Permanent Prey Slot, vilket möjliggör aktivering av ytterligare ett byte. \nOm du aktiverar ett byte kan du välja ett monster av nio. Bonusen för ditt byte kommer att väljas slumpmässigt från något av följande: skadeförstärkning, skademinskning, bonus XP, förbättrat byte. Bonusvärdet kan variera från 5% till 50%. Ditt byte kommer att vara aktivt under 2 timmars jakttid: varaktigheten för ett aktivt byte kommer bara att minskas medan du jagar.

entries.en: Bored of your character's sex? Get a new sex for him now!!
entries.translated: Är du trött på din karaktärs kön? Skaffa ett nytt sex till honom nu!!

entries.en: Need a quick way home? Buy this transportation service to get instantly teleported to your home temple. \n\nNote, you cannot use this service while having a battle sign or a protection zone block. Further, the service will not work in no-logout zones or close to your home temple.
entries.translated: Behöver du en snabb väg hem? Köp den här transporttjänsten för att omedelbart bli teleporterad till ditt hemtempel. \n\nObs, du kan inte använda den här tjänsten när du har ett stridstecken eller ett skyddszonblock. Dessutom kommer tjänsten inte att fungera i zoner utan utloggning eller nära ditt hemtempel.

entries.en: You already have an active XP boost.
entries.translated: Du har redan en aktiv XP-boost.
Du har redan det här fästet.
Du har redan den här outfiten.

entries.en: This hireling outfit is already unlocked.
entries.translated: Den här hyresdräkten är redan upplåst.

entries.en: You reached the maximum amount for this blessing.
entries.translated: Du nådde maxbeloppet för denna välsignelse.

entries.en: You already have bought the maximum number of allowed hirelings.
entries.translated: Du har redan köpt det maximala antalet tillåtna hyresgäster.

entries.en: You already have maximum of prey wildcards.
entries.translated: Du har redan maximalt med byte-jokertecken.

entries.en: You already have maximum of reward tokens.
entries.translated: Du har redan maximalt med belöningstoken.

entries.en: You take some blood out of the hollow crystal. Hopefully it is actually a medusa's blood.
entries.translated: Pobierasz trochę krwi z pustego kryształu. Oby rzeczywiście była to krew meduzy.

entries.en: You unpetrify a banshee's scream near the evil crystal, your ears protected by wax. Thus the baleful artefact is destroyed.
entries.translated: Odpetryfikowujesz krzyk banshee przy złym krysztale, a twoje uszy są chronione woskiem. W ten sposób złowieszczy artefakt zostaje zniszczony.

entries.en: You dare not touch there remains. A word has been carved into these bones over and over: 'K'muuh'.
entries.translated: Nie odważasz się dotknąć tych szczątków. W te kości wielokrotnie wyryto jedno słowo: 'K'muuh'.

entries.en: Well done! The water is analyzed.
You are not worthy to travel by the lion's roar.
entries.translated: Nie jesteś godzien podróży Lwim Rykiem.

entries.en: The ashes swirl with a life of their own, mixing with the sparks of the altar.
entries.translated: Popioły wirują własnym życiem, mieszając się z iskrami ołtarza.

entries.en: You are gathering some catus milk.
You see water as far as the eye can reach. No sea serpent in sight.
entries.translated: Widzisz wodę aż po horyzont. Ani śladu morskiego węża.

entries.en: It's getting away! You should tell the captain to gain speed!
entries.translated: Ucieka! Powinieneś powiedzieć kapitanowi, żeby przyspieszył!

entries.en: There are multiple shadows under the surface. This has to be the right location.
entries.translated: Pod powierzchnią widać wiele cieni. To musi być właściwe miejsce.

entries.en: You find a golden symbol at the bottom of the blood-filled basin.
entries.translated: Znajdujesz złoty symbol na dnie misy wypełnionej krwią.

entries.en: The cave parrot may be tough but he somehow couldn't resist this particular birdcage. Or maybe it was you...
entries.translated: Jaskiniowa papuga może i jest twarda, ale jakoś nie mogła się oprzeć tej konkretnej klatce. A może to jednak przez ciebie...

entries.en: You open the cage and let the cave parrot roam free!
entries.translated: Otwierasz klatkę i wypuszczasz jaskiniową papugę na wolność!

entries.en: Amidst the pile of various bones you find  large, hollow part, similar to a pipe.
entries.translated: Pośród sterty różnych kości znajdujesz duży, pusty element przypominający rurę.

entries.en: You ransack the pile but fail to find any useful parts.
entries.translated: Przeszukujesz stertę, ale nie znajdujesz żadnych użytecznych części.

entries.en: You have found a bone flute.
You attach the ebony wood to the skull. This should meet the requirements of a fingerboard.
entries.translated: Mocujesz hebanowe drewno do czaszki. To powinno spełniać wymagania gryfu.

entries.en: You tack the hair to the ebony fingerboard. The strands should be adquate to serve as strings.
entries.translated: Przymocowujesz włosy do hebanowego gryfu. Pasma powinny nadawać się jako struny.

entries.en: *There was once a maiden fair, with dark eyes and silken hair. Far away from home she died. No grave, no wake, no mourning.*
entries.translated: *Była raz piękna panna, o ciemnych oczach i jedwabnych włosach. Umarła daleko od domu. Bez grobu, bez czuwania, bez żałoby.*

entries.en: [World Change] Yasir has arrived in %s today!
You don't have the outfit, you can't buy the addon.
entries.translated: No tienes el conjunto, no puedes comprar el complemento.

entries.en: You have not learned all the verses of the hymn
entries.translated: No te has aprendido todos los versos del himno

entries.en: You don't feel like hugging an unconcious bear.
entries.translated: No tienes ganas de abrazar a un oso inconsciente.

entries.en: You can not enter a protection zone after attacking another player.
entries.translated: No puedes entrar en una zona de protección después de atacar a otro jugador.

entries.en: Seems that you don't make grow enough trees or not free the parrots.
entries.translated: Parece que no haces crecer suficientes árboles o no liberas a los loros.

entries.en: As this is your first time as a druid, you received a few extra items. As a druid, you can use these spells: Mud Attack, Chill Out, Magic Patch.
entries.translated: Como esta es tu primera vez como druida, recibiste algunos elementos adicionales. Como druida, puedes usar estos hechizos: Ataque de barro, Relájate, Parche mágico.

entries.en: As this is your first time as a paladin, you received a few extra items. As a paladin, you can use the following spells: Magic Patch, Arrow Call.
entries.translated: Como es tu primera vez como paladín, recibiste algunos elementos adicionales. Como paladín, puedes usar los siguientes hechizos: Magic Patch, Arrow Call.

entries.en: As this is your first time as a sorcerer, you received a few extra items. As a sorcerer, you can use the following spells: Magic Patch, Buzz, Scorch.
entries.translated: Como es tu primera vez como hechicero, recibiste algunos elementos adicionales. Como hechicero, puedes utilizar los siguientes hechizos: Magic Patch, Buzz, Scorch.

entries.en: You have received the weapons of a druid. As a druid, you can use these spells: Mud Attack, Chill Out, Magic Patch.
entries.translated: Has recibido las armas de un druida. Como druida, puedes usar estos hechizos: Ataque de barro, Relájate, Parche mágico.

entries.en: You need 2 players for enter in the arena.
entries.translated: Для входа на арену вам нужны 2 игрока.

entries.en: You need 2 players for enter in the arena.
entries.translated: Для входа на арену вам нужны 2 игрока.

entries.en: Please wait for the fighters come out of the arena.
entries.translated: Пожалуйста, подождите, пока бойцы выйдут с арены.

entries.en: You may construct this only inside a house.
entries.translated: Вы можете построить это только внутри дома.

entries.en: Put the construction kit on the floor first.
Someone is fighting against the boss! You need wait awhile.
entries.translated: Кто-то сражается против босса! Вам нужно подождать некоторое время.

entries.en: You need 5 players to fight with this boss.
entries.translated: Чтобы сразиться с этим боссом, вам понадобится 5 игроков.

entries.en: You did not collect enough knowledge from the ancient Shapers. Visit the Shaper temple in Montag for help.
entries.translated: Вы не получили достаточно знаний от древних Создателей. Посетите храм Шейперов в Монтэге за помощью.

entries.en: You have fifteen minutes to kill and loot this boss, else you will lose that chance.
entries.translated: У вас есть пятнадцать минут, чтобы убить и ограбить этого босса, иначе вы потеряете этот шанс.

entries.en: You have entered an ancient demon prison cell!
entries.translated: Вы вошли в древнюю тюремную камеру демонов!

entries.en: You can not buy more than {max} days of premium account.
entries.translated: Вы не можете купить премиум-аккаунт более чем на {max} дней.

entries.en: You're still too full to eat any gourmet dishes for a while.
entries.translated: Вы все еще слишком сыты, чтобы какое-то время есть изысканные блюда.

entries.en: You need the outfit for this part.
entries.translated: Для этой части вам понадобится одежда.

entries.en: You already own this outfit part.
entries.translated: Эта часть наряда у вас уже есть.

entries.en: Store don't have offers for rookgaard citizen.
entries.translated: В магазине нет предложений для гражданина rookgaard.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: I d...don't care about any n...news unless it's the announcement of a h....heatwave.
entries.translated: No... no me importan ninguna n...noticia a menos que sea el anuncio de una h...ola de calor.

entries.en: The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Чини се да су врата запечаћена од нежељених уљеза.

entries.en: I understand your scepticism, but believe me, all will be well! As you can see, they change colour from dark to light red, and that's when they also start turning soft. <stirs with one hand while he slices carrots and peppers with the other hand> ...
entries.translated: Entiendo tu escepticismo, pero créeme, ¡todo irá bien! Como puedes ver, cambian de color de rojo oscuro a rojo claro, y es entonces cuando también empiezan a ponerse suaves. <stirs with one hand while he slices carrots and peppers with the other hand>...

entries.en: Now we just have to let it simmer and stir using a blessed wooden stake <stirs so vigorously that you can barely see his arms anymore> for thirty minutes. ...
entries.translated: Ahora sólo nos queda dejar hervir a fuego lento y remover con una estaca de madera bendita <stirs so vigorously that you can barely see his arms anymore> durante treinta minutos. ...

entries.en: Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
entries.translated: Пожалуйста, убедитесь, что в вашем ящике магазина есть свободные слоты.

entries.en: Good bye and don't forget me!
Pssst! Keep it down! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>
entries.translated: Пссст! Држи се доле! <даје вам детаљан извештај о активностима чудовишта>

entries.en: Greetings humans! Consider yourselfs lucky, I'm in need of {help}.
entries.translated: Поздрав људи! Сматрајте да сте срећни, треба ми {help}.

entries.en: You have done me a favour and the knowledge you are seeking shall be yours. I melted the ice for you, you can pass now.
entries.translated: Учинили сте ми услугу и знање које тражите биће ваше. Отопио сам лед за тебе, сада можеш да прођеш.

entries.en: As I told you, fiendish ice creatures dragged my egg into the lower caves. ...
entries.translated: Као што сам ти рекао, ђаволска ледена створења су одвукла моје јаје у доње пећине. ...

entries.en: Without enough heat the egg will die soon. Venture there and save my hatchling and the knowledge you seeek shall be yours!
entries.translated: Без довољно топлоте јаје ће ускоро умрети. Одважите се тамо и спасите моје младунче и знање које тражите биће ваше!

entries.en: So return to the upper tunnels where cultists and ice golems dwell. Somewhere in these tunnels you will find a small prison haunted by a ghost. South of this prison cell there is a tunnel that will lead you eastwards. ...
entries.translated: Зато се вратите у горње тунеле где бораве култисти и ледени големи. Негде у овим тунелима наћи ћете мали затвор који прогања дух. Јужно од ове затворске ћелије постоји тунел који ће вас одвести на исток. ...

entries.en: Follow the tunnel until you reach a small cave. Step down and down until you see a blue energy field. It will lead you to my egg. It is sealed so that not everyone may enter the room. But you have the permission now.
entries.translated: Пратите тунел док не дођете до мале пећине. Идите доле и доле док не видите плаво енергетско поље. Одвешће те до мог јајета. Запечаћена је тако да не могу сви ући у просторију. Али сада имате дозволу.

entries.en: Wretched creatures of ice have stolen my egg that was close to hatching. ...
entries.translated: Јадна створења од леда су украла моје јаје које је било близу излегања. ...

entries.en: Since I'm to huge to enter those lower Tunnels I have to ask you to take care of my {egg}. Will you do this?
entries.translated: Пошто сам превелик за улазак у те доње тунеле, морам да вас замолим да се побринете за моје {egg}. Хоћеш ли ово урадити?

entries.en: I'm aware what you are looking for. Usually I would rather devour you, but due to unfortunate circumstances, I need your {assistance}.
entries.translated: Свестан сам шта тражите. Обично бих те радије прогутао, али због несрећних околности треба ми твоје {assistance}.

entries.translated: Цхцхцх. Цхх! <нисте сигурни, али изгледа да веверица жели да мења ваше вредне жиреве за бескорисно камење које је нашла и сматрала нејестивим>
Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
Pilnuj dobrze swojego kamienia poszukiwacza przygód.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you.
Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Po prostu poproś mnie o {trade}, żeby zobaczyć moje oferty.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Śmiertelniku! Jeśli jesteś na {quest}, by służyć bogu krwi, mojemu panu - bądź pozdrowiony!

entries.en: Goodbye. I am sure you will come back for more. They all do.
entries.translated: Do widzenia. Jestem pewien, że wrócisz po więcej. Wszyscy tak robią.

entries.translated: Czy mówisz do mnie? Cóż, rozmawiaj dalej, ale nie oczekuj odpowiedzi.

entries.en: Hi! I hope you're not going to kill me!
entries.translated: Cześć! Mam nadzieję, że nie zamierzasz mnie zabić!

entries.en: No, no, I was asking for one of the names.

entries.en: I fear that will not do. Sorry.

entries.en: I'm Karith. I don't belong to a caste any longer, and only serve the Yalahari.
entries.translated: Soy Karith. Ya no pertenezco a ninguna casta y sólo sirvo a los Yalahari.

entries.en: The skull have not seen all yet!
entries.translated: ¡El cráneo aún no lo he visto todo!

entries.en: You don't have enough money, don't try to fool me.
entries.translated: No tienes suficiente dinero, no trates de engañarme.

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: Good bye and don't forget me!
entries.translated: До свидания и не забывайте меня!

entries.en: Yeah, good bye and don't come again!
entries.translated: Sì, arrivederci e non tornare più!

entries.en: Yeah, good bye and don't come again!
entries.translated: Да, збогом и немој више долазити!

entries.en: Ah, I feel a mortal walks these ancient halls again. Pardon me, I barely notice you. I am so lost in my thoughts.

entries.en: Good bye and don't forget me!
Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. You must be the one sent by Lily. Do you have a sack of {herbs} for me?
entries.translated: Pozdrawiam, podróżniku |PLAYERNAME|. To ty musisz być tym, którego przysłała Lily. Czy masz dla mnie worek {herbs}?

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a trade if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Cześć. Jak mogę Ci pomóc |PLAYERNAME|? Jeśli chcesz coś kupić, zapytaj mnie o wymianę. Mogę również wyjaśnić system {mail}.

entries.en: Ahhh, welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Say, have you already heard the latest news about the {seamonster}, {Aneus}, or the {rumours} in this area?
entries.translated: Ach, witaj |PLAYERNAME|! Powiedz, czy słyszałeś już najnowsze wiadomości o {seamonster}, {Aneus} lub {rumours} w tym obszarze?

entries.en: Welcome to the magic emporium, child. Ask me for a trade if you need {runes}, {wands}, or spellbooks.
entries.translated: Witamy w magicznym sklepie, dziecko. Zapytaj mnie o wymianę, jeśli potrzebujesz {runes}, {wands} lub ksiąg zaklęć.

entries.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. If you are looking for sorcerer {spells} don't hesitate to ask.
entries.translated: Pozdrawiam, |PLAYERNAME|. Jeśli szukasz czarownika {spells}, nie wahaj się zapytać.

entries.en: Of course, take a good look at my meat.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, mira bien mi carne.

entries.en: Nice to see you, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my exclusive offers.
entries.translated: ¡Qué bueno verte, |PLAYERNAME|! Pídeme un {trade} si quieres ver mis ofertas exclusivas.

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a trade if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Hola. ¿Cómo puedo ayudarte |PLAYERNAME|? Pídeme un intercambio si quieres comprar algo. También puedo explicar el sistema {mail}.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
entries.translated: Aquí. No olvides que también debes comprar una etiqueta si quieres enviar un paquete. Escriba siempre el nombre del {receiver} en la primera línea.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my offers. If you buy a potion, don't forget that there's a {deposit} of 5 gold on the empty flask.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, simplemente navega por mis ofertas. Si compras una poción, no olvides que hay un {deposit} de 5 de oro en el frasco vacío.

entries.en: Oh hey, |PLAYERNAME|! Vascalir must have sent you to help me with a little {mission}, right?
entries.translated: ¡Oye, |PLAYERNAME|! Vascalir debe haberte enviado para que me ayudes con un poco de {mission}, ¿verdad?

entries.en: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Back so soon? Have you delivered the herbs to Hyacinth?
entries.translated: Hola, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Volviste tan pronto? ¿Le has entregado las hierbas a Hyacinth?

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! You look a little stressed today. If you like to view my offers of potions, just ask me for a {trade}. In case you're looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east!
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido, |PLAYERNAME|! Te ves un poco estresado hoy. Si quieres ver mis ofertas de pociones, sólo pídeme un {trade}. En caso de que estés buscando el mercado y las mazmorras, ¡simplemente sigue el camino hacia el este!

entries.en: I'd rather be left in {peace}. Keep it short.
entries.translated: Preferiría que me dejaran en {peace}. Sea breve.

entries.en: Welcome to my humble hut, |PLAYERNAME|. What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Bienvenido a mi humilde cabaña, |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Qué te trae {here}?

entries.en: May the gods protect you! And stay away from that hole!
entries.translated: ¡Que los dioses te protejan! ¡Y mantente alejado de ese agujero!

entries.en: Welcome to my adventurer shop, |PLAYERNAME|! What do you need? Ask me for a {trade} to look at my wares.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido a mi tienda de aventureros, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Qué necesitas? Pídeme un {trade} para ver mis productos.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Te sientes aventurero? ¿Quiere un {ticket} semanal para el sistema de vagones de mineral aquí? ¡Puedes usarlo aquí mismo para llegar al centro de Kazordoon!

entries.en: Instinctively you run to a larger emerald bluff near the raise to find cover. Mere seconds after you claimed the sturdy shelter, a deep dark humming starts to swirl through the air. ...
entries.translated: Инстинктивно трчите до већег смарагдног блефа у близини повећања да бисте пронашли заклон. Само неколико секунди након што сте преузели чврсто склониште, дубоко тамно брујање почиње да се врти кроз ваздух. ...

entries.en: Seconds pass as the hum gets louder. The noise is maddening, drowning all other sounds around you. As you cover your ears in pain, the humming explodes into a deafening growl. ...
entries.translated: Секунде пролазе док зујање постаје све гласније. Бука излуђује, дави све друге звукове око вас. Док покривате уши од бола, зујање експлодира у заглушујуће режање. ...

entries.en: You raise your head above the edge of the emerald to catch a glimpse of what's happening. ...
entries.translated: Подижете главу изнад ивице смарагда да бисте бацили поглед на оно што се дешава. ...

entries.en: The hand seems to have grown into a fist. In the distance you can now see a blurry scheme of a creature too large for your eyes to get a sharper view of its head. ...
entries.translated: Рука као да је прерасла у шаку. У даљини сада можете видети мутну шему створења које је превелико да би ваше очи могле оштрије видети његову главу. ...

entries.en: Blending the rays, the mirror directs pure white light directly towards the part where you assume the face of the creature. ...
entries.translated: Мешајући зраке, огледало усмерава чисту белу светлост директно ка делу где претпостављате лице створења. ...

entries.en: The growl transforms into a scream, everything around you seems to compress. As you press yourself tightly against the bluff, everything falls silent and in a split second, the dark being dissolves into bursts of blackness. You wake.
entries.translated: Режање се претвара у врисак, све око вас као да се стисне. Док се чврсто притишћете уз блеф, све утихне и у делићу секунде, мрачно биће се раствара у налетима црнила. Ти се пробудиш.

entries.en: You lunge out and throw the model far into the water. As nothing happens, you turn your back to the ocean. ...
entries.translated: Избаците и баците модел далеко у воду. Како се ништа не дешава, окрећете леђа океану. ...

entries.en: The very moment you walk down the dune to head back south, rays of light burst over your head in a shock wave that makes you tumble down the rest of the hill. ...
entries.translated: Истог тренутка када ходате низ дину да бисте се вратили на југ, зраци светлости су избили изнад ваше главе у ударном таласу који вас натера да се срушите низ остатак брда. ...

entries.en: As your eyes adjust to the sudden reduction of brightness, you see the giant wings of the gate before you move to the side. You can also make out something shiny on the ground.
entries.translated: Док се ваше очи прилагођавају наглом смањењу осветљености, видите џиновска крила капије пре него што се померите у страну. Такође можете уочити нешто сјајно на тлу.

entries.en: You pick the mirror from the ground.

A broad darkness surrounds you as if a heavy curtain is closing before your eyes. After what seems like minutes of floating through emptiness, you get the feeling as if a hole opens in the dark before you. ...
entries.translated: Окружује те широка тама као да се тешка завеса затвара пред твојим очима. После онога што изгледа као неколико минута лебдења кроз празнину, имате осећај као да се пред вама отвара рупа у мраку. ...

entries.en: The hole grows larger, you cannot close your eyes. An unimaginable black. Deeper and darker than any nothingness you could possibly imagine drags you into it. ...
entries.translated: Рупа расте, не можете затворити очи. Незамислива црна. Дубље и мрачније него што вас било које ништавило које можете замислити увлачи у то. ...

entries.en: You feel as if you cannot breathe anymore. The very second you let loose of your consciousness, you sense all heaviness around you lifted. ...
entries.translated: Осећате се као да више не можете да дишете. Чим се ослободите свести, осетите да се подигла сва тежина око вас. ...

entries.en: You dive into an ocean of emerald light. Feeling like born anew the colour around you is almost overwhelming. Countless objects of all shapes and sizes are dashing past you. Racing against each other, millions are clashing in the distance. ..
entries.translated: Уроните у океан смарагдне светлости. Боја око вас је скоро неодољива. Безброј предмета свих облика и величина пролеће поред вас. Тркајући се једни против других, милиони се сукобљавају у даљини. ..

entries.en: The loudness of the gargantuan spectacle around you bursts your hearing, yet you absorb all the sounds around you. ...
entries.translated: Гласноћа огромног спектакла око вас разбија ваш слух, а ви упијате све звукове око себе. ...

entries.en: As several large obstacles move aside directly in front of you, an intense bright centre leaps into your view. Though you cannot perceive how fast you are, your pace seems too slow. ...
entries.translated: Док се неколико великих препрека помера директно испред вас, интензиван светли центар скаче у ваш поглед. Иако не можете да приметите колико сте брзи, ваш темпо делује преспоро. ...

entries.en: Ever decelerating, you ultimately approach a middle in this chaos of tones of green. ...
entries.translated: Кад год успоравате, на крају се приближавате средини у овом хаосу зелених тонова. ...

entries.en: As you come closer to it, yellowish shades of orange embrace you, softer shapes emerge and you almost forget the mayhem before. In warm comfort you see what lies in the heart of it all. ...
entries.translated: Како му се приближавате, грле вас жућкасте нијансе наранџе, појављују се мекши облици и скоро заборавите на хаос који је био пре. У топлој удобности видите шта лежи у срцу свега. ...

entries.en: A majestic dragon in his sleep is surrounded by what seems the warmth and energy of a thousand suns. The tranquillity of its sight makes you smile gently. ...
entries.translated: Величанствени змај у сну окружен је нечим што се чини топлином и енергијом хиљаду сунаца. Мир његовог погледа тера те да се нежно осмехнеш. ...

entries.en: What we get to eat is really ridiculous.
entries.translated: To, co jemy, jest naprawdę śmieszne.

entries.en: We dig up all what mother earth delivers to us, valuable natural resources.
entries.translated: Wydobywamy wszystko, co matka ziemia nam daje, cenne zasoby naturalne.

entries.en: Every man is the architect of his own fortune. The times of repression are finally over.
entries.translated: Każdy człowiek jest kowalem własnego losu. Czasy ucisku wreszcie się skończyły.

entries.en: The repression has taken too long. With our new weapons the respective people will get their just punishment.
entries.translated: Ucisk trwał zbyt długo. Z naszą nową bronią winni ludzie dostaną zasłużoną karę.

entries.en: The repression has taken too long. With our new weapons the respective people will get their just punishment.
entries.translated: Ucisk trwał zbyt długo. Z naszą nową bronią winni ludzie dostaną zasłużoną karę.

entries.en: We need weapons to overcome our situation.
entries.translated: Potrzebujemy broni, by poprawić naszą sytuację.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
entries.translated: ¿En qué me he convertido? ¿Qué es el slime si no es para todos?

entries.en: What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
entries.translated: ¿En qué me he convertido? ¿Qué es el slime si no es para todos?

entries.en: Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
entries.translated: ¡Brillante! ¡Necesitamos buenos aventureros como tú! Si estás listo para aprender, pídeme una lección. Siempre puedes pedir palabras de diferentes colores, como ésta, para continuar la lección.

entries.en: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
entries.translated: Bueno, podría darte un valioso {lessons} o algo de {hints} general sobre el juego, o un pequeño {quest} si estás interesado.

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
entries.translated: ¡Adiós, |PLAYERNAME|! Y recuerda: ¡No correr de un lado a otro en la academia!

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You find nothing in the Ambassador's house. If he's in fact a traitor he got rid of any evidence that could incriminate him.
entries.translated: В доме посла вы ничего не найдете. Если он на самом деле предатель, он избавился от любых улик, которые могли бы его обвинить.

entries.en: Documents were burnt here recently. Only the part of one scroll still lies in front of the chimney but it's too sooted to read.
entries.translated: Недавно здесь сожгли документы. Только часть одного свитка все еще лежит перед дымоходом, но он слишком закопчен, чтобы его можно было читать.

entries.en: You feel shaky and dizzy, the world turns dark around you. Then your sight clears again - and you are somewhere else.
entries.translated: Вы чувствуете дрожь и головокружение, мир вокруг вас темнеет. Затем ваше зрение снова проясняется – и вы находитесь где-то в другом месте.

entries.en: You were moved to the right brain side
entries.translated: Вас переместили в правое полушарие мозга

entries.en: You were moved to the left brain side
entries.translated: Вас переместили в левое полушарие мозга

entries.en: Good bye and don't forget me!
entries.translated: La revedere si nu ma uita!

entries.en: The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Чини се да су врата запечаћена од нежељених уљеза.

entries.en: The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Чини се да су врата запечаћена од нежељених уљеза.

entries.en: This crystal geode is shaking from a battle nearby.
entries.translated: Ова кристална геода се тресе од битке у близини.

entries.en: This crystal geode is shaking from a battle nearby.
entries.translated: Ова кристална геода се тресе од битке у близини.

entries.en: This crystal geode is shaking from a battle nearby.

entries.en: You started an escort, get your prisoner to the dwarf outpost!
entries.translated: Покренули сте пратњу, одведите свог затвореника до патуљасте испоставе!

entries.en: You find nothing of interest beneath the rubble.
entries.translated: Не налазите ништа занимљиво испод рушевина.

entries.en: You can not use this portal yet.
entries.translated: Још не можете користити овај портал.

entries.en: Bye now, Neutrala |PLAYERNAME|. Visit old Bob again one day!
entries.translated: Do widzenia, Neutrala |PLAYERNAME|. Któregoś dnia ponownie odwiedź starego Boba!

entries.en: Well ... you defeated my guards! Now everything is over! I guess I will have to answer your questions now.
entries.translated: Bueno... ¡derrotaste a mis guardias! ¡Ahora todo ha terminado! Supongo que tendré que responder a tus preguntas ahora.

entries.en: Good bye and come again for another small talk! *waves*
entries.translated: ¡Adiós y vuelve para otra pequeña charla! *ondas*

entries.en: Ah, you come just in time for the special voting about the most recent {funding} project. I guess you want to participate in it.
entries.translated: Ah, llegas justo a tiempo para la votación especial sobre el proyecto {funding} más reciente. Supongo que quieres participar en ello.

entries.en: Greetings, dear visitor. Please tell me what {brings} you here, to my humble adobe.
entries.translated: Saludos, querido visitante. Por favor dime qué {brings} estás aquí, a mi humilde adobe.

entries.en: Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. If you are looking for potions, seek no further.
entries.translated: Sé de luto, |PLAYERNAME|, peregrino en carne. Si buscas pociones, no busques más.
Que la iluminación sea tu camino, |PLAYERNAME|.
Que la iluminación sea tu camino, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.
entries.translated: Adiós, extraño. Que Uman el Sabio guíe tus pasos en esta tierra traicionera.

entries.en: Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.
entries.translated: Adiós, extraño. Que Uman el Sabio guíe tus pasos en esta tierra traicionera.

entries.en: Just great, another disturbance. Just what I need.
entries.translated: Simplemente genial, otra perturbación. Justo lo que necesito.

entries.en: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you?
Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. Have a look at my fine {weapons} and {armors}.
entries.translated: Sé de luto, |PLAYERNAME|, peregrino en carne. Echa un vistazo a mis finos {weapons} y {armors}.
Que la iluminación sea tu camino, |PLAYERNAME|.
Que la iluminación sea tu camino.

entries.en: Oh hello. I hardly noticed you. I'm afraid I am a bit distracted at the moment.
entries.translated: Ah hola. Casi no te noté. Me temo que en este momento estoy un poco distraído.

entries.en: Of course, take a look at my tasty offers.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, echa un vistazo a mis sabrosas ofertas.
Las bendiciones de Daraman. Vuelve pronto.

entries.en: Greetings, traveller. It seems, you're a {guest} here, just like me.
entries.translated: Saludos, viajero. Parece que aquí eres un {guest}, como yo.

entries.en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
entries.translated: Ччч. Чх! <вы не уверены, но, похоже, белка хочет обменять ваши ценные желуди на бесполезные камни, которые она нашла и посчитала несъедобными>

entries.en: You will now be travelled out of here. Are you sure that you want to face that teleport?
entries.translated: Теперь вас отправят отсюда. Вы уверены, что хотите встретиться с этим телепортом?

entries.en: Then stay here in these ghostly halls.
entries.translated: Тогда оставайся здесь, в этих призрачных залах.

entries.en: Good bye and don't forget me!
entries.translated: La revedere si nu ma uita!

entries.en: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
entries.translated: Sei ferito, figlio mio. Guarirò le tue ferite.

entries.en: Advancing to the west, you recognise an increase of onyx on the ground.
entries.translated: Напредујући према западу, препознајете пораст оникса на земљи.

entries.en: Advancing to the west, you recognise an increase of onyx on the ground.
entries.translated: Напредујући према западу, препознајете пораст оникса на земљи.

entries.en: You continue travelling the barren sea of gemstones to the north.
entries.translated: Настављате да путујете неплодним морем драгог камења на север.

entries.en: You leave the massive open gate behind you and go to the west.
entries.translated: Остављате масивну отворену капију иза себе и идете на запад.

entries.en: You carefully remove the sapphire from Bastesh's grasp.
entries.translated: Пажљиво извадите сафир из Бастесховог стиска.

entries.en: You head back to the east and to the plateau.
entries.translated: Враћате се на исток и на висораван.

entries.en: You head back south to the site with the onyx lookout.
entries.translated: Враћате се на југ до локације са видиковцем од оникса.

entries.en: You return to the plateau in the east.
entries.translated: Враћате се на висораван на истоку.

entries.en: You put the stand into a small recess you find near the middle of the plateau.
entries.translated: Ставите постоље у мало удубљење које пронађете близу средине платоа.

entries.en: As the ruby slips into the notch, the strong red of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
entries.translated: Како рубин клизи у зарез, јака црвена камена се хиљаду пута појачава. Плашите се да ћете повредити очи и одмах се окренете. Изгледа да је зрак са запањујућом прецизношћу усмерен ка центру платоа.

entries.en: As the sapphire slips into the notch, the deep blue of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
entries.translated: Како сафир клизи у зарез, тамноплава боја камена се хиљаду пута појачава. Плашите се да ћете повредити очи и одмах се окренете. Изгледа да је зрак са запањујућом прецизношћу усмерен ка центру платоа.

entries.en: You carefully lift the onyx attachment from its socket. It is lighter than you expected.
entries.translated: Пажљиво подигните додатак од оникса из његовог лежишта. Лакши је него што сте очекивали.

entries.en: As the emerald slips into the notch, the vibrant green of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
entries.translated: Како смарагд клизи у зарез, живописна зелена боја камена се хиљаду пута појачава. Плашите се да ћете повредити очи и одмах се окренете. Изгледа да је зрак са запањујућом прецизношћу усмерен ка центру платоа.

entries.en: I call you the wayfarer. You travelled through my dreams. You ultimately freed my mind. My mind accepted you and so will I.
entries.translated: Зовем те путником. Путовао си кроз моје снове. На крају си ми ослободио ум. Мој ум те је прихватио и ја ћу.

entries.en: You return to the plateau in the east.
entries.translated: Враћате се на висораван на истоку.

entries.en: You wander to the south, passing large obelisks of emerald to your left and sprawling trees of topaz to your right.
entries.translated: Лутате на југ, пролазећи поред великих смарагдних обелиска са ваше леве стране и распрострањених стабала топаза са ваше десне стране.

entries.en: As you rip the solid stand out of its socket and take it with you, the large gate opens with a deafening rumble.
entries.translated: Док ишчупате чврст сталак из његовог лежишта и понесете га са собом, велика капија се отвара уз заглушујућу тутњаву.

entries.en: You gasp at the size of the large open gate as you walk through to head further to the east.
entries.translated: Дахтате од величине велике отворене капије док пролазите кроз њу да бисте кренули даље на исток.

entries.en: You reach for a small solitary arrangement of combined small houses and put it in your pocket.
entries.translated: Посегнете за малим усамљеним распоредом комбинованих кућица и ставите га у џеп.

entries.en: You take an emerald from the pile.

entries.translated: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.en: Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
entries.translated: Po prostu poproś mnie o {trade}, żeby zobaczyć, co od ciebie kupuję.

entries.en: Stand still on the examination platform |PLAYERNAME|.
Hello there, hmm just... just wait right there, I'll be with you in a second. Just getting this {experiment} done...
entries.translated: Witaj, hmm po prostu... chwilę zaczekaj, zaraz będę. Kończę tylko ten {experiment}...

entries.en: Hi, come closer. Have a look at my wares.
entries.translated: Cześć, podejdź bliżej. Spójrz na moje towary.

entries.en: Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.
entries.translated: Kim jesteś? Czego chcesz? Wyglądasz na zbyt doświadczonego, by zostać moim asystentem. Proszę, odejdź.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?

entries.translated: Do widzenia i żegnaj, mój przyjacielu.

entries.en: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
entries.translated: Wróć, kiedy tylko będziesz potrzebować mądrości.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.
entries.translated: Och, cześć |PLAYERNAME|! Jak miło, że odwiedzasz takiego starego człowieka jak ja.

entries.en: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
entries.translated: Wróć, kiedy tylko będziesz potrzebować mądrości.

entries.en: Come back when you have enough money.
entries.translated: Wróć, gdy będziesz mieć dość pieniędzy.

entries.en: I wish you a good hunt. Goodbye!
entries.translated: Życzę ci udanego polowania. Do widzenia!

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
Get some training in the academy!
Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
Gain some knowledge in the academy!
No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: Good morning citizen. How may I serve you?
entries.translated: Добро јутро грађанине. Како да вам служим?
Идентификована мета: Пацов! Раскид је покренут!

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
Pssst! Keep it down! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>
entries.translated: Пссс! Держи это в покое! <предоставляет подробный отчет об активности монстров>

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: Hm... the device reads: 0,0,zero,0,zero which may roughly translate to: NOTHING OF INTEREST HERE
entries.translated: Хм... на устройстве написано: 0,0,ноль,0,ноль, что примерно можно перевести как: ЗДЕСЬ НИЧЕГО ИНТЕРЕСНОГО.

entries.en: You have successfully gathered the data.
You successfully harvest some juicy roots.
entries.translated: Вы успешно собрали несколько сочных корней.

entries.en: Your harvesting attempt destroyed more of the juicy roots than you could salvage.
entries.translated: Ваша попытка сбора урожая уничтожила больше сочных корней, чем вы смогли спасти.

entries.en: You successfully harvest some juicy roots.

entries.en: Your harvesting attempt destroyed more of the juicy roots than you could salvage.
entries.translated: Ваша попытка сбора урожая уничтожила больше сочных корней, чем вы смогли спасти.

entries.en: This root has already been harvested, nothing to gain here.
entries.translated: Этот корень уже собран, и здесь нет никакой выгоды.

entries.en: You have a feeling of dread.

entries.en: You find nothing in the Ambassador's house. If he's in fact a traitor he got rid of any evidence that could incriminate him.
entries.translated: Ништа не налазите у амбасадоровој кући. Ако је он у ствари издајник, ослободио се сваког доказа који би га могао инкриминисати.

entries.en: Documents were burnt here recently. Only the part of one scroll still lies in front of the chimney but it's too sooted to read.
entries.translated: Овде су недавно спаљени документи. Само део једног свитка још увек лежи испред оџака, али је превише чађ да би се читао.

entries.en: You feel shaky and dizzy, the world turns dark around you. Then your sight clears again - and you are somewhere else.
entries.translated: Осећате се дрхтави и вртоглави, свет постаје мрак око вас. Онда ти се вид поново разбистри - и ти си негде другде.

entries.en: You were moved to the right brain side
entries.translated: Премештени сте на десну страну мозга

entries.en: You were moved to the left brain side
entries.translated: Премештени сте на леву страну мозга

entries.en: Hello adventurer. It is {good} to see you.
Bye now, Neutrala |PLAYERNAME|. Visit old Bob again one day!
entries.translated: Adiós, Neutrala |PLAYERNAME|. ¡Visita al viejo Bob de nuevo algún día!

entries.en: Welcome to the Tibian bank, |PLAYERNAME| What can I do for you?
entries.translated: Bienvenido al banco Tibiano, |PLAYERNAME| ¿Qué puedo hacer por ti?

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, What can I do for you? I'm working for the post office, but I also trade with important {potions}, {runes} and other magical equipment.
entries.translated: Hola |PLAYERNAME|, ¿Qué puedo hacer por ti? Trabajo para la oficina de correos, pero también comercio con importantes {potions}, {runes} y otros equipos mágicos.
Ah, la impetuosidad de la juventud.

entries.en: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
entries.translated: Saludos viajero |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Hay algo que pueda {do for you}?

entries.en: Beware, if you go any further you will have to fight a large group of Chosen. This place is called the Fire Dragon Dojo. Tread carefully since these are lizard training grounds.
entries.translated: Cuidado, si avanzas más tendrás que luchar contra un gran grupo de Elegidos. Este lugar se llama Fire Dragon Dojo. Vaya con cuidado ya que estos son campos de entrenamiento de lagartos.

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Hola. ¿Cómo puedo ayudarte |PLAYERNAME|? Pídeme un {trade} si quieres comprar algo. También puedo explicar el sistema {mail}.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
Ah, another diciple of the extreme... surviving the icy outdoors? Let me {help}! If you need some first aid out here, I can provide {healing} or grant you an {enhanced} blessing!
entries.translated: Ah, otro discípulo del extremo... ¿sobrevivir al aire libre helado? ¡Déjame {help}! Si necesita primeros auxilios aquí, puedo brindarle {healing} o otorgarle una bendición {enhanced}.

entries.en: Hm? Oh! Oh, yes a... visitor! Intruder? Benefactor...? Wha- what are you? If you want to pass through this cave, I may have to disappoint you. Or maybe not. It... depends. So, just passing through?
entries.translated: ¿Mmm? ¡Oh! Oh, sí, un... ¡visitante! ¿Intruso? Benefactor...? ¿Qué-qué eres? Si quieres pasar por esta cueva, es posible que tenga que decepcionarte. O tal vez no. Eso depende. Entonces, ¿estás de paso?

entries.en: Hey, where are you going? We've just started!
No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.

entries.en: You could use it and try to form a statue out of it
entries.translated: Можете га искористити и покушати да формирате статуу од тога

entries.en: It seems just perfect to try and create something out of it with a sharp obsidian knife
entries.translated: Чини се да је савршено покушати и створити нешто од тога оштрим ножем од опсидијана

entries.en: Use it in your house to construct a monkey statue
entries.translated: Use to w twój dom do construct jeden małpa posąg
