entries.en: The customer is king! Come back anytime you want to if you wish to {withdraw} your money.
entries.translated: Клиент всегда прав! Возвращайтесь в любое время, если захотите {withdraw} свои деньги.

entries.en: The customer is king! Come back anytime you want to if you wish to {withdraw} your money.
entries.translated: Клиент всегда прав! Возвращайтесь в любое время, если захотите {withdraw} свои деньги.

entries.en: I feel you. I hear your thoughts. You are ... alive.
entries.translated: Я чувствую тебя. Я слышу твои мысли. Ты... жив.

entries.en: Once I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
entries.translated: Когда-то я был членом ордена рыцарей кошмара. Теперь я всего лишь тень, бродящая по этим холодным коридорам.

entries.en: The north has a puzzle to complete.
Interesting. A human who can speak the language of wolves.
entries.translated: Интересный. Человек, говорящий на языке волков.

entries.en: I can see in your eyes that you are a honest and friendly person, |PLAYERNAME|. You were patient enough to learn our language and I will grant you a special gift. Will you accept it?
entries.translated: По твоим глазам я вижу, что ты честный и дружелюбный человек, |PLAYERNAME|. Вы проявили достаточно терпения, чтобы выучить наш язык, и я подарю вам особый подарок. Вы примете это?

entries.en: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the wolf girl. You shall be fast and smart as Morgrar, the great white wolf. He shall guide your path.
entries.translated: Отныне ты будешь известна как |PLAYERNAME|, девушка-волк. Ты будешь быстрым и умным, как Морграр, великий белый волк. Он укажет ваш путь.

entries.en: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the bear warrior. You shall be strong and proud as Angros, the great dark bear. He shall guide your path.
entries.translated: Отныне ты будешь известен как |PLAYERNAME|, воин-медведь. Ты будешь сильным и гордым, как Ангрос, великий темный медведь. Он укажет ваш путь.

entries.en: Good bye! Don't forget about the secrets of mathemagics.
entries.translated: До свидания! Не забывайте о тайнах математической магии.

entries.en: Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?
entries.translated: Хм? Что? Я вижу! Ух ты! Не мино. Они и {capture} тебя тоже?

entries.en: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
entries.translated: Sei ferito, figlio mio. Guarirò le tue ferite.

entries.en: I don't know, I have that constant urge to drink but in this form I would not need to, there is no mouth, no stomach, no flesh and no actual need to eat, drink or sleep. ...
entries.translated: Не знам, имам ту сталну жељу за пићем, али у овом облику не бих требао, нема уста, нема стомака, нема меса и нема стварне потребе да једем, пијем или спавам. ...

entries.en: I basically communicate by making the metal of this goblet vibrate and using its form as a body of sound. Like a real voice, don't you think?? Yes, alright I know it's creepy. ...
entries.translated: Ја у основи комуницирам тако што чиним да метал овог пехара вибрира и користим његову форму као тело звука. Као прави глас, зар не?? Да, у реду знам да је језиво. ...

entries.en: I am still in the middle of my research and do not want to go home, so please tell my daughter to not worry about my - this will be a breakthrough! I already {learned} a lot!
entries.translated: Још увек сам усред истраживања и не желим да идем кући, па молим вас реците мојој ћерки да не брине за мене - ово ће бити напредак! Већ сам {learned} много!

entries.en: Oh yes, so since I wanted to study the Draken up close, I came up with an idea. Based on my research, and some slight bruises and a scar, the perfect hiding place is often right in the middle of subjects. ...
entries.translated: Ох да, пошто сам желео да проучавам Дракена изблиза, дошао сам на идеју. На основу мог истраживања, и неких благих модрица и ожиљака, савршено место за скривање је често тачно усред субјеката. ...

entries.en: If I could enter their lair unseen and establish a forward camp, I would be able to study the draken in peace - or so I thought. Turns out the whole place was empty. I set up my camp and waited. ...
entries.translated: Кад бих могао невиђено да уђем у њихову јазбину и успоставим напредни логор, могао бих на миру да проучавам дракене - или сам бар тако мислио. Испоставило се да је цело место било празно. Поставио сам свој камп и чекао. ...

entries.en: Finally. That's what I... oh wait, you're still talking to me - you will blow my cover! What do you want? Oh wait, did my {daughter} send you? It has been some time now, indeed.
entries.translated: Коначно. То је оно што ја... ох чекај, ти ми још причаш - развалићеш ме! шта хоћеш? Ох чекај, да ли ти је мој {daughter} послао? Прошло је доста времена, заиста.

entries.en: 'Alice the chalice'... Hmpf, of course I won't TELL you my name, I am UNDERCOVER! Now be quiet or they will hear you.
entries.translated: 'Alice the chalice'... Хмпф, наравно да ти нећу рећи своје име, ја сам НА ПОТКРИВАЊУ! Сада ћути или ће те чути.

entries.en: Well, I am drinking most of the time. Er, no I mean - trying to hold my fluids... ah, wait that came out wrong: I am doing research. Let's just keep it at that.
entries.translated: Па, ја пијем већину времена. Не, мислим - покушавам да задржим течност... ах, чекај да је испало погрешно: ја истражујем. Хајде да останемо на томе.

entries.en: A bill? Oh boy so you are delivering another bill to poor me?
entries.translated: Рачун? О, дечко, значи испоручујеш још један рачун јадној мени?

entries.en: Ok, ok, I'll take it. I guess I have no other choice anyways. And now leave me alone in my misery please.
entries.translated: Ок, ок, узећу. Мислим да ионако немам другог избора. А сада ме остави на миру у мојој беди, молим те.

entries.en: What? My hat?? Theres... nothing special about it!
entries.translated: Ста? Мој шешир?? Нема... ништа посебно у томе!

entries.en: Stop bugging me about that hat, do you listen?
entries.translated: Престани да ме гњавиш због тог шешира, слушаш ли?

entries.en: Hey! Don't touch that hat! Leave it alone!!! Don't do this!!!!
entries.translated: Хеј! Не дирај тај шешир! Остави то на миру!!! Не ради ово!!!!

entries.en: Noooooo! Argh, ok, ok, I guess I can't deny it anymore, I am David Brassacres, the magnificent, so what do you want?
entries.translated: Ноооооо! Аргх, ок, ок, претпостављам да то више не могу да поричем, ја сам Давид Брассацрес, величанствени, па шта хоћеш?

entries.en: Thank you, human being! I guess the thieving troll headed to the mountains east of here. As far as I know you can only reach these mountain tops by diving into a small cave. ...
entries.translated: Хвала ти, човече! Претпостављам да је лоповски трол кренуо у планине источно одавде. Колико ја знам, до ових планинских врхова можете доћи само зароњењем у малу пећину. ...

entries.en: The connecting tunnels will lead you to a mountain where you may discover him. I heard a man named Jerom talking about this when he passed by this river. Perhaps he knows more about it.
entries.translated: Тунели за повезивање ће вас одвести до планине где ћете га можда открити. Чуо сам човека по имену Јером како говори о томе када је пролазио поред ове реке. Можда он зна више о томе.

entries.en: This is everything that remained of my cloak? That's terrible! However, I guess I can put the feathers together again. Yes, that should be enough feathers. ...
entries.translated: Ово је све што је остало од мог огртача? То је страшно! Међутим, претпостављам да могу поново да саставим перје. Да, требало би да буде довољно перја. ...

entries.en: Please give them to me so I can restore my cloak. But don't watch me! Swan maidens don't like to be observed. Nature's blessings, human being. I will tell Ikassis that you have been of great assistance.
entries.translated: Молим те, дај ми их да могу да вратим свој огртач. Али не гледај ме! Девојке лабудови не воле да их посматрају. Благослови природе, људско биће. Рећи ћу Икасису да сте били од велике помоћи.
Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.
Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.en: Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
entries.translated: Żegnaj, człowieku. Zawsze będę cię pamiętać. O ile oczywiście nie zapomnę.

entries.en: Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
entries.translated: Żegnaj, człowieku. Zawsze będę cię pamiętać. O ile oczywiście nie zapomnę.

entries.en: Greetings, dear guest and welcome to my {potion} shop.
entries.translated: Pozdrowienia, drogi gościu, witaj w moim sklepie {potion}.

entries.en: Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.
entries.translated: Witaj, wojowniku. Zgaduję, że jesteś tu, by {fight} za naszą szlachetną {cause}.

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh and welcome to the furniture store.
entries.translated: Bądź opłakany, pielgrzymie w ciele, witaj w sklepie meblowym.

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?
entries.translated: Spójrz. Większość mebli jest w poręcznych zestawach. Użyj ich w domu, aby złożyć meble. Chcesz zobaczyć tylko określony rodzaj mebli?

entries.en: MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!
entries.translated: PILNUJ MANIER, PLEBEJUSZU! Zwracając się do królowej, witaj ją jej tytułem!

entries.en: MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!
entries.translated: PILNUJ MANIER, PLEBEJUSZU! Zwracając się do królowej, witaj ją jej tytułem!

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh and welcome to the magic store.
entries.translated: Bądź opłakany, pielgrzymie w ciele, witaj w sklepie magicznym.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.

This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?
Pilnuj dobrze swojego kamienia poszukiwacza przygód.

entries.en: Good bye and please come back soon.
Sure, take a look. Apart from those, I also buy some of the possessions from famous demonlords and bosses. Ask me about it if you found anything interesting.
entries.translated: Jasne, spójrz. Oprócz tego kupuję też niektóre przedmioty po słynnych demon lordach i bossach. Zapytaj, jeśli znalazłeś coś ciekawego.

entries.en: Good bye and please come back soon.
No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
You are already in a party.
You are already in a party.
You have received a fame point.
Wait! Don't leave! I want to tell you about my surreal numbers.
entries.translated: Ждать! Не уходи! Хочу рассказать вам о своих сюрреалистических цифрах.

entries.en: Ahhhh! At last someone that can listen to my {story}!
entries.translated: Аааа! Наконец-то кто-то может послушать мой {story}!

entries.en: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
entries.translated: Привет? Что ты имеешь в виду 'hi' - разве ты не видишь, что я... мне нужно понизить голос. Вам не приходило в голову, что этот 'chalice' не хочет, чтобы его беспокоили?! Оставь меня в покое!

entries.en: I greet you, human. This is a time of distress, more than ever are we in need of guardians to protect us and our world.
entries.translated: Приветствую тебя, человек. Это время бедствия, мы больше, чем когда-либо, нуждаемся в стражах, которые защитят нас и наш мир.

entries.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
entries.translated: Что это? Объект с оптическими проблемами под названием |PLAYERNAME|. Как увлекательно!

entries.en: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Подожди там. Я съем тебя после того, как запишу то, что узнал.

entries.en: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Подожди там. Я съем тебя после того, как запишу то, что узнал.

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Оплакивайся, паломник во плоти. Продаю товары общего назначения. Просто попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: You back. You know, you right. Brother is right. Fist not always good. Tell him that!
entries.translated: Ты вернулся. Знаешь, ты прав. Брат прав. Кулак не всегда хорош. Скажи ему это!
Что ты делаешь на моем месте?

entries.en: Take a look in the trade window to your left.
entries.translated: Посмотрите в торговое окно слева от вас.

entries.en: Greetings, pilgrim. Welcome to the halls of hope. We are the keepers of this {temple} and welcome everyone willing to contribute.
entries.translated: Приветствую тебя, паломник. Добро пожаловать в залы надежды. Мы являемся хранителями этого {temple} и приветствуем всех, кто готов внести свой вклад.

entries.en: The pile of bones is empty.
The pile of bones is empty.
All chants have been sung in the right order, you are deemed worthy. You are transported away...
entries.translated: Сви напеви су отпевани у правом редоследу, сматрате се достојним. Превезени сте...

entries.en: You have a feeling of dread.
The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Чини се да су врата запечаћена од нежељених уљеза.

entries.en: You've been into the skirmish in the last 10 hours.
entries.translated: Учествовали сте у окршају у последњих 10 сати.

entries.en: The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Чини се да су врата запечаћена од нежељених уљеза.

entries.en: The telescope provides a perfect view over the endless ocean - no land in sight
entries.translated: Телескоп пружа савршен поглед на бескрајни океан - нема копна на видику

entries.en: You see the scattered parts of a wrecked ship. Miraculously the ship telescope survived the wreckm it seems still to be intact.
entries.translated: Видите разбацане делове разбијеног брода. Чудом је бродски телескоп преживео олупину, чини се да је још увек нетакнут.

entries.en: There are still some loose planks and hawsers. You can't use the raft like this, it will sink for sure.
entries.translated: Још увек има лабавих дасака и хватаљки. Не можете овако користити сплав, сигурно ће потонути.

entries.en: You use the hawser to lash up the loose planks. The raft should be seaworthy now.
entries.translated: Користиш маказе да развучеш лабаве даске. Сплав би сада требало да буде способан за пловидбу.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.translated: Hälsningar människor! Se dig själv som lycklig, jag är i behov av {help}.

entries.en: You have done me a favour and the knowledge you are seeking shall be yours. I melted the ice for you, you can pass now.
entries.translated: Du har gjort mig en tjänst och den kunskap du söker kommer att vara din. Jag smälte isen åt dig, du kan passera nu.

entries.en: Take a look in the trade window to your left.

entries.en: Greetings, pilgrim. Welcome to the halls of hope. We are the keepers of this {temple} and welcome everyone willing to contribute.

entries.en: The customer is king! Come back anytime you want to if you wish to {withdraw} your money.
entries.translated: Клиент всегда прав! Возвращайтесь в любое время, если захотите {withdraw} свои деньги.

entries.en: Great riddle, isn't it? If you can tell me the correct answer, \z I will give you something. Hehehe!

entries.en: Great riddle, isn't it? If you can tell me the correct answer, I will give you something. Hehehe!

entries.en: My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics?
entries.translated: Мои сюрреалистические цифры основаны на удивительных фактах. Вы заинтересованы в раскрытии тайны математической магии?

entries.en: I think you are not in touch with yourself, come back if you have tuned in on your own feelings.
entries.translated: Я думаю, вы не в контакте с самим собой, вернитесь, если настроились на собственные чувства.

entries.en: My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. \z Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics?

entries.en: Then take it and get happy - or die, hehe.
entries.translated: Тогда бери и радуйся — или умрешь, хе-хе.

entries.en: You already know the secrets of mathemagics! Now go and use them to learn.
entries.translated: Вы уже знаете тайны математической магии! Теперь идите и используйте их, чтобы учиться.

entries.en: But first tell me your favourite colour please!
entries.translated: Но сначала скажи мне, пожалуйста, твой любимый цвет!

entries.en: I was captured and tortured to death by the cultists here. They worship a being that they call Ghazbaran ...
entries.translated: Меня схватили и замучили до смерти культисты. Они поклоняются существу, которое называют Ghazbaran...

entries.en: Firy steel it is. Need green ones' breath to melt. Or red even better. Me can make from shield. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: Ватрени челик је. Потребан је дах зелених да се растопи. Или још боље црвено. Могу направити од штита. Мали желиш да тргујеш?

entries.en: Good good! Woman happy will be. Now me happy too and help you.
entries.translated: Добро добро! Жена ће бити срећна. Сада сам и ја срећан и да вам помогнем.

entries.en: Lil' one bring three bast skirts.

entries.translated: Врло племенито. Сјајно. Мени се свиђа. Али ломи се тако брзо. Могу да направим од сјајног оклопа. Мали желиш да тргујеш?

entries.en: Hellsteel is. Cursed and evil. Dangerous to work with. Me can make from evil helmet. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: Хеллстеел је. Проклет и зао. Опасно за рад. Ја могу направити од зле кациге. Мали желиш да тргујеш?

entries.en: Good iron is. Me friends use it much for fight. Me can make from weapon. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: Добро гвожђе је. Моји пријатељи га много користе за борбу. Могу да направим од оружја. Мали желиш да тргујеш?

entries.en: Wait. Me work no cheap is. Do favour for me first, yes?
entries.translated: Чекај. Мој рад није јефтин. Прво ми учини услугу, да?

entries.en: Uh. Me can make some nasty lil' bolt from soul orbs. Lil' one want to trade all?
entries.translated: Ух. Могу да направим неку гадну муњу од сфера душе. Лил' један жели све да тргује?

entries.en: Cling clang! Me done good work today! Li'l one gets double bolts!
entries.translated: Цлинг цланг! Данас сам урадио добар посао! Један добија дупле вијке!

entries.en: Me need gift for woman. We dance, so me want to give her bast skirt. But she big is. So I need many to make big one. Bring three okay? Me wait.
entries.translated: Треба ми поклон за жену. Плешемо, па желим да јој дам сукњу. Али она је велика. Тако да ми треба много да направим велику. Донеси три, ок? Ја чекам.

entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
EVEN WITH ALL THAT TIME IN THE PRISON THAT WEAKENED ME, YOU ARE NO MATCH TO ME!
entries.translated: AUN CON TODO ESE TIEMPO EN LA PRISIÓN QUE ME DEBILITÓ, ¡NO ERES COMPATIBLE PARA MÍ!

entries.en: May your path always be even.
entries.translated: Пусть твой путь всегда будет ровным.

entries.en: May your path always be even.

entries.en: Kneel before the all-devouring power of blooded decay.
entries.translated: Преклоните колени перед всепожирающей силой кровавого разложения.

entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.translated: О, привет, приятно тебя видеть |PLAYERNAME|. Вы здесь, чтобы услышать истории о моем {adventures} или вам нужен {help}?

entries.translated: Что ж, посмотрим, увенчалась ли ваша миссия успехом. Просто принеси мне все необходимое {materials}.

entries.en: You can only use this entrance during the night.
entries.translated: Овај улаз можете користити само током ноћи.

entries.en: The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Чини се да су врата запечаћена од нежељених уљеза.

entries.en: You have completed the food offering ritual!
You must wait. Someone is challenging Furious Scorpion now.
entries.translated: Морате чекати. Неко сада изазива Фуриоус Сцорпион-а.

entries.en: The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Чини се да су врата запечаћена од нежељених уљеза.

entries.en: I greet you, human. This is a time of distress, more than ever are we in need of guardians to protect us and our world.
entries.translated: Поздрављам те човече. Ово је време невоље, више него икада потребни су нам чувари који ће заштитити нас и наш свет.

entries.en: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Сачекај тамо. Појешћу те након што запишем шта сам сазнао.

entries.en: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Сачекај тамо. Појешћу те након што запишем шта сам сазнао.

entries.en: You back. You know, you right. Brother is right. Fist not always good. Tell him that!
entries.translated: Вратио си се. Знаш, у праву си. Брат је у праву. Песница није увек добра. Реци му то!
Шта да радиш на мом месту?

entries.en: Take a look in the trade window to your left.
entries.translated: Погледајте у трговински прозор са ваше леве стране.

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: На услузи, само прегледајте моју робу.

entries.en: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
entries.translated: Hej? Vad menar du 'hi' - kan du inte se att jag är en... Jag måste sänka rösten. Har det fallit dig in att denna 'chalice' inte vill bli störd?! Låt mig vara!

entries.en: I greet you, human. This is a time of distress, more than ever are we in need of guardians to protect us and our world.
entries.translated: Jag hälsar dig, människa. Det här är en tid av nöd, mer än någonsin är vi i behov av vårdnadshavare för att skydda oss och vår värld.

entries.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
entries.translated: Vad är det här? En optiskt utmanad enhet som heter |PLAYERNAME|. Vad fascinerande!

entries.en: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Vänta där. Jag äter dig efter att ha skrivit ner vad jag fick reda på.

entries.en: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Vänta där. Jag äter dig efter att ha skrivit ner vad jag fick reda på.

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Sörjas pilgrim i kött. Jag säljer allmänna varor. Fråga mig bara om en {trade}.

entries.en: You back. You know, you right. Brother is right. Fist not always good. Tell him that!
entries.translated: Du tillbaka. Du vet, du har rätt. Bror har rätt. Fist inte alltid bra. Säg det till honom!
Vad gör du i mitt ställe?

entries.en: Take a look in the trade window to your left.
entries.translated: Ta en titt i handelsfönstret till vänster.

entries.en: Greetings, pilgrim. Welcome to the halls of hope. We are the keepers of this {temple} and welcome everyone willing to contribute.
entries.translated: Hälsningar, pilgrim. Välkommen till hoppets salar. Vi är innehavare av denna {temple} och välkomnar alla som är villiga att bidra.

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Till din tjänst, bläddra bara igenom mina varor.

entries.en: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Only rarely I can welcome {visitors} these days.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido |PLAYERNAME|! Pocas veces puedo darle la bienvenida a {visitors} estos días.

entries.en: Take care, it's dangerous out there.
entries.translated: Tenga cuidado, es peligroso ahí fuera.

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Hola. ¿Cómo puedo ayudarte |PLAYERNAME|? Pídeme un {trade} si quieres comprar algo. También puedo explicar el sistema {mail}.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
entries.translated: Aquí. No olvides que también debes comprar una etiqueta si quieres enviar un paquete. Escriba siempre el nombre del {receiver} en la primera línea.

entries.en: At last, a visitor! Welcome to my... humble abode. {Scroll} or {mission}?
entries.translated: ¡Por fin un visitante! Bienvenidos a mi... humilde morada. ¿{Scroll} o {mission}?

entries.en: Well done! But know this: The cursed crystal seems to regenerate over time. It could be necessary to come back and repeat whatever you have done down there.
entries.translated: ¡Bien hecho! Pero debes saber esto: el cristal maldito parece regenerarse con el tiempo. Podría ser necesario volver y repetir lo que hayas hecho allí abajo.

entries.en: Hello there. I'm sorry, I hardly noticed you. I'm a bit nervous. The spooky {sounds} down there, you know
entries.translated: Hola. Lo siento, casi no te noté. Estoy un poco nervioso. El espeluznante {sounds} ahí abajo, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. You've come at a good time for our {project}.
entries.translated: Hola, |PLAYERNAME|. Has llegado en un buen momento para nuestro {project}.

entries.en: What's your business here with the {magicians}, |PLAYERNAME|?
Good bye, and don't come back too soon.
entries.translated: Adiós y no vuelvas demasiado pronto.

entries.en: Welcome to our humble guild, wanderer. May I be of any assistance to you?
entries.translated: Bienvenido a nuestro humilde gremio, vagabundo. ¿Puedo serte de alguna ayuda?

entries.en: Good bye, visit me again. I will be here, promised.
entries.translated: Adiós, visítame de nuevo. Estaré aquí, prometido.

entries.en: Good bye, visit me again. I will be here, promised.

entries.en: Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
entries.translated: Бригхтстеел је. Много уметности је направљено са њим. Чаробњаци су превише лењи и плаше се да много очарају.

entries.en: Heartiron from heart of big old mountain, found very deep. Lil' lil ones fiercely defend. Not wanting to have it used for stuff but holy stuff.
entries.translated: Хеартирон из срца велике старе планине, пронађен веома дубоко. Лил' лил оне жестоко бране. Не желим да се користи за ствари, већ за свете ствари.

entries.en: Me parents live here before town was. Me not care about lil' ones.
entries.translated: Моји родитељи живе овде пре града. Није ме брига за мале.

entries.en: Lil' lil' ones are so fun. We often chat.
entries.translated: Лил' лил' оне су тако забавне. Често ћаскамо.

entries.en: One day I'll go and look.
entries.translated: Једног дана ћу отићи и погледати.

entries.en: Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.

entries.translated: Да ли је из породице вилењака или тако нешто. Не разумем мале и њихов посао.

entries.en: I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
entries.translated: Назвао сам Бенцтхицлтхртрпрр својим људима. Мали које ја зовем Биг Бен.

entries.en: You shut up. Me not want to hear.
entries.translated: Ти умукни. Не желим да чујем.

entries.en: Do lil' one want to trade a fire sword?
entries.translated: Да ли мали жели да мења ватрени мач?

entries.en: Do lil' one want to trade a dragon shield?
entries.translated: Да ли мали жели да мења змајев штит?

entries.en: Do lil' one want to trade a sword of valor?
entries.translated: Да ли мали жели да размени мач храбрости?

entries.en: Do lil' one want to trade a warlord sword?
entries.translated: Да ли мали жели да размени мач војсковође?

entries.en: They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
entries.translated: Били су пријатељи са мојим родитељима. Много пре вилењака овде су често долазили у посету. Не долази више овамо.

entries.en: Me not fight them, they not fight me.
entries.translated: Ја се не борим против њих, они се не боре против мене.

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Till din tjänst, bläddra bara igenom mina varor.

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Till din tjänst, bläddra bara igenom mina varor.
Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.en: I am a little sad, that you seem to have forgotten me, handsome. I am Aruda.
entries.translated: Trochę mi smutno, że chyba mnie zapomniałeś, przystojniaku. Jestem Aruda.

entries.en: Oh, I like it, how you say my name.
entries.translated: Och, podoba mi się, jak wymawiasz moje imię.

entries.en: Please don't be so rude to look for the time if you are talking to me.
entries.translated: Proszę, nie bądź taki niegrzeczny i nie zerkaj na zegar, kiedy ze mną rozmawiasz.

entries.en: I am deeply sorry, I can't help you.
entries.translated: Bardzo mi przykro, nie mogę ci pomóc.

entries.en: UH! What a terrifying topic. Please let us speak about something more pleasant, I am a weak and small woman after all.
entries.translated: Uch! Co za przerażający temat. Porozmawiajmy o czymś przyjemniejszym. W końcu jestem słabą i drobną kobietą.

entries.en: What gives you the impression, I am the kind of women, you find in sewers?
entries.translated: Co sprawia, że myślisz, że jestem kobietą, którą znajdziesz w kanałach?

entries.en: You should ask about that in one of the temples.
entries.translated: Powinieneś zapytać o to w którejś ze świątyń.

entries.en: The king, that lives in this fascinating castle? I think he does look kind of cute in his luxurious robes, doesn't he?
entries.translated: Król, który mieszka w tym fascynującym zamku? Myślę, że w swoich luksusowych szatach wygląda całkiem uroczo, nie sądzisz?

entries.en: Oh, sorry, I was distracted, what did you say?
entries.translated: Och, przepraszam, rozproszyłam się. Co powiedziałeś?

entries.en: He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! Did you ask him for a date?
entries.translated: On jest taaaki silny! Jakie mięśnie! Jaka sylwetka! Poprosiłeś go o randkę?

entries.en: He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! On the other hand, compared to you he looks quite puny.
entries.translated: On jest taaaki silny! Jakie mięśnie! Jaka sylwetka! Z drugiej strony, przy tobie wygląda całkiem mizernie.

entries.en: He is a little simple minded but always nice and well dressed.
entries.translated: Jest trochę prostoduszny, ale zawsze miły i dobrze ubrany.

entries.en: He should really sell some stylish gowns or something like that. We Tibians never get some clothing of the latest fashion. It's a shame.
entries.translated: Powinien sprzedawać jakieś stylowe suknie czy coś takiego. My, Tibijczycy, nigdy nie dostajemy ubrań zgodnych z najnowszą modą. Szkoda.

entries.en: I don't understand this lonely monks. I love company too much to become one. Hehehe!
entries.translated: Nie rozumiem tych samotnych mnichów. Za bardzo lubię towarzystwo, by sama zostać jednym z nich. Hehehe!

entries.en: Oh, isn't he funny? I could listen to him the whole day.
entries.translated: Och, czy on nie jest zabawny? Mogłabym go słuchać cały dzień.

entries.en: As far as I know, he is working in the castle.
entries.translated: O ile wiem, pracuje w zamku.

entries.en: I am a little shy and so don't hear many rumors.
entries.translated: Jestem trochę nieśmiała, więc nie słyszę wielu plotek.

entries.en: Oh, you little devil, stop talking like that! <blush>
entries.translated: Och, ty mały diabełku, przestań tak mówić! <blush>

entries.en: I know only little about weapons. Can you tell me something about them, please?
entries.translated: Wiem niewiele o broni. Czy możesz opowiedzieć mi coś o niej, proszę?

entries.en: Oh, I just remember I have some work to do, sorry. Bye!
entries.translated: Och, właśnie sobie przypomniałam, że mam trochę pracy. Przepraszam. Pa!

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: Me the greenest and the meanest!
Me have power to crush you!
entries.translated: Ја имам моћ да те скршим!

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
EVEN WITH ALL THAT TIME IN THE PRISON THAT WEAKENED ME, YOU ARE NO MATCH TO ME!
entries.translated: AUN CON TODO ESE TIEMPO EN LA PRISIÓN QUE ME DEBILITÓ, ¡NO ERES COMPATIBLE PARA MÍ!

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.translated: Помните: если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу вылечить вас бесплатно.

entries.en: You can only use the shrine on an valid item.
entries.translated: Puteți folosi altarul numai pentru un articol valid.

entries.en: Put the construction kit on the floor first.
entries.translated: Puneți mai întâi trusa de construcție pe podea.

entries.en: You may construct this only inside a house.
entries.translated: Poți construi acest lucru doar în interiorul unei case.

entries.en: You may construct this only inside a house.
entries.translated: Poți construi acest lucru doar în interiorul unei case.

entries.en: You need 5 players to fight with this boss.
entries.translated: Ai nevoie de 5 jucători pentru a lupta cu acest boss.

entries.en: You have entered an ancient demon prison cell!
entries.translated: Ai intrat într-o celulă antică de închisoare a demonilor!

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: На услузи, само прегледајте моју робу.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Пажљиво прегледаш свитке. То су наређења од Rathleton за амбасадора. Овде нема знакова издаје.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at
entries.translated: Наравно, само прегледајте моју робу. Или желите да гледате само у

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
entries.translated: Запамтите: ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вас излечити бесплатно.

entries.en: Nature's blessing, traveller! May you not be affected by any sinister force.
entries.translated: Благослов природе, путниче! Нека на вас не утиче никаква злокобна сила.

entries.en: May your path always be even.
entries.translated: Нека твој пут увек буде раван.

entries.en: May your path always be even.
entries.translated: Нека твој пут увек буде раван.

entries.en: Kneel before the all-devouring power of blooded decay.
entries.translated: Клекни пред свепрождирућом снагом крвавог пропадања.

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
entries.translated: Запамтите: ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вас излечити бесплатно.

entries.en: Oh hello, nice to see you |PLAYERNAME|. Are you here to hear some stories of my {adventures} or do you need {help}?
entries.translated: Åh hej, trevligt att se dig |PLAYERNAME|. Är du här för att höra några berättelser om min {adventures} eller behöver du {help}?

entries.en: Hello, I am the warden of this {monument}. The {sarcophagus} in front of you was established to prevent people from going {down} there. But I doubt that this step is sufficient.
entries.translated: Hej, jag är vaktmästare för denna {monument}. {sarcophagus} framför dig skapades för att hindra människor från att gå {down} dit. Men jag tvivlar på att detta steg är tillräckligt.

entries.en: Well, let's see if your mission was successful. Just bring me all needed {materials}.
entries.translated: Nåväl, låt oss se om ditt uppdrag var framgångsrikt. Ta bara med mig alla nödvändiga {materials}.

entries.en: If you dug up all three crystals of sufficient quantity and obtained the poison gland, the charging of your compass can start! For the very first time it will be charged by the violet crystal. Ready to {unleash} the power of the crystals?
entries.translated: Om du grävde upp alla tre kristallerna i tillräcklig mängd och fick giftkörteln, kan laddningen av din kompass börja! För allra första gången kommer den att laddas av den violetta kristallen. Är du redo att {unleash} kraften i kristallerna?

entries.en: Greetings adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
entries.translated: Hälsningar äventyraren |PLAYERNAME|. Vad leder dig till mig?

entries.en: Good bye and take care of you!
entries.translated: Hejdå och ta hand om dig!

entries.en: The gods must be praised that I am finally saved. I do not have many worldly possessions, but please accept a small reward, do you?
entries.translated: Gudarna måste prisas att jag äntligen är frälst. Jag har inte många världsliga ägodelar, men snälla acceptera en liten belöning, gör du?

entries.en: Thanks for saving my life! Should I teleport you out of the Dark Cathedral?
entries.translated: Tack för att du räddade mitt liv! Ska jag teleportera dig ut ur den mörka katedralen?

entries.en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
entries.translated: Druid av Crunor? Han berättade att en ny grotta dök upp här? Det stämmer. Jag är chef för en {project} som försöker ta reda på mer om denna nya {area}.

entries.en: Just get out of my way! You killed this beautiful creature. I have nothing more to say. Damn druid of Crunor!
entries.translated: Gå bara ur min väg! Du dödade denna vackra varelse. Jag har inget mer att säga. Crunors jävla druid!

entries.en: Hello, mighty adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. Can I teach you something you don't know?
entries.translated: Hola, poderoso aventurero |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Puedo enseñarte algo que no sabes?

entries.en: Go and be careful. Remember what you have learned!
entries.translated: Ve y ten cuidado. ¡Recuerda lo que has aprendido!

entries.en: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you?
It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Tenga en cuenta que no encontrará mejores ofertas aquí. Simplemente navega por mis productos.

entries.en: Yeah, another fool {disturbing} me, what a joy.
entries.translated: Sí, otro tonto {disturbing} de mí, que alegría.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Te sientes aventurero? ¿Quiere un {ticket} semanal para el sistema de vagones de mineral aquí? ¡Puedes usarlo aquí mismo para llegar al centro de Kazordoon!

entries.en: Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|! I can smell the scent of a phoenix on you!
entries.translated: ¡Sea saludado |PLAYERNAME|! ¡Puedo oler el aroma de un fénix en ti!

entries.en: May the fire in your heart never die, |PLAYERNAME|!
entries.translated: ¡Que el fuego de tu corazón nunca se apague, |PLAYERNAME|!

entries.en: May the fire in your heart never die.
entries.translated: Que el fuego de tu corazón nunca se apague.

entries.en: Ah, a customer! Please feel free to browse my wares, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: ¡Ah, un cliente! No dude en explorar mis productos, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: Adiós. Recomiéndenos si quedó satisfecho con nuestro servicio.

entries.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, may the winds guide your way.

entries.translated: Apa din acest vas a fost purificată

entries.en: Purified by sacred fires, this coal has the power to cleanse a significant amount of impure water
entries.translated: Purificat prin focuri sacre, acest cărbune are puterea de a curăța o cantitate semnificativă de apă impură

entries.en: This chunk was cut from sacred wood in the temple complex and looks ideal for carving
entries.translated: Această bucată a fost tăiată din lemn sacru în complexul templului și arată ideală pentru sculptură

entries.en: This clay has been dug from sacred ground
entries.translated: Acest lut a fost săpat din pământ sacru

entries.en: This clay has been mixed with sacred earth
entries.translated: Acest lut a fost amestecat cu pământ sacru

entries.en: This bowl was coated with sacred clay and can be used to purify small amounts of corrupted water
entries.translated: Acest vas a fost acoperit cu argilă sacră și poate fi folosit pentru a purifica cantități mici de apă coruptă

entries.en: This plant poison is meant to destroy the growths near the Keeper's lair deep beneath the gardens
entries.translated: Această otravă de plante este menită să distrugă creșterile din apropierea bârlogului Păstrătorului, adânc sub grădini.

entries.en: This potion will help you enter the dreams of any lifeform
entries.translated: Această poțiune te va ajuta să intri în visele oricărei forme de viață

entries.en: The dwarven emperor is sleeping there.
Only a single word is scribbled on the sheet: SOLOSARASATIQUARIUM
entries.translated: Pe foaie este mâzgălit un singur cuvânt: SOLOSARASATIQUARIUM

entries.en: It seems to be perfect to shape a weapon from it. Someone could definitely be interested in it
entries.translated: Pare a fi perfect pentru a modela o armă din ea. Cu siguranță cineva ar putea fi interesat de asta

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.translated: Sei ferito, figlio mio. Guarirò le tue ferite.

entries.en: I greet you, human. This is a time of distress, more than ever are we in need of guardians to protect us and our world.
entries.translated: Поздрављам те човече. Ово је време невоље, више него икада потребни су нам чувари који ће заштитити нас и наш свет.

entries.en: Crafted generations ago to rob a creature of its freedom for that it may earn it again truthfully. You will need them if you plan on returning the birds to their rightful home in the glade. ...
entries.translated: Створен генерацијама уназад да бићу отму слободу да би је истински поново заслужио. Биће вам потребни ако планирате да вратите птице у њихов законити дом на пропланку. ...

entries.en: Are you in need of another one?
entries.translated: Да ли вам треба још један?

entries.en: Indeed, you will. Take one of these cages, which have been crafted generations ago to rob a creature of its freedom for that it may earn it again truthfully. Return the birds back to their home in the glade. ...
entries.translated: Заиста, хоћеш. Узмите један од ових кавеза, који су направљени пре неколико генерација да би одузели слободу створењу да би је поново истински заслужили. Вратите птице у њихов дом на пропланку. ...

entries.en: You will find {phials} for water near this sacred well which will take you safely to the glade. No seeds are left, they are in the hands of the intruders now. Have faith in yourself, guardian.
entries.translated: Наћи ћете {phials} за воду у близини овог светог бунара који ће вас безбедно одвести на пропланак. Нема више семена, сада су у рукама уљеза. Имај вере у себе, чувару.

entries.en: My pride is great but not greater than reason. I am not too proud to ask for help as this is a dark hour. ...
entries.translated: Мој понос је велики, али не већи од разума. Нисам превише поносан да тражим помоћ јер је ово мрачан час. ...

entries.en: This glade has been desecrated. We kept it secret for centuries, yet evil has found a way to sully and destroy what was our most sacred. ...
entries.translated: Овај пропланак је оскрнављен. Вековима смо то чували у тајности, али је зло пронашло начин да укаља и уништи оно што је било наше најсветије. ...

entries.en: There is only one way to reinvigorate its spirits, a guardian must venture down there and bring life back into the forest. ...
entries.translated: Постоји само један начин да се оживи њен дух, чувар мора да се упусти тамо доле и врати живот у шуму. ...

entries.en: The purest {water} from the purest well needs to be brought there and poured and {birds} that give life need to be brought back to the inner sanctum of the glade. ...
entries.translated: Најчистије {water} из најчистијег бунара треба донети тамо и излити, а {birds} које дају живот треба вратити у унутрашње светиште пропланка. ...

entries.en: Seeds to give life to strong trees, blooming and proud. The {intruders} robbed us from them.
entries.translated: Семе које даје живот снажном дрвећу, цветајућем и поносном. {intruders} нас је опљачкао од њих.

entries.en: The intruders appeared in the blink of an eye. Out of thin air, as if they came from nowhere. They overrun the glade within ours and drove away what was remaining from us within the day.
entries.translated: Уљези су се појавили за трен ока. Из ничега, као да су дошли ниоткуда. Прегазили су пропланак унутар нашег и отерали оно што нам је остало у току дана.

entries.en: The purest water flows through this well. For centuries we concealed it, for other beings to not lay their eyes on it.
entries.translated: Кроз овај бунар тече најчистија вода. Вековима смо је скривали, да друга бића не виде.

entries.en: Phials for the purest water from our sacred well. They are finely crafted and very fragile. We keep a small supply up here around the well. Probably the only thing the intruders did not care for.
entries.translated: Фијале за најчистију воду из нашег светог бунара. Фино су израђене и веома крхке. Имамо малу залиху овде око бунара. Вероватно једино што уљези нису марили.

entries.en: I already handed a cage to you. If you are in need of another one, you will have to return to me later.
entries.translated: Већ сам ти дао кавез. Ако вам затреба још један, мораћете да ми се вратите касније.

entries.en: Just get out of my way! You killed this beautiful creature. I have nothing more to say. Damn druid of Crunor!
entries.translated: Gå bara ur min väg! Du dödade denna vackra varelse. Jag har inget mer att säga. Crunors jävla druid!

entries.translated: Må din väg alltid vara jämn.

entries.en: Yenny? I know no Yenny, nor have I ever used that name! You have mistook me with someone else.
entries.translated: Yenny? Nie znam żadnej Yenny i nigdy nie używałam takiego imienia! Pomyliłeś mnie z kimś innym.

entries.en: Well ... I have met him for a little while .. but this was nothing serious.
entries.translated: Cóż... spotykałam się z nim przez krótki czas... ale to nic poważnego.

entries.en: Thank you very much. How kind of you to care about me. I am fine, thank you.
entries.translated: Dziękuję bardzo. Jak miło z twojej strony, że się o mnie troszczysz. U mnie wszystko w porządku, dziękuję.

entries.en: I hope to see you soon.
entries.translated: Mam nadzieję, że wkrótce cię zobaczę.

entries.en: Welcome to Carlin, |PLAYERNAME| Would you like some information and a map guide?
entries.translated: Witaj w Carlin, |PLAYERNAME|. Czy chcesz informacje i przewodnik po mapie?

entries.en: Daraman's blessings, enjoy your stay in Darashia, |PLAYERNAME|
entries.translated: Błogosławieństwo Daramana, miłego pobytu w Darashii, |PLAYERNAME|

entries.en: Daraman's blessings, Black Sabbatth, welcome to Darashia! Would you like some information and a map guide?
entries.translated: Błogosławieństwo Daramana, Black Sabbatth, witaj w Darashii! Chcesz trochę informacji i przewodnik po mapie?

entries.en: Hello there, |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to Liberty Bay! Would you like some information and a map guide?
entries.translated: Witaj, |PLAYERNAME|, i witaj w Liberty Bay! Czy chcesz informacje i przewodnik po mapie?

entries.en: Meow, welcome to Yalahar |PLAYERNAME|! Even though I might not look like it, I can give you {information} and a {map} guide. Need some?
entries.translated: Miau, witaj w Yalahar, |PLAYERNAME|! Choć może tak nie wyglądam, mogę dać ci {information} i przewodnik po {map}. Potrzebujesz?

entries.en: Welcome to Venore, |PLAYERNAME| Would you like some information and a map guide?
entries.translated: Witaj w Venore, |PLAYERNAME|. Czy chcesz informacje i przewodnik po mapie?

entries.en: Welcome to Rathleton, |PLAYERNAME|! Looking for a transport to the main isle of Oramond or would you like some information and a mapguide?
entries.translated: Witaj w Rathleton, |PLAYERNAME|! Szukasz transportu na główną wyspę Oramond, czy chcesz informacji i przewodnik po mapie?

entries.en: Hello there, |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to Thais! Would you like some {information} and a {map} guide?
entries.translated: Witaj, |PLAYERNAME|, i witaj w Thais! Czy chcesz {information} i przewodnik po {map}?

entries.en: Welcome to Ankrahmun, |PLAYERNAME| This city can be a bit confusing at first. Would you like some information and a map guide?
entries.translated: Witaj w Ankrahmun, |PLAYERNAME|. To miasto na początku może być trochę mylące. Chcesz informacje i przewodnik po mapie?

entries.en: Hello there, |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to Ab'Dendriel! Would you like some information and a map guide?
entries.translated: Witaj, |PLAYERNAME|, i witaj w Ab'Dendriel! Czy chcesz informacje i przewodnik po mapie?

entries.en: Hello there, and welcome to Port Hope! Would you like some information and a map guide?
entries.translated: Witaj i witaj w Port Hope! Chcesz trochę informacji i przewodnik po mapie?

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Lovely steamboat, ain't it? I can even offer you a {passage} if you like.
entries.translated: Witaj, |PLAYERNAME|! Piękny parowiec, prawda? Mogę nawet zaoferować ci {passage}, jeśli chcesz.

entries.en:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
entries.translated: Cóż, możesz być właśnie bohaterem, którego tam potrzebują. Prawdę mówiąc, część naszych najbardziej niezawodnych kopalń rudy zaczęła się wyczerpywać... \z Dlatego rozwinęliśmy nowe technologie parowców, by móc dalej badać i kartografować wielkie podziemne rzeki. Nasi bracia założyli bazę na kontynencie bardzo, bardzo daleko stąd... \z Nazywamy ją bazą bardzo, bardzo daleko. Ale ponieważ mamy nadzieję, że pewnego dnia stanie się kwitnącą kopalnią, większość z nas zaczęła nazywać ją {Farmine}. Krasnoludy na miejscu naprawdę potrzebują teraz pomocy.

entries.en: Be greeted, friend of the ape people. If you want to {trade}, just ask for my offers. If you are injured, ask for healing.
entries.translated: Witaj, przyjacielu małpiego ludu. Jeśli chcesz {trade}, po prostu zapytaj o moje oferty. Jeśli jesteś ranny, poproś o leczenie.

entries.en: Hello competitor! Do you want to {fight} in the arena or shall I explain the {rules} first?
entries.translated: Witaj, zawodniku! Chcesz {fight} na arenie, czy mam najpierw wyjaśnić {rules}?

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

EVEN WITH ALL THAT TIME IN THE PRISON THAT WEAKENED ME, YOU ARE NO MATCH TO ME!

entries.en: I feel you. I hear your thoughts. You are ... alive.

entries.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, may the winds guide your way.
entries.translated: Adiós, |PLAYERNAME|, que los vientos guíen tu camino.

entries.en: Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
entries.translated: ¡Tómate todo el tiempo que necesites para decidir lo que quieres!

entries.en: Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
entries.translated: ¿Mip? Quiero decir, ¡hola! Lo siento, |PLAYERNAME|... Ser {rat} me ha gustado mucho.

entries.en: Be greeted. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
entries.translated: Sea saludado. ¿Hay algo que pueda {do for you}?

entries.en: Greetings |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
Hello sweetie. If you need general equipment, stuff like that, let me know.
entries.translated: Hola cariño. Si necesitas equipo general o cosas así, dímelo.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. Remember that if you buy vials of oil, there's a deposit of 5 gold on the empty one.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, simplemente navega por mis productos. Recuerda que si compras viales de aceite, hay un depósito de 5 de oro por el vacío.

entries.en: Hello there, mate. Here for a {trade}? My stock's just been refilled.
entries.translated: Hola, amigo. ¿Estás aquí por un {trade}? Acaban de recargar mis existencias.

entries.en: |PLAYERNAME| HEHEHEHE! Another fool visits the {tower}! Excellent!
HEHEHE! I knew you don't have the stomach.
Hrmpf, I'd say welcome if I felt like lying.
entries.translated: Hrmpf, diría bienvenido si tuviera ganas de mentir.

entries.en: Everyone on this island has gone crazy! Except for me and you, it seems. Let's {trade} like normal people would.
entries.translated: ¡Todos en esta isla se han vuelto locos! Excepto tú y yo, al parecer. Hagamos {trade} como lo haría la gente normal.

entries.en: Promise to come back sometime, will ya?
Hey! Don't leave me alone with all these lunatics!
entries.translated: ¡Ey! ¡No me dejes solo con todos estos locos!

entries.en: I welcome thee, |PLAYERNAME|! I suppose you are looking for a trade in fine weapons!
entries.translated: ¡Te doy la bienvenida, |PLAYERNAME|! ¡Supongo que estás buscando un negocio de armas finas!

entries.en: Goodbye and please bring more gold next time <chuckles>. I mean, it would be nice to see you again.
entries.translated: Adiós y trae más oro la próxima vez <chuckles>. Quiero decir, sería bueno verte de nuevo.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: It's too tiny to be worn by humans
entries.translated: Este prea mic pentru a fi purtat de oameni

entries.en: It's too large to be worn by humans, but rather light
entries.translated: Este prea mare pentru a fi purtat de oameni, ci mai degrabă ușor

entries.en: A dark curse prevents you from wearing it

entries.en: Yuck. This might only be interesting to botanists
entries.translated: Naiba. Acest lucru ar putea fi interesant doar pentru botanici

entries.en: The strong smell of orcish sweat sticks to it

entries.en: Cruel beings. Large and monstrous, with a single eye, staring at their prey.
entries.translated: Окрутна бића. Велики и монструозни, са једним оком, буље у свој плен.

entries.en: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Сачекај тамо. Појешћу те након што запишем шта сам сазнао.

entries.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
entries.translated: Шта је ово? Ентитет са оптичким изазовом који се зове |PLAYERNAME|. Како фасцинантно!

entries.en: These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.
entries.translated: Ове будале и њихов сујеверни животни култ не разумеју ништа важно.
Само инфериорним врстама је потребно оружје.

entries.en: I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
entries.translated: Чуо сам да су се вилењаци уселили горе.

entries.en: Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics you are a master over life and death.
entries.translated: Бројеви су неопходни. Они су тајна иза сцене. Ако сте магистар математике, ви сте господар живота и смрти.

entries.en: Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.
entries.translated: Наше књиге су написане у 469, наравно да их не можете разумети.

entries.en: Go and wash your eyes for using this obscene number!
entries.translated: Иди и опери очи због употребе овог опсценог броја!

entries.en: The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.
entries.translated: Језик моје врсте. Врхунски је у односу на било који други језик и да га говоре само ентитети са довољно очију да трепну.

entries.en: Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer then they know and closer then it's good for them.
entries.translated: Њихови магови су тако близу истини. Ближе него што знају и ближе онда је добро за њих.

entries.en: Good tools to work with ... After their death, that is.
entries.translated: Добар алат за рад ... После њихове смрти, тј.

entries.en: Yes, yes, I will kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigation on you.
entries.translated: Да, да, ускоро ћу те убити, а сад ми дозволи да наставим истрагу о теби.

entries.en: They will mourn the day they abandoned us.
entries.translated: Они ће оплакивати дан када су нас напустили.

entries.en: It's a fine library, isn't it?
entries.translated: То је добра библиотека, зар не?

entries.en: May your path always be even.
entries.translated: Må din väg alltid vara jämn.

entries.en: Ahoy, matey! Lookin' for a {passage}, eh.
Ahoy, matey! Lookin' for a {passage}, eh.
Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: Żegnaj, |PLAYERNAME|, będę tu, jeśli znów będziesz mnie potrzebować.

entries.en: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. The {spiritual} world looks upon you and your deeds.
entries.translated: Witaj, |PLAYERNAME|. Świat {spiritual} patrzy na ciebie i twoje czyny.
|PLAYERNAME|, dzień dobry... albo noc dobry... cokolwiek.

entries.en: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. You must be the one sent by Lily. Do you have a sack of {herbs} for me?
entries.translated: Pozdrawiam, podróżniku |PLAYERNAME|. To ty musisz być tym, którego przysłała Lily. Czy masz dla mnie worek {herbs}?

entries.en: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. As you have found the way to my hut, how can I {help} you?
entries.translated: Pozdrowienia, podróżniku |PLAYERNAME|. Skoro odnalazłeś drogę do mojej chaty, jak mogę ci {help}?

entries.en: See you later |PLAYERNAME| come back soon.
See you later |PLAYERNAME| come back soon.

This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.

entries.translated: Pilnuj dobrze swojego kamienia poszukiwacza przygód.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?
