entries.en: Hello, my lad. Sit down, have a drink, why don't you?
entries.translated: Hola, muchacho. Siéntate, toma una copa, ¿por qué no?

entries.en: Hunter's greeting! I assume you want something from me since you came all the way out here on your own. This is a dangerous place to be, I doubt that all my men will accept strangers like I do. You don't seem to have any problems with that, though.
entries.translated: ¡El saludo de Hunter! Supongo que quieres algo de mí ya que viniste hasta aquí por tu cuenta. Este es un lugar peligroso, dudo que todos mis hombres acepten extraños como yo. Aunque no pareces tener ningún problema con eso.

entries.en: Welcome to the finest weaponshop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|! Tell me if you're looking for a good {trade}.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido a la mejor tienda de armas del país, |PLAYERNAME|! Dime si buscas un buen {trade}.

entries.en: Oh, a customer. Hello |PLAYERNAME|. If you'd like to see my wonderful self-tailored clothes, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Ah, un cliente. Hola |PLAYERNAME|. Si quieres ver mi maravillosa ropa hecha a medida, pídeme un {trade}.

entries.en: Hello, my name is Saideh. Once this was the entry to the crypt of our heroes. One of the graves belongs to our beloved hero Dayyan. Nowadays it is not a good idea to visit this place.
entries.translated: Hola, mi nombre es Saideh. Una vez esta fue la entrada a la cripta de nuestros héroes. Una de las tumbas pertenece a nuestro querido héroe Dayyan. Hoy en día no es buena idea visitar este lugar.

entries.en: Welcome to my shop, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|! I {trade} with weapons and armor.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido a mi tienda, aventurero |PLAYERNAME|! Yo {trade} con armas y armaduras.

entries.en: Praise the gods, I bid you farewell.
entries.translated: Alabado sea los dioses, me despido de vosotros.

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|, please come back soon.
Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|, please come back soon.
Of course, just browse through my wares. By the way, if you'd like to join our bonus system for depositing flasks and vial, you have to tell me about that {deposit}.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, simplemente navega por mis productos. Por cierto, si quieres unirte a nuestro sistema de bonificación por depósito de matraces y viales, tienes que contarme sobre eso {deposit}.

entries.en: ...er... hello? Yes...? Well, if... if you have any questions - I am not even here.
entries.translated: ...eh... ¿hola? Sí...? Bueno, si... si tienes alguna pregunta... ni siquiera estoy aquí.

entries.en: Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I asked you if you saw your 'level up'! You did, {right}?
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido de nuevo! ¿Dónde estábamos...? Ah, claro, ¡te pregunté si viste tu 'level up'! ¿Lo hiciste, {right}?

entries.en: Good bye traveller, and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
entries.translated: Adiós viajero y disfrute de su estadía en Rookgaard.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, nice to see you on Rookgaard! I saw you walking by and wondered if you could help me. Could you? Please, say {yes}!
entries.translated: Hola |PLAYERNAME|, ¡encantado de verte en Rookgaard! Te vi pasar y me pregunté si podrías ayudarme. ¿Podrías? ¡Por favor, diga {yes}!

entries.en: Oh, |PLAYERNAME|, it's you again! It's probably impolite to disturb a busy adventurer like you, but I really need help. Please, say {yes}!
entries.translated: ¡Oh, |PLAYERNAME|, eres tú otra vez! Probablemente sea de mala educación molestar a un aventurero ocupado como tú, pero realmente necesito ayuda. ¡Por favor, diga {yes}!

entries.en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
entries.translated: Chchch. Chh! <non ne sei sicuro, ma sembra che lo scoiattolo voglia scambiare le tue preziose ghiande con pietre inutili che ha trovato e considerate immangiabili>

entries.en: Ah, I feel a mortal walks these ancient halls again. Pardon me, I barely notice you. I am so lost in my thoughts.
entries.translated: Ah, sento che un mortale cammina di nuovo per queste antiche sale. Perdonami, ti noto a malapena. Sono così perso nei miei pensieri.

entries.en: You will now be travelled out of here. Are you sure that you want to face that teleport?
entries.translated: Ora sarai portato fuori di qui. Sei sicuro di voler affrontare quel teletrasporto?

entries.en: Then stay here in these ghostly halls.
entries.translated: Allora resta qui, in queste sale spettrali.

entries.en: I feel you. I hear your thoughts. You are ... alive.
entries.translated: Ti capisco. Sento i tuoi pensieri. Tu sei... vivo.

entries.en: Once I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
entries.translated: Una volta ero un membro dell'ordine dei cavalieri dell'incubo. Ora non sono altro che un'ombra che cammina per questi freddi corridoi.

entries.en: Well then. Here, take the book, I added the story. Oh, just a piece of advice: Not to inflame prejudice but poachers are of rather simple disposition. I doubt they are ardent readers. ...
entries.translated: Па онда. Ево, узми књигу, додао сам причу. Ох, само један савет: да не распаљујем предрасуде, али ловокрадице су прилично једноставне нарави. Сумњам да су ватрени читаоци. ...

entries.en: So if you want to make sure they read this anytime soon, perhaps don't hide the book in a shelf or chest. Make sure to place it somewhere where they will find it easily, like very obviously on a table or something.
entries.translated: Дакле, ако желите да будете сигурни да ће ово ускоро прочитати, можда немојте сакрити књигу у полицу или шкрињу. Побрините се да га ставите негде где ће га лако пронаћи, као што је очигледно на столу или нешто слично.

entries.en: Of course you do! Go hunt down the thieves and bring back the stuff they have stolen from me. ...
entries.translated: Наравно да хоћеш! Идите у лов на лопове и вратите ствари које су ми украли. ...

entries.en: I saw them running out of town and then to the north. Maybe they hide at the oasis.
entries.translated: Видео сам их како трче из града, а затим на север. Можда се крију у оази.

entries.en: What are you talking about?? I was robbed!!!! Someone catch those filthy thieves!!!!! GUARDS! ...
entries.translated: О чему причаш?? Био сам опљачкан!!!! Нека неко ухвати те прљаве лопове!!!!! ГУАРДС! ...

entries.en: <nothing happens>....<SIGH> Like usual, they hide at the slightest sign of trouble! YOU! Want to earn some quick money?
entries.translated: <ништа се не дешава>....<УЗДАХ> Као и обично, крију се на најмањи знак невоље! ТИ! Желите да зарадите брзо новац?

entries.en: You need some forged documents? But I will only forge something for a friend. ...
entries.translated: Требају вам фалсификована документа? Али сковати ћу нешто само за пријатеља. ...

entries.en: The nomads at the northern oasis killed someone dear to me. Go and kill at least one of them, then we talk about your document.
entries.translated: Номади у северној оази убили су неког мени драгог. Иди и убиј бар једног од њих, па ћемо онда причати о твом документу.

entries.en: The slayer of my enemies is my friend! For a mere 1000 gold I will create the documents you need. Are you interested?
entries.translated: Убица мојих непријатеља је мој пријатељ! За само 1000 злата направићу документе који су вам потребни. Да ли сте заинтересовани?

entries.en: I see: You want me to add an additional story to this book. A legend about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer. I could do that, yes. It costs 5000 gold, however. Are you still interested?
entries.translated: Видим: желите да овој књизи додам још једну причу. Легенда о томе како убити белог јелена доноси несрећу. Могао бих то да урадим, да. Међутим, кошта 5000 злата. Да ли сте још увек заинтересовани?

entries.en: And here they are! Now forget where you got them from.
entries.translated: И ево их! Сада заборавите одакле сте их набавили.

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Ahh, you found my chest. Let me take a look at you. You put on that coat, {yes}?

entries.en: Hey, I want to give you a weapon for free! You should not refuse that, in fact you should say '{yes}'!
entries.translated: ¡Oye, quiero darte un arma gratis! ¡No deberías negarte a eso, de hecho deberías decir '{yes}'!

entries.en: Good job! For that, I'll grant you 100 experience points! Oh - what was that? I think you advanced a level, {right}?
entries.translated: ¡Buen trabajo! ¡Por eso te otorgaré 100 puntos de experiencia! Ah, ¿qué fue eso? Creo que avanzaste un nivel, {right}?

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Oh, por favor entra, |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Qué puedo hacer por ti? Si necesitas equipo de aventura, pídeme un {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, simplemente navega por mis productos. {Footballs} debe comprarse por separado.

entries.en: |PLAYERNAME|. I have been watching your fate for quite some time. It's about time you came here. Do you seek to enter the riven island of Quirefang or travel back from where you came?
entries.translated: |PLAYERNAME|. He estado observando tu destino durante bastante tiempo. Ya era hora de que vinieras aquí. ¿Buscas entrar a la isla dividida de Quirefang o viajar de regreso desde donde viniste?

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Saludos, atrevido aventurero. Si necesitas un {passage}, házmelo saber.

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.

entries.en: Welcome to my fruit and vegetable store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you'd like to see my wares.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenidos a mi tienda de frutas y verduras, |PLAYERNAME|! Pídeme un {trade} si quieres ver mis productos.

entries.en: The. Slime. Has. Entered. Our. Master. Has. Left! We. Must. Help.
entries.translated: El. Limo. Tiene. Entró. Nuestro. Maestro. Tiene. ¡Izquierda! Nosotros. Debe. Ayuda.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Oh, por favor entra, |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Qué puedo hacer por ti? Si necesitas equipo de aventura, pídeme un {trade}.

entries.en: LONG LIVE THE KING! You may leave now!

entries.translated: Que la iluminación sea tu camino, |PLAYERNAME|.
Que la iluminación sea tu camino, |PLAYERNAME|.
Que la iluminación sea tu camino, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics?
entries.translated: I miei numeri surreali si basano su fatti sorprendenti. Sei interessato a conoscere i segreti della matematica?

entries.en: I think you are not in touch with yourself, come back if you have tuned in on your own feelings.
entries.translated: Penso che tu non sia in contatto con te stesso, torna se ti sei sintonizzato sui tuoi sentimenti.

entries.en: My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. \z Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics?
entries.translated: I miei numeri surreali si basano su fatti sorprendenti. \z Sei interessato a conoscere i segreti della matematica?

entries.en: Then take it and get happy - or die, hehe.
entries.translated: Allora prendilo e sii felice - o muori, eheh.

entries.en: You already know the secrets of mathemagics! Now go and use them to learn.
entries.translated: Conosci già i segreti della matematica! Ora vai e usali per imparare.

entries.en: But first tell me your favourite colour please!
entries.translated: Ma prima dimmi il tuo colore preferito, per favore!

entries.en: Wait! Don't leave! I want to tell you about my surreal numbers.
entries.translated: Aspettare! Non andartene! Voglio raccontarvi dei miei numeri surreali.

entries.en: I was captured and tortured to death by the cultists here. They worship a being that they call Ghazbaran ...
entries.translated: Sono stato catturato e torturato a morte dai cultisti qui. Adorano un essere che chiamano Ghazbaran ...

entries.en: In his name they have claimed the mines and started to melt the ice to free an army of vile demons that have been frozen here for ages ...
entries.translated: In suo nome hanno rivendicato le miniere e iniziato a sciogliere il ghiaccio per liberare un esercito di vili demoni che sono rimasti congelati qui da secoli...

entries.en: Their plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans must learn about it! Hurry before its too late.
entries.translated: Il loro piano è creare un nuovo esercito di demoni affinché il loro padrone conquisti il ​​mondo. Hjaern e gli altri sciamani devono saperlo! Sbrigati prima che sia troppo tardi.

entries.en: With your eyes covered and avoiding direct sight of the rays, you put the mirror into the stand. ...
entries.translated: Con gli occhi coperti ed evitando la vista diretta dei raggi, metti lo specchio sul supporto. ...

entries.en: Instinctively you run to a larger emerald bluff near the raise to find cover. Mere seconds after you claimed the sturdy shelter, a deep dark humming starts to swirl through the air. ...
entries.translated: Istintivamente corri verso un bluff color smeraldo più grande vicino al rilancio per trovare copertura. Pochi secondi dopo aver rivendicato il robusto rifugio, un profondo ronzio oscuro inizia a turbinare nell'aria. ...

entries.en: Seconds pass as the hum gets louder. The noise is maddening, drowning all other sounds around you. As you cover your ears in pain, the humming explodes into a deafening growl. ...
entries.translated: I secondi passano mentre il ronzio diventa più forte. Il rumore è esasperante e soffoca tutti gli altri suoni intorno a te. Mentre ti copri le orecchie per il dolore, il ronzio esplode in un ringhio assordante. ...

entries.en: You raise your head above the edge of the emerald to catch a glimpse of what's happening. ...
entries.translated: Alzi la testa sopra il bordo dello smeraldo per intravedere cosa sta succedendo. ...

entries.en: As intensely as the orcs hate all other races, they share a feeling of community. The orcs can sense, to some extent, the feelings of other orcs. The shamans develop this ability to such an extent, that they can sense the innermost potential of newborn orc whelps. All newborn are tested and the shamans decide a future function in orcish society. The whelps are fed differently, raised differently, and educated differently. Wise men of other races say that such behavior is similar to some insects, such as bees, and through their empathetic bond might share a kind of 'hive-mind', so they refer to orc communities as hives. The chief of a hive owns a big harem of women who have no other function than to pleasure him and give birth to new orcs. These orcish matrons are usually incredibly big and fat, almost not able to walk on their own. Where 'normal' orcwomen function as laborer and craftwomen and give birth to two to three orcs in their lives, these female orcs are only reproductive machinery, giving birth to about six whelps each half year. Orcs are usually contend with their place in orcish society and only the leaders fight each other on purpose. Rarely will an orc raise a weapon against another orc, even if they are not of the same hive. Rivalry between hives is usually dissolved through a fight of their leaders and the victorious hive absorbs the other one. Now and then, when a new strong warrior reaches maturity he challenges the old leader for a fight of supremacy. Sometimes though, when the hive becomes too big for the area it occupies, such a warrior senses somehow that its time to move on. Then he and a few other orcs leave the hive in peace to settle somewhere else. This unique culture, together with its fertility, makes the orcs the most formidable threat to all other tibian communities.
entries.translated: Choć orkowie nienawidzą wszystkich innych ras, łączy ich poczucie wspólnoty. Orkowie potrafią w pewnym stopniu wyczuwać uczucia innych orków. Szamani rozwijają tę zdolność do tego stopnia, że ​​potrafią wyczuć najgłębszy potencjał nowo narodzonych orczych szczeniąt. Wszystkie noworodki są poddawane testom, a szamani decydują o ich przyszłej funkcji w społeczeństwie orków. Szczenięta są inaczej karmione, inaczej wychowywane i inaczej wychowywane. Mędrcy innych ras mówią, że takie zachowanie jest podobne do niektórych owadów, takich jak pszczoły, i poprzez ich empatyczną więź mogą dzielić coś w rodzaju 'hive-mind', dlatego nazywają społeczności orków ulami. Wódz ula posiada duży harem kobiet, których jedynym zadaniem jest sprawianie mu przyjemności i rodzenie nowych orków. Te orkowe matrony są zazwyczaj niewiarygodnie duże i grube, prawie nie są w stanie samodzielnie chodzić. Tam, gdzie 'normal' orki działają jako robotnice i rzemieślniczki i rodzą od dwóch do trzech orków w swoim życiu, te samice orków są jedynie maszyną reprodukcyjną, rodząc około sześciu młodych co pół roku. Orkowie zazwyczaj walczą o swoje miejsce w społeczeństwie orków i tylko przywódcy walczą między sobą celowo. Rzadko ork podnosi broń przeciwko innemu orkowi, nawet jeśli nie należą oni do tego samego ula. Rywalizacja między rojami zwykle zostaje rozwiązana poprzez walkę ich przywódców, a zwycięski ul wchłonie drugiego. Od czasu do czasu, gdy nowy silny wojownik osiąga dojrzałość, rzuca wyzwanie staremu przywódcy w walce o dominację. Czasami jednak, gdy ul staje się zbyt duży w stosunku do zajmowanego obszaru, taki wojownik w jakiś sposób wyczuwa, że ​​nadszedł czas, aby ruszyć dalej. Następnie on i kilka innych orków opuszczają ul w spokoju i osiedlają się gdzie indziej. Ta wyjątkowa kultura, wraz z jej płodnością, czyni orków najpotężniejszym zagrożeniem dla wszystkich innych społeczności Tibii.

entries.en: As intensely as the orcs hate all other races, they share a feeling of community. The orcs can sense, to some extent, the feelings of other orcs. The shamans develop this ability to such an extent, that they can sense the innermost potential of newborn orc whelps. All newborn are tested and the shamans decide a future function in orcish society. The whelps are fed differently, raised differently, and educated differently. Wise men of other races say that such behavior is similar to some insects, such as bees, and through their empathetic bond might share a kind of 'hive-mind', so they refer to orc communities as hives. The chief of a hive owns a big harem of women who have no other function than to pleasure him and give birth to new orcs. These orcish matrons are usually incredibly big and fat, almost not able to walk on their own. Where 'normal' orcwomen function as laborer and craftwomen and give birth to two to three orcs in their lives, these female orcs are only reproductive machinery, giving birth to about six whelps each half year. Orcs are usually contend with their place in orcish society and only the leaders fight each other on purpose. Rarely will an orc raise a weapon against another orc, even if they are not of the same hive. Rivalry between hives is usually dissolved through a fight of their leaders and the victorious hive absorbs the other one. Now and then, when a new strong warrior reaches maturity he challenges the old leader for a fight of supremacy. Sometimes though, when the hive becomes too big for the area it occupies, such a warrior senses somehow that its time to move on. Then he and a few other orcs leave the hive in peace to settle somewhere else. This unique culture, together with its fertility, makes the orcs the most formidable threat to all other tibian communities.
entries.translated: Choć orkowie nienawidzą wszystkich innych ras, łączy ich poczucie wspólnoty. Orkowie potrafią w pewnym stopniu wyczuwać uczucia innych orków. Szamani rozwijają tę zdolność do tego stopnia, że ​​potrafią wyczuć najgłębszy potencjał nowo narodzonych orczych szczeniąt. Wszystkie noworodki są poddawane testom, a szamani decydują o ich przyszłej funkcji w społeczeństwie orków. Szczenięta są inaczej karmione, inaczej wychowywane i inaczej wychowywane. Mędrcy innych ras mówią, że takie zachowanie jest podobne do niektórych owadów, takich jak pszczoły, i poprzez ich empatyczną więź mogą dzielić coś w rodzaju 'hive-mind', dlatego nazywają społeczności orków ulami. Wódz ula posiada duży harem kobiet, których jedynym zadaniem jest sprawianie mu przyjemności i rodzenie nowych orków. Te orkowe matrony są zazwyczaj niewiarygodnie duże i grube, prawie nie są w stanie samodzielnie chodzić. Tam, gdzie 'normal' orki działają jako robotnice i rzemieślniczki i rodzą od dwóch do trzech orków w swoim życiu, te samice orków są jedynie maszyną reprodukcyjną, rodząc około sześciu młodych co pół roku. Orkowie zazwyczaj walczą o swoje miejsce w społeczeństwie orków i tylko przywódcy walczą między sobą celowo. Rzadko ork podnosi broń przeciwko innemu orkowi, nawet jeśli nie należą oni do tego samego ula. Rywalizacja między rojami zwykle zostaje rozwiązana poprzez walkę ich przywódców, a zwycięski ul wchłonie drugiego. Od czasu do czasu, gdy nowy silny wojownik osiąga dojrzałość, rzuca wyzwanie staremu przywódcy w walce o dominację. Czasami jednak, gdy ul staje się zbyt duży w stosunku do zajmowanego obszaru, taki wojownik w jakiś sposób wyczuwa, że ​​nadszedł czas, aby ruszyć dalej. Następnie on i kilka innych orków opuszczają ul w spokoju i osiedlają się gdzie indziej. Ta wyjątkowa kultura, wraz z jej płodnością, czyni orków najpotężniejszym zagrożeniem dla wszystkich innych społeczności Tibii.

entries.en: As long as the pits were defended by the Nightmare Knights, who must have known previously when an eruption would occur, the demons could be fought back while they were still materialising and thus, most vulnerable. Now that the pits are lost and overrun by demonic hordes, an attack becomes more and more likely.
entries.translated: Tak długo, jak doły były bronione przez Rycerzy Koszmaru, którzy musieli wiedzieć wcześniej, kiedy nastąpi erupcja, demony można było odeprzeć, gdy jeszcze się materializowały, a zatem były najbardziej bezbronne. Teraz, gdy doły zostały zagubione i opanowane przez hordy demonów, atak staje się coraz bardziej prawdopodobny.

entries.en: As long as there are enough minions to boost the negative energy of a place, demons can exist for a very long time in our realm. So in theory, it would also be possible that the gate between the two realms is kept open, allowing more and more demons to enter our world that can easily form a demonic army causing mayhem and havoc.
entries.translated: Dopóki jest wystarczająca liczba sług, aby zwiększyć negatywną energię danego miejsca, demony mogą istnieć w naszym królestwie przez bardzo długi czas. Zatem teoretycznie możliwe byłoby również, że brama między dwoma królestwami pozostanie otwarta, umożliwiając coraz większej liczbie demonów wkraczanie do naszego świata, które z łatwością mogą utworzyć demoniczną armię siejącą chaos i spustoszenie.

entries.en: As the king became sick and no one was able to heal him, the traitor stepped forward with a strange medicine. Trusting in his beloved servant, the king drank the medicine which actually was the blood of some servant that had been murdered recently. The medicine seemed to restore the king's strength, so the traitor had no trouble to feed him with more blood. Soon the king's appearance started to change. His aversion to sunlight and his paleness were attributed to his illness, but also the king's temper and behaviour turned more and more violent and aggressive. Nonetheless, the people loved their king and put up with his moods.
entries.translated: Gdy król zachorował i nikt nie był w stanie go uleczyć, zdrajca wystąpił z dziwnym lekarstwem. Ufając swemu ukochanemu słudze, król wypił lekarstwo, które w rzeczywistości było krwią jakiegoś niedawno zamordowanego sługi. Lekarstwo zdawało się przywracać królowi siły, więc zdrajca nie miał problemu z nakarmieniem go większą ilością krwi. Wkrótce wygląd króla zaczął się zmieniać. Jego niechęć do światła słonecznego i bladość przypisywano chorobie, ale także temperament i zachowanie króla stawały się coraz bardziej gwałtowne i agresywne. Niemniej jednak lud kochał swego króla i tolerował jego nastroje.

entries.en: As the orcs approached I've hidden myself in the bushes near the lake. I did hardly dare to breath as they met only some inches from my nose. I thought my wild beating heart might betray me to this murderous beasts.
entries.translated: Gdy orki się zbliżyły, ukryłem się w krzakach w pobliżu jeziora. Ledwo odważyłam się oddychać, ponieważ stykali się zaledwie kilka centymetrów od mojego nosa. Myślałam, że moje dziko bijące serce może mnie zdradzić tym morderczym bestiom.

entries.en: As we travelled through the dungeon tunnels we came to a big cave. In the light of our torches we saw several eyes glowing in the darkness, then the trolls attacked, silently as usual. We immediately dropped our torches and raised our shields to block the first attack, then we counterattacked. Soon the floor was wet with blood, ours and theirs. They were very skilled in blocking our blows and I am sure with inferior weapons we would have hacked on these beasts for an eternity.
entries.translated: Gdy podróżowaliśmy tunelami lochów, dotarliśmy do dużej jaskini. W świetle naszych pochodni widzieliśmy kilka oczu świecących w ciemności, po czym trolle zaatakowały, jak zwykle cicho. Natychmiast opuściliśmy pochodnie i podnieśliśmy tarcze, aby zablokować pierwszy atak, po czym przystąpiliśmy do kontrataku. Wkrótce podłoga była mokra od krwi, naszej i ich. Byli bardzo uzdolnieni w blokowaniu naszych ciosów i jestem pewien, że przy użyciu gorszej broni siekalibyśmy te bestie przez całą wieczność.

entries.en: As with other tests it could be observed that the vampires have the ability of regeneration but not of regrowth.
entries.translated: Podobnie jak w przypadku innych testów, można było zaobserwować, że wampiry mają zdolność regeneracji, ale nie ponownego wzrostu.

entries.en: At last even Baa'leal, who led the Efreet in battle, had to admit that the Marid and their despised human allies fought valiantly. However, despite the heavy losses he was determined to decide the war there and now. He summoned the most powerful Efreet wizards and ordered them to unleash a huge column of magic fire onto Ankrahmun in order to render the city and all those in it to cinders. The Efreet wizards' followed his orders and soon a wall of devastating fire rose up to the sky. However, when they tried to move it onto Ankrahmun they soon realised that it did not move into the desired direction. The Marid had soon seen through Baa'leals plan, and Fa'hradin and his fellow Marid mages used their own magic to turn the devastating flames against their creators. A fierce battle of wills ensued between the mages from both sides, and the whole battle came to a halt when the two armies watched in horrified fascination as the terrible pile of flames wandered seemingly undecided to and fro. But then, all of a sudden, the pile made a sudden leap to the north, and within seconds those who had summoned it from the sky were reduced to smouldering ashes. That was the turning point of the great battle.
entries.translated: W końcu nawet Baa'leal, który dowodził Efreetami w bitwie, musiał przyznać, że Maridowie i ich pogardzani ludzcy sojusznicy walczyli dzielnie. Jednak pomimo ciężkich strat był zdecydowany rozstrzygnąć wojnę tu i teraz. Przywołał najpotężniejszych czarodziejów Efreetów i rozkazał im wyzwolić ogromną kolumnę magicznego ognia na Ankrahmun, aby obrócić miasto i wszystkich w nim w popiół. Czarodzieje Efreetów wykonali jego rozkazy i wkrótce w niebo wzniosła się ściana niszczycielskiego ognia. Jednakże, gdy próbowali przenieść go na Ankrahmun, szybko zdali sobie sprawę, że nie poruszał się on w pożądanym kierunku. Maridowie wkrótce przejrzeli plan Baa'lealsa, a Fa'hradin i jego towarzysze magowie Maridowie użyli własnej magii, aby zwrócić niszczycielskie płomienie przeciwko swoim twórcom. Pomiędzy magami z obu stron doszło do zaciekłej bitwy woli, a cała bitwa została zatrzymana, gdy obie armie patrzyły z przerażającą fascynacją, jak straszliwy stos płomieni wędruje tam i z powrotem, pozornie niezdecydowany. Ale nagle stos skoczył na północ i w ciągu kilku sekund ci, którzy go wezwali z nieba, zostali zamienieni w tlący się popiół. To był punkt zwrotny wielkiej bitwy.

entries.en: At last, Malor prepared for a decisive strike. He sent a messenger to Gabel and challenged him to a personal duel. Gabel, who was prepared to do anything to stop the fratricidal war, accepted the challenge. The enemies agreed to meet in the fertile plains of Kha'labal. There they stood, face to face, the old king and the usurper, and so did their armies, because neither of two was gullible or foolish enough to come on his own. It was the greatest gathering of djinns in recorded history.
entries.translated: Wreszcie Malor przygotował się do zdecydowanego uderzenia. Wysłał posłańca do Gabela i wyzwał go na osobisty pojedynek. Gabel, który był gotowy zrobić wszystko, aby położyć kres bratobójczej wojnie, przyjął wyzwanie. Wrogowie zgodzili się spotkać na żyznych równinach Kha'labal. Stali tam twarzą w twarz, stary król i uzurpator, podobnie jak ich armie, ponieważ żaden z nich nie był na tyle naiwny ani głupi, aby przyjść sam. Było to największe zgromadzenie dżinów w historii.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: now you have to kill Morik the Gladiator and bring his helmet to Tamerin as proof.
entries.translated: теперь вам предстоит убить Морика Гладиатора и в качестве доказательства принести его шлем Тамерину.

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Palimuth, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Палимуту, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: Get back to Palimuth and report him your mission.

entries.en: *After reading the whole book (which takes you almost an hour) you suffer from headaches. You remember only one thing and have to laugh as the memory returns. It's the 647th. way to use an energy beam: a venerable wizard who grills meat with his deadly spell.*

entries.en: After the disastrous battle of Ankrahmun Drefia's necromancers knew the end was near. The Marid would never forgive them their treachery, and this would be a battle the necromancers could not win - after all, many of them had already perished in the battle of Ankrahmun, and their Efreet allies could provide no assistance. So the necromancers prepared for the inevitable with the defiant cynicism of those who have been familiar with death all their lives, performing evil rituals and indulging in morbid orgies.
entries.translated: După bătălia dezastruoasă a lui Ankrahmun Drefia, nigromanții au știut că sfârșitul era aproape. Marid nu le-ar ierta niciodată trădarea lor și aceasta ar fi o bătălie pe care nigromanții nu ar putea-o câștiga - la urma urmei, mulți dintre ei pieriseră deja în bătălia de la Ankrahmun, iar aliații lor Efreet nu puteau oferi nicio asistență. Așa că nigromanții s-au pregătit pentru inevitabil cu cinismul sfidător al celor care au fost familiarizați cu moartea toată viața, săvârșind ritualuri malefice și comfandu-se în orgii morbide.

entries.en: After the female reign of Carlin was established and the independent city tried to expand its influence settlers were sent there to claim the nearby area.
entries.translated: După ce domnia feminină a lui Carlin a fost stabilită și orașul independent a încercat să-și extindă influența, coloniștii au fost trimiși acolo pentru a revendica zona din apropiere.

entries.en: After thorough examination the Rathal I Pyramid was officially declared to be free of occult phenomena. The success of the ritual of purification performed by the responsible priests surpassed everybody's expectations, and the rather obstinate evil presence that was clearly the work of a person officially identified as one Ushu the witch by the authorities was dispelled. The suspect was traced to the mountains where she sucessfully hid from the agents of the witchhunting department. She is presently said to produce low-quality love potions in an unknown hideout somewhere in the western jungles.
entries.translated: După o examinare amănunțită, Piramida Rathal I a fost declarată oficial ca fiind liberă de fenomene oculte. Succesul ritualului de purificare desfășurat de preoții responsabili a depășit așteptările tuturor, iar prezența diabolică destul de obstinată, care era în mod clar opera unei persoane identificate oficial ca fiind vrăjitoarea Ushu de către autorități, a fost spulberată. Suspecta a fost urmărită până la munți, unde s-a ascuns cu succes de agenții departamentului de vânătoare de vrăjitoare. În prezent, se spune că produce poțiuni de dragoste de calitate scăzută într-o ascunzătoare necunoscută undeva în junglele vestice.

entries.en: ... After we reached the site we pitched camp. The next day we started the excavations. It was hard work. The sand was treacherous and obstinate, and for every bucket we took away two more seemed to take its place. Sometimes we hit upon something valuable by pure chance, but usually it took hours to find some lucrative spot because you could never tell if a site was promising without having performing extensive excavations first. And still the real thing eluded us. The remnants of the legendary cities of old seemed lost to the desert. But we carried on, working day and night, digging at the same spot over and over again. Progress was painfully slow, but in the end hit on something. What we found proved to be an adequate reward for our hardships.
entries.translated: ... După ce am ajuns la locul am întins tabăra. A doua zi am început săpăturile. A fost o muncă grea. Nisipul era perfid și încăpăţânat, iar pentru fiecare găleată pe care o luam încă două păreau să-i ia locul. Uneori, am dat peste ceva valoros din pură întâmplare, dar, de obicei, a fost nevoie de ore întregi pentru a găsi un loc profitabil, deoarece nu ți-ai putea da seama dacă un sit era promițător fără să fi efectuat mai întâi săpături ample. Și totuși lucrul real ne-a scăpat. Rămășițele orașelor legendare din vechime păreau pierdute în deșert. Dar am continuat, lucrând zi și noapte, săpat în același loc iar și iar. Progresul a fost dureros de lent, dar în cele din urmă a lovit ceva. Ceea ce am găsit s-a dovedit a fi o recompensă adecvată pentru greutățile noastre.

entries.en: Although most problems have to be solved by intellect, the demons they  summoned frighten me to death. Maybe we had to add something like this to ensure that no one passes the tests just by being told how it works. Still, adding a bunch of powerful monsters seems like madness to me. As if Hugo wasn't dangerous enough already!!

Poate că a trebuit să adăugăm așa ceva pentru a ne asigura că nimeni nu trece testele doar prin faptul că ni se spune cum funcționează. Totuși, adăugarea unor monștri puternici mi se pare o nebunie. De parcă Hugo nu era deja destul de periculos!!

entries.en: Ancient mummies are fiends of horrendous powers. Only the bravest warriors dare to challenge them, and most of these fools join the ranks of the mummie's undead legions all too soon. In life, each of these ancient horrors was a champion in his own right, but now that they have entered the dreadful state of undeath they have become truly formidable, for there is no way to kill them for good. No matter how hard they are hit the ancient powers bound to their mummified bodies will always make them rise again in all their horrifying glory to take revenge on the living.
entries.translated: Mumiile antice sunt niște diavolți ai unor puteri îngrozitoare. Doar cei mai curajoși războinici îndrăznesc să-i provoace, iar cei mai mulți dintre acești proști se înscriu prea curând în rândurile legiunilor de strigoi ale mumiilor. În viață, fiecare dintre aceste orori străvechi a fost un campion în sine, dar acum că au intrat în starea îngrozitoare a morții au devenit cu adevărat formidabile, pentru că nu există nicio modalitate de a le ucide definitiv. Indiferent cât de tare sunt loviti, puterile străvechi legate de corpurile lor mumificate îi vor face întotdeauna să se ridice din nou în toată gloria lor înfiorătoare pentru a se răzbuna pe cei vii.

entries.en: And as all gnomes he was a treacherous, greedy coward (and that's pretty treacherous, greedy and cowardish). One day in the middle of a deep forest the little gnome met a little girl wearing a pretty red cap. As the greedy gnome saw that she was carrying a bag full of finest bread and a flask of wine, he pretended to be starving and begged the little girl for food and water in a way anoying as only gnomes can be (and that's pretty anoying). But the girl was warned of treacherous gnomes by a valiant huntsman she met before and she quickly ran away from the greedy little gnome. The gnome became angry but was afraid to steal from her, because she might have been stronger than him. So he wandered into the woods cursing as only gnomes can curse (and that's pretty ugly). By chance he almost stumbled over a sleeping bard. Quickly figuring out the magical nature of the flute lying near the sleeping bard, he stole it as quickly as only a gnome can do (and that's pretty quick). Using the magic flute he lured a pack of wolves to the little girls grandmas house and let the beasts chase both into the wilderness and laughed wickedly as only gnomes can laugh (and that's pretty wicked). Laughing the gnome gulped the wine and swallowed the bread as fast as only gnomes can (and that's pretty fast). So he lived in the woods and molested squirrels happily ever after.
entries.translated: Și, ca toți gnomii, era un laș perfid și lacom (și asta e destul de perfid, lacom și laș). Într-o zi, în mijlocul unei păduri adânci, micul gnom a întâlnit o fetiță care purta o șapcă roșie drăguță. Când gnomul lacom a văzut că duce o pungă plină cu cea mai bună pâine și un balon de vin, el s-a prefăcut că este înfometat și a implorat fetița să-i dea mâncare și apă într-un fel enervant așa cum pot fi doar gnomii (și asta e destul de enervant). Dar fata a fost avertizată de gnomi perfid de către un vânător viteaz pe care l-a întâlnit înainte și a fugit repede de micul gnom lacom. Gnomul s-a înfuriat, dar i-a fost frică să o fure, pentru că ar fi putut fi mai puternică decât el. Așa că a rătăcit în pădure blestemând așa cum numai gnomii pot blestema (și asta e destul de urât). Din întâmplare, aproape că s-a împiedicat de un bard adormit. Înțelegând rapid natura magică a flautului care se afla lângă bardul adormit, l-a furat la fel de repede pe cât poate face doar un gnom (și asta este destul de rapid). Folosind flautul magic, a ademenit o haită de lupi la casa bunicilor fetițelor și a lăsat fiarele să-i alunge pe ambele în pustiu și a râs rău, așa cum numai gnomii pot râde (și asta e destul de rău). Râzând, gnomul a înghițit vinul și a înghițit pâinea cât de repede pot doar gnomii (și asta e destul de repede). Așa că a trăit în pădure și a molestat veverițele din fericire pentru totdeauna.

entries.en: And finally he spoke to Gabel: "Alas! Truly thy race hath suffered! But there is hope, mylord, hope even for your race that has been deserted by its reckless creator!" And he went on to teach him the ways of abjuration and of enlightenment. And Gabel listened and learned, and when he saw the wisdom in Daraman's words he decided to renounce the old ways. And soon many others of his race embraced the holy words and became proselytes of Daraman's creed.
entries.translated: Și, în cele din urmă, i-a vorbit lui Gabel: "Vai! Într-adevăr neamul tău a suferit! Dar există speranță, stăpâne, chiar și pentru neamul tău, care a fost părăsit de către creatorul ei nesăbuit!" Și a continuat să-l învețe căile abjurării și ale iluminării. Și Gabel a ascultat și a învățat, iar când a văzut înțelepciunea din cuvintele lui Daraman, a hotărât să renunțe la vechile căi. Și în curând mulți alții din rasa lui au îmbrățișat cuvintele sfinte și au devenit prozeliți ai crezului lui Daraman.

entries.en: And immediately the dead ones began to raise themselves on his calling, and they all were his creatures. Like the orcs before
entries.translated: Și îndată cei morți au început să învieze la chemarea lui și toți erau făpturile Lui. La fel ca orcii înainte

entries.en: and maically erected a hedge which they empowered with magic. The queen was not happy but did not intervene to stop them. Since then the area is known as the ghostlands (and several other nicknames suggesting the same).
entries.translated: și au ridicat maiic un gard viu pe care l-au împuternicit cu magie. Regina nu a fost fericită, dar nu a intervenit să-i oprească. De atunci, zona este cunoscută sub numele de Ghostlands (și alte câteva porecle care sugerează același lucru).

entries.en: And Omruc, the dreaded hunter and assassin. None of his victims ever saw it coming, and none of them ever escaped.
entries.translated: Și Omruc, temutul vânător și asasin. Niciuna dintre victimele lui nu a văzut-o vreodată venind și nici una dintre ele nu a scăpat vreodată.

entries.translated: Una città al servizio di un solo obiettivo: l'investigazione della magia nel nostro mondo Tibia!

entries.en: A goblet forged by the dragon Khax that represents all the knowledge and wisdom of TibiaVenezuela.
entries.translated: Un calice forgiato dal drago Khax che rappresenta tutta la conoscenza e la saggezza di TibiaVenezuela.

entries.en: A low, nearly always four-leaved plant with yellow blossoms that grows in warm climate. It used to be the main source of food for the goats of the continent. However, later it was discovered to have a previously totally unknown poisenous long-term effect on the animals, and all goats died within two months.
entries.translated: Pianta bassa, quasi sempre a quattro foglie, con fiori gialli, che cresce nei climi caldi. Un tempo era la principale fonte di cibo per le capre del continente. Tuttavia, in seguito si scoprì che aveva un effetto velenoso a lungo termine sugli animali precedentemente totalmente sconosciuto e tutte le capre morirono entro due mesi.

entries.en: A map of several known as well as completely exotic locations.
entries.translated: Una mappa di diversi luoghi conosciuti e completamente esotici.

entries.en: A number of Marid was caught and slaughtered on the spot, but much to Malor's disappointment the majority of Gabel's troops managed to escape southwards in what appeared to be a well-planned strategic withdrawal. And how much greater was his surprise to find that the Marid fled to the city of Ankrahmun where they appeared were expected! It was then that he realised that Gabel had suspected a ruse all along, and that he had prepared a counterstrategy. Malor immediately ordered his troops to abandon pursuit, but it was too late. The undead marched against Ankrahmun with all the determination of a mindless killing machine, and the Efreet, blinded by rage, did not lag behind, only to be met by ceaseless barrages of arrows and catapult stones. A cataclysmic battle ensued.
entries.translated: Un certo numero di Marid furono catturati e massacrati sul posto, ma con grande disappunto di Malor la maggior parte delle truppe di Gabel riuscì a fuggire verso sud in quella che sembrava essere una ritirata strategica ben pianificata. E quanto maggiore fu la sua sorpresa nello scoprire che i Marid fuggirono nella città di Ankrahmun dove erano attesi! Fu allora che si rese conto che Gabel aveva sempre sospettato uno stratagemma e che aveva preparato una controstrategia. Malor ordinò immediatamente alle sue truppe di abbandonare l'inseguimento, ma era troppo tardi. I non morti marciarono contro Ankrahmun con tutta la determinazione di una macchina per uccidere senza cervello, e l'Efreet, accecato dalla rabbia, non rimase indietro, solo per essere accolto da incessanti raffiche di frecce e catapulte di pietre. Ne seguì una battaglia catastrofica.

entries.en: You're an aspiring mago-mechanic. Science and magic work well together in your eyes - and even though you probably delivered countless wrong charges while working for Telas, you might just have enough knowledge to build your own golem now.
entries.translated: Ești un aspirant mago-mecanic. Știința și magia funcționează bine împreună în ochii tăi - și chiar dacă probabil ai livrat nenumărate taxe greșite în timp ce lucrați pentru Telas, s-ar putea să aveți suficiente cunoștințe pentru a vă construi propriul golem acum.

entries.en: Poems, verses, songs and rhymes you've recited many times. You have passed the cryptic door, raconteur of ancient lore. Even elves you've left impressed, so it seems you're truly blessed.
entries.translated: Poezii, versuri, cântece și rime pe care le-ați recitat de multe ori. Ai trecut de ușa criptică, povestitor al tradițiilor antice. Chiar și spiridușii pe care i-ai lăsat impresionați, așa că se pare că ești cu adevărat binecuvântat.

entries.en: You can handle any music instrument you're given - and actually manage to produce a pleasant sound with it. You're a welcome guest and entertainer in most taverns.
entries.translated: Poți să te descurci cu orice instrument muzical care ți se oferă - și chiar să reușești să produci un sunet plăcut cu el. Sunteți un invitat binevenit și un animator în majoritatea tavernelor.

entries.en: You know Banuta like the back of your hand and are good at destroying caskets and urns. The sight of giant footprints doesn't keep you from exploring unknown areas either.
entries.translated: Știi că Banuta îi place dosul mâinii și ești bun la distrugerea sicrie și urne. Nici vederea unor urme gigantice nu te împiedică să explorezi zone necunoscute.

entries.en: Your map is your friend — always in your back pocket and covered with countless marks of interesting and useful locations. One could say that you might be lost without it — but luckily there's no way to take it from you.
entries.translated: Harta ta este prietena ta — mereu în buzunarul din spate și acoperită cu nenumărate semne de locații interesante și utile. S-ar putea spune că s-ar putea să fii pierdut fără ea - dar, din fericire, nu ai cum să ți-o iei.

entries.en: Even though the Efreet welcomed you only reluctantly and viewed you as "only a human" for quite some time, you managed to impress Malor and gained his respect and trade options with the green djinns.
entries.translated: Chiar dacă Efreet te-a întâmpinat doar fără tragere de inimă și te-a privit ca „doar un om” de ceva timp, ai reușit să-l impresionezi pe Malor și i-ai câștigat respectul și opțiunile de schimb cu djinii verzi.

entries.en: Dreams - are your reality? Strange visions, ticking clocks, going to bed and waking up somewhere completely else - that was some trip, but you're almost sure you actually did enjoy it.
entries.translated: Visele - sunt realitatea ta? Viziuni ciudate, ticăitul ceasurilor, mersul la culcare și trezirea în altă parte - asta a fost o excursie, dar ești aproape sigur că ți-a plăcut de fapt.

entries.en: You've been to places most people don't even know the names of. Collecting botanic, zoologic and ectoplasmic samples is your daily business and you're always prepared to discover new horizons.
entries.translated: Ai fost în locuri în care majoritatea oamenilor nici măcar nu știu numele. Colectarea probelor botanice, zoologice și ectoplasmatice este treaba ta zilnică și ești mereu pregătit să descoperi noi orizonturi.

entries.en: Wow - what was that? You don't know how you ended up here, but somehow you did. How to get from Beregar to Kazordoon in a jiffy - that's something those dwarves would love to know, but you're not quite sure how to reproduce it.
entries.translated: Wow - ce a fost asta? Nu știi cum ai ajuns aici, dar cumva ai făcut-o. Cum să ajungi de la Beregar la Kazordoon într-o clipă - asta e ceva pe care acelor pitici le-ar plăcea să știe, dar nu ești sigur cum să-l reproduci.

entries.en: Warm, furry and cuddly - though that same bear you just hugged would probably rip you into pieces if he had been conscious, he reminded you of that old teddy bear which always slept in your bed when you were still small.
entries.translated: Călduț, blănos și drăgălaș – deși același urs pe care tocmai l-ai îmbrățișat probabil te-ar frânge în bucăți dacă ar fi fost conștient, ți-a amintit de acel ursuleț bătrân care dormea ​​întotdeauna în patul tău când erai încă mic.

entries.en: You don't hunt them, you talk to them. You know that ghosts might keep secrets that have been long lost among the living, and you're skilled at talking them into revealing them to you.
entries.translated: Nu îi vânezi, vorbești cu ei. Știi că fantomele ar putea păstra secrete care au fost pierdute de mult printre cei vii și ești priceput să le convingi să ți le dezvăluie.

entries.en: You have a soft spot for little, weak animals, and you do everything in your power to protect them - even if you probably eat dragons for breakfast.
entries.translated: Ai un punct slab pentru animalele mici și slabe și faci tot ce-ți stă în putere pentru a le proteja - chiar dacă probabil mănânci dragoni la micul dejun.

entries.en: You've hugged bears, pushed mammoths and proved your drinking skills. And even though you have a slight hangover, a partially fractured rib and some greasy hair on your tongue, you're quite proud to call yourself a honorary barbarian from now on.
entries.translated: Ai îmbrățișat urși, ai împins mamuți și ți-ai dovedit abilitățile de a bea. Și chiar dacă ai o ușoară mahmureală, o coastă parțial fracturată și niște păr gras pe limbă, ești destul de mândru să te numești barbar de onoare de acum înainte.

entries.en: You're the one who poses the questions around here, and you know how to get the answers you want to hear. Besides, you're a famous exorcist and slay a few vampires and demons here and there. You and your stake are a perfect team.
entries.translated: Tu ești cel care pune întrebările pe aici și știi cum să obții răspunsurile pe care vrei să le auzi. În plus, ești un exorcist celebru și omoară câțiva vampiri și demoni ici și colo. Tu și miza ta sunteți o echipă perfectă.

entries.en: You're not sure what it is, but you feel drawn to royalty. Your knees are always a bit grazed from crawling around in front of thrones and you love hanging out in castles. Maybe you should consider applying as a guard?
entries.translated: Nu ești sigur ce este, dar te simți atras de regalitate. Genunchii tăi sunt întotdeauna puțin zdrobiți de când te târăști în fața tronurilor și îți place să stai în castele. Poate ar trebui să te gândești să aplici ca gardian?

entries.en: You're a fast runner and are good at delivering wares which are bound to decay just in the nick of time, even if you can't use any means of transportation or if your hands get cold or smelly in the process.
entries.translated: Sunteți un alergător rapid și sunteți bun la livrarea de mărfuri care se vor deteriora la timp, chiar dacă nu puteți folosi niciun mijloc de transport sau dacă mâinile vă devin rece sau mirositoare în acest proces.

entries.en: You love playing jokes on others and tricking them into looking a little silly. Wagging tongues say that the moment of realisation in your victims' eyes is the reward you feed on, but you're probably just kidding and having fun with them... right??
entries.translated: Îți place să faci glume altora și să-i păcăliști să pară puțin prosti. Limbi care dau din nou spun că momentul realizării în ochii victimelor tale este recompensa cu care te hrănești, dar probabil doar glumiți și vă distrați cu ele... nu-i așa?

entries.translated: Witaj, nieznajomy! Wyglądasz mi podejrzanie. Nie sądzę, żebyśmy mieli o czym rozmawiać.

Ma dość złożone znaczenie i, o ile możemy stwierdzić, przekłada się na 'army of those who are many, dedicated to the ultimate time of mayhem and despair'. ... \ z

entries.en: It was an honour to serve you, |PLAYERNAME|.
It was an honour to serve you.
Gerimor is right. As an expert for minotaurs I am researching these creatures for years. I thought I already knew a lot but the monsters in this cave are {different}. It's a big {mystery}.
entries.translated: Gerimor ma rację. Jako ekspert od minotaurów badam te stworzenia od lat. Myślałem, że wiem już wiele, ale potwory w tej jaskini są {different}. To wielka {mystery}.

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido en nombre de los dioses, peregrino |PLAYERNAME|!

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my offers.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, simplemente navega por mis ofertas.

entries.en: Please come back from time to time.
entries.translated: Por favor regresa de vez en cuando.

entries.en: Please come back from time to time.
entries.translated: Por favor regresa de vez en cuando.
Que la iluminación sea tu camino, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido, joven |PLAYERNAME|! Si estás gravemente herido o envenenado, puedo {heal} gratis.

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
entries.translated: Recuerda: si estás gravemente herido o envenenado, puedo curarte gratis.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
As you come closer to it, yellowish shades of orange embrace you, softer shapes emerge and you almost forget the mayhem before. In warm comfort you see what lies in the heart of it all. ...
entries.translated: Man mano che ti avvicini, sfumature giallastre di arancione ti abbracciano, emergono forme più morbide e quasi dimentichi il caos precedente. Nel caldo comfort vedi cosa si nasconde nel cuore di tutto. ...

entries.en: A majestic dragon in his sleep is surrounded by what seems the warmth and energy of a thousand suns. The tranquillity of its sight makes you smile gently. ...
entries.translated: Un maestoso drago nel sonno è circondato da quello che sembra il calore e l'energia di mille soli. La tranquillità della sua vista ti fa sorridere dolcemente. ...

entries.en: You feel a perfect mixture of joy, compassion and sudden peacefulness. Bright xanthous impressions of topaz, orange and white welcome you at the final halt of your journey. ...
entries.translated: Provi una miscela perfetta di gioia, compassione e pace improvvisa. Impressioni luminose e xante di topazio, arancio e bianco ti danno il benvenuto alla tappa finale del tuo viaggio. ...
I sogni dei draghi sono d'oro. ...

entries.en: You find yourself inside the dragon's dream. You can {look} around or {go} into a specific direction. You can also {take} or {use} an object. Enter {help} to display this information at any time.
entries.translated: Ti ritrovi nel sogno del drago. Puoi {look} girare o {go} in una direzione specifica. Puoi anche {take} o {use} un oggetto. Inserisci {help} per visualizzare queste informazioni in qualsiasi momento.

entries.en: You are now prepared to enter the realm of the evildoer. I am grateful for your help, wayfarer. Should you seek my council, use this charm I cede to you. For my spirit will guide you wherever you are. May you enjoy a sheltered future, you shall prevail.
entries.translated: Ora sei pronto per entrare nel regno del malfattore. Sono grato per il tuo aiuto, viandante. Se vuoi chiedere il mio consiglio, usa questo incantesimo che ti cedo. Perché il mio spirito ti guiderà ovunque tu sia. Che tu possa godere di un futuro protetto, prevarrai.

entries.en: I assume you need to get through the gate to reach the evildoer. I can help you if you trust me, wayfarer. I will share a part of my mind with you which should enable you to step through the gate. ...
entries.translated: Presumo che tu debba attraversare il cancello per raggiungere il malfattore. Posso aiutarti se ti fidi di me, viandante. Condividerò con te una parte della mia mente che dovrebbe consentirti di varcare il cancello. ...

entries.en: This procedure may be exhausting. Are you prepared to receive my key?
entries.translated: Questa procedura potrebbe essere estenuante. Sei pronto a ricevere la mia chiave?

entries.en: You find yourself inside the dragon's dream. You can {look} around or {go} into a specific direction. You can also {take} or {use} an object. Enter {help} to display this information at any time.
entries.translated: Ti ritrovi nel sogno del drago. Puoi {look} girare o {go} in una direzione specifica. Puoi anche {take} o {use} un oggetto. Inserisci {help} per visualizzare queste informazioni in qualsiasi momento.

entries.en: You return through the semi-translucent gate to the west.
entries.translated: Ritornerai attraverso il cancello semitrasparente a ovest.

entries.en: You head back north to the plateau.
You travel east across several large emerald bluffs and edges. All sorts of gems are scattered alongside your path.
entries.translated: Viaggia verso est attraverso diverse grandi scogliere e bordi color smeraldo. Tutti i tipi di gemme sono sparse lungo il tuo cammino.

entries.en: You take a rather large ruby out of a pile before you.
entries.translated: Prendi un rubino piuttosto grande da una pila davanti a te.

entries.en: You head north passing countless stones in the crimson sea of stones beneath your feet.
entries.translated: Ti dirigi a nord superando innumerevoli pietre nel mare cremisi di pietre sotto i tuoi piedi.

entries.en: Avoiding the bright light, you carefully put the attachment on top of the strange socket. ...
entries.translated: Evitando la luce intensa, metti con attenzione l'accessorio sopra la strana presa. ...

entries.en: Your path to the north is open. You pass the gigantic gate wings to your left and right as you advance. After about an hour of travel you hear a slight rustling in the distance. You head further into that direction. ...
entries.translated: La tua strada verso nord è aperta. Superi le gigantesche ali del cancello alla tua sinistra e alla tua destra mentre avanzi. Dopo circa un'ora di viaggio si sente un leggero fruscio in lontananza. Ti dirigi ulteriormente in quella direzione. ...

entries.en: You travel all the way back down the dune and through the gate to the south.
entries.translated: Percorri tutta la strada lungo la duna e attraverso il cancello a sud.

entries.en: You return to the crimson sea of rubies in the south.
entries.translated: Ritorni nel mare cremisi dei rubini a sud.

entries.translated: Este o rună împodobită a morții subite

entries.en: This place is for our eyes only!
entries.translated: Это место только для наших глаз!

entries.en: We will live and let you die!
entries.translated: Мы будем жить и позволим тебе умереть!
У нас есть лицензия на убийство!

entries.en: You shall burn in the thornfires!!
entries.translated: Ты будешь гореть в терновом огне!!

entries.en: DOWN with the followers of the bog!!
Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: Farväl, |PLAYERNAME|, jag finns här om du behöver mig igen.

entries.en: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}
entries.translated: Det är bra att se dig. Jag är alltid vid din {shop options}

entries.en: YOU STUPID! STUBBORN! I KILL YOU! WILL LEAVE NOW?!
entries.translated: ТИ ГЛУПА! ТУРАД! УБИЋУ ТЕ! ДА ЛИ ЋЕ ОТИЋИ САД?!

entries.en: Ah! All stuff there. I will start making axes now. Come later and ask me for axe.
entries.translated: Ах! Све ствари тамо. Сада ћу почети да правим секире. Дођи касније и тражи од мене секиру.

entries.en: ARRRRRRRRRR! YOU ME DRIVE MAD! HOW I MAKE YOU GO??
entries.translated: АРРРРРРРРРР! ТИ МЕ ЛУДИШ! КАКО ТЕ ДА ТЕРА ДА ИДЕТЕ??

entries.en: Please? What you mean please? Like I say please you say bye? Please?
entries.translated: Молим те? Како то мислиш молим те? Као што сам рекао, молим те, реци збогом? Молим те?

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: If you want to help bro, bring him fighting spirit. Magic fighting spirit. Ask Djinn.
entries.translated: Ако хоћеш да помогнеш брату, донеси му борбеност. Магични борбени дух. Питај Дјина.

entries.en: Bron gave me present. Ugly, but nice from him. Me want to give present too. You help me?
entries.translated: Брон ми је дао поклон. Ружно, али лепо од њега. И ја желим да дам поклон. Помажеш ми?

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: Take a look in the trade window to your left.
entries.translated: Погледајте у трговински прозор са ваше леве стране.

entries.en: Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!
entries.translated: Да ли тражите најбоље послове? Дођи у моју радњу!

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
entries.translated: Краљ је подстицао продавце да путују овамо, али само сам се ја усудио да ризикујем, а ризик је био!

congelación de la plaga del hierro

entries.en: You do not have the Chayenne's magical key.
The time waster hungrily consumes the time and vanishes.
entries.translated: Pożeracz czasu łapczywie pochłania czas i znika.

entries.en: This isn't a normal paiting anymore. By using magical paint you transformed it into a portal and can easily pass it.
entries.translated: To nie jest już zwykły obraz. Używając magicznej farby, przemieniłeś go w portal i możesz przez niego łatwo przejść.

entries.en: The gate mechanism won't move. You probably have to find a way around until you figure out how to operate the gate.
entries.translated: Mechanizm bramy się nie rusza. Prawdopodobnie musisz znaleźć obejście, dopóki nie ustalisz, jak obsługiwać bramę.

entries.en: You paralyse the bully and the amulet reveals the true face of the creature behind the possession of this misguided creature.
entries.translated: Paraliżujesz napastnika, a amulet ujawnia prawdziwą twarz stworzenia stojącego za opętaniem tej zagubionej istoty.

entries.en: The arena is already in use.
You have found some clothes in wardrobe
You have found a flask of poison.
Hm... the device reads: 0,0,zero,0,zero which may roughly translate to: NOTHING OF INTEREST HERE
entries.translated: Hm... urządzenie pokazuje: 0,0,zero,0,zero, co można z grubsza przetłumaczyć jako: NIC TU CIEKAWEGO.

entries.en: You have successfully gathered the data.
No matter how often you try, you cannot decipher anything.
entries.translated: Nieważne ile razy próbujesz, nie potrafisz niczego rozszyfrować.

entries.en: You decipher something! You get a rift runner to accompany you on your journey.
entries.translated: Udaje ci się coś rozszyfrować! Otrzymujesz rift runnera, który będzie ci towarzyszył w podróży.

entries.en: You have destroyed a monster nest.
You first must find the Carrot under one of the three hats to get the access!
entries.translated: Najpierw musisz znaleźć marchewkę pod jednym z trzech kapeluszy, aby uzyskać dostęp!

entries.en: You found the carrot! The door is open!
You insert the old lock into the door. It fits perfectly.
entries.translated: Wkładasz stary zamek do drzwi. Pasuje idealnie.

entries.en: You already get an old silver key.
You find an old silver key inside of the drower.
entries.translated: W szufladzie znajdujesz stary srebrny klucz.

entries.en: You find nothing in the Ambassador's house. If he's in fact a traitor he got rid of any evidence that could incriminate him.

entries.translated: Di recente sono stati bruciati dei documenti qui. Solo la parte di una pergamena si trova ancora davanti al camino, ma è troppo fuligginosa per poterla leggere.

entries.en: You feel shaky and dizzy, the world turns dark around you. Then your sight clears again - and you are somewhere else.
entries.translated: Ti senti tremante e stordito, il mondo diventa buio intorno a te. Poi la tua vista si schiarisce di nuovo e sei da qualche altra parte.

entries.en: You were moved to the right brain side

entries.en: You were moved to the left brain side
