entries.en: You are cutting some snake maw.
entries.translated: Stai tagliando le fauci di un serpente.

entries.en: You are cutting some veldt flowers.
entries.translated: Stai tagliando dei fiori del veldt.
Il nido del grifone è vuoto.

entries.en: You have found a gryphon mask.
entries.translated: Hai trovato una maschera di grifone.

entries.en: You have found a mirror mask.
entries.translated: Hai trovato una maschera a specchio.

entries.en: You have found a silver mask.
You are gathering some spiderweb cloud shreds. But you become entangled.
entries.translated: Stai raccogliendo alcuni brandelli di nuvole di ragnatela. Ma rimani intrappolato.

entries.en: The Ambassador tells another dignitary: Rathleton must never be surpassed! I will procure that the Empire falters!
entries.translated: L'Ambasciatore dice ad un altro dignitario: Rathleton non deve mai essere superato! Farò in modo che l'Impero vacilli!

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see the Ambassador of Rathleton wearing a cloak with a black sphinx on it.
entries.translated: Attraverso un portale dimensionale puoi vedere l'Ambasciatore di Rathleton che indossa un mantello con sopra una sfinge nera.

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see how the Ambassador of Rathleton is talking to Fafnar cultists in a quite familiar way. The proof is absolutely substantive. The Ambassador is a betrayer!
entries.translated: Attraverso un portale dimensionale puoi vedere come l'Ambasciatore di Rathleton sta parlando con i cultisti di Fafnar in un modo abbastanza familiare. La prova è assolutamente sostanziale. L'Ambasciatore è un traditore!

entries.en: You place the amethyst on the small socket. A violet flame begins to burn.
entries.translated: Metti l'ametista sulla piccola presa. Una fiamma viola comincia a bruciare.

entries.en: You place the ruby on the small socket. A red flame begins to burn.
entries.translated: Metti il ​​rubino sulla piccola presa. Una fiamma rossa inizia a bruciare.

entries.en: You place the sapphire on the small socket. A blue flame begins to burn.
entries.translated: Metti lo zaffiro sulla piccola presa. Una fiamma blu inizia a bruciare.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Quando arriverà il momento, '%s' sarà accettato in questo santuario.

entries.en: With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the golden statue: And the mighty lion defeated the greedy hyaena.
entries.translated: Con l'aiuto dell'antico rotolo traduci le iscrizioni sulla statua d'oro: E il possente leone sconfisse l'avida iena.

entries.en: As a sign of victory he tooks its blood, red as voracity and lust, and created a precious treasure.
entries.translated: In segno di vittoria ne prese il sangue, rosso come la voracità e la lussuria, e creò un tesoro prezioso.

entries.en: With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the floor: And the mighty lion defeated the lazy lizard.
entries.translated: Con l'aiuto del vecchio rotolo traduci le iscrizioni sul pavimento: E il potente leone sconfisse la pigra lucertola.

entries.en: As a sign of victory he tooks its egg, blue as sloth and conceit, and out of a foul creature created a precious treasure.
entries.translated: In segno di vittoria prese il suo uovo, azzurro come l'accidia e la presunzione, e da una creatura immonda creò un tesoro prezioso.

entries.en: The sulphur is burning your skin. You almost feel your body melting away in acid.
entries.translated: Сера обжигает кожу. Вы почти чувствуете, как ваше тело тает в кислоте.

entries.en: The acid burning is now unbearable, your skin feels like a sieve. There's almost no strength left in you - act quickly!
entries.translated: Жжение кислотой теперь невыносимо, кожа словно решето. Сил в тебе почти не осталось – действуй быстро!

entries.en: Embrace the stigma of vanity. The sulphur does not burn your skin anymore. You passed the trial.
entries.translated: Примите клеймо тщеславия. Сера больше не обжигает кожу. Вы прошли испытание.

entries.en: You are now ready to prove your worth. Take heart and cross the threshold of sulphur.
entries.translated: Теперь вы готовы доказать свою ценность. Мужайтесь и переступите порог серы.

entries.en: The acid covering you has cooled down and fell off for the most part. Your body is not heated up anymore.
entries.translated: Кислота, покрывающая вас, остыла и по большей части отпала. Ваше тело больше не нагревается.

entries.en: As you enter the tar pits, you feel the heat around you rising dramatically. Survive the heat long enough to prove worthy.
entries.translated: Когда вы входите в смоляные ямы, вы чувствуете, как вокруг вас резко нарастает жар. Переживите жару достаточно долго, чтобы оказаться достойным.

entries.en: Your body is heating up, the air around you is flickering.
entries.translated: Ваше тело нагревается, воздух вокруг вас мерцает.

entries.en: The heat is now unbearable, the blood in your body feels like lava. There's almost no strength left in you - act quickly!
entries.translated: Жара теперь невыносима, кровь в теле кажется лавой. Сил в тебе почти не осталось – действуй быстро!

entries.en: Embrace the stigma of bad fortune. The tar does not feel so hot anymore. You passed the tar trial.
entries.translated: Примите клеймо неудачи. Смола больше не кажется такой горячей. Вы прошли смоляное испытание.

entries.en: The tar covering you has cooled down and fell off for the most part. Your body is not heated up anymore.
entries.translated: Деготь, покрывающий вас, остыл и большей частью отпал. Ваше тело больше не нагревается.

entries.en: You absorb the energetic remains of this decaying soul. Its power is very fragile and fleeting
entries.translated: Вы поглощаете энергетические остатки этой разлагающейся души. Его сила очень хрупка и мимолетна.

entries.en: You absorb the energetic remains of this whitering soul. Its power is very fragile and fleeting.
entries.translated: Вы поглощаете энергетические остатки этой белеющей души. Его сила очень хрупка и мимолетна.

entries.en: You need exactly 10 players to start this challenge.
entries.translated: Чтобы начать это испытание, вам нужно ровно 10 игроков.

entries.en: You need exactly 5 players to start this challenge.
entries.translated: Чтобы начать это испытание, вам нужно ровно 5 игроков.

entries.en: You need to wait for 10 hours to face this boss again.
entries.translated: Вам нужно подождать 10 часов, чтобы снова встретиться с этим боссом.

entries.en: You need to wait for 20 hours to face this boss again.
entries.translated: Вам нужно подождать 20 часов, чтобы снова встретиться с этим боссом.

entries.en: Couldn't find any position for you right now.
entries.translated: Не удалось найти для вас вакансию.

entries.en: You need 4 players to fight with The Ravager.
entries.translated: Чтобы сразиться с Опустошителем, вам нужно 4 игрока.

entries.en: You have hit enough targets. Report back!
entries.translated: Ați atins suficiente ținte. Raportați înapoi!

entries.en: You've hit the wrong target and have to start all over!
entries.translated: Ai lovit ținta greșită și trebuie să o iei de la capăt!

entries.en: You have gathered the correct spores.
You have gathered the wrong spores. You ruined your collection.
entries.translated: Ai adunat sporii greșiți. Ți-ai distrus colecția.

entries.en: You had no luck this time.
entries.translated: Nu ai avut noroc de data asta.

entries.en: Your skill allowed you to grab a whetstone before the stone sinks into lava.
entries.translated: Abilitatea ta ți-a permis să apuci o piatră de ascuțit înainte ca piatra să se scufunde în lavă.
Așteptați 30 de minute pentru a începe din nou.

entries.en: You have already cleared this warzone in the last 20 hours. You have to wait {0} more hours.
entries.translated: Ați eliberat deja această zonă de război în ultimele 20 de ore. Trebuie să așteptați încă {0} ore.

entries.en: You need a mission crystal or a job done with Gnomission to enter.
entries.translated: Ai nevoie de un cristal de misiune sau de o lucrare făcută cu Gnomission pentru a intra.

entries.en: You are not permitted to enter.
You finally have enough renown among the gnomes, ask Gnomission for a mission to receive your crystal.
entries.translated: În sfârșit aveți suficientă renume printre gnomi, cereți lui Gnomission o misiune pentru a vă primi cristalul.

entries.en: This is not the crystal you're looking for!
entries.translated: Acesta nu este cristalul pe care îl cauți!

entries.en: An impressive ammount of fish is stored here.
entries.translated: O cantitate impresionantă de pește este depozitată aici.

entries.en: A seemingly endless array of weapon stretches before you into the darkness.
entries.translated: O gamă aparent nesfârșită de arme se întinde înaintea ta în întuneric.

entries.en: These barracks seem to be home for quite a lot of soldiers.
entries.translated: Aceste barăci par să fie acasă pentru o mulțime de soldați.

entries.en: All the players need to be level {0} or higher.
entries.translated: Toți jucătorii trebuie să fie de nivelul {0} sau mai mare.

entries.en: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
entries.translated: Здраво? Како то мислиш 'hi' - зар не видиш да сам ја... Морам да стишам глас. Да ли вам је пало на памет да овај 'chalice' не жели да га узнемиравате?! Остави ме на миру!

entries.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
entries.translated: Шта је ово? Ентитет са оптичким изазовом који се зове |PLAYERNAME|. Како фасцинантно!

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Буди оплакиван ходочасник у телу. Продајем општу робу. Само ме замоли за {trade}.

entries.translated: Вратите се с времена на време.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Пажљиво прегледаш свитке. То су наређења од Rathleton за амбасадора. Овде нема знакова издаје.

entries.en: Thank god you are back!! Did you find....err...what we were talking about??
entries.translated: Хвала Богу да си се вратио!! Јесте ли нашли....ерр...о чему смо причали??

entries.en: Be mourned, pilgrim in flesh. Be mourned in my tavern.
entries.translated: Буди ожалошћен, ходочасник у телу. Буди оплаки у мојој кафани.

entries.en: Good bye and please stay away, okay?
entries.translated: Збогом и молим те клони се, ок?

entries.en: At last! Good things come to those who wait.
entries.translated: Најзад! Добре ствари долазе онима који чекају.

entries.en: Oh, the nerve. Go to the rats which raised you.
entries.translated: Ох, нерв. Иди код пацова који су те одгојили.

entries.en: I hope to see you soon.
entries.translated: Надам се да се видимо ускоро.

entries.en: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow
entries.translated: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow

entries.en: The entrance to their inner sanctum has been opened for you. Be prepared for a HARD battle! Better gather some friends to assist you.
entries.translated: La entrada a su santuario interior ha sido abierta para vosotros. ¡Prepárate para una batalla DURA! Será mejor que reúnas a algunos amigos para que te ayuden.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: For this mission the Yalahari requests you go to the Factory Quarter and find a pattern crystal, which will be used to supply weapons to help take control of the city. Good side: Palimuth will send you there to use the crystal to supply food for the city.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: для этой миссии Ялахари просит вас пойти в Фабричный квартал и найти кристалл образца, который будет использоваться для поставки оружия, которое поможет взять город под контроль. Хорошая сторона: Палимут отправит вас туда, чтобы вы использовали кристалл для снабжения города продовольствием.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: After thorough examination the Rathal I Pyramid was officially declared to be free of occult phenomena. The success of the ritual of purification performed by the responsible priests surpassed everybody's expectations, and the rather obstinate evil presence that was clearly the work of a person officially identified as one Ushu the witch by the authorities was dispelled. The suspect was traced to the mountains where she sucessfully hid from the agents of the witchhunting department. She is presently said to produce low-quality love potions in an unknown hideout somewhere in the western jungles.
entries.translated: После тщательного обследования пирамида Ратал I была официально объявлена ​​свободной от оккультных явлений. Успех ритуала очищения, проведенного ответственными жрецами, превзошел все ожидания, и довольно упрямое злое присутствие, которое явно было делом рук человека, официально идентифицированного властями как некая ведьма Ушу, было рассеяно. Подозреваемую выследили в горах, где она успешно скрылась от агентов отдела охоты на ведьм. В настоящее время говорят, что она производит низкокачественные любовные зелья в неизвестном укрытии где-то в западных джунглях.

entries.en: ... After we reached the site we pitched camp. The next day we started the excavations. It was hard work. The sand was treacherous and obstinate, and for every bucket we took away two more seemed to take its place. Sometimes we hit upon something valuable by pure chance, but usually it took hours to find some lucrative spot because you could never tell if a site was promising without having performing extensive excavations first. And still the real thing eluded us. The remnants of the legendary cities of old seemed lost to the desert. But we carried on, working day and night, digging at the same spot over and over again. Progress was painfully slow, but in the end hit on something. What we found proved to be an adequate reward for our hardships.
entries.translated: ... Достигнув места, мы разбили лагерь. На следующий день мы приступили к раскопкам. Это была тяжелая работа. Песок был коварным и упрямым, и на место каждого унесенного нами ведра, казалось, приходило еще два. Иногда мы находим что-то ценное по чистой случайности, но обычно поиск какого-то прибыльного места занимает несколько часов, потому что невозможно определить, перспективно ли это место, не проведя предварительно обширные раскопки. И все же реальная вещь ускользнула от нас. Остатки легендарных городов древности казались затерянными в пустыне. Но мы продолжали работать день и ночь, снова и снова копая в одном и том же месте. Прогресс был мучительно медленным, но в конце концов кое-что натолкнулось. То, что мы нашли, оказалось достойной наградой за наши невзгоды.

entries.en: Ancient mummies are fiends of horrendous powers. Only the bravest warriors dare to challenge them, and most of these fools join the ranks of the mummie's undead legions all too soon. In life, each of these ancient horrors was a champion in his own right, but now that they have entered the dreadful state of undeath they have become truly formidable, for there is no way to kill them for good. No matter how hard they are hit the ancient powers bound to their mummified bodies will always make them rise again in all their horrifying glory to take revenge on the living.
entries.translated: Древние мумии — демоны ужасающей силы. Только самые храбрые воины осмеливаются бросить им вызов, и большинство этих дураков слишком рано вступают в ряды легионов нежити мумии. При жизни каждый из этих древних ужасов был сам по себе чемпионом, но теперь, когда они вошли в ужасное состояние нежити, они стали поистине грозными, поскольку нет способа убить их навсегда. Независимо от того, насколько сильно они пострадают, древние силы, связанные с их мумифицированными телами, всегда заставят их воскреснуть во всей своей ужасающей славе, чтобы отомстить живым.

entries.en: As we travelled through the dungeon tunnels we came to a big cave. In the light of our torches we saw several eyes glowing in the darkness, then the trolls attacked, silently as usual. We immediately dropped our torches and raised our shields to block the first attack, then we counterattacked. Soon the floor was wet with blood, ours and theirs. They were very skilled in blocking our blows and I am sure with inferior weapons we would have hacked on these beasts for an eternity.
entries.translated: În timp ce am călătorit prin tunelurile temniței, am ajuns la o peșteră mare. În lumina torțelor noastre am văzut câțiva ochi strălucind în întuneric, apoi trolii au atacat, în tăcere, ca de obicei. Ne-am aruncat imediat torțele și am ridicat scuturile pentru a bloca primul atac, apoi am contraatacat. Curând podeaua a fost uda de sânge, al nostru și al lor. Erau foarte pricepuți în a ne bloca loviturile și sunt sigur că cu arme inferioare le-am fi spart aceste fiare pentru o eternitate.

entries.en: At last even Baa'leal, who led the Efreet in battle, had to admit that the Marid and their despised human allies fought valiantly. However, despite the heavy losses he was determined to decide the war there and now. He summoned the most powerful Efreet wizards and ordered them to unleash a huge column of magic fire onto Ankrahmun in order to render the city and all those in it to cinders. The Efreet wizards' followed his orders and soon a wall of devastating fire rose up to the sky. However, when they tried to move it onto Ankrahmun they soon realised that it did not move into the desired direction. The Marid had soon seen through Baa'leals plan, and Fa'hradin and his fellow Marid mages used their own magic to turn the devastating flames against their creators. A fierce battle of wills ensued between the mages from both sides, and the whole battle came to a halt when the two armies watched in horrified fascination as the terrible pile of flames wandered seemingly undecided to and fro. But then, all of a sudden, the pile made a sudden leap to the north, and within seconds those who had summoned it from the sky were reduced to smouldering ashes. That was the turning point of the great battle.
entries.translated: În cele din urmă, chiar și Baa'leal, care a condus Efreet în luptă, a trebuit să admită că Marid și aliații lor umani disprețuiți au luptat cu vitejie. Cu toate acestea, în ciuda pierderilor grele, el era hotărât să decidă războiul acolo și acum. I-a chemat pe cei mai puternici vrăjitori Efreet și le-a ordonat să dezlănțuie o coloană uriașă de foc magic pe Ankrahmun pentru a transforma orașul și toți cei din el în cenuşă. Vrăjitorii Efreet i-au urmat ordinele și în curând un zid de foc devastator s-a ridicat spre cer. Cu toate acestea, când au încercat să-l mute pe Ankrahmun, au realizat curând că nu s-a deplasat în direcția dorită. Marid reușise în curând planul Baa'leals, iar Fa'hradin și colegii săi magi Marid și-au folosit propria magie pentru a întoarce flăcările devastatoare împotriva creatorilor lor. A urmat o bătălie acerbă a voințelor între magii din ambele părți și întreaga bătălie s-a oprit când cele două armate au privit fascinate îngrozite cum groaznica grămadă de flăcări rătăcea aparent nehotărâte încoace și încolo. Dar apoi, dintr-o dată, grămada a făcut un salt brusc spre nord, iar în câteva secunde cei care o chemaseră din cer s-au redus la cenușă mocnitoare. Acesta a fost punctul de cotitură al marii bătălii.

entries.en: At last, Malor prepared for a decisive strike. He sent a messenger to Gabel and challenged him to a personal duel. Gabel, who was prepared to do anything to stop the fratricidal war, accepted the challenge. The enemies agreed to meet in the fertile plains of Kha'labal. There they stood, face to face, the old king and the usurper, and so did their armies, because neither of two was gullible or foolish enough to come on his own. It was the greatest gathering of djinns in recorded history.
entries.translated: În cele din urmă, Malor s-a pregătit pentru o lovitură decisivă. I-a trimis un mesager lui Gabel și l-a provocat la un duel personal. Gabel, care era pregătit să facă orice pentru a opri războiul fratricid, a acceptat provocarea. Dușmanii au fost de acord să se întâlnească în câmpiile fertile din Kha'labal. Acolo stăteau, față în față, bătrânul rege și uzurpatorul, la fel și armatele lor, pentru că niciunul dintre doi nu era suficient de credul sau de prost să vină singur. A fost cea mai mare adunare de djinni din istoria înregistrată.

entries.en: At one far-away point in history, the Yalahari seemingly vanished. Certain clues that our ancestors gathered, hint that they locked themselves in the city's centre and cut off all contact to their helpers. When the Augur sometime later dared to enter the inner city, the Yalahari were all gone - vanished without a trace. After getting over the initial shock, the Augur assumed the role of the Yalahari themselves. For a while they tried to get familiar with some of the secrets of their lost masters, but they were only able to understand the most basic concepts of the Yalahari's knowledge. They stuck to their usual tasks to keep the city running. Still, they were too few to keep the enormous city, of which they understood so little, in shape.
entries.translated: Într-un moment îndepărtat al istoriei, Yalahari a dispărut aparent. Anumite indicii pe care le-au adunat strămoșii noștri sugerează că s-au închis în centrul orașului și au întrerupt orice contact cu ajutoarele lor. Când augurul a îndrăznit ceva mai târziu să intre în interiorul orașului, Yalahari au dispărut cu toții - au dispărut fără urmă. După ce au trecut peste șocul inițial, augurul și-a asumat rolul Yalaharilor înșiși. Pentru o vreme, au încercat să se familiarizeze cu unele dintre secretele stăpânilor lor pierduți, dar au reușit să înțeleagă doar conceptele de bază ale cunoștințelor Yalahari. Ei și-au respectat sarcinile obișnuite pentru a menține orașul în funcțiune. Totuși, erau prea puțini pentru a menține în formă imensul oraș, despre care înțelegeau atât de puțin.

entries.en: At the great bay, east of Thais lies a rotten town of criminals. Little is known about it and only the most ruthles people even think about travelling there.
entries.translated: La marele golf, la est de Thais se află un oraș putred de criminali. Se știu puține despre asta și doar cei mai nemiloși oameni se gândesc chiar să călătorească acolo.

entries.translated: ATENȚIE: Această zonă este considerată diabolică și considerată restricționată prin decret direct al inchiziției. Nu putem cruța niciun om care să păzească acest pasaj pentru a-i împiedica pe străinii să se aventureze mai adânc în insulă, dar, știți asta: lângă niciunul de-al nostru

entries.translated: a trezit vechile rase și vechile frici înapoi la viață. Se spune că orașul Tibia a fost primul care a răsărit, steril de aproape toți

entries.translated: Banor a ales-o însă ca soție pe cea mai nobilă dintre muritorii, Kirana, și ea i-a născut pe Elane, care poseda tot atâtea

entries.en: Bastesh allowed him to enter her realm in his early years
entries.translated: Bastesh i-a permis să intre în tărâmul ei în primii săi ani

entries.en: Basteth wanted to come to aid her cousin, but her creatures, large and dreadful as they were simply could not walk ashore.
entries.translated: Basteth voia să vină să vină în ajutorul verișoarei ei, dar creaturile ei, mari și înspăimântătoare, pur și simplu nu puteau să meargă pe țărm.

entries.en: Be aware that our kind mastered the art of tunnelling. It may take you a whole life to understand the techniques that are used and it takes generations to know all the tunnels of a mine and all their exits. You even may find an exit that you never expected to.
entries.translated: Fiți conștienți de faptul că oamenii noștri stăpâneau arta tunelului. Poate că îți va lua o viață întreagă pentru a înțelege tehnicile care sunt folosite și este nevoie de generații pentru a cunoaște toate tunelurile unei mine și toate ieșirile lor. S-ar putea chiar să găsești o ieșire la care nu te-ai așteptat niciodată.

entries.en: Be polite and respectful to other people you meet. Most dangers are far easier to overcome for
entries.translated: Fii politicos și respectuos cu ceilalți oameni pe care îi întâlnești. Cele mai multe pericole sunt mult mai ușor de depășit

entries.en: Before picking away the rubble you need to place a buttress otherwise the tunnel will collapse over and over again. If you don't have a matching tree at hand you could still build a brickwall to stabilize the tunnel. Good luck!
entries.translated: Înainte de a ridica molozul trebuie să plasați un contrafort, altfel tunelul se va prăbuși din nou și din nou. Dacă nu aveți la îndemână un copac potrivit, puteți construi un zid de cărămidă pentru a stabiliza tunelul. Noroc!

entries.en: beginning over the world! Only gradually the recovering sections of the old world started to rise from the nebulas of time,
entries.translated: început peste lume! Numai treptat, secțiunile de recuperare ale lumii vechi au început să se ridice din nebuloasele timpului,

entries.en: After thorough examination the Rathal I Pyramid was officially declared to be free of occult phenomena. The success of the ritual of purification performed by the responsible priests surpassed everybody's expectations, and the rather obstinate evil presence that was clearly the work of a person officially identified as one Ushu the witch by the authorities was dispelled. The suspect was traced to the mountains where she sucessfully hid from the agents of the witchhunting department. She is presently said to produce low-quality love potions in an unknown hideout somewhere in the western jungles.
entries.translated: Dopo un esame approfondito la Piramide Rathal I è stata ufficialmente dichiarata priva di fenomeni occulti. Il successo del rituale di purificazione eseguito dai sacerdoti responsabili ha superato le aspettative di tutti, e la presenza malvagia piuttosto ostinata che era chiaramente opera di una persona ufficialmente identificata come una certa strega Ushu dalle autorità è stata fugata. La sospettata è stata rintracciata sulle montagne dove si è nascosta con successo dagli agenti del dipartimento di caccia alle streghe. Si dice che attualmente produca pozioni d'amore di bassa qualità in un nascondiglio sconosciuto da qualche parte nelle giungle occidentali.

entries.en: ... After we reached the site we pitched camp. The next day we started the excavations. It was hard work. The sand was treacherous and obstinate, and for every bucket we took away two more seemed to take its place. Sometimes we hit upon something valuable by pure chance, but usually it took hours to find some lucrative spot because you could never tell if a site was promising without having performing extensive excavations first. And still the real thing eluded us. The remnants of the legendary cities of old seemed lost to the desert. But we carried on, working day and night, digging at the same spot over and over again. Progress was painfully slow, but in the end hit on something. What we found proved to be an adequate reward for our hardships.
entries.translated: ... Dopo aver raggiunto il sito ci siamo accampati. Il giorno successivo abbiamo iniziato gli scavi. È stato un duro lavoro. La sabbia era insidiosa e ostinata, e per ogni secchio che portavamo via altri due sembravano prenderne il posto. A volte ci imbattiamo in qualcosa di prezioso per puro caso, ma di solito ci volevano ore per trovare un posto redditizio perché non si poteva mai sapere se un sito fosse promettente senza prima aver eseguito scavi estesi. E ancora la cosa vera ci sfuggeva. I resti delle leggendarie città del passato sembravano perduti nel deserto. Ma noi continuammo, lavorando giorno e notte, scavando più e più volte nello stesso punto. I progressi sono stati dolorosamente lenti, ma alla fine si è arrivati ​​a qualcosa. Ciò che abbiamo trovato si è rivelato una ricompensa adeguata per le nostre difficoltà.

entries.en: afterwards life returned to the world.
entries.translated: poi la vita ritornò nel mondo.

entries.translated: scopo dell'esistenza! E così la colonna di cristallo del tempo crebbe verso l'alto e da allora ne fu il centro inamovibile

entries.translated: Il negozio di Al Dee: vieni dove sono le corde!

entries.translated: Il negozio di Al Dee: vieni dove sono le corde!

entries.en: All others made the same experience.
entries.translated: Tutti gli altri hanno fatto la stessa esperienza.

entries.en: All seem to work well. But after some years new problems appeared.
entries.translated: Sembra che tutto funzioni bene. Ma dopo alcuni anni apparvero nuovi problemi.

entries.translated: tutta la forza che riuscì a raccogliere nel cuore di Tibiasula, la cui esistenza non voleva più sopportare. E come il

entries.translated: Tutta la loro magia, che probabilmente veniva data in eccesso agli antichi popoli, non riuscì a renderli vittoriosi, ed essi ed i loro

entries.translated: Tutto ciò però non poté volgere la sorte della guerra contro le orde oscure. Ovunque Banor apparisse personalmente per guidare il

entries.translated: Già i demoni martellavano le pareti della loro fragile prigione.

entries.en: Also via the portal of souls old and new heroes found their way to Tibia. Gradually larger sections of the old world emerged
entries.translated: Anche attraverso il portale delle anime, vecchi e nuovi eroi hanno trovato la strada per Tibia. Emersero gradualmente sezioni più ampie del vecchio mondo

entries.en: Although most problems have to be solved by intellect, the demons they  summoned frighten me to death. Maybe we had to add something like this to ensure that no one passes the tests just by being told how it works. Still, adding a bunch of powerful monsters seems like madness to me. As if Hugo wasn't dangerous enough already!!
entries.translated: Sebbene la maggior parte dei problemi debbano essere risolti con l'intelletto, i demoni che hanno evocato mi spaventano a morte. Forse dovevamo aggiungere qualcosa del genere per garantire che nessuno superi i test semplicemente dicendogli come funziona. Tuttavia, aggiungere un mucchio di mostri potenti mi sembra una follia. Come se Hugo non fosse già abbastanza pericoloso!!

entries.en: Ancient mummies are fiends of horrendous powers. Only the bravest warriors dare to challenge them, and most of these fools join the ranks of the mummie's undead legions all too soon. In life, each of these ancient horrors was a champion in his own right, but now that they have entered the dreadful state of undeath they have become truly formidable, for there is no way to kill them for good. No matter how hard they are hit the ancient powers bound to their mummified bodies will always make them rise again in all their horrifying glory to take revenge on the living.
entries.translated: Le antiche mummie sono demoni dai poteri orrendi. Solo i guerrieri più coraggiosi osano sfidarli, e la maggior parte di questi sciocchi si unisce troppo presto ai ranghi delle legioni di non morti delle mummie. In vita, ciascuno di questi antichi orrori era un campione a pieno titolo, ma ora che sono entrati nel terribile stato di non morte sono diventati davvero formidabili, poiché non c'è modo di ucciderli una volta per tutte. Non importa quanto duramente vengano colpiti, gli antichi poteri legati ai loro corpi mummificati li faranno sempre risorgere in tutta la loro orribile gloria per vendicarsi dei vivi.

entries.en: and all life threatened to be suffocated thereby.
entries.translated: e tutta la vita minacciava di esserne soffocata.

entries.en: And as all gnomes he was a treacherous, greedy coward (and that's pretty treacherous, greedy and cowardish). One day in the middle of a deep forest the little gnome met a little girl wearing a pretty red cap. As the greedy gnome saw that she was carrying a bag full of finest bread and a flask of wine, he pretended to be starving and begged the little girl for food and water in a way anoying as only gnomes can be (and that's pretty anoying). But the girl was warned of treacherous gnomes by a valiant huntsman she met before and she quickly ran away from the greedy little gnome. The gnome became angry but was afraid to steal from her, because she might have been stronger than him. So he wandered into the woods cursing as only gnomes can curse (and that's pretty ugly). By chance he almost stumbled over a sleeping bard. Quickly figuring out the magical nature of the flute lying near the sleeping bard, he stole it as quickly as only a gnome can do (and that's pretty quick). Using the magic flute he lured a pack of wolves to the little girls grandmas house and let the beasts chase both into the wilderness and laughed wickedly as only gnomes can laugh (and that's pretty wicked). Laughing the gnome gulped the wine and swallowed the bread as fast as only gnomes can (and that's pretty fast). So he lived in the woods and molested squirrels happily ever after.
entries.translated: E come tutti gli gnomi era un vigliacco traditore e avido (e questo è piuttosto infido, avido e codardo). Un giorno, nel mezzo di un fitto bosco, il piccolo gnomo incontrò una bambina che indossava un grazioso berretto rosso. Quando lo gnomo goloso vide che portava una borsa piena di pane pregiato e un fiasco di vino, finse di morire di fame e implorò la bambina cibo e acqua in un modo fastidioso come solo gli gnomi sanno essere (e questo è piuttosto fastidioso). Ma la ragazza fu avvertita degli gnomi traditori da un valoroso cacciatore che aveva incontrato prima e scappò rapidamente dall'avido piccolo gnomo. Lo gnomo si arrabbiò ma aveva paura di derubarla, perché avrebbe potuto essere più forte di lui. Quindi vagò nel bosco imprecando come solo gli gnomi possono imprecare (e questo è piuttosto brutto). Per caso quasi inciampò in un bardo addormentato. Avendo capito subito la natura magica del flauto che giaceva vicino al bardo addormentato, lo rubò con la rapidità che solo uno gnomo può fare (ed è piuttosto veloce). Usando il flauto magico attirò un branco di lupi nella casa della nonna della bambina e lasciò che le bestie inseguissero entrambi nel deserto e rise maliziosamente come solo gli gnomi sanno ridere (e questo è piuttosto malvagio). Ridendo lo gnomo trangugiò il vino e ingoiò il pane con la stessa rapidità con cui solo gli gnomi sanno farlo (ed è piuttosto veloce). Così visse nei boschi e molestò gli scoiattoli per sempre felici e contenti.

entries.en: And finally he spoke to Gabel: "Alas! Truly thy race hath suffered! But there is hope, mylord, hope even for your race that has been deserted by its reckless creator!" And he went on to teach him the ways of abjuration and of enlightenment. And Gabel listened and learned, and when he saw the wisdom in Daraman's words he decided to renounce the old ways. And soon many others of his race embraced the holy words and became proselytes of Daraman's creed.
entries.translated: E alla fine parlò a Gabel: "Ahimè! Davvero la tua razza ha sofferto! Ma c'è speranza, mio ​​​​signore, speranza anche per la tua razza che è stata abbandonata dal suo temerario creatore!" E continuò insegnandogli le vie dell'abiura e dell'illuminazione. E Gabel ascoltò e imparò, e quando vide la saggezza nelle parole di Daraman decise di rinunciare ai vecchi metodi. E presto molti altri della sua razza abbracciarono le sante parole e divennero proseliti del credo di Daraman.

entries.en: One thing's for sure: You definitely love swimming. Hanging out on the beach with your friends, having ice cream and playing beach ball is splashingly good fun!
entries.translated: Un lucru este sigur: cu siguranță îți place să înoți. Să stai pe plajă cu prietenii tăi, să bei înghețată și să joci mingi de plajă este o distracție uluitor!

entries.en: Music just comes to you naturally. You feel comfortable on any stage, at any time, and secretly hope that someday you will be able to defeat your foes by playing music only. Rock on!
entries.translated: Muzica vine la tine în mod natural. Te simți confortabil pe orice scenă, în orice moment și speri în secret că într-o zi vei putea să-ți învingi inamicii doar cântând muzică. Rock on!

entries.en: You certainly have your ways when it comes to acquiring money. Many of them are pink and paved with broken fragments of porcelain.
entries.translated: Cu siguranță ai modurile tale când vine vorba de a obține bani. Multe dintre ele sunt roz și pavate cu fragmente sparte de porțelan.

entries.en: The breeze in your hair, your fingers clutching the rim of your carpet - that's how you like to travel. Faster! Higher! And a looping every now and then.
entries.translated: Briza din părul tău, degetele strângând marginea covorului tău - așa îți place să călătorești. Mai repede! Superior! Și câte o buclă din când în când.

entries.en: You love getting your hands wet and dirty - and covered with clay. Your perfect sculpture of Brog, the raging Titan is your true masterpiece.
entries.translated: Îți place să îți umezi mâinile și să-ți murdăști - și să acoperiți cu lut. Sculptura ta perfectă a lui Brog, Titanul furios este adevărata ta capodopera.

entries.en: You probably don't know anymore how you really look like - usually when you look into a mirror, some kind of monster stares back at you. On the other hand - maybe that's an improvement?
entries.translated: Probabil că nu mai știi cum arăți cu adevărat - de obicei, când te uiți într-o oglindă, un fel de monstru se uită înapoi la tine. Pe de altă parte - poate că este o îmbunătățire?

entries.en: Under the sea - might not be your natural living space, but you're feeling quite comfortable on the ocean floor. Quara don't scare you anymore and sometimes you sleep with your helmet of the deep still equipped.
entries.translated: Sub mare - s-ar putea să nu fie spațiul tău natural de viață, dar te simți destul de confortabil pe fundul oceanului. Quara nu te mai sperie și uneori dormi cu casca de adânc încă echipată.

entries.en: Running barefoot across ember is not for you! You do it the elegant way. Yet, you're kind of drawn to fire and warm surroundings in general - you like it hot!
entries.translated: A alerga desculț pe jar nu este pentru tine! O faci într-un mod elegant. Cu toate acestea, ești cam atras de foc și de împrejurimile calde în general - îți place cald!

entries.en: Ah, the smell of the sea! Standing at the shore and casting a line is one of your favourite activities. For you, fishing is relaxing - and at the same time, providing easy food. Perfect!
entries.translated: Ah, mirosul de mare! A sta la mal și a arunca o linie este una dintre activitățile tale preferate. Pentru tine, pescuitul este relaxant - și, în același timp, oferă hrană ușoară. Perfect!

entries.en: If someone gives you seeds, you usually grow a beautiful plant from it within a few days. You like your house green and decorated with flowers. Probably you also talk to them.
entries.translated: Dacă cineva vă oferă semințe, de obicei creșteți o plantă frumoasă din ea în câteva zile. Îți place casa ta verde și decorată cu flori. Probabil vorbesti si cu ei.

entries.en: Your local magic trader considers you one of his best customers - you usually buy large stocks of potions so you won't wake up in the middle of the night craving for more. Yet, you always seem to run out of them too fast. Cheers!
entries.translated: Comerciantul local de magie te consideră unul dintre cei mai buni clienți ai săi - de obicei cumperi stocuri mari de poțiuni, astfel încât să nu te trezești în mijlocul nopții cu pofta de mai mult. Cu toate acestea, se pare că întotdeauna rămâi fără ele prea repede. Noroc!

entries.en: You love to hang out in cold surroundings and consider ice the best material to be shaped. What a waste to use ice cubes for drinks when you can create a beautiful mammoth statue from it!
entries.translated: Îți place să stai în medii reci și consideri gheața cel mai bun material care trebuie modelat. Ce risipă să folosești cuburi de gheață pentru băuturi când poți crea din ea o frumoasă statuie de mamut!

entries.en: Your home is your castle - and the furniture in it is just as important. Your friends ask for your advice when decorating their houses and your probably own every statue, rack and bed there is.
entries.translated: Casa ta este castelul tău - iar mobilierul din ea este la fel de important. Prietenii tăi îți cer sfatul atunci când își decorezi casele și probabil că deții fiecare statuie, suport și pat care există.

entries.en: Sometimes you feel there's a gremlin in there. So many lottery tickets, so many blanks? That's just not fair! Share your misery with the world.
entries.translated: Uneori simți că e un gremlin acolo. Atâtea bilete de loterie, atâtea spații libere? Doar că nu e corect! Împărtășește-ți nefericirea cu lumea.

entries.en: That's almost too much luck for one person. If something's really, really rare - it probably falls into your lap sooner or later. Congratulations!
entries.translated: Este aproape prea mult noroc pentru o persoană. Dacă ceva este cu adevărat, foarte rar - probabil că îți cade în poală mai devreme sau mai târziu. Felicitări!

entries.translated: сада морате да убијете Морика Гладијатора и донесете његов шлем Тамерину као доказ.

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Пријавите се Тамерину јер ће саслушати ваш захтев и сада можете да изаберете: стока за Палимут (добра страна), ратне звери за Иалахари (__ПХ0__) (лоша страна). Онда пријавите онај за који сте одлучили да је ваша мисија.

entries.en: You decided to help Palimuth, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Одлучио си да помогнеш Палимуту, пријавиш му своју мисију.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Одлучили сте да помогнете __ПХ0__, пријавите му своју мисију.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Иалахари (__ПХ0__) вам наређује да отпутујете до гробљанске четврти и пронађете Чудну резбарију. Он вам даје амајлију духова и каже вам да га напуните измученим душама тамошњих духова да бисте га користили као извор енергије. Палимут жели Цхарм Цхаргед Гхост како би ослободио те душе. Сада можете поново да користите механизам Цеметери Куартер. Идите до велике зграде у четврти Гробља и употребите чаролију духова на чудној резбарији у задњем делу собе.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Добра страна: Иди до Палимута, питај га о својој мисији и предај му шарм. Лоша страна: Питајте за своју мисију у Иалахари (__ПХ0__) и вратите је.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Врати се __ПХ0__ и пријави му своју мисију.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Лоша страна: Иалахари (__ПХ1__) ће вас послати на нову мисију да одете у Потопљену четврт и убијете вође Куара, Инки, Спласхер и Схарптоотх. Добра страна: Уместо да се борите са било којим вођама Куара, Палимут ће вас послати да пронађете узрок __ПХ0__ агресивног понашања. Пронађите Маритиму и разговарајте са њом о Кварама и она ће вам објаснити у чему је њихов проблем.

entries.en: Get back to Palimuth and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Врати се Палимуту и ​​пријави му своју мисију.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Убио си Кварабосе. Затражите од __ПХ0__ мисију.

entries.en: Bad side: For this mission the Yalahari requests you go to the Factory Quarter and find a pattern crystal, which will be used to supply weapons to help take control of the city. Good side: Palimuth will send you there to use the crystal to supply food for the city.
entries.translated: Лоша страна: За ову мисију Иалахари тражи да одете у Фабрички кварт и пронађете шаблонски кристал, који ће се користити за снабдевање оружјем за преузимање контроле над градом. Добра страна: Палимут ће вас послати тамо да користите кристал за снабдевање храном за град.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Врати се __ПХ0__ и пријави му своју мисију.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Сада морате да одлучите између навијања за Палимут или гола Јалахарија. Да бисте изабрали Палимутову добру страну, идите код њега и једноставно га замолите за мисију. Исто тако, да бисте се придружили Иалахари (__ПХ0__) (лоша страна) идите до њега и реците исто.

entries.en: You joined the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. Ask Grizzly Adams for some hunting tasks. You already gained %d points. You currently have %d boss points.
entries.translated: Придружили сте се __ПХ1__. Питајте Гризлија Адамса за неке ловачке задатке. Већ сте освојили __ПХ2__ поена. Тренутно имате __ПХ3__ босс поена.

entries.en: A low, nearly always four-leaved plant with yellow blossoms that grows in warm climate. It used to be the main source of food for the goats of the continent. However, later it was discovered to have a previously totally unknown poisenous long-term effect on the animals, and all goats died within two months.
entries.translated: En låg, nästan alltid fyrbladig växt med gula blommor som växer i varmt klimat. Det brukade vara den viktigaste källan till mat för getterna på kontinenten. Senare upptäcktes det dock att det hade en tidigare totalt okänd giftig långtidseffekt på djuren och alla getter dog inom två månader.

entries.en: A number of Marid was caught and slaughtered on the spot, but much to Malor's disappointment the majority of Gabel's troops managed to escape southwards in what appeared to be a well-planned strategic withdrawal. And how much greater was his surprise to find that the Marid fled to the city of Ankrahmun where they appeared were expected! It was then that he realised that Gabel had suspected a ruse all along, and that he had prepared a counterstrategy. Malor immediately ordered his troops to abandon pursuit, but it was too late. The undead marched against Ankrahmun with all the determination of a mindless killing machine, and the Efreet, blinded by rage, did not lag behind, only to be met by ceaseless barrages of arrows and catapult stones. A cataclysmic battle ensued.
entries.translated: Ett antal Marid fångades och slaktades på plats, men till Malors stor besvikelse lyckades majoriteten av Gabels trupper fly söderut i vad som verkade vara ett välplanerat strategiskt tillbakadragande. Och hur mycket större var hans förvåning när han upptäckte att mariden flydde till staden Ankrahmun där de dök upp var väntade! Det var då han insåg att Gabel hade misstänkt ett knep hela tiden och att han hade förberett en motstrategi. Malor beordrade omedelbart sina trupper att överge förföljelsen, men det var för sent. De odöda marscherade mot Ankrahmun med all beslutsamhet av en sinneslös mördarmaskin, och Efreet, förblindad av raseri, släpade inte efter, bara för att mötas av ständiga störtfloder av pilar och katapultstenar. En katastrofal strid följde.

Међутим, касније је откривено да има до сада потпуно непознато отровно дуготрајно дејство на животиње, па су све козе угинуле у року од два месеца.

entries.en: A number of Marid was caught and slaughtered on the spot, but much to Malor's disappointment the majority of Gabel's troops managed to escape southwards in what appeared to be a well-planned strategic withdrawal. And how much greater was his surprise to find that the Marid fled to the city of Ankrahmun where they appeared were expected! It was then that he realised that Gabel had suspected a ruse all along, and that he had prepared a counterstrategy. Malor immediately ordered his troops to abandon pursuit, but it was too late. The undead marched against Ankrahmun with all the determination of a mindless killing machine, and the Efreet, blinded by rage, did not lag behind, only to be met by ceaseless barrages of arrows and catapult stones. A cataclysmic battle ensued.
entries.translated: Један број Марида је ухваћен и заклан на лицу места, али на велико разочарање Малора, већина Габелових трупа успела је да побегне на југ у нечему што је изгледало као добро планирано стратешко повлачење. И колико је веће било његово изненађење када је открио да су Мариди побегли у град __ПХ0__ где су се очекивали! Тада је схватио да је Габел све време сумњао у превару и да је припремио контрастратегију. Малор је одмах наредио својим трупама да напусте потеру, али је било прекасно. Немртви су марширали против __ПХ1__ са свом одлучношћу безумне машине за убијање, а Ефрити, заслепљени бесом, нису заостајали, само да би их дочекали непрекидни удари стрела и катапултног камења. Уследила је катаклизмична битка.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: I was captured and tortured to death by the cultists here. They worship a being that they call Ghazbaran ...
entries.translated: Los cultistas de aquí me capturaron y torturaron hasta la muerte. Adoran a un ser al que llaman Ghazbaran...

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido, joven |PLAYERNAME|! Si estás gravemente herido o envenenado, puedo {heal} gratis.

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
entries.translated: Recuerda: si estás gravemente herido o envenenado, puedo curarte gratis.

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: Adiós. Recomiéndenos si quedó satisfecho con nuestro servicio.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: ¿Sí? ¿Qué puedo hacer por ti, |PLAYERNAME|? ¿Negocios bancarios, tal vez?

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Oh, por favor entra, |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Qué puedo hacer por ti? Si necesitas equipo de aventura, pídeme un {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, simplemente navega por mis productos. {Footballs} debe comprarse por separado.

entries.en: Mysteriously some colourful music notes fall of the panpipes. - Hurry, they will fade away quickly.
entries.translated: Misteriosamente algunas coloridas notas musicales caen de la flauta de Pan. - Date prisa, se desvanecerán rápidamente.

entries.en: Step inside the elevator to use it.
You can't use this item in a container.
entries.translated: No puedes usar este ítem en un contenedor.

entries.en: Advancing to the west, you recognise an increase of onyx on the ground.
entries.translated: Avanzando verso ovest si riconosce un aumento di onice sul terreno.

entries.en: You continue travelling the barren sea of gemstones to the north.
entries.translated: Continui a viaggiare nell'arido mare di pietre preziose verso nord.

entries.en: You leave the massive open gate behind you and go to the west.
entries.translated: Lasci il massiccio cancello aperto dietro di te e vai verso ovest.

entries.en: You carefully remove the sapphire from Bastesh's grasp.
entries.translated: Rimuovi con attenzione lo zaffiro dalla presa di Bastesh.

entries.en: You head back to the east and to the plateau.
You head back south to the site with the onyx lookout.
entries.translated: Torni a sud verso il sito con la vedetta di onice.

entries.en: You return to the plateau in the east.
You put the stand into a small recess you find near the middle of the plateau.
entries.translated: Metti il ​​supporto in una piccola rientranza che trovi vicino al centro dell'altopiano.

entries.en: As the ruby slips into the notch, the strong red of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
entries.translated: Quando il rubino scivola nella tacca, il rosso intenso della pietra si intensifica mille volte. Hai paura di ferirti gli occhi e ti volti immediatamente dall'altra parte. Il raggio sembra essere diretto al centro dell'altopiano con una precisione sorprendente.

entries.en: As the sapphire slips into the notch, the deep blue of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
entries.translated: Quando lo zaffiro scivola nella tacca, il blu intenso della pietra si intensifica mille volte. Hai paura di ferirti gli occhi e ti volti immediatamente dall'altra parte. Il raggio sembra essere diretto al centro dell'altopiano con una precisione sorprendente.

entries.en: You carefully lift the onyx attachment from its socket. It is lighter than you expected.
entries.translated: Sollevi con attenzione l'accessorio d'onice dal suo alloggiamento. È più leggero di quanto ti aspettassi.

entries.en: As the emerald slips into the notch, the vibrant green of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
entries.translated: Quando lo smeraldo scivola nella tacca, il verde vibrante della pietra si intensifica mille volte. Hai paura di ferirti gli occhi e ti volti immediatamente dall'altra parte. Il raggio sembra essere diretto al centro dell'altopiano con una precisione sorprendente.

entries.en: I call you the wayfarer. You travelled through my dreams. You ultimately freed my mind. My mind accepted you and so will I.
entries.translated: Ti chiamo il viandante. Hai viaggiato attraverso i miei sogni. Alla fine mi hai liberato la mente. La mia mente ti ha accettato e lo farò anch'io.

entries.en: You return to the plateau in the east.
You wander to the south, passing large obelisks of emerald to your left and sprawling trees of topaz to your right.
entries.translated: Vaghi verso sud, superando grandi obelischi di smeraldo alla tua sinistra e estesi alberi di topazio alla tua destra.

entries.en: As you rip the solid stand out of its socket and take it with you, the large gate opens with a deafening rumble.
entries.translated: Mentre strappi il solido supporto dalla sua sede e lo porti con te, il grande cancello si apre con un rombo assordante.

entries.en: You gasp at the size of the large open gate as you walk through to head further to the east.
entries.translated: Rimani senza fiato davanti alle dimensioni del grande cancello aperto mentre lo attraversi per dirigerti più a est.

entries.en: You reach for a small solitary arrangement of combined small houses and put it in your pocket.
entries.translated: Prendi una piccola sistemazione solitaria di piccole case combinate e te la metti in tasca.

entries.en: You take an emerald from the pile.
Sorry, but you are too inexperienced. Come back when you reach level 8.
entries.translated: Извините, но вы слишком неопытны. Возвращайтесь, когда достигнете уровня 8.

entries.en: My name is Marcus. I run this shop.
entries.translated: Меня зовут Маркус. Я управляю этим магазином.

entries.en: Have you heard? Dragons were spotted near the mountains!
entries.translated: Вы слышали? Dragons были замечены возле гор!

entries.en: Hey, what's that burnt stench... isn't that... YOU?
entries.translated: Эй, что это за запах горелого... не так ли... ТЫ?

entries.en: Nobody will ever escape from this place, muwahaha!!!
entries.translated: Никто никогда не сбежит из этого места, мувахаха!!!
Эти голоса… они никогда не умолкают!

entries.en: I am getting crazy here...Wa wa wahhh!!!
entries.translated: Я тут схожу с ума... Ва ва вааа!!!

entries.en: Good morning citizen. How may I serve you?
entries.translated: Bună dimineața cetățean. Cum te pot servi?
Ținta identificată: Șobolan! Rezilierea a început!

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Ja? Vad kan jag göra för dig, |PLAYERNAME|? Bankaffärer kanske?

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Bugs plague this isle, but my wares are bug-free, totally bug-free.
entries.translated: Бубе муче ово острво, али моја роба је без буба, потпуно без буба.

entries.en: One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
entries.translated: Једног дана ћу се вратити на континент као богат, веома богат човек!

entries.en: Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!
entries.translated: Осећате се изгубљено? Увек ме можете питати о општим саветима!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: I you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
entries.translated: Ако желите да нађете некога ко би хтео да купи ваше колаче, требало би да упознате Лили.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: You are not allowed to use this yet.
You hold the old chestplate of Galthein in front of you. It does not fit and far too old to withstand any attack.
entries.translated: Trzymasz przed sobą starą napierśnicę Galtheina. Nie pasuje i jest zbyt stara, by wytrzymać jakikolwiek atak.

entries.en: Somebody left a card. It says: Looking for the scroll? Come find me. Take the stairs next to the students. Dorm.
entries.translated: Ktoś zostawił kartkę. Widnieje na niej: Szukasz zwoju? Znajdź mnie. Weź schody obok studentów. Dorm.

entries.en: A hidden stash appears the very moment you turn the key. Unfortunately the key breaks as you attempt to remove it from the lock.
entries.translated: Ukryta skrytka pojawia się dokładnie w chwili przekręcenia klucza. Niestety klucz łamie się, gdy próbujesz wyjąć go z zamka.

entries.en: You don't have the fitting key.
<BOOOOOOOONGGGGGG> A slow throbbing, like blood pulsing, runs through the floor.
entries.translated: <BOOOOOOOONGGGGGG> Przez podłogę przechodzi powolne pulsowanie, jak bicie krwi.

entries.en: There is not enough ectoplasm left to fill it in the bucket.
entries.translated: Nie ma dość ektoplazmy, by napełnić nią wiadro.

entries.en: There is not enough ectoplasm left to fill it in the bucket.
entries.translated: Nie ma dość ektoplazmy, by napełnić nią wiadro.

entries.en: The ectoplasm all over this egg was already seeping inside the cocoon itself. You manage to fill soem of it into the bucket.
entries.translated: Ektoplazma pokrywająca to jajo już przesączała się do kokonu. Udaje ci się nabrać jej trochę do wiadra.

entries.en: You pour all of the ectoplasm over yourself. Without the bucket you cannot stabilise it, you need to hurry until it dissolves!
entries.translated: Wylewasz na siebie całą ektoplazmę. Bez wiadra nie możesz jej ustabilizować, musisz się spieszyć, zanim się rozpuści!

entries.en: The dragon tears glow and disappear. The old powers are appeased.
entries.translated: Smocze łzy świecą i znikają. Stare moce zostały ułagodzone.

entries.en: You already teleported this part of the Godbreaker to Mazarius.
entries.translated: Już teleportowałeś tę część Godbreakera do Mazariusa.

entries.en: The telescope provides a perfect view over the endless ocean - no land in sight
entries.translated: Teleskop zapewnia doskonały widok na bezkresny ocean - nie widać lądu.

entries.en: You harvested some of the herb's flower buds. Bring them Morris for a reward.
entries.translated: Zebrałeś część pąków tego ziela. Zanieś je Morrisowi po nagrodę.

entries.en: Whew! That was that hot, it melted the thermometer! At least you've found the hot spot!
entries.translated: Uff! Było tak gorąco, że termometr się stopił! Przynajmniej znalazłeś gorący punkt!

entries.en: This is not the hot spot!
You have to wait a while before travel in time!
entries.translated: Musisz chwilę poczekać, zanim znów będziesz podróżować w czasie!

entries.en: You crash the vial and spill the blood tincture. This altar is anointed.
entries.translated: Rozbijasz fiolkę i rozlewasz krwawą nalewkę. Ołtarz został namaszczony.

entries.en: You hear a loud grinding sound not very far from you. something very heavy seems to have moved.
entries.translated: Słyszysz głośny zgrzyt niedaleko siebie. Coś bardzo ciężkiego najwyraźniej się poruszyło.

entries.en: All chants have been sung in the right order, you are deemed worthy. You are transported away...
entries.translated: Tutti i canti sono stati cantati nel giusto ordine, sei ritenuto degno. Sei trasportato via...

The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.

entries.en: You tack the hair to the ebony fingerboard. The strands should be adquate to serve as strings.
entries.translated: Attacchi i capelli alla tastiera in ebano. I fili dovrebbero essere adeguati per fungere da corde.

entries.en: *There was once a maiden fair, with dark eyes and silken hair. Far away from home she died. No grave, no wake, no mourning.*
entries.translated: *C'era una volta una fanciulla bella, con gli occhi scuri e i capelli di seta. Lontano da casa morì. Nessuna tomba, nessuna veglia funebre, nessun lutto.*

entries.en: You are playing the Peacock Ballad and the portal opens.
entries.translated: Stai suonando la Ballata del Pavone e il portale si apre.

entries.en: You are playing the bone fiddle.
You attach the ebony wood to the skull. This should meet the requirements of a fingerboard.
entries.translated: Attacchi il legno di ebano al teschio. Questo dovrebbe soddisfare i requisiti di una tastiera.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. Или вы хотите смотреть только на

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: К вашим услугам, просто просмотрите мои товары.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
entries.translated: Помните: если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу вылечить вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Congratulations you received the Poltergeist Outfit.
Something clicked at same time a booming sound almost deafens you.
entries.translated: Что-то щелкнуло, и в то же время гулкий звук почти оглушил вас.

entries.en: Something clicked at same time a booming sound almost deafens you.

entries.en: The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Ușa pare să fie sigilată împotriva intrușilor nedoriți.

entries.en: Oh hello, nice to see you |PLAYERNAME|. Are you here to hear some stories of my {adventures} or do you need {help}?
entries.translated: Bună, mă bucur să te văd |PLAYERNAME|. Ești aici pentru a auzi câteva povești despre {adventures} al meu sau ai nevoie de {help}?

entries.en: Hello, I am the warden of this {monument}. The {sarcophagus} in front of you was established to prevent people from going {down} there. But I doubt that this step is sufficient.
entries.translated: Bună, sunt directorul acestui {monument}. {sarcophagus} din fața ta a fost creat pentru a împiedica oamenii să meargă acolo {down}. Dar mă îndoiesc că acest pas este suficient.

entries.en: Well, let's see if your mission was successful. Just bring me all needed {materials}.
entries.translated: Ei bine, să vedem dacă misiunea ta a avut succes. Doar adu-mi tot ce ai nevoie {materials}.

entries.en: If you dug up all three crystals of sufficient quantity and obtained the poison gland, the charging of your compass can start! For the very first time it will be charged by the violet crystal. Ready to {unleash} the power of the crystals?
entries.translated: Dacă ați dezgropat toate cele trei cristale în cantitate suficientă și ați obținut glanda otrăvitoare, încărcarea busolei dvs. poate începe! Pentru prima dată va fi încărcat de cristalul violet. Ești gata să {unleash} puterea cristalelor?

entries.en: Greetings adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
entries.translated: Salutări aventurier |PLAYERNAME|. Ce te duce la mine?

entries.en: Good bye and take care of you!
entries.translated: La revedere si ai grija de tine!

entries.en: The gods must be praised that I am finally saved. I do not have many worldly possessions, but please accept a small reward, do you?
entries.translated: Zeii trebuie lăudați că sunt în sfârșit mântuit. Nu am multe posesiuni lumești, dar vă rog să acceptați o mică recompensă, nu-i așa?

entries.en: Thanks for saving my life! Should I teleport you out of the Dark Cathedral?
entries.translated: Mulțumesc că mi-ai salvat viața! Ar trebui să te teleportez din Catedrala Întunecată?
Fie ca zeii să te binecuvânteze.
Fie ca zeii să te binecuvânteze.

entries.en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
entries.translated: Druid din Crunor? Ți-a spus că aici a apărut o peșteră nouă? Asta e corect. Sunt șeful unui {project} care încearcă să afle mai multe despre acest nou {area}.

entries.en: Just get out of my way! You killed this beautiful creature. I have nothing more to say. Damn druid of Crunor!
entries.translated: Doar dă-te din calea mea! Ai ucis această creatură frumoasă. Nu mai am nimic de spus. Al naibii de druid al lui Crunor!
