entries.en: But since there were only acolytes there the nature of the prophecy was kept a secret by the priests. They called for the stranger, who seemed to have lost his memory, to be brought to the temple, where they talked to him and asked him all kinds of questions. But much to their dismay he could not give them the answers they sought, for his memory seemed to be blank like the surface of the desert after a sandstorm. However, the priests had the wisdom of the secret prophecy to guide them, and so they knew that they had to give the strangers five tasks to fulfil before they could reveal his destiny to him. And so they did, and the stranger swore he would fulfil all the tasks or die in the attempt. His first task was to travel into the desert and to find the eldest of the scarabs there, so that the priests would reveal their wisdom to him and fill his empty mind with recollections. The stranger descended deep into the burrows of the scarabs in order to face their judgement and to find answers that had been lost in the desert sand aeons ago. But the stranger never returned.
entries.translated: Ponieważ jednak byli tam tylko akolici, charakter proroctwa był utrzymywany przez kapłanów w tajemnicy. Wezwali, aby przyprowadzić nieznajomego, który najwyraźniej stracił pamięć, do świątyni, gdzie z nim rozmawiali i zadawali mu najróżniejsze pytania. Jednak ku ich przerażeniu nie mógł udzielić im odpowiedzi, których szukali, gdyż jego pamięć wydawała się pusta jak powierzchnia pustyni po burzy piaskowej. Jednakże kapłani posiadali mądrość tajemnego proroctwa, które ich prowadziło, więc wiedzieli, że muszą dać nieznajomym pięć zadań do wykonania, zanim będą mogli wyjawić mu jego przeznaczenie. Tak też uczynili, a nieznajomy poprzysiągł, że wykona wszystkie zadania albo zginie przy próbie. Jego pierwszym zadaniem była wyprawa na pustynię i odnalezienie tam najstarszego ze skarabeuszy, aby kapłani objawili mu swoją mądrość i wypełnili jego pusty umysł wspomnieniami. Nieznajomy zszedł głęboko do nor skarabeuszy, aby stawić czoła ich osądowi i znaleźć odpowiedzi, które zaginęły w pustynnym piasku eony temu. Ale nieznajomy nigdy nie wrócił.

entries.translated: Non puoi richiedere la ricompensa del tuo compito con uno slot di ricerca compito vuoto.

entries.en: To unlock this task hunting slot you must buy it in the store first.
entries.translated: Per sbloccare questo slot di caccia alle attività devi prima acquistarlo nel negozio.

This mysterious lamp summons your very own personal hireling.
This item cannot be traded.

Эта таинственная лампа призывает вашего личного наемника.
Этот предмет нельзя продать.

entries.en: You have received Adventurer's Blessing, which applies up to level {0}!
entries.translated: Вы получили Благословение искателя приключений, которое действует до уровня {0}!

entries.translated: Все игроки должны быть уровня {0} или выше.

entries.translated: Для этого испытания вам нужны квалифицированные игроки {0}.

entries.en: Your prey bonus time has been successfully reset.
entries.translated: Timpul bonus de pradă a fost resetat cu succes.

entries.en: Your prey bonus type and time have been successfully reset.
entries.translated: Tipul și ora bonusului dvs. de pradă au fost resetate cu succes.

entries.en: You don't have enough prey cards to enable automatic reroll when your slot expires.
entries.translated: Nu aveți suficiente cărți de pradă pentru a activa rerularea automată atunci când slotul expiră.

entries.en: You don't have enough prey cards to lock the monster and bonus before the slot expires.
entries.translated: Nu aveți suficiente cărți de pradă pentru a bloca monstrul și bonusul înainte ca slotul să expire.

entries.en: There was an error while processing your action. Please try reopening the prey window.
entries.translated: A apărut o eroare la procesarea acțiunii dvs. Vă rugăm să încercați să redeschideți fereastra de pradă.

entries.en: You already have an active monster on this prey slot.
entries.translated: Ai deja un monstru activ pe acest slot de pradă.

entries.en: You don't have enough prey cards to reroll this prey slot's bonus type.
entries.translated: Nu aveți suficiente cărți de pradă pentru a rerola tipul de bonus al acestui slot de pradă.

entries.en: You don't have enough prey cards to choose a monster from the list.
entries.translated: Nu aveți suficiente cărți de pradă pentru a alege un monstru din listă.

entries.en: This creature can't be selected for prey. Please choose another one.
entries.translated: Această creatură nu poate fi selectată pentru pradă. Vă rugăm să alegeți altul.

entries.en: This creature is already selected on another slot.
entries.translated: Această creatură este deja selectată pe un alt slot.

entries.en: You don't have enough money to reroll the prey slot.
entries.translated: Nu ai suficienți bani pentru a rerola slotul pentru pradă.

entries.en: You don't have any active monster on this prey slot.
entries.translated: Nu aveți niciun monstru activ pe acest slot pentru pradă.

entries.en: To unlock this prey slot you must buy it in the store first.
entries.translated: Pentru a debloca acest slot pentru pradă, trebuie să îl cumpărați mai întâi din magazin.

entries.en: Congratulations! You are ready to leave this island and choose a vocation. Visit the Oracle above the academy in Rookgaard before you reach level 10.
entries.translated: Felicitări! Ești gata să părăsești această insulă și să alegi o vocație. Vizitați Oracolul de deasupra academiei în Rookgaard înainte de a ajunge la nivelul 10.

entries.en: Not enough capacity. You could not retrieve any items.
entries.translated: Capacitate insuficientă. Nu ați putut prelua niciun element.

entries.en: Not enough capacity. You could not retrieve all items.
entries.translated: Capacitate insuficientă. Nu ați putut prelua toate articolele.

entries.en: Not enough space. You could not retrieve any items.
entries.translated: Nu este suficient spațiu. Nu ați putut prelua niciun element.

entries.en: Not enough space. You could not retrieve all items.
entries.translated: Nu este suficient spațiu. Nu ați putut prelua toate articolele.

entries.en: Use this knife on a dead war wolf to retrieve some leather. Don't lose it and don't leave the cave
entries.translated: Użyj tego noża na martwym wilku bojowym, aby odzyskać trochę skóry. Nie zgub go i nie opuszczaj jaskini

entries.en: Dogs would probably find this treat really yummy
entries.translated: Psy prawdopodobnie uznałyby ten przysmak za naprawdę pyszny

entries.en: The water of the bog seems slippery and tries to escape even your clothes.
entries.translated: Woda torfowiska wydaje się śliska i próbuje uciec nawet z ubrania.

entries.en: It seems the water wants to go back to the bog it came from. Soon it will all be trickled away
entries.translated: Wygląda na to, że woda chce wrócić do bagna, z którego wyszła. Niedługo wszystko się rozpłynie

entries.en: Did it just twitch...? No, must have been an optical illusion
entries.translated: Czy po prostu drgnęło...? Nie, to musiało być złudzenie optyczne

entries.en: This bow seems to be alive but keeps perfectly still
entries.translated: Ten łuk wydaje się żywy, ale pozostaje idealnie nieruchomy

entries.en: It seems all its former magical power has left this broken carcass of a ring
entries.translated: Wygląda na to, że cała jego dawna magiczna moc opuściła ten zniszczony szkielet pierścienia

entries.en: This is a quest item and cannot be used for anything else
entries.translated: Jest to przedmiot questowy i nie można go używać do niczego innego

entries.en: Fine wax for various different uses
It's very toxic. Do not ever drink green liquids
entries.translated: To bardzo toksyczne. Nigdy nie pij zielonych płynów

entries.en: Vascalir gave it to you to collect wasp poison
entries.translated: Vascalir dał ci to, żebyś zebrał truciznę na osy

entries.en: It seems to be a part of an outfit. If you own the outfit you might refine it by using the item
entries.translated: Wygląda na część stroju. Jeśli posiadasz ten strój, możesz go udoskonalić, używając przedmiotu

entries.en: It seems to be a part of an outfit. If you own the outfit you might refine it by using the item
entries.translated: Wygląda na część stroju. Jeśli posiadasz ten strój, możesz go udoskonalić, używając przedmiotu

entries.en: A good item to paralyse fast and rowdy orcs
entries.translated: Dobry przedmiot do paraliżowania szybkich i hałaśliwych orków

entries.en: A good item to knock out unsuspicious orcs
entries.translated: Dobry przedmiot do ogłuszania niczego niepodejrzewających orków

entries.en: He doesn't seem to notice your presence.
entries.translated: Wygląda na to, że nie zauważa twojej obecności.

entries.en: No - you can't fool this one with an orc outfit. He needs to be distracted.
entries.translated: Nie – tego nie da się oszukać strojem orka. Trzeba odwrócić jego uwagę.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: You need 5 players to fight with this boss.
entries.translated: Necesitas 5 jugadores para pelear con este jefe.

entries.en: Someone is fighting against the boss! You need wait awhile.
entries.translated: ¡Alguien está luchando contra el jefe! Necesitas esperar un rato.

entries.en: You have entered an ancient demon prison cell!
entries.translated: ¡Has entrado en una antigua celda de prisión de demonios!

entries.en: You have fifteen minutes to kill and loot this boss, else you will lose that chance.
entries.translated: Tienes quince minutos para matar y saquear a este jefe, sino perderás esa oportunidad.

entries.en: You already fixed many broken walls today.
entries.translated: Ya has reparado muchos muros rotos hoy.

entries.en: Your lock pick open this chest!
Adding free acccess quests to your character.
entries.translated: Añadiendo quests de acceso gratuito a tu personaje.

entries.en: I already know how to enter it, you need to step in and yell 'zzubaran'. Unfortunately they never took me with them. ...
entries.translated: So già come accedervi, devi intervenire e urlare 'zzubaran'. Purtroppo non mi hanno mai portato con loro. ...

entries.en: Tell her I love her and that I will take care. I have to press on! My research is most valuable to the 'Edron-Zaoan Exploration Division'. You don't happen to have some water, do you? Ah nevermind. It's a long {story}.
entries.translated: Dille che la amo e che mi prenderò cura di me. Devo andare avanti! La mia ricerca è molto preziosa per '__PH0__-Zaoan Exploration Division'. Non hai per caso un po' d'acqua, vero? Ah non importa. È lungo {story}.

entries.en: I heard them say it once, when a seemingly drunk guard yelled it in front of a wall mounted torch, hitting his head against it afterwards. He spilt all my contents on the floor, hmpf.
entries.translated: Li ho sentiti dire una volta, quando una guardia apparentemente ubriaca lo ha urlato davanti a una torcia montata sul muro, sbattendovi poi la testa contro. Ha rovesciato tutto il mio contenuto sul pavimento, hmpf.

entries.en: Ah did I say that? Nevermind, I'm not really thirsty. It's part of this illusion. Somehow, I've been in hiding for so long, I started to... become... a vessel. ...
entries.translated: Ah, ho detto questo? Non importa, non ho molta sete. Fa parte di questa illusione. In qualche modo, sono rimasto nascosto per così tanto tempo che ho iniziato a... diventare... un tramite. ...

entries.en: I don't know, I have that constant urge to drink but in this form I would not need to, there is no mouth, no stomach, no flesh and no actual need to eat, drink or sleep. ...
entries.translated: Non lo so, ho quel bisogno costante di bere ma in questa forma non ne avrei bisogno, non c'è bocca, né stomaco, né carne e nessun bisogno effettivo di mangiare, bere o dormire. ...

entries.en: I basically communicate by making the metal of this goblet vibrate and using its form as a body of sound. Like a real voice, don't you think?? Yes, alright I know it's creepy. ...
entries.translated: Fondamentalmente comunico facendo vibrare il metallo di questo calice e utilizzando la sua forma come corpo sonoro. Come una voce vera, non credi?? Sì, va bene, lo so, è inquietante. ...

entries.en: I am still in the middle of my research and do not want to go home, so please tell my daughter to not worry about my - this will be a breakthrough! I already {learned} a lot!
entries.translated: Sono ancora nel bel mezzo delle mie ricerche e non voglio andare a casa, quindi per favore dì a mia figlia di non preoccuparsi per me: sarà una svolta! Ho già {learned} tanto!

entries.en: Oh yes, so since I wanted to study the Draken up close, I came up with an idea. Based on my research, and some slight bruises and a scar, the perfect hiding place is often right in the middle of subjects. ...
entries.translated: Oh sì, quindi visto che volevo studiare il Draken da vicino, mi è venuta un'idea. Sulla base delle mie ricerche, di alcuni lievi lividi e di una cicatrice, il nascondiglio perfetto è spesso proprio in mezzo ai soggetti. ...

entries.en: If I could enter their lair unseen and establish a forward camp, I would be able to study the draken in peace - or so I thought. Turns out the whole place was empty. I set up my camp and waited. ...
entries.translated: Se potessi entrare nella loro tana senza essere visto e allestire un accampamento avanzato, avrei potuto studiare i draghi in pace... o almeno così pensavo. Si scopre che l'intero posto era vuoto. Ho allestito il mio accampamento e ho aspettato. ...

entries.en: Finally. That's what I... oh wait, you're still talking to me - you will blow my cover! What do you want? Oh wait, did my {daughter} send you? It has been some time now, indeed.
entries.translated: Finalmente. Questo è quello che... oh aspetta, stai ancora parlando con me - mi farai saltare la copertura! Cosa vuoi? Oh aspetta, il mio {daughter} ti ha inviato? È passato un po' di tempo ormai, in effetti.

entries.en: Well, I am drinking most of the time. Er, no I mean - trying to hold my fluids... ah, wait that came out wrong: I am doing research. Let's just keep it at that.
entries.translated: Beh, bevo per la maggior parte del tempo. Ehm, no, voglio dire, sto cercando di trattenere i liquidi... ah, aspetta, è uscito male: sto facendo delle ricerche. Manteniamolo così.

entries.en: A bill? Oh boy so you are delivering another bill to poor me?
entries.translated: Una fattura? Oh ragazzo, quindi stai consegnando un'altra fattura al povero me?

entries.en: Ok, ok, I'll take it. I guess I have no other choice anyways. And now leave me alone in my misery please.
entries.translated: Ok, ok, lo prendo. Immagino di non avere altra scelta comunque. E ora lasciami solo nella mia miseria, per favore.

entries.en: What? My hat?? Theres... nothing special about it!
entries.translated: Che cosa? Il mio cappello?? Non c'è... niente di speciale!

entries.en: Stop bugging me about that hat, do you listen?
entries.translated: Smettila di infastidirmi per quel cappello, mi ascolti?

entries.en: Hey! Don't touch that hat! Leave it alone!!! Don't do this!!!!
entries.translated: EHI! Non toccare quel cappello! Lascia stare!!! Non farlo!!!!

entries.en: Noooooo! Argh, ok, ok, I guess I can't deny it anymore, I am David Brassacres, the magnificent, so what do you want?
entries.translated: Nooooo! Argh, ok, ok, credo di non poterlo più negare, sono David Brassacres, il magnifico, quindi cosa vuoi?

entries.en: Thank you, human being! I guess the thieving troll headed to the mountains east of here. As far as I know you can only reach these mountain tops by diving into a small cave. ...
entries.translated: Grazie, essere umano! Immagino che il troll ladro si sia diretto verso le montagne a est di qui. Per quanto ne so è possibile raggiungere queste cime montuose solo tuffandosi in una piccola grotta. ...

entries.en: Nobody will ever escape from this place, muwahaha!!!
entries.translated: Никто никогда не сбежит из этого места, мувахаха!!!

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Åh, snälla kom in, |PLAYERNAME|. Vad kan jag göra för dig? Om du behöver äventyrsutrustning, be mig om en {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Naturligtvis, bara bläddra igenom mina varor. {Footballs} måste köpas separat.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Naturligtvis, bara bläddra igenom mina varor.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Ja? Vad kan jag göra för dig, |PLAYERNAME|? Bankaffärer kanske?

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Ja? Vad kan jag göra för dig, |PLAYERNAME|? Bankaffärer kanske?

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Ja? Vad kan jag göra för dig, |PLAYERNAME|? Bankaffärer kanske?

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my offers.
entries.translated: Naturligtvis är det bara att bläddra igenom mina erbjudanden.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Välkommen, unga |PLAYERNAME|! Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag {heal} dig gratis.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: Tools and general equipment at Al Dee's!
entries.translated: Алати и општа опрема код Ал Дее'са!

entries.en: As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
entries.translated: Као врхунски авантуриста имате много предности. Заиста би требало да их проверите!

entries.en: If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
entries.translated: Ако ми кажете име неког грађанина, рећи ћу вам шта знам о њему или њој.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: The device reads: 'abnormal glooth structure detected, possible probing location'

entries.en: Follow the small path to the north to reach the spider lair.
entries.translated: Seguite il piccolo sentiero verso nord per raggiungere la tana del ragno.

entries.en: This is not the way to the tarantula's lair. Head up the little ramp to the southwest.
entries.translated: Questa non è la strada per la tana della tarantola. Salite la piccola rampa a sud-ovest.

entries.en: Remember that you have to aquire a web sample for Vascalir. You should not leave this cave without it.
entries.translated: Ricorda che devi acquistare un campione web per Vascalir. Non dovresti lasciare questa grotta senza.

entries.en: Walk to the west from here to reach the hole leading to the tarantula lair.
entries.translated: Da qui cammina verso ovest per raggiungere il buco che conduce alla tana della tarantola.

entries.en: There is a dead war wolf! Use the knife, and then use it on its body to get some leather - but quickly!
entries.translated: C'è un lupo di guerra morto! Usa il coltello e poi usalo sul suo corpo per prendere della pelle, ma velocemente!

entries.en: Follow the north-eastern path into the forest. Beware of wolves!
entries.translated: Seguite il sentiero nord-orientale nella foresta. Attenzione ai lupi!

entries.en: This is not the way into the wolf forest. Stay on the southern path leading to the north-east!
entries.translated: Questa non è la strada per la foresta dei lupi. Rimani sul sentiero meridionale che porta a nord-est!

entries.en: It seems plans changed. It's up to you now to find a dead war wolf and use the skinning knife on it to get some leather.
entries.translated: Sembra che i piani siano cambiati. Adesso tocca a te trovare un lupo di guerra morto e usare il coltello per scuoiare su di esso per ottenere un po' di pelle.

entries.en: Well.. that seems to be the poacher. Dead. Check his body - maybe he still has something that you can use.
entries.translated: Beh... quello sembra essere il bracconiere. Morto. Controlla il suo corpo: forse ha ancora qualcosa che puoi usare.

entries.en: This hole leads into the wolves' den. Only enter if you have full health and food - this might be dangerous.
entries.translated: Questo buco conduce nella tana dei lupi. Entra solo se hai salute e cibo completi: questo potrebbe essere pericoloso.

entries.en: This must be the chest with the book - but it's covered in flames!
entries.translated: Questo deve essere lo scrigno con il libro, ma è coperto di fiamme!

entries.en: Right-click on the grey rune on the table and then left-click on the fire! You can't take the rune, but it works.
entries.translated: Fai clic con il pulsante destro del mouse sulla runa grigia sul tavolo, quindi fai clic con il pulsante sinistro del mouse sul fuoco! Non puoi prendere la runa, ma funziona.

entries.en: Go down the stairs to reach the vault. It smells like fire down there. Make sure you are healthy!
entries.translated: Scendete le scale per raggiungere il caveau. C'è odore di fuoco laggiù. Assicurati di essere sano!

entries.en: The vault is on fire! There is almost no air in here. You don't have much time to find the book. Hurry!
entries.translated: Il caveau è in fiamme! Non c'è quasi aria qui dentro. Non hai molto tempo per trovare il libro. Fretta!

entries.en: This is not the way to the troll caves. Go back down the stairs and walk north to find them.
entries.translated: Questa non è la strada per le caverne dei troll. Scendete le scale e camminate verso nord per trovarli.

entries.en: You've reached the newly dug troll tunnel. Take what you find in this chest and use it to bring down all support beams!

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: You joined the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. Ask Grizzly Adams for some hunting tasks. You already gained %d points. You currently have %d boss points.
entries.translated: Вы присоединились к '__PH0__'. Попросите Гризли Адамса выполнить несколько охотничьих заданий. Вы уже набрали %d баллов. На данный момент у вас есть %d очков босса.

entries.translated: Вы успешно охотились на 200 каменных големов. Если вы хотите, вы можете выполнить это задание еще раз.

entries.en: As expected nothing useful could be learnt, even though the vampiric regeneration could once again be observed.

entries.en: As expected sunlight had an effect on the creatures though not as severe and effective as one might wish.
entries.translated: Как и ожидалось, солнечный свет подействовал на существ, хотя и не так сильно и эффективно, как хотелось бы.

entries.en: As intensely as the orcs hate all other races, they share a feeling of community. The orcs can sense, to some extent, the feelings of other orcs. The shamans develop this ability to such an extent, that they can sense the innermost potential of newborn orc whelps. All newborn are tested and the shamans decide a future function in orcish society. The whelps are fed differently, raised differently, and educated differently. Wise men of other races say that such behavior is similar to some insects, such as bees, and through their empathetic bond might share a kind of 'hive-mind', so they refer to orc communities as hives. The chief of a hive owns a big harem of women who have no other function than to pleasure him and give birth to new orcs. These orcish matrons are usually incredibly big and fat, almost not able to walk on their own. Where 'normal' orcwomen function as laborer and craftwomen and give birth to two to three orcs in their lives, these female orcs are only reproductive machinery, giving birth to about six whelps each half year. Orcs are usually contend with their place in orcish society and only the leaders fight each other on purpose. Rarely will an orc raise a weapon against another orc, even if they are not of the same hive. Rivalry between hives is usually dissolved through a fight of their leaders and the victorious hive absorbs the other one. Now and then, when a new strong warrior reaches maturity he challenges the old leader for a fight of supremacy. Sometimes though, when the hive becomes too big for the area it occupies, such a warrior senses somehow that its time to move on. Then he and a few other orcs leave the hive in peace to settle somewhere else. This unique culture, together with its fertility, makes the orcs the most formidable threat to all other tibian communities.
entries.translated: Как бы сильно орки ни ненавидели все остальные расы, их объединяет чувство общности. Орки могут в некоторой степени чувствовать чувства других орков. Шаманы развивают эту способность до такой степени, что могут чувствовать сокровенный потенциал новорожденных орков. Все новорожденные проходят тестирование, и шаманы решают, какую роль они будут играть в будущем в обществе орков. Детенышей кормят по-другому, воспитывают по-другому и воспитывают по-другому. Мудрецы других рас говорят, что такое поведение похоже на поведение некоторых насекомых, таких как пчелы, и благодаря их чуткой связи они могут разделять своего рода 'hive-mind', поэтому они называют сообщества орков ульями. Вождю улья принадлежит большой гарем женщин, у которых нет другой функции, кроме как доставлять ему удовольствие и рожать новых орков. Эти орочьи матроны обычно невероятно большие и толстые, почти не умеющие ходить самостоятельно. Там, где 'normal' женщины-орки действуют как чернорабочие и ремесленницы и рожают двух-трех орков за свою жизнь, эти женщины-орки представляют собой всего лишь репродуктивный механизм, рожая около шести детенышей каждые полгода. Орки обычно борются за свое место в орочьем обществе, и только лидеры намеренно воюют друг с другом. Редко орк поднимет оружие против другого орка, даже если они не из одного улья. Соперничество между ульями обычно прекращается в результате борьбы их лидеров, и победивший улей поглощает другой. Время от времени, когда новый сильный воин достигает зрелости, он бросает вызов старому лидеру в борьбе за превосходство. Однако иногда, когда улей становится слишком большим для занимаемой площади, такой воин каким-то образом чувствует, что пора двигаться дальше. Затем он и еще несколько орков спокойно покидают улей и поселяются в другом месте. Эта уникальная культура вместе с ее плодовитостью делает орков самой грозной угрозой для всех остальных тибийских сообществ.

entries.en: As long as the pits were defended by the Nightmare Knights, who must have known previously when an eruption would occur, the demons could be fought back while they were still materialising and thus, most vulnerable. Now that the pits are lost and overrun by demonic hordes, an attack becomes more and more likely.
entries.translated: Пока ямы защищали Рыцари Кошмаров, которые, должно быть, заранее знали, когда произойдет извержение, демонам можно было дать отпор, пока они еще материализовались и, следовательно, были наиболее уязвимы. Теперь, когда ямы затеряны и наводнены ордами демонов, нападение становится все более вероятным.

entries.en: As long as there are enough minions to boost the negative energy of a place, demons can exist for a very long time in our realm. So in theory, it would also be possible that the gate between the two realms is kept open, allowing more and more demons to enter our world that can easily form a demonic army causing mayhem and havoc.
entries.translated: Пока существует достаточно миньонов, чтобы усилить негативную энергию места, демоны могут существовать в нашем мире очень долго. Таким образом, теоретически также возможно, что врата между двумя мирами остаются открытыми, позволяя все большему и большему количеству демонов проникать в наш мир, которые могут легко сформировать демоническую армию, вызывающую хаос и хаос.

entries.en: As the king became sick and no one was able to heal him, the traitor stepped forward with a strange medicine. Trusting in his beloved servant, the king drank the medicine which actually was the blood of some servant that had been murdered recently. The medicine seemed to restore the king's strength, so the traitor had no trouble to feed him with more blood. Soon the king's appearance started to change. His aversion to sunlight and his paleness were attributed to his illness, but also the king's temper and behaviour turned more and more violent and aggressive. Nonetheless, the people loved their king and put up with his moods.
entries.translated: Когда король заболел и никто не смог его вылечить, предатель выступил вперед со странным лекарством. Доверившись своему любимому слуге, король выпил лекарство, которое на самом деле представляло собой кровь какого-то недавно убитого слуги. Лекарство, казалось, восстановило силы короля, поэтому предателю не составило труда накормить его еще кровью. Вскоре внешний вид короля начал меняться. Его отвращение к солнечному свету и бледность объяснялись его болезнью, но характер и поведение короля становились все более жестокими и агрессивными. Тем не менее народ любил своего короля и терпел его капризы.

entries.en: As the orcs approached I've hidden myself in the bushes near the lake. I did hardly dare to breath as they met only some inches from my nose. I thought my wild beating heart might betray me to this murderous beasts.
entries.translated: Когда орки приблизились, я спрятался в кустах возле озера. Я едва осмеливался дышать, поскольку они встретились всего в нескольких дюймах от моего носа. Я думал, что мое бешено бьющееся сердце может выдать меня этим кровожадным зверям.

entries.en: As we travelled through the dungeon tunnels we came to a big cave. In the light of our torches we saw several eyes glowing in the darkness, then the trolls attacked, silently as usual. We immediately dropped our torches and raised our shields to block the first attack, then we counterattacked. Soon the floor was wet with blood, ours and theirs. They were very skilled in blocking our blows and I am sure with inferior weapons we would have hacked on these beasts for an eternity.
entries.translated: Проходя через туннели подземелья, мы подошли к большой пещере. В свете наших факелов мы увидели несколько светящихся в темноте глаз, затем тролли атаковали, как обычно, бесшумно. Мы немедленно бросили факелы и подняли щиты, чтобы отразить первую атаку, а затем контратаковали. Вскоре пол был мокрым от крови, нашей и их. Они были очень искусны в блокировании наших ударов, и я уверен, что с плохим оружием мы бы рубили этих зверей вечность.

entries.en: As with other tests it could be observed that the vampires have the ability of regeneration but not of regrowth.
entries.translated: Как и в случае с другими тестами, можно заметить, что вампиры обладают способностью к регенерации, но не к возобновлению роста.

entries.en: Ask for the different goods you need.
entries.translated: Попросите различные товары, которые вам нужны.

entries.en: Ask Muriel to learn spells or to
at a store. Sell spare food at the farm.
entries.translated: в магазине. Продавайте запасную еду на ферме.

entries.en: At last even Baa'leal, who led the Efreet in battle, had to admit that the Marid and their despised human allies fought valiantly. However, despite the heavy losses he was determined to decide the war there and now. He summoned the most powerful Efreet wizards and ordered them to unleash a huge column of magic fire onto Ankrahmun in order to render the city and all those in it to cinders. The Efreet wizards' followed his orders and soon a wall of devastating fire rose up to the sky. However, when they tried to move it onto Ankrahmun they soon realised that it did not move into the desired direction. The Marid had soon seen through Baa'leals plan, and Fa'hradin and his fellow Marid mages used their own magic to turn the devastating flames against their creators. A fierce battle of wills ensued between the mages from both sides, and the whole battle came to a halt when the two armies watched in horrified fascination as the terrible pile of flames wandered seemingly undecided to and fro. But then, all of a sudden, the pile made a sudden leap to the north, and within seconds those who had summoned it from the sky were reduced to smouldering ashes. That was the turning point of the great battle.
entries.translated: В конце концов даже Баа'леал, возглавлявший ифритов в битве, был вынужден признать, что мариды и их презираемые союзники-люди сражались доблестно. Однако, несмотря на тяжелые потери, он был полон решимости решить исход войны здесь и сейчас. Он призвал самых могущественных волшебников ифритов и приказал им обрушить на Ankrahmun огромный столб магического огня, чтобы превратить город и всех, кто в нем, в пепел. Волшебники-эфриты последовали его приказу, и вскоре к небу поднялась стена опустошительного огня. Однако когда они попытались переместить его на Ankrahmun, они вскоре поняли, что он не движется в желаемом направлении. Мариды вскоре разгадали план Баа'леала, и Фахрадин и его коллеги-маги использовали свою собственную магию, чтобы обратить разрушительное пламя против их создателей. Между магами с обеих сторон завязалась ожесточенная битва воли, и вся битва остановилась, когда две армии с ужасом и зачарованностью наблюдали, как ужасная груда пламени блуждала, казалось, в нерешительности взад и вперед. Но затем внезапно куча прыгнула на север, и через несколько секунд те, кто вызвал ее с неба, превратились в тлеющий пепел. Это был поворотный момент великой битвы.

entries.en: At last, Malor prepared for a decisive strike. He sent a messenger to Gabel and challenged him to a personal duel. Gabel, who was prepared to do anything to stop the fratricidal war, accepted the challenge. The enemies agreed to meet in the fertile plains of Kha'labal. There they stood, face to face, the old king and the usurper, and so did their armies, because neither of two was gullible or foolish enough to come on his own. It was the greatest gathering of djinns in recorded history.
entries.translated: Наконец Мэлор приготовился к решающему удару. Он отправил к Габелю гонца и вызвал его на личную дуэль. Габель, готовый на все, чтобы остановить братоубийственную войну, принял вызов. Враги согласились встретиться на плодородных равнинах Ха'лабала. Там они стояли лицом к лицу, старый король и узурпатор, как и их армии, потому что ни один из двоих не был настолько легковерным или глупым, чтобы прийти в одиночку. Это было величайшее собрание джиннов в истории человечества.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.

El vă oferă un farmec Fantomă și vă spune să îl încărcați cu sufletele chinuite ale fantomelor de acolo pentru a fi folosit ca sursă de energie. Palimuth vrea farmecul fantomă încărcată pentru a elibera acele suflete. Puteți folosi acum mecanismul Cartierul cimitirului. Mergeți la clădirea mare din Cartierul Cimitirului și folosiți farmecul fantomă pe Sculptura ciudată din spatele camerei.

Partea bună: în loc să te lupți cu liderii Quara, Palimuth te va trimite în schimb să găsești cauza comportamentului agresiv Quaras. entries.en: But since there were only acolytes there the nature of the prophecy was kept a secret by the priests. They called for the stranger, who seemed to have lost his memory, to be brought to the temple, where they talked to him and asked him all kinds of questions. But much to their dismay he could not give them the answers they sought, for his memory seemed to be blank like the surface of the desert after a sandstorm. However, the priests had the wisdom of the secret prophecy to guide them, and so they knew that they had to give the strangers five tasks to fulfil before they could reveal his destiny to him. And so they did, and the stranger swore he would fulfil all the tasks or die in the attempt. His first task was to travel into the desert and to find the eldest of the scarabs there, so that the priests would reveal their wisdom to him and fill his empty mind with recollections. The stranger descended deep into the burrows of the scarabs in order to face their judgement and to find answers that had been lost in the desert sand aeons ago. But the stranger never returned.
entries.translated: Dar din moment ce acolo erau doar acoliți, natura profeției a fost ținută secretă de preoți. Au chemat ca străinul, care părea să-și fi pierdut memoria, să fie adus la templu, unde au stat de vorbă cu el și i-au pus tot felul de întrebări. Dar, spre disperarea lor, el nu le-a putut da răspunsurile pe care le căutau, pentru că memoria lui părea goală ca suprafața deșertului după o furtună de nisip. Cu toate acestea, preoții aveau înțelepciunea profeției secrete pentru a-i călăuzi și așa știau că trebuiau să le dea străinilor cinci sarcini de îndeplinit înainte de a-i putea dezvălui destinul lui. Și așa au făcut, iar străinul a jurat că va îndeplini toate sarcinile sau va muri în încercare. Prima lui sarcină a fost să călătorească în deșert și să-l găsească pe cel mai mare dintre scarabei acolo, pentru ca preoții să-i dezvăluie înțelepciunea și să-i umple mintea goală de amintiri. Străinul a coborât adânc în vizuinile scarabeilor pentru a-și înfrunta judecata și pentru a găsi răspunsuri care se pierduseră în nisipul deșertului cu eoni în urmă. Dar străinul nu s-a mai întors.

entries.en: But the progress goes well. Soon we will be able to control the power. And we will be then one step closer to our main goal.
entries.translated: Dar progresul merge bine. În curând vom putea controla puterea. Și atunci vom fi cu un pas mai aproape de scopul nostru principal.

entries.en: But we havent give up hope yet. Maybe we will find somehow someday by chance a key element that will help us to open many doors in the magic web.
entries.translated: Dar încă nu am renunțat la speranță. Poate vom găsi cumva, întâmplător, un element cheie care ne va ajuta să deschidem multe uși în rețeaua magică.

entries.en: As long as there are enough minions to boost the negative energy of a place, demons can exist for a very long time in our realm. So in theory, it would also be possible that the gate between the two realms is kept open, allowing more and more demons to enter our world that can easily form a demonic army causing mayhem and havoc.
entries.translated: Finché ci sono abbastanza servitori per aumentare l'energia negativa di un luogo, i demoni possono esistere per molto tempo nel nostro regno. Quindi, in teoria, sarebbe anche possibile che la porta tra i due regni venga mantenuta aperta, consentendo a sempre più demoni di entrare nel nostro mondo e di formare facilmente un esercito demoniaco causando caos e caos.

entries.en: As the king became sick and no one was able to heal him, the traitor stepped forward with a strange medicine. Trusting in his beloved servant, the king drank the medicine which actually was the blood of some servant that had been murdered recently. The medicine seemed to restore the king's strength, so the traitor had no trouble to feed him with more blood. Soon the king's appearance started to change. His aversion to sunlight and his paleness were attributed to his illness, but also the king's temper and behaviour turned more and more violent and aggressive. Nonetheless, the people loved their king and put up with his moods.
entries.translated: Poiché il re si ammalò e nessuno riuscì a curarlo, il traditore si fece avanti con una strana medicina. Confidando nel suo amato servitore, il re bevve la medicina che in realtà era il sangue di un servo che era stato recentemente assassinato. La medicina sembrava ripristinare le forze del re, quindi il traditore non ebbe problemi a nutrirlo con altro sangue. Ben presto l'aspetto del re cominciò a cambiare. La sua avversione alla luce del sole e il suo pallore furono attribuiti alla sua malattia, ma anche il carattere e il comportamento del re divennero sempre più violenti e aggressivi. Ciò nonostante, il popolo amava il proprio re e sopportava i suoi umori.

entries.en: As the orcs approached I've hidden myself in the bushes near the lake. I did hardly dare to breath as they met only some inches from my nose. I thought my wild beating heart might betray me to this murderous beasts.
entries.translated: Quando gli orchi si sono avvicinati mi sono nascosto tra i cespugli vicino al lago. Non osavo quasi respirare perché si incontravano a pochi centimetri dal mio naso. Pensavo che il mio cuore pulsante e selvaggio potesse tradirmi a causa di queste bestie assassine.

entries.en: As we travelled through the dungeon tunnels we came to a big cave. In the light of our torches we saw several eyes glowing in the darkness, then the trolls attacked, silently as usual. We immediately dropped our torches and raised our shields to block the first attack, then we counterattacked. Soon the floor was wet with blood, ours and theirs. They were very skilled in blocking our blows and I am sure with inferior weapons we would have hacked on these beasts for an eternity.
entries.translated: Mentre viaggiavamo attraverso i tunnel dei sotterranei arrivammo ad una grande grotta. Alla luce delle nostre torce abbiamo visto diversi occhi brillare nell'oscurità, poi i troll hanno attaccato, silenziosamente come al solito. Abbiamo subito abbassato le torce e alzato gli scudi per bloccare il primo attacco, poi abbiamo contrattaccato. Ben presto il pavimento fu bagnato di sangue, il nostro e il loro. Erano molto abili nel parare i nostri colpi e sono sicuro che con armi inferiori avremmo fatto a pezzi queste bestie per l'eternità.

entries.en: As with other tests it could be observed that the vampires have the ability of regeneration but not of regrowth.
entries.translated: Come per altri test si è potuto osservare che i vampiri hanno la capacità di rigenerazione ma non di ricrescita.

entries.en: At last even Baa'leal, who led the Efreet in battle, had to admit that the Marid and their despised human allies fought valiantly. However, despite the heavy losses he was determined to decide the war there and now. He summoned the most powerful Efreet wizards and ordered them to unleash a huge column of magic fire onto Ankrahmun in order to render the city and all those in it to cinders. The Efreet wizards' followed his orders and soon a wall of devastating fire rose up to the sky. However, when they tried to move it onto Ankrahmun they soon realised that it did not move into the desired direction. The Marid had soon seen through Baa'leals plan, and Fa'hradin and his fellow Marid mages used their own magic to turn the devastating flames against their creators. A fierce battle of wills ensued between the mages from both sides, and the whole battle came to a halt when the two armies watched in horrified fascination as the terrible pile of flames wandered seemingly undecided to and fro. But then, all of a sudden, the pile made a sudden leap to the north, and within seconds those who had summoned it from the sky were reduced to smouldering ashes. That was the turning point of the great battle.
entries.translated: Alla fine anche Baa'leal, che guidò gli Efreet in battaglia, dovette ammettere che i Marid e i loro disprezzati alleati umani combattevano valorosamente. Tuttavia, nonostante le pesanti perdite, era determinato a decidere la guerra lì e ora. Convocò i più potenti maghi Efreet e ordinò loro di scatenare un'enorme colonna di fuoco magico su Ankrahmun per ridurre in cenere la città e tutti i suoi abitanti. I maghi Efreet seguirono i suoi ordini e presto un muro di fuoco devastante si alzò verso il cielo. Tuttavia, quando hanno provato a spostarlo su Ankrahmun si sono presto accorti che non si muoveva nella direzione desiderata. I Marid capirono presto il piano di Baa'leal e Fa'hradin e i suoi compagni maghi Marid usarono la loro stessa magia per rivolgere le fiamme devastanti contro i loro creatori. Ne seguì una feroce battaglia di volontà tra i maghi di entrambe le parti, e l'intera battaglia si interruppe quando i due eserciti guardarono con orrore e fascino il terribile mucchio di fiamme vagare apparentemente indeciso avanti e indietro. Ma poi, all'improvviso, il mucchio fece un balzo improvviso verso nord, e in pochi secondi coloro che lo avevano evocato dal cielo furono ridotti in cenere fumante. Quello fu il punto di svolta della grande battaglia.

entries.en: At last, Malor prepared for a decisive strike. He sent a messenger to Gabel and challenged him to a personal duel. Gabel, who was prepared to do anything to stop the fratricidal war, accepted the challenge. The enemies agreed to meet in the fertile plains of Kha'labal. There they stood, face to face, the old king and the usurper, and so did their armies, because neither of two was gullible or foolish enough to come on his own. It was the greatest gathering of djinns in recorded history.
entries.translated: Alla fine Malor si preparò per un attacco decisivo. Mandò un messaggero a Gabel e lo sfidò a duello personale. Gabel, disposto a tutto pur di fermare la guerra fratricida, accettò la sfida. I nemici accettarono di incontrarsi nelle fertili pianure di Kha'labal. Lì si trovarono, faccia a faccia, il vecchio re e l'usurpatore, e così fecero anche i loro eserciti, perché nessuno dei due era abbastanza ingenuo o sciocco da venire da solo. È stato il più grande raduno di jinn nella storia documentata.

entries.en: At last we trapped Hugo in the dungeon cellars!

entries.en: At one far-away point in history, the Yalahari seemingly vanished. Certain clues that our ancestors gathered, hint that they locked themselves in the city's centre and cut off all contact to their helpers. When the Augur sometime later dared to enter the inner city, the Yalahari were all gone - vanished without a trace. After getting over the initial shock, the Augur assumed the role of the Yalahari themselves. For a while they tried to get familiar with some of the secrets of their lost masters, but they were only able to understand the most basic concepts of the Yalahari's knowledge. They stuck to their usual tasks to keep the city running. Still, they were too few to keep the enormous city, of which they understood so little, in shape.
entries.translated: In un momento molto lontano della storia, gli Yalahari apparentemente scomparvero. Alcuni indizi raccolti dai nostri antenati suggeriscono che si chiudessero nel centro della città e interrompessero ogni contatto con i loro aiutanti. Quando qualche tempo dopo l'Augure osò entrare nel centro della città, gli Yalahari se n'erano andati tutti, svaniti senza lasciare traccia. Dopo aver superato lo shock iniziale, gli Auguri hanno assunto il ruolo degli stessi Yalahari. Per un po' cercarono di familiarizzare con alcuni dei segreti dei loro maestri perduti, ma riuscirono a comprendere solo i concetti più elementari della conoscenza degli Yalahari. Si sono attenuti ai loro soliti compiti per far funzionare la città. Tuttavia erano troppo pochi per mantenere in forma l'enorme città, di cui capivano così poco.

entries.en: At the great bay, east of Thais lies a rotten town of criminals. Little is known about it and only the most ruthles people even think about travelling there.
entries.translated: Nella grande baia, a est di Thais si trova una putrida città di criminali. Si sa poco e solo i più spietati pensano di andarci.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: You love fish - but preferably those caught in the cold north. Even though they're hard to come by you never get tired of picking holes in ice sheets and hanging your fishing rod in.
entries.translated: Iubești peștele - dar de preferat pe cei prinși în nordul rece. Chiar dacă sunt greu de găsit, nu te sături niciodată să faci găuri în foile de gheață și să-ți agăți undița de pescuit.

entries.en: When it comes to interracial understanding, you're an expert. You've mastered the language of the Chakoya and made someone really happy with your generosity. Achuq!
entries.translated: Când vine vorba de înțelegerea interrasială, ești un expert. Ai stăpânit limba Chakoya și ai făcut pe cineva foarte fericit cu generozitatea ta. Achuq!

entries.en: Your world is lucky to have you! You don't hesitate to jump in and help when brave heroes are called to save the world.
entries.translated: Lumea ta este norocoasă să te aibă! Nu ezitați să sari și să ajuți atunci când eroi curajoși sunt chemați să salveze lumea.

entries.en: You're in the front line when it comes to saving your world or taking part in social events. Whether you do it noticed or unnoticed by the people, your world can rely on you to dutifully do your part to make it a better place for everyone.
entries.translated: Ești în prima linie atunci când vine vorba de a-ți salva lumea sau de a participa la evenimente sociale. Indiferent dacă o faci observat sau neobservat de oameni, lumea ta se poate baza pe tine pentru a-ți face cu respect partea ta pentru a-l face un loc mai bun pentru toată lumea.

entries.en: You don't consider yourself too good to do the dirty work while someone else might win the laurels for killing Devovorga. They couldn't do it without you!
entries.translated: Nu te consideri prea bun pentru a face treaba murdară în timp ce altcineva ar putea câștiga lauri pentru uciderea lui Devovorga. Nu ar putea face asta fără tine!

entries.en: You've entered the lair of Devovorga and joined the crew trying to take her down - whether crowned with success or not doesn't matter, but they can't blame you for not trying!
entries.translated: Ai intrat în bârlogul lui Devovorga și te-ai alăturat echipajului care încearcă să o doboare - dacă ai sau nu încununat de succes, nu contează, dar nu te pot învinovăți că nu ai încercat!

entries.en: Souls are like butterflies. The black soul of a living weapon yearning to strike lies shattered beneath your feet.
entries.translated: Sufletele sunt ca fluturii. Sufletul negru al unei arme vii care tânjește să lovească stă spulberat sub picioarele tale.

entries.en: Power lies in the will of her who commands it. You fought it with full force - and were stronger.
entries.translated: Power stă în voința celei care o poruncește. Te-ai luptat cu toată forța - și ai fost mai puternic.

entries.en: Few things equal the wild fury of a trapped and riven creature. You were a worthy opponent.
entries.translated: Puține lucruri egalează furia sălbatică a unei creaturi prinse și sfâșiate. Ai fost un adversar demn.

entries.en: Blind hatred took physical form, violently rebelling against the injustice it was born into. You were not able to bring justice - but at least temporary peace.
entries.translated: Ura oarbă a luat formă fizică, răzvrătindu-se violent împotriva nedreptății în care s-a născut. Nu ai fost în stare să faci dreptate – dar măcar pace temporară.

entries.en: The forbidden knowledge of aeons was never meant to invade this world. You silenced its voice before it could be made heard.
entries.translated: Cunoașterea interzisă a eonilor nu a fost niciodată menită să invadeze această lume. I-ai tăiat vocea înainte de a putea fi auzită.

entries.en: You helped bringing Devovorga's dangerous tentacles and her humongous cocoon down - not stopping her transformation, but ultimately completing a crucial step to her death.
entries.translated: Ai ajutat la doborarea tentaculelor periculoase ale lui Devovorga și a coconului ei uriaș - fără a opri transformarea ei, dar în cele din urmă a finalizat un pas crucial către moartea ei.

entries.en: One special hero among many. This year - it was you. Devovorga withdrew in a darker realm because she could not withstand your power - and that of your comrades. Time will tell if the choice you made was good - but for now, it saved your world.
entries.translated: Un erou special printre multe. Anul acesta - ai fost tu. Devovorga s-a retras într-un tărâm mai întunecat pentru că nu a putut rezista puterii tale - și a tovarășilor tăi. Timpul va spune dacă alegerea pe care ai făcut-o a fost bună - dar deocamdată ți-a salvat lumea.

entries.en: Tired... so tired... curling up in a warm and cosy bed seems like the perfect thing to do right now. Sweet dreams!
entries.translated: Obosit... atât de obosit... să te ghemuiești într-un pat cald și confortabil pare a fi lucrul perfect de făcut chiar acum. Vise plăcute!

entries.en: Sleeping - you do it with style. You're chilling in your hammock, listening to the sound of the birds and crickets as you slowly drift away into the realm of dreams.
entries.translated: Dormit - o faci cu stil. Te relaxezi în hamac, ascultând sunetul păsărilor și al greierilor în timp ce te îndepărtezi încet în tărâmul viselor.

entries.en: You don't need much to sleep comfortably. A pile of straw and a roof over your head - with the latter being completely optional - is quite enough to relax. You don't even mind the rats nibbling on your toes.
entries.translated: Nu ai nevoie de multe pentru a dormi confortabil. O grămadă de paie și un acoperiș deasupra capului - acesta din urmă fiind complet opțional - este suficient pentru a vă relaxa. Nici măcar nu te deranjează șobolanii care îți ronțăie degetele de la picioare.

entries.en: Well - the contents of that present weren't quite what you expected. With friends like these, who needs enemies?
entries.translated: Ei bine, conținutul acelui cadou nu a fost exact ceea ce te așteptai. Cu asemenea prieteni, cine are nevoie de dușmani?

entries.en: So much for your feathered little friend! Maybe standing in front of the birdcage, squeezing its neck and shouting 'Sing! Sing! Sing!' was a little too much for it?!
entries.translated: Atât pentru micul tău prieten cu pene! Poate că să stai în fața cuștii, să-i strângi gâtul și să strigi 'Sing! Sing! Sing!' a fost puțin prea mult pentru asta?!

entries.en: You live the life of hunters and gatherers. Well, especially that of a gatherer, and especially of one who gathers lots of blueberries. Have you checked the colour of your tongue lately?
entries.translated: Trăiești viața de vânători și culegători. Ei bine, mai ales cea a unui culegător, și mai ales a unuia care adună multe afine. Ți-ai verificat culoarea limbii în ultima vreme?

entries.en: Would you like to change your platinum coins into {gold} or {crystal}?
entries.translated: Czy chcesz wymienić swoje platynowe monety na {gold} lub {crystal}?

entries.en: It is shining with positive energy and was awarded by FunTibia.com
entries.translated: Emanuje pozytywną energią i została nagrodzona przez FunTibia.com

entries.en: It is shining with positive energy and was awarded by FunTibia.com
entries.translated: Emanuje pozytywną energią i została nagrodzona przez FunTibia.com

entries.en: It is filled with a desecrated bone.
It contains holy water from the white raven monastery.
entries.translated: Zawiera wodę święconą z klasztoru Białego Kruka.

entries.en: It contains so much cash that you wouldn't have any idea how to use it. Return it to a nearby bank
entries.translated: Zawiera tyle gotówki, że nie masz pojęcia, jak ją wykorzystać. Zwróć go do pobliskiego banku

entries.en: It contains highly intensified poison against vermin.
entries.translated: Zawiera wysoce intensywną truciznę przeciw szkodnikom.

entries.en: It is filled with the legendary dwarvish brown ale.
entries.translated: Wypełnione jest legendarnym krasnoludzkim brązowym piwem.

entries.en: This lamp is glowing very dimly.
This lamp is glowing very dimly.
It is the bottle Boozer gave you for the brown ale.
entries.translated: To butelka, którą Boozer dał ci po brązowym piwie.

entries.en: They seem to have strange effects on other plants and can also be grown into an own plant
entries.translated: Wydaje się, że mają dziwny wpływ na inne rośliny i można je również wyhodować jako własną roślinę

entries.en: This is Budriks old mining helmet.
The seal used by the spellsingers of the deep
The strange shape of this key glistens softly in the light
entries.translated: Dziwny kształt tego klucza miękko błyszczy w świetle

entries.en: A belt buckle snatched from a deepling guard
This formidable gem was hand-cut by |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Ten wspaniały klejnot został ręcznie wycięty przez |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: What do you want in my magical robe store? I doubt I have anything that's of interest to you.
entries.translated: Czego chcesz w moim sklepie z magicznymi szatami? Wątpię, bym miała coś, co cię zainteresuje.

entries.en: Of course, take a good look at my meat.
entries.translated: Oczywiście, dobrze przyjrzyj się mojemu mięsu.

entries.en: Nice to see you, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my exclusive offers.
entries.translated: Miło cię widzieć, |PLAYERNAME|! Poproś o {trade}, jeśli chcesz zobaczyć moje wyjątkowe oferty.

entries.en: Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
entries.translated: Po prostu poproś mnie o {trade}, żeby zobaczyć, co od ciebie kupuję.

entries.en: He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
entries.translated: Poświęcił swoje życie, by witać nowoprzybyłych na tej wyspie.

entries.en: Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
entries.translated: Biedna staruszka, jej syn {Tom} nigdy jej nie odwiedza.

entries.en: He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
entries.translated: Przeważnie trzyma się na uboczu. To pustelnik poza miastem - powodzenia w znalezieniu go.

entries.en: He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
entries.translated: To miejscowy garbarz. Możesz spróbować sprzedać mu świeże zwłoki albo skórę.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Cieszę się, że mogłem ci pomóc, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a trade if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Cześć. Jak mogę Ci pomóc |PLAYERNAME|? Jeśli chcesz coś kupić, zapytaj mnie o wymianę. Mogę również wyjaśnić system {mail}.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Cieszę się, że mogłem ci pomóc, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Oh hey, |PLAYERNAME|! Vascalir must have sent you to help me with a little {mission}, right?
entries.translated: Hej, |PLAYERNAME|! Vascalir musiał cię przysłać, żebyś pomógł mi w małej {mission}, prawda?

entries.en: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Back so soon? Have you delivered the herbs to Hyacinth?
entries.translated: Witaj, |PLAYERNAME|! Tak szybko wróciłeś? Dostarczyłeś zioła do Hyacinth?

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! You look a little stressed today. If you like to view my offers of potions, just ask me for a {trade}. In case you're looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east!
entries.translated: Witaj, |PLAYERNAME|! Wyglądasz dziś na trochę zestresowanego. Jeśli chcesz zobaczyć moje oferty mikstur, poproś o {trade}. Jeśli szukasz marketu i lochów, idź ścieżką na wschód!

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my offers. If you buy a potion, don't forget that there's a {deposit} of 5 gold on the empty flask.
entries.translated: Oczywiście, przejrzyj moje oferty. Jeśli kupujesz miksturę, pamiętaj, że za pustą fiolkę jest {deposit} 5 sztuk złota.

entries.en: If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
entries.translated: Jeśli podasz mi imię obywatela, powiem ci, co o nim lub o niej wiem.

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Aby zobaczyć oferty kupca, po prostu porozmawiaj z nim lub z nią i poproś o {trade}. Chętnie pokażą ci swoje oferty, a także rzeczy, które od ciebie kupują.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
EVEN WITH ALL THAT TIME IN THE PRISON THAT WEAKENED ME, YOU ARE NO MATCH TO ME!
entries.translated: AUN CON TODO ESE TIEMPO EN LA PRISIÓN QUE ME DEBILITÓ, ¡NO ERES COMPATIBLE PARA MÍ!

entries.en: Lil' one bring three bast skirts.
entries.translated: Il piccolo porta tre gonne di rafia.

entries.en: Lil' one bring three bast skirts?
entries.translated: Il piccolo porta tre gonne di rafia?

entries.en: Very noble. Shiny. Me like. But breaks so fast. Me can make from shiny armour. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: Molto nobile. Brillante. Mi piace. Ma si rompe così in fretta. Posso creare armature lucenti. Il piccolo vuole fare uno scambio?

entries.en: Firy steel it is. Need green ones' breath to melt. Or red even better. Me can make from shield. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: È acciaio ardente. Ho bisogno che il respiro dei verdi si sciolga. O rosso ancora meglio. Posso ricavarne uno scudo. Il piccolo vuole fare uno scambio?

entries.en: Hellsteel is. Cursed and evil. Dangerous to work with. Me can make from evil helmet. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: Hellsteel lo è. Maledetto e malvagio. Pericoloso con cui lavorare. Posso creare un elmo malvagio. Il piccolo vuole fare uno scambio?

entries.en: Good iron is. Me friends use it much for fight. Me can make from weapon. Lil' one want to trade?
entries.translated: Un buon ferro lo è. I miei amici lo usano molto per combattere. Posso creare un'arma. Il piccolo vuole fare uno scambio?

entries.en: Wait. Me work no cheap is. Do favour for me first, yes?
entries.translated: Aspettare. Il mio lavoro non è economico. Fammi un favore per primo, sì?

entries.en: Uh. Me can make some nasty lil' bolt from soul orbs. Lil' one want to trade all?
entries.translated: Eh. Posso creare qualche brutto piccolo dardo dalle sfere dell'anima. Lil' uno vuole scambiare tutto?

entries.en: Cling clang! Me done good work today! Li'l one gets double bolts!
entries.translated: Aggrappati clang! Ho fatto un buon lavoro oggi! Quello avrà doppie frecce!

entries.en: Me need gift for woman. We dance, so me want to give her bast skirt. But she big is. So I need many to make big one. Bring three okay? Me wait.
entries.translated: Ho bisogno di un regalo per una donna. Balliamo, quindi voglio regalarle una gonna di rafia. Ma lei è grande. Quindi me ne servono molti per realizzarne uno grande. Portane tre, ok? Io aspetto.

entries.en: Good good! Woman happy will be. Now me happy too and help you.
entries.translated: Bene bene! La donna sarà felice. Ora anch'io sono felice e ti aiuto.

entries.en: Lil' one bring three bast skirts.
entries.translated: Il piccolo porta tre gonne di rafia.

entries.en: Lil' one bring three bast skirts?
entries.translated: Il piccolo porta tre gonne di rafia?

entries.translated: È acciaio ardente. Ho bisogno che il respiro dei verdi si sciolga. O rosso ancora meglio. Posso ricavarne uno scudo. Il piccolo vuole fare uno scambio?

entries.en: Wait. Me work no cheap is. Do favour for me first, yes?
entries.translated: Aspettare. Il mio lavoro non è economico. Fammi un favore per primo, sì?

entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.
