entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!
ola de serpiente de cresta marina
invocación del guardián de la puerta del lagarto
reductor de habilidades de hombre lobo

entries.en: Your body is heating up, the air around you is flickering.
entries.translated: Twoje ciało się nagrzewa, powietrze wokół ciebie migocze.

entries.en: The heat is now unbearable, the blood in your body feels like lava. There's almost no strength left in you - act quickly!
entries.translated: Upał jest teraz nie do zniesienia, krew w twoim ciele przypomina lawę. Już prawie nie ma w Tobie sił – działaj szybko!

entries.en: Embrace the stigma of bad fortune. The tar does not feel so hot anymore. You passed the tar trial.
entries.translated: Przyjmij piętno złego losu. Smoła nie jest już tak gorąca. Przeszedłeś próbę smoły.

entries.en: Your body reacts to this strange green substance as you reach out to touch it. You feel an urge for more of this energy.
entries.translated: Twoje ciało reaguje na tę dziwną zieloną substancję, gdy wyciągasz rękę, aby jej dotknąć. Czujesz potrzebę zdobycia większej ilości tej energii.

entries.en: The tar covering you has cooled down and fell off for the most part. Your body is not heated up anymore.
entries.translated: Pokrywająca cię smoła ostygła i w większości odpadła. Twoje ciało nie jest już rozgrzane.

entries.en: You absorb the energetic remains of this decaying soul. Its power is very fragile and fleeting
entries.translated: Wchłaniasz energetyczne pozostałości tej rozkładającej się duszy. Jego moc jest bardzo krucha i ulotna

entries.en: You absorb the energetic remains of this whitering soul. Its power is very fragile and fleeting.
entries.translated: Wchłaniasz energetyczne pozostałości tej wybielającej duszy. Jego moc jest bardzo krucha i ulotna.

entries.en: You need exactly 10 players to start this challenge.
entries.translated: Aby rozpocząć to wyzwanie, potrzebujesz dokładnie 10 graczy.

entries.en: You need exactly 5 players to start this challenge.
entries.translated: Aby rozpocząć to wyzwanie, potrzebujesz dokładnie 5 graczy.

entries.en: You need to wait for 10 hours to face this boss again.
entries.translated: Aby ponownie zmierzyć się z tym bossem, musisz poczekać 10 godzin.

entries.en: You need to wait for 20 hours to face this boss again.
entries.translated: Aby ponownie zmierzyć się z tym bossem, musisz poczekać 20 godzin.

entries.en: Couldn't find any position for you right now.
entries.translated: Nie udało nam się teraz znaleźć dla Ciebie żadnego stanowiska.

entries.en: You need 4 players to fight with The Ravager.
entries.translated: Do walki z Niszczycielem potrzeba 4 graczy.

entries.en: You need 5 players to fight with Death Priest Shargon.
entries.translated: Potrzebujesz 5 graczy do walki z Kapłanem Śmierci Shargonem.

entries.en: You need exactly 5 players to fight with Death Priest Shargon.
entries.translated: Potrzebujesz dokładnie 5 graczy, aby walczyć z Kapłanem Śmierci Shargonem.

entries.en: As this is your first time as a %s %s
entries.translated: Ponieważ jest to Twój pierwszy raz w roli %s %s

entries.en: {0} defends his belongings and will not let you open his chest.
entries.translated: {0} broni swoich rzeczy i nie pozwala otworzyć swojej piersi.

entries.en: HOW IS THAT POSSIBLE?!? MY MASTER WILL CRUSH YOU!! AHRRGGG!
entries.translated: JAK TO MOŻLIWE?!? MÓJ MISTRZ CIĘ Zmiażdży!! AHRRGGG!

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: You feel a powerfull eletric charge building up!
You loaded the last stone on the catapults. Time to return to Vascalir.
entries.translated: Załadowałeś ostatni kamień na katapulty. Czas wracać do Vascalira.

entries.en: You have already loaded a stone on this catapult. Look around on other roofs to find the remaining catapults.
entries.translated: Załadowałeś już kamień na tę katapultę. Rozejrzyj się po innych dachach, aby znaleźć pozostałe katapulty.

entries.en: You rub the strange grease on your body. The spider queen will not be able to smell you for about 2 minutes. Hurry!
entries.translated: Wcierasz dziwny smar w ciało. Królowa pająków nie wyczuje cię przez około 2 minuty. Pośpiesz się!

entries.en: You already retrieved some of the spider queen's web. No need to go back down there.
entries.translated: Masz już część pajęczyny królowej pająków. Nie ma potrzeby tam wracać.

entries.en: Don't enter the lair without a protective grease. Use one of the stones to the north to become invisible to her.
entries.translated: Nie wchodź do legowiska bez ochronnego smaru. Użyj jednego z kamieni na północy, aby stać się dla niej niewidzialnym.

entries.en: You already have the spider queen's web. You should go back to Vascalir and not take any further risks.
entries.translated: Masz już pajęczynę królowej pająków. Powinieneś wrócić do Vascalira i nie podejmować dalszego ryzyka.

entries.en: You retrieved some of the spider queen's web. Hurry back before she can smell you again!
entries.translated: Zdobyłeś część pajęczyny królowej pająków. Wracaj szybko, zanim znów cię wyczuje!

entries.en: Oh no... you were too slow and the wolves caught up with you. You may try again.
entries.translated: O nie... byłeś za wolny i wilki cię dogoniły. Możesz spróbować ponownie.

entries.en: You got the war wolf leather - but you hear a scary howl behind you. Time to get out of here - FAST!
entries.translated: Masz skórę wojennego wilka - ale słyszysz za sobą przerażające wycie. Czas stąd znikać - SZYBKO!

entries.en: You're coughing so badly that you had to return upstairs. Take a few deep breaths and try again.
entries.translated: Kaszel tak cię dusi, że musiałeś wrócić na górę. Weź kilka głębokich oddechów i spróbuj ponownie.

entries.en: This fire is much too hot to walk through it. Use the destroy field rune on the fire to weaken the flames!
entries.translated: Ten ogień jest zbyt gorący, by przez niego przejść. Użyj runy destroy field na ogniu, aby osłabić płomienie!

entries.en: Fire in this stadium can be crossed without taking damage. Open the chest and get out of here!
entries.translated: Przez ogień na tej arenie można przejść bez obrażeń. Otwórz skrzynię i uciekaj stąd!

entries.en: The cave has collapsed. It's not safe to go down there anymore.
entries.translated: Jaskinia się zawaliła. Schodzenie tam na dół nie jest już bezpieczne.

entries.en: That should weaken the beam enough to make it collapse soon.
entries.translated: To powinno osłabić belkę na tyle, że wkrótce się zawali.

entries.en: With his last energy, Kraknaknork pushes you out of his throne room. Hurry back and defeat him before he regains his power.
entries.translated: Resztką sił Kraknaknork wypycha cię ze swojej sali tronowej. Wracaj szybko i pokonaj go, zanim odzyska moc.

entries.en: A player is already inside the boss room.
entries.translated: Gracz jest już w pokoju bossa.
Modo de autoloot establecido a TODO.

entries.en: [World Change] Yasir has arrived in %s today!
You have received a {} soul core.
entries.translated: Has recibido un núcleo de alma {}.

entries.en: The arena is already in use.
This creature is already selected on another slot.
entries.translated: Questa creatura è già selezionata in un altro slot.

entries.en: You don't have any active monster on this prey slot.
entries.translated: Non hai nessun mostro attivo in questo slot preda.

entries.en: There was an error while processing your action. Please try reopening the task window.
entries.translated: Si è verificato un errore durante l'elaborazione della tua azione. Prova a riaprire la finestra delle attività.

entries.en: You already have an active monster on this task hunting slot.
entries.translated: Hai già un mostro attivo in questo slot di caccia all'attività.

entries.en: You cannot claim your task reward with an empty task hunting slot.
entries.translated: Non puoi richiedere la ricompensa del tuo compito con uno slot di ricerca compito vuoto.
Il tuo bonus preda è scaduto.

entries.en: You already have an active monster on this prey slot.
entries.translated: Hai già un mostro attivo in questo slot preda.

entries.en: A player with this name does not exist.
entries.translated: Non esiste un giocatore con questo nome.

entries.en: I greet you, human. This is a time of distress, more than ever are we in need of guardians to protect us and our world.
entries.translated: Ti saluto, umano. Questo è un momento di angoscia, più che mai abbiamo bisogno di tutori che proteggano noi e il nostro mondo.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: All chants have been sung in the right order, you are deemed worthy. You are transported away...
entries.translated: Все песнопения пропеты в правильном порядке, вы признаны достойными. Вас переносят...
Срок действия вашего бонуса за добычу истек.

entries.en: You have already received your reward.
You need to defeat Goshnar's Megalomania to receive your reward.
entries.translated: Trebuie să învingi Megalomania lui Goshnar pentru a-ți primi recompensa.

entries.en: All chants have been sung in the right order, you are deemed worthy. You are transported away...
entries.translated: Toate cântările au fost cântate în ordinea corectă, sunteți considerat demn. Ești transportat departe...

entries.en: The arena is already in use.
The arena is already in use.
You must be holding the container to set it as a loot container.
entries.translated: Trebuie să ții containerul pentru a-l seta ca container de pradă.

entries.en: A player with this name does not exist.
entries.translated: Un jucător cu acest nume nu există.

entries.en: There was an error while processing your action. Please try reopening the task window.
entries.translated: A apărut o eroare la procesarea acțiunii dvs. Vă rugăm să încercați să redeschideți fereastra de activitate.

entries.en: You already have an active monster on this task hunting slot.
entries.translated: Ai deja un monstru activ în acest slot de vânătoare de sarcini.

entries.en: You cannot claim your task reward with an empty task hunting slot.
entries.translated: Nu vă puteți revendica recompensa pentru sarcină cu un slot de vânătoare de sarcini gol.

entries.en: A player with this name does not exist.
entries.translated: Un jucător cu acest nume nu există.

entries.en: Good bye and please stay away, okay?
entries.translated: La revedere și te rog stai departe, bine?

entries.en: At last! Good things come to those who wait.
entries.translated: În sfârșit! Lucrurile bune vin la cei care așteaptă.

entries.en: Oh, the nerve. Go to the rats which raised you.
entries.translated: Oh, nervii. Du-te la șobolanii care te-au crescut.

entries.en: Ah, an adventurer. Be greeted and have a seat. How may I {serve} you?
entries.translated: Ah, un aventurier. Fiți salutați și luați loc. Cum te pot {serve}?

entries.en: I hope to see you soon.

entries.translated: anello di ghiaccio della tigre mannara bianca
reducere de îndemânare a furiei în pădure 2

entries.en: lord of the elements skill reducer
You sneaked into the orc fortress. Careful now, don't go outside again.
entries.translated: Ti sei intrufolato nella fortezza degli orchi. Attento adesso, non uscire più.

entries.en: Got your tarantula trap ready? You might need to use it soon...
entries.translated: Hai pronto la trappola per tarantole? Potrebbe essere necessario usarlo presto...

entries.en: The bank is below the academy. Go north and head down the stairs and to the right.
entries.translated: La banca è sotto l'accademia. Andate a nord e scendete le scale e poi a destra.

entries.en: Go to the right to find the bank and talk to Paulie.
entries.translated: Vai a destra per trovare la banca e parla con Paulie.

entries.en: Follow the way to the east and go south to reach the graveyard.
entries.translated: Seguite la strada verso est e andate a sud per raggiungere il cimitero.

entries.en: Head through the northern door and follow the hallways to find the library vault.
entries.translated: Attraversa la porta nord e segui i corridoi per trovare il caveau della biblioteca.

entries.en: Follow the path to the east to find Hyacinth's little house.
entries.translated: Segui il sentiero verso est per trovare la casetta di Hyacinth.

entries.en: The library vault is below the academy. Go north and head down several stairs until you find a quest door.
entries.translated: Il caveau della biblioteca è sotto l'accademia. Vai a nord e scendi diverse scale finché non trovi una porta di missione.

entries.en: You don't have the bag with the items yet. Open the door in the basement of the academy to the left of Paulie to get them!
entries.translated: Non hai ancora la borsa con gli oggetti. Apri la porta nel seminterrato dell'accademia a sinistra di Paulie per prenderli!

entries.en: This is not the way to the crypt. Go south to reach the graveyard.
entries.translated: Questa non è la strada per la cripta. Andate a sud per raggiungere il cimitero.

entries.en: This is not the way to Hyacinth. Stay on the path a little more to the south to find Hyacinth's little house.
entries.translated: Questa non è la strada per Hyacinth. Rimani sul sentiero un po' più a sud per trovare la casetta di Hyacinth.

entries.en: This is not the way to the tarantula's lair. Head northwest and go up the little ramp.
entries.translated: Questa non è la strada per la tana della tarantola. Andate a nord-ovest e salite la piccola rampa.

entries.en: This is not the way to the troll caves. Follow the path to the north past the hill to reach them.
entries.translated: Questa non è la strada per le caverne dei troll. Seguite il sentiero verso nord oltre la collina per raggiungerli.

entries.en: This is not the way to the wasps' lair. Choose the northern path to reach it.
entries.translated: Questa non è la strada per la tana delle vespe. Scegli il percorso a nord per raggiungerlo.

entries.en: Follow the path to the north, cross the bridge to the south and walk west to reach the orc fortress.
entries.translated: Seguite il sentiero a nord, attraversate il ponte a sud e camminate verso ovest per raggiungere la fortezza degli orchi.

entries.en: Follow the path to the west to reach the orc fortress.
entries.translated: Seguite il sentiero verso ovest per raggiungere la fortezza degli orchi.

entries.en: This road is the main access of the village. You might want to finish your business here first.
entries.translated: Questa strada è l'accesso principale del villaggio. Potresti voler finire prima i tuoi affari qui.

entries.en: Walk to the north and down the stairs to reach the tarantula's lair.
entries.translated: Cammina verso nord e scendi le scale per raggiungere la tana della tarantola.

entries.en: Follow the path to the north past the hill to reach the troll caves.
entries.translated: Seguite il sentiero a nord oltre la collina per raggiungere le caverne dei troll.

entries.en: Congratulations! You completed %s arena, you should take your reward now.
entries.translated: Поздравляем! Вы завершили арену %s, теперь вы должны получить свою награду.

entries.en: You cannot use this lever again.
entries.translated: Вы не сможете использовать этот рычаг снова.

entries.en: You have found a bag, but you have no room to take it.
entries.translated: Вы нашли сумку, но вам некуда ее взять.

entries.en: You enter the circle of trees and flowers. By visiting this sacred site you're infused with the power of nature and plants.

entries.translated: Вы вошли в солнечную башню Аб'дендриэля. Посетив это священное место, вы наполнитесь силой животворящего солнца.

entries.en: A shade emerges and snatches the candle from your hands.
entries.translated: O umbră apare și îți smulge lumânarea din mâini.

entries.en: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...
entries.translated: Дакле, дошли сте, |PLAYERNAME|. Надао сам се да нећеш...

entries.en: Greetings humans! Consider yourselfs lucky, I'm in need of {help}.
entries.translated: Поздрав људи! Сматрајте да сте срећни, треба ми {help}.

entries.en: Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?

entries.en: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
entries.translated: Здраво? Како то мислиш 'hi' - зар не видиш да сам ја... Морам да стишам глас. Да ли вам је пало на памет да овај 'chalice' не жели да га узнемиравате?! Остави ме на миру!

entries.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
entries.translated: Шта је ово? Ентитет са оптичким изазовом који се зове |PLAYERNAME|. Како фасцинантно!

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: There is a fully grown ember queen flower in it. This plant can't wither anymore
entries.translated: Znajduje się w nim w pełni rozwinięty kwiat królowej żaru. Ta roślina nie może już uschnąć

entries.en: There is a fully grown midnight bloom flower in it. This plant can't wither anymore
entries.translated: Znajduje się w nim w pełni rozwinięty kwiat kwitnący o północy. Ta roślina nie może już uschnąć

entries.en: There is a fully grown fairy dancer flower in it. This plant can't wither anymore
entries.translated: Znajduje się w nim w pełni rozwinięty kwiat wróżkowej tancerki. Ta roślina nie może już uschnąć

entries.en: There is a fully grown finger snapper plant in it. This plant can't wither anymore
entries.translated: Znajduje się w nim w pełni rozwinięta roślina lucjanu palcowego. Ta roślina nie może już uschnąć

entries.en: The substance will dissolve after a while
A filigree case made of seashell. It seems there is a small lock on the side of the case.
entries.translated: Filigranowe etui wykonane z muszli. Wygląda na to, że z boku obudowy znajduje się mały zamek.
W środku znajdują się małe szczeniaki

entries.en: It belongs to Noodles, the King's dog
This continuous stream of water seems strong enough to cut even the hardest of materials.
entries.translated: Ten ciągły strumień wody wydaje się wystarczająco silny, aby przeciąć nawet najtwardszy materiał.

entries.en: This blood red gem is still rough
entries.translated: Ten krwistoczerwony klejnot jest wciąż szorstki

entries.en: This crate is full of fossilised coral. It needs to be obstructed in time or it will corrode
entries.translated: Ta skrzynia jest pełna skamieniałych koralowców. Należy go z czasem zablokować, w przeciwnym razie ulegnie korozji

entries.en: This crate is full of fossilised coral. It needs to be obstructed in time or it will corrode.
entries.translated: Ta skrzynia jest pełna skamieniałych koralowców. Należy go z czasem zablokować, w przeciwnym razie ulegnie korozji.

entries.en: I write this trilogy of blackness and death to warn the world of the evil in the depths
entries.translated: Piszę tę trylogię o ciemności i śmierci, aby ostrzec świat przed złem czającym się w głębinach

entries.en: Darkness clutches the creatures of the sea to end all living things. Be watchful of this black void
entries.translated: Ciemność chwyta stworzenia morskie, aby położyć kres wszystkim żywym istotom. Uważaj na tę czarną pustkę

entries.en: And they drove them mad and to the edge of extinction. Extinction of the world that surrounded them
entries.translated: Doprowadzili ich do szaleństwa i na skraj wyginięcia. Zagłada otaczającego ich świata

entries.en: The chair is tied to this strange machine. You could use this if you had appropriate instructions.
entries.translated: Krzesło jest przywiązane do tej dziwnej maszyny. Możesz tego użyć, jeśli masz odpowiednie instrukcje.

entries.en: A true Heart of the Sea, cut by Deeplings in depths of deepest black. It feels cold and lifeless
entries.translated: Prawdziwe Serce Morza, wycięte przez Deeplingów w głębinach najgłębszej czerni. Czuje się zimno i bez życia

entries.en: This makeshift drum will not last for long
entries.translated: Ten prowizoryczny bęben nie przetrwa długo

entries.en: Welcome to my humble hut, |PLAYERNAME|. What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Witaj w mojej skromnej chacie, |PLAYERNAME|. Co cię tu {here}?

entries.en: May the gods protect you! And stay away from that hole!
entries.translated: Niech bogowie cię chronią! I trzymaj się z dala od tej dziury!

entries.en: Welcome to my adventurer shop, |PLAYERNAME|! What do you need? Ask me for a {trade} to look at my wares.
entries.translated: Witaj w moim sklepie dla poszukiwaczy przygód, |PLAYERNAME|! Czego potrzebujesz? Poproś o {trade}, by obejrzeć mój towar.

entries.en: Great! Alright, I need a while to finish this backpack for you. Come ask me later, okay?
entries.translated: Świetnie! Dobrze, potrzebuję chwili, żeby dokończyć ten plecak dla ciebie. Wróć i zapytaj mnie później, okej?

entries.en: Ah, right, almost forgot about the backpack! Have you brought me 100 pieces of minotaur leather as requested?
entries.translated: Ach, racja, prawie zapomniałam o plecaku! Przyniosłeś/przyniosłaś mi, tak jak prosiłam, 100 kawałków skóry minotaura?

entries.en: Just in time! Your backpack is finished. Here you go, I hope you like it.
entries.translated: W samą porę! Twój plecak jest gotowy. Proszę, oto on, mam nadzieję, że ci się spodoba.

entries.en: Sorry, but I can only make one backpack per person, else I'd have to close my shop and open a leather manufactory.
entries.translated: Przykro mi, ale mogę zrobić tylko jeden plecak na osobę, inaczej musiałabym zamknąć sklep i otworzyć manufakturę skóry.

entries.en: Well, if you really like this backpack, I could make one for you, but minotaur leather is hard to come by these days. Are you willing to put some work into this?
entries.translated: Cóż, jeśli naprawdę podoba ci się ten plecak, mogłabym zrobić jeden dla ciebie, ale skórę minotaura ciężko dziś zdobyć. Chcesz włożyć w to trochę pracy?

entries.en: Alright then, if you bring me 100 pieces of fine minotaur leather I will see what I can do for you. You probably have to kill really many minotaurs though... so good luck!
entries.translated: No dobrze, jeśli przyniesiesz mi 100 kawałków dobrej skóry minotaura, zobaczę, co da się zrobić. Pewnie będziesz musiał/musiała zabić naprawdę sporo minotaurów... powodzenia!

entries.en: Sorry, but I don't run a welfare office, you know... no pain, no gain.
entries.translated: Wybacz, ale nie prowadzę biura pomocy społecznej, wiesz... bez bólu nie ma zysku.

entries.en: Sorry, but that's not enough leather yet to make one of these backpacks. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?
entries.translated: Przykro mi, ale to wciąż za mało skóry, żeby zrobić jeden z tych plecaków. Może wolisz kupić zwykły plecak za 10 sztuk złota?

entries.en: Greetings, traveller. Maybe you'd like to take a look at my {offers}...
entries.translated: Pozdrowienia, podróżniku. Może chcesz rzucić okiem na moje {offers}...

entries.en: Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!
So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: You can receive an exercise weapon using command !reward
entries.translated: Puedes recibir un arma de ejercicio usando el comando !reward

entries.en: Your contract with your horse expired and it returned back to the horse station.
entries.translated: Tu contrato con tu caballo expiró y regresó a la estación de caballos.

entries.en: This table is made of several old doors. One of them has a noticeable ornate lock. Perhaps you could lever it out with a tool.
entries.translated: Esta mesa está hecha de varias puertas viejas. Una de ellas tiene una cerradura ornamentada notable. Quizás podrías sacarla con una herramienta.

entries.en: You already removed the old lock.
You dug a hole! Walk onto it as long as it is open to jump down into the forest cave.
entries.translated: ¡Cavaste un agujero! Camina sobre él mientras esté abierto para saltar hacia abajo a la cueva del bosque.

entries.en: You found a piece of the scroll. You pocket it quickly.
entries.translated: Encontraste un trozo del pergamino. Lo guardas rápidamente.

entries.en: A torn scroll piece emerges. Probably gnawed off by rats.
entries.translated: Aparece un trozo de pergamino roto. Probablemente roído por ratas.

entries.en: This table is made of several old doors. One of them has a noticeable ornate lock. Perhaps you could lever it out with a tool.
entries.translated: Esta mesa está hecha de varias puertas viejas. Una de ellas tiene una cerradura ornamentada notable. Quizás podrías sacarla con una herramienta.

entries.en: You already removed the old lock.
You can't remove this pile since it's currently holding up the tunnel.
entries.translated: No puedes retirar esta pila ya que actualmente sostiene el túnel.

entries.en: Crushing the stone produces some fine gravel.
entries.translated: Triturar la piedra produce algo de grava fina.

entries.en: Crushing the stone yields nothing but slightly finer, yet still unusable rubber.
entries.translated: Triturar la piedra no produce más que caucho ligeramente más fino, pero aún inutilizable.

entries.en: You must wear an underwater exploration helmet in order to dive.
entries.translated: Debes llevar un casco de exploración submarina para bucear.

entries.en: Welcome to Dawnport! Walk around and explore on your own, or talk to Inigo if you need directions.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido a Dawnport! Pasea y explora por tu cuenta, o habla con Inigo si necesitas indicaciones.

entries.en: To walk on STAIRS, use your arrow keys on your keyboard. You can also use them to walk in general.
entries.translated: Para subir ESCALERAS, usa las teclas de dirección de tu teclado. También puedes usarlas para caminar en general.

entries.en: One day I'll go and look.
Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
entries.translated: Appartiene alla famiglia degli elfi o qualcosa del genere. Io non capisco i piccoli e i loro affari.

entries.en: Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
entries.translated: Appartiene alla famiglia degli elfi o qualcosa del genere. Io non capisco i piccoli e i loro affari.

entries.en: I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
entries.translated: Ho chiamato Bencthyclthrtrprr dalla mia gente. Quelli piccoli che io chiamo Big Ben.

entries.en: You shut up. Me not want to hear.
Do lil' one want to trade a fire sword?
entries.translated: Il piccolo vuole scambiare una spada di fuoco?

entries.en: Do lil' one want to trade a dragon shield?
entries.translated: Il piccolo vuole scambiare uno scudo di drago?

entries.en: Do lil' one want to trade a sword of valor?
entries.translated: Il piccolo vuole scambiare una spada del valore?

entries.en: Do lil' one want to trade a warlord sword?
entries.translated: Il piccolo vuole scambiare la spada di un signore della guerra?

entries.en: They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
entries.translated: Erano amici dei miei genitori. Molto prima che gli elfi venissero qui, spesso facevano visita. Non vieni più qui.

entries.en: Me not fight them, they not fight me.
entries.translated: Io non li combatto, loro non combattono contro di me.
Lavorare l'acciaio è la mia professione.

entries.en: Most ancients use dream silver for different stuff. Now ancients most gone. Most not know about.
entries.translated: La maggior parte degli antichi usa l'argento dei sogni per cose diverse. Ora gli antichi sono quasi scomparsi. La maggior parte non lo sa.

entries.en: It's high steel called. Only lil' lil' ones know how make.
entries.translated: Si chiama High Steel. Solo i più piccoli sanno come si fa.

entries.en: It's evil. Demon iron is. No good cyclops goes where you can find and need evil flame to melt.
entries.translated: È malvagio. Il ferro demoniaco lo è. Nessun ciclope buono va dove puoi trovare e ha bisogno che la fiamma malvagia si sciolga.

entries.en: Steel that is singing when forged. No one knows where find today.
entries.translated: Acciaio che canta quando forgiato. Nessuno sa dove trovarlo oggi.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.translated: Ține minte: dacă ești grav rănit sau otrăvit, te pot vindeca gratuit.

entries.en: Great. Here you are. Form 411. Come back anytime you want to talk. Bye.
entries.translated: Mare. Poftim. Formularul 411. Reveniți oricând doriți să vorbiți. la revedere.

entries.en: Now where did I put that form?
entries.translated: Acum unde am pus formularul acela?

entries.en: Sure, you can get it from me. Here you are. Bye
entries.translated: Sigur, o poți obține de la mine. Poftim. la revedere

entries.en: Now where did I put that form?
entries.translated: Acum unde am pus formularul acela?

entries.en: I was a {}, too, before I died!! What do you want from me?
entries.translated: Am fost și eu un {}, înainte de a muri!! Ce vrei de la mine?

entries.en: That's right, you can get Form 145 from me. However, I need Form 411 first. Come back when you have it.
entries.translated: Așa e, poți obține formularul 145 de la mine. Totuși, am nevoie de formularul 411 mai întâi. Întoarce-te când o ai.

entries.en: Well done! You have form 411!! Here is Form 145. Have fun with it.
entries.translated: Bine făcut! Ai formularul 411!! Iată Formularul 145. Distrează-te cu el.

o replică a servitorului de fier

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Till din tjänst, bläddra bara igenom mina varor.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Välkommen, unga |PLAYERNAME|! Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag {heal} dig gratis.

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
entries.translated: Kom ihåg: Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag bota dig gratis.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

reductor de habilidades del rastreador de magma
reductor de habilidades para dormir con fiebre
ola de golem de montón de óxido

entries.en: You can not use this teleport yet.
entries.translated: Nie możesz jeszcze użyć tego teleportu.

entries.en: You cannot enter without Halvar's permission.
entries.translated: Nie możesz wejść bez zgody Halvara.

entries.en: You need at least level 250 to enter.
entries.translated: Potrzebujesz co najmniej 250 poziomu, aby wejść.

entries.en: You offerings to this sanguine master of this realm have been insufficient. You can not pass.
entries.translated: Twoje ofiary dla sanguine mastera tej krainy były niewystarczające. Nie możesz przejść.

entries.en: You see the scattered parts of a wrecked ship. Miraculously the ship telescope survived the wreckm it seems still to be intact.
entries.translated: Widzisz porozrzucane części rozbitego statku. Cudem okrętowy teleskop przetrwał wrak i wygląda na nienaruszony.

entries.en: You see the scattered parts of a wrecked ship. Miraculously the ship telescope survived the wreck it seems still to be intact.
entries.translated: Widzisz porozrzucane części rozbitego statku. Cudem okrętowy teleskop przetrwał wrak i wygląda na nienaruszony.

entries.en: Witout any points of orientation you will never find your way back. Try to find a way to improve your navigation.
entries.translated: Bez punktów orientacyjnych nigdy nie znajdziesz drogi powrotnej. Spróbuj znaleźć sposób na poprawę nawigacji.

entries.en: Go to another Teleport or take mission with Zizzle.
entries.translated: Idź do innego teleportu albo weź misję od Zizzle.

entries.en: You enter the realm of Calassa.
You not have permission to use this teleport!
entries.translated: Nie masz uprawnień, aby użyć tego teleportu!

entries.en: You have found a lovely oasis with green fauna and juicy fruit. You didn't expect that.
entries.translated: Znalazłeś urokliwą oazę z zieloną roślinnością i soczystymi owocami. Tego się nie spodziewałeś.

entries.en: You should hurry, try not to dwell here any longer than a few minutes.
entries.translated: Powinieneś się pospieszyć, postaraj się nie zostawać tu dłużej niż kilka minut.

entries.en: You took too long, the battle has ended.
entries.translated: Zajęło ci to zbyt długo, walka się zakończyła.

entries.en: You have discovered an old writing desk that contains an ancient map.
entries.translated: Odkryłeś stare biurko, które zawiera starożytną mapę.

entries.en: With you being the vessel binding the power of whitered souls, you step through the magic barrier.
entries.translated: Jako naczynie wiążące moc zwiędłych dusz przechodzisz przez magiczną barierę.

entries.en: The combined powers of decaying souls roaming these halls may help breach this barrier, it needs but a vessel to bind them.
entries.translated: Połączone moce gnijących dusz krążących po tych korytarzach mogą pomóc przełamać tę barierę, potrzebują jedynie naczynia, które je zwiąże.

entries.en: As you cross the threshold in to the inner sanctuary of the cult of the Misguided, you feel an eerie presence all around you.
entries.translated: Gdy przekraczasz próg wewnętrznego sanktuarium kultu Misguided, czujesz wokół siebie upiorną obecność.

entries.en: You have gained your new outfit and may leave the reward room now!
entries.translated: Hai ottenuto il tuo nuovo vestito e ora puoi lasciare la stanza delle ricompense!

entries.en: You already taken the outfit, ask about mission for Chrak.
entries.translated: Hai già preso l'abito, chiedi della missione di Chrak.

entries.en: You are placing the book on the table, hopefully the poachers will discover it soon.
entries.translated: Stai mettendo il libro sul tavolo, speriamo che i bracconieri lo scoprano presto.

entries.en: You have found notes of a poacher.
entries.translated: Hai trovato appunti di un bracconiere.

entries.en: You place the whelp fur in the stone's mouth and thus lay it to rest.
entries.translated: Metti la pelliccia del cucciolo nella bocca della pietra e così la metti a riposare.

entries.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
entries.translated: Cos'è questo? Un'entità con problemi di vista chiamata |PLAYERNAME|. Che fascino!

entries.en: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Aspetta proprio lì. Ti mangerò dopo aver scritto quello che ho scoperto.

entries.en: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
entries.translated: Aspetta proprio lì. Ti mangerò dopo aver scritto quello che ho scoperto.

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Sii compianto pellegrino in carne ed ossa. Vendo beni generali. Chiedimi solo un {trade}.

entries.en: You back. You know, you right. Brother is right. Fist not always good. Tell him that!
entries.translated: Sei tornato. Lo sai, hai ragione. Il fratello ha ragione. Il pugno non è sempre buono. Diglielo!

entries.en: Take a look in the trade window to your left.
entries.translated: Dai un'occhiata alla finestra degli scambi alla tua sinistra.

entries.en: Greetings, pilgrim. Welcome to the halls of hope. We are the keepers of this {temple} and welcome everyone willing to contribute.
entries.translated: Saluti, pellegrino. Benvenuti nelle sale della speranza. Siamo i custodi di questo {temple} e diamo il benvenuto a chiunque voglia contribuire.

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Al tuo servizio, sfoglia i miei prodotti.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at
entries.translated: Naturalmente, basta sfogliare la mia merce. Oppure vuoi solo guardare

entries.translated: Benvenuto, giovane |PLAYERNAME|! Se sei gravemente ferito o avvelenato, posso {heal} gratis.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: There was an error while processing your action. Please try reopening the prey window.
entries.translated: При обработке вашего действия произошла ошибка. Пожалуйста, попробуйте снова открыть окно добычи.

entries.en: This creature is already selected on another slot.
entries.translated: Это существо уже выбрано в другом слоте.

entries.en: You don't have any active monster on this prey slot.
entries.translated: У вас нет активных монстров в этом слоте добычи.

entries.en: You already have an active monster on this prey slot.
entries.translated: У вас уже есть активный монстр в этом слоте добычи.

entries.en: I am not here to fight you, fool. Like it or not, we will have to work together to stop the catastrophe you and that priest have initiated.
entries.translated: Nu sunt aici să mă lupt cu tine, prostule. Ne place sau nu, va trebui să lucrăm împreună pentru a opri catastrofa pe care dumneavoastră și acel preot ați inițiat-o.

entries.en: Greetings, mortal. Be aware that you are trying my patience while we are talking.
entries.translated: Salutări, muritor. Fii conștient că îmi încerci răbdarea în timp ce vorbim.

entries.en: LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
entries.translated: Bine ați venit în umilul meu sălaș. Dacă vii pentru noul vrăjitor {spells}, ai ajuns în locul potrivit.

entries.en: May God show you the path, |PLAYERNAME|.
Of course, just browse through my offers.
It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}
entries.translated: E bine să te văd. Sunt mereu la {shop options} dvs.

entries.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: La revedere, |PLAYERNAME|, voi fi aici dacă mai ai nevoie de mine.

entries.en: Do you bring freshly killed rats for a bounty of 1 gold each? By the way, I also buy orc teeth and other stuff you ripped from their bloody corp... I mean... well, you know what I mean.
entries.translated: Aduci șobolani proaspăt uciși pentru o recompensă de 1 aur fiecare? Apropo, cumpăr și dinți de orc și alte chestii pe care le-ai smuls din trupul lor sângeros... Adică... ei bine, știi ce vreau să spun.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares.
Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Buna ziua. Cum te pot ajuta |PLAYERNAME|? Cere-mi un {trade} dacă vrei să cumperi ceva. Pot explica și sistemul {mail}.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you.
entries.translated: A fost o plăcere să vă ajut.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Oh, te rog intră, |PLAYERNAME|. Cu ce ​​vă pot ajuta? Dacă aveți nevoie de echipament de aventură, cereți-mi un {trade}.

entries.en: You need to wait 20 hours to face this boss again.
entries.translated: Devi aspettare 20 ore per affrontare di nuovo questo boss.

entries.en: Even though many djinns had lost their lives during the fateful battle of Ankrahmun, the war was still undecided. Malor had lost many of his bravest warriors, but so had Gabel, and they both knew that another epic battle like that would bring the whole djinn race to the brink of destruction. In his desperation, Gabel turned to his trusted friend Fa'Hradin for advice. The old djinn suggested using a trick to eliminate Malor. Without their leader, he reasoned, the Efreet would end the rebellion. Gabel, who wanted to avoid further bloodshed, agreed. And so it came to pass that the magic lamp was created and, by means that are unknown to this very day, secretly placed in Malor's private chamber. The mighty Efreet never had a chance. When he went to sleep in what he thought was his private lamp he was trapped inside the lamp, which was soon enough smuggled out of Mal'Ouquah, the Efreets' fortress, and brought back to the Marid. Fa'hradin's trick had worked - Malor was Gabel's prisoner.
entries.translated: Mimo że wielu dżinów straciło życie podczas pamiętnej bitwy pod Ankrahmun, wojna wciąż nie została rozstrzygnięta. Malor stracił wielu ze swoich najodważniejszych wojowników, ale Gabel także i obaj wiedzieli, że kolejna taka epicka bitwa doprowadzi całą rasę dżinów na skraj zagłady. W swojej desperacji Gabel zwrócił się o radę do swojego zaufanego przyjaciela Fa'Hradina. Stary dżinn zasugerował zastosowanie podstępu w celu wyeliminowania Malora. Rozumował, że bez przywódcy Efreetowie położą kres buntowi. Gabel, który chciał uniknąć dalszego rozlewu krwi, zgodził się. I tak doszło do stworzenia magicznej lampy, która w nieznany do dziś sposób została potajemnie umieszczona w prywatnej komnacie Malora. Potężny Efreet nigdy nie miał szans. Kiedy kładł się spać w czymś, co uważał za swoją prywatną lampę, został uwięziony w lampie, która wkrótce została przemycona z Mal'Ouquah, fortecy Efreetów, i przywieziona z powrotem do Maridu. Sztuczka Fa'hradina zadziałała – Malor był więźniem Gabela.

entries.en: Eventually Gabel stepped forward to meet his opponent. This was the moment Malor, who had never intended to fight honourably, had been waiting for. All of a sudden the earth opened in a thousand places, and hordes of vicious undead attacked the Gabel and his army. For Malor had secretly formed an alliance with the dreaded necromancers of Drefia and it was them who controlled the undead hordes that fought for him. Faced with an overwhelming enemy, Gabel and his army turned to flee.
entries.translated: W końcu Gabel wystąpił naprzód, by spotkać się ze swoim przeciwnikiem. To był moment, na który czekał Malor, który nigdy nie miał zamiaru walczyć honorowo. Nagle ziemia otworzyła się w tysiącu miejsc, a hordy okrutnych nieumarłych zaatakowały Gabela i jego armię. Ponieważ Malor potajemnie zawarł sojusz z przerażającymi nekromantami z Drefia i to oni kontrolowali hordy nieumarłych, które walczyły dla niego. W obliczu przeważającego wroga Gabel i jego armia rzucili się do ucieczki.

entries.en: Eventually they started exposing undead bodies to evil energies and merging them with living beings into massive undead monstrosities, which, however, withered and died almost as soon as they were created. After some experiments that failed in an particularly spectacular manner, the bone lords were forced to abandon their experiments. Soon, their gruesome experiments faded from memory. They had been all but forgotten when a number of braindeath emerged in a remote beholder city, claiming to have achieved a decisive breakthrough in the field of necromancy. The high council of the beholder elders reluctantly sent a number of scientists down to the laboratories to examine the results. The undead creatures they found were so hideous and degenerated that the scientists flatly declared that these experiments that led their creation contradicted the very principles of beholderkin. All undead were to be destroyed and the experiments were to be abolished once and for all.
entries.translated: W końcu zaczęli wystawiać nieumarłe ciała na działanie złych energii i łączyć je z żywymi istotami, tworząc ogromne nieumarłe potwory, które jednak więdły i umierały niemal natychmiast po ich stworzeniu. Po kilku eksperymentach, które zakończyły się szczególnie spektakularnym niepowodzeniem, kościani władcy zostali zmuszeni do porzucenia swoich eksperymentów. Wkrótce ich makabryczne eksperymenty zatarły się w pamięci. Zostały prawie zapomniane, gdy w odległym mieście-beakerach pojawiło się wiele śmierci mózgowych, twierdzących, że osiągnęli decydujący przełom w dziedzinie nekromancji. Wysoka rada starszych obserwatorów niechętnie wysłała grupę naukowców do laboratoriów, aby zbadali wyniki. Znalezione przez nich nieumarłe stworzenia były tak ohydne i zdegenerowane, że naukowcy stanowczo oświadczyli, że eksperymenty, które doprowadziły do ​​ich stworzenia, są sprzeczne z samymi zasadami beholderkina. Wszyscy nieumarli mieli zostać zniszczeni, a eksperymenty miały zostać zniesione raz na zawsze.

entries.en: Every child knows the sad fate of the Kha'labal. Once it was brimming with life, a verdant paradise filled with lush forests and countless freshwater springs. The gods created this paradise and gave it to their newly-made race, the humans, as a present. Protected on all sides by the sea or by insurpassable mountains, the Kha'labal was the perfect environment for the young, vulnerable race to flourish. And flourish and thrive it did. Guided by their leader Banor and endowed with amazing technical skills and knowledge by their creators, the humans managed to settle the whole Kha'labal within few generations, and beautiful buildings rose to the sky, the mightiest of which were to be found in the majestic city of Ankrahmun. These early humans, who today are called the Founders, were a friendly race who lived in peace and harmony with each other, ignorant of the horrors lurking in the outside world. And the gods, who watched them from their thrones in the Kha'zeel, smiled on them.
entries.translated: Każde dziecko zna smutny los Kha'labala. Niegdyś tętnił życiem, zielony raj pełen bujnych lasów i niezliczonych źródeł słodkowodnych. Bogowie stworzyli ten raj i podarowali go nowo powstałej rasie, ludziom, w prezencie. Chroniony ze wszystkich stron przez morze lub niezrównane góry, Kha'labal był idealnym środowiskiem dla rozwoju młodej, bezbronnej rasy. I kwitł i prosperował, tak się stało. Prowadzeni przez swojego przywódcę Banora i wyposażeni w niesamowite umiejętności techniczne i wiedzę swoich twórców, ludziom udało się zasiedlić cały Kha'labal w ciągu kilku pokoleń, a w niebo wzniosły się piękne budynki, z których najpotężniejszy znajdował się w majestatycznym mieście Ankrahmun. Ci pierwsi ludzie, dziś nazywani Założycielami, byli przyjazną rasą, która żyła ze sobą w pokoju i harmonii, nieświadomi okropności czających się w świecie zewnętrznym. A bogowie, którzy obserwowali ich ze swoich tronów w Kha'zeel, uśmiechali się do nich.

entries.en: Example how to talk with the npc:

exchange for certain services that have not been further elaborated on in the court's documents. The foreigner was found guilty without trial and sentenced to three years of work in the salt mines. The footsoldier Kamahl claimed his father Indril was guilty of witchcraft. Several obscure texts were found beneath the accused person's bed. Indril was banished from the city and his property was equally divided between the pharaoh and his heirs. The foreigner Todd Ballory was pronounced guilty of killing the overseer Barnak, a father of sixteen children and a respectable member of the local whipcrackers' association. The aforementioned convict was sentenced to a rather spectacular final appearance in the local arena.
entries.translated: zamian za określone usługi, które nie zostały szerzej omówione w dokumentach sądu. Cudzoziemiec został uznany za winnego bez procesu i skazany na trzy lata pracy w kopalni soli. Piechur Kamahl twierdził, że jego ojciec Indril był winny czarów. Pod łóżkiem oskarżonego znaleziono kilka niejasnych tekstów. Indril został wygnany z miasta, a jego majątek został równo podzielony pomiędzy faraona i jego spadkobierców. Cudzoziemiec Todd Ballory został uznany za winnego zabicia nadzorcy Barnaka, ojca szesnaściorga dzieci i szanowanego członka lokalnego stowarzyszenia biczowników. Wspomniany skazaniec został skazany na dość spektakularny finałowy występ na lokalnej arenie.

entries.en: It consists of four parts wich have been scratched out of this book. They need to be read in conjunction with chants.
entries.translated: Si compone di quattro parti che sono state cancellate da questo libro. Devono essere letti insieme ai canti.

entries.en: You have to wait to challange this enemy again!
entries.translated: Devi aspettare per sfidare nuovamente questo nemico!

entries.en: You have found a crumpled paper.
entries.translated: Hai trovato un foglio di carta stropicciato.

entries.en: You need to equip the boot to try use it.
entries.translated: Devi equipaggiare il bagagliaio per provare a usarlo.

entries.en: Magical sparks whirl around the boots and suddenly you are somewhere else.
entries.translated: Scintille magiche vorticano intorno agli stivali e all'improvviso sei altrove.

entries.en: If you want to wear this boots you need to stay in a protection zone.
entries.translated: Se vuoi indossare questi stivali devi rimanere in una zona di protezione.

entries.en: You are tired of the last use of the boots, you must wait for one hour to use it again.
entries.translated: Sei stanco dell'ultimo utilizzo degli stivali, devi attendere un'ora per riutilizzarli.

entries.en: Timira the Many-Headed has been defeated. You have {} seconds to leave the room.
entries.translated: Timira la dalle molte teste è stata sconfitta. Hai {} secondi per lasciare la stanza.

entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.translated: Недостаточно места. Вы не смогли получить ни одного предмета.

entries.translated: Недостаточно места. Не удалось получить все элементы.

entries.translated: При обработке вашего действия произошла ошибка. Попробуйте снова открыть окно задач.

entries.en: You already have an active monster on this task hunting slot.
entries.translated: У вас уже есть активный монстр в этом слоте для охоты.

entries.en: You don't have enough prey cards to reroll your task reward rarity.
entries.translated: У вас недостаточно карт добычи, чтобы изменить редкость награды за задание.

entries.en: You don't have enough prey cards to choose a creature from the list for this task hunting slot.
entries.translated: У вас недостаточно карт добычи, чтобы выбрать существо из списка для этого слота охоты.

entries.en: You cannot claim your task reward with an empty task hunting slot.
entries.translated: Вы не можете получить награду за задание, имея пустой слот для поиска заданий.

entries.en: You don't have enough money to cancel your current task hunting.
entries.translated: У вас недостаточно денег, чтобы отменить текущий поиск задач.

entries.en: You don't have enough money to reroll the task hunting slot.
entries.translated: У вас недостаточно денег, чтобы перезапустить слот поиска заданий.

entries.en: Congratulations! You have earned {0} Hunting Task points, including a 100% bonus.
entries.translated: Поздравляем! Вы заработали {0} очков охотничьих заданий, включая 100% бонус.

entries.en: Congratulations! You have earned {0} Hunting Task points, including a 50% bonus.
entries.translated: Поздравляем! Вы заработали {0} очков охотничьих заданий, включая бонус 50%.

entries.en: Congratulations! You have earned {0} Hunting Task points.
entries.translated: Поздравляем! Вы заработали {0} очков охотничьих заданий.

entries.en: There was an error while processing your task hunting reward. Please try reopening the window.
entries.translated: Произошла ошибка при обработке награды за охоту за заданиями. Пожалуйста, попробуйте снова открыть окно.

entries.en: To unlock this task hunting slot you must buy it in the store first.
entries.translated: Чтобы разблокировать этот слот для поиска заданий, вы должны сначала купить его в магазине.
Frate! Am nevoie de ajutorul tău!

entries.en: My turn! Let me show you my skills!
entries.translated: Randul meu! Lasă-mă să-ți arăt abilitățile mele!

entries.en: I'll step back now. Let's see how you handle my brother!
entries.translated: Mă voi întoarce acum. Să vedem cum te descurci pe fratele meu!

entries.en: Oh, man! You always get the fun!
Indeed! It has been a while! As the elder one I request the right of the first battle!
entries.translated: Într-adevăr! A trecut ceva timp! Ca cel mai mare cer dreptul la prima bătălie!

entries.en: Ah look my Brother! Challengers! After all this time finally a chance to prove our skills!
entries.translated: Ah uite fratele meu! Challengers! După tot acest timp, în sfârșit, o șansă de a ne demonstra abilitățile!

entries.en: You see water as far as the eye can reach. No sea serpent in sight.
entries.translated: Vedeți apă cât de departe poate ajunge cu ochii. Niciun șarpe de mare la vedere.

entries.en: It's getting away! You should tell the captain to gain speed!
entries.translated: Se scapă! Ar trebui să-i spui căpitanului să câștige viteză!

entries.en: There are multiple shadows under the surface. This has to be the right location.
entries.translated: Există mai multe umbre sub suprafață. Aceasta trebuie să fie locația potrivită.

entries.en: You find a golden symbol at the bottom of the blood-filled basin.
entries.translated: Găsești un simbol auriu în fundul bazinului plin de sânge.

entries.en: Beauty has to be rewarded! Muahahaha!
The cave parrot may be tough but he somehow couldn't resist this particular birdcage. Or maybe it was you...
entries.translated: Papagalul din peșteră poate fi dur, dar cumva nu a putut rezista acestei cușcă specială. Sau poate ai fost tu...

entries.en: You open the cage and let the cave parrot roam free!
entries.translated: Deschideți cușca și lăsați papagalul din peșteră să se plimbe liber!

entries.en: Amidst the pile of various bones you find  large, hollow part, similar to a pipe.
entries.translated: Printre grămada de diverse oase găsiți o parte mare, goală, asemănătoare unei țevi.

entries.en: You ransack the pile but fail to find any useful parts.
entries.translated: Răscoliți grămada, dar nu reușiți să găsiți piese utile.

entries.en: This one's still unwilling reveal whether it's your spirit animal.
entries.translated: Acesta încă nu vrea să dezvăluie dacă este animalul tău spiritual.

entries.en: This one has shaken its head. This probably means it's not your spirit animal.
entries.translated: Acesta și-a clătinat din cap. Asta înseamnă probabil că nu este animalul tău spiritual.

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: You joined the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. Ask Grizzly Adams for some hunting tasks. You already gained %d points. You currently have %d boss points.
entries.translated: Вы присоединились к '__PH0__'. Попросите Гризли Адамса выполнить несколько охотничьих заданий. Вы уже набрали %d баллов. На данный момент у вас есть %d очков босса.
Вы успешно охотились на 200 каменных големов.

entries.en: Greetings. I have only little time to {spare}, so the conversation will be short. I teach sorcerer {spells} and buy a few magical {ingredients}.
entries.translated: Pozdrowienia. Mam mało czasu do {spare}, więc rozmowa będzie krótka. Uczę czarodziei {spells} i kupuję trochę magicznych {ingredients}.

entries.en: I hope you have a good reason to step near my {ship}, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Mam nadzieję, że masz dobry powód, by zbliżać się do mojego {ship}, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Good bye and come again for another small talk! *waves*
entries.translated: Do widzenia i wpadaj znów na krótką pogawędkę! *macha*

entries.en: Ahhh, welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Say, have you already heard the latest news about the {seamonster}, {Aneus}, or the {rumours} in this area?
entries.translated: Ach, witaj |PLAYERNAME|! Powiedz, czy słyszałeś już najnowsze wiadomości o {seamonster}, {Aneus} lub {rumours} w tym obszarze?

entries.en: Ah, you come just in time for the special voting about the most recent {funding} project. I guess you want to participate in it.
entries.translated: Ach, przychodzisz akurat na specjalne głosowanie dotyczące najnowszego projektu {funding}. Domyślam się, że chcesz wziąć w nim udział.

entries.en: Greetings, dear visitor. Please tell me what {brings} you here, to my humble adobe.
entries.translated: Pozdrowienia, drogi gościu. Powiedz proszę, co cię tu {brings}, do mojego skromnego domu.

entries.en: Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. If you are looking for potions, seek no further.
entries.translated: Niech żałoba ci towarzyszy, |PLAYERNAME|, pielgrzymie w ciele. Jeśli szukasz mikstur, nie musisz szukać dalej.

entries.en: Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.
entries.translated: Żegnaj, nieznajomy. Niech mądry Uman prowadzi twoje kroki po tej zdradliwej krainie.

entries.en: Just great, another disturbance. Just what I need.
entries.translated: Po prostu świetnie, kolejne zakłócenie. Tego właśnie mi trzeba.

entries.en: Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. Have a look at my fine {weapons} and {armors}.
entries.translated: Niech żałoba ci towarzyszy, |PLAYERNAME|, pielgrzymie w ciele. Rzuć okiem na moją wspaniałą {weapons} i {armors}.
