entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
EVEN WITH ALL THAT TIME IN THE PRISON THAT WEAKENED ME, YOU ARE NO MATCH TO ME!
entries.translated: AUN CON TODO ESE TIEMPO EN LA PRISIÓN QUE ME DEBILITÓ, ¡NO ERES COMPATIBLE PARA MÍ!

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Al tuo servizio, sfoglia i miei prodotti.

entries.translated: Benvenuto, giovane |PLAYERNAME|! Se sei gravemente ferito o avvelenato, posso {heal} gratis.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: It contains a lot of wine flasks.
entries.translated: Conține o mulțime de baloane de vin.

entries.en: This simple hat might be more worth than what it looks like
entries.translated: Această pălărie simplă ar putea valora mai mult decât arată

entries.en: I see colours, all colours! Or are these just illusions?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.

entries.translated: Hälsningar, vågade äventyrare. Om du behöver en {passage}, låt mig veta.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Välkommen, unga |PLAYERNAME|! Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag {heal} dig gratis.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!
naładowany energią, wściekły mag, reduktor umiejętności
reductor de habilidades del torturador oscuro

entries.en: You traverse the rubble with ease but more of it falls down behind you, essentially blocking your path once again.
entries.translated: Z łatwością pokonujesz gruz, ale jego większa część spada za tobą, ponownie blokując ci drogę.

entries.en: You put the minotaur skull into the coffin within the minotaur skeleton. One of the door's locks clicks.
entries.translated: Wkładasz czaszkę minotaura do trumny w szkielecie minotaura. Jeden z zamków drzwi klika.

entries.en: You put the orc skull into the coffin within the orc skeleton. One of the door's locks clicks.
entries.translated: Wkładasz czaszkę orka do trumny w szkielecie orka. Jeden z zamków drzwi klika.

entries.en: This statue has a word written on her hand: 'N'ogalu'.
entries.translated: Ta statua ma na dłoni wypisane słowo: 'N'ogalu”.

entries.en: You charge the summer ward stone and the engraved sun crystal glows in a golden light.
entries.translated: Ładujesz letni kamień ochronny, a wygrawerowany kryształ słońca świeci złotym światłem.

entries.en: You charge the winter ward stone and the engraved ice crystal glows in a blue light.
entries.translated: Ładujesz zimowy kamień ochronny, a wygrawerowany kryształ lodu świeci niebieskim światłem.

entries.en: You have already obtained this addon!
You have already used this lever!
You need to offer a small diamond.
You cannot use this lever again.
entries.translated: Nie możesz ponownie użyć tej dźwigni.

entries.en: You have found a bag, but you have no room to take it.
entries.translated: Znalazłeś torbę, ale nie masz miejsca, aby ją zabrać.

entries.en: You enter the circle of trees and flowers. By visiting this sacred site you're infused with the power of nature and plants.
entries.translated: Wchodzisz w krąg drzew i kwiatów. Odwiedzając to święte miejsce, zostajesz nasycony mocą natury i roślin.

entries.en: You enter the beautiful oasis. By visiting this sacred site you're infused with the power of water bringing life to the desert.
entries.translated: Wchodzisz do pięknej oazy. Odwiedzając to święte miejsce, zostajesz napełniony mocą wody ożywiającej pustynię.

entries.en: You entered the suntower of Ab'dendriel. By visiting this sacred site you're infused with the power of the life-giving sun.
entries.translated: Wszedłeś do słonecznej wieży Ab'dendriela. Odwiedzając to święte miejsce, zostajesz napełniony mocą życiodajnego słońca.

entries.en: 5 diamond entities are consuming too much raw energy for the cosmic chamber to awaken, it will be put to rest again in 10 minutes.
entries.translated: 5 diamentowych bytów zużywa zbyt dużo surowej energii, aby kosmiczna komora mogła się obudzić. Za 10 minut zostanie ona ponownie uśpiona.

entries.en: 5 golden entities are consuming too much raw energy for the cosmic chamber to awaken, it will be put to rest again in 10 minutes.
entries.translated: 5 złotych istot zużywa zbyt dużo surowej energii, aby kosmiczna komnata mogła się obudzić. Za 10 minut zostanie ona ponownie zatrzymana.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: The cold has all but disappeared from your body and you're getting warmer. You need to renew all preparations for purification.
entries.translated: Zimno niemal całkowicie ustąpiło z twojego ciała i robi ci się cieplej. Musisz odnowić wszystkie przygotowania do oczyszczenia.

entries.en: This teleport is only available between January 14 and February 12.
entries.translated: Ten teleport jest dostępny tylko między 14 stycznia a 12 lutego.

entries.en: Offer the lives of the yet unborn to the lizard god if you want to enter the sanctuary.
entries.translated: Złóż życia jeszcze nienarodzonych w ofierze jaszczurzemu bogu, jeśli chcesz wejść do sanktuarium.

entries.en: You have to pass the Lion's Tests to enter the inner sanctum!
entries.translated: Musisz przejść Lwie Próby, aby wejść do wewnętrznego sanktuarium!

entries.en: As you pass incautiously, the ancient amphora crumbles to shards and dust. Amidst the debris you discover an old scroll.
entries.translated: Gdy przechodzisz nieostrożnie, starożytna amfora rozpada się na odłamki i pył. Wśród szczątków odkrywasz stary zwój.

entries.en: You enter a temple area which is gorgeously decorated and mysteriously unaffected by the course of time.
entries.translated: Wchodzisz do obszaru świątynnego, który jest wspaniale ozdobiony i tajemniczo nietknięty przez upływ czasu.

entries.en: Due to the strength of an orc you are able to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Dzięki sile orka możesz przejść przez tę szczelinę.

entries.en: You need the strength of an orc to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Potrzebujesz siły orka, aby przejść przez tę szczelinę.

entries.en: With the help off the might of an orc warlod you are able to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Dzięki mocy orczego warlorda możesz przejść przez tę szczelinę.

entries.en: You need the might of an orc warlod to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Potrzebujesz mocy orczego warlorda, aby przejść przez tę szczelinę.

entries.en: With the help of the wisdom of an orc shaman you are able to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Dzięki mądrości orczego szamana możesz przejść przez tę szczelinę.

entries.en: You need the wisdom of an orc shaman to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Potrzebujesz mądrości orczego szamana, aby przejść przez tę szczelinę.

entries.en: You need to break all 4 large amphoras to use this teleporter.
entries.translated: Musisz rozbić wszystkie 4 duże amfory, aby użyć tego teleportera.

entries.en: A strange ritual has taken place here. Report about it to the Gloot Brothers.
entries.translated: Miał tu miejsce dziwny rytuał. Zgłoś to Braciom Gloot.

entries.en: The necrometer reveals a hidden passage!
You cannot pass here outside the period from April 1st to May 1st.
entries.translated: Nie możesz tędy przejść poza okresem od 1 kwietnia do 1 maja.

entries.en: To enter Pumin's domain you must gain permission from the bureaucrats.
entries.translated: Aby wejść do domeny Pumina, musisz uzyskać zgodę biurokratów.

entries.en: With the power of the dark Custodian still holding away, the fog is keeping you from entering Quaid's den.
entries.translated: Dopóki działa moc mrocznego Custodiana, mgła nie pozwala ci wejść do legowiska Quaida.

entries.en: In this cave there is a rope. It once belonged to a wanderer who was stuck. Only take it if you're stuck as well.
entries.translated: W tej jaskini jest lina. Należała kiedyś do wędrowca, który utknął. Weź ją tylko wtedy, gdy sam utkniesz.
Modo de autoloot establecido a TODO.

No non-negative KV entries found for {}.
entries.translated: No se encontraron entradas KV no negativas para {}.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: There was an error while processing your action. Please try reopening the task window.
entries.translated: При обработке вашего действия произошла ошибка. Попробуйте снова открыть окно задач.

entries.en: You already have an active monster on this task hunting slot.
entries.translated: У вас уже есть активный монстр в этом слоте для охоты.

entries.en: You cannot claim your task reward with an empty task hunting slot.
entries.translated: Вы не можете получить награду за задание, имея пустой слот для поиска заданий.

entries.en: Greetings adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
entries.translated: Приветствую искателя приключений |PLAYERNAME|. Что привело тебя ко мне?

entries.en: Good bye and take care of you!
The gods must be praised that I am finally saved. I do not have many worldly possessions, but please accept a small reward, do you?
entries.translated: Надо хвалить богов за то, что я наконец спасся. У меня не так много мирских благ, но, пожалуйста, примите небольшую награду, а вы?

entries.en: Thanks for saving my life! Should I teleport you out of the Dark Cathedral?
entries.translated: Спасибо, что спасли мне жизнь! Мне телепортировать тебя из Темного Собора?

entries.en: For a long time Malor had plotted and schemed in secrecy, using promises and threats to recruit followers and to form alliances. Many djinn refused to betray Gabel, but the majority of the strongest djinn warriors rallied to his cause, and since Malor had been plotting his insurrection for a long time the rebels were well-prepared. When Malor finally gave the signal his minions attacked the palace in full force, planning to kill Gabel swiftly. Their attack was deadly effective, and the palace guards were quickly overwhelmed. However, Gabel, who had received warning about the conspiracy was saved in time by his trusted aide and friend Fa'hradin. He managed to flee in the darkness, and that very night he started to gather his troops in order to take revenge on the usurper. Malor, on the other hand, had to acknowledge that his plan to get rid of Gabel quickly had failed. And he ordered his followers to prepare for a long-term military engagement. Neither he nor Gabel realised then that this was the starting point for a war that would last for eons.
entries.translated: Przez długi czas Malor spiskował i planował w tajemnicy, wykorzystując obietnice i groźby do rekrutacji zwolenników i tworzenia sojuszy. Wielu dżinów odmówiło zdrady Gabela, ale większość najsilniejszych wojowników dżinów zebrała się po jego stronie, a ponieważ Malor od dawna planował swoje powstanie, rebelianci byli dobrze przygotowani. Kiedy Malor w końcu dał sygnał, jego słudzy zaatakowali pałac z pełną siłą, planując szybkie zabicie Gabela. Ich atak był zabójczo skuteczny, a straże pałacowe zostały szybko pokonane. Jednakże Gabel, który otrzymał ostrzeżenie o spisku, został w porę uratowany przez swojego zaufanego pomocnika i przyjaciela Fa'hradina. Udało mu się uciec w ciemnościach i już tej nocy zaczął gromadzić swoje wojska, aby zemścić się na uzurpatorze. Malor natomiast musiał przyznać, że jego plan szybkiego pozbycia się Gabela nie powiódł się. I nakazał swoim zwolennikom przygotować się do długoterminowego zaangażowania wojskowego. Ani on, ani Gabel nie zdawali sobie wtedy sprawy, że był to punkt wyjścia do wojny, która będzie trwała eony.

entries.en: For each missing part (on the basis of a standard rail) I recommend to use three pieces of wood. Lock them in position by at least 6 nails. For the rail itself use a saw on a piece of wood to build your wooden ties. Then place two metal fittings on them and you can make your first ride on your new rail. Congratulations!
entries.translated: Na każdą brakującą część (na bazie standardowej szyny) polecam użyć trzech kawałków drewna. Zablokuj je w odpowiedniej pozycji za pomocą co najmniej 6 gwoździ. Do samej szyny użyj piły na kawałku drewna, aby zbudować drewniane krawaty. Następnie umieść na nich dwa metalowe okucia i możesz odbyć pierwszą przejażdżkę nową szyną. Gratulacje!

entries.en: For now the merchants seem content with their station and the place Venore takes on the continent and in the kingdom. There are voices that Venore might separate one day or use it influence to wrest even mor rights and privileges from the kingdom that becomes more and more dependent on its economical power.
entries.translated: Na razie kupcy wydają się zadowoleni ze swojej pozycji i miejsca, jakie Venore zajmuje na kontynencie i w królestwie. Istnieją głosy, że Venore może pewnego dnia oddzielić lub wykorzystać swoje wpływy, aby wyrwać jeszcze więcej praw i przywilejów królestwu, które staje się coraz bardziej zależne od swojej potęgi ekonomicznej.

entries.en: For our deeds for king and country, the king granted our order the Eastern lands. The city under our protectorate is growing and will soon be as big and as beautiful as our capital. But there is much work to do and countless monsters to slay to bring peace to the green planes. Some days ago, Falnus vanished and we must reckon that he is dead, probably murdered by the brotherhood. Of course even a mage of his power could have been slain by a greater number of creatures as dangerous as giant spiders that still roam these plains. It's a hard blow to our researches in the arts of healing and recreations and the loss of a great man.
entries.translated: Za nasze czyny dla króla i kraju król udzielił nam rozkazu ziem wschodnich. Miasto pod naszym protektoratem rozrasta się i wkrótce będzie tak duże i piękne jak nasza stolica. Ale jest wiele pracy do wykonania i niezliczone potwory do zabicia, aby zaprowadzić pokój na zielonych planach. Kilka dni temu Falnus zniknął i należy uznać, że nie żyje, prawdopodobnie zamordowany przez bractwo. Oczywiście nawet mag o takiej mocy mógł zostać zabity przez większą liczbę stworzeń równie niebezpiecznych jak gigantyczne pająki, które wciąż przemierzają te równiny. To ciężki cios dla naszych badań nad sztuką uzdrawiania i rekreacji oraz strata wielkiego człowieka.

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: You joined the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. Ask Grizzly Adams for some hunting tasks. You already gained %d points. You currently have %d boss points.
entries.translated: Вы присоединились к '__PH0__'. Попросите Гризли Адамса выполнить несколько охотничьих заданий. Вы уже набрали %d баллов. На данный момент у вас есть %d очков босса.

entries.en: Basteth wanted to come to aid her cousin, but her creatures, large and dreadful as they were simply could not walk ashore.
entries.translated: Бастет хотела прийти на помощь своей кузине, но ее создания, какими бы большими и ужасными они ни были, просто не могли выйти на берег.

entries.en: Be aware that our kind mastered the art of tunnelling. It may take you a whole life to understand the techniques that are used and it takes generations to know all the tunnels of a mine and all their exits. You even may find an exit that you never expected to.
entries.translated: Имейте в виду, что наш вид овладел искусством прокладки туннелей. Вам может потребоваться целая жизнь, чтобы понять используемые методы, и потребуются поколения, чтобы знать все туннели шахты и все их выходы. Вы даже можете найти выход, которого никогда не ожидали.

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You should leave for the Mainland now. Go left to reach the ship.
entries.translated: Deberías partir al Continente ahora. Ve a la izquierda para llegar al barco.

entries.en: You have not the right vocation to enter this room.
entries.translated: No tienes la vocación adecuada para entrar a esta habitación.

entries.en: You cannot go upstairs. You have chosen a vocation and must now leave for the Mainlands.
entries.translated: No puedes subir. Has elegido una vocación y ahora debes partir al Continente.

entries.en: Use these stairs to enter the Adventurer's Outpost on Dawnport.
entries.translated: Usa estas escaleras para entrar al Puesto de Aventureros en Dawnport.

entries.en: You need to be at least Level 2 in order to pass.
entries.translated: Necesitas ser al menos Nivel 2 para poder pasar.

entries.en: You don't have any business there anymore.
entries.translated: Ya no tienes nada que hacer allí.

entries.en: You have been trapped in a nightmare.
entries.translated: Has sido atrapado en una pesadilla.

entries.en: You dive into the vortex to swim below the rocks to the other side of the cave.
entries.translated: Te sumerges en el vórtice para nadar bajo las rocas al otro lado de la cueva.

entries.en: The flying carpet brought you back to Thais.
entries.translated: La alfombra voladora te ha traído de vuelta a Thais.

entries.en: You need level 999 to enter here.
You need at least level 200 to enter.
entries.translated: Necesitas al menos nivel 200 para entrar.

entries.en: Congratulations you received the Rascoohan Outfit.
entries.translated: Felicidades, has recibido el Atuendo Rascoohan.

entries.en: You need at least level 150 to enter.
entries.translated: Necesitas al menos nivel 150 para entrar.

entries.en: You need at least level 250 to enter.
entries.translated: Necesitas al menos nivel 250 para entrar.

entries.en: The purest water flows through this well. For centuries we concealed it, for other beings to not lay their eyes on it.
entries.translated: L'acqua più pura scorre attraverso questo pozzo. Per secoli l'abbiamo nascosto, affinché altri esseri non vi posassero gli occhi.

entries.en: Phials for the purest water from our sacred well. They are finely crafted and very fragile. We keep a small supply up here around the well. Probably the only thing the intruders did not care for.
entries.translated: Fiale per l'acqua purissima del nostro pozzo sacro. Sono finemente lavorati e molto fragili. Ne conserviamo una piccola scorta qui intorno al pozzo. Probabilmente l'unica cosa che agli intrusi non interessava.

entries.en: I already handed a cage to you. If you are in need of another one, you will have to return to me later.
entries.translated: Ti ho già dato una gabbia. Se ne hai bisogno di un altro, dovrai tornare da me più tardi.

entries.en: My name is now known only to the wind and it shall remain like this until I will return to my kin.
entries.translated: Il mio nome ora è noto solo al vento e rimarrà tale finché non tornerò tra i miei parenti.

entries.en: I was a guardian of this glade. I am the last one... everyone had to leave.
entries.translated: Ero il guardiano di questa radura. Io sono l'ultimo... tutti sono dovuti andare via.

entries.en: This glade's time is growing short if nothing will be done soon.
entries.translated: Il tempo a disposizione di questa radura sta per scadere se non si farà nulla al più presto.

entries.en: Cruel beings. Large and monstrous, with a single eye, staring at their prey.
entries.translated: Esseri crudeli. Grandi e mostruosi, con un solo occhio, che fissano la preda.

entries.en: These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.
entries.translated: Questi sciocchi e il loro culto superstizioso della vita non capiscono nulla di importante.
Solo le specie inferiori hanno bisogno di armi.

entries.en: I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
entries.translated: Ho sentito che gli elfi si sono trasferiti di sopra.

entries.en: Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics you are a master over life and death.
entries.translated: I numeri sono essenziali. Sono il segreto dietro le quinte. Se sei un maestro della matematica sei un maestro della vita e della morte.

entries.en: Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.
entries.translated: I nostri libri sono scritti nel 469, ovviamente non puoi capirli.

entries.en: Go and wash your eyes for using this obscene number!
entries.translated: Vai a lavarti gli occhi per aver usato questo numero osceno!

entries.en: The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.
entries.translated: Il linguaggio della mia specie. Superiore a qualsiasi altra lingua e può essere parlato solo da entità con abbastanza occhi da poter battere le palpebre.

entries.en: Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer then they know and closer then it's good for them.
entries.translated: I loro maghi sono così vicini alla verità. Più vicini di quanto sappiano e più vicini di quanto sia un bene per loro.

entries.en: Good tools to work with ... After their death, that is.
entries.translated: Ottimi strumenti con cui lavorare... Dopo la loro morte, ovviamente.

entries.en: Thanks for saving my life! Should I teleport you out of the Dark Cathedral?
entries.translated: Спасибо, что спасли мне жизнь! Мне телепортировать тебя из Темного Собора?

entries.en: {}, is that right?! What do you want from me?
entries.translated: {}, așa-i?! Ce vrei de la mine?

entries.en: Sorry, you need Form 145 to get Form 356. Come back when you have it
entries.translated: Ne pare rău, aveți nevoie de Formularul 145 pentru a obține Formularul 356. Reveniți când îl aveți

entries.en: You are better than I thought! Congratulations, here you are: Form 356!
entries.translated: Esti mai bun decat credeam! Felicitări, iată-te: Formularul 356!

entries.en: As I told you, fiendish ice creatures dragged my egg into the lower caves. ...
entries.translated: După cum ți-am spus, creaturi diabolice de gheață mi-au târât oul în peșterile de jos. ...

entries.en: Without enough heat the egg will die soon. Venture there and save my hatchling and the knowledge you seeek shall be yours!
entries.translated: Fără suficientă căldură, oul va muri în curând. Îndrăznește-te acolo și salvează-mi puiul și cunoștințele pe care le cauți vor fi ale tale!

entries.en: So return to the upper tunnels where cultists and ice golems dwell. Somewhere in these tunnels you will find a small prison haunted by a ghost. South of this prison cell there is a tunnel that will lead you eastwards. ...
entries.translated: Așadar, întoarceți-vă la tunelurile superioare, unde locuiesc culțiștii și golemii de gheață. Undeva în aceste tuneluri vei găsi o mică închisoare bântuită de o fantomă. La sud de această celulă există un tunel care te va conduce spre est. ...

entries.en: Follow the tunnel until you reach a small cave. Step down and down until you see a blue energy field. It will lead you to my egg. It is sealed so that not everyone may enter the room. But you have the permission now.
entries.translated: Urmați tunelul până ajungeți la o mică peșteră. Coborâți și coborâți până când vedeți un câmp de energie albastru. Te va duce la oul meu. Este sigilat astfel încât să nu poată intra toată lumea în cameră. Dar ai permisiunea acum.

entries.en: Wretched creatures of ice have stolen my egg that was close to hatching. ...
entries.translated: Nenorocitele creaturi de gheață mi-au furat oul care era aproape de eclozare. ...

entries.en: Since I'm to huge to enter those lower Tunnels I have to ask you to take care of my {egg}. Will you do this?
entries.translated: Deoarece sunt prea mare pentru a intra în acele tuneluri inferioare, trebuie să vă rog să aveți grijă de {egg}-ul meu. Vei face asta?

entries.en: For the Daughter of the Stars!
Soon I will harvest you for ingredients!
entries.translated: Скоро я соберу тебя на ингредиенты!

entries.en: I have just the solution for this problem!
entries.translated: У меня есть только решение этой проблемы!

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: That's right, you can get Form 145 from me. However, I need Form 411 first. Come back when you have it.
entries.translated: Det stämmer, du kan få blankett 145 av mig. Men jag behöver Form 411 först. Kom tillbaka när du har den.

entries.en: Well done! You have form 411!! Here is Form 145. Have fun with it.
entries.translated: Bra gjort! Du har blankett 411!! Här är formulär 145. Ha kul med det.

entries.en: {}, is that right?! What do you want from me?
entries.translated: {}, stämmer det?! Vad vill du ha av mig?

entries.en: Sorry, you need Form 145 to get Form 356. Come back when you have it
entries.translated: Tyvärr, du behöver formulär 145 för att få formulär 356. Kom tillbaka när du har det

entries.en: You are better than I thought! Congratulations, here you are: Form 356!
entries.translated: Du är bättre än jag trodde! Grattis, här är du: Form 356!

entries.en: As I told you, fiendish ice creatures dragged my egg into the lower caves. ...
entries.translated: Som jag sa till dig, släpade djävulska isvarelser mitt ägg in i de nedre grottorna. ...

entries.en: Without enough heat the egg will die soon. Venture there and save my hatchling and the knowledge you seeek shall be yours!
entries.translated: Utan tillräckligt med värme dör ägget snart. Våga dig dit och rädda min kläckning och kunskapen du söker kommer att bli din!

entries.en: So return to the upper tunnels where cultists and ice golems dwell. Somewhere in these tunnels you will find a small prison haunted by a ghost. South of this prison cell there is a tunnel that will lead you eastwards. ...
entries.translated: Så återvänd till de övre tunnlarna där kultister och isgolemer bor. Någonstans i dessa tunnlar hittar du ett litet fängelse hemsökt av ett spöke. Söder om denna fängelsecell finns en tunnel som leder dig österut. ...

entries.en: Follow the tunnel until you reach a small cave. Step down and down until you see a blue energy field. It will lead you to my egg. It is sealed so that not everyone may enter the room. But you have the permission now.
entries.translated: Följ tunneln tills du kommer till en liten grotta. Kliv ner och ner tills du ser ett blått energifält. Det kommer att leda dig till mitt ägg. Den är förseglad så att inte alla kan komma in i rummet. Men du har tillstånd nu.

entries.en: Wretched creatures of ice have stolen my egg that was close to hatching. ...
entries.translated: Usla varelser av is har stulit mitt ägg som var nära att kläckas. ...

entries.en: Since I'm to huge to enter those lower Tunnels I have to ask you to take care of my {egg}. Will you do this?
entries.translated: Eftersom jag är för stor för att komma in i de lägre tunnlarna måste jag be dig ta hand om min {egg}. Kommer du att göra det här?

entries.en: I'm aware what you are looking for. Usually I would rather devour you, but due to unfortunate circumstances, I need your {assistance}.
entries.translated: Jag är medveten om vad du letar efter. Vanligtvis skulle jag hellre sluka dig, men på grund av olyckliga omständigheter behöver jag din {assistance}.

entries.en: If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.
entries.translated: Om en annan prins kommer för att kyssa mig, sparkar jag honom så illa att han behöver en sedanstol för att komma undan.

entries.en: If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.
entries.translated: Om en annan prins kommer för att kyssa mig, sparkar jag honom så illa att han behöver en sedanstol för att komma undan.

entries.en: Don't even try to kiss me or I'll rondhouse kick you!
entries.translated: Försök inte ens kyssa mig, annars sparkar jag dig!

entries.en: Talking frogs don't exist, idiot. It's your fucking imagination tricking you. And now your imagination commands you to walk away.
entries.translated: Talande grodor finns inte, idiot. Det är din jävla fantasi som lurar dig. Och nu befaller din fantasi dig att gå därifrån.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

reductor de habilidades de demonio marginado

entries.en: You need to wait before using it again.
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać zanim użyjesz tego ponownie.

entries.en: [World Change] Yasir has arrived in %s today!
You need to wait before using it again.
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać zanim użyjesz tego ponownie.

entries.en: The door seems to be sealed against unwanted intruders.
entries.translated: Drzwi wydają się być zabezpieczone przed niechcianymi intruzami.

entries.en: Step inside the elevator to use it.
entries.translated: Aby skorzystać z windy, wejdź do środka.

entries.en: This table is made of several old doors. One of them has a noticeable ornate lock. Perhaps you could lever it out with a tool.
entries.translated: Ten stół jest zrobiony z kilku starych drzwi. Jedne z nich mają wyraźny, ozdobny zamek. Może dałoby się go podważyć narzędziem.

entries.en: You already removed the old lock.
This table is made of several old doors. One of them has a noticeable ornate lock. Perhaps you could lever it out with a tool.
entries.translated: Ten stół jest zrobiony z kilku starych drzwi. Jedne z nich mają wyraźny, ozdobny zamek. Może dałoby się go podważyć narzędziem.

entries.en: You already removed the old lock.
You dug a hole! Walk onto it as long as it is open to jump down into the forest cave.
entries.translated: Wykopałeś dół! Wejdź na niego, póki jest otwarty, aby wskoczyć do leśnej jaskini.

entries.en: A torn scroll piece emerges. Probably gnawed off by rats.
entries.translated: Pojawia się rozdarty fragment zwoju. Prawdopodobnie ogryziony przez szczury.

entries.en: You need to wait before using it again.
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać zanim użyjesz tego ponownie.

entries.en: You don't have any business there anymore.
entries.translated: Nie masz już tam nic do roboty.

entries.en: The flying carpet brought you back to Thais.
entries.translated: Latający dywan przeniósł cię z powrotem do Thais.

entries.en: You need to wait before using it again.
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać zanim użyjesz tego ponownie.

entries.en: You need level 999 to enter here.
You open the cage and let the cave parrot roam free!
entries.translated: Apri la gabbia e lascia che il pappagallo delle caverne vaghi libero!

entries.en: The cave parrot may be tough but he somehow couldn't resist this particular birdcage. Or maybe it was you...
entries.translated: Il pappagallo delle caverne può essere duro ma in qualche modo non ha saputo resistere a questa particolare gabbia per uccelli. O forse eri tu...

entries.en: You are not worthy to travel by the lion's roar.
entries.translated: Non sei degno di viaggiare seguendo il ruggito del leone.

entries.en: The silvered trap has been set and cannot be removed from its current position.
entries.translated: La trappola argentata è stata posizionata e non può essere rimossa dalla sua posizione attuale.

entries.en: Use it on the ground to set the trap.
entries.translated: Usatelo a terra per posizionare la trappola.

entries.en: You may use it in the Feroxa's room.
entries.translated: Puoi usarlo nella stanza di Feroxa.

entries.en: You are gathering some catus milk.
entries.translated: Stai raccogliendo del latte di gatto.

entries.en: You find a golden symbol at the bottom of the blood-filled basin.
entries.translated: Trovi un simbolo dorato sul fondo della bacinella piena di sangue.

entries.en: You have found a wooden cage key.
entries.translated: Hai trovato la chiave di una gabbia di legno.

entries.en: Amidst the pile of various bones you find  large, hollow part, similar to a pipe.
entries.translated: In mezzo al mucchio di varie ossa trovi una parte grande e cava, simile a una pipa.

entries.en: You ransack the pile but fail to find any useful parts.
entries.translated: Frughi nella pila ma non riesci a trovare parti utili.

entries.en: You fill some of the fine chalk into a bucket.
entries.translated: Metti un po' di gesso fine in un secchio.

entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You must be holding the container to set it as a loot container.
entries.translated: Вы должны держать контейнер, чтобы использовать его в качестве контейнера для добычи.

entries.en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
entries.translated: Druid Крунора? Он вам рассказал, что здесь появилась новая пещера? Это верно. Я руководитель {project}, который пытается узнать больше об этом новом {area}.

entries.en: Just get out of my way! You killed this beautiful creature. I have nothing more to say. Damn druid of Crunor!
entries.translated: Просто уйди с моего пути! Ты убил это прекрасное существо. Мне больше нечего сказать. Проклятый друид Крунора!

entries.en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a project that tries to find out more about this new area.
entries.translated: Druid Крунора? Он вам рассказал, что здесь появилась новая пещера? Это верно. Я руководитель проекта, который пытается узнать больше об этой новой области.

entries.en: Greetings, what can I do for you?
entries.translated: Приветствую, что я могу для вас сделать?

entries.en: As you use the small bell, an unearthly sound rings out sweetly. At the same moment, the lake's waters begin to whirl.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce folosești clopoțelul mic, un sunet nepământesc răsună dulce. În același moment, apele lacului încep să se învârtească.

entries.en: A vortex already exists in this area.
entries.translated: Un vârtej există deja în această zonă.

entries.en: You have found a sheet of paper.
entries.translated: Ai găsit o foaie de hârtie.

entries.en: The pile of bones is empty.
You have found a small crystal bell.
entries.translated: Ai găsit un mic clopot de cristal.

entries.en: The pile of bones is empty.
You dare not touch there remains. A word has been carved into these bones over and over: 'K'muuh'.
entries.translated: Nu îndrăznești să atingi acolo rămășițe. Un cuvânt a fost sculptat în aceste oase iar și iar: 'K'muuh'.

entries.en: This book tells you about a spell that draws its wielder towards the most energetic being next to him.
entries.translated: Această carte îți vorbește despre o vrajă care îl atrage pe cel care o poartă spre cea mai energică ființă de lângă el.

entries.en: It consists of four parts wich have been scratched out of this book. They need to be read in conjunction with chants.
entries.translated: Este alcătuită din patru părți care au fost scoase din această carte. Ele trebuie citite împreună cu cântecele.

entries.en: You have to wait to challange this enemy again!
entries.translated: Trebuie să așteptați pentru a provoca din nou acest inamic!

entries.en: The ashes swirl with a life of their own, mixing with the sparks of the altar.
entries.translated: Cenușa se învârte cu o viață proprie, amestecându-se cu scânteile altarului.

entries.en: You see water as far as the eye can reach. No sea serpent in sight.
entries.translated: Vedeți apă cât de departe poate ajunge cu ochii. Niciun șarpe de mare la vedere.

entries.en: It's getting away! You should tell the captain to gain speed!
entries.translated: Se scapă! Ar trebui să-i spui căpitanului să câștige viteză!

entries.en: There are multiple shadows under the surface. This has to be the right location.
entries.translated: Există mai multe umbre sub suprafață. Aceasta trebuie să fie locația potrivită.

entries.en: You've been into the skirmish in the last 10 hours.
entries.translated: Ai fost în încăierare în ultimele 10 ore.

entries.en: You see the scattered parts of a wrecked ship. Miraculously the ship telescope survived the wreckm it seems still to be intact.
entries.translated: Vedeți părțile împrăștiate ale unei nave naufragiate. În mod miraculos, telescopul navei a supraviețuit epavei și pare să fie încă intact.

entries.en: There are still some loose planks and hawsers. You can't use the raft like this, it will sink for sure.
entries.translated: Mai sunt niște scânduri și șuruburi libere. Nu poți folosi pluta așa, sigur se va scufunda.

entries.en: You use the hawser to lash up the loose planks. The raft should be seaworthy now.
entries.translated: Folosești șurubul pentru a bate scândurile libere. Pluta ar trebui să fie navigabilă acum.

entries.en: You see the scattered parts of a wrecked ship. Miraculously the ship telescope survived the wreck it seems still to be intact.
entries.translated: Vedeți părțile împrăștiate ale unei nave naufragiate. În mod miraculos, telescopul navei a supraviețuit epavei și pare să fie încă intact.

entries.en: My tainted siblings locked me up in the dark far too long. Now I'm finally free! Thank you, mortal being!
entries.translated: I miei fratelli corrotti mi hanno rinchiuso nell'oscurità per troppo tempo. Ora sono finalmente libero! Grazie, essere mortale!

entries.en: You found some more feathers on the grass near the wheat. Now you should have enough for an entire cloak.
entries.translated: Hai trovato altre piume sull'erba vicino al grano. Ora dovresti averne abbastanza per un intero mantello.

entries.en: You found some beautiful swan feathers in the dustbin.
entries.translated: Hai trovato delle bellissime piume di cigno nella pattumiera.

entries.en: You found some beautiful swan feathers entangled in the cactus stings.
entries.translated: Hai trovato delle bellissime piume di cigno impigliate nelle punture del cactus.

entries.en: You found some beautiful swan feathers beneath the dragon skull.
entries.translated: Hai trovato delle bellissime piume di cigno sotto il teschio del drago.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: Grimvale drowns in werecreatures as the full moon reaches its apex and ancient evil returns.
entries.translated: Grimvale тонет в существах-оборотнях, когда полная луна достигает апогея и возвращается древнее зло.

entries.en: You need to wait %s before trying to challenge %s again!
entries.translated: Вам нужно подождать %s, прежде чем снова пытаться бросить вызов %s!

entries.en: Your Goshnar's taints have been reset.
Your Goshnar's taints have been reset. You didn't finish the quest in 14 days.
entries.translated: Порчи вашего Гошнара были сброшены. Вы не выполнили квест за 14 дней.

entries.en: Congratulations! You completed %s arena, you should take your reward now.
entries.translated: Поздравляем! Вы завершили арену %s, теперь вы должны получить свою награду.

entries.en: Entering the Mirror Maze of Madness.
You are cutting some desert rose blossoms.
You are cutting some snake maw.
You are cutting some veldt flowers.
You have found a gryphon mask.
You have found a mirror mask.
You have found a silver mask.
You are gathering some spiderweb cloud shreds. But you become entangled.
entries.translated: Вы собираете кусочки паутины облаков. Но вы запутываетесь.

entries.en: The Ambassador tells another dignitary: Rathleton must never be surpassed! I will procure that the Empire falters!
entries.translated: Посол говорит другому высокопоставленному лицу: Rathleton никогда нельзя превзойти! Я добьюсь того, чтобы Империя пошатнулась!

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see the Ambassador of Rathleton wearing a cloak with a black sphinx on it.
entries.translated: Через межпространственные врата вы можете увидеть Посла Rathleton в плаще с черным сфинксом.

entries.en: These stairs lead up to the roof of the academy. Up there you should find TWO of the catapults.
entries.translated: Aceste scări duc pe acoperișul academiei. Acolo sus ar trebui să găsești DOUA dintre catapulte.

entries.en: This is the house Vascalir mentioned. You should find a stone pile in the cellar. Use it to get a stone!
entries.translated: Aceasta este casa despre care a pomenit Vascalir. Ar trebui să găsești o grămadă de piatră în pivniță. Folosește-l pentru a obține o piatră!

entries.en: This is Norma's bar. If you go to the roof, you should find one of the catapults that need to be filled with stones.
entries.translated: Acesta este barul lui Norma. Dacă mergi pe acoperiș, ar trebui să găsești una dintre catapultele care trebuie umplute cu pietre.

entries.en: This is Obi's shop. Up on his roof you should find one of the catapults Vascalir mentioned.
entries.translated: Acesta este magazinul lui Obi. Pe acoperișul lui ar trebui să găsești una dintre catapultele menționate de Vascalir.

entries.en: This is not the way to Hyacinth. Follow the path to the east to find Hyacinth's little house.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către Hyacinth. Urmați poteca spre est pentru a găsi căsuța lui Hyacinth.

entries.en: This is not the way to Hyacinth. Follow the path to the north exit of the village.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către Hyacinth. Urmați poteca până la ieșirea de nord a satului.

entries.en: This is not the way to Hyacinth. Stay on the path a little more to the north to find Hyacinth's little house.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către Hyacinth. Rămâneți pe potecă puțin mai spre nord pentru a găsi căsuța lui Hyacinth.

entries.en: This is not the way to Lily. Follow the road leading to the south-west to find her shop.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către Lily. Urmați drumul care duce spre sud-vest pentru a găsi magazinul ei.

entries.en: Follow the small path to the north to reach the spider lair.
entries.translated: Urmați poteca mică spre nord pentru a ajunge la bârlogul păianjenilor.

entries.en: This is not the way to the tarantula's lair. Head up the little ramp to the southwest.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către bârlogul tarantulei. Urcă-te pe mica rampă spre sud-vest.

entries.en: Remember that you have to aquire a web sample for Vascalir. You should not leave this cave without it.
entries.translated: Amintiți-vă că trebuie să achiziționați un eșantion web pentru Vascalir. Nu ar trebui să părăsești această peșteră fără ea.

entries.en: Walk to the west from here to reach the hole leading to the tarantula lair.
entries.translated: Mergeți spre vest de aici pentru a ajunge la gaura care duce la bârlogul tarantulelor.

entries.en: There is a dead war wolf! Use the knife, and then use it on its body to get some leather - but quickly!
entries.translated: Există un lup de război mort! Folosește cuțitul și apoi folosește-l pe corp pentru a obține niște piele - dar repede!

entries.en: You reached the exit in time! Phew.. back to Tom.
entries.translated: Ai ajuns la ieșire la timp! Puff... înapoi la Tom.

entries.en: Follow the north-eastern path into the forest. Beware of wolves!
entries.translated: Urmați poteca de nord-est în pădure. Atenție la lupi!

entries.en: This is not the way into the wolf forest. Stay on the southern path leading to the north-east!
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul spre pădurea lupilor. Rămâi pe poteca de sud care duce spre nord-est!

entries.en: It seems plans changed. It's up to you now to find a dead war wolf and use the skinning knife on it to get some leather.
entries.translated: Se pare că planurile s-au schimbat. Acum depinde de tine să găsești un lup de război mort și să folosești cuțitul de jupuit de pe el pentru a obține niște piele.

entries.en: Well.. that seems to be the poacher. Dead. Check his body - maybe he still has something that you can use.
entries.translated: Ei bine... acesta pare a fi braconierul. Mort. Verifică-i corpul - poate mai are ceva ce poți folosi.

entries.en: This hole leads into the wolves' den. Only enter if you have full health and food - this might be dangerous.
entries.translated: Această gaură duce în bârlogul lupilor. Intrați numai dacă aveți sănătate și mâncare deplină - acest lucru ar putea fi periculos.

entries.en: This must be the chest with the book - but it's covered in flames!
entries.translated: Acesta trebuie să fie cufărul cu cartea - dar este acoperit de flăcări!

entries.en: Here ya go! Use it on the crane when you see the monster. Then refill it every time you use the telescope.
entries.translated: Varsågod! Använd den på kranen när du ser monstret. Fyll sedan på det varje gång du använder teleskopet.

entries.en: You found the spot |PLAYERNAME|!! Grab yourself a helmet of the deep and go explore the {caves} down there.
entries.translated: Du hittade platsen |PLAYERNAME|!! Ta dig själv en hjälm från djupet och utforska {caves} där nere.

entries.en: Welcome on board, traveller. Where can I {sail} you today?

entries.translated: Välkommen tillbaka, |PLAYERNAME|! Var lade du den där läckra biten mat? Har du ätit det själv? Tja, om du hittar en annan, snälla kom tillbaka.

entries.en: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!
entries.translated: Hej där, |PLAYERNAME|! Tja, det är så handel med NPC:er som jag fungerar. Jag tror att du är redo att gå över bron till Rookgaard! Ta hand om dig!

entries.en: Hello again, |PLAYERNAME|! What are you still doing here? You should head over the bridge to Rookgaard village now!
entries.translated: Hej igen, |PLAYERNAME|! Vad gör du fortfarande här? Du borde gå över bron till byn Rookgaard nu!

entries.en: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...
entries.translated: Дакле, дошли сте, |PLAYERNAME|. Надао сам се да нећеш...

entries.en: Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?
entries.translated: Здраво! Шта је то, шта си {want}?

entries.en: Greetings humans! Consider yourselfs lucky, I'm in need of {help}.
entries.translated: Поздрав људи! Сматрајте да сте срећни, треба ми {help}.

entries.en: Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?
entries.translated: Ха? ста? могу да видим! Вау! Не-мино. Да ли су и вама {capture}?

entries.en: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
entries.translated: Здраво? Како то мислиш 'hi' - зар не видиш да сам ја... Морам да стишам глас. Да ли вам је пало на памет да овај 'chalice' не жели да га узнемиравате?! Остави ме на миру!

entries.en: Gha'Zuul grew up a simple boy among one of the northern nomad tribes. A frail and meagre child, he was frequently the target of the other childrens' jeers as well as of his despotic father's scorn. Hurt and angered by the constant humiliations, Gha'Zuul developed a bitter, unforgiving personality. He took notes of all the indignities he suffered, and he was determined to take revenge for every single one of them. One day, when his camp was attacked by an undead raiding party he decided it was time to get his revenge. Taking advantage of the general hullabaloo, Gha'Zuul sneaked up on his worst tormentor and quickly cut his throat. However, he had made a mistake when he thought that his crime would go unnoticed. One of the necromancers who was part of the raiding party sensed the evil of this deed, and since he was impressed by the young boy's obvious ruthlessness he ordered his undead troops to kidnap him. And so Gha'Zuul was brought to Drefia.
entries.translated: Gha'Zuul dorastał jako prosty chłopiec wśród jednego z północnych plemion nomadów. Jako wątłe i wątłe dziecko często był celem szyderstw innych dzieci, a także pogardy swego despotycznego ojca. Zraniony i rozgniewany ciągłymi upokorzeniami, Gha'Zuul rozwinął zgorzkniałą, bezlitosną osobowość. Zapisywał wszystkie upokorzenia, których doznał, i był zdecydowany zemścić się za każde z nich. Pewnego dnia, kiedy jego obóz został zaatakowany przez grupę nieumarłych, zdecydował, że nadszedł czas, aby się zemścić. Korzystając z ogólnego zamieszania, Gha'Zuul podkradł się do swojego najgorszego oprawcy i szybko poderżnął mu gardło. Popełnił jednak błąd sądząc, że jego zbrodnia pozostanie niezauważona. Jeden z nekromantów, który był częścią grupy najeźdźców, wyczuł zło tego czynu, a ponieważ był pod wrażeniem oczywistej bezwzględności chłopca, rozkazał swoim nieumarłym oddziałom go porwać. I tak Gha'Zuul został doprowadzony do Drefia.

entries.en: Given the need for information on how to torture the creatures effectively, should a more valuable specimen fall into our hands, several new techniques were tried out. Most proved to be unsuccessful. Eventually both probands died at intended points of the experiment.
entries.translated: Biorąc pod uwagę potrzebę uzyskania informacji na temat skutecznego torturowania stworzeń, gdyby w nasze ręce wpadł cenniejszy okaz, wypróbowano kilka nowych technik. Większość okazała się nieudana. Ostatecznie obaj probanci zmarli w zamierzonych momentach eksperymentu.

entries.en: Glows, shades and hues - light and its origins: natural and artificial
entries.translated: Blaski, cienie i barwy – światło i jego pochodzenie: naturalne i sztuczne

entries.en: Go ahead and follow the path of light
entries.translated: Idź dalej i podążaj ścieżką światła

entries.en: GO TO THE LEFT BROTHER AND JOIN US IN DARKNESS
entries.translated: UDAJ SIĘ DO LEWEGO BRATA I DOŁĄCZ DO NAS W CIEMNOŚCI

entries.en: Golden lines are embedded in the amulet and show mysterious symbols. It was awarded by TibiaHoF.
entries.translated: W amulecie wtopione są złote linie, które przedstawiają tajemnicze symbole. Został on przyznany przez TibiaHoF.

entries.en: Got your rope and shovel? Well, have fun hunting!
entries.translated: Masz linę i łopatę? Cóż, miłego polowania!

entries.en: Graveyard of the Red Legion and all the workers who fell in the fight against the orcish hordes
entries.translated: Cmentarz Czerwonego Legionu i wszystkich robotników, którzy polegli w walce z hordami orków
Nagrody za rangę Greenhorn – wybieraj mądrze!

entries.en: Ground floor: Flint's Finest - Melee Weapons and Armor
entries.translated: Parter: Flint's Finest - Broń biała i zbroja

entries.en: Guided by omens an expedition of brave warriors from the thaian order of the knights of noodles traveled the perillious seas the remote isle of rookgaard and discovered the new soulvortex.
entries.translated: Kierowana wróżbami wyprawa odważnych wojowników z tajskiego zakonu rycerzy makaronu przemierzyła niebezpieczne morza na odległej wyspie Rookgaard i odkryła nowy wir duszy.

entries.en: Haha, we caught one of our enemys
entries.translated: Haha, złapaliśmy jednego z naszych wrogów

entries.en: Hail to Marianos Pall, the current hero of the Scrapper difficulty!

Hai già preso la lente d'ingrandimento.

entries.translated: Questa cassa appartiene ad Angelo. Dovresti parlargli prima di tirare fuori qualcosa.

entries.en: With considerable effort you manage to knock a largely unscathed rough gem out of the rocks.
entries.translated: Con uno sforzo considerevole si riesce a far cadere dalle rocce una gemma grezza, quasi intatta.

entries.en: You take some hot water from the geyser.
The power of Gaffir won't let you pass this door!

entries.translated: Racconta a Oldrak della tua grande vittoria contro la quercia demoniaca.

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

The forged key unlocks the door.

entries.translated: Capcana argintie a fost pusă și nu poate fi scoasă din poziția sa actuală.

entries.en: You choose the colour of decay.
Suddenly a guard jumps at you from behind!
entries.translated: Deodată, un gardian sare la tine din spate!

entries.en: Quandon has been murdered! You should report to Sholley about it!.
entries.translated: Quandon a fost ucis! Ar trebui să-i raportezi lui Sholley despre asta!.

entries.en: You take no more gold than you actually need and release the merchant who makes away the very second you remove the ropes.
entries.translated: Nu iei mai mult aur decât ai nevoie și eliberezi comerciantul care eliberează chiar în secunda în care scoți frânghiile.

entries.en: You discover an owl resting in a tree. Thats special, because you have never seen an owl in all of Kilmaresh.
entries.translated: Descoperi o bufniță care se odihnește într-un copac. Este special, pentru că nu ai văzut niciodată o bufniță în tot Kilmaresh.

entries.translated: Furtuna de nisip nu numai că a distrus oaza, dar a scos la iveală și niște plăci de pavaj și o pârghie.

entries.translated: Ai nevoie de cel puțin 4 jucători pentru această misiune.
