entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: You joined the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. Ask Grizzly Adams for some hunting tasks. You already gained %d points. You currently have %d boss points.

entries.en: Deep in the heart of the Kha'labal the dreaded hyena king has its lair. This legendary beast is much larger than any other specimen of its race, surpassing lions and even elephants in size, and it can tear a man apart in seconds with its enormous, razor-sharp teeth. What's more, the hyena king is said to be truly immortal, for it has been sighted time and again by numerous travellers and merchants. Many a caravan is said to have fallen prey to this ferocious beast, and it is widely believed to have amassed untold treasures over the centuries.
entries.translated: Adânc în inima lui Kha'labal, temutul rege al hienelor își are bârlogul. Această fiară legendară este mult mai mare decât orice alt exemplar din rasa sa, depășind în mărime leii și chiar elefanții și poate sfâșie un om în câteva secunde cu dinții săi enormi și ascuțiți ca brici. În plus, se spune că regele hienelor este cu adevărat nemuritor, pentru că a fost văzut în repetate rânduri de numeroși călători și negustori. Se spune că multe caravane au căzut pradă acestei fiare feroce și se crede că a adunat comori nespuse de-a lungul secolelor.

entries.en: But since there were only acolytes there the nature of the prophecy was kept a secret by the priests. They called for the stranger, who seemed to have lost his memory, to be brought to the temple, where they talked to him and asked him all kinds of questions. But much to their dismay he could not give them the answers they sought, for his memory seemed to be blank like the surface of the desert after a sandstorm. However, the priests had the wisdom of the secret prophecy to guide them, and so they knew that they had to give the strangers five tasks to fulfil before they could reveal his destiny to him. And so they did, and the stranger swore he would fulfil all the tasks or die in the attempt. His first task was to travel into the desert and to find the eldest of the scarabs there, so that the priests would reveal their wisdom to him and fill his empty mind with recollections. The stranger descended deep into the burrows of the scarabs in order to face their judgement and to find answers that had been lost in the desert sand aeons ago. But the stranger never returned.
entries.translated: Ma poiché lì c'erano solo accoliti, la natura della profezia fu tenuta segreta dai sacerdoti. Chiesero che lo straniero, che sembrava aver perso la memoria, fosse portato al tempio, dove parlarono con lui e gli fecero ogni sorta di domande. Ma con loro grande sgomento non poteva dare loro le risposte che cercavano, perché la sua memoria sembrava essere vuota come la superficie del deserto dopo una tempesta di sabbia. Tuttavia, i sacerdoti avevano la saggezza della profezia segreta a guidarli, e quindi sapevano che dovevano dare agli stranieri cinque compiti da compiere prima che potessero rivelargli il suo destino. E così fecero, e lo straniero giurò che avrebbe adempiuto a tutti i compiti o sarebbe morto nel tentativo. Il suo primo compito era viaggiare nel deserto e trovare lì il più vecchio degli scarabei, affinché i sacerdoti gli rivelassero la loro saggezza e riempissero di ricordi la sua mente vuota. Lo straniero scese nelle profondità delle tane degli scarabei per affrontare il loro giudizio e trovare risposte che erano andate perdute nella sabbia del deserto eoni fa. Ma lo sconosciuto non è mai tornato.

entries.en: But the progress goes well. Soon we will be able to control the power. And we will be then one step closer to our main goal.
entries.translated: Ma i progressi vanno bene. Presto saremo in grado di controllare il potere. E allora saremo un passo più vicini al nostro obiettivo principale.

entries.en: But this ritual requires complete concentration and only with many warlocks it was possible to build this city out of the lava.
entries.translated: Ma questo rituale richiede una concentrazione completa e solo con l'aiuto di molti stregoni è stato possibile costruire questa città dalla lava.

entries.en: But we havent give up hope yet. Maybe we will find somehow someday by chance a key element that will help us to open many doors in the magic web.
entries.translated: Ma non abbiamo ancora rinunciato alla speranza. Forse un giorno troveremo per caso un elemento chiave che ci aiuterà ad aprire molte porte nella rete magica.

entries.en: But when the Orks threatened to cover Tibia almost completely, the dragon came! They had decided that only they
entries.translated: Ma quando gli Orki minacciarono di coprire quasi completamente Tibia, arrivò il drago! Lo avevano deciso solo loro

entries.en: But you can feel a strange energy flowing through the book.*
entries.translated: Ma puoi sentire una strana energia che scorre attraverso il libro.*

entries.en: But you can feel a strange energy flowing through the book.*
entries.translated: Ma puoi sentire una strana energia che scorre attraverso il libro.*
Acquista armi di qualità da Obi!

entries.en: Buy ropes at Al Dee's shop.
entries.translated: Compra delle corde nel negozio di Al Dee.

entries.en: by a victim of a bugged chameleon spell.
entries.translated: da una vittima di un incantesimo camaleonte disturbato.

entries.en: By Jonea, ancient council of the warlocks
entries.translated: Di Jonea, antico consiglio degli stregoni

entries.en: By the way: The summoning of lesser creatures, the so-called 'reds', progressed comparatively well. Of course, these creatures are mere borderdwellers and may consequently not be considered true demons. However, it may prove that the development of summoning spells for 'reds' will prove a rewarding spin-off of demon summoning research.
entries.translated: A proposito: l'evocazione di creature minori, le cosiddette 'reds', è andata relativamente bene. Naturalmente queste creature sono semplici abitanti di confine e di conseguenza non possono essere considerate veri demoni. Tuttavia, potrebbe dimostrare che lo sviluppo di incantesimi di evocazione per 'reds' si rivelerà un gratificante spin-off della ricerca sull'evocazione dei demoni.

entries.translated: Список предметов, которые вы можете купить

entries.translated: Ошибка при чтении файла настроек контейнеров.

Dodges an attack with a chance, avoiding all damage.
entries.translated: С некоторой вероятностью уклоняется от атаки, избегая любого урона.

entries.en: Minimap couldn't be loaded, file missing?
entries.translated: Не удалось загрузить миникарту, файл отсутствует?

entries.en: You, Sir or Lady, are a true alchemist. Conducting transmutating experiments to find every possible combination has been your secret passion since years and the results of your research are incredible. Science has just taken a leap thanks to you!
entries.translated: Tu, domnule sau doamnă, ești un adevărat alchimist. Efectuarea de experimente de transmutare pentru a găsi orice combinație posibilă a fost pasiunea ta secretă de ani de zile, iar rezultatele cercetărilor tale sunt incredibile. Știința tocmai a făcut un salt datorită ție!

entries.en: RAWR! Strength running through your body, your heart racing faster and adrenaline fueling your every weapon swing. All in a little bottle. No refund for destroyed furniture. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
entries.translated: RAWR! Forța îți străbate corpul, inima îți bate mai repede și adrenalina alimentează fiecare armă. Toate într-o sticlă mică. Nicio rambursare pentru mobilierul distrus. Pentru întrebări suplimentare, consultați vindecătorul sau distribuitorul de poțiuni.

entries.en: You feel you could solve the hardest riddles within a minute or so. Plus, there's a nice boost on your spell damage. All in a little bottle. Aftereffects - feeling slightly stupid. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
entries.translated: Simți că poți rezolva cele mai grele ghicitori într-un minut și ceva. În plus, există un impuls bun asupra daunelor tale vrăji. Toate într-o sticlă mică. Efecte secundare - senzație de prost. Pentru întrebări suplimentare, consultați vindecătorul sau distribuitorul de poțiuni.

entries.en: Improved eyesight, arrows and bolts flying at the speed of light and pinning your enemies with extra damage. All in a little bottle. No consumption of carrots required. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
entries.translated: Vedere îmbunătățită, săgeți și șuruburi care zboară cu viteza luminii și țineau inamicii cu daune suplimentare. Toate într-o sticlă mică. Nu este necesar consumul de morcovi. Pentru întrebări suplimentare, consultați vindecătorul sau distribuitorul de poțiuni.

entries.en: Rise and shine! It's a beautiful new day - open your windows, feel the warm sunlight, watch the birds singing on your windowsill and care for your plants. What reason is there not to be happy?
entries.translated: Ridică-te și strălucește! Este o nouă zi frumoasă - deschideți ferestrele, simțiți lumina caldă a soarelui, priviți păsările cântând pe pervazul ferestrei și îngrijiți-vă plantele. Ce motiv există pentru a nu fi fericit?

entries.en: Argh! Not now! How is it that those multifunctional tools never fail when you're using them for something completely trivial like squeezing juice, but mess up when you desperately need to climb up a rope spot with a fire-breathing dragon chasing you?
entries.translated: Argh! Nu acum! Cum se face că acele instrumente multifuncționale nu eșuează niciodată atunci când le folosești pentru ceva complet banal, cum ar fi stoarcerea sucului, dar încurcă atunci când ai nevoie disperată să te cațări într-un loc de frânghie cu un dragon care suflă foc care te urmărește?

entries.en: You laugh at unprepared adventurers stuck in high grass or rush wood. Or maybe you actually do help them out. They call you... 'Machete'.
entries.translated: Râzi de aventurierii nepregătiți blocați în iarba înaltă sau în pădure de papură. Sau poate chiar îi ajuți. Ei te sună... 'Machete'.

entries.en: Scythe swung over your shoulder, sun burning down on your back - you are a farmer at heart and love working in the fields. Or then again maybe you just create fancy crop circles to scare your fellow men.
entries.translated: Coasa ți-a legănat peste umăr, soarele arzând pe spate - ești un fermier la inimă și îți place să lucrezi la câmp. Sau din nou, poate doar creezi cercuri fanteziste pentru a-ți speria semenii.

entries.en: Liberty Bay is the perfect hangout for you and harvesting sugar cane quite a relaxing leisure activity. Would you like some tea with your sugar, hon?
entries.translated: Liberty Bay este locul perfect pentru tine, iar recoltarea trestiei de zahăr este o activitate de agrement destul de relaxantă. Vrei niște ceai cu zahărul tău, dragă?

entries.en: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum - homebrewed, of course, made from handpicked and personally harvested sugar cane plants. Now, let it age in an oak barrel and enjoy it in about 10 years. Or for the impatient ones: Let's have a paaaarty right now!
entries.translated: Yo-ho-ho și o sticlă de rom - preparat în casă, desigur, din plante de trestie de zahăr alese manual și recoltate personal. Acum, lăsați-l să îmbătrânească într-un butoi de stejar și savurați-l în aproximativ 10 ani. Sau pentru cei nerăbdători: Să facem un paaaarty chiar acum!

entries.en: Hidden treasures below the sand dunes of the desert - you have a nose for finding them and you know where to dig. They might not make you filthy rich, but they're shiny and pretty anyhow.
entries.translated: Comori ascunse sub dunele de nisip ale deșertului - ai un nas să le găsești și știi unde să sapi. S-ar putea să nu te îmbogățească, dar oricum sunt strălucitoare și drăguțe.

entries.en: You and your shovel - a match made in heaven. Or hell, for that matter. Somewhere down below in any case. You're magically attracted by stone piles and love to open them up and see where those holes lead you. Good biceps as well.
entries.translated: Tu și lopata ta - un meci făcut în rai. Sau la naiba, de altfel. Undeva mai jos, în orice caz. Ești atras magic de grămezile de piatră și adoră să le deschizi și să vezi unde te duc acele găuri. Biceps bun, de asemenea.

entries.en: You can easily be found by anyone if they just follow the cookie crumb trail. And for you, true love means to give away your last cookie.
entries.translated: Poți fi găsit cu ușurință de oricine dacă urmează doar traseul firimiturii de prăjituri. Și pentru tine, dragostea adevărată înseamnă să dai ultimul tău prăjitură.

entries.en: The famous 'Ode to a Molten Chocolate Cake' was probably written by you. Spending a rainy afternoon in front of the chimney, wrapped in a blanket while indulging in cocoa delights sounds just like something you'd do. Enjoy!
entries.translated: Celebrul 'Ode to a Molten Chocolate Cake' a fost probabil scris de tine. Să petreci o după-amiază ploioasă în fața coșului de fum, înfășurat într-o pătură în timp ce te răsfăț cu delicii cu cacao sună exact ca ceva ce ai face. Bucurați-vă!

entries.en: You like your cake soft, with fruity bits and a nice sugar icing. And you prefer to make them by yourself. Have you ever considered opening a bakery? You must be really good by now!
entries.translated: Îți place tortul tău moale, cu bucăți de fructe și o glazură frumoasă de zahăr. Și preferați să le faceți singur. Te-ai gândit vreodată să deschizi o brutărie? Trebuie să fii cu adevărat bun până acum!

entries.en: Muahahaha it's a... mutated pumpkin! After helping to take it down - you DID help, didn't you? - you claimed your reward and got a more or less weird present. Happy Halloween!
entries.translated: Muahahaha este un... dovleac mutant! După ce te-ai ajutat să-l dai jos - ai ajutat, nu-i așa? - ți-ai revendicat recompensa și ai primit un cadou mai mult sau mai puțin ciudat. Halloween fericit!

entries.en: One of the Lightbearers. One of those who helped to keep the basins burning and worked together against the darkness. The demonic whispers behind the thin veil between the worlds - they were silenced again thanks to your help.
entries.translated: Unul dintre Purtătorii de Lumină. Unul dintre cei care au ajutat la menținerea bazinelor aprinse și au lucrat împreună împotriva întunericului. Șoaptele demonice din spatele vălului subțire dintre lumi - au fost din nou reduse la tăcere datorită ajutorului tău.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.translated: Zawiera czerwone i zielone zarodniki. Zbierz trochę NIEBIESKICH zarodników

entries.translated: Zawiera zarodniki czerwone, zielone i niebieskie. Zbierz trochę ŻÓŁTYCH zarodników

entries.en: It contains red, green, blue and yellow spores. Deliver it to the gnomes
entries.translated: Zawiera zarodniki czerwone, zielone, niebieskie i żółte. Dostarcz to gnomom

entries.en: With some luck you might be able to pluck a grindstone from the formation.
entries.translated: Przy odrobinie szczęścia być może uda ci się wyrwać kamień szlifierski z formacji.

entries.en: You have to deliver the Whetstone while it is still hot. It will crumble within one hour
entries.translated: Musisz dostarczyć Osełkę, póki jest jeszcze gorąca. Rozpadnie się w ciągu godziny

entries.en: The little pig needs to be returned to its keeper within an hour
entries.translated: Świnkę należy zwrócić właścicielowi w ciągu godziny

entries.en: A true staff of old, spitting slimy orbs
entries.translated: Prawdziwa laska starych, plujących śluzowatymi kulami

We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Of course you do! Go hunt down the thieves and bring back the stuff they have stolen from me. ...
entries.translated: Certo che lo fai! Vai a dare la caccia ai ladri e riporta indietro la roba che mi hanno rubato. ...

entries.en: I saw them running out of town and then to the north. Maybe they hide at the oasis.
entries.translated: Li ho visti correre fuori città e poi verso nord. Forse si nascondono nell'oasi.

entries.en: What are you talking about?? I was robbed!!!! Someone catch those filthy thieves!!!!! GUARDS! ...
entries.translated: Di cosa stai parlando?? Sono stato derubato!!!! Qualcuno catturi quegli schifosi ladri!!!!! GUARDIE! ...

entries.en: <nothing happens>....<SIGH> Like usual, they hide at the slightest sign of trouble! YOU! Want to earn some quick money?
entries.translated: <non succede nulla>....<SIGH> Come al solito, si nascondono al minimo segno di guai! VOI! Vuoi guadagnare qualche soldo velocemente?

entries.en: You need some forged documents? But I will only forge something for a friend. ...
entries.translated: Hai bisogno di documenti falsificati? Ma creerò qualcosa solo per un amico. ...

entries.en: The nomads at the northern oasis killed someone dear to me. Go and kill at least one of them, then we talk about your document.
entries.translated: I nomadi dell'oasi settentrionale hanno ucciso una persona a me cara. Vai e uccidine almeno uno, poi parliamo del tuo documento.

entries.en: The slayer of my enemies is my friend! For a mere 1000 gold I will create the documents you need. Are you interested?
entries.translated: L'uccisore dei miei nemici è mio amico! Per soli 1000 oro creerò i documenti di cui hai bisogno. Sei interessato?

entries.en: I see: You want me to add an additional story to this book. A legend about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer. I could do that, yes. It costs 5000 gold, however. Are you still interested?
entries.translated: Capisco: vuoi che aggiunga un'ulteriore storia a questo libro. Una leggenda racconta che uccidere un cervo bianco porta sfortuna. Potrei farlo, sì. Tuttavia, costa 5000 monete d'oro. Sei ancora interessato?

entries.en: And here they are! Now forget where you got them from.
entries.translated: Ed eccoli qui! Ora dimentica da dove li hai presi.

entries.en: GREAT! If you ever need a job as my personal security guard, let me know. Here is the reward I promised you.
entries.translated: GRANDE! Se mai avessi bisogno di un lavoro come mia guardia di sicurezza personale, fammelo sapere. Ecco la ricompensa che ti ho promesso.

entries.en: Come back when you find my stuff.
entries.translated: Torna quando trovi la mia roba.

entries.en: You need 5000 gps and book with ancient legends.
entries.translated: Hai bisogno di 5000 gps e prenota con antiche leggende.

entries.en: You are not in this mission.
Good! Me make shiny weapon. If you help me, I make one for you too. Like axe I wear. I need stuff. Listen. ...
entries.translated: Bene! Faccio un'arma scintillante. Se mi aiuti ne faccio uno anche per te. Come l'ascia che indosso. Ho bisogno di cose. Ascoltare. ...

entries.en: Me need 100 iron ore. Then need crude iron. Then after that 50 behemoth fangs. And 50 lizard leather. You understand?
entries.translated: Mi servono 100 minerali di ferro. Allora serve ferro grezzo. Poi 50 zanne di colosso. E 50 pelle di lucertola. Capisci?

entries.en: YOURS? WHAT IS YOURS! NOTHING IS YOURS! IS MINE! GO AWAY, YES?!
entries.translated: IL TUO? QUAL È IL TUO! NIENTE È TUO! È MIO! ANDARE VIA, SI?!

entries.translated: Приветствую, что я могу для вас сделать?

entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: I can sell you potions, weapons and armor. Say {trade} to browse my goods.
entries.translated: Я могу продать тебе зелья, оружие и броню. Скажите {trade}, чтобы просмотреть мои товары.

entries.en: Have you heard? Dragons were spotted near the mountains!
entries.translated: Вы слышали? Dragons были замечены возле гор!

entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: I can see in your eyes that you are a honest and friendly person, |PLAYERNAME|. You were patient enough to learn our language and I will grant you a special gift. Will you accept it?
entries.translated: Văd în ochii tăi că ești o persoană sinceră și prietenoasă, |PLAYERNAME|. Ai avut suficientă răbdare să înveți limba noastră și îți voi acorda un cadou special. O vei accepta?

entries.en: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the wolf girl. You shall be fast and smart as Morgrar, the great white wolf. He shall guide your path.
entries.translated: De acum înainte, vei fi cunoscută ca |PLAYERNAME|, fata lupului. Vei fi rapid și deștept ca Morgrar, marele lup alb. El vă va călăuzi calea.

entries.en: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the bear warrior. You shall be strong and proud as Angros, the great dark bear. He shall guide your path.
entries.translated: De acum înainte, vei fi cunoscut ca |PLAYERNAME|, războinicul urs. Vei fi puternic și mândru ca Angros, marele urs întunecat. El vă va călăuzi calea.

entries.en: Great riddle, isn't it? If you can tell me the correct answer, \z I will give you something. Hehehe!
entries.translated: Mare ghicitoare, nu-i așa? Dacă îmi poți spune răspunsul corect, \z îți voi da ceva. Hehehe!

entries.en: Great riddle, isn't it? If you can tell me the correct answer, I will give you something. Hehehe!
entries.translated: Mare ghicitoare, nu-i așa? Daca imi poti spune raspunsul corect, iti dau ceva. Hehehe!

entries.en: My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics?
entries.translated: Numerele mele suprareale se bazează pe fapte uimitoare. Ești interesat să înveți secretul matematicii?

entries.en: I think you are not in touch with yourself, come back if you have tuned in on your own feelings.
entries.translated: Cred că nu ești în contact cu tine însuți, revino dacă te-ai conectat la propriile sentimente.

entries.en: My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. \z Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics?
entries.translated: Numerele mele suprareale se bazează pe fapte uimitoare. \z Ești interesat să înveți secretul matematicii?
Mai întâi mai luați niște mere!

entries.en: Then take it and get happy - or die, hehe.
entries.translated: Atunci ia-l și fii fericit - sau mori, hehe.

entries.en: You already know the secrets of mathemagics! Now go and use them to learn.
entries.translated: Știi deja secretele matematicii! Acum du-te și folosește-le pentru a învăța.

entries.en: But first tell me your favourite colour please!
entries.translated: Dar mai întâi spune-mi culoarea ta preferată, te rog!

entries.en: I was captured and tortured to death by the cultists here. They worship a being that they call Ghazbaran ...
entries.translated: Am fost capturat și torturat până la moarte de către cultiştii de aici. Ei se închină unei ființe pe care o numesc Ghazbaran...

entries.en: In his name they have claimed the mines and started to melt the ice to free an army of vile demons that have been frozen here for ages ...
entries.translated: În numele lui, au revendicat minele și au început să topească gheața pentru a elibera o armată de demoni ticăloși care au fost înghețați aici de secole...

entries.en: Their plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans must learn about it! Hurry before its too late.
entries.translated: Planul lor este să creeze o nouă armată de demoni pentru ca stăpânul lor să cucerească lumea. Hjaern și ceilalți șamani trebuie să învețe despre asta! Grăbește-te înainte să fie prea târziu.

entries.en: This old cape might be worth more than what it looks like
entries.translated: Această pelerină veche ar putea valora mai mult decât arată

entries.en: You swapped it with Bozo's crate of wine flasks
entries.translated: L-ai schimbat cu lada lui Bozo cu pahare de vin

entries.en: It is filled with delicious cream pies
entries.translated: Este umplută cu plăcinte cu cremă delicioase

entries.en: Use it on the cauldron slide to keep the fire burning
entries.translated: Folosiți-l pe toboganul cazanului pentru a menține focul aprins

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: For the Daughter of the Stars!
Finally someone notices I'm a FROG. Congratulations, you're VERY observant... *sigh*
entries.translated: Äntligen märker någon att jag är en GRODA. Grattis, du är VÄLDIGT observant... *suck*

entries.en: A quest? Yeah I got a quest! Go and tell King Tibianus his son tried to kiss me again!
entries.translated: Ett uppdrag? Ja, jag har ett uppdrag! Gå och berätta för kung Tibianus att hans son försökte kyssa mig igen!

entries.en: Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.
entries.translated: Pyrale? Den idioten förvandlade mig till en människa en gång. Men min fru kom och kysste mig, så jag är en groda igen.

entries.en: Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.
entries.translated: Pyrale? Den idioten förvandlade mig till en människa en gång. Men min fru kom och kysste mig, så jag är en groda igen.

entries.en: You will now be travelled out of here. Are you sure that you want to face that teleport?
entries.translated: Du kommer nu att resas härifrån. Är du säker på att du vill möta den där teleporteringen?

entries.en: Then stay here in these ghostly halls.
entries.translated: Stanna då här i dessa spöklika salar.

entries.en: Once I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
entries.translated: En gång var jag medlem i mardrömsriddarnas orden. Nu är jag bara en skugga som går i dessa kalla salar.

entries.en: The north has a puzzle to complete.
entries.translated: Norr har ett pussel att slutföra.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!
reductor de habilidad del lanzador perdido

entries.en: Entering the Shadow Nexus. Abandon all Hope.
entries.translated: Wejście do Nexusa Cieni. Porzuć wszelką nadzieję.

entries.en: Entering the Mirror Maze of Madness.
You are cutting some desert rose blossoms.
You are cutting some snake maw.
You are cutting some veldt flowers.
You have found a gryphon mask.
You have found a mirror mask.
You have found a silver mask.
You are gathering some spiderweb cloud shreds. But you become entangled.
entries.translated: Zbierasz strzępy chmur pajęczych. Ale ty się wplątujesz.

entries.en: The Ambassador tells another dignitary: Rathleton must never be surpassed! I will procure that the Empire falters!
entries.translated: Ambasador mówi innemu dygnitarzowi: Rathleton nigdy nie może zostać przekroczony! Sprawię, że Imperium upadnie!

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see the Ambassador of Rathleton wearing a cloak with a black sphinx on it.
entries.translated: Przez bramę wymiarową możesz zobaczyć Ambasadora Rathleton ubranego w płaszcz z czarnym sfinksem.

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see how the Ambassador of Rathleton is talking to Fafnar cultists in a quite familiar way. The proof is absolutely substantive. The Ambassador is a betrayer!
entries.translated: Przez bramę wymiarową możesz zobaczyć, jak Ambasador Rathleton rozmawia z kultystami Fafnar w całkiem znajomy sposób. Dowód jest całkowicie merytoryczny. Ambasador jest zdrajcą!

entries.en: You place the amethyst on the small socket. A violet flame begins to burn.
entries.translated: Umieszczasz ametyst na małym oczku. Zaczyna palić się fioletowy płomień.

entries.en: You place the ruby on the small socket. A red flame begins to burn.
entries.translated: Umieszczasz rubin na małym oczku. Zaczyna palić się czerwony płomień.
Modo de autoloot establecido a TODO.

entries.en: Someone is fighting in the soulpit!
entries.translated: Qualcuno sta combattendo nella fossa dell'anima!

entries.en: This book tells you about a spell that draws its wielder towards the most energetic being next to him.
entries.translated: Questo libro racconta di un incantesimo che attira chi lo impugna verso l'essere più energico accanto a lui.

entries.en: It consists of four parts wich have been scratched out of this book. They need to be read in conjunction with chants.
entries.translated: Si compone di quattro parti che sono state cancellate da questo libro. Devono essere letti insieme ai canti.

entries.en: You have to wait to challange this enemy again!
entries.translated: Devi aspettare per sfidare nuovamente questo nemico!

entries.en: The ashes swirl with a life of their own, mixing with the sparks of the altar.
entries.translated: Le ceneri vorticano con vita propria, mescolandosi con le scintille dell'altare.

entries.en: You have already got your brain
You have found an incantation fragment.
entries.translated: Hai trovato un frammento di incantesimo.

entries.en: Reading the parchment, you identify three human tallow candles and pocket them.
entries.translated: Leggendo la pergamena, identifichi tre candele di sego umane e le metti in tasca.

entries.en: You now look like a Necromancer.
You see water as far as the eye can reach. No sea serpent in sight.
entries.translated: Vedi l'acqua a perdita d'occhio. Nessun serpente marino in vista.

entries.en: It's getting away! You should tell the captain to gain speed!
entries.translated: Si sta allontanando! Dovresti dire al capitano di prendere velocità!

entries.en: There are multiple shadows under the surface. This has to be the right location.
entries.translated: Ci sono più ombre sotto la superficie. Questa deve essere la posizione giusta.

entries.en: You can not enter a protection zone after attacking another player.
entries.translated: Non puoi entrare in una zona di protezione dopo aver attaccato un altro giocatore.

entries.en: Attention! The container assigned to category {0} is full.
entries.translated: Attenzione! Il contenitore assegnato alla categoria {0} è pieno.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: The forged key unlocks the door.
The forged key unlocks the door.
The forged key unlocks the door.
You have not learned all the verses of the hymn
entries.translated: Вы не выучили все стихи гимна

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You have already received your reward.
You need to defeat Goshnar's Megalomania to receive your reward.
entries.translated: Чтобы получить награду, вам нужно победить «Манию величия» Гошнара.

entries.en: The arena is already in use.
The arena is already in use.
A player with this name does not exist.
entries.translated: Игрока с таким именем не существует.

entries.en: A player with this name does not exist.
entries.translated: Игрока с таким именем не существует.

entries.en: You have found a wooden cage key.
entries.translated: Ați găsit o cheie de cușcă de lemn.

entries.en: You discover an owl resting in a tree. Thats special, because you have never seen an owl in all of Kilmaresh.
entries.translated: Descoperi o bufniță care se odihnește într-un copac. Este special, pentru că nu ai văzut niciodată o bufniță în tot Kilmaresh.

entries.en: You fill some of the fine chalk into a bucket.
entries.translated: Umpleți o parte din creta fină într-o găleată.

entries.en: You have already got your brain
You have found an incantation fragment.
entries.translated: Ați găsit un fragment de incantație.

entries.en: Reading the parchment, you identify three human tallow candles and pocket them.
entries.translated: Citind pergamentul, identifici trei lumânări umane de seu și le pui în buzunar.

entries.en: You now look like a Necromancer.
Witout any points of orientation you will never find your way back. Try to find a way to improve your navigation.
entries.translated: Fără niciun punct de orientare nu vei găsi niciodată drumul înapoi. Încercați să găsiți o modalitate de a vă îmbunătăți navigarea.

entries.en: You can not use this portal yet.
entries.translated: Nu puteți utiliza încă acest portal.

entries.en: You have discovered an old writing desk that contains an ancient map.
entries.translated: Ați descoperit un birou vechi care conține o hartă veche.

entries.en: You took too long, the battle has ended.
entries.translated: Ai luat prea mult timp, bătălia s-a încheiat.

entries.en: You have completed the food offering ritual!
entries.translated: Ai finalizat ritualul de ofertă de mâncare!

entries.en: You must wait. Someone is challenging Furious Scorpion now.
entries.translated: Trebuie să aștepți. Cineva îl provoacă pe Scorpionul Furios acum.

entries.en: You can not enter a protection zone after attacking another player.
entries.translated: Nu poți intra într-o zonă de protecție după ce ai atacat un alt jucător.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. {Footballs} trebuie achiziționate separat.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: The vial is glittering with starlight now.
entries.translated: La fiala ora brilla di luce stellare.

entries.en: As soon as you're pouring out the vial over the dreambird tree the plant is infused with starlight. The barrier strengthens.
entries.translated: Non appena verserai la fiala sull'albero dell'uccello dei sogni, la pianta sarà infusa dalla luce delle stelle. La barriera si rafforza.

entries.en: As soon as you're pouring out the vial over the dreambird tree the plant is infused with starlight. This was the last tree.
entries.translated: Non appena verserai la fiala sull'albero dell'uccello dei sogni, la pianta sarà infusa dalla luce delle stelle. Questo era l'ultimo albero.

entries.en: You are rubbing the gem in the sun catcher's centre but nothing happens.
entries.translated: Stai strofinando la gemma al centro dell'acchiappasole ma non succede nulla.

entries.en: The sun has to be shining in order to strengthen the barrier. Wait for the day.
entries.translated: Il sole deve splendere per rafforzare la barriera. Aspetta il giorno.

entries.en: The sun catcher is shining with sunlight now.
entries.translated: L'acchiappasole ora risplende di luce solare.

entries.en: As soon as you're placing the sun catcher on the stone the pattern the mosaic is infused with sunlight. The barrier strengthens.
entries.translated: Non appena si posiziona l'acchiappasole sulla pietra, il motivo del mosaico viene infuso di luce solare. La barriera si rafforza.

entries.en: As soon as you're placing the sun catcher on the stone the pattern the mosaic is infused with sunlight. This was the last mosaic.
entries.translated: Non appena si posiziona l'acchiappasole sulla pietra, il motivo del mosaico viene infuso di luce solare. Questo è stato l'ultimo mosaico.

entries.en: This can only be used between 1st of April and 1st of May.
entries.translated: Può essere utilizzato solo dal 1° aprile al 1° maggio.

entries.en: You hold the skull up high. You can resist the urge to have it look through a telescope though.
entries.translated: Tieni il teschio in alto. Puoi però resistere alla tentazione di guardarlo attraverso un telescopio.

entries.en: That's definitely one of the highest spots in whole Tibia. If that's not simply perfect you don't know what it is.
entries.translated: Questo è sicuramente uno dei posti più alti dell'intero Tibia. Se non è semplicemente perfetto non sai cosa sia.

entries.en: What a beautiful view. Worthy of a Queen indeed! Time to head back to Lazaran and show him what you got.
entries.translated: Che bella vista. Degno di una regina davvero! È ora di tornare da Lazaran e mostrargli quello che sai fare.

entries.en: You hold up the skull and let it take a peek over the beautiful elven town through the dense leaves.
entries.translated: Sollevi il teschio e gli lasci dare una sbirciatina sulla bellissima città degli elfi attraverso le fitte foglie.

entries.en: Thanita gives you a really strange look as you hold up the skull, but oh well.
entries.translated: Thanita ti lancia uno sguardo davvero strano mentre sollevi il teschio, ma vabbè.

entries.en: That was a real easy one. And you are used to getting strange looks now, so whatever!
entries.translated: È stato davvero facile. E adesso sei abituato a ricevere sguardi strani, quindi qualunque cosa!

entries.en: Wow, it's hot up here. Luckily the skull can't get a sunburn any more, but you can, so you better descend again!
entries.translated: Wow, fa caldo qui. Per fortuna il teschio non può più scottarsi, ma tu sì, quindi è meglio scendere di nuovo!

entries.en: Considering that higher places around here aren't that easy to reach, you think the view from here is tolerably good.
entries.translated: Considerando che i posti più alti da queste parti non sono così facili da raggiungere, pensi che la vista da qui sia abbastanza buona.

entries.en: Yep, that's a pretty high spot. If Lazaran ever sees what the skull sees, he'd be pretty satisfied with that nice view.
entries.translated: Sì, è un punto piuttosto alto. Se Lazaran vedesse mai ciò che vede il teschio, sarebbe piuttosto soddisfatto di quella bella visione.

entries.en: Well, there are higher spots around here, but none of them is as easily reachable as this one. It just has to suffice.
entries.translated: Beh, ci sono punti più alti da queste parti, ma nessuno di questi è facilmente raggiungibile come questo. Deve solo bastare.

entries.en: Nice! White in white as far as the eye can see. Time to leave before your fingers turn into icicles.
entries.translated: Carino! Bianco nel bianco a perdita d'occhio. È ora di andarsene prima che le tue dita si trasformino in ghiaccioli.

entries.en: Grimvale drowns in werecreatures as the full moon reaches its apex and ancient evil returns.
entries.translated: Grimvale тонет в существах-оборотнях, когда полная луна достигает апогея и возвращается древнее зло.

entries.en: You need to wait %s before trying to challenge %s again!
entries.translated: Вам нужно подождать %s, прежде чем снова пытаться бросить вызов %s!

entries.en: The Ambassador tells another dignitary: Rathleton must never be surpassed! I will procure that the Empire falters!
entries.translated: Посол говорит другому высокопоставленному лицу: Rathleton никогда нельзя превзойти! Я добьюсь того, чтобы Империя пошатнулась!

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see the Ambassador of Rathleton wearing a cloak with a black sphinx on it.
entries.translated: Через межпространственные врата вы можете увидеть Посла Rathleton в плаще с черным сфинксом.

entries.en: Congratulations! You completed %s arena, you should take your reward now.
entries.translated: Поздравляем! Вы завершили арену %s, теперь вы должны получить свою награду.

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see how the Ambassador of Rathleton is talking to Fafnar cultists in a quite familiar way. The proof is absolutely substantive. The Ambassador is a betrayer!
entries.translated: Через межпространственные врата можно увидеть, как Посол Rathleton вполне знакомым языком разговаривает с культистами Фафнара. Доказательство абсолютно существенное. Посол — предатель!

entries.en: You place the amethyst on the small socket. A violet flame begins to burn.
entries.translated: Вы помещаете аметист в маленькое гнездо. Фиолетовое пламя начинает гореть.

entries.en: You place the ruby on the small socket. A red flame begins to burn.
entries.translated: Вы помещаете рубин в маленькое гнездо. Красное пламя начинает гореть.

entries.en: You place the sapphire on the small socket. A blue flame begins to burn.
entries.translated: Вы помещаете сапфир в маленькое гнездо. Голубое пламя начинает гореть.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the golden statue: And the mighty lion defeated the greedy hyaena.
entries.translated: С помощью старого свитка вы переводите надписи на золотой статуе: И могучий лев победил жадную гиену.

entries.en: As a sign of victory he tooks its blood, red as voracity and lust, and created a precious treasure.
entries.translated: В знак победы он взял его кровь, красную, как жадность и похоть, и создал драгоценное сокровище.

entries.en: With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the floor: And the mighty lion defeated the lazy lizard.
entries.translated: С помощью старого свитка переводите надписи на полу: И могучий лев победил ленивую ящерицу.

entries.en: As a sign of victory he tooks its egg, blue as sloth and conceit, and out of a foul creature created a precious treasure.
entries.translated: В знак победы он взял ее яйцо, голубое, как лень и тщеславие, и создал из мерзкого существа драгоценное сокровище.

entries.en: With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the golden altar: And the mighty lion defeated the treacherous scorpion.
entries.translated: С помощью старого свитка вы переводите надписи на золотом алтаре: И могучий лев победил коварного скорпиона.

entries.en: As a sign of victory he tooks its poison, violet as deceit and betrayal, and created a precious treasure.
entries.translated: В знак победы он принимает ее яд, фиолетовый, как обман и предательство, и создает драгоценное сокровище.

entries.en: With the aid of the old scroll you translate the inscriptions on the floor: And the mighty lion defeated the jealous snake.
entries.translated: С помощью старого свитка вы переводите надписи на полу: И могучий лев победил ревнивого змея.

entries.en: As a sign of victory he tooks its eye, yellow as envy and malevolence, and out of a foul creature created a precious treasure.
entries.translated: В знак победы он отобрал у него глаз, желтый, как зависть и злоба, и создал из мерзкого существа драгоценное сокровище.

entries.en: You place the topaz on the small socket. A yellow flame begins to burn.
entries.translated: Вы помещаете топаз в маленькое гнездо. Желтое пламя начинает гореть.

entries.en: You haven't used the poison on Kraknaknork's soup yet. Don't try to fight him before that - or he will definitely kill you.
entries.translated: Încă nu ai folosit otrava din supa lui Kraknaknork. Nu încerca să te lupți cu el înainte de asta - sau el te va ucide cu siguranță.

entries.en: This orc has turned his back to you and is obviously taking a break. Use the rolling pin on him to knock him out!
entries.translated: Acest orc ți-a întors spatele și, evident, ia o pauză. Folosește sucitorul pe el pentru a-l doborî!

entries.en: You sneaked into the orc fortress. Careful now, don't go outside again.
entries.translated: Te-ai strecurat în fortăreața orcilor. Atenție acum, nu mai ieși afară.

entries.en: Got your tarantula trap ready? You might need to use it soon...
entries.translated: Ți-ai pregătit capcana pentru tarantule? S-ar putea să fie nevoie să-l folosești în curând...

entries.en: The bank is below the academy. Go north and head down the stairs and to the right.
entries.translated: Banca este sub academie. Mergeți spre nord și coborâți scările și la dreapta.

entries.en: Go to the right to find the bank and talk to Paulie.
entries.translated: Du-te la dreapta pentru a găsi banca și vorbește cu Paulie.

entries.en: Follow the way to the east and go south to reach the graveyard.
entries.translated: Urmați drumul spre est și mergeți spre sud pentru a ajunge la cimitir.

entries.en: Head through the northern door and follow the hallways to find the library vault.
entries.translated: Treceți prin ușa de nord și urmați holurile pentru a găsi seiful bibliotecii.

entries.en: Follow the path to the east to find Hyacinth's little house.
entries.translated: Urmați poteca spre est pentru a găsi căsuța lui Hyacinth.

entries.en: The library vault is below the academy. Go north and head down several stairs until you find a quest door.
entries.translated: Seiful bibliotecii este sub academie. Mergeți spre nord și coborâți câteva scări până când găsiți o ușă de căutare.

entries.en: You don't have the bag with the items yet. Open the door in the basement of the academy to the left of Paulie to get them!
entries.translated: Nu ai încă geanta cu articolele. Deschide ușa din subsolul academiei din stânga lui Paulie pentru a-i lua!

entries.en: This is not the way to the crypt. Go south to reach the graveyard.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către criptă. Mergi spre sud pentru a ajunge la cimitir.

entries.en: This is not the way to Hyacinth. Stay on the path a little more to the south to find Hyacinth's little house.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către Hyacinth. Rămâneți pe potecă puțin mai spre sud pentru a găsi căsuța lui Hyacinth.

entries.en: This is not the way to the tarantula's lair. Head northwest and go up the little ramp.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către bârlogul tarantulei. Îndreptați-vă spre nord-vest și urcați pe mica rampă.

entries.en: This is not the way to the troll caves. Follow the path to the north past the hill to reach them.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către peșterile trolilor. Urmați poteca spre nord, trecând de deal pentru a ajunge la ele.

entries.en: This is not the way to the wasps' lair. Choose the northern path to reach it.
entries.translated: Acesta nu este drumul către bârlogul viespilor. Alegeți calea nordică pentru a ajunge la ea.

entries.en: Follow the path to the north, cross the bridge to the south and walk west to reach the orc fortress.
entries.translated: Urmați poteca spre nord, traversați podul spre sud și mergeți spre vest pentru a ajunge la fortăreața orcilor.

entries.en: Follow the path to the west to reach the orc fortress.
entries.translated: Urmați poteca spre vest pentru a ajunge la cetatea orcilor.

entries.en: This road is the main access of the village. You might want to finish your business here first.
entries.translated: Acest drum este principalul acces al satului. Poate doriți să vă terminați afacerea aici mai întâi.

entries.en: Very nice! Food for me! Sell it to me, fast! Once you sold your food to me, just say {ready} to let me know you are done.
entries.translated: Mycket trevligt! Mat till mig! Sälj den till mig, snabbt! När du sålt din mat till mig, säg bara {ready} för att meddela mig att du är klar.

entries.en: Good bye traveller and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
entries.translated: Hej då resenären och njut av din vistelse på Rookgaard.

entries.en: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! As a tailor and merchant I have to say - we need to do something about your {outfit}, shall we?
entries.translated: Var hälsad, |PLAYERNAME|! Som skräddare och handlare måste jag säga - vi måste göra något åt ​​din {outfit}, eller hur?

entries.en: Hey, I thought you were going to run away, but luckily you came back. I'll show you how to change your {outfit}, okay?
entries.translated: Hej, jag trodde att du skulle fly, men som tur var kom du tillbaka. Jag ska visa dig hur du ändrar din {outfit}, okej?

entries.en: Welcome back! You know, after providing my little outfit service, I like to ask a little favour of you. Can you {help} me?
entries.translated: Välkommen tillbaka! Du vet, efter att ha tillhandahållit min lilla outfitservice, vill jag be dig om en liten tjänst. Kan du {help} mig?

entries.en: Oh hey |PLAYERNAME|, you didn't answer my question yet - could you help me get some {food}? I'll even give you some gold for it.
entries.translated: Åh hej |PLAYERNAME|, du har inte svarat på min fråga ännu - kan du hjälpa mig att få lite {food}? Jag ska till och med ge dig lite guld för det.

entries.en: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...
entries.translated: Дакле, дошли сте, |PLAYERNAME|. Надао сам се да нећеш...

entries.en: Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?
entries.translated: Здраво! Шта је то, шта си {want}?

entries.en: Greetings humans! Consider yourselfs lucky, I'm in need of {help}.
entries.translated: Поздрав људи! Сматрајте да сте срећни, треба ми {help}.

entries.en: Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?
entries.translated: Ха? ста? могу да видим! Вау! Не-мино. Да ли су и вама {capture}?

entries.en: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
entries.translated: Здраво? Како то мислиш 'hi' - зар не видиш да сам ја... Морам да стишам глас. Да ли вам је пало на памет да овај 'chalice' не жели да га узнемиравате?! Остави ме на миру!

entries.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
entries.translated: Шта је ово? Ентитет са оптичким изазовом који се зове |PLAYERNAME|. Како фасцинантно!

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Буди оплакиван ходочасник у телу. Продајем општу робу. Само ме замоли за {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my offers.
You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Пажљиво прегледаш свитке. То су наређења од Rathleton за амбасадора. Овде нема знакова издаје.

entries.en: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow
entries.translated: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Brothers, why does the ignorant world still consider death their enemy and end of life? It is not folly? Death is but the portal, not the end; it is but an artificial hindrance to ward off the lesser spirits from the realm of the mighty; and the gods put it up to prevent us Chosen from ascension to their own powers, and threaten their dominion. These shackles to our existence are unnatural; but it is natural to rebel and to seek power, yes, to gain power, to exert power! Brothers, we must overcome this hindrance set up by the jealous gods and claim our rightful place! We are the masters of the living and undead, the true lords of the created, and nothing shall stop us from achieving what we seek.
entries.translated: Братья, почему невежественный мир до сих пор считает смерть своим врагом и концом жизни? Это не глупость? Смерть — это всего лишь портал, а не конец; это всего лишь искусственное препятствие, призванное отогнать меньших духов из царства сильных; и боги устроили это, чтобы помешать нам, Избранным, обрести свои силы и поставить под угрозу их владычество. Эти оковы нашего существования неестественны; но бунтовать и стремиться к власти естественно, да, получать власть, проявлять власть! Братья, мы должны преодолеть это препятствие, созданное ревнивыми богами, и занять свое законное место! Мы — повелители живых и нежити, истинные повелители всего сотворенного, и ничто не помешает нам достичь того, что мы ищем.

entries.en: Digging. Not a single trace of any door or even a window. Maybe home of some obscure cult of darkness? Maybe creatures of the night? A hideout for ghouls? Maybe I am working not hard enough. Hm, there seems to be a strange spot there at the wall, I can see it clearly from here. I shall try to push or pull it right away! Fame and riches, here I come!
entries.translated: Săpat. Nici o urmă de vreo ușă sau măcar de fereastră. Poate căminul unui cult obscur al întunericului? Poate creaturi ale nopții? O ascunzătoare pentru ghouls? Poate că nu muncesc suficient. Hm, pare să fie un loc ciudat acolo la perete, îl văd clar de aici. Voi încerca să o împing sau să o trag imediat! Faimă și bogății, iată-mă!

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.

entries.translated: Pilnuj dobrze swojego kamienia poszukiwacza przygód.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
