entries.en: The very moment you walk down the dune to head back south, rays of light burst over your head in a shock wave that makes you tumble down the rest of the hill. ...
entries.translated: Chiar în momentul în care cobori dună pentru a te întoarce spre sud, razele de lumină îți izbucnesc peste cap într-o undă de șoc care te face să prăbușești pe restul dealului. ...

entries.en: As your eyes adjust to the sudden reduction of brightness, you see the giant wings of the gate before you move to the side. You can also make out something shiny on the ground.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce ochii tăi se adaptează la reducerea bruscă a luminozității, vezi aripile uriașe ale porții înainte de a te deplasa în lateral. De asemenea, puteți distinge ceva strălucitor pe pământ.

entries.en: You pick the mirror from the ground.

A broad darkness surrounds you as if a heavy curtain is closing before your eyes. After what seems like minutes of floating through emptiness, you get the feeling as if a hole opens in the dark before you. ...
entries.translated: Un întuneric larg te înconjoară ca și cum o perdea grea s-ar închide în fața ochilor tăi. După ceea ce par minute de plutire prin gol, ai senzația că o gaură se deschide în întuneric înaintea ta. ...

entries.en: The hole grows larger, you cannot close your eyes. An unimaginable black. Deeper and darker than any nothingness you could possibly imagine drags you into it. ...
entries.translated: Gaura devine mai mare, nu poți închide ochii. Un negru de neimaginat. Mai adânc și mai întunecat decât orice nimic pe care ți-ai putea imagina că te trage în ea. ...

entries.en: You feel as if you cannot breathe anymore. The very second you let loose of your consciousness, you sense all heaviness around you lifted. ...
entries.translated: Simți că nu mai poți respira. Chiar în clipa în care îți eliberezi conștiința, simți că toată greutatea din jurul tău este ridicată. ...

entries.en: You dive into an ocean of emerald light. Feeling like born anew the colour around you is almost overwhelming. Countless objects of all shapes and sizes are dashing past you. Racing against each other, millions are clashing in the distance. ..
entries.translated: Te scufunzi într-un ocean de lumină de smarald. Să te simți ca și cum te-ai născut din nou culoarea din jurul tău este aproape copleșitor. Nenumărate obiecte de toate formele și dimensiunile trec peste tine. Concurând unul împotriva celuilalt, milioane se ciocnesc în depărtare. ..

entries.en: The loudness of the gargantuan spectacle around you bursts your hearing, yet you absorb all the sounds around you. ...
entries.translated: Sunetul spectacolului uriaș din jurul tău îți sparge auzul, dar absorbi toate sunetele din jurul tău. ...

entries.en: As several large obstacles move aside directly in front of you, an intense bright centre leaps into your view. Though you cannot perceive how fast you are, your pace seems too slow. ...
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce mai multe obstacole mari se îndepărtează direct în fața ta, un centru intens luminos iese în vizorul tău. Deși nu poți percepe cât de repede ești, ritmul tău pare prea lent. ...

entries.en: Ever decelerating, you ultimately approach a middle in this chaos of tones of green. ...
entries.translated: Decelerând mereu, în cele din urmă te apropii de mijlocul acestui haos de tonuri de verde. ...

entries.en: As you come closer to it, yellowish shades of orange embrace you, softer shapes emerge and you almost forget the mayhem before. In warm comfort you see what lies in the heart of it all. ...
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce te apropii de ea, nuanțe gălbui de portocaliu te îmbrățișează, ies forme mai moi și aproape că uiți de haos înainte. Într-un confort cald, vezi ce se află în inima tuturor. ...

entries.en: A majestic dragon in his sleep is surrounded by what seems the warmth and energy of a thousand suns. The tranquillity of its sight makes you smile gently. ...
entries.translated: Un dragon maiestuos în somn este înconjurat de ceea ce pare căldura și energia a o mie de sori. Liniștea vederii sale te face să zâmbești blând. ...

entries.en: You feel a perfect mixture of joy, compassion and sudden peacefulness. Bright xanthous impressions of topaz, orange and white welcome you at the final halt of your journey. ...
entries.translated: Simți un amestec perfect de bucurie, compasiune și liniște bruscă. Impresii strălucitoare de topaz, portocaliu și alb vă întâmpină la capătul final al călătoriei. ...

entries.en: You find yourself inside the dragon's dream. You can {look} around or {go} into a specific direction. You can also {take} or {use} an object. Enter {help} to display this information at any time.
entries.translated: Te regăsești în visul dragonului. Puteți {look} în jurul sau {go} într-o anumită direcție. De asemenea, puteți {take} sau {use} un obiect. Introduceți {help} pentru a afișa aceste informații în orice moment.

entries.en: You are now prepared to enter the realm of the evildoer. I am grateful for your help, wayfarer. Should you seek my council, use this charm I cede to you. For my spirit will guide you wherever you are. May you enjoy a sheltered future, you shall prevail.
entries.translated: Acum ești pregătit să intri în tărâmul răufăcătorului. Sunt recunoscător pentru ajutorul tău, călător. Dacă vrei să-mi cauți sfatul, folosește acest farmec pe care ți-l cedez. Căci spiritul meu te va călăuzi oriunde te-ai afla. Fie ca tu să te bucuri de un viitor adăpostit, vei învinge.

entries.en: I assume you need to get through the gate to reach the evildoer. I can help you if you trust me, wayfarer. I will share a part of my mind with you which should enable you to step through the gate. ...
entries.translated: Presupun că trebuie să treci prin poartă pentru a ajunge la răufăcător. Te pot ajuta dacă ai încredere în mine, călător. Îți voi împărtăși o parte din mintea mea, care ar trebui să-ți permită să treci prin poartă. ...

entries.en: This procedure may be exhausting. Are you prepared to receive my key?
entries.translated: Această procedură poate fi epuizantă. Ești pregătit să-mi primești cheia?

entries.en: The eternal love is awarded by TibiaTR.net
entries.translated: Dragostea eternă este premiată de TibiaTR.net

entries.en: This doll seems to be the favourite doll of the emperor. It was awarded by TibiaJourney.com
entries.translated: Această păpușă pare să fie păpușa preferată a împăratului. A fost premiat de TibiaJourney.com

entries.en: The song inside is made of love. It was rewarded by TibiaSpace.com
entries.translated: Cântecul din interior este făcut din dragoste. A fost recompensat de TibiaSpace.com

entries.en: This little critter just loves slime fungus
entries.translated: Această creatură mică iubește ciuperca de slime

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: Bow to the power of the iron bull!
My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. \z Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics?
entries.translated: Mina surrealistiska siffror är baserade på häpnadsväckande fakta. \z Är du intresserad av att lära dig matematikens hemlighet?

entries.en: Then take it and get happy - or die, hehe.
entries.translated: Ta det då och bli glad – eller dö, hehe.

entries.en: You already know the secrets of mathemagics! Now go and use them to learn.
entries.translated: Du känner redan till matematikens hemligheter! Gå nu och använd dem för att lära dig.

entries.en: But first tell me your favourite colour please!
entries.translated: Men berätta först för mig din favoritfärg!

entries.en: I was captured and tortured to death by the cultists here. They worship a being that they call Ghazbaran ...
entries.translated: Jag blev tillfångatagen och torterad till döds av sekterna här. De dyrkar en varelse som de kallar Ghazbaran ...

entries.en: In his name they have claimed the mines and started to melt the ice to free an army of vile demons that have been frozen here for ages ...
entries.translated: I hans namn har de gjort anspråk på minorna och börjat smälta isen för att befria en armé av avskyvärda demoner som har varit frusna här i evigheter ...

entries.en: Their plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans must learn about it! Hurry before its too late.
entries.translated: Deras plan är att skapa en ny demonarmé för deras herre att erövra världen. Hjaern och de andra shamanerna måste lära sig om det! Skynda dig innan det är för sent.

entries.en: With your eyes covered and avoiding direct sight of the rays, you put the mirror into the stand. ...
entries.translated: Med ögonen täckta och undvikande av direkt syn på strålarna sätter du spegeln i stativet. ...

entries.en: Instinctively you run to a larger emerald bluff near the raise to find cover. Mere seconds after you claimed the sturdy shelter, a deep dark humming starts to swirl through the air. ...
entries.translated: Instinktivt springer du till en större smaragdbluff nära höjningen för att hitta skydd. Bara sekunder efter att du gjort anspråk på det robusta skyddet börjar ett djupt mörkt brummande virvla genom luften. ...

entries.en: Seconds pass as the hum gets louder. The noise is maddening, drowning all other sounds around you. As you cover your ears in pain, the humming explodes into a deafening growl. ...
entries.translated: Sekunder går när surret blir högre. Ljudet är irriterande och dränker alla andra ljud runt omkring dig. När du täcker för öronen av smärta exploderar brummandet i ett öronbedövande morrande. ...

entries.en: You raise your head above the edge of the emerald to catch a glimpse of what's happening. ...
entries.translated: Du höjer huvudet ovanför kanten av smaragden för att få en glimt av vad som händer. ...

entries.en: The hand seems to have grown into a fist. In the distance you can now see a blurry scheme of a creature too large for your eyes to get a sharper view of its head. ...
entries.translated: Handen verkar ha växt till en knytnäve. På avstånd kan du nu se ett suddigt schema av en varelse som är för stor för dina ögon för att få en skarpare bild av huvudet. ...

entries.en: Blending the rays, the mirror directs pure white light directly towards the part where you assume the face of the creature. ...
entries.translated: Genom att blanda strålarna riktar spegeln rent vitt ljus direkt mot den del där du antar varelsens ansikte. ...

entries.en: The growl transforms into a scream, everything around you seems to compress. As you press yourself tightly against the bluff, everything falls silent and in a split second, the dark being dissolves into bursts of blackness. You wake.
entries.translated: Morret förvandlas till ett skrik, allt runt omkring dig verkar komprimeras. När du trycker dig hårt mot bluffen tystnar allt och på en bråkdel av en sekund löses mörkret upp i skurar av svärta. Du vaknar.

entries.en: You lunge out and throw the model far into the water. As nothing happens, you turn your back to the ocean. ...
entries.translated: Du gör ett utfall och kastar modellen långt ner i vattnet. Eftersom ingenting händer, vänder du ryggen till havet. ...

entries.en: The very moment you walk down the dune to head back south, rays of light burst over your head in a shock wave that makes you tumble down the rest of the hill. ...
entries.translated: I samma ögonblick som du går nerför dynen för att gå tillbaka söderut, sprider ljusstrålar över ditt huvud i en chockvåg som får dig att ramla nerför resten av backen. ...

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.translated: Ta misja śmierdzi... a teraz ty też!

entries.en: You carefully gather the stalker blood.
%s damaged the shadow nexus! You can't damage it while it's burning.
entries.translated: %s uszkodził nexus cienia! Nie możesz go uszkodzić, gdy się pali.

entries.en: %s destroyed the shadow nexus! In 10 seconds it will return to its original state.
entries.translated: %s zniszczył nexus cienia! Za 10 sekund powróci do pierwotnego stanu.

entries.en: You flipped the {0} lever. Hurry up and find the next one!
entries.translated: Przestawiłeś dźwignię {0}. Pospiesz się i znajdź następny!

entries.en: You have touched Infernatil's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Dotknąłeś tronu Infernatila i wchłonąłeś część jego ducha.

entries.en: You have touched Tafariel's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Dotknąłeś tronu Tafariela i wchłonąłeś część jego ducha.

entries.en: You have touched Verminor's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Dotknąłeś tronu Verminora i wchłonąłeś część jego ducha.

entries.en: You have touched Apocalypse's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Dotknąłeś tronu Apocalypse i wchłonąłeś część jego ducha.

entries.en: You have touched Bazir's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Dotknąłeś tronu Bazira i wchłonąłeś część jego ducha.

entries.en: You have touched Ashfalor's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Dotknąłeś tronu Ashfalora i wchłonąłeś część jego ducha.

entries.en: You have touched Pumin's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Dotknąłeś tronu Pumina i wchłonąłeś część jego ducha.

entries.en: A batch of documents has been stashed in the shelf. These might be of interest to Zalamon.
entries.translated: Na półce ukryto partię dokumentów. To może zainteresować Zalamona.

entries.en: You dig out a skull from the pile of bones. That must be the skull Lazaran talked about.
entries.translated: Ze stosu kości wykopujesz czaszkę. To musi być ta czaszka, o której mówił Lazaran.

entries.en: To buy some time you replace the fish with a piece of carrot.
entries.translated: Aby zyskać na czasie, zastępujemy rybę kawałkiem marchewki.

entries.en: These stairs lead up to the roof of the academy. Up there you should find TWO of the catapults.
entries.translated: Te schody prowadzą na dach akademii. Tam na górze powinieneś znaleźć DWIE katapulty.

entries.en: This is the house Vascalir mentioned. You should find a stone pile in the cellar. Use it to get a stone!
entries.translated: To jest dom, o którym wspomniał Vascalir. W piwnicy powinieneś znaleźć stos kamieni. Użyj go, aby zdobyć kamień!

entries.en: This is Norma's bar. If you go to the roof, you should find one of the catapults that need to be filled with stones.
entries.translated: To jest bar Normy. Jeśli wejdziesz na dach, powinieneś znaleźć jedną z katapult, które należy wypełnić kamieniami.

entries.en: This is Obi's shop. Up on his roof you should find one of the catapults Vascalir mentioned.
entries.translated: To jest sklep Obi. Na jego dachu powinieneś znaleźć jedną z katapult, o których wspomniał Vascalir.

entries.en: This is not the way to Hyacinth. Follow the path to the east to find Hyacinth's little house.
entries.translated: To nie jest droga do Hiacynta. Podążaj ścieżką na wschód, aby znaleźć mały domek Hiacynta.

entries.en: You need to wait before using it again.
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać zanim użyjesz tego ponownie.

entries.en: You need to wait before using it again.
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać zanim użyjesz tego ponownie.

entries.en: You need to wait before using it again.
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać zanim użyjesz tego ponownie.

entries.en: Are you tired of leveling slow? try it!
entries.translated: Czy jesteś zmęczony powolnym zdobywaniem poziomów? spróbuj!

entries.en: This is a fantastic mount that helps to become faster, try it!
entries.translated: To fantastyczny wierzchowiec, który pomaga stać się szybszym, wypróbuj go!

entries.en: The first rider of this mount became the leader of his country! legends say that.
entries.translated: Pierwszy jeździec tego wierzchowca został przywódcą swojego kraju! legendy tak mówią.

entries.en: Are you hunted? Tired of that? Get a new name, a new life!
entries.translated: Czy jesteś ścigany? Masz dość tego? Zdobądź nowe imię, nowe życie!

entries.en: This outfit looks nice. Only high-class people are able to wear it!
entries.translated: Ten strój wygląda ładnie. Mogą go nosić tylko ludzie z klasą!

entries.en: Legend says only smart people should wear it, otherwise you will burn!
entries.translated: Legenda głosi, że powinni go nosić tylko mądrzy ludzie, w przeciwnym razie spalisz się!

entries.en: You activated a prey but do not like the randomly selected bonus? Roll for a new one! Here you can purchase five Prey Bonus Rerolls! \nA Bonus Reroll allows you to get a bonus with a higher value (max. 50%). The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The 2 hours hunting time will start anew once you have rolled for a new bonus. Your prey monster will stay the same.
entries.translated: Aktywowałeś ofiarę, ale nie podoba Ci się losowo wybrany bonus? Rzuć się na nowy! Tutaj możesz kupić pięć Prey Bonus Rerolls! \nA Bonus Reroll pozwala uzyskać bonus o wyższej wartości (maks. 50%). Bonus dla twojej ofiary zostanie wybrany losowo spośród następujących: zwiększenie obrażeń, redukcja obrażeń, dodatkowe PD, ulepszone łupy. 2-godzinny czas polowania rozpocznie się od nowa, gdy wylosujesz nowy bonus. Twój potwór-ofiara pozostanie taki sam.

entries.en: It's hunting season! Activate a prey to gain a bonus when hunting a certain monster. Every character can purchase one Permanent Prey Slot, which enables the activation of an additional prey. \nIf you activate a prey, you can select one monster out of nine. The bonus for your prey will be selected randomly from one of the following: damage boost, damage reduction, bonus XP, improved loot. The bonus value may range from 5% to 50%. Your prey will be active for 2 hours hunting time: the duration of an active prey will only be reduced while you are hunting.
entries.translated: To sezon polowań! Aktywuj ofiarę, aby zyskać premię podczas polowania na określonego potwora. Każda postać może kupić jedno stałe miejsce na zdobycz, które umożliwia aktywację dodatkowej ofiary. \nJeśli aktywujesz ofiarę, możesz wybrać jednego potwora z dziewięciu. Bonus dla twojej ofiary zostanie wybrany losowo spośród następujących: zwiększenie obrażeń, redukcja obrażeń, dodatkowe PD, ulepszone łupy. Wartość bonusu może wynosić od 5% do 50%. Twoja ofiara będzie aktywna przez 2 godziny polowania: czas trwania aktywnej ofiary zostanie skrócony tylko podczas polowania.

entries.en: Need a quick way home? Buy this transportation service to get instantly teleported to your home temple. \n\nNote, you cannot use this service while having a battle sign or a protection zone block. Further, the service will not work in no-logout zones or close to your home temple.
entries.translated: Potrzebujesz szybkiej drogi do domu? Kup tę usługę transportu, aby natychmiast zostać teleportowanym do swojej domowej świątyni. \n\nUwaga, nie możesz korzystać z tej usługi, jeśli masz znak bojowy lub blokadę strefy ochronnej. Co więcej, usługa nie będzie działać w strefach, w których nie można się wylogować ani w pobliżu Twojej domowej świątyni.

entries.en: You already have an active XP boost.

entries.translated: Modo de autoloot establecido a TODO.

entries.en: [World Change] Yasir has arrived in %s today!
No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.translated: Per entrare è necessario almeno il livello 250.

entries.en: You have already completed this step.
You take the dreamcurse on yourself!
entries.translated: Prendi su di te la maledizione del sogno!

entries.en: Attention! The loot you are trying to pick up is too heavy for you to carry.
entries.translated: Attenzione! Il bottino che stai cercando di raccogliere è troppo pesante per essere trasportato.

entries.en: You can only withdraw up to {0} items at a time from the stash.
entries.translated: Puoi prelevare solo fino a {0} articoli alla volta dalla scorta.

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
entries.translated: Ricorda: se sei gravemente ferito o avvelenato, posso curarti gratuitamente.

entries.en: Nature's blessing, traveller! May you not be affected by any sinister force.
entries.translated: Una benedizione della natura, viaggiatore! Possa tu non essere influenzato da nessuna forza sinistra.

entries.en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
entries.translated: Druid Крунора? Он вам рассказал, что здесь появилась новая пещера? Это верно. Я руководитель {project}, который пытается узнать больше об этом новом {area}.

entries.en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a project that tries to find out more about this new area.
entries.translated: Druid Крунора? Он вам рассказал, что здесь появилась новая пещера? Это верно. Я руководитель проекта, который пытается узнать больше об этой новой области.

entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.translated: Bună |PLAYERNAME|. Sunt fermier și bucătar, poate te pot interesa într-un {trade} cu mâncare? De asemenea, puteți să-mi cereți {hints} general despre joc.

entries.en: Hi there, |PLAYERNAME|! You look like you are eager to {trade}!
entries.translated: Bună ziua, |PLAYERNAME|! Arăți de parcă ești dornic să {trade}!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Muritor! Dacă ești pe un {quest} pentru a-i sluji pe zeul sângelui, stăpânul meu - fii salutat!

entries.en: Goodbye. I am sure you will come back for more. They all do.
entries.translated: La revedere. Sunt sigur că vei reveni pentru mai multe. Toate o fac.

entries.en: Grimvale drowns in werecreatures as the full moon reaches its apex and ancient evil returns.
entries.translated: Grimvale тонет в существах-оборотнях, когда полная луна достигает апогея и возвращается древнее зло.

entries.en: You need to wait %s before trying to challenge %s again!
entries.translated: Вам нужно подождать %s, прежде чем снова пытаться бросить вызов %s!

entries.en: The Ambassador tells another dignitary: Rathleton must never be surpassed! I will procure that the Empire falters!
entries.translated: Посол говорит другому высокопоставленному лицу: Rathleton никогда нельзя превзойти! Я добьюсь того, чтобы Империя пошатнулась!

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see the Ambassador of Rathleton wearing a cloak with a black sphinx on it.
entries.translated: Через межпространственные врата вы можете увидеть Посла Rathleton в плаще с черным сфинксом.

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see how the Ambassador of Rathleton is talking to Fafnar cultists in a quite familiar way. The proof is absolutely substantive. The Ambassador is a betrayer!
entries.translated: Через межпространственные врата можно увидеть, как Посол Rathleton вполне знакомым языком разговаривает с культистами Фафнара. Доказательство абсолютно существенное. Посол — предатель!

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: You must wait. Someone is challenging
entries.translated: Вы должны подождать. Кто-то бросает вызов

entries.en: Congratulations! You completed %s arena, you should take your reward now.
entries.translated: Поздравляем! Вы завершили арену %s, теперь вы должны получить свою награду.

entries.en: You've been into the skirmish in the last 10 hours.
entries.translated: Вы участвовали в перестрелке последние 10 часов.

entries.en: You need a premium account to access this area.
entries.translated: Для доступа к этой области вам понадобится премиум-аккаунт.

entries.en: Respect and honour to you, champion!
Witout any points of orientation you will never find your way back. Try to find a way to improve your navigation.
entries.translated: Без каких-либо ориентиров вы никогда не найдете дорогу назад. Попробуйте найти способ улучшить свою навигацию.

entries.en: You see the scattered parts of a wrecked ship. Miraculously the ship telescope survived the wreck it seems still to be intact.
entries.translated: Вы видите разбросанные части разбитого корабля. Корабельный телескоп чудом уцелел после крушения и, кажется, до сих пор цел.

entries.en: You use the hawser to lash up the loose planks. The raft should be seaworthy now.
entries.translated: Вы используете трос, чтобы связать оторвавшиеся доски. Теперь плот должен быть готов к плаванию.

entries.en: There are still some loose planks and hawsers. You can't use the raft like this, it will sink for sure.
entries.translated: Есть еще несколько незакрепленных досок и тросов. Так плотом пользоваться нельзя, он наверняка утонет.

entries.en: The dread's torment is killing you!
The dread's torment is now lethal!

entries.en: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...

entries.en: Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?

entries.en: Greetings humans! Consider yourselfs lucky, I'm in need of {help}.

entries.en: Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?
entries.translated: Ха? ста? могу да видим! Вау! Не-мино. Да ли су и вама {capture}?

entries.en: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
entries.translated: Здраво? Како то мислиш 'hi' - зар не видиш да сам ја... Морам да стишам глас. Да ли вам је пало на памет да овај 'chalice' не жели да га узнемиравате?! Остави ме на миру!

entries.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
entries.translated: Шта је ово? Ентитет са оптичким изазовом који се зове |PLAYERNAME|. Како фасцинантно!

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Буди оплакиван ходочасник у телу. Продајем општу робу. Само ме замоли за {trade}.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

3c) Usar software no oficial para jugar

entries.en: I lost my key to the crypts below while I was fishing in the port. This is especially bad because those trolls hid my precious trumpet somewhere down there.
entries.translated: Zgubiłem klucz do krypt poniżej, gdy łowiłem ryby w porcie. Jest to szczególnie złe, ponieważ te trolle ukryły gdzieś tam moją cenną trąbkę.

entries.en: I only buy fresh corpses of rats, rabbits and wolves, as well as bear paws, wolf paws and minotaur
entries.translated: Kupuję tylko świeże zwłoki szczurów, królików i wilków, a także łapy niedźwiedzia, łapy wilka i minotaura

entries.en: I overheared the greenskined brutes. 'charach' (or so) one said and the other responded the same way, then they began to chat in their strange language, certainly talking about some gruesome plot against mankind. Talking they wandered away and after they vanished from my view I quickly got up and headed to Thais as fast as I could.
entries.translated: Podsłuchałem zielonoskórych brutali. 'charach' (mniej więcej) jeden powiedział, drugi odpowiedział w ten sam sposób, po czym zaczęli rozmawiać w swoim dziwnym języku, z pewnością rozmawiając o jakimś makabrycznym spisku przeciwko ludzkości. Rozmawiając, odeszli, a kiedy zniknęli mi z pola widzenia, szybko wstałem i udałem się do Thais tak szybko, jak tylko mogłem.

entries.en: "I see" the sorcerer said, "that this bridge will break down and fall into the water within 60 minutes. So we have to hurry up. It will only hold two of us at the same time and it is a long bridge. The wounded knight will need 25 minutes to go over the bridge, and it will take me 20. The paladin can go faster, so he will be on the other side within 10 minutes."
entries.translated: „Widzę” – powiedział czarnoksiężnik – „że ten most zawali się i w ciągu 60 minut wpadnie do wody. Musimy się więc spieszyć. Pomieści nas tylko dwóch jednocześnie i jest to długi most. Ranny rycerz będzie potrzebował 25 minut na przejście przez most, a mnie zajmie to 20. Paladyn może jechać szybciej, więc w ciągu 10 minut będzie po drugiej stronie.”

entries.en: I stopped counting the days, because I lost all feeling for time down here.
entries.translated: Przestałam liczyć dni, bo tutaj na dole straciłam poczucie czasu.

entries.en: I, Tarberi of House of Winter, hereby pledge my services to the Lord of... (the rest of the document is stained and burnt)
entries.translated: Ja, Tarberi z Domu Zimy, niniejszym ślubuję swoje usługi Panu... (reszta dokumentu jest poplamiona i spalona)

entries.en: I think I found out some coordinates for the Island Dianscher.
I was one of the first who was allowed to teleport through the magic web.
entries.translated: Byłem jednym z pierwszych, którym pozwolono teleportować się przez magiczną sieć.

entries.en: I will have you know that those tricks you played on the more gullible of our fellow brothers have been entertaining for a while i admit. However, they severely interfere with my instructions, as the fake chant syllables distort the fabric of our songs. Continue, and we shall punish you.
entries.translated: Chcę, żebyś wiedział, że te sztuczki, które płatałeś bardziej naiwnym współbraciom, przyznaję, bawią już od jakiegoś czasu. Jednakże poważnie kolidują z moimi instrukcjami, ponieważ fałszywe sylaby pieśni zniekształcają strukturę naszych piosenek. Kontynuuj, a my cię ukarzemy.

entries.en: I will honour the godly spark in my soul.
entries.translated: Będę szanować boską iskrę w mojej duszy.

entries.en: I wonder where this all might lead us ...
entries.translated: Zastanawiam się, dokąd nas to wszystko może zaprowadzić…

entries.en: I won't dig any more stupid dungeons unless the mining company provides me better tools!
entries.translated: Nie będę kopał więcej głupich lochów, chyba że firma wydobywcza zapewni mi lepsze narzędzia!

entries.en: If the suspect claims that he has no trouble at all, ask him if he thinks that the lack of trouble is explained by the FORESIGHT of the AUTHORITIES. If he denies, he is to be observed for heretical tendencies. If he agrees, ask him if he thinks that it is ALSO for the GODS' will that he has no trouble. If he disagrees, he is to be observed for heretical tendencies. If the subject does not show any suspicious b haviour at this point, ask him if he thinks that any TROUBLE will arise in the near FUTURE. If he negates, he obviously will become lax in the line of his duty and he is to be observed for heretical tendencies. If he confirms that trouble might arise, continue as in paragraph II.
entries.translated: Jeśli podejrzany twierdzi, że nie ma żadnych kłopotów, zapytaj go, czy uważa, że ​​brak kłopotów tłumaczy się PRZEWIDYWALNOŚCIĄ WŁADZ. Jeśli zaprzeczy, należy go obserwować pod kątem skłonności heretyckich. Jeśli się zgodzi, zapytaj go, czy uważa, że ​​RÓWNIEŻ wolą BOGÓW jest, aby nie sprawiał kłopotów. Jeśli się nie zgodzi, należy go obserwować pod kątem skłonności heretyckich. Jeśli badany nie wykazuje w tym momencie żadnego podejrzanego zachowania, zapytaj go, czy sądzi, że w najbliższej PRZYSZŁOŚCI pojawią się jakieś KŁOpoty. Jeśli zaprzeczy, w oczywisty sposób rozluźni się w wypełnianiu swoich obowiązków i należy go obserwować pod kątem tendencji heretyckich. Jeśli potwierdzi, że mogą wystąpić problemy, postępuj zgodnie z punktem II.

entries.en: If we release the power of the might rings without being able to control it, then this power will destroy our whole city immediatly.
entries.translated: Jeśli uwolnimy moc pierścieni mocy, nie będąc w stanie jej kontrolować, wówczas moc ta natychmiast zniszczy całe nasze miasto.

entries.en: If you are no dwarf don't even try to think that you have a chance of mastering the art of tunnelling. If you are a dwarf I wish you good luck and don't abandon faith. There is a light at the end of the tunnel.
entries.translated: Jeśli nie jesteś krasnoludem, nawet nie próbuj myśleć, że masz szansę opanować sztukę drążenia tuneli. Jeśli jesteś krasnoludem, życzę Ci powodzenia i nie porzucaj wiary. Jest światełko w tunelu.

entries.en: There are still some loose planks and hawsers. You can't use the raft like this, it will sink for sure.
entries.translated: Есть еще несколько незакрепленных досок и тросов. Так плотом пользоваться нельзя, он наверняка утонет.

entries.en: You use the hawser to lash up the loose planks. The raft should be seaworthy now.
entries.translated: Вы используете трос, чтобы связать оторвавшиеся доски. Теперь плот должен быть готов к плаванию.

entries.en: Witout any points of orientation you will never find your way back. Try to find a way to improve your navigation.
entries.translated: Без каких-либо ориентиров вы никогда не найдете дорогу назад. Попробуйте найти способ улучшить свою навигацию.

entries.en: You must wait. Someone is challenging
entries.translated: Вы должны подождать. Кто-то бросает вызов

entries.en: A phial of fresh pond water. It looks crystal clear and sparkles a little.
entries.translated: O fiolă cu apă proaspătă de iaz. Arată limpede și strălucește puțin.

entries.en: You feel very refreshed and relaxed.
entries.translated: Te simți foarte împrospătat și relaxat.

entries.en: You need to wait a while, recently someone challenge Frozen Horror.
entries.translated: Trebuie să așteptați puțin, recent cineva provoacă Frozen Horror.

entries.en: You have completed the ghost detector task.
entries.translated: Ați finalizat sarcina detector de fantome.

entries.en: Seems that an old silver key appears in the drower.
entries.translated: Se pare că o cheie de argint veche apare în dâră.

entries.en: You are gently squishing some of the honey palm blossoms and golden honey is depping into the jug.
entries.translated: Strângeți ușor câteva dintre florile de palmier cu miere și mierea aurie se varsă în ulcior.

entries.en: You need to wait 15 minutes to use again.
entries.translated: Trebuie să așteptați 15 minute pentru a utiliza din nou.

entries.en: Everyone in this place will be teleported into Glooth Fairy's hideout in one minute. No way back!!!
entries.translated: Toți cei din acest loc vor fi teleportați în ascunzătoarea lui Glooth Fairy într-un minut. Nicio cale de întoarcere!!!

entries.en: First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
entries.translated: Сначала вам нужно будет убить трех носителей чумы, а затем получить Формулы алхимиков. Когда это будет сделано, возвращайтесь либо к Палимуту (хорошая сторона), либо к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона).

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: You joined the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. Ask Grizzly Adams for some hunting tasks. You already gained %d points. You currently have %d boss points.
entries.translated: Вы присоединились к '__PH0__'. Попросите Гризли Адамса выполнить несколько охотничьих заданий. Вы уже набрали %d баллов. На данный момент у вас есть %d очков босса.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
entries.translated: Porozmawiaj z pustelnikiem Eremo na wyspie Cormaya o tym blogoslawienstwie.

entries.en: Hm? Oh! Oh, yes a... visitor! Intruder? Benefactor...? Wha- what are you? If you want to pass through this cave, I may have to disappoint you. Or maybe not. It... depends. So, just passing through?
entries.translated: Hm? Och! Och, tak, g... gość! Intruz? Dobroczyńca...? Czym... czym ty jesteś? Jeśli chcesz przejść przez tę jaskinię, mogę cię rozczarować. A może nie. To... zależy. Więc, tylko przechodzisz?

entries.en: Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
entries.translated: Masz tyle czasu, ile potrzebujesz, żeby zdecydować, czego chcesz!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Aby zobaczyć oferty kupca, po prostu porozmawiaj z nim lub z nią i poproś o {trade}. Chętnie pokażą ci swoje oferty, a także rzeczy, które od ciebie kupują.

entries.en: Hey, where are you going? We've just started!
entries.translated: Hej, dokąd idziesz? Przecież dopiero zaczęliśmy!

entries.en: It's .. It's YOU! At last!! So what's this special proposal you would like to make, my friend?
entries.translated: To... to TY! Wreszcie!! Więc jaka to wyjątkowa propozycja, którą chcesz mi złożyć, mój przyjacielu?

entries.en: Farewell, I hope you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: Żegnaj, mam nadzieję, że byłeś zadowolony z naszych usług.

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}!
entries.translated: Witaj, witaj, |PLAYERNAME|! Wejdź, obejrzyj i kup! Jeśli chcesz zobaczyć moje oferty, poproś o {trade}!

entries.en: The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
entries.translated: Król zachęcał handlarzy, żeby tu przyjeżdżali, ale tylko ja odważyłem się podjąć to ryzyko - i było to ryzyko!

entries.en: A shadow preceded you. You wish?
Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Only rarely I can welcome {visitors} these days.
entries.translated: Witaj |PLAYERNAME|! Rzadko mam teraz okazję gościć {visitors}.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Cieszę się, że mogłem ci pomóc, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Come to me if you need healing!
entries.translated: Przyjdź do mnie, jeśli potrzebujesz leczenia!

entries.en: What's your business here with the {magicians}, |PLAYERNAME|?
Good bye, and don't come back too soon.
entries.translated: Do widzenia i nie wracaj zbyt szybko.

entries.en: Welcome to our humble guild, wanderer. May I be of any assistance to you?
entries.translated: Witaj w naszej skromnej gildii, wędrowcze. Czy mogę ci jakoś pomóc?

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
EVEN WITH ALL THAT TIME IN THE PRISON THAT WEAKENED ME, YOU ARE NO MATCH TO ME!
entries.translated: AUN CON TODO ESE TIEMPO EN LA PRISIÓN QUE ME DEBILITÓ, ¡NO ERES COMPATIBLE PARA MÍ!

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
entries.translated: Ricorda: se sei gravemente ferito o avvelenato, posso curarti gratuitamente.

entries.en: You return through the semi-translucent gate to the west.
entries.translated: Te întorci prin poarta semitranslucidă spre vest.

entries.en: You head back north to the plateau.
entries.translated: Te întorci spre nord spre platou.

entries.en: You travel east across several large emerald bluffs and edges. All sorts of gems are scattered alongside your path.
entries.translated: Călătorești spre est prin mai multe blufuri și margini mari de smarald. Tot felul de pietre prețioase sunt împrăștiate pe calea ta.

entries.en: You take a rather large ruby out of a pile before you.
entries.translated: Scoți un rubin destul de mare dintr-o grămadă înaintea ta.

entries.en: You head north passing countless stones in the crimson sea of stones beneath your feet.
entries.translated: Te îndrepți spre nord trecând pe lângă nenumărate pietre în marea purpurie de pietre de sub picioarele tale.

entries.en: Avoiding the bright light, you carefully put the attachment on top of the strange socket. ...
entries.translated: Evitând lumina puternică, puneți cu grijă atașamentul deasupra prizei ciudate. ...

entries.en: Your path to the north is open. You pass the gigantic gate wings to your left and right as you advance. After about an hour of travel you hear a slight rustling in the distance. You head further into that direction. ...
entries.translated: Calea ta spre nord este deschisă. Treci de aripile gigantice ale porții în stânga și în dreapta ta pe măsură ce înaintați. După aproximativ o oră de călătorie se aude un ușor foșnet în depărtare. Te îndrepți mai departe în acea direcție. ...

entries.en: You travel all the way back down the dune and through the gate to the south.
entries.translated: Călătorești până în jos pe dună și prin poarta spre sud.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.translated: La porta sembra essere sigillata contro gli intrusi indesiderati.

entries.translated: Este incredibil de lipicios și prea dulce pentru a o mânca

entries.en: This ribbon was handcrafted by Rottin Wood and the Married Men of the forest
entries.translated: Această panglică a fost realizată manual de Rottin Wood și bărbații căsătoriți din pădure

entries.en: The wool that was stuffed under the ribbon makes the spoon look and feel like a real rabbit's foot
entries.translated: Lâna care a fost umplută sub panglică face ca lingura să arate și să se simtă ca un adevărat picior de iepure

entries.en: Adding some wool here and there would certainly make this look and feel like a real rabbit's foot
entries.translated: Adăugarea de puțină lână ici și colo ar face acest lucru să arate și să se simtă ca un adevărat picior de iepure

entries.en: You find yourself inside the dragon's dream. You can {look} around or {go} into a specific direction. You can also {take} or {use} an object. Enter {help} to display this information at any time.
entries.translated: Du befinner dig i drakens dröm. Du kan {look} runt eller {go} i en specifik riktning. Du kan också {take} eller {use} ett objekt. Ange {help} för att visa denna information när som helst.

entries.en: You are now prepared to enter the realm of the evildoer. I am grateful for your help, wayfarer. Should you seek my council, use this charm I cede to you. For my spirit will guide you wherever you are. May you enjoy a sheltered future, you shall prevail.
entries.translated: Du är nu beredd att gå in i ondskans rike. Jag är tacksam för din hjälp, vägfarare. Om du söker mitt råd, använd denna charm som jag överlåter till dig. För min ande kommer att vägleda dig var du än är. Må du njuta av en skyddad framtid, du ska segra.

entries.en: I assume you need to get through the gate to reach the evildoer. I can help you if you trust me, wayfarer. I will share a part of my mind with you which should enable you to step through the gate. ...
entries.translated: Jag antar att du måste ta dig genom porten för att nå illgäraren. Jag kan hjälpa dig om du litar på mig, vägfarare. Jag kommer att dela en del av mitt sinne med dig som borde göra det möjligt för dig att kliva in genom porten. ...

entries.en: This procedure may be exhausting. Are you prepared to receive my key?
entries.translated: Denna procedur kan vara ansträngande. Är du beredd att ta emot min nyckel?

entries.en: You find yourself inside the dragon's dream. You can {look} around or {go} into a specific direction. You can also {take} or {use} an object. Enter {help} to display this information at any time.
entries.translated: Du befinner dig i drakens dröm. Du kan {look} runt eller {go} i en specifik riktning. Du kan också {take} eller {use} ett objekt. Ange {help} för att visa denna information när som helst.

entries.en: You return through the semi-translucent gate to the west.
entries.translated: Du återvänder genom den halvgenomskinliga porten i väster.

entries.en: You head back north to the plateau.
entries.translated: Du går tillbaka norrut till platån.

entries.en: You travel east across several large emerald bluffs and edges. All sorts of gems are scattered alongside your path.
entries.translated: Du reser österut över flera stora smaragdbluffar och kanter. Alla möjliga ädelstenar är utspridda längs din väg.

entries.en: You take a rather large ruby out of a pile before you.
entries.translated: Du tar en ganska stor rubin ur en hög framför dig.

entries.en: You head north passing countless stones in the crimson sea of stones beneath your feet.
entries.translated: Du beger dig norrut och passerar otaliga stenar i det röda havet av stenar under dina fötter.

entries.en: Avoiding the bright light, you carefully put the attachment on top of the strange socket. ...
entries.translated: Undviker det starka ljuset, lägger du försiktigt fästet ovanpå det konstiga uttaget. ...

entries.en: Your path to the north is open. You pass the gigantic gate wings to your left and right as you advance. After about an hour of travel you hear a slight rustling in the distance. You head further into that direction. ...
entries.translated: Din väg norrut är öppen. Du passerar de gigantiska portvingarna till vänster och höger när du avancerar. Efter ungefär en timmes resa hör man ett lätt prasslande i fjärran. Du går vidare i den riktningen. ...

entries.en: You travel all the way back down the dune and through the gate to the south.
entries.translated: Du reser hela vägen tillbaka ner för dynen och genom porten i söder.

entries.en: You return to the crimson sea of rubies in the south.
entries.translated: Du återvänder till det röda havet av rubiner i söder.

entries.en: You travel back to the plateau in the west.
entries.translated: Du reser tillbaka till platån i väster.

entries.en: Advancing to the west, you recognise an increase of onyx on the ground.
entries.translated: När du avancerar västerut känner du igen en ökning av onyx på marken.

entries.en: Advancing to the west, you recognise an increase of onyx on the ground.
entries.translated: När du avancerar västerut känner du igen en ökning av onyx på marken.

entries.en: You continue travelling the barren sea of gemstones to the north.
entries.translated: Du fortsätter resa det karga havet av ädelstenar norrut.

entries.en: You leave the massive open gate behind you and go to the west.
entries.translated: Du lämnar den massiva öppna porten bakom dig och går västerut.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!
fuego del alma engendro del infierno
reductor de habilidades de mago furioso energizado
gran ola de drenaje de vida
reductor de habilidades de ala aterradora

entries.en: This is the crypt Vascalir was talking about. Explore it and search the coffins - one of them must hold a nice fleshy bone.
entries.translated: To jest krypta, o której mówił Vascalir. Zbadaj go i przeszukaj trumny - w jednej z nich musi znajdować się ładna, mięsista kość.

entries.en: This door seems to lead deeper into the crypt. Go downstairs and look for a special coffin. Beware of the walking dead!
entries.translated: Wydaje się, że te drzwi prowadzą w głąb krypty. Zejdź na dół i poszukaj specjalnej trumny. Uważaj na chodzące trupy!

entries.en: Now that you have a fleshy bone, it's time to find out what Vascalir wanted with it.
entries.translated: Teraz, gdy masz już mięsistą kość, czas dowiedzieć się, czego chciał od niej Vascalir.

entries.en: This sarcophagus seems special. Sarcophagi are said to conserve meat longer than normal coffins - maybe you get lucky.
entries.translated: Ten sarkofag wydaje się wyjątkowy. Mówi się, że sarkofagi przechowują mięso dłużej niż zwykłe trumny – może będziesz mieć szczęście.

entries.en: You've found the wasp tower. Kill a wasp and use the flask you got from Vascalir on its corpse to retrieve some of its poison.
entries.translated: Znalazłeś wieżę os. Zabij osę i użyj butelki otrzymanej od Vascalira na jej zwłokach, aby odzyskać część trucizny.

entries.en: Cross the bridge to the west and go south to reach the wasps' nest.
entries.translated: Przejdź przez most na zachód i idź na południe, aby dotrzeć do gniazda os.

entries.en: Beware... you're approaching Kraknaknork's room. Once you enter, you have only 5 minutes to kill him before he throws you out.
entries.translated: Uważaj... zbliżasz się do pokoju Kraknaknorka. Po wejściu masz tylko 5 minut na zabicie go, zanim cię wyrzuci.

entries.en: This chest should contain everything you need to infiltrate the fortress.
entries.translated: W tej skrzyni powinno znajdować się wszystko, czego potrzebujesz, aby przedostać się do twierdzy.

entries.en: You cannot hope to sneak past this guard. Maybe some distraction would help? You could try using the fleshy bone on him...
entries.translated: Nie możesz mieć nadziei, że przemkniesz obok tego strażnika. Może odrobina odwrócenia uwagi by pomogła? Mógłbyś spróbować użyć na nim mięsistej kości...

entries.en: Kraknaknork maintains strong energy barriers. There is only one way to disable them.
entries.translated: Kraknaknork utrzymuje silne bariery energetyczne. Jest tylko jeden sposób, aby je wyłączyć.

entries.en: This guard will definitely not let you pass. Sneak around the fortress to find a way to disguise yourself.
entries.translated: Ten strażnik na pewno Cię nie przepuści. Przekradnij się po fortecy, aby znaleźć sposób na przebranie się.

entries.en: You've managed to reach the interior of the orc fortress. Be prepared for a fight - and look for the soup cauldron.
entries.translated: Udało ci się dotrzeć do wnętrza fortecy orków. Przygotuj się na walkę i rozejrzyj się za kociołkiem z zupą.

entries.en: Those items should be what you need to infiltrate the fortress. Go back near the wasps' nest and walk south from there.
entries.translated: Te przedmioty powinny być tym, czego potrzebujesz, aby przedostać się do twierdzy. Wróć w pobliże gniazda os i idź stamtąd na południe.

entries.en: You're apperently in the kitchen. If you find a big cauldron, use the flask of wasp poison on it.
entries.translated: Najwyraźniej jesteś w kuchni. Jeśli znajdziesz duży kocioł, użyj na nim butelki z trucizną na osę.

entries.en: The energy barrier to the south temporarily disappeared.
entries.translated: Bariera energetyczna na południu chwilowo zniknęła.

entries.en: You haven't used the poison on Kraknaknork's soup yet. Don't try to fight him before that - or he will definitely kill you.
entries.translated: Nie użyłeś jeszcze trucizny na zupie Kraknaknorka. Nie próbuj z nim walczyć wcześniej, bo na pewno cię zabije.

entries.en: This orc has turned his back to you and is obviously taking a break. Use the rolling pin on him to knock him out!
entries.translated: Ten ork odwrócił się do ciebie plecami i najwyraźniej robi sobie przerwę. Użyj na nim wałka do ciasta, aby go znokautować!

entries.en: You sneaked into the orc fortress. Careful now, don't go outside again.
entries.translated: Wkradłeś się do fortecy orków. Uważaj teraz, nie wychodź więcej na zewnątrz.

entries.en: Got your tarantula trap ready? You might need to use it soon...
entries.translated: Czy masz już przygotowaną pułapkę na tarantule? Być może wkrótce będziesz musiał z niego skorzystać...

entries.en: The bank is below the academy. Go north and head down the stairs and to the right.
entries.translated: Bank znajduje się pod akademią. Idź na północ, skieruj się w dół po schodach i w prawo.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: You cannot buy hireling skill on client 10, please relog on client 12 and try again.
entries.translated: Nie możesz kupić umiejętności najemnika na kliencie 10. Zaloguj się ponownie na kliencie 12 i spróbuj ponownie.

entries.en: Error delivering your hireling lamp, try again later.
entries.translated: Błąd podczas dostawy lampy najemnej. Spróbuj ponownie później.

entries.en: You cannot have more than %s hirelings.
entries.translated: Nie możesz mieć więcej niż %s pracowników.

entries.en: Error adding item to store inbox.
entries.translated: Błąd podczas dodawania przedmiotu do skrzynki odbiorczej sklepu.

entries.en: This name is already used, please try again!
entries.translated: Ta nazwa jest już używana, spróbuj ponownie!

entries.en: You must own the outfit before you can buy its addon.
entries.translated: Musisz posiadać ten strój, zanim będziesz mógł kupić jego dodatek.

entries.en: You don't have enough coins. Your purchase has been cancelled.
entries.translated: Nie masz wystarczającej liczby monet. Twój zakup został anulowany.

entries.en: There has been an issue with your outfit purchase. Your purchase has been cancelled.
entries.translated: Wystąpił problem z zakupem stroju. Twój zakup został anulowany.

entries.en: This outfit seems not to suit your sex, we are sorry for that!
entries.translated: Ten strój wydaje się nie pasować do Twojej płci, przepraszamy za to!

entries.en: You cannot own more than %s prey wildcards.
entries.translated: Nie możesz posiadać więcej niż %s dzikich kart zdobyczy.

entries.en: Something went wrong. Your purchase has been cancelled.
entries.translated: Coś poszło nie tak. Twój zakup został anulowany.

entries.en: You cannot own more than %s reward tokens.
entries.translated: Nie możesz posiadać więcej niż %s tokenów nagród.

entries.en: You've been into the skirmish in the last 10 hours.
entries.translated: Вы участвовали в перестрелке последние 10 часов.

entries.en: You see the scattered parts of a wrecked ship. Miraculously the ship telescope survived the wreckm it seems still to be intact.

entries.en: There are still some loose planks and hawsers. You can't use the raft like this, it will sink for sure.

entries.translated: Через межпространственные врата можно увидеть, как Посол Rathleton вполне знакомым языком разговаривает с культистами Фафнара. Доказательство абсолютно существенное. Посол — предатель!

entries.en: Hey there! You don't happen to have some {food} on you, you're willing to share? Well, where are my manners, a warm welcome for now.
