entries.en: In the 23rd year of the reign of Esuph III there was a tax inspector whose greed was unrivalled by any other mortal before or after him. He let the people bleed in the name of the pharaoh and amassed huge amounts of gold, most of which somehow ended up in his own private treasury. But Shehamin, the second wife of the pharaoh, was not a woman to be fooled easily. Using cleverness and charm she brought his schemes to light and told her husband about them. Esuph III was furious, and his verdict on the fraudulent tax inspector was as cruel as it was clever: The screaming tax collector was sunk into a cauldron full of boiling gold. The terribly distorted statue which as the result of this peculiar treatment was put up in the tax office as a grim reminder that fraud can seriously affect your health. The gold that was stolen by the tax collector, however, was never found, and to this day there are many who dream about finding the unfaithful tax collector's hidden treasure.
entries.translated: W 23. roku panowania Esufa III żył inspektor podatkowy, którego chciwość nie miała sobie równych przed żadnym innym śmiertelnikiem przed nim ani po nim. Pozwolił ludziom krwawić w imię faraona i zgromadził ogromne ilości złota, z których większość jakimś cudem trafiła do jego prywatnego skarbca. Ale Szehamin, druga żona faraona, nie była kobietą, którą można było łatwo oszukać. Wykorzystując spryt i wdzięk, wydobyła na światło dzienne jego plany i opowiedziała o nich mężowi. Esuf III był wściekły, a jego werdykt w sprawie oszukańczego inspektora podatkowego był równie okrutny, co mądry: wrzeszczący celnik został zatopiony w kotle pełnym wrzącego złota. Strasznie zniekształcona statua, która w wyniku tego osobliwego traktowania została postawiona w urzędzie skarbowym jako ponure przypomnienie, że oszustwo może poważnie odbić się na zdrowiu. Złota skradzionego przez celnika nigdy jednak nie odnaleziono i do dziś wielu marzy o odnalezieniu ukrytego skarbu niewiernego poborcy podatkowego.

entries.en: In the beginning, our ancients lived in total isolation. They thought, that they can survive down here without any contact to the outside world.
entries.translated: Na początku nasi starożytni żyli w całkowitej izolacji. Myśleli, że mogą tu przetrwać bez kontaktu ze światem zewnętrznym.

entries.en: In the beginning there was only the big gaping void.
entries.translated: Na początku była tylko wielka, ziejąca pustka.

entries.en: In the civilization not all we have same skill and amount of magic power, common knowed as Mana, but it will be explained in next Book.
entries.translated: W cywilizacji nie wszyscy mamy takie same umiejętności i ilość magicznej mocy, powszechnie znanej jako Mana, ale zostanie to wyjaśnione w następnej Księdze.

entries.en: In the far northwest is the city of Carlin, that is ruled by amazons. The stuborn so called queen refuses to accept the rulership of the Thais monarchy over the whole continent.
entries.translated: Na dalekim północnym zachodzie znajduje się miasto Carlin rządzone przez amazonki. Uparty tzw. królowa nie chce zaakceptować panowania monarchii Thais nad całym kontynentem.

entries.en: * In the first stage, cake golems will attack certain cities.
entries.translated: * W pierwszym etapie ciastkowe golemy zaatakują określone miasta.

entries.en: In the old days we had to walk all the way back out of the maze and then in again.
entries.translated: W dawnych czasach musieliśmy przejść całą drogę z labiryntu i wejść z powrotem.

entries.en: In the second year of the reign of pharaoh Rahmen Tah there was a vizier who was said to consort with demons and to tamper with the powers of oblivion. He lived in a majestic tower that stood on a little island close the harbour. It was a marvel to behold, made of black glass and gold, and everybody who looked at it was filled with an eerie sense of foreboding. The vizier was rumoured to be so powerful that no one dared to bring him to justice. Even Rahmen Tah himself feared the power of his vizier, and he did not dare to send troops against the vizier. Finally he called for his chief astrologer and mathematician, the wise Athem, and asked him for advice. Athem listened quietly to the words of his pharaoh. After he had finished Athem ask his pharaoh for some time to think everything over. Reluctantly the pharaoh agreed.
entries.translated: W drugim roku panowania faraona Rahmen Taha żył wezyr, o którym mówiono, że zadaje się z demonami i manipuluje mocami zapomnienia. Mieszkał w majestatycznej wieży, która stała na małej wyspie w pobliżu portu. Był to cud, wykonany z czarnego szkła i złota, i każdy, kto na niego patrzył, miał niesamowite złe przeczucia. Krążyły pogłoski, że wezyr był tak potężny, że nikt nie odważył się postawić go przed sądem. Nawet sam Rahmen Tah obawiał się potęgi swego wezyra i nie odważył się wysłać wojsk przeciwko wezyrowi. W końcu wezwał swego głównego astrologa i matematyka, mądrego Athema, i poprosił go o radę. Athem w milczeniu słuchał słów swego faraona. Kiedy Athem skończy, poproś faraona o trochę czasu na przemyślenie wszystkiego. Faraon niechętnie się zgodził.

entries.en: In the swamps at the eastern coast of the continent lies the city of Venore. It is ruled by the money and the power of the local merchant houses.
entries.translated: Na bagnach na wschodnim wybrzeżu kontynentu leży miasto Venore. Rządzą nim pieniądze i władza lokalnych domów kupieckich.

entries.en: is in honors to her a woman and assumes the honorary name Elane.
entries.translated: na cześć niej jest kobietą i przyjmuje honorowe imię Elane.

entries.en: The flames roar and eat the bone hungrily. The Dark Lord is satisfied with your gift

entries.en: You besprinkle the antler talisman with holy water. It glitters faintly.

entries.en: You need at least level 150 to enter.
entries.translated: Per entrare è necessario almeno il livello 150.

entries.en: The words seem to breathe, stangely. One word stays in your mind: bronze

entries.en: The words seem to glow slightly. A name fixes in your mind: Takesha Antishu
entries.translated: Le parole sembrano brillare leggermente. Un nome ti fissa nella mente: Takesha Antishu

entries.en: The words seem to flutter. One word stays in your mind: floating
entries.translated: Le parole sembrano fluttuare. Una parola ti rimane in mente: fluttuare

entries.en: An invisible hand pulls you inside.
entries.translated: Una mano invisibile ti trascina dentro.

entries.en: As soon as you turn the second key a mechanism retracts the locks and swallows the keys, opening a small passage beyond.
entries.translated: Non appena si gira la seconda chiave un meccanismo ritrae le serrature e ingoia le chiavi, aprendo un piccolo passaggio al di là.

entries.en: You need to use the mechanism of the pillar itself to turn both keys at once.
entries.translated: È necessario utilizzare il meccanismo del pilastro stesso per girare entrambe le chiavi contemporaneamente.

entries.en: You reach for the onyx and trigger and enormous discharge of raw energy. It is now possible to traverse the portal in this tomb.
entries.translated: Raggiungi l'onice, il grilletto e un'enorme scarica di energia grezza. Ora è possibile attraversare il portale in questa tomba.

entries.en: You are not worthy to enter in The First Dragon's Lair yet.
entries.translated: Non sei ancora degno di entrare nella tana di The First Dragon.

entries.en: The strange symbol in the wall in the back glows violently.
entries.translated: Lo strano simbolo nel muro in fondo si illumina violentemente.

entries.en: The cult object just lies there quietly. The dangerous area around it has been all but dissolved.
entries.translated: L'oggetto di culto giace lì in silenzio. L'area pericolosa attorno ad esso è stata quasi dissolta.

entries.en: As you reach out to touch the cult object, a surge of energy burst from the skull. You banished its power.
entries.translated: Non appena ti allunghi per toccare l'oggetto di culto, un'ondata di energia esplose dal cranio. Ne hai bandito il potere.

entries.en: You have already discovered this teleport.
The lizard god accepts your offer! You may enter the santuary!
entries.translated: Il dio lucertola accetta la tua offerta! Puoi entrare nel santuario!

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
entries.translated: Песчаная буря путешествует по Дараме, приводя к островам, полным смертоносных существ внутри кошмара. Избегайте реки возле Drefia!

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You pass the fire without taking any damage. It's now or never...

entries.translated: Вы потратили слишком много времени, битва окончена.

entries.en: You have discovered an old writing desk that contains an ancient map.

entries.en: With the power of the dark Custodian still holding away, the fog is keeping you from entering Quaid's den.
entries.translated: Поскольку сила темного Хранителя все еще сдерживается, туман не дает вам войти в логово Куэйда.

You must wait. Someone is challenging Furious Scorpion now.

entries.en: First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
entries.translated: Сначала вам нужно будет убить трех носителей чумы, а затем получить Формулы алхимиков. Когда это будет сделано, возвращайтесь либо к Палимуту (хорошая сторона), либо к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона).

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: But since there were only acolytes there the nature of the prophecy was kept a secret by the priests. They called for the stranger, who seemed to have lost his memory, to be brought to the temple, where they talked to him and asked him all kinds of questions. But much to their dismay he could not give them the answers they sought, for his memory seemed to be blank like the surface of the desert after a sandstorm. However, the priests had the wisdom of the secret prophecy to guide them, and so they knew that they had to give the strangers five tasks to fulfil before they could reveal his destiny to him. And so they did, and the stranger swore he would fulfil all the tasks or die in the attempt. His first task was to travel into the desert and to find the eldest of the scarabs there, so that the priests would reveal their wisdom to him and fill his empty mind with recollections. The stranger descended deep into the burrows of the scarabs in order to face their judgement and to find answers that had been lost in the desert sand aeons ago. But the stranger never returned.
entries.translated: Но поскольку там были только послушники, жрецы держали суть пророчества в секрете. Они позвали привезти странника, как будто потерявшего память, в храм, где разговаривали с ним и задавали ему всевозможные вопросы. Но, к их большому разочарованию, он не смог дать им ответов, которые они искали, поскольку его память казалась пустой, как поверхность пустыни после песчаной бури. Однако жрецы обладали мудростью тайного пророчества, которая направляла их, и поэтому они знали, что им нужно дать незнакомцам пять заданий, которые они должны выполнить, прежде чем они смогут раскрыть ему его судьбу. Так они и сделали, и незнакомец поклялся, что выполнит все задания или погибнет при попытке. Его первой задачей было отправиться в пустыню и найти там старшего из скарабеев, чтобы жрецы раскрыли ему свою мудрость и наполнили его пустой разум воспоминаниями. Незнакомец спустился глубоко в норы скарабеев, чтобы предстать перед их судом и найти ответы, которые были потеряны в песках пустыни много веков назад. Но незнакомец так и не вернулся.

entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
EVEN WITH ALL THAT TIME IN THE PRISON THAT WEAKENED ME, YOU ARE NO MATCH TO ME!
entries.translated: AUN CON TODO ESE TIEMPO EN LA PRISIÓN QUE ME DEBILITÓ, ¡NO ERES COMPATIBLE PARA MÍ!

entries.en: Please? What you mean please? Like I say please you say bye? Please?
entries.translated: Per favore? Cosa intendi, per favore? Come ho detto, per favore, dici ciao? Per favore?

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Ragazzo fastidioso. Il fratello lo odia, ma parlare non aiuta. Il fratello ha bisogno di {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: If you want to help bro, bring him fighting spirit. Magic fighting spirit. Ask Djinn.
entries.translated: Se vuoi aiutare il fratello, portagli spirito combattivo. Spirito combattivo magico. Chiedi a Djinn.

entries.en: Bron gave me present. Ugly, but nice from him. Me want to give present too. You help me?
entries.translated: Bron mi ha fatto un regalo. Brutto, ma carino da parte sua. Anch'io voglio fare un regalo. Mi aiuti?

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Ciao, ciao, |PLAYERNAME|! Per favore entra, guarda e compra! Sono uno specialista per tutti i tipi di {tools}. Chiedimi solo un {trade} per vedere le mie offerte! Puoi anche chiedermi informazioni generali {hints} sul gioco. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Puoi anche chiedermi informazioni su ciascun {citizen} dell'isola.

entries.en: Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!
entries.translated: Stai cercando i migliori scambi? Vieni nel mio negozio!

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Sono un commerciante. Chiedimi semplicemente un {trade} per vedere le mie offerte.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Il mio nome è Al Dee, ma puoi chiamarmi Al. Posso interessarti per un {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: Si tratta di |TIME|. Mi dispiace tanto, non ho orologi da vendere. Vuoi comprare qualcos'altro?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Se vuoi esplorare i sotterranei come {sewers}, devi {equip} te stesso con le cose vitali che sto vendendo. È {vital} nel senso più profondo della parola.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Oh, il nostro sistema fognario è molto primitivo: è così primitivo che è invaso da {rats}. Ma la roba che vendo è al sicuro da loro. Chiedimi solo un {trade} per vederlo!

entries.en: The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
entries.translated: Il re incoraggiava i venditori a viaggiare fin qui, ma solo io osavo correre il rischio, e un rischio era!

entries.en: Bugs plague this isle, but my wares are bug-free, totally bug-free.
entries.translated: Gli insetti affliggono quest'isola, ma la mia merce è priva di insetti, totalmente priva di insetti.

entries.en: One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
entries.translated: Un giorno tornerò nel continente da ricco, ricchissimo!

entries.en: Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!
entries.translated: Ti senti perso? Puoi sempre chiedermi suggerimenti generali!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Ti sei mai chiesto di cosa parla la gente? Bene, una volta raggiunto il livello 8, dovresti parlare con {oracle}. Puoi scegliere un {profession} in seguito ed esplorare molto di più su Tibia.

entries.en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a project that tries to find out more about this new area.
entries.translated: Druid Крунора? Он вам рассказал, что здесь появилась новая пещера? Это верно. Я руководитель проекта, который пытается узнать больше об этой новой области.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Have you heard? Dragons were spotted near the mountains!
entries.translated: Вы слышали? Dragons были замечены возле гор!

entries.en: As the sapphire slips into the notch, the deep blue of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce safirul alunecă în crestătură, albastrul profund al pietrei se intensifică de o mie de ori. Ți-e teamă să-ți rănești ochii și să te îndepărtezi imediat. Raza pare să fie îndreptată spre centrul platoului cu o precizie uluitoare.

entries.en: You carefully lift the onyx attachment from its socket. It is lighter than you expected.
entries.translated: Ridicați cu grijă atașamentul de onix din soclu. Este mai usoara decat te asteptai.

entries.en: As the emerald slips into the notch, the vibrant green of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce smaraldul alunecă în crestătură, verdele vibrant al pietrei se intensifică de o mie de ori. Ți-e teamă să-ți rănești ochii și să te îndepărtezi imediat. Raza pare să fie îndreptată spre centrul platoului cu o precizie uluitoare.

entries.en: I call you the wayfarer. You travelled through my dreams. You ultimately freed my mind. My mind accepted you and so will I.
entries.translated: Eu te numesc călător. Ai călătorit prin visele mele. În cele din urmă mi-ai eliberat mintea. Mintea mea te-a acceptat și eu la fel.

entries.en: You return to the plateau in the east.
entries.translated: Te intorci pe platoul din est.

entries.en: You wander to the south, passing large obelisks of emerald to your left and sprawling trees of topaz to your right.
entries.translated: Te plimbi spre sud, trecând pe lângă obeliscuri mari de smarald în stânga ta și copaci întinși de topaz în dreapta ta.

entries.en: As you rip the solid stand out of its socket and take it with you, the large gate opens with a deafening rumble.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce smulgi suportul solid din priză și îl iei cu tine, poarta mare se deschide cu un zgomot asurzitor.

entries.en: You gasp at the size of the large open gate as you walk through to head further to the east.
entries.translated: Gâfâi la dimensiunea porții mari deschise în timp ce treci pentru a te îndrepta mai spre est.

entries.en: You reach for a small solitary arrangement of combined small houses and put it in your pocket.
entries.translated: Atingeți un mic aranjament solitar de case mici combinate și îl puneți în buzunar.

entries.en: You take an emerald from the pile.

Yes, well for instance I tried for some time to figure out how to enter the fiery portal in this complex. Most of the draken never come up here. They rather hide somewhere down there, planning and plotting. ...
entries.translated: Da, de exemplu, am încercat de ceva timp să-mi dau seama cum să intru în portalul de foc din acest complex. Majoritatea drakenilor nu vin niciodată aici. Mai degrabă se ascund undeva acolo jos, planificând și complotând. ...

entries.en: Then something happened, lizardfolk started to appear, searching the place. I had to retreat from my hiding place and advance through a safer position. ...
entries.translated: Apoi s-a întâmplat ceva, oameni șopârle au început să apară, cercetând locul. A trebuit să mă retrag din ascunzătoarea mea și să avansez printr-o poziție mai sigură. ...

entries.en: I needed to get close and blend in. So I came up with the ultimate disguise: a chalice. I could establish foothold right in their midst, would never be identified as an intruder and could even analyse their drinks! ...
entries.translated: Trebuia să mă apropii și să mă integrez. Așa că am venit cu deghizarea supremă: un potir. Aș putea stabili un punct de sprijin chiar în mijlocul lor, nu aș fi identificat niciodată ca un intrus și aș putea chiar să le analizez băuturile! ...

entries.en: I quickly dug a tunnel to get into what I assume is a throne room and waited for them to pick me up an carry me around! ...
entries.translated: Am săpat rapid un tunel pentru a intra în ceea ce presupun că este o sală a tronului și am așteptat ca ei să mă ia și să mă transporte! ...

entries.en: They also 'used' me a bit, you don't want to go into any details here. I am really {thirsty}.
entries.translated: De asemenea, mă 'used' un pic, nu vrei să intri în detalii aici. Sunt cu adevărat {thirsty}.

entries.en: No water then? Ah drat - er, don't worry, no problem. So, from the day I received news of the discovery of Zao, I wanted to study its inhabitants, wildlife, plants and geography. ...
entries.translated: Fără apă atunci? Ah, drăguț, nu-ți face griji, nicio problemă. Așa că, din ziua în care am primit vestea despre descoperirea Zao-ului, am vrut să-i studiez locuitorii, fauna sălbatică, plantele și geografia. ...

entries.en: The academy instated the 'Edron-Zaoan Exploration Division' shortly after. I was a founding member and head of the 'Draken' research branch. ...
entries.translated: Academia a instalat '__PH0__-Zaoan Exploration Division' la scurt timp după. Am fost membru fondator și șef al filialei de cercetare 'Draken'. ...

entries.en: Since my valued and practical oriented colleague and mentor Spectulus did not join us, there is only one member of the academy exploration division to actually venture out to see the place - me. ...
entries.translated: Deoarece colegul meu apreciat și orientat spre practică și mentorul Spectulus nu ni s-a alăturat, există un singur membru al diviziei de explorare a academiei care să se aventureze să vadă locul - eu. ...

entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: You carefully remove the sapphire from Bastesh's grasp.

entries.en: You head back to the east and to the plateau.
entries.translated: Du går tillbaka österut och till platån.

entries.en: You head back south to the site with the onyx lookout.
entries.translated: Du går tillbaka söderut till platsen med onyxutkiken.

entries.en: You return to the plateau in the east.
entries.translated: Du återvänder till platån i öster.

entries.en: You put the stand into a small recess you find near the middle of the plateau.
entries.translated: Du sätter stativet i en liten urtagning du hittar nära mitten av platån.

entries.en: As the ruby slips into the notch, the strong red of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.

entries.en: As the emerald slips into the notch, the vibrant green of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.

entries.translated: När du sliter ur det solida stativet ur dess uttag och tar det med dig, öppnas den stora porten med ett öronbedövande mullret.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: You have faced this boss in the last {0} hours.
entries.translated: Walczyłeś z tym bossem w ciągu ostatnich {0} godzin.

entries.en: Use on Silencer Plateau is located in the south-eastern part of Roshamuul
entries.translated: Zastosowanie na Płaskowyżu Tłumików znajduje się w południowo-wschodniej części Roshamuul

entries.en: You squeeze through an ancient small passage. There are small symbols carved deep into the coral you cannot read.
entries.translated: Przeciskasz się przez starożytne małe przejście. Głęboko w koralu wyryte są małe symbole, których nie można odczytać.

entries.en: The descriptions in this book look like plans detailing the launch of a large-scale assault.
entries.translated: Opisy zawarte w tej książce wyglądają jak plany szczegółowo opisujące rozpoczęcie ataku na dużą skalę.

entries.en: You have ten minutes to kill and loot this monster, else you will lose that chance and will be kicked out.
entries.translated: Masz dziesięć minut na zabicie i ograbienie tego potwora, w przeciwnym razie stracisz tę szansę i zostaniesz wyrzucony.

entries.en: You are still exhausted from your last battle.
A small island emerges out of the mist as you row towards a tiny light inside a dark, forehoding chapel.
entries.translated: Kiedy wiosłujesz w kierunku maleńkiego światła w ciemnej, złowrogiej kaplicy, z mgły wyłania się mała wyspa.

entries.en: Your heart lightens as you return from the gloomy isle.
entries.translated: Twoje serce się rozjaśnia, gdy wracasz z ponurej wyspy.

entries.en: You have ten minutes to kill and loot this monster, else you will lose that chance and will be kicked out.
entries.translated: Masz dziesięć minut na zabicie i ograbienie tego potwora, w przeciwnym razie stracisz tę szansę i zostaniesz wyrzucony.

entries.en: The Njey will appreciate your help.
entries.translated: Njey będzie wdzięczny za twoją pomoc.

entries.en: Without the help of other Njey you will probably not make enough of a difference in this battle.
entries.translated: Bez pomocy innych Njeyów prawdopodobnie nie zrobisz wystarczającej różnicy w tej bitwie.

entries.en: You are not ready to pass yet.
entries.translated: Nie jesteś jeszcze gotowy, aby przejść.

entries.en: You are not ready to pass yet.
entries.translated: Nie jesteś jeszcze gotowy, aby przejść.

entries.en: You need to wait 20 hours to face this boss again.
entries.translated: Aby ponownie zmierzyć się z tym bossem, musisz poczekać 20 godzin.

entries.en: You have sucessfully read plan A.
You have sucessfully read plan B.
You have sucessfully read plan C.
You have to wait {0} to face {1} again!
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać {0}, aby ponownie zmierzyć się z {1}!

entries.en: All players need to be level {0} or higher.
entries.translated: Wszyscy gracze muszą mieć poziom {0} lub wyższy.

entries.en: You need {0} qualified players for this challenge.
entries.translated: Do tego wyzwania potrzebujesz {0} wykwalifikowanych graczy.

entries.en: A member in your team has to wait {0} to face {1} again!
entries.translated: Członek Twojej drużyny musi poczekać {0}, aby ponownie zmierzyć się z {1}!

entries.en: You must wait {0} before using {1} again.
You have activated {0}. It will last for {1}{2}.
You or a member in your team have to wait {0} hours to face {1} again!
entries.translated: Ty lub członek Twojego zespołu musicie poczekać {0} godzin, aby ponownie zmierzyć się z {1}!

entries.en: You have reached the level limit. Choose your vocation and leave Dawnport.
entries.translated: Osiągnąłeś limit poziomu. Wybierz swoje powołanie i opuść Dawnport.

entries.en: Congratulations! You may now choose your vocation and leave Dawnport. Talk to Oressa in the temple.
entries.translated: Gratulacje! Możesz teraz wybrać swoje powołanie i opuścić Dawnport. Porozmawiaj z Oressą w świątyni.

entries.en: You cannot train your magic level any further. Travel to the mainland to improve it.
entries.translated: Nie możesz dalej trenować swojego poziomu magii. Udaj się na kontynent, aby go ulepszyć.

entries.en: You cannot train this skill any further. Travel to the mainland to improve it.
entries.translated: Nie możesz dalej trenować tej umiejętności. Udaj się na kontynent, aby go ulepszyć.

entries.en: You have lost your house because you are no longer a premium account.
entries.translated: Straciłeś dom, ponieważ nie jesteś już kontem premium.

entries.en: Your prey bonus time has been successfully reset.
entries.translated: Twój dodatkowy czas zdobyczy został pomyślnie zresetowany.

entries.en: Your prey bonus type and time have been successfully reset.
entries.translated: Rodzaj i czas premii za zdobycz zostały pomyślnie zresetowane.

entries.en: There is already an idol here. Try another altar.
entries.translated: C'è già un idolo qui. Prova un altro altare.

entries.en: As soon as you turn the second key a mechanism retracts the locks and swallows the keys, opening a small passage beyond.
entries.translated: Non appena si gira la seconda chiave un meccanismo ritrae le serrature e ingoia le chiavi, aprendo un piccolo passaggio al di là.

entries.en: You need to use the mechanism of the pillar itself to turn both keys at once.
entries.translated: È necessario utilizzare il meccanismo del pilastro stesso per girare entrambe le chiavi contemporaneamente.

entries.en: You reach for the onyx and trigger and enormous discharge of raw energy. It is now possible to traverse the portal in this tomb.
entries.translated: Raggiungi l'onice, il grilletto e un'enorme scarica di energia grezza. Ora è possibile attraversare il portale in questa tomba.

entries.en: You are not worthy to enter in The First Dragon's Lair yet.
entries.translated: Non sei ancora degno di entrare nella tana di The First Dragon.

entries.en: The flames roar and eat the bone hungrily. The Dark Lord is satisfied with your gift
entries.translated: Le fiamme ruggiscono e mangiano avidamente l'osso. Il Signore Oscuro è soddisfatto del tuo dono

entries.en: The words seem to flutter. One word stays in your mind: floating
entries.translated: Le parole sembrano fluttuare. Una parola ti rimane in mente: fluttuare

entries.en: The words seem to breathe, stangely. One word stays in your mind: bronze
entries.translated: Le parole sembrano respirare, stranamente. Una parola ti rimane in mente: bronzo

entries.en: The words seem to glow slightly. A name fixes in your mind: Takesha Antishu
entries.translated: Le parole sembrano brillare leggermente. Un nome ti fissa nella mente: Takesha Antishu

entries.en: An invisible hand pulls you inside.
entries.translated: Una mano invisibile ti trascina dentro.

entries.en: May your path always be even.
entries.translated: Possa il tuo percorso essere sempre pianeggiante.

entries.en: May your path always be even.
entries.translated: Possa il tuo percorso essere sempre pianeggiante.

entries.en: Kneel before the all-devouring power of blooded decay.
entries.translated: Inginocchiatevi davanti al potere divorante della decomposizione sanguinaria.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: You pass the fire without taking any damage. It's now or never...
entries.translated: Вы минуете огонь, не получив никакого урона. Сейчас или никогда...

entries.en: With the power of the dark Custodian still holding away, the fog is keeping you from entering Quaid's den.
entries.translated: Поскольку сила темного Хранителя все еще сдерживается, туман не дает вам войти в логово Куэйда.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You have discovered an old writing desk that contains an ancient map.
entries.translated: Вы обнаружили старый письменный стол, на котором лежит древняя карта.

entries.en: You took too long, the battle has ended.
entries.translated: Вы потратили слишком много времени, битва окончена.

entries.en: You have completed the food offering ritual!
You must wait. Someone is challenging Furious Scorpion now.
entries.translated: Вы должны подождать. Кто-то сейчас бросает вызов Яростному Скорпиону.

entries.en: Attention! The container assigned to category {0} is full.
Attention! The loot you are trying to pick up is too heavy for you to carry.
entries.translated: Внимание! Добыча, которую вы пытаетесь подобрать, слишком тяжела для вас.

entries.en: The room transforms into a completely different landscape.
entries.translated: Camera se transformă într-un peisaj complet diferit.

entries.translated: Ai așezat toți idolii pe altare și ai descuiat templul!

entries.translated: Puteți retrage numai până la {0} articole odată din depozit.

entries.translated: Vorbesti cu mine? Ei bine, continuă să vorbești, dar nu te aștepta la un răspuns.

entries.en: Hi! I hope you're not going to kill me!
entries.translated: Hi! Sper că nu o să mă omori!

entries.en: Hi there, how's it hanging, |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Bună ziua, cum e agățat, |PLAYERNAME|! Ce vă aduce {here}?

entries.en: The chants in this book often contain the word 'O'kteth.'.
entries.translated: Песни в этой книге часто содержат слово 'O'kteth.'.

entries.en: This statue has a word written on her hand: 'N'ogalu'.
entries.translated: На руке этой статуи написано слово: 'N'ogalu'.

entries.en: Grimvale drowns in werecreatures as the full moon reaches its apex and ancient evil returns.
entries.translated: Grimvale тонет в существах-оборотнях, когда полная луна достигает апогея и возвращается древнее зло.

entries.en: You need to wait %s before trying to challenge %s again!
entries.translated: Вам нужно подождать %s, прежде чем снова пытаться бросить вызов %s!

entries.en: The Ambassador tells another dignitary: Rathleton must never be surpassed! I will procure that the Empire falters!
entries.translated: Посол говорит другому высокопоставленному лицу: Rathleton никогда нельзя превзойти! Я добьюсь того, чтобы Империя пошатнулась!

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see the Ambassador of Rathleton wearing a cloak with a black sphinx on it.
entries.translated: Через межпространственные врата вы можете увидеть Посла Rathleton в плаще с черным сфинксом.

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see how the Ambassador of Rathleton is talking to Fafnar cultists in a quite familiar way. The proof is absolutely substantive. The Ambassador is a betrayer!

entries.en: It is obvious that such greatness comes not without sacrifices, but we will make sure to keep them to a minimum. All of our decisions serve a greater good, of course. Even if this is not always obvious, in the end things will work out and provide us all with a better life and a bright future.\nBased on the ruins of our former glory, it is hard to imagine how magnificent this future will be, but we, the Yalahari, still carry the vision of what we want to accomplish in our hearts. To bring this vision to life is our greatest goal which we all work towards.\nThere are elements that see their power and influence waning in these days of change. They are afraid of the things to come, and in their ignorance they cling to the rotting reality they know all too well. They created their own little niches of power and influence and feel guilty for neglecting their duties, and with that also for the decay of the city. They are surely already approaching unsuspecting outsiders to poison their minds with selfish lies. For generations the Augur, once the pride of our people, have done things the same way they had known for generations, and everyone can see where it has taken Yalahar.
entries.translated: Jest oczywiste, że taka wielkość nie wiąże się z wyrzeczeniami, ale zadbamy o to, aby były one minimalne. Oczywiście wszystkie nasze decyzje służą wyższemu dobru. Nawet jeśli nie zawsze jest to oczywiste, ostatecznie wszystko się ułoży i zapewni nam wszystkim lepsze życie i świetlaną przyszłość.\nNa podstawie ruin naszej dawnej świetności trudno sobie wyobrazić, jak wspaniała będzie ta przyszłość, ale my, Yalahari, wciąż nosimy w sercach wizję tego, co chcemy osiągnąć. Wcielenie tej wizji w życie jest naszym największym celem, do którego wszyscy dążymy.\nIstnieją elementy, których siła i wpływ słabną w tych dniach zmian. Boją się tego, co nadejdzie i w swojej niewiedzy trzymają się gnijącej rzeczywistości, którą znają aż za dobrze. Stworzyli własne nisze władzy i wpływów i czują się winni za zaniedbanie swoich obowiązków, a co za tym idzie, za upadek miasta. Z pewnością już zwracają się do niczego niepodejrzewających osób z zewnątrz, aby zatruć ich umysły samolubnymi kłamstwami. Od pokoleń Augur, niegdyś duma naszego ludu, postępował w ten sam sposób, jaki znał od pokoleń i każdy może zobaczyć, dokąd to doprowadziło Yalahar.

Ale ponieważ nikt nie będzie miał odwagi tam pojechać, nigdy nie będzie wiadomo, czy legendy są prawdziwe.

Obiecawszy zakazaną władzę i zjednoczenie z ukochanymi, niegdyś lojalny naśladowca króla, stał się pionkiem mrocznych mocy. Otruwał swego pana, prawdopodobnie przez kilka miesięcy, jakąś paskudną miksturą, którą mu podano.

entries.en: It seemed like the beholderkin, which was created by the gods as a counterweight to another race that preceded them in the god wars, was unstoppable. But, alas! In the end, they shared the same fate that most other races suffered during the god wars: Yet another race appeared on the scene which proved to be even mightier. They were well protected against the beholders' magical arsenal, and so it was only a question of time before the beholders' empire collapsed. The beholders were replaced by a succession of other races that were chosen by the dark gods to champion their cause. One race followed another, sometimes even before the previous race had become extinct. All the while, the beholders fared better than most of their successors: Owing to the fact that they had once conquered the whole world, small areas of their civilisation remained even while their once mighty cities disappeared and their mysterious pyramids crumbled to dust. Many beholders chose to hide below the surface of the world, fighting fierce underground wars to win supremacy over the other races that had fled the surface where the god wars raged on. Their successes were limited, but at least the beholders managed to establish a number of new subterranean bases, which were safe even though they lacked the grandeur of the beholders former cities.
entries.translated: Wydawało się, że beholderkin, stworzony przez bogów jako przeciwwaga dla innej rasy, która poprzedzała ich w wojnach bogów, był nie do powstrzymania. Ale, niestety! W końcu podzielił ich ten sam los, jaki spotkała większość innych ras podczas wojen bogów: na scenie pojawiła się kolejna rasa, która okazała się jeszcze potężniejsza. Byli dobrze chronieni przed magicznym arsenałem patrzących, więc upadek imperium obserwatorów był tylko kwestią czasu. Widzowie zostali zastąpieni przez szereg innych ras wybranych przez mrocznych bogów, aby bronili ich sprawy. Jedna rasa następowała po drugiej, czasem nawet zanim poprzednia rasa wymarła. Przez cały ten czas obserwatorom powodziło się lepiej niż większości ich następców: dzięki temu, że kiedyś podbili cały świat, małe obszary ich cywilizacji pozostały nawet wtedy, gdy ich niegdyś potężne miasta zniknęły, a tajemnicze piramidy rozsypały się w pył. Wielu obserwatorów zdecydowało się ukryć pod powierzchnią świata, tocząc zaciekłe podziemne wojny, aby zdobyć dominację nad innymi rasami, które uciekły z powierzchni, gdzie toczyły się boskie wojny. Ich sukcesy były ograniczone, ale przynajmniej obserwatorom udało się założyć kilka nowych podziemnych baz, które były bezpieczne, mimo że brakowało im wielkości dawnych miast obserwatorów.

entries.en: It stands to reason that the stars and the suns influence the flow of magic. The astral patterns wax and wane like the tides, and it is not possible to perform certain summonings on inappropriate days, to give but one example. The study of astrology is pointing at further influences that go well beyond summoning creatures, though. For instance, the influence of the stars and the suns seems to increase with the power level of the performed incantation or ritual. The more mana is used in a spell the more it is susceptible to extratibian influence. For this reason it seems quite safe to assume that certain powerful rituals are only possible when the stars are correctly aligned. We consequently hope to achieve through close observation and through careful calculation a measure of exactness concerning the right timing of rituals which we did not dare dream of so far. Several magic incantations we have never managed to reproduce until now might actually be achieved once we know the ideal stellar constellations. This would explain why all our previous attempts to achieve these effects were doomed to fail.
entries.translated: Jest rzeczą oczywistą, że gwiazdy i słońca wpływają na przepływ magii. Wzory astralne przybywają i zanikają jak przypływy i nie jest możliwe przeprowadzanie pewnych wezwań w nieodpowiednie dni, żeby dać tylko jeden przykład. Badania astrologiczne wskazują jednak na dalsze wpływy, które wykraczają daleko poza przywoływanie stworzeń. Na przykład wpływ gwiazd i słońc wydaje się wzrastać wraz z poziomem mocy wykonywanego zaklęcia lub rytuału. Im więcej many zużyje się na zaklęcie, tym bardziej jest ono podatne na wpływy pozatibiańskie. Z tego powodu wydaje się całkiem bezpieczne założenie, że pewne potężne rytuały są możliwe tylko wtedy, gdy gwiazdy są prawidłowo ustawione. Mamy zatem nadzieję, że poprzez uważną obserwację i uważne obliczenia uda nam się osiągnąć miarę dokładności w zakresie prawidłowego harmonogramu rytuałów, o której dotychczas nie śmialiśmy marzyć. Kilka magicznych zaklęć, których nigdy dotąd nie udało nam się odtworzyć, może faktycznie zostać zrealizowanych, gdy poznamy idealne konstelacje gwiezdne. To wyjaśniałoby, dlaczego wszystkie nasze dotychczasowe próby osiągnięcia tych efektów były skazane na niepowodzenie.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.

entries.en: You have found a piece of paper.

entries.en: The strange symbol in the wall in the back glows violently.

entries.en: The cult object just lies there quietly. The dangerous area around it has been all but dissolved.
entries.translated: Obiectul de cult stă acolo în liniște. Zona periculoasă din jurul ei a fost aproape dizolvată.

entries.en: As you reach out to touch the cult object, a surge of energy burst from the skull. You banished its power.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce întindeți mâna pentru a atinge obiectul de cult, un val de energie a izbucnit din craniu. I-ai alungat puterea.

entries.en: You don't know what to do.
First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
entries.translated: Сначала вам нужно будет убить трех носителей чумы, а затем получить Формулы алхимиков. Когда это будет сделано, возвращайтесь либо к Палимуту (хорошая сторона), либо к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона).

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

By the way: The summoning of lesser creatures, the so-called 'reds', progressed comparatively well. Of course, these creatures are mere borderdwellers and may consequently not be considered true demons. However, it may prove that the development of summoning spells for 'reds' will prove a rewarding spin-off of demon summoning research.
entries.translated: Кстати: призыв меньших существ, так называемых 'reds', продвигался сравнительно хорошо. Конечно, эти существа всего лишь обитатели границ и, следовательно, не могут считаться настоящими демонами. Однако может оказаться, что разработка заклинаний призыва для 'reds' станет полезным побочным продуктом исследований по призыву демонов.

entries.en:
Diary of Hengis Wulfson
...
I can only hope I can escape the
cyclops someday. For now I have
occupied their chief with an attempt
to learn to read and write, but for
how long?
I'm so desperate.
What a foolish idea to travel here to
search the famous treasures of this
ancient, knightly order.
I wish I had never heard about it.
I wish I had never sung that song.
No clue how many unfortunate souls I
have lured to death with it.
entries.translated:
Jurnalul lui Hengis Wulfson
...
Nu pot decât să sper că voi scăpa de 
ciclopi într-o zi. Deocamdată l-am 
ocupat pe șeful lor cu o încercare de
de a învăța să citească și să scrie, dar pentru
cât timp?
Sunt atât de disperat.
Ce idee proastă să călătoresc aici pentru a
căutare celebrele comori ale acestei__PH91__ordine antică. am auzit despre asta.
Mi-aș fi dorit să nu fi cântat niciodată acel cântec.
N-am nicio idee câte suflete nefericite am atras la moarte cu el
.

entries.en: Deep in the heart of the Kha'labal the dreaded hyena king has its lair. This legendary beast is much larger than any other specimen of its race, surpassing lions and even elephants in size, and it can tear a man apart in seconds with its enormous, razor-sharp teeth. What's more, the hyena king is said to be truly immortal, for it has been sighted time and again by numerous travellers and merchants. Many a caravan is said to have fallen prey to this ferocious beast, and it is widely believed to have amassed untold treasures over the centuries.
entries.translated: Nel profondo del cuore del Kha'labal ha la sua tana il temuto re iena. Questa bestia leggendaria è molto più grande di qualsiasi altro esemplare della sua razza, superando in dimensioni i leoni e persino gli elefanti, e può fare a pezzi un uomo in pochi secondi con i suoi enormi denti affilati come rasoi. Inoltre si dice che il re iena sia davvero immortale, poiché è stato avvistato più e più volte da numerosi viaggiatori e mercanti. Si dice che molte carovane siano cadute preda di questa bestia feroce, ed è opinione diffusa che abbia accumulato tesori indicibili nel corso dei secoli.

entries.en: Digging. Not a single trace of any door or even a window. Maybe home of some obscure cult of darkness? Maybe creatures of the night? A hideout for ghouls? Maybe I am working not hard enough. Hm, there seems to be a strange spot there at the wall, I can see it clearly from here. I shall try to push or pull it right away! Fame and riches, here I come!
entries.translated: Scavo. Non una sola traccia di porta e nemmeno di finestra. Forse sede di qualche oscuro culto dell'oscurità? Forse creature della notte? Un nascondiglio per i demoni? Forse non sto lavorando abbastanza. Hm, sembra che ci sia uno strano punto lì sul muro, lo vedo chiaramente da qui. Proverò a spingerlo o tirarlo subito! Fama e ricchezza, sto arrivando!

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?
