entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: What a chance to try out my latest work!
entries.translated: Какой шанс опробовать мою последнюю работу!

entries.en: May the forge be with me!
This time the prey is you!
entries.translated: На этот раз жертвой станете вы!

entries.en: Well, basically Spectulus is the only one likeminded so far. In fact, he incited me to work in the field in first place. So here I am! {Disguised} as a chalice.
entries.translated: Tja, Spectulus är i princip den enda likasinnade hittills. I själva verket hetsade han mig att arbeta på fältet i första hand. Så här är jag! {Disguised} som en kalk.

entries.en: Well, besides being a renowned sorcerer and scholar at the magic academy in Edron, I am also the proud father of a beautiful daughter, Ivalisse. My little endeavour here must have troubled the poor thing all the time since I left. ...
entries.translated: Tja, förutom att vara en känd trollkarl och lärd vid magiska akademin i Edron, är jag också stolt far till en vacker dotter, Ivalisse. Min lilla strävan här måste ha besvärat stackaren hela tiden sedan jag gick. ...

entries.en: I already know how to enter it, you need to step in and yell 'zzubaran'. Unfortunately they never took me with them. ...
entries.translated: Jag vet redan hur man skriver in den, du måste kliva in och skrika 'zzubaran'. Tyvärr tog de mig aldrig med sig. ...

entries.en: Tell her I love her and that I will take care. I have to press on! My research is most valuable to the 'Edron-Zaoan Exploration Division'. You don't happen to have some water, do you? Ah nevermind. It's a long {story}.
entries.translated: Säg att jag älskar henne och att jag ska ta hand om henne. Jag måste trycka på! Min forskning är mest värdefull för '__PH0__-Zaoan Exploration Division'. Du råkar inte ha lite vatten, eller hur? Ah strunt i. Det är en lång {story}.

entries.en: I heard them say it once, when a seemingly drunk guard yelled it in front of a wall mounted torch, hitting his head against it afterwards. He spilt all my contents on the floor, hmpf.
entries.translated: Jag hörde dem säga det en gång, när en till synes berusad vakt skrek det framför en väggmonterad ficklampa och slog huvudet mot den efteråt. Han spillde allt mitt innehåll på golvet, hmpf.

entries.en: Ah did I say that? Nevermind, I'm not really thirsty. It's part of this illusion. Somehow, I've been in hiding for so long, I started to... become... a vessel. ...
entries.translated: Ah sa jag det? Strunt i, jag är inte riktigt törstig. Det är en del av denna illusion. På något sätt har jag gömt mig så länge att jag började... bli... ett kärl. ...

entries.en: I don't know, I have that constant urge to drink but in this form I would not need to, there is no mouth, no stomach, no flesh and no actual need to eat, drink or sleep. ...
entries.translated: Jag vet inte, jag har den ständiga sugen att dricka men i den här formen skulle jag inte behöva det, det finns ingen mun, ingen mage, inget kött och inget egentligt behov av att äta, dricka eller sova. ...

entries.en: I basically communicate by making the metal of this goblet vibrate and using its form as a body of sound. Like a real voice, don't you think?? Yes, alright I know it's creepy. ...
entries.translated: Jag kommunicerar i princip genom att få metallen i denna bägare att vibrera och använda dess form som en ljudkropp. Som en riktig röst, tycker du inte?? Ja, jag vet att det är läskigt. ...

entries.en: I am still in the middle of my research and do not want to go home, so please tell my daughter to not worry about my - this will be a breakthrough! I already {learned} a lot!
entries.translated: Jag är fortfarande mitt uppe i min forskning och vill inte åka hem, så snälla säg till min dotter att inte oroa mig för min - det här kommer att bli ett genombrott! Jag har redan {learned} mycket!

entries.en: Oh yes, so since I wanted to study the Draken up close, I came up with an idea. Based on my research, and some slight bruises and a scar, the perfect hiding place is often right in the middle of subjects. ...
entries.translated: Åh ja, så eftersom jag ville studera Draken på nära håll så kom jag på en idé. Baserat på min forskning, och några små blåmärken och ett ärr, är det perfekta gömstället ofta mitt i ämnet. ...

entries.en: If I could enter their lair unseen and establish a forward camp, I would be able to study the draken in peace - or so I thought. Turns out the whole place was empty. I set up my camp and waited. ...
entries.translated: Om jag kunde gå in i deras lya osedd och etablera ett framåtläger, skulle jag i lugn och ro kunna studera draken - eller det trodde jag. Det visade sig att hela stället var tomt. Jag slog upp mitt läger och väntade. ...

entries.en: Finally. That's what I... oh wait, you're still talking to me - you will blow my cover! What do you want? Oh wait, did my {daughter} send you? It has been some time now, indeed.
entries.translated: Slutligen. Det är vad jag... o vänta, du pratar fortfarande med mig - du kommer att spränga mitt skydd! Vad vill du? Åh vänta, skickade min {daughter} dig? Det har verkligen gått ett tag nu.

entries.en: 'Alice the chalice'... Hmpf, of course I won't TELL you my name, I am UNDERCOVER! Now be quiet or they will hear you.
entries.translated: 'Alice the chalice'... Hmpf, självklart kommer jag inte att berätta vad jag heter, jag är UNDERCOVER! Var tyst nu, annars hör de dig.

entries.en: Well, I am drinking most of the time. Er, no I mean - trying to hold my fluids... ah, wait that came out wrong: I am doing research. Let's just keep it at that.
entries.translated: Tja, jag dricker för det mesta. Eh, nej, jag menar - försöker hålla kvar mina vätskor... ah, vänta det blev fel: jag forskar. Låt oss bara hålla det vid det.

entries.en: A bill? Oh boy so you are delivering another bill to poor me?
entries.translated: En räkning? Oh boy så du levererar en annan räkning till stackars mig?

entries.en: Ok, ok, I'll take it. I guess I have no other choice anyways. And now leave me alone in my misery please.
entries.translated: Ok, okej, jag tar det. Jag antar att jag inte har något annat val ändå. Och lämna mig nu ensam i mitt elände tack.

entries.en: What? My hat?? Theres... nothing special about it!
entries.translated: Vad? Min hatt?? Det är... inget speciellt med det!

entries.en: Stop bugging me about that hat, do you listen?
entries.translated: Sluta tjata om den där hatten, lyssnar du?

entries.en: Hey! Don't touch that hat! Leave it alone!!! Don't do this!!!!
entries.translated: Hej! Rör inte den hatten! Låt det vara!!! Gör inte detta!!!!

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...
reductor de habilidades de bestia aterradora

entries.en: You've gained access to the third floor. You can now fight with the Goshnar's Cruelty.
entries.translated: Uzyskałeś dostęp do trzeciego piętra. Możesz teraz walczyć z Okrucieństwem Goshnara.

entries.en: You need to wait {0} more seconds before using the greedy maw again.
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać {0} więcej sekund, zanim ponownie użyjesz chciwej paszczy.

entries.en: The dread starts to torment you! Don't let dread level reach critical value!
entries.translated: Strach zaczyna cię dręczyć! Nie pozwól, aby poziom strachu osiągnął wartość krytyczną!
Męka strachu staje się nie do zniesienia!

entries.en: The Dread's torment begins to tear you apart!
The dread's torment is killing you!
The dread's torment is now lethal!
You new taint level is: {0}, name: {1}
entries.translated: Twój nowy poziom skażenia to: {0}, imię: {1}

entries.en: You don't have access to this floor yet. You have collected {0}/{1}, and need {2} more pulsating energies to gain access.
entries.translated: Nie masz jeszcze dostępu do tego piętra. Zebrałeś {0}/{1} i potrzebujesz {2} więcej pulsujących energii, aby uzyskać dostęp.

entries.en: The ooze calms your dread but leaves you vulnerable to phantasmal attacks!
entries.translated: Szlam uspokaja twój strach, ale pozostawia cię podatnym na fantazmatyczne ataki!

entries.en: Removed taint level: {0}, name: {1} from player: {2}
entries.translated: Usunięto poziom skażenia: {0}, imię: {1} od gracza: {2}

entries.en: You have already activated this shrine.
You failed to stomp out the soul fire!
entries.translated: Nie udało ci się zdusić ognia duszy!

entries.en: The soul fire was stomped out in time! Your soul will now have to recover before you can do this again.
entries.translated: Ogień duszy został w porę zgaszony! Twoja dusza będzie teraz musiała zregenerować się, zanim będziesz mogła zrobić to ponownie.

entries.en: The soul fire was stomped out in time!
entries.translated: Ogień duszy został w porę zgaszony!

entries.en: Congratulations! You have earned {0} Hunting Task points, including a 100% bonus.
entries.translated: Gratulacje! Zdobyłeś {0} punktów Zadania Polowania, w tym 100% premii.

entries.en: Congratulations! You have earned {0} Hunting Task points, including a 50% bonus.
entries.translated: Gratulacje! Zdobyłeś {0} punktów Zadania Polowania, w tym 50% premii.

entries.en: Congratulations! You have earned {0} Hunting Task points.
There was an error while processing your task hunting reward. Please try reopening the window.
entries.translated: Wystąpił błąd podczas przetwarzania nagrody za zadanie. Spróbuj ponownie otworzyć okno.

entries.en: To unlock this task hunting slot you must buy it in the store first.
entries.translated: Aby odblokować ten slot do polowania na zadania, musisz najpierw kupić go w sklepie.

entries.en: You need to wait {0} minutes to select a new creature for this task.
entries.translated: Musisz poczekać {0} minut, aby wybrać nowe stworzenie do tego zadania.

entries.en: You earned {0} point(s) on the scouts mission.
Your Goshnar's taints have been reset.
Your Goshnar's taints have been reset. You didn't finish the quest in 14 days.
entries.translated: Skażenia Twojego Goshnara zostały zresetowane. Nie ukończyłeś zadania w ciągu 14 dni.

entries.en: A fiery fury gate has opened near one of the major cities somewhere in Tibia.
entries.translated: Brama ognistej furii otworzyła się w pobliżu jednego z głównych miast gdzieś w Tibia.

entries.en: Oriental ships sighted! A trader for exotic creature products may currently be visiting Carlin, Ankrahmun or Liberty Bay.
entries.translated: Zaobserwowano orientalne statki! Sprzedawca produktów egzotycznych stworzeń może obecnie odwiedzać Carlin, Ankrahmun lub Liberty Bay.

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the northernmost coast!
entries.translated: Burza piaskowa przechodzi przez Daramę, prowadząc do wysp pełnych śmiercionośnych stworzeń znajdujących się w koszmarze. Unikaj najbardziej wysuniętego na północ wybrzeża!

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
entries.translated: Burza piaskowa przechodzi przez Daramę, prowadząc do wysp pełnych śmiercionośnych stworzeń znajdujących się w koszmarze. Unikaj rzeki w pobliżu Drefia!

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the Ankhramun tar pits!.
entries.translated: Burza piaskowa przechodzi przez Daramę, prowadząc do wysp pełnych śmiercionośnych stworzeń znajdujących się w koszmarze. Unikaj dołów smołowych Ankhramun!.

entries.en: You've marked the tree, but its former inhabitant has stolen your bait! Get it before it runs away!
entries.translated: Oznaczyłeś drzewo, ale jego dawny mieszkaniec ukradł Twoją przynętę! Zdobądź go, zanim ucieknie!

entries.en: You have marked the tree but it seems someone marked it already! He is not happy with your actions and he brought friends!
entries.translated: Oznaczyłeś drzewo, ale wygląda na to, że ktoś już je zaznaczył! Nie jest zadowolony z twoich działań i przyprowadził przyjaciół!

entries.en: You have marked the tree, but you also angered the aquirrel family who lived on it!
entries.translated: Oznaczyłeś drzewo, ale rozgniewałeś także rodzinę wiewiórek, która na nim mieszkała!

entries.en: At last.. I have it back, my precious amulet. I am glad you didn't use it! I allow you to ...ahh... enter door ...ahh
entries.translated: Nareszcie.. Mam go z powrotem, mój cenny amulet. Cieszę się, że z tego nie skorzystałeś! Pozwalam ci...ahh... wejść do drzwi...ahh
Modo de autoloot establecido a TODO.

entries.en: [World Change] Yasir has arrived in %s today!
No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: You need to wait few minutes to use again.
entries.translated: È necessario attendere qualche minuto per riutilizzarlo.

entries.en: A booming sound almost deafens you. From somewhere deep within you hear a whisper: 'Grass...'
entries.translated: Un suono rimbombante quasi ti assorda. Da qualche parte nel profondo senti un sussurro: 'Grass...'

entries.en: A booming sound almost deafens you. From somewhere deep within you hear a whisper: 'Ice...'
entries.translated: Un suono rimbombante quasi ti assorda. Da qualche parte nel profondo senti un sussurro: 'Ice...'

entries.en: The time waster hungrily consumes the time and vanishes.
entries.translated: Il perditempo consuma avidamente il tempo e svanisce.

entries.en: The bag can not be opened.
entries.translated: La borsa non può essere aperta.

entries.en: Oh hello, nice to see you |PLAYERNAME|. Are you here to hear some stories of my {adventures} or do you need {help}?
entries.translated: Oh ciao, piacere di vederti |PLAYERNAME|. Sei qui per ascoltare alcune storie del mio {adventures} o hai bisogno di {help}?

entries.en: Hello, I am the warden of this {monument}. The {sarcophagus} in front of you was established to prevent people from going {down} there. But I doubt that this step is sufficient.
entries.translated: Ciao, sono il direttore di questo {monument}. Il {sarcophagus} di fronte a te è stato creato per impedire alle persone di andarci {down}. Ma dubito che questo passaggio sia sufficiente.

entries.en: Well, let's see if your mission was successful. Just bring me all needed {materials}.
entries.translated: Bene, vediamo se la tua missione ha avuto successo. Portami tutto il necessario {materials}.

entries.en: If you dug up all three crystals of sufficient quantity and obtained the poison gland, the charging of your compass can start! For the very first time it will be charged by the violet crystal. Ready to {unleash} the power of the crystals?
entries.translated: Se hai raccolto tutti e tre i cristalli in quantità sufficiente e hai ottenuto la ghiandola del veleno, la ricarica della tua bussola può iniziare! Per la prima volta verrà caricato dal cristallo viola. Pronti a {unleash} il potere dei cristalli?

entries.en: Greetings adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
entries.translated: Saluti avventuriero |PLAYERNAME|. Cosa ti porta da me?

entries.en: Good bye and take care of you!
entries.translated: Arrivederci e abbi cura di te!

entries.en: The gods must be praised that I am finally saved. I do not have many worldly possessions, but please accept a small reward, do you?
entries.translated: Bisogna lodare gli dei perché finalmente sono stato salvato. Non ho molti beni terreni, ma per favore accetta una piccola ricompensa, vero?

entries.en: Thanks for saving my life! Should I teleport you out of the Dark Cathedral?
entries.translated: Grazie per avermi salvato la vita! Dovrei teletrasportarti fuori dalla Cattedrale Oscura?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You have found a piece of paper.
You can only withdraw up to {0} items at a time from the stash.
entries.translated: Вы можете за раз извлечь из тайника не более {0} предметов.

entries.en: Someone is fighting in the soulpit!
entries.translated: Cineva se luptă în groapa sufletească!

entries.en: As soon as you turn the second key a mechanism retracts the locks and swallows the keys, opening a small passage beyond.
entries.translated: Imediat ce rotiți a doua cheie, un mecanism retrage încuietorile și înghite cheile, deschizând un mic pasaj dincolo.

entries.en: You need to use the mechanism of the pillar itself to turn both keys at once.
entries.translated: Trebuie să utilizați mecanismul stâlpului în sine pentru a roti ambele chei simultan.

entries.en: You reach for the onyx and trigger and enormous discharge of raw energy. It is now possible to traverse the portal in this tomb.
entries.translated: Atingeți onixul și declanșați și descărcarea enormă de energie brută. Acum este posibil să traversăm portalul din acest mormânt.

entries.en: You are not worthy to enter in The First Dragon's Lair yet.
entries.translated: Încă nu ești demn să intri în Bârlogul lui The First Dragon.

entries.en: The flames roar and eat the bone hungrily. The Dark Lord is satisfied with your gift
entries.translated: Flăcările urlă și mănâncă osul cu foame. Domnul Întunecat este mulțumit de darul tău

entries.en: The words seem to flutter. One word stays in your mind: floating
entries.translated: Cuvintele par să fluture. Un cuvânt rămâne în minte: plutire

entries.en: The words seem to breathe, stangely. One word stays in your mind: bronze
entries.translated: Cuvintele par să respire, ciudat. Un cuvânt rămâne în minte: bronz

entries.en: The words seem to glow slightly. A name fixes in your mind: Takesha Antishu
entries.translated: Cuvintele par să strălucească ușor. Un nume se fixează în mintea ta: Takesha Antishu

entries.en: An invisible hand pulls you inside.
entries.translated: O mână invizibilă te trage înăuntru.

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Bună, bună, bună, domnișoară |PLAYERNAME|! Ce vă aduce {here}?

entries.en: Remember: A joke a day keeps the ghouls away!
entries.translated: Ține minte: o glumă pe zi ține ghouls departe!

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Bun venit, |PLAYERNAME|! Fie ca pământul să vă protejeze pe terenurile stâncoase. Dacă aveți nevoie de un {passage}, vă pot ajuta.
Bun venit în coliba mea umilă, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Oh no! Was that really me? This is so embarassing, I have no idea what has gotten into me. Was that the fighting spirit you gave me?
entries.translated: O, nu! Chiar ăsta am fost eu? Este atât de penibil, nu am idee ce mi-a pătruns. Acesta a fost spiritul de luptă pe care mi l-ai dat?
La revedere și vino din nou!
maledizione dell'orso delle caverne non morto
riduttore di abilità del cantante incantatore profondo
il prete della morte shargon abbaglia
Riduttore di abilità del pilastro Madareth

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: The chants in this book often contain the word 'O'kteth.'.
entries.translated: Песни в этой книге часто содержат слово 'O'kteth.'.

entries.en: This statue has a word written on her hand: 'N'ogalu'.
entries.translated: На руке этой статуи написано слово: 'N'ogalu'.

entries.en: Grimvale drowns in werecreatures as the full moon reaches its apex and ancient evil returns.
entries.translated: Grimvale тонет в существах-оборотнях, когда полная луна достигает апогея и возвращается древнее зло.

entries.en: You need to wait %s before trying to challenge %s again!
entries.translated: Вам нужно подождать %s, прежде чем снова пытаться бросить вызов %s!

entries.en: The Ambassador tells another dignitary: Rathleton must never be surpassed! I will procure that the Empire falters!
entries.translated: Посол говорит другому высокопоставленному лицу: Rathleton никогда нельзя превзойти! Я добьюсь того, чтобы Империя пошатнулась!

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see the Ambassador of Rathleton wearing a cloak with a black sphinx on it.
entries.translated: Через межпространственные врата вы можете увидеть Посла Rathleton в плаще с черным сфинксом.

entries.en: Through a dimensional gate you can see how the Ambassador of Rathleton is talking to Fafnar cultists in a quite familiar way. The proof is absolutely substantive. The Ambassador is a betrayer!
entries.translated: Через межпространственные врата можно увидеть, как Посол Rathleton вполне знакомым языком разговаривает с культистами Фафнара. Доказательство абсолютно существенное. Посол — предатель!

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: %s damaged the shadow nexus! You can't damage it while it's burning.
entries.translated: %s повредил теневую связь! Вы не сможете повредить его, пока он горит.

entries.en: %s destroyed the shadow nexus! In 10 seconds it will return to its original state.
entries.translated: %s уничтожил теневую связь! Через 10 секунд он вернется в исходное состояние.

entries.en: Congratulations! You completed %s arena, you should take your reward now.
entries.translated: Поздравляем! Вы завершили арену %s, теперь вы должны получить свою награду.

entries.en: You have touched Tafariel's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Вы прикоснулись к трону Тафариэля и впитали в себя часть его духа.

entries.en: You have touched Verminor's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Вы прикоснулись к трону Верминора и поглотили часть его духа.

entries.en: You have touched Apocalypse's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Вы прикоснулись к трону Apocalypse и впитали в себя часть его духа.

entries.en: You have touched Bazir's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Вы прикоснулись к трону Базира и впитали в себя часть его духа.

entries.en: You have touched Ashfalor's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Вы прикоснулись к трону Ашфалора и впитали в себя часть его духа.

entries.en: You have touched Pumin's throne and absorbed some of his spirit.
entries.translated: Вы прикоснулись к трону Пумина и впитали в себя часть его духа.

entries.en: A batch of documents has been stashed in the shelf. These might be of interest to Zalamon.
entries.translated: На полке спрятана пачка документов. Это может представлять интерес для Заламона.

entries.en: You dig out a skull from the pile of bones. That must be the skull Lazaran talked about.
entries.translated: Вы выкапываете череп из груды костей. Должно быть, это тот самый череп, о котором говорил Лазаран.

entries.en: To buy some time you replace the fish with a piece of carrot.
entries.translated: Чтобы выиграть время, замените рыбу кусочком моркови.

entries.en: The vial is glittering with starlight now.
entries.translated: Flaconul strălucește de lumina stelelor acum.

entries.en: As soon as you're pouring out the vial over the dreambird tree the plant is infused with starlight. The barrier strengthens.
entries.translated: De îndată ce turnați flaconul peste copacul de pasăre de vis, planta este infuzată cu lumina stelelor. Bariera se întărește.

entries.en: As soon as you're pouring out the vial over the dreambird tree the plant is infused with starlight. This was the last tree.
entries.translated: De îndată ce turnați flaconul peste copacul de pasăre de vis, planta este infuzată cu lumina stelelor. Acesta a fost ultimul copac.

entries.en: You are rubbing the gem in the sun catcher's centre but nothing happens.
entries.translated: Freci bijuteria în centrul captatorului de soare, dar nu se întâmplă nimic.

entries.en: The sun has to be shining in order to strengthen the barrier. Wait for the day.
entries.translated: Soarele trebuie să strălucească pentru a întări bariera. Așteaptă ziua.

entries.en: The sun catcher is shining with sunlight now.
entries.translated: Captorul de soare strălucește acum de lumina soarelui.

entries.en: As soon as you're placing the sun catcher on the stone the pattern the mosaic is infused with sunlight. The barrier strengthens.
entries.translated: De îndată ce așezați captorul de soare pe piatră, modelul mozaicul este infuzat cu lumina soarelui. Bariera se întărește.

entries.en: As soon as you're placing the sun catcher on the stone the pattern the mosaic is infused with sunlight. This was the last mosaic.
entries.translated: De îndată ce așezați captorul de soare pe piatră, modelul mozaicul este infuzat cu lumina soarelui. Acesta a fost ultimul mozaic.

entries.en: You are not on that mission.
This can only be used between 1st of April and 1st of May.
entries.translated: Acesta poate fi folosit doar între 1 aprilie și 1 mai.

entries.en: You hold the skull up high. You can resist the urge to have it look through a telescope though.
entries.translated: Țineți craniul sus. Totuși, poți rezista nevoii de a o privi printr-un telescop.

entries.en: That's definitely one of the highest spots in whole Tibia. If that's not simply perfect you don't know what it is.
entries.translated: Acesta este cu siguranță unul dintre cele mai înalte locuri din întregul Tibia. Dacă asta nu este pur și simplu perfect, nu știi ce este.

entries.en: What a beautiful view. Worthy of a Queen indeed! Time to head back to Lazaran and show him what you got.
entries.translated: Ce priveliste frumoasa. Demn de o regină într-adevăr! E timpul să te întorci la Lazaran și să-i arăți ce ai.

entries.en: You hold up the skull and let it take a peek over the beautiful elven town through the dense leaves.
entries.translated: Îți ridici craniul și îl lași să arunce o privire peste frumosul oraș elf prin frunzele dese.

entries.en: Thanita gives you a really strange look as you hold up the skull, but oh well.
entries.translated: Thanita îți arată cu adevărat ciudat în timp ce ții craniul în sus, dar ei bine.

entries.en: That was a real easy one. And you are used to getting strange looks now, so whatever!
entries.translated: A fost unul cu adevărat ușor. Și acum ești obișnuit să ai un aspect ciudat, așa că orice!

entries.en: Wow, it's hot up here. Luckily the skull can't get a sunburn any more, but you can, so you better descend again!
entries.translated: Uau, e cald aici sus. Din fericire, craniul nu mai poate face arsuri de soare, dar tu poți, așa că mai bine cobori din nou!

entries.en: Considering that higher places around here aren't that easy to reach, you think the view from here is tolerably good.
entries.translated: Având în vedere că locurile mai înalte de aici nu sunt atât de ușor de ajuns, crezi că priveliștea de aici este destul de bună.

entries.en: Yep, that's a pretty high spot. If Lazaran ever sees what the skull sees, he'd be pretty satisfied with that nice view.
entries.translated: Da, e un punct destul de înalt. Dacă Lazaran vede vreodată ceea ce vede craniul, ar fi destul de mulțumit de acea vedere frumoasă.

entries.en: Well, there are higher spots around here, but none of them is as easily reachable as this one. It just has to suffice.
entries.translated: Ei bine, există locuri mai înalte pe aici, dar niciunul dintre ele nu este la fel de ușor accesibil ca acesta. Trebuie doar să fie suficient.

entries.en: At your service |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the post office.
entries.translated: Till din tjänst |PLAYERNAME| och välkommen till postkontoret.

entries.en: Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
entries.translated: Här. Glöm inte att du måste köpa en etikett också om du vill skicka ett paket. Skriv alltid namnet på {receiver} på första raden.

entries.en: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...
entries.translated: Дакле, дошли сте, |PLAYERNAME|. Надао сам се да нећеш...

entries.en: Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?
entries.translated: Здраво! Шта је то, шта си {want}?

entries.en: Greetings humans! Consider yourselfs lucky, I'm in need of {help}.
entries.translated: Поздрав људи! Сматрајте да сте срећни, треба ми {help}.

entries.en: Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?
entries.translated: Ха? ста? могу да видим! Вау! Не-мино. Да ли су и вама {capture}?

entries.en: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
entries.translated: Здраво? Како то мислиш 'hi' - зар не видиш да сам ја... Морам да стишам глас. Да ли вам је пало на памет да овај 'chalice' не жели да га узнемиравате?! Остави ме на миру!

entries.en: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
entries.translated: Шта је ово? Ентитет са оптичким изазовом који се зове |PLAYERNAME|. Како фасцинантно!

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Буди оплакиван ходочасник у телу. Продајем општу робу. Само ме замоли за {trade}.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Пажљиво прегледаш свитке. То су наређења од Rathleton за амбасадора. Овде нема знакова издаје.

entries.en: Do you bring freshly killed rats for a bounty of 1 gold each? By the way, I also buy orc teeth and other stuff you ripped from their bloody corp... I mean... well, you know what I mean.
entries.translated: Да ли доносите свеже убијене пацове за награду од 1 злата сваки? Узгред, такође купујем зубе орка и друге ствари које си отео из њиховог проклетог корпуса... Мислим... па, знаш на шта мислим.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow
entries.translated: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow

entries.en: The guards have spotted you. You were forcibly dragged into a small cell. It looks like you need to build another disguise.
entries.translated: Le guardie ti hanno notato. Sei stato trascinato con la forza in una piccola cella. Sembra che tu debba costruire un altro travestimento.

entries.en: I WILL RETURN!! My death will just be a door to await my homecoming, my physical hull will be... my... argh...
entries.translated: TORNERÒ!! La mia morte sarà solo una porta in attesa del mio ritorno a casa, il mio scafo fisico sarà... il mio... argh...

entries.en: Terofar cast a greater death curse on you!
entries.translated: Terofar ti ha lanciato una maledizione mortale ancora più grande!

entries.en: NO ONE WILL STOP ME THIS TIME!
Feel the hungry kiss of death!
Feel the hungry kiss of death!
A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
entries.translated: Песчаная буря путешествует по Дараме, приводя к островам, полным смертоносных существ внутри кошмара. Избегайте реки возле Drefia!

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: The pile of bones is empty.
The pile of bones is empty.
Well done! The water is analyzed.
A sandstorm has destroyed almost all pillars. The effect of the counteragent worked different than expected.
entries.translated: Песчаная буря разрушила почти все столбы. Эффект от контрагента подействовал иначе, чем ожидалось.

entries.en: The sandstorm has not only destroyed the oasis, but also revealed some paving tiles and a lever.
entries.translated: Песчаная буря не только разрушила оазис, но и обнажила тротуарную плитку и рычаг.

entries.en: Perfect! You took a wonderful loupe from this crate.
entries.translated: Идеальный! Ты взял из этого ящика чудесную лупу.

entries.en: This crate belongs to Angelo. You should talk to him before taking something out.
entries.translated: Этот ящик принадлежит Анджело. Вам следует поговорить с ним, прежде чем что-то брать.

entries.en: Dear curator, this recently opened museum is a really nice place to be.
entries.translated: Дорогой куратор, этот недавно открывшийся музей — действительно приятное место.

entries.en: But wait! What about the empty space in front of you? What a pity!
entries.translated: Но подождите! А как насчет пустого пространства перед тобой? Как жаль!

entries.en: It seems that somebody has removed one of the beautiful pictures. But come on! You have the money and we need it.
entries.translated: Кажется, кто-то удалил одну из красивых картинок. Но давай! У вас есть деньги, и они нам нужны.

entries.en: Ask him: Has the cat got your tongue?
entries.translated: Спроси его: Кот забрал твой язык?

entries.en: You need at least level 250 to enter.
entries.translated: Для входа вам нужен минимум 250 уровень.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: You charted the location and dimensions of a strange structure, an ancient gate.
entries.translated: Вы нанесли на карту расположение и размеры странного сооружения — древних ворот.

entries.en: You charted the location and dimensions of a strange structure, a small ruin.
entries.translated: Вы нанесли на карту расположение и размеры странного сооружения, небольших руин.

entries.en: You charted the location and dimensions of a strange structure, resembling a stone face.
entries.translated: Вы нанесли на карту расположение и размеры странного сооружения, напоминающего каменное лицо.

entries.en: You charted the location and dimensions of a strange structure, an outpost.
entries.translated: Вы нанесли на карту местоположение и размеры странного сооружения — аванпоста.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: Impossible to turn on this machine for now!
entries.translated: Este imposibil să pornești această mașină deocamdată!

entries.en: All machines are working, now is possible to use the teleport at west.
entries.translated: Toate mașinile funcționează, acum este posibil să utilizați teleportul la vest.

entries.en: Impossible to turn on this machine for now!
entries.translated: Este imposibil să pornești această mașină deocamdată!

entries.en: All machines are working, now is possible to use the teleport at west.
entries.translated: Toate mașinile funcționează, acum este posibil să utilizați teleportul la vest.

entries.en: Impossible to turn on this machine for now!
entries.translated: Este imposibil să pornești această mașină deocamdată!

entries.en: All machines are working, now is possible to use the teleport at east.
entries.translated: Toate mașinile funcționează, acum este posibil să utilizați teleportarea la est.

entries.en: Impossible to turn on this machine for now!
entries.translated: Este imposibil să pornești această mașină deocamdată!

entries.en: Carefully you paint over the picture. As you are doing so the flat paiting deepens. It looks now like a room you can enter.
entries.translated: Pictezi cu grijă peste imagine. Pe măsură ce faci asta, pictura plată se adâncește. Acum arată ca o cameră în care poți intra.

entries.en: This isn't a normal paiting anymore. By using magical paint you transformed it into a portal and can easily pass it.
entries.translated: Acesta nu mai este o lucrare normală. Folosind vopsea magică, l-ați transformat într-un portal și îl puteți trece cu ușurință.

entries.en: As you open the device a bright light pours out of its interior and drags all remaining energy of the nightstalker into it.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce deschideți dispozitivul, o lumină strălucitoare se revarsă din interiorul său și trage toată energia rămasă a urmăritorului de noapte în el.

entries.en: As you open the device a bright light pours out of its interior and drags all remaining energy of the souleater into it.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce deschideți dispozitivul, o lumină strălucitoare se revarsă din interiorul său și trage toată energia rămasă a sufletului în el.

entries.en: As you open the device a bright light pours out of its interior and drags all remaining energy of the ghost into it.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce deschideți dispozitivul, o lumină strălucitoare se revarsă din interiorul său și trage toată energia rămasă a fantomei în el.

entries.en: You have used items in gravestone.
entries.translated: Ați folosit articole în piatra funerară.

entries.en: An incredibly slimy substance oozes out of every crack in the old gravestone. It seems to attack you.
entries.translated: Din fiecare crăpătură din vechea piatră funerară se scurge o substanță incredibil de lipicioasă. Se pare că te atacă.

entries.en: Nothing special. This picture looks genuine.
entries.translated: Nimic special. Această imagine pare autentică.

entries.en: This is it. It looks like it was painted by a child!
entries.translated: Asta este. Se pare că a fost pictat de un copil!

entries.en: Mh hello there. What can I do for you?
entries.translated: Hola, hola. ¿Qué puedo hacer por ti?

entries.en: Another creature who believes thinks physical strength is more important than wisdom! Why are you disturbing me?
entries.translated: ¡Otra criatura que cree piensa que la fuerza física es más importante que la sabiduría! ¿Por qué me molestas?

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
entries.translated: ¡Hola |PLAYERNAME|! Llegas tarde, ¿no tienes noción del tiempo? Mi misión es de suma importancia. Si no estás interesado en ayudarme, es mejor que te vayas.

entries.en: Ah hello again |PLAYERNAME|! I still have one or two other {missions} for you. There are also some {tasks} someone needs to attend to.
entries.translated: Ah hola de nuevo |PLAYERNAME|! Todavía tengo uno o dos {missions} más para ti. También hay algunos {tasks} que alguien debe atender.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
entries.translated: ¡Hola |PLAYERNAME|! Llegas tarde, ¿no tienes noción del tiempo? Mi misión es de suma importancia. Si no estás interesado en ayudarme, es mejor que te vayas.

entries.en: This place is... haunted... heed my warning... there are... ghooooooosts here...! Why are you giving me that... look? I am certain, there aaaaaaare ghosts here - I've seen them! Do you believe me?
entries.translated: Este lugar está... embrujado... presta atención a mi advertencia... ¡hay... fantasmas aquí...! ¿Por qué me das esa... mirada? Estoy seguro de que aquí hay fantasmas, ¡los he visto! ¿Me crees?

entries.en: Take a look, but not a sip before you've paid. And I hope it stays like this and you don't get any strange ideas about {rice}.
entries.translated: Echa un vistazo, pero ni un sorbo antes de pagar. Y espero que siga así y no se te ocurra ninguna idea extraña sobre {rice}.

entries.en: Im carving bolts and arrows and i also craft bows anda spears.If you'd like to buy some ammunition, take a look.
entries.translated: Estoy tallando pernos y flechas y también fabrico arcos y lanzas. Si quieres comprar municiones, echa un vistazo.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: You joined the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. Ask Grizzly Adams for some hunting tasks. You already gained %d points. You currently have %d boss points.
entries.translated: Вы присоединились к '__PH0__'. Попросите Гризли Адамса выполнить несколько охотничьих заданий. Вы уже набрали %d баллов. На данный момент у вас есть %d очков босса.
Deschide un canal de mesaje private

entries.en: I will be still around when my 'noble' race is gone.
entries.translated: Још увек ћу бити ту када моја трка 'noble' нестане.

entries.en: Of course, just have a look.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, sólo eche un vistazo.

entries.en: Here is the list with the missing ingredients to complete the ritual.
entries.translated: Aquí tienes la lista con los ingredientes que faltan para completar el ritual.

entries.en: Hello. I'm so glad someone has found me. Did you meet THEM?!
entries.translated: Hola. Me alegro mucho que alguien me haya encontrado. ¡¿Los conociste?!

entries.en: Greetings, friend. Good you are showing up.
entries.translated: Saludos amigo. Qué bueno que estás apareciendo.

entries.en: Hey there, you are surely interested in helping the Rathleton city guard, right? Right - especially now since the dreaded minotaurs gain more ground every day.
entries.translated: Hola, seguramente estás interesado en ayudar a la guardia de la ciudad Rathleton, ¿verdad? Claro, sobre todo ahora que los temidos minotauros ganan cada día más terreno.

entries.en: Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
entries.translated: Cuídate mucho viajero. Sería una pena perder a un vagabundo tan valiente ante esos monstruos verdes.

entries.en: How could you sneak up on me like this? I thought you were one of THEM! Well, since you are not, what brings you to this wilderness?
entries.translated: ¿Cómo pudiste acercarte sigilosamente así? ¡Pensé que eras uno de ELLOS! Bueno, ya que no lo eres, ¿qué te trae a este desierto?

entries.en: Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
entries.translated: Cuídate mucho viajero. Sería una pena perder a un vagabundo tan valiente ante esos monstruos verdes.

entries.en: Hi! You look like someone on a {mission}.
Be greeted, friend of the apes.
entries.translated: Sea saludado, amigo de los simios.

entries.en: Greetings, dear guest. If you are interested in paperware such as books or scrolls, ask me for a trade.
entries.translated: Saludos, querido invitado. Si estás interesado en artículos de papel como libros o pergaminos, pregúntame por un intercambio.

entries.en: Ah, a customer! Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! I buy all kinds of loot, would you like a {trade}? I can also show you my {shop options}.
entries.translated: ¡Ah, un cliente! ¡Sea saludado, |PLAYERNAME|! Compro todo tipo de botín, ¿te gustaría un {trade}? También puedo mostrarte mi {shop options}.

entries.en: COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!
entries.translated: ¡VUELVE CUANDO ESTÉS PREPARADO PARA ENFRENTAR TU DESTINO!

entries.en: COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!
entries.translated: ¡VUELVE CUANDO ESTÉS PREPARADO PARA ENFRENTAR TU DESTINO!

entries.en: Harrrrk! You think you are strong now? You shall never escape my wrath! I am immortal!
entries.translated: ¡Hurra! ¿Crees que eres fuerte ahora? ¡Nunca escaparás de mi ira! ¡Soy inmortal!

entries.en: Be greeted, dear visitor. Come and {stay} ... a while.
entries.translated: Sea saludado, querido visitante. Ven y {stay}... un rato.

entries.en: Yes, flee from death. But know it shall be always one step behind you.
entries.translated: Sí, huye de la muerte. Pero sepan que siempre estará un paso detrás de ustedes.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage} back, I can help you.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido, |PLAYERNAME|! Que la tierra os proteja en los terrenos pedregosos. Si necesitas un respaldo {passage}, puedo ayudarte.

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. May the gods be with you to guard and guide you, my child!
entries.translated: Adiós, |PLAYERNAME|. ¡Que los dioses estén contigo para protegerte y guiarte, hija mía!

entries.en: Oh, hello! It's a pleasure to see a visitor from the continent.
entries.translated: ¡Hola! Es un placer recibir a un visitante del continente.

entries.en: Welcome to my little shop, adventurer! First read my blackboards.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido a mi pequeña tienda, aventurero! Primero lee mis pizarrones.
Apri la finestra di dialogo Bosstiario

entries.en:
Minor Charm echoes
Earned by unlocking or upgrading major charm and promotion your character
entries.translated:
Echi di fascino minore
Ottenuto sbloccando o potenziando il fascino principale e promuovendo il tuo personaggio

entries.en: Brog however laughed over the dragon, which he had created, because he roamed over Tibia and was a terror to the few
entries.translated: Однако Брог смеялся над драконом, которого он создал, потому что он бродил по Tibia и был ужасом для немногих.

entries.en: buildings disappeared gradually from the face of Tibia.
entries.translated: здания постепенно исчезли с лица Tibia.

entries.en: But when the Orks threatened to cover Tibia almost completely, the dragon came! They had decided that only they
entries.translated: Но когда орки пригрозили почти полностью захватить Tibia, пришел дракон! Они решили, что только они

entries.en: By the way: The summoning of lesser creatures, the so-called 'reds', progressed comparatively well. Of course, these creatures are mere borderdwellers and may consequently not be considered true demons. However, it may prove that the development of summoning spells for 'reds' will prove a rewarding spin-off of demon summoning research.
entries.translated: Кстати: призыв меньших существ, так называемых 'reds', продвигался сравнительно хорошо. Конечно, эти существа всего лишь обитатели границ и, следовательно, не могут считаться настоящими демонами. Однако может оказаться, что разработка заклинаний призыва для 'reds' станет полезным побочным продуктом исследований по призыву демонов.

entries.en: Centuries ago, our ancients build this maze to protect our city Demona from bandits and warriors.
entries.translated: Много веков назад наши предки построили этот лабиринт, чтобы защитить наш город Demona от бандитов и воинов.

entries.en: circle of the creators and help them with the task of the creation. Tibiasula agreed, because she also was fascinated by the idea
entries.translated: круг творцов и помочь им в творчестве. Тибиасула согласилась, потому что она тоже была очарована этой идеей.

entries.en: City Cellar - Beware of the spiders
clear as seldom before: our order will be wiped
entries.translated: ясно, как редко: наш заказ будет удален

entries.en: Clear up subjects' remains and blood. Borrowed equipment must be returned clean and functional.
entries.translated: Очистите останки и кровь субъектов. Взятое напрокат оборудование должно быть возвращено чистым и работоспособным.

entries.en: Congratulations, you have passed the Dream Challenge. Now enjoy the fruits of your success and relax before continue the way to meet the master.
entries.translated: Поздравляем, вы прошли Dream Challenge. Теперь наслаждайтесь плодами своего успеха и расслабьтесь, прежде чем продолжить путь к встрече с мастером.

entries.en: Contact Berenice in the local Explorer Society outpost!
entries.translated: Свяжитесь с Беренис в местном аванпосте Общества исследователей!

entries.en: Contact Henricus in the Inquisiton quarters beneath the Thaian jail!
entries.translated: Свяжитесь с Henricus в помещении Инквизиции под тайской тюрьмой!

entries.en: Captain Max will bring you to Calassa whenever you are ready. Please try to retrieve the missing logbook which must be in one of the sunken shipwrecks.
entries.translated: Căpitanul Max te va aduce la Calassa ori de câte ori ești gata. Vă rugăm să încercați să recuperați jurnalul de bord lipsă care trebuie să fie într-una dintre epavele scufundate.
Ai vânat cu succes 500 de păianjeni giganți.

entries.en: Travel to Okolnir and try to find a proof for the existence of dragon lords there in the old times. I think old Buddel might be able to bring you there.
entries.translated: Viaggia a Okolnir e cerca di trovare una prova dell'esistenza dei signori dei draghi nei tempi antichi. Penso che il vecchio Buddel potrebbe portarti lì.

entries.en: Captain Max will bring you to Calassa whenever you are ready. Please try to retrieve the missing logbook which must be in one of the sunken shipwrecks.
entries.translated: Il Capitano Max ti porterà a Calassa ogni volta che sarai pronto. Per favore prova a recuperare il giornale di bordo mancante che deve trovarsi in uno dei relitti affondati.

entries.en: Hello hello! Always good to see fresh blood! What brings you here?
entries.translated: Hola hola! ¡Siempre es bueno ver sangre fresca! ¿Qué te trae por aquí?

entries.en: Greetings! This isn't the {time} to chitchat though.
entries.translated: ¡Saludos! Sin embargo, este no es el {time} para charlar.

entries.en: Don't hurt yourself with that weapon, little one.
entries.translated: No te hagas daño con esa arma, pequeña.

entries.en: Hello, dear |PLAYERNAME|. Can I be of any assistance? Just tell me if you'd like to {trade} weapons or armor.
entries.translated: Hola querido |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Puedo ser de alguna ayuda? Sólo dime si te gustaría {trade} armas o armaduras.
Los espíritus te dan la bienvenida.

entries.en: I have read and I agree to the Extended Tibia Service Agreement and the Tibia Privacy Policy.
entries.translated: Я прочитал(а) и согласен(на) с Расширенным соглашением об услугах Tibia и Политикой конфиденциальности Tibia.

entries.en: Defeating a boosted boss is extra lucrative. Boosted bosses contain more loot and count more kills for your Bosstiary.
entries.translated: Победа над усиленным боссом особенно выгодна. Усиленные боссы содержат больше добычи и засчитывают больше убийств для вашего Bosstiary.

entries.en: Achievements are extra goals that you can accomplish while playing Tibia. This list offers you an overview of all common achievements that can be reached in Tibia. However, there are also a number of
entries.translated: Достижения — это дополнительные цели, которые вы можете выполнять во время игры в Tibia. Этот список даёт обзор всех общих достижений, которые можно получить в Tibia. Однако существует также ряд

entries.en: Compare yourself with other characters of your game world in the "Highscores". Achievements yield a certain number of points depending on their grade of difficulty:
entries.translated: Сравните себя с другими персонажами вашего мира в «Highscores». Достижения дают определённое количество очков в зависимости от уровня сложности:

entries.en: Welcome to Valentine's Store. Let's {trade} something?
entries.translated: Bienvenido a la tienda de San Valentín. ¿Vamos a {trade} algo?

entries.en: Yes, i have some potions and runes if you are interested. Or do you want to buy only potions or only runes?oh if you want sell or buy gems, your may also ask me.
entries.translated: Sí, tengo algunas pociones y runas si estás interesado. ¿O quieres comprar solo pociones o solo runas? Oh, si quieres vender o comprar gemas, también puedes preguntarme.

entries.en: Greetings hero. I guess you came to {talk}.
entries.translated: Saludos héroe. Supongo que viniste a {talk}.

entries.en: Welcome, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. These are dire times for Rookgaard... have you come to help in our {mission}?
entries.translated: Bienvenido, aventurero |PLAYERNAME|. Son tiempos terribles para Rookgaard... ¿has venido a ayudar en nuestro {mission}?

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! How about that studded armor - would you like to have it now?
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido de nuevo, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Qué tal esa armadura con tachuelas? ¿Te gustaría tenerla ahora?

entries.en: |PLAYERNAME|! Thank the gods you are back! While you were gone, something horrible happened. Do you smell the fire?
entries.translated: |PLAYERNAME|! ¡Gracias a los dioses que has vuelto! Mientras no estabas, sucedió algo horrible. ¿Hueles el fuego?

entries.en: Oh my, what happened to your hair? Your face is all black, too - it must have been a hell of flames down there. That's so brave of you. Did you get the book?
entries.translated: Dios mío, ¿qué pasó con tu cabello? Tu cara también está toda negra; debe haber un infierno de llamas allí abajo. Eso es muy valiente de tu parte. ¿Recibiste el libro?

entries.en: Are you prepared for your next mission, |PLAYERNAME|?
Now that you know how to store your money, it's time to go after the trolls. I'm even going to give you some more equipment as reward. Do you feel ready for that mission?
entries.translated: Ahora que sabes cómo almacenar tu dinero, es hora de perseguir a los trolls. Incluso te daré más equipo como recompensa. ¿Te sientes preparado para esa misión?

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you have enough space for that sword now?
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido de nuevo, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Tienes suficiente espacio para esa espada ahora?

entries.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! I'm in a really good mood, I must say. We're almost able to infiltrate Kraknaknork's hideout. I have one last little favour to ask and then my plan is complete. Are you ready?
entries.translated: ¡Saludos, |PLAYERNAME|! Estoy de muy buen humor, debo decir. Casi podemos infiltrarnos en el escondite de Kraknaknork. Tengo un último pequeño favor que pedir y entonces mi plan estará completo. ¿Estás listo?

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! But - back so soon? Please find the wasps' lair in the north-western region of Rookgaard and use the flask I gave you on its dead body. Or did you lose the flask?
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido de nuevo, |PLAYERNAME|! Pero... ¿volverás tan pronto? Encuentra la guarida de las avispas en la región noroeste de Rookgaard y usa el frasco que te di en su cadáver. ¿O perdiste el matraz?

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Were you able to bring back some wasp poison?
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenido de nuevo, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Pudiste traer algo de veneno para avispas?

entries.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. I've heard a loud rumbling from the roof - I hope the stones didn't fall on your toes. Have you loaded at least two catapults?
entries.translated: Saludos, |PLAYERNAME|. Escuché un fuerte estruendo desde el techo. Espero que las piedras no te hayan caído sobre los dedos de los pies. ¿Has cargado al menos dos catapultas?

entries.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. Actually I have some more equipment I could give to you, but first I want to see how you fight. You have fought before, haven't you?
entries.translated: Saludos, |PLAYERNAME|. En realidad tengo más equipo que podría darte, pero primero quiero ver cómo peleas. Has peleado antes, ¿no?

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|. Are you done with the 5 rats I asked you to kill?
entries.translated: Bienvenido de nuevo, |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Terminaste con las 5 ratas que te pedí que mataras?

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|. Glad to see you made it back in one piece. I hope you're not too exhausted, because I could use your {help} again.
entries.translated: Bienvenido de nuevo, |PLAYERNAME|. Me alegra ver que regresaste de una pieza. Espero que no estés demasiado agotado, porque podría usar tu {help} nuevamente.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! Have you made up your mind about sneaking into the tarantula's lair and retrieving a sample of her web? Are you up for it?
entries.translated: ¡Hola |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Has decidido colarte en la guarida de la tarántula y recuperar una muestra de su red? ¿Estás dispuesto a ello?

entries.en: Do you need the instruction for the tarantula's lair again?
entries.translated: ¿Necesitas nuevamente las instrucciones para la guarida de la tarántula?

entries.en: Oh, well done! Let me take that spider web sample from you - careful, careful... it's sturdy, yet fragile. Thank you! I should be able to make a great paralyse trap with this one. Here, I have something sturdy for you as well - want it?
entries.translated: ¡Ah, bien hecho! Déjame tomarte esa muestra de telaraña. Cuidado, cuidado... es resistente, pero frágil. ¡Gracias! Debería poder hacer una gran trampa paralizante con ésta. Toma, también tengo algo resistente para ti. ¿Lo quieres?

entries.en: Hey t-there, you look like someone who enjoys a good {booze}.
entries.translated: Oye, pareces alguien que disfruta de un buen {booze}.

entries.en: Oh, two t-trolls. Hellooo, wittle twolls. <hicks>
entries.translated: Oh, dos trolls. Hola, pequeños dos. <palejones>

entries.en: Oh, two t-trolls. Hellooo, wittle twolls. <hicks>
entries.translated: Oh, dos trolls. Hola, pequeños dos. <palejones>

entries.en: Good hunting! I can offer you some lovely {rewards} for finishing prey hunting tasks! Furthermore I can tell you how many hunting task points (HTP) you actually {have} and you have already {spent}.
entries.translated: ¡Buena caza! ¡Puedo ofrecerte unos encantadores {rewards} para terminar las tareas de caza de presas! Además, puedo decirte cuántos puntos de tareas de caza (HTP) tienes realmente {have} y ya tienes {spent}.

entries.en: Don't touch the machines and beware of uncontrolled worker golems!
entries.translated: Non toccare le macchine e fai attenzione ai golem lavoratori incontrollati!

entries.translated: draghi, orchi e anche i loro empi servitori, e Banor era un leader glorioso per l'umanità.

entries.en: Embalming fluid, chants and holy preparations required to guide the spirit to the next world and preserve his body in the intermediate world, by Rames-Seni  Osi-Atun-Ra-Heton, enlightened embalmer and humble servant of the Lord of the Seven Sandy Seas, may his spirit rule in the afterlife forever.
entries.translated: Fluido per l'imbalsamazione, canti e preparazioni sacre necessarie per guidare lo spirito nell'aldilà e preservare il suo corpo nel mondo intermedio, di Rames-Seni Osi-Atun-Ra-Heton, imbalsamatore illuminato e umile servitore del Signore dei Sette Mari Sabbiosi, possa il suo spirito governare nell'aldilà per sempre.

entries.translated: impiegato. Già gli eserciti delle razze più antiche si preparavano a riconquistare agli umani ciò che gli antichi

entries.en: Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
entries.translated: Поскольку оно пожаробезопасно, это пылающее существо чувствует себя как дома в бушующем аду. Но помните: если оно не горит, оно все равно горит!

entries.en: Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
entries.translated: Это насекомое, похожее на компаньона, оснащенное панцирем черепахи и когтями омара, поможет вам преодолеть любые трудности.

entries.en: This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
entries.translated: Это могучее толстокожее животное пойдет в бой, словно просто на воскресную прогулку. Цена дружбы составила всего несколько очков дрома!

entries.en: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
entries.translated: Вы выдержали палящую жару в туннелях глубоко под Kazordoon и победили Похитителя мозгов. Голоса в твоей голове наконец замолкают.

entries.en: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
entries.translated: Поздравляем с первым достижением! ... Ну, не совсем. Но представьте себе, это так. Потому что на этом этапе вашего путешествия в прошлое Tibia были введены достижения.

entries.en: Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
entries.translated: Просто все будут от вас без ума, если вы наденете это торжественное платье. Они прибегут, обещаю!

entries.en: This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
entries.translated: Этот локомотив, управляемый мрачностью, в мгновение ока доставит вас на любую вечеринку.

entries.en: You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!
entries.translated: Вы овладели огнем и приручили супервулкан!

entries.en: Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
entries.translated: Увы! Что может быть прекраснее и радостнее, чем объединить два любящих сердца? Так романтично!

entries.en: You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
entries.translated: Ты действительно был занят, как бобр, чтобы помочь нагам. Наслаждайтесь энергичной компанией!

entries.en: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
entries.translated: Таинственные наги, яркие джунгли и тонущий остров — теперь вы действительно знаете каждый уголок Marapur.

entries.en: Greetings and Banor be with you, |PLAYERNAME|! May I interest you in a {trade} for weapons, ammunition or armor?
entries.translated: ¡Saludos y Banor esté contigo, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Puedo interesarle un {trade} para armas, municiones o armaduras?

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. If you're only interested in {distance} equipment, let me know.
entries.translated: Por supuesto, simplemente navega por mis productos. Si solo está interesado en el equipo {distance}, hágamelo saber.

entries.en: Did you bring all the materials I informed you about?

entries.en: You gobbled enough slime to get a good grip on this dungeon's slippery floor.
entries.translated: Hai inghiottito abbastanza melma da riuscire ad avere una buona presa sul pavimento scivoloso di questo dungeon.

entries.en: The slime gobbler gobbles large chunks of the slime fungus with great satisfaction.
entries.translated: Il divoratore di melma divora grossi pezzi del fungo melmoso con grande soddisfazione.

entries.translated: ¡Oh, el cielo debe haberte enviado! ¿Podrías ayudarme con un {quest}?

entries.translated: Bienvenido de nuevo, cariño... en cuanto a esa leña, ¿podrías por favor {help}?
