entries.translated: Oh, cariño, ¿hay algún problema con la misión? ¿Debería {explain} volver a hacerlo?

entries.en: Right, thank you sweetheart! This will be enough to heat my oven. Oh, and you are probably waiting for your reward, {yes}?
entries.translated: ¡Bien, gracias cariño! Esto será suficiente para calentar mi horno. Ah, y probablemente estés esperando tu recompensa, ¿{yes}?

entries.en: Oh, welcome back, dear Isleth Eagonst! Are you here for a little chat? Just use the highlighted {keywords} again to choose a {topic}.
entries.translated: ¡Bienvenida de nuevo, querida Isleth Eagonst! ¿Estás aquí para charlar un poco? Simplemente use el {keywords} resaltado nuevamente para elegir un {topic}.

entries.en: Ah, the wind brings in another visitor. Welcome, dear guest. Are you looking for a {passage} with my carpet?
entries.translated: Ah, el viento trae otro visitante. Bienvenido, querido invitado. ¿Estás buscando un {passage} con mi alfombra?

entries.en: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|, student of the arcane arts. I teach the fiercest {spells} available.
entries.translated: Bienvenido |PLAYERNAME|, estudiante de las artes arcanas. Enseño el {spells} más feroz disponible.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Another visitor to this constricted, cosy, calm realm, perfect except for an {exit}. Muhaha.
entries.translated: Otro visitante de este reino restringido, acogedor y tranquilo, perfecto excepto por un {exit}. Mujaja.

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: I am the captain of this ship.
entries.translated: Sono il capitano di questa nave.

entries.en: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you?
entries.translated: Saluti, viaggiatore |PLAYERNAME|. Dove vuoi che vada {fly} tu?

entries.en: Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
entries.translated: Senti il ​​vento tra i capelli durante uno dei miei giri sul tappeto!

entries.en: Do you seek a ride to {0} for {1}?
entries.translated: Cerchi un passaggio fino a {0} per {1}?

entries.en: Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
entries.translated: Senti il ​​vento tra i capelli durante uno dei miei giri sul tappeto!

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Tieni presente che non troverai offerte migliori qui. Basta sfogliare la mia merce.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Quindi ricevi la protezione dello scherzo del destino, pellegrino.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Quindi ricevi la protezione dello scherzo del destino, pellegrino.

entries.en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
entries.translated: Non hai un bell'aspetto. Mi spiace, non posso aiutarti. Ma se stai cercando una protezione aggiuntiva dovresti andare sullo {pilgrimage} di Ash o ottenere la protezione di {twist of fate} qui.

entries.en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
entries.translated: Ogni volta che ricevi una ferita letale, la tua forza vitale viene danneggiata e c'è la possibilità che tu perda parte del tuo equipaggiamento. Con ognuno dei cinque {blessings} che hai, questo danno e la possibilità di perdita saranno ridotti.

entries.en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

entries.en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
entries.translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

entries.en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

entries.en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
entries.translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

entries.en: Please come back from time to time.
Please come back from time to time.
Please come back from time to time.
Thank god you are back!! Did you find....err...what we were talking about??
entries.translated: Слава богу, ты вернулся!! Вы нашли....эээ...о чём мы говорили??

entries.en: At last! Good things come to those who wait.
entries.translated: Наконец! Хорошие вещи приходят к тем, кто ждет.

entries.en: Good bye and please stay away, okay?
entries.translated: До свидания и, пожалуйста, держитесь подальше, хорошо?

entries.en: Ah, an adventurer. Be greeted and have a seat. How may I {serve} you?
entries.translated: Ах, авантюрист. Поприветствуйте и присядьте. Как я могу {serve} тебя?

entries.en: Oh, the nerve. Go to the rats which raised you.
entries.translated: Ох, нервы. Идите к крысам, которые вас вырастили.

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
entries.translated: До свидания, |PLAYERNAME|. Я очень надеюсь, что мы скоро снова поговорим.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?
entries.translated: О, привет |PLAYERNAME|, твои волосы выглядят великолепно! Кто сделал это для тебя?

entries.en: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
entries.translated: О, привет, красавчик! Приятно познакомиться, |PLAYERNAME|. С радостью, у меня есть время {chat} немного.

entries.en: I hope to see you soon.
entries.translated: Я надеюсь увидеть вас в ближайшее время.

entries.en: Hello, stranger! These caves must seem strange to you. I wonder what brings you here... maybe you are interested in some work? There are several tasks I could need a hand with.
entries.translated: Привет, незнакомец! Эти пещеры, должно быть, кажутся вам странными. Интересно, что привело вас сюда... может, вас интересует какая-нибудь работа? Есть несколько задач, с которыми мне может понадобиться помощь.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Да? Что я могу для тебя сделать, |PLAYERNAME|? Банковский бизнес, возможно?

entries.en: As far as I know, he is working in the castle.
entries.translated: Din câte știu eu, el lucrează la castel.

entries.en: I am a little shy and so don't hear many rumors.
entries.translated: Sunt puțin timid și nu aud multe zvonuri.

entries.en: Oh, you little devil, stop talking like that! <blush>
entries.translated: O, dracule, nu mai vorbi așa! <blush>

entries.en: I know only little about weapons. Can you tell me something about them, please?
entries.translated: Știu puțin despre arme. Poți să-mi spui ceva despre ei, te rog?

entries.en: Oh, I just remember I have some work to do, sorry. Bye!
entries.translated: Oh, îmi amintesc că am ceva de lucru, îmi pare rău. Pa!

entries.en: I believe that love is stronger than magic, don't you agree?
entries.translated: Eu cred că dragostea este mai puternică decât magia, nu ești de acord?

entries.en: Oh, sorry, I have to hurry, bye!
entries.translated: Oh, scuze, trebuie să mă grăbesc, pa!

entries.en: I would like to visit the beach more often, but I guess it's too dangerous.
entries.translated: Mi-ar plăcea să vizitez plaja mai des, dar cred că este prea periculos.

entries.en: I love this castle! It's so beautiful.
entries.translated: Iubesc acest castel! E atât de frumos.

entries.en: Powerful sorcerers frighten me a little.
I personally think it's inappropriate for a woman to become a warrior, what do you think about that?
entries.translated: Eu personal cred că este nepotrivit ca o femeie să devină războinică, ce părere ai despre asta?

entries.en: Druids seldom visit a town, what do you know about druids?
entries.translated: Druizii vizitează rar un oraș, ce știi despre druizi?

entries.en: I like brave fighters like him.
entries.translated: Îmi plac luptătorii curajoși ca el.
Oh, el este atât de drăguț!

entries.en: I like dogs, the little ones at least. Do you like dogs, too?
entries.translated: Îmi plac câinii, cel puțin cei mici. Îți plac și ție câinii?

entries.en: Take some time to talk to me!
entries.translated: Fă-ți puțin timp să vorbești cu mine!

entries.en: Oh, I am just a girl and know nothing about magic swords and such things.
entries.translated: Oh, sunt doar o fată și nu știu nimic despre săbiile magice și astfel de lucruri.

entries.en: I ... don't know someone named like that.
entries.translated: Eu... nu cunosc pe cineva numit așa.

entries.en: Yenny? I know no Yenny, nor have I ever used that name! You have mistook me with someone else.
entries.translated: Yenny? Nu o cunosc pe Yenny și nici nu am folosit vreodată acest nume! M-ai confundat cu altcineva.

entries.en: Well ... I have met him for a little while .. but this was nothing serious.
entries.translated: Ei bine... l-am cunoscut de putin timp.. dar asta nu a fost nimic grav.

entries.en: A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it
entries.translated: Un eremita vicino a Carlin potrebbe dirti di più a riguardo

entries.en: Use it in your house to construct a drawer
entries.translated: Folosește-l în casa ta pentru a construi un sertar

entries.en: Zzaion is our last zztand! I will not leave wizzout a fight!
entries.translated: Ззайон — наш последний ззтанд! Я не оставлю wizzout бой!

entries.en: Feel the wrath of mother Tibia!
I will be still around when my 'noble' race is gone.
entries.translated: Я буду рядом, когда моя гонка 'noble' закончится.

entries.translated: Gratis eskort till depån för nykomlingar!

entries.en: Would you like me to mark locations like - for example - the depot, bank and shops on your map?
entries.translated: Vill du att jag markerar platser som - till exempel - depån, banken och butikerna på din karta?

entries.en: Well, nothing wrong about exploring the town on your own. Let me know if you need something!
entries.translated: Nåväl, inget fel med att utforska staden på egen hand. Säg till om du behöver något!

entries.en: Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
entries.translated: Gratis eskort till depån för nykomlingar!

entries.en: Talk to me if you need directions.
entries.translated: Prata med mig om du behöver vägbeskrivning.

entries.en: Would you like me to mark locations like - for example - the depot, bank and shops on your map?
entries.translated: Vill du att jag markerar platser som - till exempel - depån, banken och butikerna på din karta?

entries.en: Well, nothing wrong about exploring the town on your own. Let me know if you need something!
entries.translated: Nåväl, inget fel med att utforska staden på egen hand. Säg till om du behöver något!

entries.en: Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
entries.translated: Gratis eskort till depån för nykomlingar!

entries.en: Free escort to the depot for newcomers!

entries.en: Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
entries.translated: För närvarande kan jag berätta allt om staden, dess tempel, banken, butiker, speltränare och depån, samt om världsstatusen.

entries.en: Talk to me if you need directions.
entries.translated: Prata med mig om du behöver vägbeskrivning.

entries.en: Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
entries.translated: Gratis eskort till depån för nykomlingar!

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: [World Change] Yasir has arrived in %s today!
Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
entries.translated: Oh, ciao, bello! È un piacere conoscerti, |PLAYERNAME|. Volentieri ho il tempo di {chat} un po'.

entries.en: Hello, stranger! These caves must seem strange to you. I wonder what brings you here... maybe you are interested in some work? There are several tasks I could need a hand with.
entries.translated: Ciao, straniero! Queste grotte ti devono sembrare strane. Mi chiedo cosa ti porta qui... forse ti interessa qualche lavoro? Ci sono diversi compiti per i quali potrei aver bisogno di una mano.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: I am not here to fight you, fool. Like it or not, we will have to work together to stop the catastrophe you and that priest have initiated.
entries.translated: Non sono qui per combatterti, stupido. Che ci piaccia o no, dovremo lavorare insieme per fermare la catastrofe che tu e quel prete avete provocato.

entries.en: Greetings, mortal. Be aware that you are trying my patience while we are talking.
entries.translated: Saluti, mortale. Tieni presente che stai mettendo a dura prova la mia pazienza mentre parliamo.

entries.en: LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
entries.translated: VIVA LA REGINA! Puoi andartene adesso!

entries.en: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
entries.translated: Benvenuti nella mia umile dimora. Se vieni per il nuovo stregone {spells}, sei nel posto giusto.

entries.en: May God show you the path, |PLAYERNAME|.
Of course, just browse through my offers.
entries.translated: Naturalmente basta sfogliare le mie offerte.

entries.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: Addio, |PLAYERNAME|, sarò qui se avrai ancora bisogno di me.

entries.en: Do you bring freshly killed rats for a bounty of 1 gold each? By the way, I also buy orc teeth and other stuff you ripped from their bloody corp... I mean... well, you know what I mean.
entries.translated: Porti ratti appena uccisi per una taglia di 1 oro ciascuno? A proposito, compro anche denti di orco e altra roba che hai strappato al loro maledetto corpo... voglio dire... beh, sai cosa intendo.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Naturalmente, basta sfogliare la mia merce.

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Ciao. Come posso aiutarti |PLAYERNAME|? Chiedimi un {trade} se vuoi comprare qualcosa. Posso anche spiegare il sistema {mail}.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you.
Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Oh, per favore entra, |PLAYERNAME|. Cosa posso fare per lei? Se hai bisogno di attrezzatura per l'avventura, chiedimi un {trade}.

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Привет, привет, привет, маленькая леди |PLAYERNAME|! Что приносит вам {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, |PLAYERNAME|! Пусть земля защитит тебя на каменистых землях. Если вам нужен {passage}, я могу вам помочь.
Добро пожаловать в мою скромную хижину, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Привет, |PLAYERNAME|! Вы, должно быть, довольно сильно пришли в себя. Мне всегда интересно узнавать что-то новое о Зао.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome on board, recruit |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, набираем |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Приветствую тебя, отважный искатель приключений. Если вам нужен {passage}, дайте мне знать.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Hail, pirat! Come on board to go home! Welcome on board of the ship Flying Bat. Should I set {sail}s?
entries.translated: Salut, pirat! Vino la bord pentru a merge acasă! Bun venit la bordul navei Flying Bat. Ar trebui să setez {sail}?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Bun venit la bord, |PLAYERNAME|. Unde te pot {sail} astăzi?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: La revedere. Recomandați-ne dacă ați fost mulțumit de serviciile noastre.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Bun venit la bord, |PLAYERNAME|. Unde te pot {sail} astăzi?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: La revedere. Recomandați-ne dacă ați fost mulțumit de serviciile noastre.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where may I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Bun venit la bord, |PLAYERNAME|. Unde te pot {sail} astăzi?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: La revedere. Recomandați-ne dacă ați fost mulțumit de serviciile noastre.

entries.en: Welcome on board, Sir |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Bun venit la bord, domnule |PLAYERNAME|. Unde te pot {sail} astăzi?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: La revedere. Recomandați-ne dacă ați fost mulțumit de serviciile noastre.

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Salutări, aventurier îndrăzneț. Dacă aveți nevoie de un {passage}, anunțați-mă.

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a return {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Salutări, aventurier îndrăzneț. Dacă aveți nevoie de retur {passage}, anunțați-mă.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|. I am looking forward to trade with you.
entries.translated: Bun venit, |PLAYERNAME|. Aștept cu nerăbdare să schimb cu tine.

entries.en: Welcome back |PLAYERNAME|, I hope you changed your mind and will bring me some {meat}? I'll even give you some gold for it.
entries.translated: Bine ai revenit |PLAYERNAME|, sper că te-ai răzgândit și îmi vei aduce niște {meat}? Îți voi da chiar și niște aur pentru asta.

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Did you have a successful hunt and carry a piece of {meat} or ham with you?
entries.translated: Bine ai revenit, |PLAYERNAME|! Ai avut o vânătoare reușită și ai purtat cu tine o bucată de {meat} sau șuncă?

entries.en: Welcome back, Isleth Eagonst! Do you still have that piece of meat or ham? If so, please ask me for a {trade} and I'll give you some gold for it.
entries.translated: Bine ai revenit, Isleth Eagonst! Mai ai bucata aceea de carne sau sunca? Dacă da, vă rog să-mi cereți un {trade} și vă voi da niște aur pentru el.

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Where did you put that delicious piece of food? Did you eat it yourself? Well, if you find another one, please come back.
entries.translated: Bine ai revenit, |PLAYERNAME|! Unde ai pus bucata aceea delicioasa de mancare? L-ai mâncat singur? Ei bine, dacă găsești altul, te rog să revii.

entries.en: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!
entries.translated: Bună, |PLAYERNAME|! Ei bine, așa funcționează tranzacționarea cu NPC-uri ca mine. Cred că ești gata acum să treci podul spre Rookgaard! Ai grijă!

entries.en: Hello again, |PLAYERNAME|! What are you still doing here? You should head over the bridge to Rookgaard village now!
entries.translated: Bună din nou, |PLAYERNAME|! Ce mai faci aici? Ar trebui să treceți peste pod în satul Rookgaard acum!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You have no idea on how to use this device. Xelvar in Kazordoon might tell you more about it.
entries.translated: Вы понятия не имеете, как пользоваться этим устройством. Xelvar в Kazordoon может рассказать вам об этом больше.

entries.en: Gnomedix: So let the examination begin! Now don't move. Don't be afraid. The good doctor gnome won't hurt you - hopefully!
entries.translated: Gnomedix: Итак, начнём осмотр! Теперь не двигайся. Не бойтесь. Добрый гном-доктор не причинит вам вреда – надеюсь!
<clong!> <clong!> <scrit scrit scrit>Acest lucru ar trebui să facă acest lucru.

entries.en: Hello, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you?
Here, take a look and choose something nice for you!
entries.translated: Här, ta en titt och välj något fint för dig!

entries.en: Stand still on the examination platform |PLAYERNAME|.
Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! Why do you disturb me?
Hello there, hmm just... just wait right there, I'll be with you in a second. Just getting this {experiment} done...
entries.translated: Hallå där, hmm bara... vänta bara där, jag är med dig om en sekund. Bara att få det här {experiment} gjort...

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
entries.translated: Välkommen, |PLAYERNAME|! Känner du dig äventyrlig? Vill du ha en veckovis {ticket} för malmvagnssystemet här? Du kan använda den här för att komma till centrum av Kazordoon!

entries.en: Hi, come closer. Have a look at my wares.
entries.translated: Hej, kom närmare. Ta en titt på mina varor.

entries.en: Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.
entries.translated: Vem är du? Vad vill du? Du verkar för erfaren för att bli min assistent. Vänligen lämna.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
entries.translated: Hej |PLAYERNAME|! Behöver du lite utrustning till ditt hus?

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
entries.translated: Ta en titt. De flesta möbler kommer i praktiska kit. Använd dem bara i ditt hus för att montera möblerna. Vill du bara se en viss {type} möbler?

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Наравно, само прегледајте моју робу. {Footballs} се морају купити засебно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Здраво |PLAYERNAME|. Ја сам фармер и кувар, можда бих могао да те заинтересујем за {trade} са храном? Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Goodbye. I am sure you will come back for more. They all do.
entries.translated: Довиђења. Сигуран сам да ћете се вратити по још. Сви раде.

entries.en: Goodbye. I am sure you will come back for more. They all do.
entries.translated: Довиђења. Сигуран сам да ћете се вратити по још. Сви раде.

entries.en: Are you talking to me? Well, go on chatting but don't expect an answer.
entries.translated: Ти мени причаш? Па, наставите да ћаскате, али не очекујте одговор.

entries.en: Welcome to the Hard Rock Racing Track, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Добродошли на тркачку стазу Хард Роцк, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Hi! I hope you're not going to kill me!
entries.translated: Здраво! Надам се да ме нећеш убити!

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, здраво, мала дамо |PLAYERNAME|! Шта вам доноси {here}?

entries.en: Remember: A joke a day keeps the ghouls away!
entries.translated: Запамтите: шала на дан одвраћа духове!

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добродошли, млади |PLAYERNAME|! Ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вам {heal} бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добродошли, |PLAYERNAME|! Нека вас земља заштити на стеновитим теренима. Ако вам треба {passage}, могу вам помоћи.

entries.translated: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow

entries.en: You carefully coat the inside of the wooden bowl with the sacred clay.
entries.translated: Rivesti con cura l'interno della ciotola di legno con l'argilla sacra.

entries.en: You carefully mix the clay with the sacred earth.
entries.translated: Mescoli attentamente l'argilla con la terra sacra.

entries.en: The plant twines and twiggles even more than before, it almost looks as it would scream great pain.
entries.translated: La pianta si attorciglia e si dimena ancora più di prima, sembra quasi voglia urlare un grande dolore.

entries.en: This should have dealt the deathblow to the snake things' ambitions.
entries.translated: Questo avrebbe dovuto infliggere il colpo mortale alle ambizioni delle cose serpente.

entries.en: The sceptre is almost torn from your hand as you banish the presence of the emperor.
entries.translated: Lo scettro ti viene quasi strappato di mano mentre scacci la presenza dell'imperatore.

entries.en: The sceptre is almost torn from your hand as you banish the presence of the emperor.
entries.translated: Lo scettro ti viene quasi strappato di mano mentre scacci la presenza dell'imperatore.

entries.en: The sceptre is almost torn from your hand as you banish the presence of the emperor.
entries.translated: Lo scettro ti viene quasi strappato di mano mentre scacci la presenza dell'imperatore.

entries.en: The sceptre is almost torn from your hand as you banish the presence of the emperor.
entries.translated: Lo scettro ti viene quasi strappato di mano mentre scacci la presenza dell'imperatore.

entries.en: You have found some clothes in wardrobe
You have found a flask of poison.
entries.translated: Hai trovato una boccetta di veleno.

entries.en: The rice has been poisoned. This will weaken the Emperor's army significantly. Return and tell Zalamon about your success.
entries.translated: Il riso è stato avvelenato. Ciò indebolirà notevolmente l'esercito dell'Imperatore. Ritorna e racconta a Zalamon del tuo successo.

entries.en: Due to being extra greasy, the leavers can now be moved.
entries.translated: Dato che sono molto unte, le foglie ora possono essere spostate.

entries.en: After a cracking noise a deep humming suddenly starts from somewhere below.
entries.translated: Dopo uno schiocco, improvvisamente inizia da qualche parte in basso un ronzio profondo.

entries.en: A ray of sunlight comes down from the heaven and hits the crystal. Wow. That probably means Fasuon is supporting.
entries.translated: Un raggio di sole scende dal cielo e colpisce il cristallo. Oh. Ciò probabilmente significa che Fasuon sta supportando.

entries.en: This metal egg seems to be locked by a strange mechanism. The time for it to reveal its contents has not yet come.
entries.translated: Questo uovo di metallo sembra essere bloccato da uno strano meccanismo. Non è ancora giunto il momento di rivelarne il contenuto.

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
entries.translated: Песчаная буря путешествует по Дараме, приводя к островам, полным смертоносных существ внутри кошмара. Избегайте реки возле Drefia!

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: You charted the location and dimensions of a strange structure, a bastion.
entries.translated: Вы нанесли на карту расположение и размеры странного сооружения — бастиона.

entries.en: You charted the location and dimensions of a strange structure, a broken tower.
entries.translated: Вы нанесли на карту расположение и размеры странного сооружения — разрушенной башни.

entries.en: You have found a gnome charts.
You can not use this item again.
entries.translated: Вы не сможете использовать этот предмет снова.

entries.en: You have found a gnome trignometre.
Only half-decayed diremaw corpses can be neutralised with these pesticides.
entries.translated: Этими пестицидами можно нейтрализовать только полуразложившиеся трупы лютобрюхов.

entries.en: You need at least level 150 to enter.
entries.translated: Для входа вам нужен минимум 150 уровень.

entries.en: The strange symbol in the wall in the back glows violently.
entries.translated: Странный символ на стене сзади яростно светится.

entries.en: The cult object just lies there quietly. The dangerous area around it has been all but dissolved.
entries.translated: Культовый объект просто тихо лежит. Опасная зона вокруг него практически исчезла.

entries.en: As you reach out to touch the cult object, a surge of energy burst from the skull. You banished its power.
entries.translated: Когда вы протягиваете руку, чтобы прикоснуться к культовому объекту, из черепа вырывается волна энергии. Вы изгнали его силу.

entries.en: You need to wait few minutes to use again.
entries.translated: Вам нужно подождать несколько минут, чтобы использовать снова.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You remove its top and pull the crate over yourself. Inside it is stifling and you can barely see a thing when looking outward.
entries.translated: Îi scoți partea de sus și trage lada peste tine. Înăuntru este înăbușitor și abia se vede ceva când privești în afară.

entries.en: As you give the coal into the pool the corrupted fluid begins to dissolve, leaving purified, refreshing water.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce dați cărbunele în bazin, fluidul corupt începe să se dizolve, lăsând apă purificată și răcoritoare.

entries.en: Filling the corrupted water into the sacred bowl completly purifies the fluid.
entries.translated: Umplerea cu apă coruptă în vasul sacru purifică complet lichidul.

entries.en: You carefully coat the inside of the wooden bowl with the sacred clay.
entries.translated: Acoperiți cu atenție interiorul vasului de lemn cu argila sacră.

entries.en: You carefully mix the clay with the sacred earth.
entries.translated: Amesteci cu grijă lutul cu pământul sacru.

entries.en: The plant twines and twiggles even more than before, it almost looks as it would scream great pain.
entries.translated: Planta se frământă și se frământă chiar mai mult decât înainte, aproape că arată că ar țipa o durere mare.

entries.en: This should have dealt the deathblow to the snake things' ambitions.
entries.translated: Acest lucru ar fi trebuit să dea lovitura de moarte ambițiilor lucrurilor șarpe.

entries.en: The sceptre is almost torn from your hand as you banish the presence of the emperor.
entries.translated: Sceptrul este aproape smuls din mâna ta în timp ce alungi prezența împăratului.

entries.en: The sceptre is almost torn from your hand as you banish the presence of the emperor.

entries.en: You have found some clothes in wardrobe
entries.translated: Ai găsit niște haine în garderobă

entries.en: You have found a flask of poison.
entries.translated: Ai găsit un balon cu otravă.

entries.en: The rice has been poisoned. This will weaken the Emperor's army significantly. Return and tell Zalamon about your success.
entries.translated: Orezul a fost otrăvit. Acest lucru va slăbi semnificativ armata împăratului. Întoarce-te și spune-i lui Zalamon despre succesul tău.

entries.en: Due to being extra greasy, the leavers can now be moved.
entries.translated: Datorită faptului că sunt foarte grase, frunzele pot fi acum mutate.

entries.en: After a cracking noise a deep humming suddenly starts from somewhere below.
entries.translated: După un zgomot de trosnire, de undeva dedesubt începe brusc un zumzet profund.

entries.en: A ray of sunlight comes down from the heaven and hits the crystal. Wow. That probably means Fasuon is supporting.
entries.translated: O rază de soare coboară din cer și lovește cristalul. Wow. Asta înseamnă probabil că Fasuon susține.

entries.en: First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
entries.translated: Сначала вам нужно будет убить трех носителей чумы, а затем получить Формулы алхимиков. Когда это будет сделано, возвращайтесь либо к Палимуту (хорошая сторона), либо к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона).

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: You joined the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. Ask Grizzly Adams for some hunting tasks. You already gained %d points. You currently have %d boss points.
entries.translated: Вы присоединились к '__PH0__'. Попросите Гризли Адамса выполнить несколько охотничьих заданий. Вы уже набрали %d баллов. На данный момент у вас есть %d очков босса.

entries.en: Dodges an attack with a chance, avoiding all damage.
entries.translated: Evită un atac cu șansă, evitând toate daunele.

entries.en: Reflects incoming damage back to the aggressor.
entries.translated: Reflectă daunele primite înapoi asupra agresorului.

entries.en: Cripples the creature and paralyzes it for 10 seconds.
entries.translated: Infirmă creatura și o paralizează timp de 10 secunde.

entries.en: By the way: The summoning of lesser creatures, the so-called 'reds', progressed comparatively well. Of course, these creatures are mere borderdwellers and may consequently not be considered true demons. However, it may prove that the development of summoning spells for 'reds' will prove a rewarding spin-off of demon summoning research.
entries.translated: Кстати: призыв меньших существ, так называемых 'reds', продвигался сравнительно хорошо. Конечно, эти существа всего лишь обитатели границ и, следовательно, не могут считаться настоящими демонами. Однако может оказаться, что разработка заклинаний призыва для 'reds' станет полезным побочным продуктом исследований по призыву демонов.

entries.en: Even though many djinns had lost their lives during the fateful battle of Ankrahmun, the war was still undecided. Malor had lost many of his bravest warriors, but so had Gabel, and they both knew that another epic battle like that would bring the whole djinn race to the brink of destruction. In his desperation, Gabel turned to his trusted friend Fa'Hradin for advice. The old djinn suggested using a trick to eliminate Malor. Without their leader, he reasoned, the Efreet would end the rebellion. Gabel, who wanted to avoid further bloodshed, agreed. And so it came to pass that the magic lamp was created and, by means that are unknown to this very day, secretly placed in Malor's private chamber. The mighty Efreet never had a chance. When he went to sleep in what he thought was his private lamp he was trapped inside the lamp, which was soon enough smuggled out of Mal'Ouquah, the Efreets' fortress, and brought back to the Marid. Fa'hradin's trick had worked - Malor was Gabel's prisoner.
entries.translated: Chiar dacă mulți djinni și-au pierdut viața în timpul bătăliei fatidice de la Ankrahmun, războiul era încă nehotărât. Malor își pierduse mulți dintre cei mai curajoși războinici ai săi, dar la fel și Gabel și amândoi știau că o altă luptă epică ca aceea avea să aducă întreaga rasă de djini în pragul distrugerii. În disperarea sa, Gabel a apelat la prietenul său de încredere Fa'Hradin pentru sfat. Bătrânul djinn a sugerat să folosească un truc pentru a-l elimina pe Malor. Fără liderul lor, a raționat el, Efreet ar pune capăt revoltei. Gabel, care dorea să evite alte vărsări de sânge, a fost de acord. Și așa s-a întâmplat că lampa magică a fost creată și, prin mijloace necunoscute până în ziua de azi, a fost plasată în secret în camera privată a lui Malor. Puternicul Efreet nu a avut nicio șansă. Când s-a culcat în ceea ce credea că era lampa sa privată, a fost prins în interiorul lămpii, care a fost destul de curând scoasă ilegal din Mal'Ouquah, fortăreața soților Efreet, și adusă înapoi la Marid. Trucul lui Fa'hradin funcționase - Malor era prizonierul lui Gabel.

entries.en: Eventually Gabel stepped forward to meet his opponent. This was the moment Malor, who had never intended to fight honourably, had been waiting for. All of a sudden the earth opened in a thousand places, and hordes of vicious undead attacked the Gabel and his army. For Malor had secretly formed an alliance with the dreaded necromancers of Drefia and it was them who controlled the undead hordes that fought for him. Faced with an overwhelming enemy, Gabel and his army turned to flee.
entries.translated: În cele din urmă, Gabel a făcut un pas înainte pentru a-și întâlni adversarul. Acesta era momentul pe care îl aștepta Malor, care nu intenționase niciodată să lupte onorabil. Dintr-o dată pământul s-a deschis în o mie de locuri și hoarde de strigoi vicioși l-au atacat pe Gabel și armata lui. Căci Malor formase în secret o alianță cu temuții nigromanți ai lui Drefia și ei erau cei care controlau hoardele de strigoi care luptau pentru el. Confruntat cu un inamic copleșitor, Gabel și armata sa s-au întors să fugă.

entries.en: Eventually they started exposing undead bodies to evil energies and merging them with living beings into massive undead monstrosities, which, however, withered and died almost as soon as they were created. After some experiments that failed in an particularly spectacular manner, the bone lords were forced to abandon their experiments. Soon, their gruesome experiments faded from memory. They had been all but forgotten when a number of braindeath emerged in a remote beholder city, claiming to have achieved a decisive breakthrough in the field of necromancy. The high council of the beholder elders reluctantly sent a number of scientists down to the laboratories to examine the results. The undead creatures they found were so hideous and degenerated that the scientists flatly declared that these experiments that led their creation contradicted the very principles of beholderkin. All undead were to be destroyed and the experiments were to be abolished once and for all.
entries.translated: În cele din urmă, au început să expună corpurile de strigoi la energii malefice și să le îmbine cu ființe vii în monstruozități masive de strigoi, care, totuși, s-au ofilit și au murit aproape de îndată ce au fost create. După niște experimente care au eșuat într-o manieră deosebit de spectaculoasă, stăpânii oaselor au fost nevoiți să-și abandoneze experimentele. Curând, experimentele lor groaznice au dispărut din memorie. Au fost aproape uitați când au apărut o serie de morți cerebrale într-un oraș îndepărtat, pretinzând că au realizat o descoperire decisivă în domeniul necromanției. Înaltul consiliu al bătrânilor privitori a trimis fără tragere de inimă un număr de oameni de știință la laboratoare pentru a examina rezultatele. Creaturile strigoi pe care le-au găsit erau atât de hidoase și degenerate încât oamenii de știință au declarat categoric că aceste experimente care au condus creația lor contrazic înseși principiile privitorului. Toți strigoii urmau să fie distruși, iar experimentele trebuiau desființate odată pentru totdeauna.

entries.en: Every child knows the sad fate of the Kha'labal. Once it was brimming with life, a verdant paradise filled with lush forests and countless freshwater springs. The gods created this paradise and gave it to their newly-made race, the humans, as a present. Protected on all sides by the sea or by insurpassable mountains, the Kha'labal was the perfect environment for the young, vulnerable race to flourish. And flourish and thrive it did. Guided by their leader Banor and endowed with amazing technical skills and knowledge by their creators, the humans managed to settle the whole Kha'labal within few generations, and beautiful buildings rose to the sky, the mightiest of which were to be found in the majestic city of Ankrahmun. These early humans, who today are called the Founders, were a friendly race who lived in peace and harmony with each other, ignorant of the horrors lurking in the outside world. And the gods, who watched them from their thrones in the Kha'zeel, smiled on them.
entries.translated: Fiecare copil cunoaște soarta tristă a lui Kha'labal. Cândva era plin de viață, un paradis verde, plin de păduri luxuriante și nenumărate izvoare de apă dulce. Zeii au creat acest paradis și l-au făcut cadou rasei lor proaspăt create, oamenii. Protejat din toate părțile de mare sau de munți de neîntrecut, Kha'labal a fost mediul perfect pentru ca rasa tânără și vulnerabilă să înflorească. Și a înflorit și a prospera așa a făcut. Ghidați de liderul lor Banor și înzestrați cu abilități tehnice și cunoștințe uimitoare de către creatorii lor, oamenii au reușit să stabilească întregul Kha'labal în câteva generații, iar clădirile frumoase s-au ridicat spre cer, dintre care cele mai puternice se găseau în orașul maiestuos Ankrahmun. Acești oameni timpurii, care astăzi sunt numiți Fondatorii, erau o rasă prietenoasă care trăia în pace și armonie unii cu alții, ignoranți de ororile care pândesc în lumea exterioară. Și zeii, care îi priveau de pe tronurile lor în Kha'zeel, le-au zâmbit.

entries.en: Even though many djinns had lost their lives during the fateful battle of Ankrahmun, the war was still undecided. Malor had lost many of his bravest warriors, but so had Gabel, and they both knew that another epic battle like that would bring the whole djinn race to the brink of destruction. In his desperation, Gabel turned to his trusted friend Fa'Hradin for advice. The old djinn suggested using a trick to eliminate Malor. Without their leader, he reasoned, the Efreet would end the rebellion. Gabel, who wanted to avoid further bloodshed, agreed. And so it came to pass that the magic lamp was created and, by means that are unknown to this very day, secretly placed in Malor's private chamber. The mighty Efreet never had a chance. When he went to sleep in what he thought was his private lamp he was trapped inside the lamp, which was soon enough smuggled out of Mal'Ouquah, the Efreets' fortress, and brought back to the Marid. Fa'hradin's trick had worked - Malor was Gabel's prisoner.
entries.translated: Anche se molti jinn avevano perso la vita durante la fatidica battaglia di Ankrahmun, la guerra era ancora indecisa. Malor aveva perso molti dei suoi guerrieri più coraggiosi, ma anche Gabel, ed entrambi sapevano che un'altra battaglia epica come quella avrebbe portato l'intera razza dei djinn sull'orlo della distruzione. Nella sua disperazione, Gabel si rivolse al suo fidato amico Fa'Hradin per chiedere consiglio. Il vecchio jinn suggerì di usare un trucco per eliminare Malor. Senza il loro leader, ragionò, gli Efreet avrebbero posto fine alla ribellione. Gabel, che voleva evitare ulteriori spargimenti di sangue, acconsentì. E così avvenne che la lampada magica fu creata e, con mezzi ancora oggi sconosciuti, fu collocata segretamente nella camera privata di Malor. Il potente Efreet non ha mai avuto una possibilità. Quando andò a dormire in quella che pensava fosse la sua lampada privata, rimase intrappolato all'interno della lampada, che fu presto portata fuori di nascosto da Mal'Ouquah, la fortezza degli Efreet, e riportata al Marid. Il trucco di Fa'hradin aveva funzionato: Malor era prigioniero di Gabel.

entries.en: Eventually Gabel stepped forward to meet his opponent. This was the moment Malor, who had never intended to fight honourably, had been waiting for. All of a sudden the earth opened in a thousand places, and hordes of vicious undead attacked the Gabel and his army. For Malor had secretly formed an alliance with the dreaded necromancers of Drefia and it was them who controlled the undead hordes that fought for him. Faced with an overwhelming enemy, Gabel and his army turned to flee.
entries.translated: Alla fine Gabel si fece avanti per incontrare il suo avversario. Questo era il momento che Malor, che non aveva mai avuto intenzione di combattere onorevolmente, stava aspettando. All'improvviso la terra si aprì in mille punti e orde di feroci non morti attaccarono Gabel e il suo esercito. Perché Malor aveva segretamente stretto un'alleanza con i temuti negromanti di Drefia ed erano loro a controllare le orde di non morti che combattevano per lui. Di fronte a un nemico schiacciante, Gabel e il suo esercito si voltarono per fuggire.

entries.en: Eventually they started exposing undead bodies to evil energies and merging them with living beings into massive undead monstrosities, which, however, withered and died almost as soon as they were created. After some experiments that failed in an particularly spectacular manner, the bone lords were forced to abandon their experiments. Soon, their gruesome experiments faded from memory. They had been all but forgotten when a number of braindeath emerged in a remote beholder city, claiming to have achieved a decisive breakthrough in the field of necromancy. The high council of the beholder elders reluctantly sent a number of scientists down to the laboratories to examine the results. The undead creatures they found were so hideous and degenerated that the scientists flatly declared that these experiments that led their creation contradicted the very principles of beholderkin. All undead were to be destroyed and the experiments were to be abolished once and for all.
entries.translated: Alla fine iniziarono a esporre i corpi dei non morti alle energie malvagie e a fonderli con gli esseri viventi in enormi mostruosità non morte, che, tuttavia, appassirono e morirono non appena furono create. Dopo alcuni esperimenti falliti in modo particolarmente spettacolare, i signori delle ossa furono costretti ad abbandonare i loro esperimenti. Ben presto i loro raccapriccianti esperimenti svanirono dalla memoria. Erano stati quasi dimenticati quando in una remota città di beholder emersero alcuni individui della morte cerebrale, che affermavano di aver raggiunto una svolta decisiva nel campo della negromanzia. L'alto consiglio degli anziani degli osservatori inviò con riluttanza un certo numero di scienziati nei laboratori per esaminare i risultati. Le creature non morte che trovarono erano così orribili e degenerate che gli scienziati dichiararono categoricamente che gli esperimenti che portarono alla loro creazione contraddicevano i principi stessi degli osservatori. Tutti i non morti dovevano essere distrutti e gli esperimenti dovevano essere aboliti una volta per tutte.

entries.en: ever. May those who will come not fall prey to the same evil as we did.

entries.en: Every child knows the sad fate of the Kha'labal. Once it was brimming with life, a verdant paradise filled with lush forests and countless freshwater springs. The gods created this paradise and gave it to their newly-made race, the humans, as a present. Protected on all sides by the sea or by insurpassable mountains, the Kha'labal was the perfect environment for the young, vulnerable race to flourish. And flourish and thrive it did. Guided by their leader Banor and endowed with amazing technical skills and knowledge by their creators, the humans managed to settle the whole Kha'labal within few generations, and beautiful buildings rose to the sky, the mightiest of which were to be found in the majestic city of Ankrahmun. These early humans, who today are called the Founders, were a friendly race who lived in peace and harmony with each other, ignorant of the horrors lurking in the outside world. And the gods, who watched them from their thrones in the Kha'zeel, smiled on them.
entries.translated: Ogni bambino conosce il triste destino dei Kha'labal. Un tempo era pieno di vita, un paradiso verdeggiante pieno di foreste lussureggianti e innumerevoli sorgenti d'acqua dolce. Gli dei crearono questo paradiso e lo regalarono alla loro razza appena creata, gli umani. Protetto su tutti i lati dal mare o da montagne insuperabili, il Kha'labal era l'ambiente perfetto affinché la razza giovane e vulnerabile potesse prosperare. E prosperò e prosperò. Guidati dal loro leader Banor e dotati di incredibili capacità tecniche e conoscenze da parte dei loro creatori, gli umani riuscirono a colonizzare l'intero Kha'labal in poche generazioni e splendidi edifici salirono al cielo, i più possenti dei quali si trovavano nella maestosa città di Ankrahmun. Questi primi esseri umani, che oggi sono chiamati i Fondatori, erano una razza amichevole che viveva in pace e armonia tra loro, ignara degli orrori in agguato nel mondo esterno. E gli dei, che li osservavano dai loro troni nel Kha'zeel, sorridevano loro.

entries.en: Example how to talk with the npc:

exchange for certain services that have not been further elaborated on in the court's documents. The foreigner was found guilty without trial and sentenced to three years of work in the salt mines. The footsoldier Kamahl claimed his father Indril was guilty of witchcraft. Several obscure texts were found beneath the accused person's bed. Indril was banished from the city and his property was equally divided between the pharaoh and his heirs. The foreigner Todd Ballory was pronounced guilty of killing the overseer Barnak, a father of sixteen children and a respectable member of the local whipcrackers' association. The aforementioned convict was sentenced to a rather spectacular final appearance in the local arena.
entries.translated: scambio per determinati servizi che non sono stati ulteriormente elaborati nei documenti della corte. Lo straniero fu riconosciuto colpevole senza processo e condannato a tre anni di lavoro nelle miniere di sale. Il fante Kamahl affermò che suo padre Indril era colpevole di stregoneria. Sotto il letto dell'accusato sono stati rinvenuti numerosi testi oscuri. Indril fu bandito dalla città e le sue proprietà furono equamente divise tra il faraone e i suoi eredi. Lo straniero Todd Ballory fu dichiarato colpevole dell'omicidio del sorvegliante Barnak, padre di sedici figli e rispettabile membro della locale associazione di frustatori. Il suddetto detenuto fu condannato ad un'apparizione finale piuttosto spettacolare nell'arena locale.
