entries.translated: Грабить, приглашать себя на VIP-вечеринки, подделывать контракты и выдавать себя за кого-то другого — вы мастер на все руки, когда дело касается незаконной деятельности. Вы не берете пленных, за исключением случайных золотых рыбок.

entries.en: You could be the author of the magnum opus 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. Or, if your mind and heart are pure, you rather summon beings to help others. Or maybe just a little cat to have someone to cuddle.
entries.translated: Вы могли бы стать автором великого произведения «Как вызвать абсолютного зверя из адских глубин, том I». Или, если ваш разум и сердце чисты, вы предпочитаете призывать существ на помощь другим. Или, может быть, просто маленькая кошечка, чтобы было с кем обниматься.

entries.en: You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
entries.translated: Вы разорвали древнего скарабея Fleshcrawler на части и позаботились о том, чтобы он не проник вам под кожу.

entries.en: You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
entries.translated: Ты дал zzze draken возможность оценить свой потрясающий ход.

entries.en: The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
entries.translated: Гномы сочувствуют вам. Один или два из них действительно могут потрудиться запомнить ваше имя. Вам разрешен доступ к их альфа-версии базы gnomebase. Вы готовы смело ступить своими большими ногами в места, где раньше мало кто бывал.

entries.en: Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
entries.translated: Снова и снова Deathstrike падает из-за вашего мастерства. Возможно, с этого момента пришло время людям называть YOU Deathstrike.

entries.en: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
entries.translated: Вы победили зловредный дуэт Друм и Фуга и восстановили порядок в осажденном городе Bounac. Вы завоевали экзотическую крепость Ордена Cobra и победили рыцарей-нежить Ордена Сокола. Настоящий рыцарь сердцем и разумом.

entries.en: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
entries.translated: Вы помогли Домициану и тем самым доказали, что достойны войти в святилище оборотней под Lion's Rock. Там вы столкнулись с могучими верльвами, и один из редких белых львов даже решил сопровождать вас.

entries.en: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
entries.translated: Вы победили Мегасильвана Изельду, следуя за спящей карнисильванской угрозой глубоко под Bounac.

entries.en: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
entries.translated: Это уже не первый раз, когда вы помогаете Сапфировому Клину или Полуночному Пламени с трудным заданием. Теперь вы можете носить килмарешские одежды, а также тагралтский клинок и расшитую глазами вуаль провидцев в знак благодарности Issavi.

entries.en: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
entries.translated: Ваши постоянные усилия по обеспечению безопасности Bounac и народа Кесара Младшего принесли вам постоянное место при королевском дворе в качестве советника короля.

entries.en: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
entries.translated: Вы выдержали палящую жару в туннелях глубоко под Kazordoon и победили Похитителя мозгов. Голоса в твоей голове наконец замолкают.

entries.en: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
entries.translated: Поздравляем с первым достижением! ... Ну, не совсем. Но представьте себе, это так. Потому что на этом этапе вашего путешествия в прошлое Tibia были введены достижения.

entries.en: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
entries.translated: Таинственные наги, яркие джунгли и тонущий остров — теперь вы действительно знаете каждый уголок Marapur.

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: In exchange for a truly generous donation, I will offer a special outfit. Do you want to make a donation?
entries.translated: In cambio di una donazione davvero generosa, offrirò un outfit speciale. Vuoi fare una donazione?

entries.en: You need to donate {armor} outfit first.
Take this boots as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
entries.translated: Prendi questi stivali come segno di grande gratitudine. Ricordiamo per sempre questo giorno, amico mio.

entries.en: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
entries.translated: Non hai abbastanza soldi per donare tale importo.

entries.en: You need to donate {helmet} addon first.
entries.translated: Devi prima donare il componente aggiuntivo {helmet}.

entries.en: So you wold like to donate 500.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique armor?
entries.translated: Allora vorresti donare 500.000.000 di monete d'oro che in cambio ti daranno diritto ad indossare un'armatura unica?

entries.en: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear unique helmet?
entries.translated: Quindi vorresti donare 250.000.000 di monete d'oro che in cambio ti daranno diritto a indossare un casco unico?

entries.en: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique boots?
entries.translated: Vorresti quindi donare 250.000.000 di monete d'oro che in cambio ti daranno diritto ad indossare uno stivale unico?

entries.en: In that case, return to me once you made up your mind.
entries.translated: In tal caso, torna da me una volta che avrai deciso.

entries.en: Take this armor as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend!
entries.translated: Prendi questa armatura come segno di grande gratitudine. Ricordiamo per sempre questo giorno, amico mio!

entries.en: Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
entries.translated: Assicurati di avere spazi liberi nella casella di posta del tuo negozio.

entries.en: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
entries.translated: Non hai abbastanza soldi per donare tale importo.

entries.en: Take this helmet as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
entries.translated: Prendi questo casco come segno di grande gratitudine. Ricordiamo per sempre questo giorno, amico mio.

entries.en: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
entries.translated: Non hai abbastanza soldi per donare tale importo.

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
entries.translated: До свидания, |PLAYERNAME|. Я очень надеюсь, что мы скоро снова поговорим.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?
entries.translated: О, привет |PLAYERNAME|, твои волосы выглядят великолепно! Кто сделал это для тебя?

entries.en: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
entries.translated: О, привет, красавчик! Приятно познакомиться, |PLAYERNAME|. С радостью, у меня есть время {chat} немного.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Да? Что я могу для тебя сделать, |PLAYERNAME|? Банковский бизнес, возможно?

entries.en: I am not here to fight you, fool. Like it or not, we will have to work together to stop the catastrophe you and that priest have initiated.
entries.translated: Я здесь не для того, чтобы драться с тобой, дурак. Нравится вам это или нет, нам придется работать вместе, чтобы остановить катастрофу, которую инициировали вы и этот священник.

entries.en: Greetings, mortal. Be aware that you are trying my patience while we are talking.
entries.translated: Приветствую тебя, смертный. Имейте в виду, что вы испытываете мое терпение, пока мы разговариваем.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
entries.translated: Да здравствует королева! Вы можете уйти сейчас!

entries.en: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в мою скромную обитель. Если вы пришли за новым колдуном {spells}, вы попали по адресу.

entries.en: Come back when you have enough money.
Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
entries.translated: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. Puteți să vă uitați și la {}.

entries.en: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
You have no cookie that I'd like.
entries.translated: Nu ai nicio prăjitură pe care mi-aș dori.

entries.en: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: Ți-ar plăcea să primești acea protecție pentru un sacrificiu de |BLESSCOST| aur, copile?

entries.en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Îmi dau seama că scânteia phoenixului ți-a fost deja dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.

entries.en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
entries.translated: Simt că ai vorbit deja cu pustnicul Eremo de pe insula Cormaya și ai primit această binecuvântare.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Puteți cere binecuvântarea scuturilor spirituale în templul cu flori albe de la sud de Thais.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Puteți cere binecuvântarea celor doi sori în bronzul de lângă Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Scânteia phoenixului este dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Amenda. Sunteți liber să refuzați oferta mea.

entries.en: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
entries.translated: Ești rănit, copilul meu. Îți voi vindeca rănile.

entries.en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
entries.translated: Nu arăți așa de rău. Scuze, nu te pot ajuta. Dar dacă cauți protecție suplimentară, ar trebui să mergi pe {pilgrimage} de cenușă sau să obții protecția {twist of fate} aici.

entries.en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
entries.translated: Ori de câte ori primești o rană letală, forța ta vitală este deteriorată și există șansa să pierzi o parte din echipamentul tău. Cu fiecare dintre cele cinci {blessings} pe care le aveți, această daune și șansa de pierdere vor fi reduse.

entries.en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Văd că ai primit scutul spiritual în templul cu flori albe de la sud de Thais.

entries.en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Văd că ai primit binecuvântarea celor doi sori în solar lângă Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: You are not on that mission.
It shows your spells and can also shield against attacks when worn
entries.translated: Mostra i tuoi incantesimi e può anche proteggere dagli attacchi quando indossato
Runa della doccia di pietra chiara

entries.en: There is a hole in the ceiling.
A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it
entries.translated: Отшельник рядом с Carlin может рассказать вам об этом больше.

entries.en: Zzaion is our last zztand! I will not leave wizzout a fight!
entries.translated: Ззайон — наш последний ззтанд! Я не оставлю wizzout бой!

entries.en: Feel the wrath of mother Tibia!
I will be still around when my 'noble' race is gone.
entries.translated: Я буду рядом, когда моя гонка 'noble' закончится.
o replică a servitorului de diamant

entries.en: Come back when you have enough money.
entries.translated: Kom tillbaka när du har tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.translated: Naturligtvis, bara bläddra igenom mina varor. Du kan också titta på {}.

entries.en: You have no cookie that I'd like.

entries.en: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?

entries.en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.

entries.en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.

entries.en: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
entries.translated: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.

entries.en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
entries.translated: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.

entries.en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
entries.translated: Närhelst du får ett dödligt sår skadas din livskraft och det finns en chans att du tappar bort en del av din utrustning. Med varenda av de fem {blessings} du har kommer denna skada och risken för förlust att minska.

entries.en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.

entries.en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Buy all the fish you want. It's fresh and healthy, promised.
entries.translated: Compra tutto il pesce che vuoi. È fresco e sano, promesso.

entries.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Saluti, |PLAYERNAME|! Devi essere venuto qui parecchio. Sono sempre interessato a imparare cose nuove su Zao.

entries.en: Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Tieni presente che non troverai offerte migliori qui. Basta sfogliare la mia merce.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, you need more info about {canary}?
entries.translated: Ciao |PLAYERNAME|, hai bisogno di maggiori informazioni su {canary}?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: Arrivederci. Consigliateci se siete rimasti soddisfatti del nostro servizio.

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.

entries.en: Welcome on board, recruit |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Benvenuto a bordo, recluta |PLAYERNAME|. Dove posso {sail} oggi?

entries.en: On behalf of the inquisition, I bid you farewell.
Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Saluti, audace avventuriero. Se hai bisogno di un {passage}, fammi sapere.

entries.en: You sure you want to spend time on this piece of rock? I can show you the world! Huh.
entries.translated: Sei sicuro di voler trascorrere del tempo su questo pezzo di roccia? Posso mostrarti il ​​mondo! Eh.

entries.en: Here ya go! Use it on the crane when you see the monster. Then refill it every time you use the telescope.
entries.translated: Ecco qua! Usalo sulla gru quando vedi il mostro. Quindi riempilo nuovamente ogni volta che usi il telescopio.

entries.en: You found the spot |PLAYERNAME|!! Grab yourself a helmet of the deep and go explore the {caves} down there.
entries.translated: Hai trovato il posto |PLAYERNAME|!! Prendi l'elmo degli abissi ed esplora il {caves} laggiù.

entries.en: Welcome on board, traveller. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Benvenuto a bordo, viaggiatore. Dove posso {sail} oggi?

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Привет, привет, привет, маленькая леди |PLAYERNAME|! Что приносит вам {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, |PLAYERNAME|! Пусть земля защитит тебя на каменистых землях. Если вам нужен {passage}, я могу вам помочь.
Добро пожаловать в мою скромную хижину, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Привет, |PLAYERNAME|! Вы, должно быть, довольно сильно пришли в себя. Мне всегда интересно узнавать что-то новое о Зао.

entries.en: At your service |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the post office.
entries.translated: La dispoziția dumneavoastră |PLAYERNAME| și bine ați venit la oficiul poștal.

entries.en: Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
entries.translated: Aici. Nu uitați că trebuie să cumpărați și o etichetă dacă doriți să trimiteți un colet. Scrieți întotdeauna numele lui {receiver} în primul rând.

entries.en: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! You are looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds. It's my job after all.
entries.translated: Bună, |PLAYERNAME|! Arăți foarte rău. Lasă-mă să-ți vindec rănile. La urma urmei, e treaba mea.

entries.en: Blessings, Player! How may I be of service? Do you wish to trade some {token}s, or would you like some {information} or {talk}? Should I {enchant} certain items for you?
entries.translated: Binecuvântări, jucător! Cum pot fi de folos? Doriți să tranzacționați unele {token} sau vreți unele {information} sau {talk}? Ar trebui să {enchant} anumite articole pentru tine?

entries.en: Hey there. Need some armor or weapon? Then ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Hei acolo. Ai nevoie de armură sau armă? Atunci cere-mi un {trade}.

entries.en: Welcome to the finest {armor} shop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|!
entries.translated: Bine ați venit la cel mai bun magazin {armor} din țară, |PLAYERNAME|!

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: La revedere. Recomandați-ne dacă ați fost mulțumit de serviciile noastre.

entries.en: We have to dig up valuable resources, but don't get enough to eat. The situation is terrible.
entries.translated: Trebuie să dezgropăm resurse valoroase, dar nu ajungem să mâncăm. Situația este teribilă.

entries.en: What we get to eat is really ridiculous.
entries.translated: Ceea ce ajungem să mâncăm este cu adevărat ridicol.

entries.en: We dig up all what mother earth delivers to us, valuable natural resources.
entries.translated: Dezgropăm tot ceea ce mama pământul ne oferă, resurse naturale valoroase.

entries.en: Every man is the architect of his own fortune. The times of repression are finally over.
entries.translated: Fiecare om este arhitectul propriei sale averi. Vremurile represiunii s-au încheiat în sfârșit.

entries.en: The repression has taken too long. With our new weapons the respective people will get their just punishment.
entries.translated: Reprimarea a durat prea mult. Cu noile noastre arme, oamenii respectivi vor primi pedeapsa lor justă.

entries.en: My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!
entries.translated: Eroul meu! Un prieten de-al meu te-a trimis să mă eliberezi? Un prieten adevărat!

entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You have no idea on how to use this device. Xelvar in Kazordoon might tell you more about it.
entries.translated: Вы понятия не имеете, как пользоваться этим устройством. Xelvar в Kazordoon может рассказать вам об этом больше.

entries.en: Gnomedix: So let the examination begin! Now don't move. Don't be afraid. The good doctor gnome won't hurt you - hopefully!
entries.translated: Gnomedix: Итак, начнём осмотр! Теперь не двигайся. Не бойтесь. Добрый гном-доктор не причинит вам вреда – надеюсь!
<clong!> <clong!> <scrit scrit scrit>Acest lucru ar trebui să facă acest lucru.

entries.en: Hello! I guess you are here for a {mission}.
entries.translated: Hej! Jag antar att du är här för en {mission}.

entries.en: Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
entries.translated: Farväl, människa. Jag kommer alltid att minnas dig. Om jag inte glömmer dig, förstås.

entries.en: Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
entries.translated: Farväl, människa. Jag kommer alltid att minnas dig. Om jag inte glömmer dig, förstås.

entries.en: Greetings, dear guest and welcome to my {potion} shop.
entries.translated: Hälsningar, kära gäst och välkommen till min {potion} butik.

entries.en: Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.
entries.translated: Hej fighter. Jag antar att du är här för att {fight} för vår ädla {cause}.

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh and welcome to the furniture store.
entries.translated: Sörjs pilgrim i kött och välkommen till möbelaffären.

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?
entries.translated: Ta en titt. De flesta möbler kommer i praktiska kit. Använd dem bara i ditt hus för att montera möblerna. Vill du bara se en viss typ av möbel?

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh and welcome to the magic store.
entries.translated: Sörjs pilgrim i kött och välkommen till den magiska butiken.

entries.en: Good bye and please come back soon.
entries.translated: Hej då och kom tillbaka snart.

entries.en: Good bye and please come back soon.
entries.translated: Hej då och kom tillbaka snart.

entries.en: Sure, take a look. Apart from those, I also buy some of the possessions from famous demonlords and bosses. Ask me about it if you found anything interesting.
entries.translated: Visst, ta en titt. Förutom dessa köper jag också en del av ägodelar från kända demonlords och bossar. Fråga mig om det om du hittat något intressant.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you?
entries.translated: Välkommen, |PLAYERNAME|. Vad kan jag göra för dig?

entries.en: Don't you see that I'm trying to write a poem? <sighs> So what's the matter?
entries.translated: Ser du inte att jag försöker skriva en dikt? <sighs> Så vad är det?

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Welcome to the Hard Rock Racing Track, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Добродошли на тркачку стазу Хард Роцк, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, здраво, мала дамо |PLAYERNAME|! Шта вам доноси {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добродошли, млади |PLAYERNAME|! Ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вам {heal} бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добродошли, |PLAYERNAME|! Нека вас земља заштити на стеновитим теренима. Ако вам треба {passage}, могу вам помоћи.

entries.en: The Master is-is-is-is de-ad. Plea*chrrrrchk*se. Be. In. Mourning.
entries.translated: Господар је-је-је-је де-ад. Плеа*цхррррцхк*се. Буди. Ин. Моурнинг.

entries.en: Oh no! Was that really me? This is so embarassing, I have no idea what has gotten into me. Was that the fighting spirit you gave me?
entries.translated: Ох не! Јесам ли то стварно био ја? Ово је тако срамотно, немам појма шта ме је спопало. Да ли је то био борбени дух који си ми дао?

entries.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
entries.translated: Ахои, |PLAYERNAME|. Хоћеш да купиш свежу рибу?

entries.en: Buy all the fish you want. It's fresh and healthy, promised.
entries.translated: Купите сву рибу коју желите. Свеже је и здраво, обећано.

entries.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Поздрав, |PLAYERNAME|! Мора да си доста долазио. Увек сам заинтересован да научим нове ствари о Заоу.

entries.en: Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Имајте на уму да овде нећете наћи боље понуде. Само прегледај моју робу.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: Збогом. Препоручите нас ако сте задовољни нашом услугом.

entries.en: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow
entries.translated: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow

entries.en: You don't know how to use this yet.
You need to remove rubble to safely passed the tunnel.
entries.translated: È necessario rimuovere le macerie per superare in sicurezza il tunnel.
Hai superato il tunnel in sicurezza.

entries.en: You safely passed the gap but your bridge collapsed behind you.
entries.translated: Hai superato in sicurezza il divario ma il tuo ponte è crollato dietro di te.

entries.en: You need to build a bridge to pass the gap.
entries.translated: È necessario costruire un ponte per superare il divario.
Hai dipinto un cucciolo di foca.

entries.en: THE DARK KNOWLEDGE PILLS THE BOOK WITH RAW POWER. READY TO BE UNLEASHED!
entries.translated: LA CONOSCENZA OSCURA PILLOLE IL LIBRO CON POTERE GREZZO. PRONTO PER ESSERE SCATENATO!

entries.en: THE DISCHARGE OF THE BOOK BREAKS LOKATHMORS STANCE!
entries.translated: LA DISCARICA DEL LIBRO ROMPE LA POSIZIONE DI LOKATHMORS!

entries.en: You have found a bark peeler.
You are peeling a piece of tark off the again tree.
entries.translated: Stai staccando un pezzo di catrame dall'albero.

entries.en: You planted some seeds into the soil.
entries.translated: Hai piantato alcuni semi nel terreno.

entries.en: The birch grows as you pour the sparkling water from the phial over it.
entries.translated: La betulla cresce mentre vi versi sopra l'acqua frizzante della fiala.

entries.en: You cannot use the phial while the trees still have life and colour.
entries.translated: Non puoi usare la fiala finché gli alberi hanno ancora vita e colore.

entries.en: Seems that you don't make grow enough trees or not free the parrots.
entries.translated: Sembra che tu non faccia crescere abbastanza alberi o non liberi i pappagalli.

entries.en: Suddenly the area brightens and everything around you starts to bloom and thrive with life and colour.
entries.translated: All'improvviso l'area si illumina e tutto intorno a te inizia a fiorire e prosperare di vita e colore.

entries.en: You must be level {} or higher.
entries.translated: Devi essere di livello {} o superiore.
{} è attualmente in fase di sfida.

entries.en: There are too many players inside this encounter.
entries.translated: Ci sono troppi giocatori in questo incontro.

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
entries.translated: Песчаная буря путешествует по Дараме, приводя к островам, полным смертоносных существ внутри кошмара. Избегайте реки возле Drefia!

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: You do not have the Chayenne's magical key.
entries.translated: У вас нет волшебного ключа Chayenne.

entries.en: Nothing special. This picture looks genuine.
entries.translated: Ничего особенного. Эта картина выглядит настоящей.

entries.en: This is it. It looks like it was painted by a child!
entries.translated: Вот и все. Такое ощущение, будто его нарисовал ребенок!

entries.en: You paralyse the bully and the amulet reveals the true face of the creature behind the possession of this misguided creature.
entries.translated: Вы парализуете хулигана, и амулет раскрывает истинное лицо существа, стоящего за одержимостью этого заблудшего существа.

entries.en: You have found a flask of poison.
You need at least level 200 to enter.
entries.translated: Для входа вам нужен минимум 200 уровень.

entries.en: You hear a loud grinding sound not very far from you. something very heavy seems to have moved.
entries.translated: Недалеко от вас вы слышите громкий скрежет. что-то очень тяжелое, кажется, сдвинулось.

entries.en: You need at least level 250 to enter.
entries.translated: Для входа вам нужен минимум 250 уровень.

entries.en: This root seems to thicken and wreathe the moment you try to grab it.
entries.translated: Кажется, что этот корень утолщается и скручивается в тот момент, когда вы пытаетесь его схватить.

entries.en: Your contract with your horse expired and it returned back to the horse station.
entries.translated: Ваш контракт с лошадью истек, и она вернулась обратно на конную станцию.

entries.en: MWAAAHAHAAA!! NO ONE!! NO ONE CAN DEFEAT MEEE!!!
entries.translated: МВАААХАХААА!! НИКТО!! НИКТО НЕ МОЖЕТ ПОБЕДИТЬ МЕНЯ!!!

entries.en: MWAAAHAHAAA!! NO ONE!! NO ONE CAN DEFEAT MEEE!!!
entries.translated: МВАААХАХААА!! НИКТО!! НИКТО НЕ МОЖЕТ ПОБЕДИТЬ МЕНЯ!!!

entries.en: Congratulations you received the Rascoohan Outfit.
You already get an old note.
As you open the drower a ghostly apparition shortly appears hovering over the desk. You find an old note inside of the drower.
entries.translated: Pe măsură ce deschizi setul, o apariție fantomatică apare în scurt timp plutind deasupra biroului. Găsești o bancnotă veche în interiorul dăruitorului.

entries.en: You don't have permission to use this yet.
entries.translated: Încă nu aveți permisiunea de a utiliza acest lucru.

entries.en: You don't know how to use this yet.
entries.translated: Încă nu știi cum să folosești asta.

entries.en: You need to remove rubble to safely passed the tunnel.
entries.translated: Trebuie să îndepărtați moloz pentru a trece în siguranță de tunel.
Ai trecut cu bine de tunel.

entries.en: You safely passed the gap but your bridge collapsed behind you.
entries.translated: Ai trecut în siguranță de gol, dar podul tău s-a prăbușit în spatele tău.

entries.en: You need to build a bridge to pass the gap.
entries.translated: Trebuie să construiți un pod pentru a trece decalajul.
Ai pictat un pui de focă.

entries.en: THE DARK KNOWLEDGE PILLS THE BOOK WITH RAW POWER. READY TO BE UNLEASHED!
entries.translated: CUNOAȘTEREA ÎNTUNECĂ PILELE CARTEA CU PUTEREA BRUDE. GATA SĂ FIE DEZLANȚAT!

entries.en: THE DISCHARGE OF THE BOOK BREAKS LOKATHMORS STANCE!
You have found a bark peeler.
entries.translated: Ați găsit un curățător de coajă.

entries.en: You are peeling a piece of tark off the again tree.
entries.translated: Decojiți o bucată de tark de pe copacul din nou.

entries.en: You planted some seeds into the soil.
entries.translated: Ai plantat niște semințe în sol.

entries.en: The birch grows as you pour the sparkling water from the phial over it.
entries.translated: Mesteacănul crește pe măsură ce turnați peste el apa sclipitoare din fiolă.

entries.en: You cannot use the phial while the trees still have life and colour.
entries.translated: Nu puteți folosi fiola cât timp copacii au încă viață și culoare.

entries.en: Seems that you don't make grow enough trees or not free the parrots.
entries.translated: Se pare că nu faci să crească destui copaci sau nu eliberezi papagalii.

entries.en: Suddenly the area brightens and everything around you starts to bloom and thrive with life and colour.
entries.translated: Deodată, zona se luminează și totul în jurul tău începe să înflorească și să prospere cu viață și culoare.

entries.en: You must be level {} or higher.
entries.translated: Trebuie să aveți nivelul {} sau mai mare.

entries.en: First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
entries.translated: Сначала вам нужно будет убить трех носителей чумы, а затем получить Формулы алхимиков. Когда это будет сделано, возвращайтесь либо к Палимуту (хорошая сторона), либо к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона).

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: By the way: The summoning of lesser creatures, the so-called 'reds', progressed comparatively well. Of course, these creatures are mere borderdwellers and may consequently not be considered true demons. However, it may prove that the development of summoning spells for 'reds' will prove a rewarding spin-off of demon summoning research.
entries.translated: Кстати: призыв меньших существ, так называемых 'reds', продвигался сравнительно хорошо. Конечно, эти существа всего лишь обитатели границ и, следовательно, не могут считаться настоящими демонами. Однако может оказаться, что разработка заклинаний призыва для 'reds' станет полезным побочным продуктом исследований по призыву демонов.

entries.en: creation, and the process known as awakening is by no means the working of benevolence, but the gods losing grip of the things they tried to hide away from the intruding souls. The theory goes that as there is an ascension for the souls from beyond to achieve some form of godhood, there is a constant descent for the powers of the gods of old due to the power that is leaking away into nothingness and the power the living claim for their own. Of course this heresys is very popular in the ranks of certain ascension cults. More so since it takes care of the more common fear in those conclaves, that the jealous gods may strike back
entries.translated: творение, и процесс, известный как пробуждение, ни в коем случае не является действием доброжелательности, а тем, что боги теряют контроль над вещами, которые они пытались спрятать от вторгающихся душ. Теория гласит, что, поскольку души из потустороннего мира возносятся для достижения некоторой формы божественности, происходит постоянное нисхождение сил древних богов из-за силы, которая утекает в небытие, и силы, которую живые претендуют на свою собственную. Конечно, эта ересь очень популярна в рядах некоторых культов вознесения. Тем более, что он устраняет наиболее распространенный среди этих конклавов страх, что ревнивые боги могут нанести ответный удар.

entries.en:
Diary of Hengis Wulfson
...
I can only hope I can escape the
cyclops someday. For now I have
occupied their chief with an attempt
to learn to read and write, but for
how long?
I'm so desperate.
What a foolish idea to travel here to
search the famous treasures of this
ancient, knightly order.
I wish I had never heard about it.
I wish I had never sung that song.
No clue how many unfortunate souls I
have lured to death with it.
entries.translated:
Jurnalul lui Hengis Wulfson
...
Nu pot decât să sper că voi scăpa de 
ciclopi într-o zi. Deocamdată l-am 
ocupat pe șeful lor cu o încercare de
de a învăța să citească și să scrie, dar pentru
cât timp?
Sunt atât de disperat.
Ce idee proastă să călătoresc aici pentru a
căutare celebrele comori ale acestei__PH91__ordine antică. am auzit despre asta.
Mi-aș fi dorit să nu fi cântat niciodată acel cântec.
N-am nicio idee câte suflete nefericite am atras la moarte cu el
.

entries.en: exchange for certain services that have not been further elaborated on in the court's documents. The foreigner was found guilty without trial and sentenced to three years of work in the salt mines. The footsoldier Kamahl claimed his father Indril was guilty of witchcraft. Several obscure texts were found beneath the accused person's bed. Indril was banished from the city and his property was equally divided between the pharaoh and his heirs. The foreigner Todd Ballory was pronounced guilty of killing the overseer Barnak, a father of sixteen children and a respectable member of the local whipcrackers' association. The aforementioned convict was sentenced to a rather spectacular final appearance in the local arena.
entries.translated: schimb pentru anumite servicii care nu au fost mai detaliat în actele instanţei. Străinul a fost găsit vinovat fără judecată și condamnat la trei ani de muncă în saline. Soldatul Kamahl a susținut că tatăl său Indril a fost vinovat de vrăjitorie. Sub patul acuzatului au fost găsite mai multe texte obscure. Indril a fost alungat din oraș, iar proprietatea sa a fost împărțită în mod egal între faraon și moștenitorii săi. Străinul Todd Ballory a fost declarat vinovat de uciderea supraveghetorului Barnak, un tată a șaisprezece copii și un membru respectabil al asociației locale de bici. Condamnatul amintit a fost condamnat la o apariție finală destul de spectaculoasă în arena locală.

entries.en: Finally! Something! I found a strange wall somewhere under Ab'Dendriel. I had to "borrow" some equipment, a pick, some tools, a rope - I am sure the elves won't mind. And now I am here! Here to dig up my first real treasure, maybe even more! My very own discovery of a tomb or even a lost palace! No - an archeological breakthrough (let's just say that not all of the gold and riches could be recovered), I will document everything I find in this diary!
entries.translated: Finalmente! Qualcosa! Ho trovato uno strano muro da qualche parte sotto Ab'Dendriel. Ho dovuto "prendere in prestito" dell'attrezzatura, un piccone, degli attrezzi, una corda: sono sicuro che agli elfi non dispiacerà. E ora sono qui! Sono qui per disseppellire il mio primo vero tesoro, forse anche di più! La mia personale scoperta di una tomba o addirittura di un palazzo perduto! No, una scoperta archeologica (diciamo solo che non tutto l'oro e le ricchezze potrebbero essere recuperate), documenterò tutto ciò che troverò in questo diario!

entries.en: Finally, the end came swifter than they expected. Unwilling to take any risks in the unpredictable halls and passageways of Drefia's dungeons, the Marid performed a fearsome ritual. The tortured earth underneath Drefia started moving like a giant whirlpool, and slowly the unholy city was pulled inside the maelstrom. Within half an hour it was gone completely, and all but the highest buildings were completely covered by sand and by rubble. None of its inhabitants have ever been seen again, but rumour has it that deep beneath the surface the unholy city is still intact, brooding like a vengeful animal in its prison.
entries.translated: Alla fine, la fine arrivò più rapidamente di quanto si aspettassero. Non volendo correre alcun rischio nelle sale e nei passaggi imprevedibili dei sotterranei di Drefia, il Marid eseguì uno spaventoso rituale. La terra torturata sottostante Drefia iniziò a muoversi come un gigantesco vortice, e lentamente la città empia fu trascinata nel vortice. Nel giro di mezz'ora era sparito completamente e tutti gli edifici, tranne gli edifici più alti, erano completamente coperti dalla sabbia e dalle macerie. Nessuno dei suoi abitanti è mai stato più visto, ma si dice che nelle profondità della superficie la città empia sia ancora intatta, covando come un animale vendicativo nella sua prigione.

entries.en: "First shalt thou take out the Holy Pin. Then, shalt thou count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the number thou shalt count, and the number of the counting shalt be three. Four shalt thou not count, nor either count thou two, excepting that thou then proceed to three. Five is right out. Once the number three, being the third number, be reached, then lobbest thou thy Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch towards thou foe, who being naughty in my sight, shall snuff it."
entries.translated: "Prima di tutto tirerai fuori la Sacra Spilla. Poi conterai fino a tre, né più né meno. Tre sarà il numero che conterai, e il numero del conteggio sarà tre. Quattro non conterai, né conterai due, a meno che tu poi proceda a tre. Cinque è proprio fuori. Una volta raggiunto il numero tre, che è il terzo numero, allora lancia la tua Sacra Granata a mano di Antiochia verso il tuo nemico, che essendo cattivo ai miei occhi, ti farà spegnilo."

entries.en: For a long time Malor had plotted and schemed in secrecy, using promises and threats to recruit followers and to form alliances. Many djinn refused to betray Gabel, but the majority of the strongest djinn warriors rallied to his cause, and since Malor had been plotting his insurrection for a long time the rebels were well-prepared. When Malor finally gave the signal his minions attacked the palace in full force, planning to kill Gabel swiftly. Their attack was deadly effective, and the palace guards were quickly overwhelmed. However, Gabel, who had received warning about the conspiracy was saved in time by his trusted aide and friend Fa'hradin. He managed to flee in the darkness, and that very night he started to gather his troops in order to take revenge on the usurper. Malor, on the other hand, had to acknowledge that his plan to get rid of Gabel quickly had failed. And he ordered his followers to prepare for a long-term military engagement. Neither he nor Gabel realised then that this was the starting point for a war that would last for eons.
entries.translated: Per molto tempo Malor aveva complottato e complottato in segreto, usando promesse e minacce per reclutare seguaci e formare alleanze. Molti djinn si rifiutarono di tradire Gabel, ma la maggior parte dei guerrieri djinn più forti si unì alla sua causa, e poiché Malor stava pianificando da tempo la sua insurrezione, i ribelli erano ben preparati. Quando Malor finalmente diede il segnale, i suoi servi attaccarono il palazzo in forze, progettando di uccidere Gabel rapidamente. Il loro attacco fu mortalmente efficace e le guardie del palazzo furono rapidamente sopraffatte. Tuttavia, Gabel, che aveva ricevuto avvertimento sulla cospirazione, fu salvato in tempo dal suo fidato aiutante e amico Fa'hradin. Riuscì a fuggire nell'oscurità e quella stessa notte iniziò a radunare le sue truppe per vendicarsi dell'usurpatore. Malor, invece, dovette riconoscere che il suo piano per sbarazzarsi rapidamente di Gabel era fallito. E ordinò ai suoi seguaci di prepararsi per un impegno militare a lungo termine. Né lui né Gabel si resero conto allora che quello era il punto di partenza di una guerra che sarebbe durata eoni.

entries.en: Stealth kills and backstabbing are you specialty. Your numerous victims are usually unaware of their imminent death, which you bring to them silently and swiftly. Everything is permitted.
entries.translated: Uciderile furtive și înjunghierea în spate sunt specialitatea ta. Numeroasele tale victime nu sunt de obicei conștiente de moartea lor iminentă, pe care le aduci în tăcere și rapid. Totul este permis.

entries.en: What is best in life? To crush your enemies. To see them driven before you. And to maybe have a nice cup of tea afterwards.
entries.translated: Ce este mai bun în viață? Pentru a-ți zdrobi dușmanii. Să-i vezi conduși înaintea ta. Și poate să bem o ceașcă bună de ceai după aceea.

entries.en: You're a beggar, homeless, wearing filthy and ragged clothes. But that doesn't mean you have to beg anyone for stuff - and you still kept your pride. Fine feathers do not necessarily make fine birds - what's under them is more important.
entries.translated: Ești un cerșetor, fără adăpost, porți haine murdare și zdrențuite. Dar asta nu înseamnă că trebuie să cerși pe cineva pentru lucruri - și tot ți-ai păstrat mândria. Penele fine nu fac neapărat păsări fine - ceea ce este sub ele este mai important.

entries.en: Wearing the insignia and dark robes of the Brotherhood of Bones you roam the lands spreading fear and pain, creating new soldiers for the necromantic army which is about to rise soon. Hail the Brotherhood.
entries.translated: Purtând însemnele și robele întunecate ale Frăției Oaselor, cutreieră ținuturile răspândind frică și durere, creând noi soldați pentru armata necromantică care este pe cale să se ridice în curând. Salutare Frăției.

entries.en: You do not fear nightmares, you travel in them - facing countless horrors and fighting the fate they're about to bring. Few believe the dark prophecies you bring back from those dreams, but those who do fight alongside you as Nightmare Knights.
entries.translated: Nu îți este frică de coșmaruri, călătorești în ele - înfruntând nenumărate orori și luptând cu soarta pe care urmează să o aducă. Puțini cred în profețiile întunecate pe care le aduci din acele vise, dar cei care luptă alături de tine ca Cavaleri de Coșmar.

entries.en: Every city should be proud to call someone like you its inhabitant. You're keeping the streets clean and help settling the usual disputes in front of the depot. Also, you probably own a cat and like hiking.
entries.translated: Fiecare oraș ar trebui să fie mândru să numească pe cineva ca tine locuitor. Păstrați străzile curate și ajutați la soluționarea disputelor obișnuite în fața depozitului. De asemenea, probabil că ai o pisică și îți place drumețiile.

entries.en: You don't carry that stake just for decoration - you're prepared to use it. Usually you're seen hightailing through the deepest dungeons leaving a trail of slain demons. Whoever dares stand in your way should prepare to die.
entries.translated: Nu purtați acel țăruș doar pentru decorare - sunteți pregătit să îl folosiți. De obicei, ești văzut mergând prin cele mai adânci temnițe, lăsând o urmă de demoni uciși. Cine îndrăznește să-ți stea în cale ar trebui să se pregătească să moară.

entries.en: One with nature, one with wildlife. Raw and animalistic power, sharpened senses, howling on the highest cliffs and roaring in the thickest forests - that's you.
entries.translated: Una cu natura, una cu fauna sălbatică. Putere crudă și animală, simțuri ascuțite, urlă pe cele mai înalte stânci și hohote în cele mai dese păduri - asta ești tu.

entries.en: At daytime you can be found camouflaged in the woods laying traps or chasing big game, at night you're sitting by the campfire and sharing your hunting stories. You eat what you hunted and wear what you skinned. Life could go on like that forever.
entries.translated: Ziua poți fi găsit camuflat în pădure întinzând capcane sau urmărind vânatul mare, noaptea stai lângă focul de tabără și împărtășești poveștile tale de vânătoare. Mănânci ceea ce ai vânat și porți ceea ce ai jupuit. Viața ar putea continua așa pentru totdeauna.

entries.en: And remember: Never try to teach a pig to sing. It wastes your time and annoys the pig.
entries.translated: Și amintiți-vă: Nu încercați niciodată să învățați un porc să cânte. Îți pierde timpul și enervează porcul.

entries.en: With edged blade and fully equipped in a sturdy full plate armor, you charge at your enemies with both strength and valour. There's always a maiden to save and a dragon to slay for you.
entries.translated: Cu o lamă tăiată și complet echipată într-o armură robustă cu placă completă, vă încărcați asupra dușmanilor tăi atât cu putere, cât și cu putere. Întotdeauna există o fată de salvat și un dragon de ucis pentru tine.

entries.en: You begin your day by bathing in your pot of gold and you don't mind showing off your wealth while strolling the streets in your best clothes - after all it's your hard-earned money! You prefer to be addressed with 'Your Highness'.
entries.translated: Îți începi ziua făcând o baie în oala cu aur și nu te deranjează să-ți arăți bogăția în timp ce te plimbi pe străzi în cele mai bune haine - până la urmă sunt banii tăi câștigați cu greu! Preferi să fii adresat cu 'Your Highness'.

entries.en: Snow heaps and hailstorms can't keep you from where you want to go. You're perfectly equipped for any expedition into the perpetual ice and know how to keep your feet warm. If you're a woman, that's quite an accomplishment, too.
entries.translated: Mormanele de zăpadă și furtunile cu grindină nu te pot împiedica de unde vrei să mergi. Ești perfect echipat pentru orice expediție în gheața perpetuă și știi cum să-ți ții picioarele calde. Dacă ești femeie, este și asta o realizare.

entries.en: You feel at home under the hot desert sun with sand between your toes, and your favourite means of travel is a flying carpet. Also, you can probably do that head isolation dance move.
entries.translated: Te simți ca acasă sub soarele fierbinte din deșert, cu nisip între degetele de la picioare, iar mijlocul tău preferat de călătorie este un covor zburător. De asemenea, probabil că poți face acea mișcare de dans pentru izolarea capului.

entries.en: Ye be a gentleman o' fortune, fightin' and carousin' on the high seas, out fer booty and lassies! Ye no be answerin' to no man or blasted monarchy and yer life ain't fer the lily-livered. Aye, matey!
entries.translated: Fii un gentleman cu avere, luptă și gălăgie pe marea liberă, afară de pradă și fete! Nu răspundeți la niciun om sau nenorocită monarhie și viața voastră nu este cu ficatul de crin. Da, amice!

entries.en: Shaking your rattle and dancing around the fire to jungle drums sounds like something you like doing. Besides, dreadlocks are a convenient way to wear your hair - no combing required!
entries.translated: A scuturar-o și a dansa în jurul focului cu tobele junglei sună ca ceva ce îți place să faci. În plus, dreadlock-urile sunt o modalitate convenabilă de a-ți purta părul - nu este necesară pieptănarea!

entries.en: You could be the author of the magnum opus 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. Or, if your mind and heart are pure, you rather summon beings to help others. Or maybe just a little cat to have someone to cuddle.
entries.translated: Ai putea fi autorul operei magistrale „Cum să invoci bestia supremă din adâncurile infernale, volumul I”. Sau, dacă mintea și inima ta sunt pure, mai degrabă chemi ființe să-i ajute pe alții. Sau poate doar o pisică mică pentru a avea pe cineva pe care să-l îmbrățișeze.

entries.en: You're not afraid to show your colours in the heat of battle. Enemies fear your lethal lance and impenetrable armor. The list of the wars you've won is impressive. Hail and kill!
entries.translated: Nu ți-e frică să-ți arăți culorile în plină luptă. Dușmanii se tem de lancea ta letală și armura ta impenetrabilă. Lista războaielor pe care le-ați câștigat este impresionantă. Bucurați-vă și ucideți!

entries.en: Valour is for weaklings - it doesn't matter how you win the battle, as long as you're victorious. Thick armor would just hinder your movements, thus you keep it light and rely on speed and skill instead of hiding in an uncomfortable shell.
entries.translated: Valoarea este pentru cei slabi - nu contează cum câștigi bătălia, atâta timp cât ești victorios. Armura groasă ți-ar împiedica mișcările, așa că o menții ușoară și te bazezi pe viteză și îndemânare în loc să te ascunzi într-o carcasă incomodă.

entries.translated: Clicca qui per effettuare l'imbevimento selezionato. Ciò consumerà le fonti astrali e l'oro richieste.

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...

Hold on, you don't have enough room in your backpack to carry all these coins. 
I don't want you to drop them on the floor, perhaps come back when you have more space in your backpack!
