entries.translated: Creati tutti gli elementi nella mappa

entries.en: Personal log book of Mr Morris. (The following lines are written in a code that you cannot make out. It seems Mr Morris is a very distrustful person.)
entries.translated: Diario di bordo personale del signor Morris. (Le righe seguenti sono scritte in un codice che non è possibile decifrare. Sembra che il signor Morris sia una persona molto diffidente.)

entries.en: Cooking Recipes for the Wildlife (excepting Squirrels!), by Richard
entries.translated: Ricette di cucina per la fauna selvatica (eccetto gli scoiattoli!), di Richard

entries.en: Buried forever that he never shall return. Don't remove this seal or bad things may happen.
entries.translated: Sepolto per sempre affinché non ritorni mai più. Non rimuovere questo sigillo o potrebbero accadere cose brutte.

entries.en: No come near! Goblin home! Humans leave!
entries.translated: Non avvicinarti! Goblin a casa! Gli umani se ne vanno!

entries.en: Paladins of Tibia, arm yourselves and deal merciless death to all that is evil!
entries.translated: Paladini di Tibia, armatevi e uccidete senza pietà tutto ciò che è malvagio!

entries.en: It tightens around your wrist as you take it on.
entries.translated: Se strânge în jurul încheieturii mâinii pe măsură ce o iei.

entries.en: Ouch! The serpent claw stabbed you.
entries.translated: Ai! Gheara de șarpe te-a înjunghiat.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

entries.en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
entries.translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

entries.en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
entries.translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

entries.en:
A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ... \z
	However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ... \z
	I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ... \z
	Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
entries.translated:
Un paletto benedetto per sconfiggere gli spiriti maligni? Conosco un'antica preghiera che si dice conceda un potere sacro e sia in grado di legare questo potere a qualcuno o qualcosa. ...\z
	Tuttavia, questa preghiera necessita dell'energia combinata di dieci sacerdoti. Ognuno di loro deve dire una riga della preghiera. ...\z
	Potrei iniziare con la preghiera, ma poiché il prossimo sacerdote dovrà essere in un luogo diverso, probabilmente dovrai viaggiare molto. ...\z
	Questa posta in gioco è davvero abbastanza importante per te da essere disposto ad assumerti questo fardello?

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated:
Questa è una benedizione speciale che posso concederti una volta ottenuta almeno una delle altre benedizioni e che funziona in modo leggermente diverso. ...\z
	Funziona solo quando vieni ucciso da altri avventurieri, il che significa che almeno la metà del danno che ha portato alla tua morte è stato causato da altri, non da mostri o dall'ambiente. ...\z
	Lo {twist of fate} non ridurrà la pena di morte come le altre benedizioni, ma invece ti impedirà di perdere le tue altre benedizioni e l'amuleto della perdita, se ne indossi uno. Costa lo stesso delle altre benedizioni. ...\z
	Ti piacerebbe ricevere quella protezione per un sacrificio di |PVPBLESSCOST| oro, bambino?

entries.en: You already received my line of the prayer.
entries.translated: Hai già ricevuto la mia linea di preghiera.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Quindi ricevi la protezione dello scherzo del destino, pellegrino.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Bene. Sei libero di rifiutare la mia offerta.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
entries.translated: Naturalmente, basta sfogliare la mia merce. Puoi anche guardare {}.

entries.en: So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
entries.translated: Quindi mi chiedi un {{}} per iniziare la tua avventura?

entries.en: What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
entries.translated: Che cosa? Te ne ho già regalato uno {{}}!

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
entries.translated: Naturalmente, basta sfogliare la mia merce. Puoi anche guardare {}.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
entries.translated: Non dimenticare di depositare i tuoi soldi qui nella Banca Globale prima di partire per l'avventura.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Quindi ricevi la protezione dello scherzo del destino, pellegrino.

entries.en: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
entries.translated: Mi dispiace, non hai abbastanza soldi.

entries.en: Ah, an adventurer. Be greeted and have a seat. How may I {serve} you?
entries.translated: Ах, авантюрист. Поприветствуйте и присядьте. Как я могу {serve} тебя?

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
entries.translated: До свидания, |PLAYERNAME|. Я очень надеюсь, что мы скоро снова поговорим.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?
entries.translated: О, привет |PLAYERNAME|, твои волосы выглядят великолепно! Кто сделал это для тебя?

entries.en: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
entries.translated: О, привет, красавчик! Приятно познакомиться, |PLAYERNAME|. С радостью, у меня есть время {chat} немного.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Да? Что я могу для тебя сделать, |PLAYERNAME|? Банковский бизнес, возможно?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в мою скромную обитель. Если вы пришли за новым колдуном {spells}, вы попали по адресу.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my offers.
Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: Прощай, |PLAYERNAME|, я буду здесь, если я тебе снова понадоблюсь.

entries.en: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}
entries.translated: Рад тебя видеть. Я всегда рядом с твоим {shop options}

entries.en: Do you bring freshly killed rats for a bounty of 1 gold each? By the way, I also buy orc teeth and other stuff you ripped from their bloody corp... I mean... well, you know what I mean.
entries.translated: Вы приносите свежеубитых крыс за награду в 1 золотой за каждую? Кстати, я еще покупаю зубы орков и прочую ерунду, которую ты выдрал из их чертовой корпорации... То есть... ну, ты понимаешь, о чем я.

entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
entries.translated: Druizii la nord de Carlin vă vor oferi îmbrățișarea lui Tibia.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Puteți cere binecuvântarea celor doi sori în bronzul de lângă Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
entries.translated: Da, am fost informat ce să fac. Ești pregătit să primești rândul meu de rugăciune?

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Scânteia phoenixului este dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.

entries.en: You already received my line of the prayer.
entries.translated: Ai primit deja rândul meu de rugăciune.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Așa că primește protecția întorsăturii destinului, pelerine.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Amenda. Sunteți liber să refuzați oferta mea.

entries.en: You do not have enough money.
You do not have enough money.
You do not have enough money.
You are not on that mission.
You do not have enough money.

entries.translated: Binecuvântările lui Daraman și la revedere.

entries.en: I am a jeweller. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful {offers}.
entries.translated: Sunt bijutier. Poate vrei să arunci o privire la minunatul meu {offers}.

entries.en: Well, I sell gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: Ei bine, vând pietre prețioase și {goblets}. Dacă doriți să vedeți ofertele mele, cereți-mi un {trade}.

entries.en: Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.
entries.translated: Ah, cel mai nou import al nostru! Avem cupe de aur, cupe de argint și cupe de bronz. Toate au spațiu pentru o dedicație scrisă de mână.
Binecuvântările lui Daraman și la revedere.

entries.en: There is a hole in the ceiling.
A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it
entries.translated: Отшельник рядом с Carlin может рассказать вам об этом больше.

entries.en: Zzaion is our last zztand! I will not leave wizzout a fight!
entries.translated: Ззайон — наш последний ззтанд! Я не оставлю wizzout бой!

entries.en: Feel the wrath of mother Tibia!
I will be still around when my 'noble' race is gone.
entries.translated: Я буду рядом, когда моя гонка 'noble' закончится.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: Give me your sweets! They are mine to devour!
entries.translated: Dă-mi dulciurile tale! Sunt ai mei de devorat!

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.

entries.en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
entries.translated: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
entries.translated: Ja, jag fick besked om vad jag skulle göra. Är du beredd att ta emot min bönelinje?

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.

entries.en: You already received my line of the prayer.
entries.translated: Du har redan fått min bönrad.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.

entries.en: You do not have enough money.
entries.translated: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.en: You do not have enough money.
entries.translated: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.en: You do not have enough money.
entries.translated: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.en: You are not on that mission.
entries.translated: Du är inte på det uppdraget.

entries.en: You do not have enough money.
entries.translated: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.en: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. Which of my fine gems do you {need}?
entries.translated: Var hälsad, |PLAYERNAME|. Vilken av mina fina pärlor gör du {need}?

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

entries.en:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
entries.translated: Cóż, możesz być właśnie bohaterem, którego tam potrzebują. Prawdę mówiąc, część naszych najbardziej niezawodnych kopalń rudy zaczęła się wyczerpywać... \z Dlatego rozwinęliśmy nowe technologie parowców, by móc dalej badać i kartografować wielkie podziemne rzeki. Nasi bracia założyli bazę na kontynencie bardzo, bardzo daleko stąd... \z Nazywamy ją bazą bardzo, bardzo daleko. Ale ponieważ mamy nadzieję, że pewnego dnia stanie się kwitnącą kopalnią, większość z nas zaczęła nazywać ją {Farmine}. Krasnoludy na miejscu naprawdę potrzebują teraz pomocy.

entries.en: Who are you? Are you a genius in mechanics? You don't look like one.
entries.translated: Kim jesteś? Jesteś geniuszem mechaniki? Nie wyglądasz.

entries.en: Shove off, little one! Humans are not welcome here, |PLAYERNAME|!
entries.translated: Spadaj, maluchu! Ludzie nie są tu mile widziani, |PLAYERNAME|!

entries.en: Sorry but you don't have the item.
entries.translated: Przykro nam, ale nie masz tego przedmiotu.

entries.en: You see, good deeds like this will ... YOU ... YOU SPAWN OF EVIL! I WILL MAKE SURE THE MASTER LEARNS ABOUT THIS!
entries.translated: Widzisz, takie dobre uczynki… TY… WYRAŻASZ ZŁO! UPEWNIAM SIĘ, ŻE MISTRZ DOWIE SIĘ O TYM!

entries.en: I'm sorry, but you don't have Malor's permission to trade with me.
entries.translated: Przykro mi, ale nie masz pozwolenia Malora na handel ze mną.

entries.en: Be greeted, human |PLAYERNAME|. How can a humble djinn be of service?
entries.translated: Bądź pozdrowiony, człowieku |PLAYERNAME|. W jaki sposób pokorny dżinn może się przydać?

entries.en: Do you want to trade Boots of haste for Enchanted Chicken Wing?
entries.translated: Czy chcesz wymienić Buty pośpiechu na Zaczarowane Skrzydełko Kurczaka?

entries.en: Do you want to trade 4 Warrior Helmet for Warrior Sweat?
entries.translated: Czy chcesz wymienić 4 hełmy wojownika na pot wojownika?

entries.en: Do you want to trade 2 Royal Helmet for Fighting Spirit
entries.translated: Czy chcesz wymienić 2 Hełmy Królewskie na Ducha Walki

entries.en: Do you want to trade 3 Fire Sword for Magic Sulphur
entries.translated: Czy chcesz wymienić 3 Ogniste Miecze na Magiczną Siarkę

entries.en: I trade Enchanted Chicken Wing for Boots of Haste, Warrior Sweat for 4 Warrior Helmets, Fighting Spirit for 2 Royal Helmet Magic Sulphur for 3 Fire Swords
entries.translated: Wymieniam Zaczarowane Skrzydło Kurczaka na Buty Pośpiechu, Pot Wojownika na 4 Hełmy Wojownika, Duch Walki na 2 Królewskie Hełmy Magiczną Siarkę na 3 Ogniste Miecze

entries.en: You brought cookies! How nice of you! Can I have one?
entries.translated: Przyniosłeś ciasteczka! Jak miło z twojej strony! Czy mogę mieć taki?

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.translated: Ah, vuoi sostituire la tua pietra dell'avventuriero per 30 monete d'oro?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: Arrivederci. Consigliateci se siete rimasti soddisfatti del nostro servizio.

entries.en: Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
We would like to serve you some time.
entries.translated: Vorremmo servirti un po' di tempo.

entries.en: Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
entries.translated: Prenditi tutto il tempo che ti serve per decidere cosa vuoi!

entries.en: Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
entries.translated: Prenditi tutto il tempo che ti serve per decidere cosa vuoi!

entries.en: Have you really managed to fulfil the task and brought me 100 pieces of ape fur?
entries.translated: Sei davvero riuscito a portare a termine il compito e a portarmi 100 pezzi di pelliccia di scimmia?

entries.en: Ahhh, this softness! I'm impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. You're on the best way to earn that turban. Now, please retrieve 100 fish fins.
entries.translated: Ahhh, che morbidezza! Sono impressionato, |PLAYERNAME|. Sei sulla strada migliore per guadagnarti quel turbante. Ora, per favore, recupera 100 pinne di pesce.

entries.en: Only ape fur is good enough to touch the feet of our Caliph.
entries.translated: Solo la pelliccia di scimmia è abbastanza buona da toccare i piedi del nostro Califfo.

entries.en: Ah, have you brought the 100 pieces of blue cloth?
entries.translated: Ah, hai portato i 100 pezzi di stoffa blu?

entries.en: It's a great material for turbans.
entries.translated: È un ottimo materiale per i turbanti.

entries.en: Were you able to get hold of two enchanted chicken wings?
entries.translated: Sei riuscito a procurarti due ali di pollo incantate?

entries.en: Great, thank you very much. Just bring me 100 pieces of blue cloth now and I will happily show you how to make a turban.
entries.translated: Ottimo, grazie mille. Portami solo 100 pezzi di stoffa blu adesso e ti mostrerò con piacere come realizzare un turbante.

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
entries.translated: До свидания, |PLAYERNAME|. Я очень надеюсь, что мы скоро снова поговорим.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?
entries.translated: О, привет |PLAYERNAME|, твои волосы выглядят великолепно! Кто сделал это для тебя?

entries.en: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
entries.translated: О, привет, красавчик! Приятно познакомиться, |PLAYERNAME|. С радостью, у меня есть время {chat} немного.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Да? Что я могу для тебя сделать, |PLAYERNAME|? Банковский бизнес, возможно?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в мою скромную обитель. Если вы пришли за новым колдуном {spells}, вы попали по адресу.

entries.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: Прощай, |PLAYERNAME|, я буду здесь, если я тебе снова понадоблюсь.

entries.en: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}
entries.translated: Рад тебя видеть. Я всегда рядом с твоим {shop options}

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you.
Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: A sacrificial site? Damn, sounds like some freakish cult or something. Just great. And this ancient structure you talked about that's not part of the sewers? You'd better see the local historian about that, man. ...
entries.translated: Un loc de sacrificiu? La naiba, sună ca un cult ciudat sau așa ceva. Doar grozav. Și această structură veche despre care ai vorbit, care nu face parte din canalizare? Ar fi bine să-l vezi pe istoricul local despre asta, omule. ...

entries.en: He can make more sense of what you found there. His name is Barazbaz. He should be in the magistrate building.
entries.translated: El poate înțelege mai mult ceea ce ai găsit acolo. Numele lui este Barazbaz. Ar trebui să fie în clădirea magistratului.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.

entries.en: There is a hole in the ceiling.
You see the silvery movement of fish.
Zzaion is our last zztand! I will not leave wizzout a fight!
entries.translated: Ззайон — наш последний ззтанд! Я не оставлю wizzout бой!

entries.en: Feel the wrath of mother Tibia!
I will be still around when my 'noble' race is gone.
entries.translated: Я буду рядом, когда моя гонка 'noble' закончится.

entries.en: Hm? Where ... where are you now?
I was baked just a few days ago. So much to discover here!
entries.translated: Am fost copt acum câteva zile. Atât de multe de descoperit aici!

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated:
Detta är en speciell välsignelse som jag kan skänka dig när du har fått åtminstone en av de andra välsignelserna och som fungerar lite annorlunda. ... \z
	Det fungerar bara när du dödas av andra äventyrare, vilket betyder att minst hälften av skadan som ledde till din död orsakades av andra, inte av monster eller miljön. ... \z
	{twist of fate} kommer inte att minska dödsstraffet som de andra välsignelserna, utan istället hindra dig från att förlora dina andra välsignelser såväl som förlustamuletten, om du bär en. Det kostar lika mycket som de andra välsignelserna. ... \z
	Skulle du vilja få det skyddet för ett offer på |PVPBLESSCOST| guld, barn?

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
entries.translated: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten gratis?
Här är du. Ta hand om dig.

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
entries.translated: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten mot 30 guld?
Här är du. Ta hand om dig.

entries.en: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
entries.translated: Tyvärr, du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.en: Never heard about a place like this.
entries.translated: Aldrig hört talas om en plats som denna.

entries.en: Do you seek a ride to {0} for {1}?
We would like to serve you some time.
entries.translated: Vi skulle vilja tjäna dig lite tid.

entries.en: I'm sorry but I don't sail there.
entries.translated: Jag är ledsen men jag seglar inte dit.

entries.en: Never heard about a place like this.
entries.translated: Aldrig hört talas om en plats som denna.

entries.en: We would like to serve you some time.
entries.translated: Vi skulle vilja tjäna dig lite tid.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Where did you put that delicious piece of food? Did you eat it yourself? Well, if you find another one, please come back.
entries.translated: Bentornato, |PLAYERNAME|! Dove hai messo quel delizioso pezzo di cibo? L'hai mangiato tu stesso? Bene, se ne trovi un altro, per favore torna indietro.

entries.en: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!
entries.translated: Ehi, |PLAYERNAME|! Bene, è così che funziona il commercio con gli NPC come me. Penso che tu sia pronto ora per attraversare il ponte verso Rookgaard! Occuparsi!

entries.en: Hello again, |PLAYERNAME|! What are you still doing here? You should head over the bridge to Rookgaard village now!
entries.translated: Ciao di nuovo, |PLAYERNAME|! Cosa ci fai ancora qui? Dovresti andare oltre il ponte verso il villaggio Rookgaard adesso!

entries.en: Very nice! Food for me! Sell it to me, fast! Once you sold your food to me, just say {ready} to let me know you are done.
entries.translated: Molto bello! Cibo per me! Vendimelo, velocemente! Una volta che mi hai venduto il cibo, dì semplicemente {ready} per farmi sapere che hai finito.

entries.en: Good bye traveller and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
entries.translated: Arrivederci viaggiatore e buon soggiorno su Rookgaard.

entries.en: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! As a tailor and merchant I have to say - we need to do something about your {outfit}, shall we?
entries.translated: Fatti salutare, |PLAYERNAME|! Come sarto e commerciante devo dirlo: dobbiamo fare qualcosa per il tuo {outfit}, va bene?

entries.en: Hey, I thought you were going to run away, but luckily you came back. I'll show you how to change your {outfit}, okay?
entries.translated: Ehi, pensavo che saresti scappato, ma per fortuna sei tornato. Ti mostrerò come cambiare il tuo {outfit}, ok?

entries.en: Welcome back! You know, after providing my little outfit service, I like to ask a little favour of you. Can you {help} me?
entries.translated: Bentornato! Sai, dopo averti fornito il mio piccolo servizio di outfit, mi piace chiederti un piccolo favore. Puoi {help} dirmi?

entries.en: Oh hey |PLAYERNAME|, you didn't answer my question yet - could you help me get some {food}? I'll even give you some gold for it.
entries.translated: Oh ehi |PLAYERNAME|, non hai ancora risposto alla mia domanda: potresti aiutarmi a prenderne un po' {food}? Ti darò anche dell'oro in cambio.

entries.en: Welcome to the Cassino! Here we play with: \n [PAYOUT 180%] {HIGH / LOW}: High for 4, 5, 6 and Low for 1, 2, and 3 - {ODD / EVEN }: Odd for 1, 3, 5 and Even for 2, 4 and 6 \n [PAYOUT 500%] {NUMBERS}: You choose the number, and if you get it right ... {$$$$$}
entries.translated: Benvenuti a Cassino! Qui giochiamo con: \n [PAYOUT 180%] {HIGH / LOW}: Alto per 4, 5, 6 e Basso per 1, 2 e 3 - {ODD / EVEN }: Dispari per 1, 3, 5 e Pari per 2, 4 e 6 \n [PAYOUT 500%] {NUMBERS}: Scegli tu il numero, e se hai capito bene... {$$$$$}

entries.en: Always nice to meet a fellow druid, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: È sempre bello incontrare un amico druido, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Ahoy. Where can I sail you today?
Ah, welcome! Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! If you need druid spells, you've come to the right place. Otherwise it's just nice to have a visitor.
entries.translated: Ah, benvenuto! Benvenuto |PLAYERNAME|! Se hai bisogno di incantesimi da druido, sei nel posto giusto. Altrimenti è semplicemente carino avere una visita.

entries.en: Hey there! You don't happen to have some {food} on you, you're willing to share? Well, where are my manners, a warm welcome for now.
entries.translated: Ehilà! Per caso non hai qualche {food} con te, sei disposto a condividerlo? Ebbene, dove sono le mie buone maniere? Un caloroso benvenuto per ora.

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Привет, привет, привет, маленькая леди |PLAYERNAME|! Что приносит вам {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, |PLAYERNAME|! Пусть земля защитит тебя на каменистых землях. Если вам нужен {passage}, я могу вам помочь.
Добро пожаловать в мою скромную хижину, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Привет, |PLAYERNAME|! Вы, должно быть, довольно сильно пришли в себя. Мне всегда интересно узнавать что-то новое о Зао.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome on board, recruit |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, набираем |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Приветствую тебя, отважный искатель приключений. Если вам нужен {passage}, дайте мне знать.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
entries.translated: Bun venit, |PLAYERNAME|! Te simți aventuros? Vrei un {ticket} săptămânal pentru sistemul de vagoane de minereu de aici? Îl poți folosi chiar aici pentru a ajunge în centrul Kazordoon!

entries.en: Hi, come closer. Have a look at my wares.
entries.translated: Bună, vino mai aproape. Aruncă o privire la marfa mea.

entries.en: Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.
entries.translated: Cine eşti tu? ce vrei? Pari prea experimentat pentru a deveni asistentul meu. Vă rog să plecați.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
entries.translated: Salut |PLAYERNAME|! Ai nevoie de ceva echipament pentru casa ta?

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
entries.translated: Aruncă o privire. Majoritatea mobilierului vine în truse la îndemână. Folosește-le în casa ta pentru a asambla mobila. Vrei să vezi doar un anumit {type} de mobilier?

entries.en: This world is nothing without poetry, don't you think? It gives us hope, it envokes love. It's inciting and invigorating all the same.
entries.translated: Lumea asta nu este nimic fără poezie, nu crezi? Ne dă speranță, ne invocă iubire. Totuși, este incitant și revigorant.
La revedere și la revedere, prietene.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.
entries.translated: Oh, salut |PLAYERNAME|! Ce drăguț din partea ta să vizitezi un bătrân ca mine.

entries.en: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
entries.translated: Întoarce-te ori de câte ori ai nevoie de înțelepciune.

entries.en: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
entries.translated: Întoarce-te ori de câte ori ai nevoie de înțelepciune.

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
entries.translated: Aruncă o privire. Majoritatea mobilierului vine în truse la îndemână. Folosește-le în casa ta pentru a asambla mobila. Vrei să vezi doar un anumit {type} de mobilier?

entries.en: Welcome to the paladins' guild, |PLAYERNAME|! How can I help you?
entries.translated: Bun venit la breasla paladinilor, |PLAYERNAME|! Cu ce ​​​​vă pot ajuta?

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You have no idea on how to use this device. Xelvar in Kazordoon might tell you more about it.
entries.translated: Вы понятия не имеете, как пользоваться этим устройством. Xelvar в Kazordoon может рассказать вам об этом больше.

entries.en: Gnomedix: So let the examination begin! Now don't move. Don't be afraid. The good doctor gnome won't hurt you - hopefully!
entries.translated: Gnomedix: Итак, начнём осмотр! Теперь не двигайся. Не бойтесь. Добрый гном-доктор не причинит вам вреда – надеюсь!
<clong!> <clong!> <scrit scrit scrit>Acest lucru ar trebui să facă acest lucru.

entries.en: You are speaking the language of animals? I'm surprised. But I'm not in the right mood for a chat.
entries.translated: Pratar du djurens språk? Jag är förvånad. Men jag är inte på rätt humör för en pratstund.

entries.en: Hi there! I'm ready to brief you with {tactical} advice.
entries.translated: Hej där! Jag är redo att informera dig med {tactical} råd.
Hejdå och ta hand om er!

entries.en: Hello and welcome in the Gnomprona Gardens
entries.translated: Hej och välkommen till Gnomprona Trädgårdarna

entries.en: Oh, hello! I'm the gnome-human relations assistant. I am here for you to trade your tokens for {equipment}, resupply you with mission {items} and talk to you about your {relations} to us gnomes! ...
entries.translated: Åh, hej! Jag är assistenten för gnome-mänskliga relationer. Jag är här för att du ska byta ut dina tokens mot {equipment}, förse dig med uppdrag {items} och prata med dig om dina {relations} till oss tomtar! ...

entries.en: Hi there! Are you here for the {shooting} test or to {report} your success?
entries.translated: Hej där! Är du här för {shooting}-testet eller för att {report} din framgång?

entries.en: Do you have something to deliver?
Greetings! You came to the right gnome to buy {potions}, {runes} or {wands}. So let's talk about a {trade}.
entries.translated: Hälsningar! Du kom till rätt tomte för att köpa {potions}, {runes} eller {wands}. Så låt oss prata om en {trade}.

entries.en: Hello. Is it me you're {looking} for?
entries.translated: Hej. Är det mig du är {looking} för?

entries.en: Hi there! I'm ready to brief you with {tactical} advice.
entries.translated: Hej där! Jag är redo att informera dig med {tactical} råd.
Hejdå och ta hand om er!

entries.en: Hello and welcome in the gnomish {recruitment} office.
entries.translated: Hej och välkommen till det gnälliga {recruitment}-kontoret.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Welcome to the Hard Rock Racing Track, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Добродошли на тркачку стазу Хард Роцк, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, здраво, мала дамо |PLAYERNAME|! Шта вам доноси {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добродошли, млади |PLAYERNAME|! Ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вам {heal} бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добродошли, |PLAYERNAME|! Нека вас земља заштити на стеновитим теренима. Ако вам треба {passage}, могу вам помоћи.

entries.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
entries.translated: Ахои, |PLAYERNAME|. Хоћеш да купиш свежу рибу?

entries.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Поздрав, |PLAYERNAME|! Мора да си доста долазио. Увек сам заинтересован да научим нове ствари о Заоу.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: Збогом. Препоручите нас ако сте задовољни нашом услугом.

entries.en: Welcome on board, recruit |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, регрутујте |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: On behalf of the inquisition, I bid you farewell.
entries.translated: У име инквизиције, опраштам се од вас.

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Поздрав, смели авантуристе. Ако вам треба {passage}, јавите ми.

entries.en: You sure you want to spend time on this piece of rock? I can show you the world! Huh.
entries.translated: Јесте ли сигурни да желите да проведете време на овом комаду стене? Могу ти показати свет! Хух.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?
Hai registrato la musica del ghiaccio.

entries.en: You have found {} weighing {} oz. You have no capacity.

Hai già ricevuto la tua ricompensa.

entries.en: You have found a yalahari mask.
You have found a yalahari leg piece.
entries.translated: Hai trovato un pezzo di gamba Yalahari.

entries.en: You have placed the false evidence!
You plant the rosebush into the fresh soil. The green portal glows brighter. Perhaps you may pass it now.
entries.translated: Pianti il ​​cespuglio di rose nel terreno fresco. Il portale verde brilla più luminoso. Forse potresti passarlo adesso.

entries.en: You played it wrong, now you must begin with the first again!
entries.translated: Hai giocato male, ora devi ricominciare dal primo!

entries.en: You played them in the correct order and got access through the door!

entries.en: You played it wrong, now you must begin with the first again!

entries.en: You put the {} into the dried well.
Find the keeper of the sanguine tears and offer his life fluids to the sanguine master of this realm.
entries.translated: Trova il custode delle lacrime sanguigne e offri i suoi fluidi vitali al sanguigno padrone di questo regno.

entries.en: Reinforce your sacrifice for a blooded tear to the sanguine master of this realm to seal this trade.
entries.translated: Rafforza il tuo sacrificio in cambio di una lacrima di sangue al sanguigno padrone di questo regno per suggellare questo scambio.

entries.en: Your sacrifice has been accepted by the sanguine master of this realm.
entries.translated: Il tuo sacrificio è stato accettato dal sanguigno padrone di questo regno.

entries.en: Your sacrifices have been accepted by the sanguine master of this realm. Go forth and bedew your root with the waters of life.
entries.translated: I tuoi sacrifici sono stati accettati dal sanguigno padrone di questo regno. Vai avanti e irrora la tua radice con le acque della vita.

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
entries.translated: Песчаная буря путешествует по Дараме, приводя к островам, полным смертоносных существ внутри кошмара. Избегайте реки возле Drefia!

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: You do not have the Chayenne's magical key.
entries.translated: У вас нет волшебного ключа Chayenne.

entries.en: You should leave for the Mainland now. Go left to reach the ship.
entries.translated: Вам следует отправиться на материк прямо сейчас. Идите налево, чтобы добраться до корабля.

entries.en: You have not the right vocation to enter this room.
entries.translated: У вас нет права входить в эту комнату.

entries.en: You have chosen your vocation. You cannot go back.
entries.translated: Вы выбрали свое призвание. Вы не можете вернуться назад.

entries.en: You cannot go upstairs. You have chosen a vocation and must now leave for the Mainlands.
entries.translated: Вы не можете подняться наверх. Вы выбрали призвание и теперь должны отправиться на Материк.

entries.en: Use these stairs to enter the Adventurer's Outpost on Dawnport.
entries.translated: Используйте эту лестницу, чтобы войти в Заставу Искателей приключений на Dawnport.

entries.en: Welcome to Dawnport! Walk around and explore on your own, or talk to Inigo if you need directions.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в Dawnport! Прогуляйтесь и исследуйте местность самостоятельно или поговорите с Иниго, если вам нужны указания.

entries.en: To walk on STAIRS, use your arrow keys on your keyboard. You can also use them to walk in general.
entries.translated: Чтобы идти по ЛЕСТНИЦЕ, используйте клавиши со стрелками на клавиатуре. Вы также можете использовать их для прогулок в целом.

entries.en: With a giant splash, you heave an enormous fish out of the water.
entries.translated: С гигантским всплеском вы вытаскиваете из воды огромную рыбу.
