entries.en: First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
entries.translated: Сначала вам нужно будет убить трех носителей чумы, а затем получить Формулы алхимиков. Когда это будет сделано, возвращайтесь либо к Палимуту (хорошая сторона), либо к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона).

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: You joined the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. Ask Grizzly Adams for some hunting tasks. You already gained %d points. You currently have %d boss points.
entries.translated: Вы присоединились к '__PH0__'. Попросите Гризли Адамса выполнить несколько охотничьих заданий. Вы уже набрали %d баллов. На данный момент у вас есть %d очков босса.

entries.en: By the way: The summoning of lesser creatures, the so-called 'reds', progressed comparatively well. Of course, these creatures are mere borderdwellers and may consequently not be considered true demons. However, it may prove that the development of summoning spells for 'reds' will prove a rewarding spin-off of demon summoning research.
entries.translated: Кстати: призыв меньших существ, так называемых 'reds', продвигался сравнительно хорошо. Конечно, эти существа всего лишь обитатели границ и, следовательно, не могут считаться настоящими демонами. Однако может оказаться, что разработка заклинаний призыва для 'reds' станет полезным побочным продуктом исследований по призыву демонов.

entries.en:
Diary of Hengis Wulfson
...
I can only hope I can escape the
cyclops someday. For now I have
occupied their chief with an attempt
to learn to read and write, but for
how long?
I'm so desperate.
What a foolish idea to travel here to
search the famous treasures of this
ancient, knightly order.
I wish I had never heard about it.
I wish I had never sung that song.
No clue how many unfortunate souls I
have lured to death with it.

...

entries.en: Finally! Something! I found a strange wall somewhere under Ab'Dendriel. I had to "borrow" some equipment, a pick, some tools, a rope - I am sure the elves won't mind. And now I am here! Here to dig up my first real treasure, maybe even more! My very own discovery of a tomb or even a lost palace! No - an archeological breakthrough (let's just say that not all of the gold and riches could be recovered), I will document everything I find in this diary!
entries.translated: In sfarsit! Ceva! Am găsit un zid ciudat undeva sub Ab'Dendriel. A trebuit să „împrumut” niște echipamente, un târnăcop, niște unelte, o frânghie - sunt sigur că spiridușii nu le vor deranja. Și acum sunt aici! Aici pentru a dezgropa prima mea comoară adevărată, poate chiar mai mult! Descoperirea mea proprie a unui mormânt sau chiar a unui palat pierdut! Nu - o descoperire arheologică (să spunem că nu tot aurul și bogățiile ar putea fi recuperate), voi documenta tot ce găsesc în acest jurnal!

entries.en: Finally, the end came swifter than they expected. Unwilling to take any risks in the unpredictable halls and passageways of Drefia's dungeons, the Marid performed a fearsome ritual. The tortured earth underneath Drefia started moving like a giant whirlpool, and slowly the unholy city was pulled inside the maelstrom. Within half an hour it was gone completely, and all but the highest buildings were completely covered by sand and by rubble. None of its inhabitants have ever been seen again, but rumour has it that deep beneath the surface the unholy city is still intact, brooding like a vengeful animal in its prison.
entries.translated: În cele din urmă, sfârșitul a venit mai repede decât se așteptau. Nedorind să-și asume niciun risc în sălile și pasajele imprevizibile ale temnițelor lui Drefia, Marid a îndeplinit un ritual înfricoșător. Pământul chinuit de sub Drefia a început să se miște ca un vârtej uriaș și, încet, orașul nesfânt a fost tras în interiorul vârtejului. Într-o jumătate de oră a dispărut complet și toate clădirile, cu excepția celor mai înalte, au fost acoperite complet de nisip și dărâmături. Niciunul dintre locuitorii săi nu a fost revăzut vreodată, dar zvonurile spun că, în adâncul suprafeței, orașul nesfânt este încă intact, gândindu-se ca un animal răzbunător în închisoarea sa.

entries.en: "First shalt thou take out the Holy Pin. Then, shalt thou count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the number thou shalt count, and the number of the counting shalt be three. Four shalt thou not count, nor either count thou two, excepting that thou then proceed to three. Five is right out. Once the number three, being the third number, be reached, then lobbest thou thy Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch towards thou foe, who being naughty in my sight, shall snuff it."
entries.translated: „Mai întâi să scoți Știftul Sfânt. Apoi, să numeri până la trei, nici mai mult, nici mai puțin. Trei va fi numărul pe care îl vei număra, iar numărul numărării va fi trei. Nu vei număra patru, nici nu numări doi, cu excepția faptului că treci apoi la trei. Cinci este imediat scos. Grenadă a Antiohiei către dușmanul tău, care fiind obraznic în ochii mei, o vei stinge.”

There are voices that Venore might separate one day or use it influence to wrest even mor rights and privileges from the kingdom that becomes more and more dependent on its economical power.

entries.en: For our deeds for king and country, the king granted our order the Eastern lands. The city under our protectorate is growing and will soon be as big and as beautiful as our capital. But there is much work to do and countless monsters to slay to bring peace to the green planes. Some days ago, Falnus vanished and we must reckon that he is dead, probably murdered by the brotherhood. Of course even a mage of his power could have been slain by a greater number of creatures as dangerous as giant spiders that still roam these plains. It's a hard blow to our researches in the arts of healing and recreations and the loss of a great man.
entries.translated: Per le nostre azioni a favore del re e del paese, il re ha concesso al nostro ordine le terre orientali. La città sotto il nostro protettorato sta crescendo e presto sarà grande e bella come la nostra capitale. Ma c'è molto lavoro da fare e innumerevoli mostri da uccidere per riportare la pace sui piani verdi. Alcuni giorni fa Falnus è scomparso e dobbiamo ritenere che sia morto, probabilmente assassinato dalla confraternita. Naturalmente anche un mago del suo potere avrebbe potuto essere ucciso da un numero maggiore di creature pericolose come i ragni giganti che ancora vagano per queste pianure. È un duro colpo per le nostre ricerche nelle arti curative e ricreative e la perdita di un grande uomo.

entries.en: Gabel had decided to hide Fa'hradin's lamp and its powerful prisoner in a forlorn place far to the north because he thought it would be safer there than in Ashta'daramai, his own fortress. Little did he know that these were very the lands where many centuries later a race of goblinoid barbarians called the orcs chose to erect a mighty fortress. One fateful day the lamp was found and brought to the orc king. It did not take the king's shamans long to work out that a mighty spirit was caught in the lamp, and soon enough the reckless king released the mighty djinn that had lain dormant for so many centuries. Little is known about what happened next, but even though to this day the orcs claim their king is still alive there are no credible witnesses who confirm that they have seen the orc king ever since. Malor, however, freely roams the world again, and many scholars agree that he will try every trick in the book to rekindle the fire of the djinn war.
entries.translated: Gabel aveva deciso di nascondere la lampada di Fa'hradin e il suo potente prigioniero in un luogo desolato molto a nord perché pensava che sarebbe stato più sicuro lì che ad Ashta'daramai, la sua fortezza. Non sapeva che queste erano proprio le terre dove molti secoli dopo una razza di barbari goblinoidi chiamati orchi scelse di erigere una possente fortezza. Un giorno fatidico la lampada fu trovata e portata al re degli orchi. Gli sciamani del re non impiegarono molto tempo a capire che nella lampada era intrappolato uno spirito potente, e ben presto il re spericolato liberò il potente jinn che era rimasto dormiente per così tanti secoli. Si sa poco di quello che accadde dopo, ma anche se fino ad oggi gli orchi affermano che il loro re è ancora vivo, non ci sono testimoni credibili che confermino di aver visto il re degli orchi da allora. Malor, tuttavia, vaga di nuovo liberamente per il mondo, e molti studiosi concordano sul fatto che proverà ogni trucco disponibile per riaccendere il fuoco della guerra dei djinn.

entries.en: Gabel told Daraman of the visions and dreams that haunted him and asked Daraman for advice. So Daraman asked him to open up his soul for him to see. And Gabel opened his heart and soul to him. When Daraman had seen deep into Gabel's soul he understood the pain and the confusion that lay hidden deep inside it, and he wept bitter tears of pity for Gabel and for the whole of his race, for he saw that the djinn were a forlorn race that had been cast away by its creator. So full of divine compassion were his tears that they froze into immaculate gemstones of pure blue crystal as soon as they left his eyes. It is said that that springs of clear freshwater sprang forth from the earth wherever one of them hit the ground.
entries.translated: Gabel raccontò a Daraman delle visioni e dei sogni che lo perseguitavano e chiese consiglio a Daraman. Quindi Daraman gli chiese di aprire la sua anima affinché potesse vederla. E Gabel gli aprì il suo cuore e la sua anima. Quando Daraman ebbe visto nel profondo dell'anima di Gabel, capì il dolore e la confusione che giacevano nascosti nel profondo di essa, e pianse lacrime amare di pietà per Gabel e per tutta la sua razza, poiché vide che i jinn erano una razza desolata che era stata scacciata dal suo creatore. Le sue lacrime erano così piene di compassione divina che si congelarono in gemme immacolate di puro cristallo blu non appena lasciarono i suoi occhi. Si dice che sorgenti di acqua dolce e limpida sgorgassero dalla terra ogni volta che una di esse toccasse terra.

entries.en: Gabel was curious about the strange human who did not seem to know pain or fear. He approached him and asked him if he did not feel any pain. Daraman answered that the pain of the body was nothing compared to the pain of the soul.  So Gabel asked Daraman if he was not afraid. And the prophet said the famous words: "The fear of death is but a trifle compared to the fear of life." So Gabel, who was more and more intrigued by the human, asked him whether he did not care at all about his life? Daraman just looked into the mighty djinn king's eyes, and a brief smile shone on his lips. And after a long pause he spoke thus: "I am an old man and I have but little to lose, mylord. But your race has much to gain, for it lives in darkness." When he said those words many djinns were outraged by the human's apparent lack of respect. And if Gabel had not stopped them the prophet would have been killed on spot.
entries.translated: Gabel era incuriosito da quello strano essere umano che sembrava non conoscere il dolore o la paura. Gli si avvicinò e gli chiese se non sentiva alcun dolore. Daraman rispose che il dolore del corpo non era nulla in confronto al dolore dell'anima.  Quindi Gabel chiese a Daraman se non avesse paura. E il profeta pronunciò le famose parole: "La paura della morte è poca cosa rispetto alla paura della vita". Allora Gabel, sempre più incuriosito dall'umano, gli chiese se non gli importava affatto della sua vita? Daraman guardò semplicemente negli occhi il potente re dei jinn e un breve sorriso brillò sulle sue labbra. E dopo una lunga pausa parlò così: "Sono un vecchio e non ho molto da perdere, mio ​​signore. Ma la vostra razza ha molto da guadagnare, perché vive nell'oscurità". Quando pronunciò quelle parole molti jinn rimasero indignati dall'apparente mancanza di rispetto da parte dell'umano. E se Gabel non li avesse fermati, il profeta sarebbe stato ucciso sul posto.

entries.en: Gha'Zuul grew up a simple boy among one of the northern nomad tribes. A frail and meagre child, he was frequently the target of the other childrens' jeers as well as of his despotic father's scorn. Hurt and angered by the constant humiliations, Gha'Zuul developed a bitter, unforgiving personality. He took notes of all the indignities he suffered, and he was determined to take revenge for every single one of them. One day, when his camp was attacked by an undead raiding party he decided it was time to get his revenge. Taking advantage of the general hullabaloo, Gha'Zuul sneaked up on his worst tormentor and quickly cut his throat. However, he had made a mistake when he thought that his crime would go unnoticed. One of the necromancers who was part of the raiding party sensed the evil of this deed, and since he was impressed by the young boy's obvious ruthlessness he ordered his undead troops to kidnap him. And so Gha'Zuul was brought to Drefia.
entries.translated: Gha'Zuul è cresciuto come un ragazzo semplice in una delle tribù nomadi del nord. Bambino fragile e magro, era spesso il bersaglio degli scherni degli altri bambini e del disprezzo del dispotico padre. Ferito e arrabbiato per le continue umiliazioni, Gha'Zuul sviluppò una personalità amara e spietata. Prendeva nota di tutte le umiliazioni subite ed era determinato a vendicarsi per ognuna di esse. Un giorno, quando il suo accampamento fu attaccato da un gruppo di non morti, decise che era giunto il momento di vendicarsi. Approfittando del trambusto generale, Gha'Zuul si avvicinò di soppiatto al suo peggior aguzzino e gli tagliò rapidamente la gola. Tuttavia, aveva commesso un errore pensando che il suo crimine sarebbe passato inosservato. Uno dei negromanti che faceva parte del gruppo d'assalto intuì la malvagità di questo atto e, poiché rimase colpito dall'evidente spietatezza del ragazzo, ordinò alle sue truppe non morte di rapirlo. E così Gha'Zuul è stato portato a Drefia.

entries.en: Life can be so easy with the right cake at the right time - and you mastered baking many different ones, so you should be prepared for almost everything life decides to throw at you.
entries.translated: Viața poate fi atât de ușoară cu prăjitura potrivită la momentul potrivit - și ați stăpânit să coaceți multe, așa că ar trebui să fiți pregătit pentru aproape tot ce decide viața să vă arunce.

entries.en: You're considered a first-rate graduate of the Magic Academy in Edron due to your pioneering discoveries and successful studies in the field of experimental magic and spell development. Ever considered teaching the Armageddon spell?
entries.translated: Ești considerat un absolvent de prim rang al Academiei de Magie din Edron datorită descoperirilor tale de pionierat și studiilor de succes în domeniul magiei experimentale și dezvoltării vrăjilor. V-ați gândit vreodată să predați vraja Armaghedonului?

entries.en: You're proficient in the darker ways of magic and are usually found sitting inside a circle of candles and skulls muttering unspeakable words. Don't carry things too far or the demons might come get you.
entries.translated: Sunteți priceput în modurile mai întunecate ale magiei și sunteți de obicei găsit stând într-un cerc de lumânări și cranii mormăind cuvinte de nespus. Nu duce lucrurile prea departe sau ar putea veni demonii să te ia.

entries.en: Indeed, you have a soft spot for rabbits. Maybe the rabbits you saved today will be the rabbits that will save you tomorrow. When you are really hungry.
entries.translated: Într-adevăr, ai un punct slab pentru iepuri. Poate că iepurii pe care i-ați salvat astăzi vor fi iepurii care vă vor salva mâine. Când ți-e foarte foame.

entries.en: True scientists know their equipment. Testing new inventions is essential daily work for any hard working researcher. You showed no fear and took all the new equipment from Spectulus and Sinclair for a spin.
entries.translated: Oamenii de știință adevărați își cunosc echipamentul. Testarea noilor invenții este munca zilnică esențială pentru orice cercetător muncitor. Nu ți-ai arătat nicio teamă și ai luat toate echipamentele noi de la Spectulus și Sinclair pentru o învârtire.

entries.en: You went into the forest, met Rottin Wood and the Married Men and helped them out in their camp. Oh, and don't worry about those merchants. They won't dare mentioning the strangely large sums of gold they actually possessed which are missing now.
entries.translated: Ai intrat în pădure, l-ai întâlnit pe Rottin Wood și pe bărbații căsătoriți și i-ai ajutat în tabăra lor. Oh, și nu-ți face griji pentru acești comercianți. Nu vor îndrăzni să menționeze sumele ciudat de mari de aur pe care le posedau de fapt și care lipsesc acum.

entries.en: You passed their test and helped the Spirithunters testing equipment, researching the supernatural and catching ghosts - it's you they're gonna call.
entries.translated: Le-ai trecut testul și i-ai ajutat pe Spirithunters să testeze echipamentele, să cerceteze supranaturalele și să prindă fantome - pe tine te vor suna.

entries.en: Almost all the plants you tested for Chartan in Zao where inedible - you tasted them all, yet you're still standing! You should really get some fresh air now, though.
entries.translated: Aproape toate plantele pe care le-ați testat pentru Chartan în Zao erau necomestibile - le-ați gustat pe toate, dar încă ești în picioare! Totuși, ar trebui să luați puțin aer proaspăt acum.

entries.en: You have bravely stepped onto the cake isle. Is there any more beautiful, tasty place to be in the whole world?
entries.translated: Ai pășit curajos pe insula tortului. Există vreun loc mai frumos și mai gustos în care să fii în întreaga lume?

entries.en: You have cheered up a demon baby and returned it to its mother. A quick count of your fingers will reveal if you made it through unharmed.
entries.translated: Ai înveselit un copil demon și l-ai înapoiat mamei sale. O numărare rapidă a degetelor vă va dezvălui dacă ați trecut nevătămat.

entries.en: You have cheered up a bunch of demon babies and returned them to their mother. Don't bother the burn marks, don't bother the strains of grey hair, don't bother the nights you wake up screaming. It was worth it ... probably ... somehow.
entries.translated: Ai înveselit o grămadă de bebeluși demoni și i-ai înapoiat mamei lor. Nu deranja urmele de arsuri, nu deranja tulpinile de păr gri, nu deranja nopțile în care te trezești țipând. A meritat... probabil... cumva.

entries.en: You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain. Despite the perils, you and your fellow crewmen have braved the challenge.
entries.translated: Ai navigat pe mările de jos cu Căpitanul Fantomă. În ciuda pericolelor, tu și colegii tăi de echipaj ați înfruntat provocarea.

entries.en: You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain several times. The dangers of the nether have become familiar to you and unexperienced travelers turn to you for advice.
entries.translated: Ai navigat în mările de jos cu Căpitanul Fantomă de mai multe ori. Pericolele de jos ți-au devenit familiare, iar călătorii neexperimentați apelează la tine pentru sfat.

entries.en: Not fearing death or ghosts you have traveled with the ghost captain several times and are a seasoned traveler of the netherworld. The dead and the living whisper about your exploits with appreciation.
entries.translated: Fără să te temi de moarte sau de fantome, ai călătorit cu căpitanul fantomă de mai multe ori și ești un călător experimentat al lumii de jos. Morții și cei vii șoptesc despre isprăvile tale cu apreciere.

entries.en: You are a master of the nether sea and have traveled with the ghost captain so many times that you know his ship and the perils of the nether sea inside out. You laugh in the face of death and may return as a ghost pirate yourself in the afterlife!
entries.translated: Ești un stăpân al mării de jos și ai călătorit cu căpitanul fantomă de atâtea ori încât îi cunoști nava și pericolele mării de jos pe dinafară. Râzi în fața morții și te poți întoarce ca un pirat fantomă în viața de apoi!

entries.en: You have helped to keep the witches fire burning. Just watch your fingers, it's hot!
entries.translated: Ai ajutat să țină focul vrăjitoarelor aprins. Ai grijă doar la degete, e fierbinte!

entries.en: You sacrificed ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches.
entries.translated: Ai sacrificat ingrediente pentru a crea preparatul protector al vrăjitoarelor.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Invalid command format. Use: /ban playername, days [, reason].
entries.translated: Formato del comando non valido. Usa: /ban nomegiocatore, giorni [, motivo].
La durata del ban non può superare i 350.000 giorni.

entries.translated: Вы должны подождать. Кто-то сейчас бросает вызов {bossName}.

entries.translated: {message}, но у тебя нет места, чтобы его взять.

entries.en: Only allowed monsters can be influenced.
entries.translated: Influenced могут быть только разрешённые монстры.

entries.translated: {message}. При весе {weight} унции он слишком тяжел для вас.

entries.en: You have found a {itemName}, but you have no room to take it.
entries.translated: Вы нашли {itemName}, но у вас нет места, чтобы его взять.

entries.en: You have found a {itemName}. Weighing {weight} oz, it is too heavy for you to carry.
entries.translated: Вы нашли {itemName}. При весе {weight} унции он слишком тяжел для вас.

entries.en: Paid {inventoryAmount} from inventory and {bankAmount} gold from bank account. Your account balance is now {balance} gold.
entries.translated: Выплачено {inventoryAmount} из инвентаря и {bankAmount} золота с банковского счета. Баланс вашего счета теперь составляет {balance} золота.

entries.translated: Această acțiune trebuie să fie legată de o singură cheie.

entries.en: This hotkey is already in use.
entries.translated: Această tastă rapidă este deja utilizată.

entries.translated: Du behöver 2 spelare för att komma in i arenan.

entries.en: Please wait for the fighters come out of the arena.
entries.translated: Vänta på att kämparna kommer ut från arenan.

entries.en: You may construct this only inside a house.
entries.translated: Du får endast bygga detta i ett hus.

entries.en: Put the construction kit on the floor first.
Someone is fighting against the boss! You need wait awhile.
entries.translated: Någon slåss mot chefen! Du måste vänta ett tag.

entries.en: You need 5 players to fight with this boss.
entries.translated: Du behöver 5 spelare för att slåss med den här chefen.

entries.en: You can only use the shrine on an valid item.
entries.translated: Du kan bara använda helgedomen på ett giltigt föremål.

entries.en: You did not collect enough knowledge from the ancient Shapers. Visit the Shaper temple in Montag for help.
entries.translated: Du samlade inte tillräckligt med kunskap från de gamla Shapers. Besök Shaper-templet i Montag för hjälp.

entries.en: You have fifteen minutes to kill and loot this boss, else you will lose that chance.
entries.translated: Du har femton minuter på dig att döda och plundra den här chefen, annars kommer du att förlora den chansen.

entries.en: You have entered an ancient demon prison cell!
entries.translated: Du har gått in i en gammal demonfängelsecell!

entries.en: You can not buy more than {max} days of premium account.
entries.translated: Du kan inte köpa mer än {max} dagars premiumkonto.

entries.en: You're still too full to eat any gourmet dishes for a while.
entries.translated: Du är fortfarande för mätt för att äta några gourmeträtter på ett tag.

entries.en: You need the outfit for this part.
entries.translated: Du behöver klädseln för den här delen.

entries.en: You already own this outfit part.
entries.translated: Du äger redan den här outfitdelen.

entries.en: Store don't have offers for rookgaard citizen.
entries.translated: Butiken har inga erbjudanden för rookgaard medborgare.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

entries.en:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
entries.translated: Cóż, możesz być właśnie bohaterem, którego tam potrzebują. Prawdę mówiąc, część naszych najbardziej niezawodnych kopalń rudy zaczęła się wyczerpywać... \z Dlatego rozwinęliśmy nowe technologie parowców, by móc dalej badać i kartografować wielkie podziemne rzeki. Nasi bracia założyli bazę na kontynencie bardzo, bardzo daleko stąd... \z Nazywamy ją bazą bardzo, bardzo daleko. Ale ponieważ mamy nadzieję, że pewnego dnia stanie się kwitnącą kopalnią, większość z nas zaczęła nazywać ją {Farmine}. Krasnoludy na miejscu naprawdę potrzebują teraz pomocy.

entries.en: At your service, just browse through my wares.
So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
I think you have forgotten to bring your stake.
entries.translated: Myślę, że zapomniałeś zabrać ze sobą swoją stawkę.
Pilnuj dobrze swojego kamienia poszukiwacza przygód.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
Did you bring all the materials I informed you about?
entries.translated: Czy przyniosłeś wszystkie materiały, o których cię informowałem?

entries.en: Not many travellerzz zzezze dayzz. I hope you bring good newzz.
entries.translated: Niewielu podróżnikzz tych dniazz. Mam nadzieję, że przynosisz dobre wieścizz.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
entries.translated: Ogni volta che ricevi una ferita letale, la tua forza vitale viene danneggiata e c'è la possibilità che tu perda parte del tuo equipaggiamento. Con ognuno dei cinque {blessings} che hai, questo danno e la possibilità di perdita saranno ridotti.

entries.en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

entries.en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
entries.translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

entries.en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

entries.en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
entries.translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Bene. Sei libero di rifiutare la mia offerta.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

entries.en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
entries.translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated:
Questa è una benedizione speciale che posso concederti una volta ottenuta almeno una delle altre benedizioni e che funziona in modo leggermente diverso. ...\z
	Funziona solo quando vieni ucciso da altri avventurieri, il che significa che almeno la metà del danno che ha portato alla tua morte è stato causato da altri, non da mostri o dall'ambiente. ...\z
	Lo {twist of fate} non ridurrà la pena di morte come le altre benedizioni, ma invece ti impedirà di perdere le tue altre benedizioni e l'amuleto della perdita, se ne indossi uno. Costa lo stesso delle altre benedizioni. ...\z
	Ti piacerebbe ricevere quella protezione per un sacrificio di |PVPBLESSCOST| oro, bambino?
Conserva bene la tua pietra dell'avventuriero.

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
entries.translated: Ah, vuoi sostituire gratuitamente la tua pietra dell'avventuriero?

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
entries.translated: Ah, vuoi sostituire la tua pietra dell'avventuriero per 30 monete d'oro?

entries.en: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
entries.translated: Mi dispiace, non hai abbastanza soldi.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
entries.translated: Non dimenticare di depositare i tuoi soldi qui nella Banca Globale prima di partire per l'avventura.

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
entries.translated: До свидания, |PLAYERNAME|. Я очень надеюсь, что мы скоро снова поговорим.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?
entries.translated: О, привет |PLAYERNAME|, твои волосы выглядят великолепно! Кто сделал это для тебя?

entries.en: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
entries.translated: О, привет, красавчик! Приятно познакомиться, |PLAYERNAME|. С радостью, у меня есть время {chat} немного.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Да? Что я могу для тебя сделать, |PLAYERNAME|? Банковский бизнес, возможно?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в мою скромную обитель. Если вы пришли за новым колдуном {spells}, вы попали по адресу.

entries.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: Прощай, |PLAYERNAME|, я буду здесь, если я тебе снова понадоблюсь.

entries.en: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}
entries.translated: Рад тебя видеть. Я всегда рядом с твоим {shop options}

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Goodbye. I am sure you will come back for more. They all do.
entries.translated: До свидания. Я уверен, что вы вернетесь еще. Все они так делают.

entries.en: Goodbye. I am sure you will come back for more. They all do.
entries.translated: До свидания. Я уверен, что вы вернетесь еще. Все они так делают.

entries.en: Are you talking to me? Well, go on chatting but don't expect an answer.
entries.translated: Ты говоришь со мной? Что ж, продолжайте болтать, но не ждите ответа.

entries.en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
entries.translated: Nu arăți așa de rău. Scuze, nu te pot ajuta. Dar dacă cauți protecție suplimentară, ar trebui să mergi pe {pilgrimage} de cenușă sau să obții protecția {twist of fate} aici.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Puteți cere binecuvântarea scuturilor spirituale în templul cu flori albe de la sud de Thais.

entries.en: I am the captain of this ship.
I am the captain of this ship.
So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Așa că primește protecția întorsăturii destinului, pelerine.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Așa că primește protecția întorsăturii destinului, pelerine.

entries.en: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Cred că ai uitat să-ți aduci țărușul, pelerine.

entries.en: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
entries.translated: Da, am fost informat ce să fac. Ești pregătit să primești rândul meu de rugăciune?

entries.en: You already received my line of the prayer.
entries.translated: Ai primit deja rândul meu de rugăciune.

entries.en: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
entries.translated: Ești rănit, copilul meu. Îți voi vindeca rănile.

entries.en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
entries.translated: Nu arăți așa de rău. Scuze, nu te pot ajuta. Dar dacă cauți protecție suplimentară, ar trebui să mergi pe {pilgrimage} de cenușă sau să obții protecția {twist of fate} aici.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Amenda. Sunteți liber să refuzați oferta mea.

entries.en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
entries.translated: Ori de câte ori primești o rană letală, forța ta vitală este deteriorată și există șansa să pierzi o parte din echipamentul tău. Cu fiecare dintre cele cinci {blessings} pe care le aveți, această daune și șansa de pierdere vor fi reduse.

entries.en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Văd că ai primit scutul spiritual în templul cu flori albe de la sud de Thais.

entries.en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
entries.translated: Simt că druidii de la nord de Carlin ți-au oferit Îmbrățișarea lui Tibia.

entries.en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Văd că ai primit binecuvântarea celor doi sori în solar lângă Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Îmi dau seama că scânteia phoenixului ți-a fost deja dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it
entries.translated: Un pustnic de lângă Carlin ar putea să vă spună mai multe despre asta

entries.en: Zzaion is our last zztand! I will not leave wizzout a fight!
entries.translated: Ззайон — наш последний ззтанд! Я не оставлю wizzout бой!

entries.en: Feel the wrath of mother Tibia!
I will be still around when my 'noble' race is gone.
entries.translated: Я буду рядом, когда моя гонка 'noble' закончится.

entries.en: Have you seen my truffle baker?
I should visit the Candy Carnival.
entries.translated: Ar trebui să vizitez Carnavalul Bomboanelor.

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.

entries.en: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
entries.translated: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.

entries.en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
entries.translated: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.

entries.en: I am the captain of this ship.
entries.translated: Jag är kapten på det här fartyget.

entries.en: I am the captain of this ship.
entries.translated: Jag är kapten på det här fartyget.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Så ta emot skyddet av ödets vändning, pilgrim.

entries.en: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Jag tror att du har glömt att ta med din påle, pilgrim.

entries.en: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
entries.translated: Ja, jag fick besked om vad jag skulle göra. Är du beredd att ta emot min bönelinje?

entries.en: You already received my line of the prayer.
entries.translated: Du har redan fått min bönrad.

entries.en: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
entries.translated: Du är sårad, mitt barn. Jag ska läka dina sår.

entries.en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
entries.translated: Du ser inte så illa ut. Tyvärr, jag kan inte hjälpa dig. Men om du letar efter ytterligare skydd bör du gå på {pilgrimage} av aska eller få skyddet av {twist of fate} här.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Bra. Du är fri att tacka nej till mitt erbjudande.

entries.en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
entries.translated: Närhelst du får ett dödligt sår skadas din livskraft och det finns en chans att du tappar bort en del av din utrustning. Med varenda av de fem {blessings} du har kommer denna skada och risken för förlust att minska.

entries.en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.en: We have to dig up valuable resources, but don't get enough to eat. The situation is terrible.
entries.translated: Dobbiamo estrarre risorse preziose, ma non abbiamo abbastanza da mangiare. La situazione è terribile.

entries.en: What we get to eat is really ridiculous.
entries.translated: Ciò che mangiamo è davvero ridicolo.

entries.en: We dig up all what mother earth delivers to us, valuable natural resources.
entries.translated: Scaviamo tutto ciò che la madre terra ci offre, preziose risorse naturali.

entries.en: Every man is the architect of his own fortune. The times of repression are finally over.
entries.translated: Ogni uomo è l'artefice della propria fortuna. I tempi della repressione sono finalmente finiti.

entries.en: The repression has taken too long. With our new weapons the respective people will get their just punishment.
entries.translated: La repressione è durata troppo a lungo. Con le nostre nuove armi i rispettivi popoli riceveranno la giusta punizione.

entries.en: My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!
entries.translated: Il mio eroe! Un mio amico ti ha mandato per liberarmi? Un vero amico!

entries.en: We need weapons to overcome our situation.
entries.translated: Abbiamo bisogno di armi per superare la nostra situazione.

entries.en: My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!

entries.en: Every man is the architect of his own fortune. I want to see the daylight again! Just smell fresh air.

entries.en: My hero! A friend of mine sent you to liberate me? A true friend!

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Feel free to tell me what has brought you here.
entries.translated: Benvenuto, |PLAYERNAME|! Sentiti libero di dirmi cosa ti ha portato qui.

entries.en: Be greeted, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to my {hut}.
entries.translated: Fatti salutare, viaggiatore |PLAYERNAME|. Benvenuti nel mio {hut}.

entries.en: Please come back from time to time.
entries.translated: Per favore, torna di tanto in tanto.

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!

entries.en: You have found a  ritual scissors.
Somebody left a card. It says: Looking for the scroll? Come find me. Take the stairs next to the students. Dorm.
entries.translated: Qualcuno ha lasciato un biglietto. Dice: Cerchi la pergamena? Vieni a trovarmi. Prendi le scale accanto agli studenti. Dormitorio.

entries.en: You carefully put the mirror crystal into the astronomers's device.
entries.translated: Metti con cura il cristallo dello specchio nel dispositivo degli astronomi.

entries.en: You turn the key in the small lock at the side of the shelf and... the key breaks. Other than that absolutely nothing happens.
entries.translated: Giri la chiave nella piccola serratura a lato dello scaffale e... la chiave si rompe. A parte questo non succede assolutamente nulla.

entries.en: A hidden stash appears the very moment you turn the key. Unfortunately the key breaks as you attempt to remove it from the lock.
entries.translated: Una scorta nascosta appare nel momento stesso in cui giri la chiave. Sfortunatamente la chiave si rompe mentre tenti di rimuoverla dalla serratura.

entries.en: You don't have the fitting key.
The room slowly beginns to crackle. An erruption seems imanent!
entries.translated: La stanza comincia lentamente a crepitare. Sembra imminente un'eruzione!

entries.en: You entwine the antler with fresh star herb.
entries.translated: Intrecci il corno con erba stellata fresca.

entries.en: <BOOOOOOOONGGGGGG> A slow throbbing, like blood pulsing, runs through the floor.
entries.translated: <BOOOOOOOONGGGGGG> Un lento battito, come se il sangue pulsasse, percorre il pavimento.

entries.en: There is not enough ectoplasm left to fill it in the bucket.
entries.translated: Non è rimasto abbastanza ectoplasma per riempirlo nel secchio.

entries.en: There is not enough ectoplasm left to fill it in the bucket.
entries.translated: Non è rimasto abbastanza ectoplasma per riempirlo nel secchio.

entries.en: The ectoplasm all over this egg was already seeping inside the cocoon itself. You manage to fill soem of it into the bucket.
entries.translated: L'ectoplasma su tutto l'uovo stava già filtrando all'interno del bozzolo stesso. Riesci a riempirne qualcuno nel secchio.

entries.en: You pour all of the ectoplasm over yourself. Without the bucket you cannot stabilise it, you need to hurry until it dissolves!
entries.translated: Versi tutto l'ectoplasma su te stesso. Senza il secchio non puoi stabilizzarlo, devi sbrigarti finché non si dissolve!

entries.en: Suddenly, you see the big picture. It all makes sense now. And then you despair.
entries.translated: All'improvviso vedi il quadro generale. Tutto ha senso adesso. E poi ti disperi.

entries.en: Suddenly, you see the latter A. It all makes sense now. And then you now the secret.
entries.translated: All'improvviso vedi quest'ultima A. Ora tutto ha senso. E poi ora conosci il segreto.

entries.en: The dragon tears glow and disappear. The old powers are appeased.
entries.translated: Le lacrime del drago si illuminano e scompaiono. I vecchi poteri sono placati.

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
entries.translated: Песчаная буря путешествует по Дараме, приводя к островам, полным смертоносных существ внутри кошмара. Избегайте реки возле Drefia!

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: You do not have the Chayenne's magical key.
entries.translated: У вас нет волшебного ключа Chayenne.

entries.en: Use these stairs to enter the Adventurer's Outpost on Dawnport.
entries.translated: Используйте эту лестницу, чтобы войти в Заставу Искателей приключений на Dawnport.

entries.en: Welcome to Dawnport! Walk around and explore on your own, or talk to Inigo if you need directions.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в Dawnport! Прогуляйтесь и исследуйте местность самостоятельно или поговорите с Иниго, если вам нужны указания.

entries.en: You need Full Golden Outfit to use it.
entries.translated: Чтобы использовать его, вам понадобится полный золотой наряд.

entries.en: You dive into the vortex to swim below the rocks to the other side of the cave.
entries.translated: Вы ныряете в водоворот, чтобы переплыть под камнями на другую сторону пещеры.

entries.en: You already fixed many broken walls today.
entries.translated: Сегодня вы уже починили много сломанных стен.

entries.en: You need to be at least Level 2 in order to pass.
entries.translated: Чтобы пройти, вам необходимо иметь как минимум 2-й уровень.

entries.en: Your lock pick open this chest!
The amulet burns your skin. It hungers for energy right now, gather a large amount of energy as fast as possible to charge it.
entries.translated: Амулет обжигает кожу. Сейчас он жаждет энергии, соберите как можно быстрее большое количество энергии, чтобы зарядить его.

entries.en: You need at least level 250 to enter.
entries.translated: Для входа вам нужен минимум 250 уровень.

entries.en: You must wear an underwater exploration helmet in order to dive.
entries.translated: Чтобы нырять, вам необходимо надеть шлем для подводных исследований.

entries.en: You harvested some of the herb's flower buds. Bring them Morris for a reward.
entries.translated: Ai recoltat niște muguri florali ai plantei. Adu-i Morris pentru o recompensă.

entries.en: Whew! That was that hot, it melted the thermometer! At least you've found the hot spot!
entries.translated: Uf! Era atât de fierbinte, a topit termometrul! Cel puțin ai găsit punctul fierbinte!

entries.en: First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
entries.translated: Сначала вам нужно будет убить трех носителей чумы, а затем получить Формулы алхимиков. Когда это будет сделано, возвращайтесь либо к Палимуту (хорошая сторона), либо к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона).

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: By the way: The summoning of lesser creatures, the so-called 'reds', progressed comparatively well. Of course, these creatures are mere borderdwellers and may consequently not be considered true demons. However, it may prove that the development of summoning spells for 'reds' will prove a rewarding spin-off of demon summoning research.
entries.translated: Кстати: призыв меньших существ, так называемых 'reds', продвигался сравнительно хорошо. Конечно, эти существа всего лишь обитатели границ и, следовательно, не могут считаться настоящими демонами. Однако может оказаться, что разработка заклинаний призыва для 'reds' станет полезным побочным продуктом исследований по призыву демонов.
