entries.en: Deep in the heart of the Kha'labal the dreaded hyena king has its lair. This legendary beast is much larger than any other specimen of its race, surpassing lions and even elephants in size, and it can tear a man apart in seconds with its enormous, razor-sharp teeth. What's more, the hyena king is said to be truly immortal, for it has been sighted time and again by numerous travellers and merchants. Many a caravan is said to have fallen prey to this ferocious beast, and it is widely believed to have amassed untold treasures over the centuries.
entries.translated: Глубоко в сердце Кха'лабала находится логово ужасного короля гиен. Этот легендарный зверь намного крупнее любого другого представителя своей расы, превосходя по размерам львов и даже слонов, и своими огромными, острыми как бритва зубами он может разорвать человека на части за считанные секунды. Более того, говорят, что король гиен поистине бессмертен, поскольку его снова и снова видели многочисленные путешественники и торговцы. Говорят, что многие караваны стали жертвой этого свирепого зверя, и широко распространено мнение, что на протяжении веков он накопил несметные сокровища.

entries.en: For a long time Malor had plotted and schemed in secrecy, using promises and threats to recruit followers and to form alliances. Many djinn refused to betray Gabel, but the majority of the strongest djinn warriors rallied to his cause, and since Malor had been plotting his insurrection for a long time the rebels were well-prepared. When Malor finally gave the signal his minions attacked the palace in full force, planning to kill Gabel swiftly. Their attack was deadly effective, and the palace guards were quickly overwhelmed. However, Gabel, who had received warning about the conspiracy was saved in time by his trusted aide and friend Fa'hradin. He managed to flee in the darkness, and that very night he started to gather his troops in order to take revenge on the usurper. Malor, on the other hand, had to acknowledge that his plan to get rid of Gabel quickly had failed. And he ordered his followers to prepare for a long-term military engagement. Neither he nor Gabel realised then that this was the starting point for a war that would last for eons.
entries.translated: Multă vreme Malor complotase și complotase în secret, folosind promisiuni și amenințări pentru a recruta adepți și pentru a forma alianțe. Mulți djinni au refuzat să-l trădeze pe Gabel, dar majoritatea celor mai puternici războinici djinn s-au adunat în favoarea cauzei sale și, din moment ce Malor își complotase de multă vreme insurecția, rebelii erau bine pregătiți. Când Malor a dat în sfârșit semnalul, slujitorii săi au atacat palatul cu toată forța, plănuind să-l omoare pe Gabel rapid. Atacul lor a fost extrem de eficient, iar gardienii palatului au fost rapid copleșiți. Cu toate acestea, Gabel, care primise avertisment cu privire la conspirație, a fost salvat la timp de ajutorul său de încredere și prieten Fa'hradin. A reușit să fugă în întuneric și chiar în noaptea aceea a început să-și adune trupele pentru a se răzbuna pe uzurpator. Malor, în schimb, a trebuit să recunoască că planul său de a scăpa rapid de Gabel a eșuat. Și le-a ordonat adepților săi să se pregătească pentru un angajament militar pe termen lung. Nici el, nici Gabel nu și-au dat seama atunci că acesta era punctul de plecare pentru un război care avea să dureze eoni.

entries.en: For centuries we have been doing research into this magic web in our world of Tibia. And the more we try to understand how it works the more I think that we will never solve its mysteries.
entries.translated: De secole am făcut cercetări asupra acestei rețele magice din lumea noastră Tibia. Și cu cât încercăm să înțelegem mai mult cum funcționează, cu atât cred că nu îi vom rezolva niciodată misterele.

entries.en: For each missing part (on the basis of a standard rail) I recommend to use three pieces of wood. Lock them in position by at least 6 nails. For the rail itself use a saw on a piece of wood to build your wooden ties. Then place two metal fittings on them and you can make your first ride on your new rail. Congratulations!
entries.translated: Pentru fiecare parte lipsă (pe baza unei șine standard) recomand să folosiți trei bucăți de lemn. Blocați-le în poziție cu cel puțin 6 cuie. Pentru șina în sine, utilizați un ferăstrău pe o bucată de lemn pentru a vă construi legăturile de lemn. Apoi puneți două fitinguri metalice pe ele și puteți face prima călătorie pe noua șină. Felicitări!

entries.en: For example, only with its help we could find the gates of teleportation of the magic web.
entries.translated: De exemplu, doar cu ajutorul lui am putut găsi porțile teleportarii ale rețelei magice.

entries.en: For now the merchants seem content with their station and the place Venore takes on the continent and in the kingdom. There are voices that Venore might separate one day or use it influence to wrest even mor rights and privileges from the kingdom that becomes more and more dependent on its economical power.
entries.translated: Deocamdată negustorii par mulțumiți de postul lor și de locul pe care Venore îl ocupă pe continent și în regat. Există voci pe care Venore s-ar putea separa într-o zi sau s-ar putea folosi de influența ei pentru a smulge și mai multe drepturi și privilegii de la regatul care devine din ce în ce mai dependent de puterea sa economică.

entries.en: For our deeds for king and country, the king granted our order the Eastern lands. The city under our protectorate is growing and will soon be as big and as beautiful as our capital. But there is much work to do and countless monsters to slay to bring peace to the green planes. Some days ago, Falnus vanished and we must reckon that he is dead, probably murdered by the brotherhood. Of course even a mage of his power could have been slain by a greater number of creatures as dangerous as giant spiders that still roam these plains. It's a hard blow to our researches in the arts of healing and recreations and the loss of a great man.
entries.translated: Pentru faptele noastre pentru rege și țară, regele a acordat ordinului nostru pământurile răsăritene. Orașul aflat sub protectoratul nostru crește și va fi în curând la fel de mare și frumos ca capitala noastră. Dar este mult de lucru și nenumărați monștri de ucis pentru a aduce pace în avioanele verzi. Cu câteva zile în urmă, Falnus a dispărut și trebuie să considerăm că este mort, probabil ucis de frăție. Desigur, chiar și un mag al puterii sale ar fi putut fi ucis de un număr mai mare de creaturi la fel de periculoase precum păianjenii uriași care încă cutreieră aceste câmpii. Este o lovitură grea pentru cercetările noastre în artele vindecării și recreațiilor și pierderea unui om grozav.

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Got your rope and shovel? Well, have fun hunting!
entries.translated: Hai la corda e la pala? Bene, divertiti a cacciare!

Sede della Gilda della Rosa Rossa

entries.en: You sacrificed a lot of ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches and played a significant part in the efforts to repel the dreaded banebringers. The drawback is that even the banebringers may take notice of you ...
entries.translated: Ai sacrificat o mulțime de ingrediente pentru a crea băutura protectoare a vrăjitoarelor și ai jucat un rol semnificativ în eforturile de a respinge temuții nenorociți. Dezavantajul este că până și cei care s-ar putea să te bage în seamă...

entries.en: To keep the witches' fire burning, you trashed a lot of the wood the bane bringers animated. Some might find your fascination for fire ... disturbing.
entries.translated: Pentru a menține focul vrăjitoarelor aprins, ai aruncat la gunoi o mulțime de lemne pe care le-au animat aducătorul de ruine. Unii ar putea considera fascinația ta pentru foc... tulburătoare.

entries.en: Your efforts in fighting back the banebringers has not gone unnoticed. You are a legend amongst the witches and your name is whispered with awe and admiration.
entries.translated: Eforturile tale de a-i contrazice pe nenorociți nu au trecut neobservate. Ești o legendă printre vrăjitoare și numele tău este șoptit cu venerație și admirație.

entries.en: Oh, the joy of riding! You've just got your very first own mount. Conveniently enough you don't even need stables, but can summon it any time you like.
entries.translated: Oh, bucuria de a merge! Tocmai ai prima ta montură proprie. În mod suficient de convenabil, nici măcar nu aveți nevoie de grajduri, dar îl puteți invoca oricând doriți.

entries.en: Stones have always fascinated you. So has the chance of finding something really precious inside one of them. Statistically you should've discovered a few nice treasures by now. But then again, most statistics are overriden by Mother Disfortune.
entries.translated: Pietrele te-au fascinat întotdeauna. La fel are șansa de a găsi ceva cu adevărat prețios în interiorul unuia dintre ei. Statistic, ar fi trebuit să descoperi câteva comori frumoase până acum. Dar, din nou, majoritatea statisticilor sunt depășite de Mother Disfortune.

entries.en: You've discovered the Ancients' hidden powers - from now on, they will aid you in your adventures.
entries.translated: Ați descoperit puterile ascunse ale Anticilor - de acum înainte, vă vor ajuta în aventurile voastre.

entries.en: You definitely know how to bring out the best in your furniture and decoration pieces. Beautiful.
entries.translated: Cu siguranță știi să scoți ce e mai bun din piesele tale de mobilier și decor. Frumos.

entries.en: You always carry your obsidian knife with you and won't hesitate to use it. You've skinned countless little - and bigger - critters and yeah: they usually don't get any more beautiful on the inside. It's rather blood and gore and all that...
entries.translated: Îți porți mereu cuțitul obsidian cu tine și nu vei ezita să-l folosești. Ai jupuit nenumărate animale mici - și mai mari - și da: de obicei nu devin mai frumoase pe dinăuntru. E mai degrabă sânge și sânge și toate astea...

entries.en: Staking vampires and demons has almost turned into your profession. You make sure to gather even the tiniest amount of evil dust particles. Beware of silicosis.
entries.translated: Starea de vampiri și demoni aproape s-a transformat în profesia ta. Asigurați-vă că adunați chiar și cea mai mică cantitate de particule de praf rău. Atenție la silicoză.

entries.en: Don't worry, no one will be able to take it from you. Probably.
entries.translated: Nu vă faceți griji, nimeni nu vă va putea lua. Probabil.

entries.en: Awww. Your very own little goldfish friend - he's cute, he's shiny and he can't complain should you forget to feed him. He'll definitely brighten up your day!
entries.translated: Awww. Micul tău prieten peștișor - este drăguț, strălucitor și nu se poate plânge dacă uiți să-l hrănești. Cu siguranță îți va însenina ziua!

entries.en: Hopping, hopping through the snow - that's the funnest way to go! Making footprints in a flurry - it's more fun the more you hurry! Licking icicles all day - Winter, never go away!
entries.translated: Săritul, săritul prin zăpadă - acesta este cel mai amuzant mod de a merge! Faceți urme de pași într-un rafală - este mai distractiv cu cât vă grăbiți mai mult! Linge țurțuri toată ziua - Iarnă, nu pleci niciodată!

entries.en: Sinister curses, evil magic - you don't shy away from punishing others by questionable means. Someone just gave you a strange look - now where's that needle again?
entries.translated: Blesteme sinistre, magie diabolică - nu te sfii să-i pedepsești pe alții prin mijloace îndoielnice. Cineva tocmai ți-a aruncat o privire ciudată - acum unde e din nou acul?

entries.en: Home is where your current favourite hunting ground is, and though you might hold certain places more dear than others you never feel attached enough to really stay in one city for long. Pack all your stuff - it's time to move on again.
entries.translated: Acasă este locul tău de vânătoare preferat actual și, deși s-ar putea să ții anumite locuri mai drag decât altele, nu te simți niciodată suficient de atașat pentru a rămâne într-adevăr într-un oraș pentru mult timp. Împachetați toate lucrurile - este timpul să treceți din nou mai departe.

entries.en: You told Jack the truth by explaining you and Spectulus made a mistake when trying to convince him of being a completely different person.
entries.translated: I-ai spus adevărul lui Jack explicându-i că tu și Spectulus ai făcut o greșeală când ai încercat să-l convingi că este o persoană complet diferită.

entries.en: You did not tell Jack the truth about the mistake you and Spectulus made when trying to convince him about being a completely different person. He will live in doubt until the end of his existence.
entries.translated: Nu i-ai spus lui Jack adevărul despre greșeala pe care tu și Spectulus ați făcut-o când încercați să-l convingeți că este o persoană complet diferită. Va trăi în îndoială până la sfârșitul existenței sale.

entries.en: You and your friends showed the three wizards your loyalty three times - I am sure at least one of them is probably eternally thankful and exceedingly proud of you.
entries.translated: Tu și prietenii tăi le-ai arătat celor trei vrăjitori loialitatea ta de trei ori - sunt sigur că cel puțin unul dintre ei este probabil vesnic recunoscător și extrem de mândru de tine.

entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You have found a {itemName}, but you have no room to take it.
entries.translated: Вы нашли {itemName}, но у вас нет места, чтобы его взять.

entries.en: You have found a {itemName}. Weighing {weight} oz, it is too heavy for you to carry.
entries.translated: Вы нашли {itemName}. При весе {weight} унции он слишком тяжел для вас.

entries.en: Paid {inventoryAmount} from inventory and {bankAmount} gold from bank account. Your account balance is now {balance} gold.
entries.translated: Выплачено {inventoryAmount} из инвентаря и {bankAmount} золота с банковского счета. Баланс вашего счета теперь составляет {balance} золота.

entries.en: Robbing, inviting yourself to VIP parties, faking contracts and pretending to be someone else - you're a jack of all trades when it comes to illegal activities. You take no prisoners, except for the occasional goldfish now and then.
entries.translated: Грабить, приглашать себя на VIP-вечеринки, подделывать контракты и выдавать себя за кого-то другого — вы мастер на все руки, когда дело касается незаконной деятельности. Вы не берете пленных, за исключением случайных золотых рыбок.

entries.en: You could be the author of the magnum opus 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. Or, if your mind and heart are pure, you rather summon beings to help others. Or maybe just a little cat to have someone to cuddle.
entries.translated: Вы могли бы стать автором великого произведения «Как вызвать абсолютного зверя из адских глубин, том I». Или, если ваш разум и сердце чисты, вы предпочитаете призывать существ на помощь другим. Или, может быть, просто маленькая кошечка, чтобы было с кем обниматься.

entries.en: You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
entries.translated: Вы разорвали древнего скарабея Fleshcrawler на части и позаботились о том, чтобы он не проник вам под кожу.

entries.en: You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
entries.translated: Ты дал zzze draken возможность оценить свой потрясающий ход.

entries.en: The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
entries.translated: Гномы сочувствуют вам. Один или два из них действительно могут потрудиться запомнить ваше имя. Вам разрешен доступ к их альфа-версии базы gnomebase. Вы готовы смело ступить своими большими ногами в места, где раньше мало кто бывал.

entries.en: Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
entries.translated: Снова и снова Deathstrike падает из-за вашего мастерства. Возможно, с этого момента пришло время людям называть YOU Deathstrike.

entries.en: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
entries.translated: Вы победили зловредный дуэт Друм и Фуга и восстановили порядок в осажденном городе Bounac. Вы завоевали экзотическую крепость Ордена Cobra и победили рыцарей-нежить Ордена Сокола. Настоящий рыцарь сердцем и разумом.

entries.en: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
entries.translated: Вы помогли Домициану и тем самым доказали, что достойны войти в святилище оборотней под Lion's Rock. Там вы столкнулись с могучими верльвами, и один из редких белых львов даже решил сопровождать вас.

entries.en: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
entries.translated: Вы победили Мегасильвана Изельду, следуя за спящей карнисильванской угрозой глубоко под Bounac.

entries.en: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
entries.translated: Это уже не первый раз, когда вы помогаете Сапфировому Клину или Полуночному Пламени с трудным заданием. Теперь вы можете носить килмарешские одежды, а также тагралтский клинок и расшитую глазами вуаль провидцев в знак благодарности Issavi.

entries.en: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
entries.translated: Ваши постоянные усилия по обеспечению безопасности Bounac и народа Кесара Младшего принесли вам постоянное место при королевском дворе в качестве советника короля.

entries.en: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
entries.translated: Вы выдержали палящую жару в туннелях глубоко под Kazordoon и победили Похитителя мозгов. Голоса в твоей голове наконец замолкают.

entries.en: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
entries.translated: Поздравляем с первым достижением! ... Ну, не совсем. Но представьте себе, это так. Потому что на этом этапе вашего путешествия в прошлое Tibia были введены достижения.

entries.en: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
entries.translated: Таинственные наги, яркие джунгли и тонущий остров — теперь вы действительно знаете каждый уголок Marapur.

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: Welcome, child. Have you come to learn about {magic}? Then you are in the right place. I can teach you many useful {spells}.
entries.translated: Benvenuto, bambino. Sei venuto a conoscere {magic}? Allora sei nel posto giusto. Posso insegnarti tante cose utili {spells}.

entries.en: Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
entries.translated: Gli incantesimi sono molto utili in combattimento, non solo per i maghi, anche se ovviamente facciamo affidamento su di essi in particolare per gran parte dei nostri danni. ...

entries.en: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
entries.translated: Ah, la bellezza del nostro mondo! È vasto e straordinariamente diversificato. Isole strane, città bellissime e mostri feroci che vagano per le terre selvagge. Misteri, avventure, pericoli dietro ogni angolo. ...

entries.en: Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
entries.translated: Una volta raggiunto il livello 8, sei pronto per scegliere una vocazione e andare nella terraferma di Tibian.

entries.en: Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
entries.translated: La scelta della tua vocazione determinerà la tua vita in Tibia e le abilità e le tecniche di combattimento che potresti utilizzare. ...

entries.en: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to know more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
entries.translated: Ci sono quattro vocazioni: cavaliere, druido, paladino e stregone. Se vuoi saperne di più su di loro, parla con Oressa nel tempio. ...

entries.en: I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
entries.translated: Io stesso insegno incantesimi di prova per entrambe le classi magiche, mentre Tybald nella stanza accanto è specializzato in incantesimi da cavaliere e da paladino.

entries.en: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
entries.translated: Una ragazza molto intelligente. Preferisce ascoltare i rumori degli animali selvatici anziché quelli degli esseri umani, il che è abbastanza comprensibile se ci si pensa. ...

entries.en: However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
entries.translated: Tuttavia, è anche una guaritrice molto abile e può darti consigli sulla scelta della tua vocazione.

entries.en: There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
entries.translated: Esiste un'ampia varietà di ciò che gli incantesimi possono fare, come vedrai man mano che avanzi. I prossimi incantesimi che puoi acquistare dal livello 8 in poi. ...

entries.en: Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
entries.translated: Alcuni incantesimi di attacco possono essere diretti contro un singolo bersaglio mentre altri influenzano un'area, avendo un effetto nel tempo o istantaneo. Anche altri incantesimi ti proteggono o possono essere usati per creare rune. ...

entries.en: Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
entries.translated: Ogni vocazione ha i propri incantesimi individuali che nessuna delle altre vocazioni può utilizzare. Puoi imparare gli incantesimi solo presso un addestratore di incantesimi della tua vocazione. ...

entries.en: The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
entries.translated: Gli incantesimi qui su Dawnport sono solo da provare e li dimenticherai una volta scelta la tua vocazione definitiva e partirai per la terraferma. ...

entries.en: There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
entries.translated: Lì puoi andare da un insegnante di incantesimi in una città per imparare permanentemente un incantesimo.

entries.en: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and quests than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
entries.translated: La terraferma offre molte più avventure, pericoli e missioni di questa piccola isola e ha anche insegnanti di incantesimi dove puoi imparare in modo permanente un incantesimo per la tua vocazione. ...

entries.en: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have enough gold! ...
entries.translated: Una volta raggiunto il livello 8 potrai scegliere la tua vocazione definitiva e partire per Main. Vai in una città e cerca l'allenatore di incantesimi della tua vocazione per imparare un incantesimo. E assicurati di avere abbastanza oro! ...

entries.en: The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable knowledge of a spell to a novice if they can pay the price.
entries.translated: L'arte dell'insegnamento degli incantesimi è complessa e pericolosa e trasmetteremo la nostra preziosa conoscenza degli incantesimi a un principiante solo se sarà in grado di pagarne il prezzo.

entries.en: Roughened and toughened by life's tragedies. A good man, but somber.
entries.translated: Irruvidito e indurito dalle tragedie della vita. Un brav'uomo, ma cupo.

entries.en: Yes, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.
entries.translated: Sì, bambino. Se desideri imparare un incantesimo, dimmelo.

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
entries.translated: До свидания, |PLAYERNAME|. Я очень надеюсь, что мы скоро снова поговорим.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?
entries.translated: О, привет |PLAYERNAME|, твои волосы выглядят великолепно! Кто сделал это для тебя?

entries.en: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
entries.translated: О, привет, красавчик! Приятно познакомиться, |PLAYERNAME|. С радостью, у меня есть время {chat} немного.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Да? Что я могу для тебя сделать, |PLAYERNAME|? Банковский бизнес, возможно?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в мою скромную обитель. Если вы пришли за новым колдуном {spells}, вы попали по адресу.

entries.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: Прощай, |PLAYERNAME|, я буду здесь, если я тебе снова понадоблюсь.

entries.en: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}
entries.translated: Рад тебя видеть. Я всегда рядом с твоим {shop options}

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Hi! I hope you're not going to kill me!
entries.translated: Привет! Надеюсь, ты не собираешься меня убивать!

entries.en: Remember: A joke a day keeps the ghouls away!
entries.translated: Помните: шутка в день отпугивает гулей!

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Привет, привет, привет, маленькая леди |PLAYERNAME|! Что приносит вам {here}?
Привет! У дураков тоже есть чувства.

entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: We would like to welcome you on board.
entries.translated: Am dori să vă urăm bun venit la bord.

entries.en: So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
entries.translated: Deci îmi ceri un {{}} pentru a-ți începe aventura?

entries.en: What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
entries.translated: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. Puteți să vă uitați și la {}.

entries.en: Excellent! Now, let me explain. If you donate 1.000.000.000 gold pieces, you will be entitled to wear a unique outfit. ...
entries.translated: Excelent! Acum, lasă-mă să explic. Dacă donați 1.000.000.000 de piese de aur, veți avea dreptul să purtați o ținută unică. ...

entries.en: Take this helmet as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
entries.translated: Luați această cască ca pe un semn de mare recunoștință. Să ne amintim pentru totdeauna această zi, prietene.

entries.en: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
entries.translated: Nu ai suficienți bani pentru a dona acea sumă.

entries.en: You need to donate {armor} outfit first.
entries.translated: Mai întâi trebuie să donezi {armor} ținută.

entries.en: Take this boots as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
entries.translated: Luați aceste cizme ca pe un semn de mare recunoștință. Să ne amintim pentru totdeauna această zi, prietene.

entries.en: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
entries.translated: Nu ai suficienți bani pentru a dona acea sumă.

entries.en: You need to donate {helmet} addon first.
entries.translated: Mai întâi trebuie să donezi suplimentul {helmet}.

entries.en: So you wold like to donate 500.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique armor?
entries.translated: Așadar, ați dori să donați 500.000.000 de piese de aur care, în schimb, vă vor da dreptul să porți o armură unică?

entries.en: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear unique helmet?
entries.translated: Așadar, ați dori să donați 250.000.000 de piese de aur care, în schimb, vă vor da dreptul să purtați o cască unică?

entries.en: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique boots?
entries.translated: Așadar, ai dori să donezi 250.000.000 de piese de aur care, în schimb, îți vor da dreptul să porți cizme unice?

entries.en: In exchange for a truly generous donation, I will offer a special outfit. Do you want to make a donation?
entries.translated: În schimbul unei donații cu adevărat generoase, voi oferi o ținută specială. Vrei să faci o donație?

entries.en: You can see the other side through it.
entries.translated: Puoi vedere l'altro lato attraverso di esso.

entries.en: You can see the other side through it.
entries.translated: Puoi vedere l'altro lato attraverso di esso.

entries.en: A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it
entries.translated: Отшельник рядом с Carlin может рассказать вам об этом больше.

entries.en: They offer little protection but will at least provide some comfort and warmth
entries.translated: Oferă puțină protecție, dar măcar vor oferi confort și căldură

entries.en: It seems strangely out of place in this surrounding.
entries.translated: Pare ciudat de deplasat în această zonă.

entries.en: You feel drawn to the mesmerizing light.
entries.translated: Te simți atras de lumina fascinantă.

entries.en: Zzaion is our last zztand! I will not leave wizzout a fight!
entries.translated: Ззайон — наш последний ззтанд! Я не оставлю wizzout бой!

entries.en: Feel the wrath of mother Tibia!
I will be still around when my 'noble' race is gone.
entries.translated: Я буду рядом, когда моя гонка 'noble' закончится.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
entries.translated: Så du ber mig om en {{}} för att börja ditt äventyr?

entries.en: What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
entries.translated: Vad? Jag har redan gett dig en {{}}!

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
entries.translated: Naturligtvis, bara bläddra igenom mina varor. Du kan också titta på {}.

entries.en: Excellent! Now, let me explain. If you donate 1.000.000.000 gold pieces, you will be entitled to wear a unique outfit. ...
entries.translated: Excellent! Låt mig nu förklara. Om du donerar 1 000 000 000 guldpjäser har du rätt att bära en unik outfit. ...

entries.en: Take this helmet as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
entries.translated: Ta den här hjälmen som ett tecken på stor tacksamhet. Låt oss för alltid minnas denna dag, min vän.

entries.en: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
entries.translated: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar för att donera det beloppet.

entries.en: Take this boots as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
entries.translated: Ta dessa stövlar som ett tecken på stor tacksamhet. Låt oss för alltid minnas denna dag, min vän.

entries.en: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
entries.translated: Du har inte tillräckligt med pengar för att donera det beloppet.

entries.en: You need to donate {helmet} addon first.
So you wold like to donate 500.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique armor?
entries.translated: Så du skulle vilja donera 500.000.000 guldpjäser som i gengäld ger dig rätt att bära en unik rustning?

entries.en: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear unique helmet?
entries.translated: Så du skulle vilja donera 250.000.000 guldpjäser som i gengäld ger dig rätt att bära unik hjälm?

entries.en: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique boots?
entries.translated: Så du skulle vilja skänka 250.000.000 guldpjäser som i gengäld ger dig rätt att bära en unik känga?

entries.en: In that case, return to me once you made up your mind.
entries.translated: I så fall, återvänd till mig när du bestämt dig.

entries.en: Take this armor as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend!
entries.translated: Ta denna rustning som ett tecken på stor tacksamhet. Låt oss för alltid minnas denna dag, min vän!

entries.en: Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
entries.translated: Se till att du har lediga platser i din butiks inkorg.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.en: Robbing, inviting yourself to VIP parties, faking contracts and pretending to be someone else - you're a jack of all trades when it comes to illegal activities. You take no prisoners, except for the occasional goldfish now and then.
entries.translated: Грабить, приглашать себя на VIP-вечеринки, подделывать контракты и выдавать себя за кого-то другого — вы мастер на все руки, когда дело касается незаконной деятельности. Вы не берете пленных, за исключением случайных золотых рыбок.

entries.en: You could be the author of the magnum opus 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. Or, if your mind and heart are pure, you rather summon beings to help others. Or maybe just a little cat to have someone to cuddle.
entries.translated: Вы могли бы стать автором великого произведения «Как вызвать абсолютного зверя из адских глубин, том I». Или, если ваш разум и сердце чисты, вы предпочитаете призывать существ на помощь другим. Или, может быть, просто маленькая кошечка, чтобы было с кем обниматься.

entries.en: You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
entries.translated: Вы разорвали древнего скарабея Fleshcrawler на части и позаботились о том, чтобы он не проник вам под кожу.

entries.en: You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
entries.translated: Ты дал zzze draken возможность оценить свой потрясающий ход.

entries.en: The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
entries.translated: Гномы сочувствуют вам. Один или два из них действительно могут потрудиться запомнить ваше имя. Вам разрешен доступ к их альфа-версии базы gnomebase. Вы готовы смело ступить своими большими ногами в места, где раньше мало кто бывал.

entries.en: Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
entries.translated: Снова и снова Deathstrike падает из-за вашего мастерства. Возможно, с этого момента пришло время людям называть YOU Deathstrike.

entries.en: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
entries.translated: Вы победили зловредный дуэт Друм и Фуга и восстановили порядок в осажденном городе Bounac. Вы завоевали экзотическую крепость Ордена Cobra и победили рыцарей-нежить Ордена Сокола. Настоящий рыцарь сердцем и разумом.

entries.en: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
entries.translated: Вы помогли Домициану и тем самым доказали, что достойны войти в святилище оборотней под Lion's Rock. Там вы столкнулись с могучими верльвами, и один из редких белых львов даже решил сопровождать вас.

entries.en: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
entries.translated: Вы победили Мегасильвана Изельду, следуя за спящей карнисильванской угрозой глубоко под Bounac.

entries.en: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
entries.translated: Это уже не первый раз, когда вы помогаете Сапфировому Клину или Полуночному Пламени с трудным заданием. Теперь вы можете носить килмарешские одежды, а также тагралтский клинок и расшитую глазами вуаль провидцев в знак благодарности Issavi.

entries.en: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
entries.translated: Ваши постоянные усилия по обеспечению безопасности Bounac и народа Кесара Младшего принесли вам постоянное место при королевском дворе в качестве советника короля.

entries.en: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
entries.translated: Вы выдержали палящую жару в туннелях глубоко под Kazordoon и победили Похитителя мозгов. Голоса в твоей голове наконец замолкают.

entries.en: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
entries.translated: Поздравляем с первым достижением! ... Ну, не совсем. Но представьте себе, это так. Потому что на этом этапе вашего путешествия в прошлое Tibia были введены достижения.

entries.en: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
entries.translated: Таинственные наги, яркие джунгли и тонущий остров — теперь вы действительно знаете каждый уголок Marapur.
Jurnalul dvs. de misiuni a fost actualizat.
Jurnalul dvs. de misiuni a fost actualizat.

entries.en: You gobbled enough slime to get a good grip on this dungeon's slippery floor.
entries.translated: Ai înghițit suficient slime pentru a prinde bine podeaua alunecoasă a temniței.

entries.en: The slime gobbler gobbles large chunks of the slime fungus with great satisfaction.
entries.translated: Înghițitorul de slime înghite bucăți mari din ciuperca slime cu mare satisfacție.

entries.en: Your VIP status has expired. All VIP benefits have been removed.
entries.translated: Statutul tău VIP a expirat. Toate beneficiile VIP au fost eliminate.

entries.en: Your VIP status is currently inactive.
entries.translated: Statutul tău VIP este momentan inactiv.

entries.en: Your VIP status has expired. All VIP benefits have been removed.
entries.translated: Statutul tău VIP a expirat. Toate beneficiile VIP au fost eliminate.

entries.en: You have been granted {days} days of VIP status.
entries.translated: Vi s-au acordat {days} zile de statut VIP.

entries.en: Your VIP status is currently inactive.
entries.translated: Statutul tău VIP este momentan inactiv.

entries.en: You have {time} of VIP time remaining.
entries.translated: Mai aveți {time} de timp VIP rămas.

entries.en: You are already in a party.
One minute of stamina has been refilled.
entries.translated: Un minut de rezistență a fost reumplut.

entries.en: One soul point has been restored.
entries.translated: Un punct de suflet a fost restaurat.

entries.en: You were kicked by exceding time inside the boss room.
entries.translated: Ai fost lovit de depășirea timpului în camera șefului.

entries.en: You are not the master of this hireling.

entries.translated: Nu poți controla mai multe creaturi.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

entries.en:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
entries.translated: Cóż, możesz być właśnie bohaterem, którego tam potrzebują. Prawdę mówiąc, część naszych najbardziej niezawodnych kopalń rudy zaczęła się wyczerpywać... \z Dlatego rozwinęliśmy nowe technologie parowców, by móc dalej badać i kartografować wielkie podziemne rzeki. Nasi bracia założyli bazę na kontynencie bardzo, bardzo daleko stąd... \z Nazywamy ją bazą bardzo, bardzo daleko. Ale ponieważ mamy nadzieję, że pewnego dnia stanie się kwitnącą kopalnią, większość z nas zaczęła nazywać ją {Farmine}. Krasnoludy na miejscu naprawdę potrzebują teraz pomocy.

entries.en: Oh, sweetheart, is there a problem with the quest? Should I {explain} it again?
entries.translated: Och, kochanie, jest jakiś problem z questem? Mam to znowu {explain}?

entries.en: Oh, welcome back, dear Isleth Eagonst! Are you here for a little chat? Just use the highlighted {keywords} again to choose a {topic}.
entries.translated: Och, witaj ponownie, drogi Isleth Eagonst! Przyszedłeś na małą pogawędkę? Użyj ponownie podświetlonych {keywords}, aby wybrać {topic}.
Do widzenia, podróżniku, uważaj na siebie.

entries.en: Ah, the wind brings in another visitor. Welcome, dear guest. Are you looking for a {passage} with my carpet?
entries.translated: Ach, wiatr przywiał kolejnego gościa. Witaj, drogi gościu. Szukasz {passage} na moim dywanie?

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
entries.translated: Naturalmente, basta sfogliare la mia merce. Puoi anche guardare {}.

entries.en: Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.
entries.translated: Ciao combattente. Immagino che tu sia qui per {fight} per il nostro nobile {cause}.

entries.en: We allow able champions of all races to fight for our cause against the challenges of the {arena}. So are you interested? I'm not interested in fancy'wordplay, so a simple {yes} or {no} will suffice!
entries.translated: Permettiamo ai campioni capaci di tutte le razze di lottare per la nostra causa contro le sfide del {arena}. Allora sei interessato? Non mi interessano i giochi di parole fantasiosi, quindi basterà un semplice {yes} o {no}!

entries.en: You are now able to enter the teleport.

This place has always been a site where the champions of summer and winter have clashed in battle. Over the centuries this spectacle has drawn many creatures here to watch, participate and indulge in less savory activities.
entries.translated: Questo luogo è sempre stato il luogo in cui i campioni dell'estate e dell'inverno si sono scontrati in battaglia. Nel corso dei secoli questo spettacolo ha attirato qui molte creature per osservare, partecipare e dedicarsi ad attività meno gustose.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
entries.translated: Non dimenticare di depositare i tuoi soldi qui alla Tibian Bank prima di partire per l'avventura.

entries.en: I have now no mission for you.
entries.translated: Ora non ho alcuna missione per te.

entries.en: You do not have all the required items.
entries.translated: Non hai tutti gli elementi richiesti.

entries.en: It seems you already have this addon, don't you try to mock me son!
entries.translated: Sembra che tu abbia già questo componente aggiuntivo, non provare a prendermi in giro, figliolo!

entries.en: You have no cookie that I'd like.
entries.translated: Non hai nessun biscotto che vorrei.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
entries.translated: До свидания, |PLAYERNAME|. Я очень надеюсь, что мы скоро снова поговорим.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?
entries.translated: О, привет |PLAYERNAME|, твои волосы выглядят великолепно! Кто сделал это для тебя?

entries.en: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
entries.translated: О, привет, красавчик! Приятно познакомиться, |PLAYERNAME|. С радостью, у меня есть время {chat} немного.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Да? Что я могу для тебя сделать, |PLAYERNAME|? Банковский бизнес, возможно?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в мою скромную обитель. Если вы пришли за новым колдуном {spells}, вы попали по адресу.

entries.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: Прощай, |PLAYERNAME|, я буду здесь, если я тебе снова понадоблюсь.

entries.en: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}
entries.translated: Рад тебя видеть. Я всегда рядом с твоим {shop options}

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Привет, привет, привет, маленькая леди |PLAYERNAME|! Что приносит вам {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, |PLAYERNAME|! Пусть земля защитит тебя на каменистых землях. Если вам нужен {passage}, я могу вам помочь.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Puteți cere binecuvântarea celor doi sori în bronzul de lângă Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Scânteia phoenixului este dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated:
Aceasta este o binecuvântare specială pe care ți-o pot acorda odată ce ai obținut cel puțin una dintre celelalte binecuvântări și care funcționează puțin diferit. ... \z
	Funcționează doar atunci când ești ucis de alți aventurieri, ceea ce înseamnă că cel puțin jumătate din daunele care au dus la moartea ta au fost cauzate de alții, nu de monștri sau de mediu. ... \z
	{twist of fate} nu va reduce pedeapsa cu moartea la fel ca celelalte binecuvântări, ci, în schimb, vă va împiedica să vă pierdeți celelalte binecuvântări, precum și amuleta pierderii, dacă purtați una. Costa la fel ca si celelalte binecuvantari. ... \z
	Ți-ar plăcea să primești acea protecție pentru un sacrificiu de |PVPBLESSCOST| aur, copile?

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
entries.translated: Ah, vrei să înlocuiești gratis piatra de aventurier?

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
entries.translated: Ah, vrei să înlocuiești piatra de aventurier cu 30 de aur?

entries.en: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
You don't have enough suspicious devices.

The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
entries.translated: Gnomii încă au nevoie de ajutorul tău, membru al Brigăzii lui Bigfoot. Demonstrează-ți valoarea răspunzând la apelurile lor! ({}/10)

entries.en: The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
entries.translated: Piticii încă au nevoie de ajutorul tău, membru al Brigăzii lui Bigfoot. Demonstrează-ți valoarea răspunzând la apelurile lor! ({}/10)

entries.en: The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
entries.translated: Cercetașii încă au nevoie de ajutorul tău, membru al Brigăzii lui Bigfoot. Demonstrează-ți valoarea răspunzând la apelurile lor! ({}/10)

entries.en: I don't need your help for now. Come back later.
entries.translated: Nu am nevoie de ajutorul tău deocamdată. Întoarce-te mai târziu.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it
entries.translated: Отшельник рядом с Carlin может рассказать вам об этом больше.

entries.en: It contains the ink of a freshly slain quara.
entries.translated: Conține cerneala unei cariere proaspăt ucise.

entries.en: Zzaion is our last zztand! I will not leave wizzout a fight!
entries.translated: Ззайон — наш последний ззтанд! Я не оставлю wizzout бой!

entries.en: Feel the wrath of mother Tibia!
I will be still around when my 'noble' race is gone.
entries.translated: Я буду рядом, когда моя гонка 'noble' закончится.

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated:
Detta är en speciell välsignelse som jag kan skänka dig när du har fått åtminstone en av de andra välsignelserna och som fungerar lite annorlunda. ... \z
	Det fungerar bara när du dödas av andra äventyrare, vilket betyder att minst hälften av skadan som ledde till din död orsakades av andra, inte av monster eller miljön. ... \z
	{twist of fate} kommer inte att minska dödsstraffet som de andra välsignelserna, utan istället hindra dig från att förlora dina andra välsignelser såväl som förlustamuletten, om du bär en. Det kostar lika mycket som de andra välsignelserna. ... \z
	Skulle du vilja få det skyddet för ett offer på |PVPBLESSCOST| guld, barn?

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
entries.translated: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten gratis?
Här är du. Ta hand om dig.

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
entries.translated: Ah, vill du byta ut din äventyrarsten mot 30 guld?
Här är du. Ta hand om dig.

entries.en: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
entries.translated: Tyvärr, du har inte tillräckligt med pengar.

entries.en: You don't have enough suspicious devices.
entries.translated: Du har inte tillräckligt med misstänkta enheter.
