entries.en: The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
entries.translated: Tomtarna är fortfarande i behov av din hjälp, medlem av Bigfoot's Brigade. Bevisa ditt värde genom att svara på deras samtal! ({}/10)

entries.en: The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
entries.translated: Dvärgarna är fortfarande i behov av din hjälp, medlem av Bigfoot's Brigade. Bevisa ditt värde genom att svara på deras samtal! ({}/10)

entries.en: The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
entries.translated: Scouterna är fortfarande i behov av din hjälp, medlem av Bigfoot's Brigade. Bevisa ditt värde genom att svara på deras samtal! ({}/10)

entries.en: I don't need your help for now. Come back later.
entries.translated: Jag behöver inte din hjälp just nu. Kom tillbaka senare.

entries.en: Come back when you have finished your job.
entries.translated: Kom tillbaka när du är klar med ditt jobb.

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!

entries.en: [World Change] Yasir has arrived in %s today!
Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.
entries.translated: Chi sei? Cosa vuoi? Sembri troppo esperto per diventare mio assistente. Per favore, vattene.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
entries.translated: Ciao |PLAYERNAME|! Hai bisogno di qualche attrezzatura per la tua casa?

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
entries.translated: Dai un'occhiata. La maggior parte dei mobili viene fornita in pratici kit. Usali a casa tua per assemblare i mobili. Vuoi vedere solo un certo {type} di mobili?

entries.en: This world is nothing without poetry, don't you think? It gives us hope, it envokes love. It's inciting and invigorating all the same.
entries.translated: Questo mondo non è niente senza la poesia, non credi? Ci dà speranza, invoca amore. È stimolante e rinvigorente allo stesso tempo.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.
entries.translated: Oh, ciao |PLAYERNAME|! Che carino da parte tua far visita a un vecchio come me.

entries.en: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
entries.translated: Torna ogni volta che hai bisogno di saggezza.

entries.en: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.en: Welcome to the paladins' guild, |PLAYERNAME|! How can I help you?
entries.translated: Benvenuto nella gilda dei paladini, |PLAYERNAME|! Come posso aiutarla?

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, |PLAYERNAME|! Пусть земля защитит тебя на каменистых землях. Если вам нужен {passage}, я могу вам помочь.
Добро пожаловать в мою скромную хижину, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Привет, |PLAYERNAME|! Вы, должно быть, довольно сильно пришли в себя. Мне всегда интересно узнавать что-то новое о Зао.

entries.en: Oh! Hi there! I guess you are here for the {endurance} test!

entries.translated: Bună! Bine ați venit la vârf.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You have no idea on how to use this device. Xelvar in Kazordoon might tell you more about it.
entries.translated: Вы понятия не имеете, как пользоваться этим устройством. Xelvar в Kazordoon может рассказать вам об этом больше.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
entries.translated: Hej |PLAYERNAME|! Behöver du lite utrustning till ditt hus?

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
entries.translated: Ta en titt. De flesta möbler kommer i praktiska kit. Använd dem bara i ditt hus för att montera möblerna. Vill du bara se en viss {type} möbler?

entries.en: You can only use the shrine on an valid item.
entries.translated: Du kan bara använda helgedomen på ett giltigt föremål.

entries.en: Put the construction kit on the floor first.
You may construct this only inside a house.
entries.translated: Du får endast bygga detta i ett hus.

entries.en: You may construct this only inside a house.
entries.translated: Du får endast bygga detta i ett hus.

entries.en: You need 5 players to fight with this boss.
entries.translated: Du behöver 5 spelare för att slåss med den här chefen.

entries.en: Someone is fighting against the boss! You need wait awhile.
entries.translated: Någon slåss mot chefen! Du måste vänta ett tag.

entries.en: You have entered an ancient demon prison cell!
entries.translated: Du har gått in i en gammal demonfängelsecell!

entries.en: You have fifteen minutes to kill and loot this boss, else you will lose that chance.
entries.translated: Du har femton minuter på dig att döda och plundra den här chefen, annars kommer du att förlora den chansen.

entries.en: This crystal geode is shaking from a battle nearby.
entries.translated: Denna kristallgeod skakar av en strid i närheten.

entries.en: This crystal geode is shaking from a battle nearby.
entries.translated: Denna kristallgeod skakar av en strid i närheten.

entries.en: This crystal geode is shaking from a battle nearby.
entries.translated: Denna kristallgeod skakar av en strid i närheten.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Welcome to the Hard Rock Racing Track, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Добродошли на тркачку стазу Хард Роцк, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, здраво, мала дамо |PLAYERNAME|! Шта вам доноси {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добродошли, млади |PLAYERNAME|! Ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вам {heal} бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добродошли, |PLAYERNAME|! Нека вас земља заштити на стеновитим теренима. Ако вам треба {passage}, могу вам помоћи.

entries.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
entries.translated: Ахои, |PLAYERNAME|. Хоћеш да купиш свежу рибу?

entries.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Поздрав, |PLAYERNAME|! Мора да си доста долазио. Увек сам заинтересован да научим нове ствари о Заоу.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Welcome on board, recruit |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, регрутујте |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Поздрав, смели авантуристе. Ако вам треба {passage}, јавите ми.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Welcome on board, Sir |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, господине |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: Збогом. Препоручите нас ако сте задовољни нашом услугом.

entries.en: Harrr, landlubber wha'd ya want? Askin' for a {passage}?
The Banshee Queen kissed you. This meant your death, and part of your soul always belongs to her now. You broke the last seal.
entries.translated: Królowa Banshee cię pocałowała. Oznaczało to twoją śmierć, a część twojej duszy zawsze należy teraz do niej. Złamałeś ostatnią pieczęć.

entries.en: You have braved all dangers of the Banshee Quest and escaped the dungeon alive. The end room is sealed for you from now on.
entries.translated: Stawiłeś czoła wszystkim niebezpieczeństwom związanym z Wyprawą Banshee i uciekłeś żywy z lochów. Od tej chwili ostatnie pomieszczenie jest dla ciebie zamknięte.

entries.en: Palimuth asked you to help with some sewer malfunctions. You will need a Crowbar, there are 4 places where you need to go marked with an X on your map.
entries.translated: Palimuth poprosił cię o pomoc w przypadku awarii kanalizacji. Będziesz potrzebował Łomu, są 4 miejsca, do których musisz się udać, zaznaczonych X na mapie.

entries.en: You cleaned 1 pipe of 4 from the garbage.
You cleaned 2 pipes of 4 from the garbage.
You cleaned 3 pipes of 4 from the garbage.
You cleaned 4 pipes of 4 from the garbage. Go back to Palimuth and report your mission
entries.translated: Wyczyściłeś 4 rury po 4 ze śmieci. Wróć do Palimuth i zgłoś swoją misję

entries.en: You cleaned all pipes from the garbage! Go back to Palimuth and ask for mission.
entries.translated: Oczyściłeś wszystkie rury ze śmieci! Wróć do Palimuth i poproś o misję.

entries.en: Palimuth told you that a circle of Yalahari is planning some kind of ritual. They plan to create a portal for some powerful demons and to unleash them in the city to 'purge' it once and for all.
entries.translated: Palimuth powiedział ci, że krąg Yalahari planuje jakiś rytuał. Planują stworzyć portal dla potężnych demonów i wypuścić je w mieście, aby raz na zawsze 'purge'.

entries.en: The entrance to their inner sanctum has been opened for you. Be prepared for a HARD battle! Better gather some friends to assist you.
entries.translated: Wejście do ich wewnętrznego sanktuarium zostało dla ciebie otwarte. Przygotuj się na TWARDĄ bitwę! Lepiej zbierz kilku przyjaciół, którzy ci pomogą.

entries.en: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow
entries.translated: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You have to wait a while before travel in time!
entries.translated: Bisogna aspettare un po' prima di viaggiare nel tempo!

entries.en: The mechanism takes you back in time.
entries.translated: Il meccanismo ti riporta indietro nel tempo.

entries.en: The mechanism takes you back in time.
entries.translated: Il meccanismo ti riporta indietro nel tempo.

entries.en: You crash the vial and spill the blood tincture. This altar is anointed.
entries.translated: Rompi la fiala e versi la tintura di sangue. Questo altare è unto.

entries.en: You've found a useful little tool for secret agents in the parcel.
entries.translated: Nel pacco hai trovato un piccolo strumento utile per gli agenti segreti.

entries.en: You hear a loud grinding sound not very far from you. something very heavy seems to have moved.
entries.translated: Senti un forte rumore stridente non molto lontano da te. qualcosa di molto pesante sembra essersi mosso.
Il nido delle tartarughe è vuoto.

entries.en: It is impossible to take along all of the treasures here. But you pick out {}
entries.translated: È impossibile portare con sé tutti i tesori qui. Ma tu scegli {}

entries.en: You try to pick a treasure, but you hear further dragons approaching. You should kill some more before picking out something.
entries.translated: Cerchi di raccogliere un tesoro, ma senti altri draghi avvicinarsi. Dovresti ucciderne altri prima di scegliere qualcosa.

entries.en: The grave is empty. Nothing than gaping void.
entries.translated: La tomba è vuota. Nient'altro che un vuoto spalancato.

entries.en: The grave is empty. Nothing than gaping void.
entries.translated: La tomba è vuota. Nient'altro che un vuoto spalancato.

entries.en: You already have the obedience of ursagrodon.
The ice cracked and the frozen creature with it - be more careful next time!
entries.translated: Il ghiaccio si è rotto e con esso la creatura congelata: fai più attenzione la prossima volta!

entries.en: You managed to melt about half of the ice blook. Quickly now, it's ice cold here and the ice block could freeze over again.
entries.translated: Sei riuscito a sciogliere circa la metà del blocco di ghiaccio. Presto qui fa freddo e il blocco di ghiaccio potrebbe congelarsi di nuovo.

entries.en: You managed to melt almost the whole block, only the feet of the creature are still stuck in the ice. Finish the job!
entries.translated: Sei riuscito a sciogliere quasi l'intero blocco, solo i piedi della creatura sono ancora bloccati nel ghiaccio. Finisci il lavoro!

entries.en: The freed ursagrodon look at you with glowing, obedient eyes.
entries.translated: L'Ursagrodon liberato ti guarda con occhi luminosi e obbedienti.

entries.en: You have found a {}. Weighing {} oz, it is too heavy.
entries.translated: Hai trovato un {}. Con un peso di {} oz, è troppo pesante.

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
entries.translated: Песчаная буря путешествует по Дараме, приводя к островам, полным смертоносных существ внутри кошмара. Избегайте реки возле Drefia!

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: You do not have the Chayenne's magical key.
entries.translated: У вас нет волшебного ключа Chayenne.

entries.en: Use these stairs to enter the Adventurer's Outpost on Dawnport.
entries.translated: Используйте эту лестницу, чтобы войти в Заставу Искателей приключений на Dawnport.

entries.en: Welcome to Dawnport! Walk around and explore on your own, or talk to Inigo if you need directions.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в Dawnport! Прогуляйтесь и исследуйте местность самостоятельно или поговорите с Иниго, если вам нужны указания.

entries.en: You have found a lovely oasis with green fauna and juicy fruit. You didn't expect that.
entries.translated: Вы нашли прекрасный оазис с зеленой фауной и сочными фруктами. Вы этого не ожидали.

entries.en: With you being the vessel binding the power of whitered souls, you step through the magic barrier.
entries.translated: Будучи сосудом, связывающим силу белых душ, вы преодолеваете магический барьер.

entries.en: The combined powers of decaying souls roaming these halls may help breach this barrier, it needs but a vessel to bind them.
entries.translated: Объединенные силы разлагающихся душ, бродящих по этим залам, могут помочь преодолеть этот барьер, для этого нужен лишь сосуд, чтобы связать их.

entries.en: With you being the vessel binding the power of whitered souls, you step through the magic barrier.
entries.translated: Будучи сосудом, связывающим силу белых душ, вы преодолеваете магический барьер.

entries.en: The combined powers of decaying souls roaming these halls may help breach this barrier, it needs but a vessel to bind them.

entries.en: As you cross the threshold in to the inner sanctuary of the cult of the Misguided, you feel an eerie presence all around you.
entries.translated: Когда вы пересекаете порог внутреннего святилища культа Misguided, вы чувствуете жуткое присутствие вокруг себя.

entries.en: You're entering the realm of dreams.
You do not have level 40+ or missing the Chayenne's magical key.
entries.translated: У вас нет уровня 40+ и вам не хватает волшебного ключа Chayenne.

entries.en: You started an escort, get everyone to safety!
entries.translated: Вы организовали эскорт, доставьте всех в безопасное место!

entries.en: A bit of warmth returns to your body as you leave the icy cavern.
entries.translated: Немного тепла возвращается в ваше тело, когда вы покидаете ледяную пещеру.

entries.en: You were killed by something evil and others.
entries.translated: Вас убило что-то злое и другие.

entries.en: You hear a loud grinding sound not very far from you. something very heavy seems to have moved.
entries.translated: Auzi un sunet puternic de măcinat nu foarte departe de tine. ceva foarte greu pare să se fi mutat.

entries.en: It is impossible to take along all of the treasures here. But you pick out {}
entries.translated: Este imposibil să iei cu tine toate comorile de aici. Dar alegi {}

entries.en: You try to pick a treasure, but you hear further dragons approaching. You should kill some more before picking out something.
entries.translated: Încercați să alegeți o comoară, dar auziți alți dragoni apropiindu-se. Ar trebui să mai ucizi înainte de a alege ceva.

entries.en: The grave is empty. Nothing than gaping void.
entries.translated: Mormântul este gol. Nimic decât un gol căscat.

entries.en: The grave is empty. Nothing than gaping void.
entries.translated: Mormântul este gol. Nimic decât un gol căscat.

entries.en: You already have the obedience of ursagrodon.
The ice cracked and the frozen creature with it - be more careful next time!
entries.translated: Gheața a crăpat și creatura înghețată cu ea - fii mai atent data viitoare!

entries.en: You managed to melt about half of the ice blook. Quickly now, it's ice cold here and the ice block could freeze over again.
entries.translated: Ai reușit să topești aproximativ jumătate din patul de gheață. Imediat acum, este rece ca gheața aici și blocul de gheață ar putea îngheța din nou.

entries.en: You managed to melt almost the whole block, only the feet of the creature are still stuck in the ice. Finish the job!
entries.translated: Ai reușit să topești aproape tot blocul, doar picioarele creaturii sunt încă blocate în gheață. Termină treaba!

entries.en: The freed ursagrodon look at you with glowing, obedient eyes.
entries.translated: Ursagrodonul eliberat se uită la tine cu ochi strălucitori, ascultători.

entries.en: You have found a {}. Weighing {} oz, it is too heavy.
entries.translated: Ați găsit un {}. Cântărind {} oz, este prea greu.

entries.en: You have found a {}. There is no room.
entries.translated: Ați găsit un {}. Nu este loc.
Ai găsit cornul de poștă al lui Waldo.

entries.en: You have discovered a deceased warrior's skeleton. It seems he tried to hunt the dragons around here - and failed.
entries.translated: Ai descoperit scheletul unui războinic decedat. Se pare că a încercat să vâneze dragonii de aici - și nu a reușit.

entries.en: Yakchal has already been awakened today. You should try again tomorrow.
entries.translated: Yakchal a fost deja trezit astăzi. Ar trebui să încerci din nou mâine.

entries.en: The frozen starlight shattered, but you have awoken the icewitch Yakchal from her slumber! She seems not amused...
entries.translated: Lumina înghețată a stelelor s-a spulberat, dar ai trezit-o pe vrăjitoarea de gheață Yakchal din somnul ei! Nu pare amuzata...

entries.en: First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
entries.translated: Сначала вам нужно будет убить трех носителей чумы, а затем получить Формулы алхимиков. Когда это будет сделано, возвращайтесь либо к Палимуту (хорошая сторона), либо к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона).

entries.en: Ask Azerus the Yalahari for a mission.
entries.translated: Попросите Azerus Ялахари дать вам задание.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Первый — принести Тамерину флакон с лекарством для животных, его можно купить у Сифлинда на Нибелоре (к северо-востоку от Svargrond).

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Сообщите Тамерину, он выслушает ваш запрос, и теперь вы сможете сделать свой выбор: крупный рогатый скот для Палимута (хорошая сторона), боевые звери для Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона). Затем сообщите тому, кому вы решили свою миссию.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вы решили помочь Azerus, сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Ялахари (Azerus) приказывает вам отправиться в Кладбищенский квартал и найти странную резьбу. Он дает вам Призрачное заклинание и просит зарядить его измученными душами призраков, чтобы использовать их в качестве источника энергии. Палимуту нужно заклинание заряженного призрака, чтобы освободить эти души. Теперь вы можете использовать механизм Кладбищенского квартала. Идите к большому зданию в Кладбищенском квартале и используйте заклинание призрака на странной резьбе в задней части комнаты.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Хорошая сторона: отправляйтесь к Палимуту, расспросите его о своей миссии и передайте амулет. Плохая сторона: спросите о вашей миссии в Ялахари (Azerus) и верните ее.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: Bad side: Yalahari (Azerus) will send you for a new mission to go to the Sunken Quarter and kill the Quara Leaders, Inky, Splasher and Sharptooth. Good side: Rather than fighting any Quara leaders Palimuth will instead send you to find the cause for the Quaras aggressive behavior. Find Maritima and talk to her about the Quara and she will explain what their problem is.
entries.translated: Плохая сторона: Ялахари (Azerus) отправит вас на новую миссию: отправиться в Затонувший квартал и убить Лидеров Квара, Инки, Брызги и Острозуба. Хорошая сторона: вместо того, чтобы сражаться с лидерами Квара, Палимут отправит вас найти причину агрессивного поведения Quaras. Найдите Маритиму и поговорите с ней о Кваре, и она объяснит, в чем их проблема.

entries.en: You killed the Quarabosses. Ask Azerus for a mission.
entries.translated: Вы убили Карабоссов. Попросите Azerus о миссии.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Вернитесь к Azerus и сообщите ему о своей миссии.

entries.en: You now need to decide between supporting Palimuth or the Yalahari's goal. To choose Palimuth's good side go to him, and simply ask him for a mission mission. Likewise, to join the Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side) go to him and say the same.
entries.translated: Теперь вам нужно решить: поддержать Палимута или цель Ялахари. Чтобы выбрать хорошую сторону Палимута, подойдите к нему и просто попросите его выполнить миссию. Аналогично, чтобы присоединиться к Ялахари (Azerus) (плохая сторона), подойдите к нему и скажите то же самое.

entries.en: By the way: The summoning of lesser creatures, the so-called 'reds', progressed comparatively well. Of course, these creatures are mere borderdwellers and may consequently not be considered true demons. However, it may prove that the development of summoning spells for 'reds' will prove a rewarding spin-off of demon summoning research.
entries.translated: Кстати: призыв меньших существ, так называемых 'reds', продвигался сравнительно хорошо. Конечно, эти существа всего лишь обитатели границ и, следовательно, не могут считаться настоящими демонами. Однако может оказаться, что разработка заклинаний призыва для 'reds' станет полезным побочным продуктом исследований по призыву демонов.

entries.translated: Поздравляем, вы прошли Dream Challenge. Теперь наслаждайтесь плодами своего успеха и расслабьтесь, прежде чем продолжить путь к встрече с мастером.

entries.en:
Diary of Hengis Wulfson
...
I can only hope I can escape the
cyclops someday. For now I have
occupied their chief with an attempt
to learn to read and write, but for
how long?
I'm so desperate.
What a foolish idea to travel here to
search the famous treasures of this
ancient, knightly order.
I wish I had never heard about it.
I wish I had never sung that song.
No clue how many unfortunate souls I
have lured to death with it.
entries.translated:
Дневник Хенгиса Вульфсона
...
Я могу только надеяться, что когда-нибудь мне удастся спастись от 
циклопа. На данный момент я
занимаю их начальника попыткой
научиться читать и писать, но
как долго?
Я в таком отчаянии.
Какая глупая идея поехать сюда, чтобы
искать знаменитые сокровища этого
древнего рыцарского ордена.
Мне бы хотелось никогда об этом не слышать.
Лучше бы я никогда не пел об этом песня.
Понятия не имею, сколько несчастных душ я
заманил ею на смерть.

entries.en: Digging. Not a single trace of any door or even a window. Maybe home of some obscure cult of darkness? Maybe creatures of the night? A hideout for ghouls? Maybe I am working not hard enough. Hm, there seems to be a strange spot there at the wall, I can see it clearly from here. I shall try to push or pull it right away! Fame and riches, here I come!
entries.translated: Копаем. Ни единого следа ни двери, ни даже окна. Может быть, это дом какого-то малоизвестного культа тьмы? Может быть, существа ночи? Убежище для гулей? Возможно, я работаю недостаточно усердно. Хм, кажется, там, у стены, есть странное пятно, я отсюда его хорошо вижу. Я попробую его тут же подтолкнуть или потянуть! Слава и богатство, вот и я!

entries.en: You have mastered Kuriks challenge in all possible shapes.
entries.translated: Ai stăpânit provocarea lui Kurik în toate formele posibile.

entries.en: With the assistance of your friendly little helper, you gobbled more than 500 chunks of slime. Well done, Slimer.
entries.translated: Cu ajutorul micului tău ajutor prietenos, ai înghițit peste 500 de bucăți de slime. Bravo, Slimer.

entries.en: You killed the raging mage in his tower south of Zao. Again. But this one just keeps coming back. The dimensional portal collapsed once more and you know he will eventually return but hey - a raging mage, it's like asking for it...
entries.translated: L-ai ucis pe magul furios în turnul lui la sud de Zao. Din nou. Dar acesta continuă să se întoarcă. Portalul dimensional s-a prăbușit încă o dată și știi că în cele din urmă se va întoarce, dar hei - un mag furios, e ca și cum ai cere asta...

entries.en: You caught fifty rare shimmer swimmers. Getting rid of all those corpses by dumping them into the lake really was worth it, wasn't it? Wait, didn't something move in the water just now...?
entries.translated: Ai prins cincizeci de înotători rari. Să scapi de toate acele cadavre aruncându-le în lac chiar a meritat, nu-i așa? Stai, nu s-a mișcat ceva în apă acum...?

entries.en: Many creatures of the deep have lost their lives by your hand. Three hundred have entered the depths of eternity. You should probably fear the revenge of the Eyes of the Deep.
entries.translated: Multe creaturi din adâncuri și-au pierdut viața de mâna ta. Trei sute au intrat în adâncurile eternității. Probabil că ar trebui să te temi de răzbunarea Ochilor Adâncului.

entries.en: You extinguished 500 thornfires! You were there when the Firestarters took over Shadowthorn. You saved the day - and the home of some elves which will try to kill you nonetheless. Isn't it nice to see everything restored just as it was before..?
entries.translated: Ai stins 500 de focuri de spini! Ai fost acolo când Firestarters au preluat Shadowthorn. Ai salvat ziua - și casa unor spiriduși care vor încerca totuși să te omoare. Nu este frumos să vezi totul restaurat așa cum a fost înainte...?

entries.en: You managed to kill more than four hundred white deer - it looks like you are one of the main reasons they will soon be considered extinct, way to go!
entries.translated: Ai reușit să omori mai mult de patru sute de căprioare albe - se pare că ești unul dintre principalele motive pentru care vor fi considerați în curând dispăruți, mai departe!

entries.en: You broke the jar of Horestis - fifty times. Either you know no fear or simply ignore it. Whatever the case, you are "fearless" indeed.
entries.translated: Ai spart borcanul lui Horestis – de cincizeci de ori. Fie nu cunoști frica, fie pur și simplu o ignori. Oricare ar fi cazul, ești într-adevăr „neînfricat”.

entries.en: Did someone call a doctor? You delivered 100 medicine bags to Ottokar of the Venore poor house in times of dire need, well done!
entries.translated: A sunat cineva un doctor? I-ai livrat 100 de pungi cu medicamente lui Ottokar de la casa săracă Venore în vremuri de mare nevoie, bravo!

entries.en: You significantly helped the afflicted citizens of Venore in times of dire need. Somehow you still feel close to the victims of the fever outbreak. Your clothes make you one of them, one poor soul amongst the countless afflicted.
entries.translated: Ați ajutat în mod semnificativ cetățenii afectați din Venore în vremuri de mare nevoie. Cumva te simți încă aproape de victimele focarului de febră. Hainele tale te fac unul dintre ei, un biet suflet printre nenumărații suferinzi.

entries.en: You vanquished the mad mage, you subdued the raging mage - no spellweaving self-exposer can stand in your way. Yet you are quite absorbed in magical studies yourself. This very fabric reflects this personal approval of the magic arts.
entries.translated: L-ai învins pe magul nebun, l-ai stăpânit pe magul furios - nici un autoexpozitor de vrăji nu îți poate sta în cale. Cu toate acestea, sunteți destul de absorbit de studiile magice. Chiar această țesătură reflectă această aprobare personală a artelor magice.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You found and took a sip from the Fountain of Life. Thought it didn't grant you eternal life, you feel changed and somehow at peace.
entries.translated: Znalazłeś i wypiłeś łyk z Fontanny Życia. Myślałam, że nie daje ci to życia wiecznego, czujesz się odmieniony i w jakiś sposób spokojny.

entries.en: You travelled the surreal realm of the elemental spheres, summoned and slayed the Lord of the Elements, all in order to retrieve neutral matter. And as brave as you were, you couldn't have done it without your team!
entries.translated: Podróżowałeś po surrealistycznej krainie sfer żywiołów, przyzywałeś i zabijałeś Władcę Żywiołów, a wszystko po to, aby odzyskać neutralną materię. I choć byłeś odważny, nie dałbyś rady bez swojego zespołu!

entries.en: You re-enacted the Taming of the Shrew on a beach setting and proved that you can handle capricious girls quite well. With or without fish tails.
entries.translated: Odtworzyłaś Poskromienie złośnicy na plaży i udowodniłaś, że całkiem nieźle radzisz sobie z kapryśnymi dziewczynami. Z rybimi ogonami lub bez.

entries.en: When you do something, you do it right. You have an opinion and you stand by it - and no one will be able to convince you otherwise. On a sidenote, you're a bit on the brutal and war-oriented side, but that's not a bad thing, is it?
entries.translated: Kiedy coś robisz, robisz to dobrze. Masz swoje zdanie i podtrzymujesz je - i nikt Cię nie przekona, że ​​jest inaczej. Na marginesie, jesteś trochę brutalny i nastawiony na wojnę, ale to nie jest złe, prawda?

entries.en: You're a peacekeeper and listen to what the small people have to say. You've made up your mind and know who to help and for which reasons - and you do it consistently. Your war is fought with reason rather than weapons.
entries.translated: Jesteś żołnierzem sił pokojowych i słuchaj, co mają do powiedzenia mali ludzie. Podjąłeś decyzję i wiesz, komu i z jakich powodów pomóc – i robisz to konsekwentnie. Wasza wojna toczy się rozumem, a nie bronią.

entries.en: You jump at every opportunity for a hunting challenge that's offered to you and carry out those tasks with deadly precision. You're a hunter at heart and a valuable member of the Paw & Fur Society.
entries.translated: Wykorzystujesz każdą okazję, aby podjąć oferowane ci wyzwanie łowieckie i wykonywać te zadania z zabójczą precyzją. W głębi serca jesteś myśliwym i cennym członkiem stowarzyszenia Paw & Fur Society.

entries.en: You're familiar with hunting tasks and have carried out quite a few already. A bright career as hunter for the Paw & Fur society lies ahead!
entries.translated: Zadania myśliwskie znasz i wykonałeś już ich sporo. Przed nami świetlana kariera myśliwego w stowarzyszeniu Paw & Fur!

entries.en: For you, a kiss is more than a simple touch of lips. You kiss maidens and deadbeats alike with unmatched affection and faced death and rebirth through the kiss of the banshee queen. Lucky are those who get to share such an intimate moment with you!
entries.translated: Dla Ciebie pocałunek to coś więcej niż zwykły dotyk ust. Całujesz dziewice i martwe istoty z niezrównanym uczuciem, a poprzez pocałunek królowej banshee stawiasz czoła śmierci i odrodzeniu. Szczęśliwi są ci, którzy mogą dzielić z Tobą tak intymne chwile!

entries.en: You've proven yourself as a worthy member of the 'family' and successfully carried out numerous spy missions for your 'uncle' to support the Venorean traders and their goals.
entries.translated: Udowodniłeś, że jesteś godnym członkiem 'family' i pomyślnie przeprowadziłeś liczne misje szpiegowskie dla swojego 'uncle', aby wspierać handlarzy z Venore i ich cele.

entries.en: Girl power! Whether you're female or not, you've proven absolute loyalty and the willingness to put your life at stake for the girls brigade of Carlin.
entries.translated: Moc dziewczyny! Niezależnie od tego, czy jesteś kobietą, czy nie, udowodniłaś absolutną lojalność i chęć poświęcenia życia dla brygady dziewcząt Carlin.

entries.en: Conspiracies and open secrets are your daily bread. You've shown loyalty to the Thaian crown through your courage when facing enemies and completing spy missions. You're an excellent field agent of the TBI.
entries.translated: Konspiracje i otwarte tajemnice to Twój chleb powszedni. Okazałeś lojalność wobec korony Thais poprzez swoją odwagę w starciach z wrogami i wypełnianiu misji szpiegowskich. Jesteś doskonałym agentem terenowym TBI.

entries.en: Pack your spy gear and get ready for some dangerous missions in service of a secret agency. You've shown you want to - but can you really do it? Time will tell.
entries.translated: Spakuj swój sprzęt szpiegowski i przygotuj się na niebezpieczne misje w służbie tajnej agencji. Pokazałeś, że chcesz – ale czy naprawdę możesz to zrobić? Czas pokaże.

entries.en: You're an aspiring mago-mechanic. Science and magic work well together in your eyes - and even though you probably delivered countless wrong charges while working for Telas, you might just have enough knowledge to build your own golem now.
entries.translated: Jesteś początkującym mago-mechanikiem. W twoich oczach nauka i magia dobrze ze sobą współdziałają – i choć prawdopodobnie podczas pracy dla Telasa dostarczyłeś niezliczoną ilość błędnych ładunków, być może posiadasz wystarczającą wiedzę, aby teraz zbudować własnego golema.

entries.en: Poems, verses, songs and rhymes you've recited many times. You have passed the cryptic door, raconteur of ancient lore. Even elves you've left impressed, so it seems you're truly blessed.
entries.translated: Wiersze, wiersze, piosenki i rymowanki, które recytowałeś wielokrotnie. Minąłeś tajemnicze drzwi, gawędziarz starożytnej wiedzy. Nawet na elfach zrobiłeś wrażenie, więc wygląda na to, że jesteś naprawdę błogosławiony.

entries.en: You can handle any music instrument you're given - and actually manage to produce a pleasant sound with it. You're a welcome guest and entertainer in most taverns.
entries.translated: Poradzisz sobie z każdym instrumentem muzycznym, jaki ci dasz – i faktycznie zdołasz wydobyć z niego przyjemny dźwięk. W większości tawern jesteś mile widzianym gościem i artystą.

entries.en: Zzaion is our last zztand! I will not leave wizzout a fight!
entries.translated: Ззайон — наш последний ззтанд! Я не оставлю wizzout бой!

entries.en: Feel the wrath of mother Tibia!
I will be still around when my 'noble' race is gone.
entries.translated: Я буду рядом, когда моя гонка 'noble' закончится.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!
