entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
entries.translated: Stackars gumman, hennes son {Tom} besöker henne aldrig.

entries.en: He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
entries.translated: Han stannar mest för sig själv. Han är en eremit utanför staden - lycka till att hitta honom.

entries.en: He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
entries.translated: Han är den lokala garvaren. Du kan försöka sälja färska lik eller läder till honom.

entries.en: Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
entries.translated: Vill du köpa en fotboll för 111 guld?

entries.en: Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
entries.translated: Här. Glöm inte att du måste köpa en etikett också om du vill skicka ett paket. Skriv alltid namnet på {receiver} på första raden.

entries.en: Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.
entries.translated: Hej, skicka ett brev till din vän då och då. Håll kontakten, du vet.

entries.en: If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
entries.translated: Behöver du hjälp med brev eller paket är det bara att fråga mig. Jag kan förklara allt.

entries.en: If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
entries.translated: Om du säger till mig namnet på en medborgare, ska jag berätta vad jag vet om honom eller henne.

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: För att se erbjudanden från en handlare, prata helt enkelt med honom eller henne och be om ett {trade}. De visar dig gärna sina erbjudanden och även de saker de köper av dig.

entries.en: Errrkss - coughcough - what the - heck did you put in there? Get out of my sight!
entries.translated: Errrkss - hosta - vad fan stoppade du in där? Försvinn ur min syn!

entries.en: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
entries.translated: Досадно дете. Брат га мрзи, али разговор не помаже. Брату треба {fighting spirit}!

entries.en: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, |PLAYERNAME|! Уђите, погледајте и купите! Ја сам специјалиста за све врсте {tools}. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде! Такође можете да ме питате за опште {hints} о игри. ...

entries.en: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
entries.translated: Можете ме питати и за сваки {citizen} на острву.

entries.en: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
entries.translated: Ја сам трговац. Само ме замолите за {trade} да видите моје понуде.

entries.en: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
entries.translated: Моје име је Ал Дее, али можете ме звати Ал. Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade}?

entries.en: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
entries.translated: То је око |TIME|. Жао ми је, немам сатове за продају. Да ли желите да купите нешто друго?

entries.en: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
entries.translated: Ако желите да истражите тамнице као што је {sewers}, морате сами {equip} са виталним стварима које продајем. То је {vital} у најдубљем смислу те речи.

entries.en: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
entries.translated: Ох, наш канализациони систем је веома примитиван - толико је примитиван да је прегажен за {rats}. Али ствари које продајем су безбедне од њих. Само ме замолите за {trade} да га видим!

entries.en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
entries.translated: Да ли сте се икада запитали о чему људи причају то 'main'? Па, када достигнете ниво 8, требало би да разговарате са {oracle}. Након тога можете изабрати {profession} и истражити много више од Tibia.

entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
entries.translated: Ох, извини, али ја се не бавим оружјем. То је {Obi's} или {Lee'Delle's} посао. Могао бих да вам понудим {pick} у замену за {small axe} ако га случајно поседујете.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
entries.translated: Оклоп и штитови се могу купити по цени {Dixi's} или {Lee'Delle's}. Дики води ту продавницу близу {Obi's}.

entries.en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
entries.translated: Боровнице расту на жбуњу. Они су прилично чести у Tibia. Само их уберите са грма ако вам треба ужина!

entries.en: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
entries.translated: Извини, не продајем напитке. За то би требало да посетите {Lily}.

entries.en: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
entries.translated: Хмм, најбоља адреса за тражење хране би могла бити {Willie} или {Billy}. {Norma} такође има неке грицкалице на продају.

entries.en: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
entries.translated: Банка је веома корисна. Тамо можете безбедно да положите свој новац. На овај начин не морате да га носите са собом све време. Такође можете уложити свој новац у мој {wares}!

entries.en: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
entries.translated: Да бисте видели понуде трговца, једноставно разговарајте са њим или њом и затражите {trade}. Они ће вам радо показати своје понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

entries.en: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
entries.translated: Научићете све што треба да знате о професијама када достигнете {Island of Destiny}.

entries.en: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
entries.translated: До Острва судбине можете доћи преко {oracle} када достигнете ниво 8. Ово путовање ће вам помоћи да одаберете свој {profession}!
Modo de autoloot establecido a TODO.

entries.en: [World Change] Yasir has arrived in %s today!
Lancer beetles troop up in Farmine. Beware!
entries.translated: Chrząszcze ułanów gromadzą się w Farmine. Strzec się!

entries.en: A pack of lancer beetles heads towards the coast!
entries.translated: Stado chrząszczy ułanów zmierza w stronę wybrzeża!

entries.en: The gnarlhounds seem to multiply by the minute.
entries.translated: Gnarlhoundy wydają się mnożyć z każdą minutą.

entries.en: The gnarlhounds roam free in the Zao Steppe. Watch out!
entries.translated: Gnarlhoundy wędrują swobodnie po Zao Steppe. Uważaj!

entries.en: Hello, |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to my little forge.
entries.translated: Ciao, |PLAYERNAME| e benvenuto nella mia piccola fucina.

entries.en: Hello my friend. What a delight to see you, even on a busy day. You can check your status or ask me about the location of ongoing raids.
entries.translated: Ciao amico mio. Che piacere vederti, anche in una giornata impegnativa. Puoi controllare il tuo stato o chiedermi informazioni sulla posizione dei raid in corso.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Hello! I guess you are here for a {mission}.
entries.translated: Ciao! Immagino che tu sia qui per un {mission}.

entries.en: Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
entries.translated: Addio, umano. Ti ricorderò sempre. A meno che non ti dimentichi, ovviamente.

entries.en: Farewell, human. I will always remember you. Unless I forget you, of course.
entries.translated: Addio, umano. Ti ricorderò sempre. A meno che non ti dimentichi, ovviamente.

entries.en: Greetings, dear guest and welcome to my {potion} shop.
entries.translated: Saluti, caro ospite e benvenuto nel mio negozio {potion}.

entries.en: Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.
entries.translated: Ciao combattente. Immagino che tu sia qui per {fight} per il nostro nobile {cause}.

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh and welcome to the furniture store.
entries.translated: Sii compianto pellegrino in carne e ossa e benvenuto nel negozio di mobili.

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?
entries.translated: Dai un'occhiata. La maggior parte dei mobili viene fornita in pratici kit. Usali a casa tua per assemblare i mobili. Vuoi vedere solo un certo tipo di arredamento?

entries.en: LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
entries.translated: VIVA LA REGINA! Puoi andartene adesso!

entries.en: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh and welcome to the magic store.
entries.translated: Sii compianto pellegrino in carne e ossa e benvenuto nel negozio di magia.
Possa l'illuminazione essere la tua strada.
Possa l'illuminazione essere la tua strada.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Good bye and please come back soon.
entries.translated: Arrivederci e per favore torna presto.

entries.en: Good bye and please come back soon.
entries.translated: Arrivederci e per favore torna presto.

entries.en: Sure, take a look. Apart from those, I also buy some of the possessions from famous demonlords and bosses. Ask me about it if you found anything interesting.
entries.translated: Certo, dai un'occhiata. Oltre a questi, compro anche alcuni dei beni di famosi signori dei demoni e boss. Chiedimelo se hai trovato qualcosa di interessante.

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Привет, привет, привет, маленькая леди |PLAYERNAME|! Что приносит вам {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, |PLAYERNAME|! Пусть земля защитит тебя на каменистых землях. Если вам нужен {passage}, я могу вам помочь.
Добро пожаловать в мою скромную хижину, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Привет, |PLAYERNAME|! Вы, должно быть, довольно сильно пришли в себя. Мне всегда интересно узнавать что-то новое о Зао.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome on board, recruit |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, набираем |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Приветствую тебя, отважный искатель приключений. Если вам нужен {passage}, дайте мне знать.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать на борт, |PLAYERNAME|. Где я могу {sail} тебе сегодня?

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: A fost o plăcere să vă ajut, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
entries.translated: Aruncă o privire. Majoritatea mobilierului vine în truse la îndemână. Folosește-le în casa ta pentru a asambla mobila. Vrei să vezi doar un anumit {type} de mobilier?

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: A fost o plăcere să vă ajut, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
entries.translated: Aici. Nu uitați că trebuie să cumpărați și o etichetă dacă doriți să trimiteți un colet. Scrieți întotdeauna numele lui {receiver} în primul rând.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Bun venit la bord, |PLAYERNAME|. Unde te pot {sail} astăzi?

entries.en: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: A fost o plăcere să vă ajut, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
entries.translated: Rețineți că nu veți găsi oferte mai bune aici. Doar răsfoiește-mi mărfurile.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
entries.translated: Bun venit, |PLAYERNAME|! Te simți aventuros? Vrei un {ticket} săptămânal pentru sistemul de vagoane de minereu de aici? Îl poți folosi chiar aici pentru a ajunge în centrul Kazordoon!

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: La revedere. Recomandați-ne dacă ați fost mulțumit de serviciile noastre.

entries.en: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
entries.translated: La revedere. Recomandați-ne dacă ați fost mulțumit de serviciile noastre.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: You have no idea on how to use this device. Xelvar in Kazordoon might tell you more about it.
entries.translated: Вы понятия не имеете, как пользоваться этим устройством. Xelvar в Kazordoon может рассказать вам об этом больше.

entries.en: Gnomedix: So let the examination begin! Now don't move. Don't be afraid. The good doctor gnome won't hurt you - hopefully!
entries.translated: Gnomedix: Итак, начнём осмотр! Теперь не двигайся. Не бойтесь. Добрый гном-доктор не причинит вам вреда – надеюсь!
<clong!> <clong!> <scrit scrit scrit>Acest lucru ar trebui să facă acest lucru.

entries.en: You find nothing of interest beneath the rubble.
entries.translated: Du hittar inget av intresse under spillrorna.

entries.en: Something clicked at same time a booming sound almost deafens you.
entries.translated: Något klickade samtidigt som ett bultande ljud nästan dövar dig.

entries.en: Something clicked at same time a booming sound almost deafens you.
entries.translated: Något klickade samtidigt som ett bultande ljud nästan dövar dig.

entries.en: Something clicked at same time a booming sound almost deafens you.
entries.translated: Något klickade samtidigt som ett bultande ljud nästan dövar dig.

entries.en: You are not allowed to use this yet.
entries.translated: Du får inte använda detta ännu.

entries.en: You hold the old chestplate of Galthein in front of you. It does not fit and far too old to withstand any attack.
entries.translated: Du håller Galtheins gamla bröstskylt framför dig. Den passar inte och alldeles för gammal för att stå emot någon attack.

entries.en: The device reads: 'abnormal glooth structure detected, possible probing location'
entries.translated: Enheten läser: "onormal glooth-struktur upptäckt, möjlig sonderingsplats"

entries.en: Hm... the device reads: 0,0,zero,0,zero which may roughly translate to: NOTHING OF INTEREST HERE
entries.translated: Hm... enheten läser: 0,0,zero,0,zero vilket ungefär kan översättas till: INGENTING AV INTRESSE HÄR

entries.en: You have successfully gathered the data.
entries.translated: Du har framgångsrikt samlat in data.

entries.en: You successfully harvest some juicy roots.
entries.translated: Du skördar framgångsrikt några saftiga rötter.

entries.en: Your harvesting attempt destroyed more of the juicy roots than you could salvage.
entries.translated: Ditt skördeförsök förstörde mer av de saftiga rötterna än du kunde rädda.

entries.en: You successfully harvest some juicy roots.
entries.translated: Du skördar framgångsrikt några saftiga rötter.

entries.en: Your harvesting attempt destroyed more of the juicy roots than you could salvage.
entries.translated: Ditt skördeförsök förstörde mer av de saftiga rötterna än du kunde rädda.

entries.en: This root has already been harvested, nothing to gain here.
entries.translated: Denna rot är redan skördad, inget att vinna här.

entries.en: The telescope provides a perfect view over the endless ocean - no land in sight
entries.translated: Teleskopet ger en perfekt utsikt över det ändlösa havet - inget land i sikte

entries.en: Once more you mix the chalk with a drop of your blood and a bit of water and renew the symbol on the floor...
entries.translated: Än en gång blandar du krita med en droppe av ditt blod och lite vatten och förnyar symbolen på golvet...

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Мортал! Ако сте на {quest} да служите богу крви, мој господару - буди поздрављен!

entries.en: Welcome to the Hard Rock Racing Track, |PLAYERNAME|.
entries.translated: Добродошли на тркачку стазу Хард Роцк, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Здраво, здраво, здраво, мала дамо |PLAYERNAME|! Шта вам доноси {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добродошли, млади |PLAYERNAME|! Ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вам {heal} бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добродошли, |PLAYERNAME|! Нека вас земља заштити на стеновитим теренима. Ако вам треба {passage}, могу вам помоћи.

entries.en: Ahoi, |PLAYERNAME|. You want to buy some fresh fish?
entries.translated: Ахои, |PLAYERNAME|. Хоћеш да купиш свежу рибу?

entries.en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
entries.translated: Поздрав, |PLAYERNAME|! Мора да си доста долазио. Увек сам заинтересован да научим нове ствари о Заоу.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Welcome on board, recruit |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, регрутујте |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
entries.translated: Поздрав, смели авантуристе. Ако вам треба {passage}, јавите ми.

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Welcome on board, Sir |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?
entries.translated: Добродошли на брод, господине |PLAYERNAME|. Где могу да вас {sail} данас?

entries.en: Harrr, landlubber wha'd ya want? Askin' for a {passage}?
Here ya go! Use it on the crane when you see the monster. Then refill it every time you use the telescope.
entries.translated: Изволите! Користите га на дизалици када видите чудовиште. Затим га допуните сваки пут када користите телескоп.

entries.en: Get the notes behind the Yalahari and read them. Talk to Azerus again and ask him for mission when you've read the notes.
entries.translated: Zdobądź notatki za Yalahari i przeczytaj je. Porozmawiaj ponownie z Azerus i po przeczytaniu notatek poproś go o misję.

entries.en: First you will need to kill the three plague bearers and then get The Alchemists' Formulas. When this have been done head back to either Palimuth (good side) or Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side).
entries.translated: Najpierw musisz zabić trzech nosicieli zarazy, a następnie zdobyć Formuły Alchemików. Kiedy już to zrobisz, wróć do Palimutha (dobra strona) lub Yalahari (Azerus) (zła strona).

entries.en: For this mission you are asked to go to the Trade Quarter and negotiate or threaten Mr. West. Once again you will gain access to the mechanism although if you choose to help Palimuth you should go through the sewers.
entries.translated: W tej misji musisz udać się do Dzielnicy Handlowej i negocjować lub grozić panu Westowi. Po raz kolejny uzyskasz dostęp do mechanizmu, chociaż jeśli zdecydujesz się pomóc Palimuthowi, warto przejść kanałami.

entries.en: You decided to help Palimuth, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Postanowiłeś pomóc Palimuthowi i zgłosić mu swoją misję.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Zdecydowałeś się pomóc Azerus, zgłoś mu swoją misję.

entries.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
entries.translated: Wróć do Azerus i zgłoś mu swoją misję.

entries.en: On this mission you are asked to find a druid by the name of Tamerin, on the Arena Quarter. You now have permission to use the gates mechanism.
entries.translated: W tej misji zostaniesz poproszony o odnalezienie druida o imieniu Tamerin w Dzielnicy Areny. Masz teraz uprawnienia do korzystania z mechanizmu bramy.

entries.en: The first is to bring Tamerin a flask of Animal Cure, you can buy this from Siflind on Nibelor (northeast of Svargrond).
entries.translated: Pierwszym z nich jest przyniesienie Tamerinowi butelki Animal Cure, którą możesz kupić od Siflinda na Nibelorze (na północny wschód od Svargrond).

entries.en: now you have to kill Morik the Gladiator and bring his helmet to Tamerin as proof.
entries.translated: teraz musisz zabić Gladiatora Morika i jako dowód przynieść jego hełm Tamerinowi.

entries.en: Report back to Tamerin as he will listen to your request and you can now make your choice: Cattle for Palimuth (good side), Warbeasts for Yalahari (Azerus) (bad side). Then report the one you decided your mission.
entries.translated: Zdaj raport Tamerinowi, który wysłucha twojej prośby i możesz teraz dokonać wyboru: Bydło dla Palimutha (dobra strona), Bestie bojowe dla Yalahari (Azerus) (zła strona). Następnie zgłoś tego, dla którego zdecydowałeś się na misję.

entries.en: You decided to help Palimuth, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Postanowiłeś pomóc Palimuthowi i zgłosić mu swoją misję.

entries.en: You decided to help Azerus, report him your mission.
entries.translated: Zdecydowałeś się pomóc Azerus, zgłoś mu swoją misję.

entries.en: Yalahari (Azerus) orders you to travel to the Cemetery Quarter and find the Strange Carving. He gives you a Ghost Charm and tells you to charge it with the tormented souls of the ghosts there to be used as an energy source. Palimuth wants the Charged Ghost Charm in order to free those souls. You can new use the Cemetery Quarter mechanism now. Go to the big building in the Cemetery Quarter and use the Ghost Charm on the Strange Carving at the back of the room.
entries.translated: Yalahari (Azerus) zleca ci udanie się do Dzielnicy Cmentarnej i odnalezienie Dziwnej Rzeźby. Daje ci Urok Ducha i każe naładować go udręczonymi duszami duchów, które się tam znajdują, i wykorzystać je jako źródło energii. Palimuth chce Zaklęcia Naładowanego Ducha, aby uwolnić te dusze. Możesz teraz na nowo skorzystać z mechanizmu Dzielnicy Cmentarnej. Udaj się do dużego budynku w Dzielnicy Cmentarnej i użyj Uroku Ducha na Dziwnej Rzeźbie z tyłu pomieszczenia.

entries.en: Good side: Go to Palimuth, ask him about your mission, and hand in the charm. Bad side: Ask about your mission to Yalahari (Azerus) and give it back.
entries.translated: Dobra strona: idź do Palimutha, zapytaj go o swoją misję i oddaj amulet. Zła strona: Zapytaj o swoją misję w Yalahari (Azerus) i oddaj ją.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow
entries.translated: Paw and Fur: The Old Widow

entries.en: Delivering letters and parcels has always been a secret passion of yours, and now you can officially put on your blue hat, blow your post horn and do what you like to do most. Beware of dogs!
entries.translated: Doręczanie listów i paczek od zawsze było Twoją sekretną pasją, a teraz możesz już oficjalnie założyć niebieski kapelusz, zadąć w róg pocztowy i robić to, co lubisz najbardziej. Uwaga na psy!

entries.en: You don't believe in romance to be a coincidence or in love at first sight. In fact - love potions, bouquets of flowers and cheesy poems do the trick much better than ever could. Keep those hormones flowing!
entries.translated: Nie wierzysz, że romans jest dziełem przypadku lub miłością od pierwszego wejrzenia. W rzeczywistości – eliksiry miłosne, bukiety kwiatów i tandetne wiersze radzą sobie znacznie lepiej niż kiedykolwiek. Utrzymuj przepływ tych hormonów!

entries.en: You're one of the few Tibians who Armenius chose to actually show his true face to - and he made you fight him. Either that means you're very lucky or very unlucky, but one thing's for sure - it's extremely rare.
entries.translated: Jesteś jednym z niewielu Tibijczyków, którym Armenius zdecydował się pokazać swoją prawdziwą twarz – i zmusił cię do walki z nim. Albo oznacza to, że masz dużo szczęścia, albo bardzo pecha, ale jedno jest pewne – zdarza się to niezwykle rzadko.

entries.en: People with sharp canine teeth better beware of you, especially at nighttime, or they might find a stake between their ribs. You're a merciless vampire hunter and have gathered numerous tokens as proof.
entries.translated: Osoby z ostrymi kłami lepiej się na ciebie strzegą, zwłaszcza w nocy, gdyż mogą znaleźć kołek między żebrami. Jesteś bezlitosnym łowcą wampirów i jako dowód zebrałeś liczne żetony.

entries.en: Robbing, inviting yourself to VIP parties, faking contracts and pretending to be someone else - you're a jack of all trades when it comes to illegal activities. You take no prisoners, except for the occasional goldfish now and then.
entries.translated: Okradanie, zapraszanie się na imprezy VIP, fałszowanie umów i udawanie kogoś innego – jesteś specjalistą od wszelkich nielegalnych działań. Nie bierzesz jeńców, z wyjątkiem okazjonalnych złotych rybek.

entries.en: You helped bringing Princess Buttercup, Doctor Dumbness and Lucky the Wonder Dog to life - and will probably dream of them tonight, since you memorised your lines perfectly. What a .. special piece of.. screenplay.
entries.translated: Pomogłeś ożywić Księżniczkę Jaskier, Doktora Dumbnessa i Cudownego Psa Lucky’ego – i prawdopodobnie będziesz o nich śnił dziś wieczorem, ponieważ doskonale zapamiętałeś swoje kwestie. Cóż za… wyjątkowy kawałek… scenariusza.

entries.en: You put out the Spirit of Fire's flames in the arena of Svargrond. Arena fights are for you - fair, square, with simple rules and one-on-one battles.
entries.translated: Zgasiłeś płomienie Ducha Ognia na arenie Svargrond. Walki na arenie są dla Ciebie - uczciwe, kwadratowe, z prostymi zasadami i bitwami jeden na jednego.

entries.en: You wiped out Orcus the Cruel in the Arena of Svargrond. You're still a bit green behind the ears, but there's some great potential.
entries.translated: Zniszczyłeś Orcusa Okrutnego na Arenie Svargrond. Nadal jesteś trochę zielony za uszami, ale jest w tym duży potencjał.

entries.en: You sent the Obliverator into oblivion in the arena of Svargrond and defeated nine other dangerous enemies on the way. All hail the Warlord of Svargrond!
entries.translated: Wysłałeś Obliveratora w zapomnienie na arenie Svargrond i po drodze pokonałeś dziewięciu innych niebezpiecznych wrogów. Witamy wodza Svargrond!

entries.en: You're one of the brave heroes to face and defeat the mysterious demon oak and all the critters it threw in your face. Wielding your blessed axe no tree dares stand in your way - demonic or not.
entries.translated: Jesteś jednym z odważnych bohaterów, którzy muszą stawić czoła tajemniczemu demonicznemu dębowi i wszystkim stworzeniom, które rzucił ci w twarz i pokonać je. Dzierżąc swój błogosławiony topór, żadne drzewo nie odważy się stanąć ci na drodze – demoniczne czy nie.

entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.translated: Prova a spostarti di più al centro di un %s per utilizzare l'energia spirituale per un teletrasporto.

entries.en: A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia!
entries.translated: Песчаная буря путешествует по Дараме, приводя к островам, полным смертоносных существ внутри кошмара. Избегайте реки возле Drefia!

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Вы внимательно изучаете свитки. Это приказ от Rathleton послу. Никаких признаков измены здесь нет.

entries.en: When the time comes, '%s' will be accepted at this shrine.
entries.translated: Когда придет время, '%s' будет принят в этом храме.

entries.en: You do not have the Chayenne's magical key.
entries.translated: У вас нет волшебного ключа Chayenne.

entries.en: Use these stairs to enter the Adventurer's Outpost on Dawnport.
entries.translated: Используйте эту лестницу, чтобы войти в Заставу Искателей приключений на Dawnport.

entries.en: Welcome to Dawnport! Walk around and explore on your own, or talk to Inigo if you need directions.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в Dawnport! Прогуляйтесь и исследуйте местность самостоятельно или поговорите с Иниго, если вам нужны указания.

entries.en: As you cross the threshold in to the inner sanctuary of the cult of the Misguided, you feel an eerie presence all around you.
entries.translated: Когда вы пересекаете порог внутреннего святилища культа Misguided, вы чувствуете жуткое присутствие вокруг себя.

entries.en: You do not have level 40+ or missing the Chayenne's magical key.
entries.translated: У вас нет уровня 40+ и вам не хватает волшебного ключа Chayenne.

entries.en: You are still blessed with Wisdom of Solitude, Spark of the Phoenix, Fire of the Suns, Spiritual Shielding, Embrace of Tibia, Heart of the Mountain, Blood of the Mountain, and Twist of Fate.
entries.translated: Вы по-прежнему благословлены Мудростью Одиночества, Искрой Феникса, Огнем Солнца, Духовной Защитой, Объятиями Tibia, Сердцем Горы, Кровью Горы и Иронией Судьбы.

entries.translated: Вы потеряли 0 опыта и 0,00% всех своих навыков.

entries.en: You did not lose any items.
entries.translated: Вы не потеряли ни одного предмета.

entries.en: The cold has all but disappeared from your body and you're getting warmer. You need to renew all preparations for purification.
entries.translated: Холод почти исчез из вашего тела, и вам становится теплее. Вам необходимо обновить все препараты для очищения.

entries.en: Due to the strength of an orc you are able to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Благодаря силе орка вы сможете пройти этот разлом.

entries.en: You need the strength of an orc to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Чтобы пройти этот разлом, вам понадобится сила орка.

entries.en: With the help off the might of an orc warlod you are able to pass this rift.
entries.translated: С помощью мощи военачальника орков вы сможете пройти этот разлом.

entries.en: You need the might of an orc warlod to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Чтобы преодолеть этот разлом, вам понадобится мощь орка-вождя.

entries.en: With the help of the wisdom of an orc shaman you are able to pass this rift.
entries.translated: С помощью мудрости орка-шамана вам удастся пройти этот разлом.

entries.en: You need the wisdom of an orc shaman to pass this rift.
entries.translated: Чтобы пройти этот разлом, вам понадобится мудрость орка-шамана.

entries.translated: У вас пока нет доступа к этому телепорту.

entries.translated: Puteți utiliza acest lucru numai în interiorul unei case.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?

entries.en: It was given to you by the djinn ma?tre and contains new recipes you cooked
entries.translated: Te lo dio el djinn ma?tre y contiene nuevas recetas que cocinaste.

entries.en: Supposedly the last will of someone. Whatever may have been written on it is long vanished.
entries.translated: Supuestamente la última voluntad de alguien. Todo lo que pudiera haber escrito en él hace tiempo que desapareció.

entries.en: Supposedly the last will of someone. Whatever may have been written on it is long vanished
entries.translated: Supuestamente la última voluntad de alguien. Lo que sea que haya sido escrito en él desapareció hace mucho tiempo.

entries.en: It is able to store memories and thoughts.
entries.translated: Es capaz de almacenar recuerdos y pensamientos.

entries.en: It is able to store memories and thoughts
entries.translated: Es capaz de almacenar recuerdos y pensamientos.

entries.en: It looks as if it was sealed with milky goodness
entries.translated: Parece como si estuviera sellado con bondad lechosa.

entries.en: You're never sure what demonic candy balls will do, but they sure taste sweet and exciting
entries.translated: Nunca estás seguro de qué harán las bolas de caramelo demoníacas, pero seguro que tienen un sabor dulce y emocionante.

entries.en: It's said to have incredible effects if you drink it while wearing certain magical rings. So it will not work on every kind of them
entries.translated: Se dice que tiene efectos increíbles si lo bebes mientras llevas ciertos anillos mágicos. Entonces no funcionará en todos los tipos de ellos.

entries.en: It contains the daily supply for Xodet's shop.
entries.translated: Contiene el suministro diario para la tienda de Xodet.

entries.en: It's an adorned ultimate healing rune
entries.translated: Es una runa curativa suprema adornada.

entries.en: It's an adorned ultimate healing rune
entries.translated: Es una runa curativa suprema adornada.

entries.en: It's an adorned heavy magic missile rune
entries.translated: Es una runa de misil mágico pesado adornada.

entries.en: It's an adorned heavy magic missile rune
entries.translated: Es una runa de misil mágico pesado adornada.
Laa la la la la la la la!

entries.en:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
entries.translated: Cóż, możesz być właśnie bohaterem, którego tam potrzebują. Prawdę mówiąc, część naszych najbardziej niezawodnych kopalń rudy zaczęła się wyczerpywać... \z Dlatego rozwinęliśmy nowe technologie parowców, by móc dalej badać i kartografować wielkie podziemne rzeki. Nasi bracia założyli bazę na kontynencie bardzo, bardzo daleko stąd... \z Nazywamy ją bazą bardzo, bardzo daleko. Ale ponieważ mamy nadzieję, że pewnego dnia stanie się kwitnącą kopalnią, większość z nas zaczęła nazywać ją {Farmine}. Krasnoludy na miejscu naprawdę potrzebują teraz pomocy.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated: To specjalne błogosławieństwo, którego mogę ci udzielić, gdy zdobędziesz przynajmniej jedno z pozostałych błogosławieństw, i działa ono nieco inaczej... \\z Działa tylko wtedy, gdy zabiją cię inni poszukiwacze przygód, co oznacza, że co najmniej połowa obrażeń prowadzących do twojej śmierci została zadana przez innych, a nie przez potwory czy otoczenie... \\z {twist of fate} nie zmniejsza kary za śmierć jak pozostałe błogosławieństwa, ale zamiast tego zapobiega utracie twoich innych błogosławieństw oraz amuletu straty, jeśli go nosisz. Kosztuje tyle samo, co pozostałe błogosławieństwa... \\z Czy chcesz otrzymać tę ochronę za ofiarę w wysokości |PVPBLESSCOST| sztuk złota, dziecko?

entries.en:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
entries.translated: Cóż, możesz być właśnie bohaterem, którego tam potrzebują. Prawdę mówiąc, część naszych najbardziej niezawodnych kopalń rudy zaczęła się wyczerpywać... \z Dlatego rozwinęliśmy nowe technologie parowców, by móc dalej badać i kartografować wielkie podziemne rzeki. Nasi bracia założyli bazę na kontynencie bardzo, bardzo daleko stąd... \z Nazywamy ją bazą bardzo, bardzo daleko. Ale ponieważ mamy nadzieję, że pewnego dnia stanie się kwitnącą kopalnią, większość z nas zaczęła nazywać ją {Farmine}. Krasnoludy na miejscu naprawdę potrzebują teraz pomocy.

entries.en: I WILL MAKE ALL OF YOU SUFFER!
EVEN WITH ALL THAT TIME IN THE PRISON THAT WEAKENED ME, YOU ARE NO MATCH TO ME!
entries.translated: AUN CON TODO ESE TIEMPO EN LA PRISIÓN QUE ME DEBILITÓ, ¡NO ERES COMPATIBLE PARA MÍ!

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

entries.en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
entries.translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

entries.en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
entries.translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

entries.en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
entries.translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: We hauled our explosives down there - and I mean ALL our explosives. Dangerous? Indeed, so we positioned someone down there to actually watch this depot. ...
entries.translated: Llevamos nuestros explosivos hasta allí... y me refiero a TODOS nuestros explosivos. ¿Peligroso? De hecho, colocamos a alguien allí para vigilar este depósito. ...

entries.en: I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
entries.translated: Controlo TODO desde esta sala, navegando por el destino de esta tierra desde hace más de un siglo. ¿Puedes ver todos estos embudos? ¡Mi voz viaja a través de ellos y por todo lo que hay aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
entries.translated: ¿Las piedras en la playa? ¿El comerciante de ahí arriba? ¡Ese era YO TODO EL TIEMPO! ¡Te atraje a TI para que crearas todo este caos allá arriba y aquí abajo! ...

entries.en: In the Dragonbone Cemetery, OBVIOUSLY! Must I explain EVERYTHING to you? Now go!
entries.translated: En el Cementerio Dragonbone, ¡OBVIAMENTE! ¿Tengo que explicarte TODO? ¡Ahora vete!

entries.en: Now... get out! And never, ever, dare come back! You ruined EVERYTHING!
entries.translated: Ahora... ¡fuera! ¡Y nunca jamás te atrevas a volver! ¡Arruinaste TODO!

entries.en: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
entries.translated: TODO LO QUE LLEVAS CONTIGO TAMBIÉN LO PUEDES ENCONTRAR EN MI {TREASURE}. ¡¡¡TRAEME ALGO QUE NO TENGO!!!

entries.en: In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
entries.translated: En la taberna, los piratas se sienten seguros y planean sus próximos ataques. Estudia TODOS sus mapas y planos que hay por ahí...

entries.en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
entries.translated: Al menos tengo a mi confiable {servants} ayudándome a limpiar. Ellos hacen TODO el trabajo. Quitando TODA la baba. Al menos están funcionando según lo previsto. Yo los diseñé, ¿sabes?
Fai attenzione durante i tuoi viaggi.

entries.en: I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
entries.translated: Posso insegnarti {healing spells}, {attack spells} e {support spells}. Che tipo di incantesimo desideri imparare? Puoi anche dirmi per quale livello vorresti imparare un incantesimo, se lo preferisci.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my offers.
entries.translated: Naturalmente basta sfogliare le mie offerte.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Quindi ricevi la protezione dello scherzo del destino, pellegrino.

entries.en: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
entries.translated: Quindi ricevi la protezione dello scherzo del destino, pellegrino.

entries.en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
entries.translated: Non hai un bell'aspetto. Mi spiace, non posso aiutarti. Ma se stai cercando una protezione aggiuntiva dovresti andare sullo {pilgrimage} di Ash o ottenere la protezione di {twist of fate} qui.

entries.en: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
entries.translated: Bene. Sei libero di rifiutare la mia offerta.

entries.en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
entries.translated: Ogni volta che ricevi una ferita letale, la tua forza vitale viene danneggiata e c'è la possibilità che tu perda parte del tuo equipaggiamento. Con ognuno dei cinque {blessings} che hai, questo danno e la possibilità di perdita saranno ridotti.

entries.en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

entries.en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
entries.translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

entries.en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

entries.en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

entries.en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
entries.translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
entries.translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

entries.en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
entries.translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

entries.en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
entries.translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.
Conserva bene la tua pietra dell'avventuriero.

entries.en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
entries.translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

entries.en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
entries.translated:
Questa è una benedizione speciale che posso concederti una volta ottenuta almeno una delle altre benedizioni e che funziona in modo leggermente diverso. ...\z
	Funziona solo quando vieni ucciso da altri avventurieri, il che significa che almeno la metà del danno che ha portato alla tua morte è stato causato da altri, non da mostri o dall'ambiente. ...\z
	Lo {twist of fate} non ridurrà la pena di morte come le altre benedizioni, ma invece ti impedirà di perdere le tue altre benedizioni e l'amuleto della perdita, se ne indossi uno. Costa lo stesso delle altre benedizioni. ...\z
	Ti piacerebbe ricevere quella protezione per un sacrificio di |PVPBLESSCOST| oro, bambino?

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
entries.translated: Ah, vuoi sostituire gratuitamente la tua pietra dell'avventuriero?

entries.en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
entries.translated: До свидания, |PLAYERNAME|. Я очень надеюсь, что мы скоро снова поговорим.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?
entries.translated: О, привет |PLAYERNAME|, твои волосы выглядят великолепно! Кто сделал это для тебя?

entries.en: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
entries.translated: О, привет, красавчик! Приятно познакомиться, |PLAYERNAME|. С радостью, у меня есть время {chat} немного.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: Да? Что я могу для тебя сделать, |PLAYERNAME|? Банковский бизнес, возможно?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать в мою скромную обитель. Если вы пришли за новым колдуном {spells}, вы попали по адресу.

entries.en: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
entries.translated: Прощай, |PLAYERNAME|, я буду здесь, если я тебе снова понадоблюсь.

entries.en: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}
entries.translated: Рад тебя видеть. Я всегда рядом с твоим {shop options}

entries.en: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
entries.translated: Привет. Чем я могу вам помочь |PLAYERNAME|? Попросите меня поставить {trade}, если хотите что-то купить. Я также могу объяснить систему {mail}.

entries.en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
entries.translated: О, пожалуйста, заходите, |PLAYERNAME|. Что я могу сделать для вас? Если вам нужно снаряжение для приключений, попросите у меня {trade}.

entries.en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
entries.translated: Конечно, просто просмотрите мои товары. {Footballs} необходимо приобретать отдельно.

entries.en: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
entries.translated: Привет |PLAYERNAME|. Я фермер и повар, может быть, я смогу вас заинтересовать {trade} с едой? Вы также можете задать мне общие вопросы {hints} об игре.

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
entries.translated: Смертный! Если вы находитесь на {quest}, чтобы служить богу крови, моему хозяину, добро пожаловать!

entries.en: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Привет, привет, привет, маленькая леди |PLAYERNAME|! Что приносит вам {here}?

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, юный |PLAYERNAME|! Если вы тяжело ранены или отравлены, я могу {heal} вас бесплатно.

entries.en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
entries.translated: Добро пожаловать, |PLAYERNAME|! Пусть земля защитит тебя на каменистых землях. Если вам нужен {passage}, я могу вам помочь.
Добро пожаловать в мою скромную хижину, |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
entries.translated: Ah, vrei să înlocuiești gratis piatra de aventurier?

entries.en: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
entries.translated: Ah, vrei să înlocuiești piatra de aventurier cu 30 de aur?

entries.en: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
Great! Alright, I need a while to finish this backpack for you. Come ask me later, okay?
entries.translated: Mare! Bine, am nevoie de ceva timp să termin acest rucsac pentru tine. Vino să mă întrebi mai târziu, bine?

entries.en: I know, it's quite some work... don't lose heart, just keep killing minotaurs and you'll eventually get lucky. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?
entries.translated: Știu, e destul de multă muncă... nu-ți pierde inima, continuă să omori minotauri și în cele din urmă vei avea noroc. Preferă să cumperi un rucsac normal pentru 10 aur?

entries.en: Ah, right, almost forgot about the backpack! Have you brought me 100 pieces of minotaur leather as requested?
entries.translated: Ah, corect, aproape că am uitat de rucsac! Mi-ați adus 100 de bucăți de piele de minotaur așa cum v-am cerut?

entries.en: Just in time! Your backpack is finished. Here you go, I hope you like it.
entries.translated: Tocmai la timp! Rucsacul tău este terminat. Poftim, sper să vă placă.

entries.en: Uh... I didn't expect you to return that early. Sorry, but I'm not finished yet with your backpack. I'm doing the best I can, promised.
entries.translated: Uh... Nu mă așteptam să te întorci așa devreme. Îmi pare rău, dar încă nu am terminat cu rucsacul tău. Fac tot ce pot, am promis.

entries.en: Sorry, but I can only make one backpack per person, else I'd have to close my shop and open a leather manufactory.
entries.translated: Îmi pare rău, dar nu pot face decât un rucsac de persoană, altfel ar trebui să-mi închid magazinul și să deschid o fabrică de piele.

entries.en: Well, if you really like this backpack, I could make one for you, but minotaur leather is hard to come by these days. Are you willing to put some work into this?
entries.translated: Ei bine, dacă îți place foarte mult acest rucsac, aș putea să-ți fac unul, dar pielea de minotaur este greu de găsit în zilele noastre. Ești dispus să depui ceva de lucru în asta?

entries.en: Alright then, if you bring me 100 pieces of fine minotaur leather I will see what I can do for you. You probably have to kill really many minotaurs though... so good luck!
entries.translated: Bine atunci, dacă îmi aduci 100 de bucăți de piele fină de minotaur, voi vedea ce pot face pentru tine. Probabil că trebuie să ucizi foarte mulți minotauri, totuși... așa că mult noroc!

entries.en: Sorry, but I don't run a welfare office, you know... no pain, no gain.
entries.translated: Îmi pare rău, dar nu conduc un birou de asistență socială, știi... fără durere, fără câștig.

entries.en: Sorry, but that's not enough leather yet to make one of these backpacks. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?
entries.translated: Ne pare rău, dar încă nu este suficientă piele pentru a face unul dintre aceste rucsacuri. Preferă să cumperi un rucsac normal pentru 10 aur?

entries.en: A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it
entries.translated: Отшельник рядом с Carlin может рассказать вам об этом больше.
